This study evaluates whether LLMs can identify meaningful revision unit boundaries in structured revision operation data and whether they provide value beyond simple non-LLM baselines. Using 113 matched draft--revision pairs from undergraduate writing, expert annotation yielded 4,344 candidate boundaries. We compared zero- and few-shot GPT-5.5 and base Qwen3-32B, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B, and majority and proximity-based baselines. Despite receiving revision context and task instructions, no prompted LLM condition outperformed the proximity heuristic (macro-F1 = .825). In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-32B using the two context representation achieved the highest macro-F1 (.859), identifying more same-unit relationships while maintaining precision comparable to the heuristic. Deterministic post-processing substantially improved the prompted models but added little benefit to the strongest fine-tuned model. These findings suggest that LLMs can support revision boundary judgment when task-adapted, but general purpose prompting alone may not outperform transparent structural heuristics.

</details>


### [128] [Shared Experience, Separate Learning: Companion Confidence Calibration for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33721)
*Shiyu Ni,Keping Bi,Jiafeng Guo,Yilong Xu,Jingtong Wu,Zengxin Han,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出CoCal，通过"共享经验但分离学习"的原则，在RLVR框架中训练轻量伴随模型来实现LLM的并发置信度校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在答错时仍高度自信，可靠的自我评估至关重要。现有并发校准方法在共享策略参数中同时学习能力和置信度，可能将两个本质不同的学习问题耦合在一起。

Method: 提出CoCal（伴随置信度校准），从rollout隐藏状态和验证器派生的正确性监督中训练一个轻量伴随模型，同时保持任务优化不变，实现能力与置信度的分离学习。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B上，CoCal提升了置信度估计且不损害任务性能，优于基于RL的并发方法和匹配的事后校准方法；学到的伴随模型可跨领域和策略变化泛化，且收益在两种规模上均持续存在。

Conclusion: 通过分离能力与置信度的优化机制，CoCal实现了可靠的并发置信度校准，具有良好的泛化性和规模稳定性。

Abstract: Reliable self-assessment is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet they often remain highly confident when their answers are wrong. We study \emph{concurrent confidence calibration}, where confidence is learned alongside capability improvement rather than calibrated only after training. Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural setting for this paradigm, as it continuously produces responses paired with verifiable correctness feedback. Existing concurrent methods, however, learn both capability and confidence through reinforcement learning within shared policy parameters, potentially coupling two fundamentally different learning problems. We instead propose \emph{shared experience but separate learning}: capability and confidence learn from the same trajectories, but through separate optimization mechanisms and parameters. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{CoCal (Companion Confidence Calibration)}, which trains a lightweight companion from rollout hidden states and verifier-derived correctness supervision while leaving task optimization unchanged. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B show that CoCal improves confidence estimation without sacrificing task performance, outperforming both RL-based concurrent methods and matched post-hoc calibration. The learned companion further generalizes across domains and policy shifts, while the benefits of CoCal persist at both scales.

</details>


### [129] [Yorùbá in Unicode: An Overview of a Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33734)
*Kólá Túbòsún*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 约鲁巴语等非洲语言所需的预组合字符未被 Unicode 编码，导致网络与计算机书写长期失效；本文记录该问题并主张向 Unicode 联盟申请正式编码四个核心约鲁巴字符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约鲁巴语等在网络上书写时依赖 Unicode 未编码的少量预组合字符，只能使用组合字符序列，导致跨平台行为不一致、字体替换下损坏、搜索失败。该问题多年难以解决，作者希望推动 Unicode 联盟直接干预。

Method: 通过个人经验与实证证据，记录从出版书籍、网络平台到手机键盘等多种真实场景中出现的失效情况，并分析其结构性原因。

Result: 识别出 Unicode 的 NFC 规范化稳定性政策是阻碍直接修复的结构性约束；现有组合字符方案在实际使用中不可靠。

Conclusion: 主张 Unicode 联盟介入解决这一现实问题，最持久的解决方案是为四个核心约鲁巴字符提出正式编码申请。

Abstract: There is a recurrent problem in the writing of Yorùbá on the internet and on the computer that has proven intractable over the years. The language, along with other African languages that depend on diacritics for disambiguation, requires a small set of precomposed characters that Unicode does not encode. This has forced writers and digital systems to rely on combining character sequences that behave inconsistently across platforms, corrupt under font substitution, and fail in search. This paper documents that failure across a range of real world contexts, from published books to web platforms to mobile keyboards, using personal and empirical evidence. It identifies Unicode's NFC normalization stability policy as the structural constraint that prevents a straightforward fix, arguing for direct intervention of the Consortium in solving the active problem, proposing a formal encoding request for the four core Yorùbá characters as the most durable path to resolution.

</details>


### [130] [The Effects of Incremental Instruction Delivery on Language-Model Creative Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33738)
*Anshuman Singh,Abrar Eyasir,Haseeb Yaqoob,John Manavalan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究多轮增量式写作指令是否损害创意写作质量。使用160个人类创作任务、6种体裁、6个模型家族共960对匹配样本，发现渐进式交付降低显式约束遵从并最大程度损害结构与连贯性，且该结构与连贯性差距无法仅用需求丢失解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益作为交互式写作工具，用户多轮逐步提出需求，而非一次性给出完整指令。但现有多轮指令退化证据多来自可客观验证的任务，不清楚增量交互是否会以显式需求检查无法捕捉的方式损害创造性作品。

Method: 在160个人类创作的创意写作任务（6种体裁）上，将同一意图规范以"一次性完整给出"或"分5-9轮逐步给出"两种方式，投放给6个不同的开放权重模型家族，得到960对匹配样本。定义Creative Integrity为联合需求遵从与叙事结构的紧凑指标，并进行50对匹配样本的三评分者人类研究验证。

Result: 渐进式交付降低显式约束遵从，并在结构/连贯性上产生最大写作质量退化。在观测遵从未平相同的输出中，结构差距依然存在，说明仅需求丢失无法解释结构差异。增量交付下模型保留71.2%的FULL Creative Integrity（95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]）。人类评审独立复现FULL在结构/连贯性、技巧和体裁有效性上的优势，自动评分与人类汇总评分正相关。

Conclusion: 交互式创意写作系统不仅应评估需求是否在对话中存活，还应评估不断演进的需求是否被连贯地整合进最终作品；显式需求遵从不足以刻画增量交互对创意产物的损害。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive writing tools, where users develop stories, revise ideas, and introduce new requirements across multiple turns rather than specifying a complete brief upfront. Yet most evidence on multi-turn instruction degradation comes from tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes, leaving unclear whether incremental interaction harms creative artifacts in ways that explicit requirement checks cannot capture. We study this question using 160 human-authored creative-writing tasks across six genres, presenting each intended specification either upfront or progressively over 5-9 turns to six distinct open-weight model families, yielding 960 matched pairs. Progressive delivery reduces explicit constraint adherence and produces its largest writing-quality degradation in structure/coherence. The structural gap persists among outputs with equal observed adherence, suggesting that measured requirement loss alone does not explain the observed structural difference. We define Creative Integrity as a compact measure of joint adherence and narrative structure; under incremental delivery, models retain 71.2% of FULL Creative Integrity (95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]). A three-rater human study over 50 matched pairs independently recovers FULL advantages in structure/coherence, craft, and genre effectiveness, while automated scores remain positively associated with aggregated human ratings. These findings show that interactive creative-writing systems should be evaluated not only on whether requirements survive conversation, but also on whether evolving requirements remain coherently integrated into the final artifact. Our dataset, benchmarks, and source code are available at: https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19

</details>


### [131] [Positions Are Not Facts: The Mismatch Between KV Caches and Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33759)
*Changhai Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Shiyang Zhang,Jun Gao,Zhen Li,Hua Wu,Hanchao Yu,Haifeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究语言模型如何更新KV缓存中的历史事实：比较三种策略（隐藏整条记录、仅隐藏被替换值、删除旧文本重算缓存），发现保留单元和对象依赖很重要，遮蔽整体优于删除重算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当事实变化时，语言模型需要更新KV缓存中存储的历史。简单隐藏旧记录虽然便宜，但可能丢失仍需要的细节或过往问题的答案，因此需要系统比较不同更新策略对当前和历史信息保留的影响。

Method: 在受控数量任务上，对比三种KV缓存更新方式：隐藏整条记录、仅隐藏被替换的值、删除旧文本重新计算缓存。测试八个模型，并考察多跳更新中位置重建与状态移动的影响，以及基于检测器选择的遮蔽与随机遮蔽的对比。

Result: 遮蔽使八个模型都更强烈偏好新值，但六个模型因单位错误或无法停止而丢失完整答案；保留单位可保全当前答案。多跳更新中在未变位置重建状态使历史准确率下降20-41个百分点，而移动现有状态影响很小。保留对象依赖和未变修订段落可防止许多损失。学习式读出在合成记录对上优于固定缓存相似度，但自然文本上检测器选择的遮蔽相比随机遮蔽在14个同模型对比中无明显优势。查询依赖访问可避免部分损失，但增加存储或访问成本。

Conclusion: 使用KV缓存作为可更新记忆时，必须保留被替换值之外的更多信息（如单位、对象依赖和未变上下文）；简单删除重算会损害历史准确率，识别旧记录也是独立挑战。

Abstract: When a fact changes, how should a language model update the history stored in its key-value (KV) cache? Hiding the old record is cheap, but it may still contain needed details or answer questions about the past. We compare hiding whole records, hiding only replaced values, and deleting old text and recomputing the cache. In a controlled quantity task, masking makes all eight models prefer the new value more strongly, yet six lose complete answers through unit errors or failure to stop; keeping the unit preserves all current answers. Later states also retain useful information from earlier records: on multi-hop updates, rebuilding these states at unchanged positions lowers historical accuracy by 20-41 percentage points, whereas moving the existing states has little effect. Keeping object dependencies and unchanged revision passages prevents many losses. Recognition is a separate challenge. Learned readouts recover distinctions missed by fixed cache similarities on synthetic record pairs. On natural text, text-detector-selected masks show no clear advantage over random masks at the same rate in 14 same-model detector-generator comparisons. Query-dependent access can avoid some losses, with additional storage or access costs. These findings identify what must be preserved beyond the replaced value when using a KV cache as updatable memory.

</details>


### [132] [LA-CPD: Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection for Human-LLM Authorship Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33787)
*Qing Yang,Zhenyu Mao,Zixiang Luo,Zezheng Wu,Xinghe Cheng,Qinggang Zhang,Jingwei Zhang,Jiapu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LA-CPD方法，将句子级噪声分数序列转化为连贯的作者归属分段，用于定位人机合著文档中的LLM撰写片段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM生成文本日益类人，准确定位人机合著文档中的LLM撰写片段对版权、欺诈等场景的归因和问责很重要。句子级检测器虽有局部证据，但内容差异导致同源句子分数波动，产生虚假边界，且作者归属转换的数量和位置都未知，难以恢复连贯的文档划分。

Method: LA-CPD结合长度加权的段内残差与窗口化双均值对比，以捕捉段一致性和候选切点周围的持续变化。用动态规划针对每个候选切分数优化切点位置，并用AIC式准则选择最终划分，输出句子标签、作者边界和最大LLM撰写片段。输入为冻结的局部检测器分数。

Result: 在留出的人机合著测试集上，LA-CPD优于WCP+AIC，句子级准确率从0.747提升到0.796，同时改善了边界定位和LLM片段刻画。

Conclusion: LA-CPD能有效将噪声句子级分数转化为连贯的作者归属分段，提升人机合著文档中LLM片段定位的准确性。

Abstract: As LLM-generated text becomes increasingly human-like, accurately localizing LLM-authored spans in human-LLM co-authored documents is important for attribution and accountability in cases involving copyright infringement, fraud, and other harmful uses of AI-generated content. Sentence-level detectors provide local authorship evidence, but content variation can cause score fluctuations even among sentences from the same source, creating spurious boundaries. Recovering a coherent document partition therefore remains challenging when both the number and locations of authorship transitions are unknown. We propose Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection (LA-CPD), a structured method that transforms noisy sentence-level score sequences into coherent authorship segments. Given scores from a frozen local detector, LA-CPD combines a length-weighted within-segment residual with a windowed two-mean contrast to capture segment consistency and sustained changes around candidate cut points. Dynamic programming optimizes cut locations for each candidate count, while an AIC-style criterion selects the final partition, yielding sentence labels, authorship boundaries, and maximal LLM-authored spans. On a held-out human-LLM co-authored test set, LA-CPD outperforms WCP+AIC, increasing sentence-level accuracy from 0.747 to 0.796 while improving boundary localization and LLM-span delineation.

</details>


### [133] [In-Context Adaptation of Encoder-Decoder Models in Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33865)
*Yen Meng,Sharon Goldwater,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探究上下文适应是否为所有编码器-解码器语音识别模型的固有能力。结果显示六种模型（含交叉注意力与LLM架构）均能开箱即用，词法信息与说话人信息均有贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM语音模型已展示通过交错语音-文本示例进行上下文适应，但尚不清楚这种能力是否是所有编码器-解码器模型的固有特性。

Method: 在六个编码器-解码器模型上研究拼合与交错两种示例形式；在三个英语数据集上做受控实验，分析词法与说话人信息的作用。

Result: 所有测试模型均能开箱即用进行上下文适应，oracle实验相对提升最高30%，使用首遍假设最高23%。词法和说话人信息均有贡献；交错示例在部分场景有效，拼合示例更一致。

Conclusion: ASR的上下文适应并非特定架构、训练或示例方式所独有，而是编码器-解码器模型的普遍能力。

Abstract: In-context learning offers an appealing approach to adapt automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to new speakers, accents, and domains by providing speech-text pairs as demonstrations at inference time. Recent work shows that some LLM-based speech models are capable of ASR in-context adaptation, when providing interleaved speech-text demonstrations. In this work, we ask whether in-context adaptation is an inherent ability for all encoder-decoder models. We study two forms of demonstration, collated and interleaved demonstration, across six encoder-decoder models, spanning conventional cross-attention-based and LLM-based architectures. We find that all tested models are able to perform in-context adaptation out of the box, achieving up to 30% relative improvement in the oracle experiments and up to 23% using first-pass hypotheses. Through controlled experiments on three English datasets, we show that lexical and speaker information both contribute to successful adaptation. While interleaved demonstration is effective in certain cases, collated demonstration brings consistent adaptation across the board. Our results suggest that in-context adaptation for ASR is not unique to specific architectures, training, or demonstration approaches.

</details>


### [134] [Lost with a Map: Conversational State and Behavioral Reliability in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33883)
*Atahan Dokme,Larry Heck*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究八个指令微调语言模型在任务型对话中如何表征、更新和使用对话状态，并提出一种基于结构读出的状态-动作控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务型对话需跨轮维护和更新信息，但语言模型没有显式的信念状态对象，其内部对话状态如何表征和使用尚不清楚。

Method: 在MultiWOZ和SGD上对四个家族八个指令微调模型进行探针分析、因果干预和闭环交互实验；基于发现，构建从基础模型动作出发、用结构读出选择性编辑动作的状态-动作控制器。

Result: 结构与值分离：域、槽、请求在动作前线性可读，而精确值在用户提及处更可读；用户改值后两个值仍可及并影响动作。闭环中查询失败分为结构支持弱、值解析错误、约束未部署三类。控制器将精确查询准确率从.318提升至.621，任务成功率从.272提升至.371，成本极小。

Conclusion: 可靠交互不仅需要保留对话信息，还需解析哪些可用约束当前适用，并确保其真正支配行动。

Abstract: Task-oriented dialogue requires maintaining and updating information across turns, yet language models expose no explicit belief-state object. We study how conversational state is represented, updated, and used inside eight instruction-tuned language models from four families on MultiWOZ and SGD. Structure and values separate: which domains, slots, and requests are active is linearly readable just before the model acts, whereas exact values are far more readable where the user stated them. After a user changes a value, both values remain accessible at their mentions, and causal interventions show that both continue to influence the model's action. In natural closed-loop interaction, query failures separate into cases of weak structural support, incorrect value resolution, and failure to deploy otherwise-supported constraints, with targeted interventions producing systematically different repair behavior across these cases. These findings motivate a state-action controller that starts from the base model action and selectively edits it using structural readouts, without requiring a complete predicted belief state as an intermediate representation. On held-out MultiWOZ interaction across five models, it raises the base model exact-query accuracy from .318 to .621 and task success from .272 to .371 at negligible added cost. Overall, reliable interaction requires not only retaining conversational information, but resolving which available constraints currently apply and ensuring that they govern action.

</details>


### [135] [LLMs learn different forms of metacognition when trained to predict their own accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33886)
*Nicolas Yax,Stefano Palminteri,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过训练10个开源LLM预测自身答案正确率，发现校准训练习得的置信度包含两种信号：近训练分布时跟踪真实准确率，其他域则跟踪输出一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被训练为总是给出答案，导致在缺乏知识时编造事实，且其置信度估计与实际表现对应不佳。尽管微调可改善校准，但模型在训练中究竟学到了什么尚不清楚，本文旨在探究LLM如何习得元认知监控能力。

Method: 训练10个开源权重LLM，使其在回答事实性多选题之前先预测自己的准确率，并分析训练后置信度所反映的信号来源。

Result: 训练后的置信度反映两种不同信号：在接近训练数据的题目上跟踪模型真实准确率；在其他领域则跟踪输出一致性（答案分布的集中度）。输出一致性跟踪在训练早期出现且可跨数据集泛化，而准确率跟踪出现较晚且局限于训练分布。

Conclusion: 校准训练可能并未教会模型普遍检测其自信犯下的错误，这引发了对人工系统中元认知本质的更广泛疑问。

Abstract: Large language models are trained to always produce an answer, regardless of whether they possess the relevant knowledge, which leads them to fabricate facts. Prior work has shown that LLMs' confidence estimates correspond poorly to their actual performance, and that fine-tuning can substantially improve them. However, what models actually learn during such training remains poorly understood. We investigate how LLMs acquire metacognitive monitoring, the ability to know what one knows, by training 10 open-weight LLMs to predict their own accuracy on factual multiple-choice questions before answering them. We find that trained confidence reflects two distinct signals. While on questions close to the training data, it tracks the model's true accuracy, in other domains, it instead tracks output consistency: the concentration of the model's answer distribution. Output consistency tracking emerges early in training and generalizes across datasets, whereas accuracy tracking develops later and remains local to the training distribution. These results suggest that calibration training may not teach models to generally detect errors they commit confidently, and they raise broader questions about the nature of metacognition in artificial systems.

</details>


### [136] [Faster Block-Diffusion Serving with Distribution-Free Risk Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33887)
*Jungseob Lee,Dongyub Jude Lee,Chanjun Park,Sugyeong Eo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Redline，一种有限样本方法，从校准提示上的正确性选择块扩散语言模型的操作点，将参考相对风险控制在高概率用户预算内，并部署最快通过的配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块扩散语言模型的操作点（如接受阈值、缓冲深度、调度、检查点、精度）常依据平均基准准确率手工挑选，但均值无法反映“较慢配置能答对、较快配置却答错”的频率，这种风险对实际部署至关重要。

Method: Redline是一种有限样本程序，基于校准提示的答案正确性来选择操作点（无论手工还是学习得到）。它把参考相对风险（即参考配置答对而候选配置答错的联合概率）以高概率控制在用户选择的预算内，并部署通过检验的最快配置。

Result: 在数学任务上比代码任务以更小风险预算实现加速；当预算为10%时，部署的LLaDA2数学配置每次前向多提交超过三分之一的token。该方法可无修改地用于推测解码的接受规则和权重量化。相同校准数据下，Redline保持其声明的失败概率，而平均准确率规则的各容忍度要么在某模型和任务上速度增益更小，要么在另一情形下远超风险预算。

Conclusion: Redline为块扩散语言模型（以及推测解码、权重量化）提供了一种以风险为约束的操作点选择框架，优于基于平均准确率的选择方法。

Abstract: Block-diffusion language models are served at hand-picked operating points, such as acceptance thresholds, buffer depth, schedule, checkpoint and precision, and each point is chosen by its mean benchmark accuracy. However, a mean does not tell an operator how often a faster configuration fails on prompts that the slower one answers correctly. On the serving engine and its decode traces, the default commit rule already commits every fully resolved block, a static skip rule captures nearly all of the compute that allocation can save, and self-distillation on engine-decoded targets adds speed at unchanged accuracy. Larger speedups come from lower thresholds, which commit tokens that are still uncertain. We therefore present Redline, a finite-sample procedure that selects operating points, hand-picked or learned, from the correctness of their answers on calibration prompts. Redline keeps the reference-relative risk, the joint probability that the reference answers correctly and a candidate configuration does not, within a user-chosen budget with high probability, and deploys the fastest configuration that passes. It speeds up math at a smaller risk budget than code in both model families, and at a budget of ten percent it deploys a LLaDA2 math configuration that commits over a third more tokens in each forward. It also applies without modification to the acceptance rule of speculative decoding and to weight quantization. On the same calibration data, Redline stays within its stated failure probability, whereas each tolerance of a mean-accuracy rule either gains less speed for some model and task or exceeds the risk budget far more often for another. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/Redline.

</details>


### [137] [NSV-Shift: A Contrastive Benchmark for Non-Speech Vocalization Understanding and Response Adaptation in Speech-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33899)
*Ziwei Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 NSV-Shift 对比基准，评估语音到语音模型能否理解非语音发声（NSV）并调整响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音对话模型多关注语言内容，是否理解非语音发声（如笑、叹气）的情绪含义并据此调整回应尚不清楚。

Method: 构建成对对话，词汇内容相同、仅最后一轮嵌入的 NSV 不同；试点含22个人工验证配对（44条音频），评估5个模型在NSV感知、情绪理解、响应适应三方面表现。

Result: 模型检测 NSV 的能力普遍优于解读其细粒度情绪含义，以及生成有差异化的恰当回应。

Conclusion: 模型对非语音发声明辨有余但理解与回应不足；数据构造与评测流程已开源。

Abstract: We introduce NSV-Shift, a contrastive benchmark for evaluating whether speech-to-speech models can understand non-speech vocalizations (NSVs) and adapt their responses accordingly. Each pair contains two conversations with identical lexical content that differ only in the NSV embedded in the final turn. Our pilot contains 22 human-verified pairs (44 audio conditions) and evaluates five models on NSV perception, emotion understanding, and response adaptation. Results show that models generally perform better at detecting NSVs than at interpreting their fine-grained emotional meaning or producing appropriately differentiated responses. The data construction pipeline, dataset, and evaluation pipeline are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenzwNina/nsv-construction.

</details>


### [138] [SlopBench: How Well Can We Rank Language Models by Slop? A Multi-Domain Benchmark of Repetitive AI Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33905)
*Dhruv Roongta,Harsha Gaddipati,Anh Tuan Huynh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SlopBench评估18个模型在112个手写任务上的"AI slop"表面特征，采样近2万输出，发现复合评分高度依赖权重，模型排序不稳定，故主张分别报告四项行为而非单一排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测器只能判断文本是否由机器生成，却无法回答"哪个模型产生读者口中的AI slop（僵硬、重复的文风）"这一问题。

Method: 在email、社媒、文章、职场聊天四类112个手写任务上，对18个模型每任务最多采样10次（共19,928输出）；评分四项可人工核验的表面行为：词数是否符合任务规定区间、同一模型同任务多次采样的开场重复、段落节奏、以及对照ChatGPT前人类语料的固定词汇结构。

Result: 固定权重下Kimi K2.6最低(21.1)、Mistral Large最高(40.6)；500次随机重加权中Kimi有58%最低、Mistral有97%最高；无一次保留18个模型的完整排序，场景bootstrap仅一个排名无歧义。众包竞技场、AI检测器、词汇多样性三项检查均未能确认中间排序。

Conclusion: 不给出单一复合排名，改为分别报告四项行为，将复合分数视为众多可能权重之一；公开提示、输出、参考统计与评分代码。

Abstract: SlopBench asks which models produce the stiff, repetitive prose readers call AI slop, a question detectors leave open once they have classified a text as machine-written. We evaluated eighteen models on 112 hand-written tasks in email, social posts, essays, and workplace chat, sampling each model on each task up to ten times, for 19,928 outputs in all. SlopBench scores four surface behaviors a reader can check by hand: length against the word band each task specifies, opener repetition across a model's own samples of one task, and paragraph rhythm and fixed lexical constructions against pre-ChatGPT human corpora. Under one fixed weighting, Kimi K2.6 scores lowest at 21.1 and Mistral Large highest at 40.6. Across 500 random reweightings Kimi has the lowest score in 58 percent of draws and Mistral the highest in 97 percent. No draw preserves the full order of the eighteen, and a scenario bootstrap leaves exactly one of those ranks unambiguous. We ran three further checks on that middle order: a crowd arena, an AI detector, and lexical diversity. None of them confirmed the order. We therefore report the four behaviors separately and treat the composite as one weighting among many, and we release the prompts, outputs, reference statistics, and scoring code.

</details>


### [139] [Quantization Error Is Spectrally Flat: A Single Random Probe Is a Calibrated, Data-Free Sensitivity Estimator, with Application to Budget-Targeted Mixed-Precision Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33923)
*I Kennedy,T Kennedy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出随机高斯探针估计量化误差Frobenius范数，实现无需校准数据的混合精度量化（RAM）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度量化需按张量敏感度分配比特，但现有方法依赖校准数据或真实激活，成本高且目标函数未必最优。

Method: 用单个随机高斯探针无偏估计量化误差平方Frobenius范数，传播输入统计量对六个比特宽度打分；用背包求解器在字节预算下分配比特，并设护栏避免灾难性2-bit。

Result: 探针CV可由形状预测，20个探针达1.3-1.4%精度；传播探针与GPTQ层目标相关0.81-0.83；在Qwen3.8-27B上击败IQ3_M与真实激活oracle；Qwen3-8B上与HAWQ-V2持平；7个架构上WikiText-2困惑度比均匀4-bit低3.5-13.6%。

Conclusion: 探针方法无需校准数据、单次遍历适用任意预算，效果优于均匀量化，表明真实激活目标并非正确分配目标。

Abstract: A single random Gaussian probe gives an unbiased estimate of the squared Frobenius norm of a layer's quantization error. The estimator is well-behaved because round-to-nearest error is spectrally flat. Across 1,683 tensors from a 35B MoE and a 9B dense model, effective dimensionality is 0.93 to 0.96 times the i.i.d. noise value of the same shape, and on the MoE the median is unchanged from 2-bit to 8-bit. The probe coefficient of variation is predictable from tensor shape. One probe measures per-tensor sensitivity to within 4 to 7%; twenty probes reach 1.3 to 1.4%.RAM applies the propagated form of this estimator to budget-targeted mixed-precision quantization with no calibration data. Gaussian probes carrying the network's own input statistics score every tensor at six bit-widths. A knapsack solver allocates bits under an exact byte budget, with guardrails against catastrophic 2-bit assignments. One probe pass serves any budget. Isolated and propagated scores rank tensors independently on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Spearman -0.01), yet the propagated probe rank-correlates 0.81 to 0.83 with the GPTQ layer objective from real activations, while the isolated estimator is uncorrelated with it. That objective is the wrong allocation target: at matched bytes on Qwen3.8-27B, a block-output probe beats a vendor IQ3_M mix and an oracle that allocates from the real-activation objective.On Qwen3-8B the propagated probe ties HAWQ-V2 at matched bytes. Across seven architectures from 8B to 122B, with probe timing up to a 400B model in nine minutes on one workstation, RAM reaches 3.5 to 13.6% lower median WikiText-2 perplexity than size-comparable uniform 4-bit builds on the tested MoE models

</details>


### [140] [Simple Diffusion Language Models Are More Effective Few-Step Generators Than Reported](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33947)
*Hasan Amin,Ming Yin,Rajiv Khanna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 采样器配置不当是扩散语言模型少步生成质量差的主因；简单"锐化"采样器无需重训即可让旧模型超越新方法，并揭示传统指标的缺陷与并行采样的理论问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)宣称能快速并行生成，但高质量样本需大量精炼步，削弱了实际优势，促使大量少步生成方法涌现。作者质疑这种"质量差距"是否真来自模型本身。

Method: 1) 对旧版掩码DLM仅做采样器锐化(sharpening)，不重训模型；2) 证明常规逐输出指标被"至多两个输出支撑的生成器"所混淆，提出GroupEval分别评估质量与跨输出语义多样性；3) 理论分析并行解掩蔽破坏同批token依赖导致预测-生成鸿沟，证明温度=1在并行采样下普遍次优，且更差预测可产生更好样本。

Result: 锐化后的旧DLM仅16步即达到标准采样器1024步的生成困惑度，且判定质量与语义多样性均提升；GroupEval发现蒸馏模型1.5-4.7倍困惑度增益无对应质量提升。

Conclusion: 主张更广的评估原则：以实际部署的生成器为比较对象，与调优基线对比，并将质量与多样性联合、以更贴近人类的指标评估。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise fast parallel generation, yet high-quality samples often require large number of refinement steps, which diminishes their advantage in practice. This has led to massive interest in and rapid development of new methods for effective few-step generation. We show that much of the supposed quality gap at few steps can instead arise from a suboptimally configured sampler. Modest sampler sharpening, without any model retraining, enables a couple years old masked DLM to rival supposedly far improved successors. This differently sampled DLM in fact achieves lower generative perplexity in just 16 steps than what its standard sampler obtains with 1024, while improving both judged quality and semantic diversity. We further show that conventional per-output metrics can fundamentally obscure these gains, since any optimal trade-off between two such metrics can be attained by a generator supported on at most two outputs. We subsequently introduce GroupEval, which separately evaluates quality and across-output semantic diversity, and offers fresh insights including uncovering how 1.5-4.7x perplexity gains of a distilled model yield no corresponding quality gain. Finally, we explain why sharpening helps: parallel unmasking destroys dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens, creating a gap between prediction and generation. We prove that pervasive temperature choice of one is generically suboptimal under parallel sampling even for an exact denoiser, and that worse predictions can yield better samples. Through these results, we argue for a broader evaluation principle of treating the deployed generator as the object of comparison, benchmarking it against tuned baselines, and assessing quality and diversity jointly and with more human-aligned measures.

</details>


### [141] [On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33970)
*Runjia Zeng,Hang Hua,Yiyang Liu,Zhiqiang Tao,Ruixiang Tang,Qifan Wang,Cheng Han,Dongfang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CoT推理中token价值高度不均，可用归一化对数概率区分核心token与冗余token；TokenProbe通过压缩冗余token实现推理质量保持下的token大幅节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-Thought提升复杂任务表现但显著增加token消耗，核心问题是推理轨迹中每个token是否同等重要。

Method: 基于token-level对数概率信号的诊断与优化框架；归一化对数概率区分核心token（结构性、决定性）与冗余token（探索性、低置信填充）；提出TokenProbe框架及高效GRPO目标，选择性压缩冗余token。

Result: 在保持推理质量的同时减少76%的token使用量；在相同推理长度预算下，甚至可超越Gemini-3.1-Pro等强基线。

Conclusion: CoT token价值非均匀性可被有效刻画，选择性压缩冗余token可在准确率-token效率空间实现帕累托改进。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has enabled large language models to achieve substantial performance gains on complex tasks. However, these gains come at the cost of dramatically increased token consumption. This raises a fundamental question: is every token in the reasoning trace equally valuable? We present a diagnostic and optimization framework grounded in a key empirical finding: the value of tokens within a CoT reasoning sequence is highly non-uniform, and this non-uniformity can be effectively characterized by token-level log probability signals. We show that normalized log probability helps distinguish core tokens, which carry structural and decisive reasoning content, from redundant tokens, which are exploratory, low-confidence filler that contributes less directly to the final answer. Building on these findings, we formulate the TokenProbe framework around two empirical findings and one claim: findings identify token value inequality first and then establish TokenProbe as a core-token proxy, and the claim introduces an efficient GRPO objective positing that selectively compressing redundant tokens can yield Pareto improvements in the accuracy-token efficiency space. Empirically, our method preserves reasoning quality while reducing the token usage by 76% of the baseline. Under matched reasoning-length budgets, we show that it can even outperform strong flagship baselines like Gemini-3.1-Pro. Homepage: https://runjia.tech/tokenprobe/.

</details>


### [142] [Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33971)
*Saman Sarker Joy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究决策系统的"概率一致性"问题：当同一决策被拆分为更小步骤时，模型概率分布可能自我矛盾。作者比较Jev与Laya（English）在TREC、CLINC150、MASSIVE上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型对每个问题给出的概率虽和为1，但将决策拆解后可能与自身不一致，这种"概率一致性"缺陷可能影响实际工作流中的准确率与置信度可靠性，需系统评估。

Method: 在Jev与English Laya上各用2,500匹配样本，覆盖三个数据集，共72,000个分类问题。对比直接细标签预测、宽类别概率、以及经宽类别重构的预测，测量类别级总变差距离及准确率变化（配对bootstrap区间）。

Result: 两系统均存在显著不一致：Jev类别级均总变差0.219–0.349，Laya为0.424–0.689。CLINC150上重构使Jev准确率降22.9个百分点，Laya升21.3个百分点，三数据集方向一致。Laya在MASSIVE上准确率升9.2点但校准误差从0.046升至0.124。

Conclusion: 决策系统需在应用工作流中联合评估准确率、置信校准与概率一致性，而非仅看单一指标。

Abstract: A decision model can give probabilities that sum to one for every question yet disagree with itself when the same decision is broken into smaller steps. We study this form of probabilistic coherence in Jev and the English Laya checkpoint, using 2,500 matched examples per system across TREC, CLINC150, and MASSIVE. Across 72,000 classification questions, we compare direct fine-label predictions with broad-category probabilities and predictions reconstructed through those categories. Both systems show substantial disagreement: mean category-level total variation ranges from 0.219 to 0.349 for Jev and from 0.424 to 0.689 for Laya, on a scale where zero means exact agreement. The consequences differ sharply. On CLINC150, reconstruction reduces Jev's accuracy by 22.9 percentage points (paired 95% bootstrap interval: [-24.9, -20.9]) and improves Laya's by 21.3 points ([18.0, 24.5]). The same directions hold across all three datasets, with all six unadjusted accuracy-change intervals excluding zero. Improved accuracy can also accompany less reliable confidence: on MASSIVE, Laya gains 9.2 accuracy points while its expected calibration error rises from 0.046 to 0.124. Error analysis identifies both broad-category mistakes and within-category confusions. These findings show why decision systems need joint evaluation of accuracy, confidence calibration, and probability coherence in the workflow used by an application.

</details>


### [143] [Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33974)
*Ruosong Ye,Caiqi Zhang,Jiahao Li,Haijun Wu,Xiaolong Luo,Huiyuan Chen,Yu Wang,Ying Chen,Zhenting Wang,Kai Mei,Yang Zhou,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出条件渐进剪枝（CPP）框架，在同等成本约束下让多智能体辩论（MAD）首次全面超越一致性方法和强单智能体基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MAD框架在严格成本限制下无法击败强单智能体与一致性基线，动摇了MAD领域的基础，因此需要更高效地利用多轮辩论。

Method: CPP（Conditional Progressive Pruning），一种轻量级剪枝框架，旨在充分挖掘多轮MAD的潜力。

Result: 在多个主流基准上，CPP优于所有现有MAD框架，并首次全面超越一致性方法。

Conclusion: CPP为MAD领域提供了更有效的测试时扩展方案，代码与详细智能体交互记录将开源。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is one of the most effective test time scaling techniques. Through multi-round communication, agents complement each other in knowledge and reasoning and solve tasks that no single member can solve. However, existing MAD frameworks fail to beat strong Single Agent and Consistency-based baselines under the same strict cost limit, which shakes the foundation of the MAD field. We propose Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP), a lightweight pruning framework that fully exploits multi-round MAD. CPP outperforms all existing MAD frameworks on multiple dominated benchmarks. It is also the first to fully outperform consistency methods. Our code, detailed agent interaction records will be released soon.

</details>


### [144] [High-Level Text Preprocessing for Semantic Similarity Analysis of Discursive Texts: A Framework and Empirical Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33983)
*Mehmet Murat Albayrakoglu,Mehmet Nafiz Aydin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"高层文本预处理"，通过12条规则在标准NLP流程前剥离论述性结构，隔离文档真实主张，缓解语义扩散问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STS方法假设文档词汇忠实反映其主张，但对讨论、比较、批判他人立场的论述性文档不成立，导致语义扩散：因论述性介入获得的词汇人为抬高相似度。标准NLP预处理仅在词汇层面操作，无法区分词汇的论述功能。

Method: 提出高层文本预处理：在标准流程前应用系统化规则干预。设计12条规则（每条附明确理由），在斯坦福哲学百科全书的三个词条（德性伦理、义务论伦理、后果主义）上验证。用8个Transformer STS模型进行三阶段实验，并提出语义扩散指数（SDI）衡量文档原始与预处理表示的语义重定向。

Result: 预处理降低了全部三对理论的质心余弦相似度；24个模型-配对比较中23个出现预期下降，跨模型一致度为7-1到8-0。

Conclusion: 该框架虽以哲学文本示范，但针对的是领域无关问题，可适用于法律文本、政策文件、学术论文等任何因论述方式引入非本国立场词汇的文体。

Abstract: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) methods assume that a document's lexical content faithfully represents what it asserts. This assumption fails for discursive documents that discuss, compare, critique, and contextualize other positions in the process of articulating their own. The result is semantic diffusion: similarity scores between documents are inflated by vocabulary acquired through discursive engagement rather than substantive alignment. Standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) preprocessing (tokenization, stopword removal, stemming, lemmatization) cannot address this problem because it operates at the lexical level, treating all content identically regardless of its discursive function. This paper introduces high-level text preprocessing: a systematic, rule-based intervention applied before the standard preprocessing pipeline to isolate each document's actual claim from its discursive structure. We propose 12 rules, each with an explicit rationale, and demonstrate their effect on an encyclopedic philosophical corpus: three entries from the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (virtue ethics, deontological ethics, and consequentialism). A three-phase experiment using eight Transformer-based STS models shows that preprocessing reduces centroid cosine similarity scores across all three theory pairs, with 23 of 24 model-pair comparisons showing the expected decrease and cross-model agreement ranging from 7-1 to 8-0. We introduce the semantic diffusion index (SDI), a per-document metric for assessing the semantic reorientation between a document's raw and high-level preprocessed representations. Although the framework is demonstrated using philosophical texts, it potentially addresses a domain-agnostic problem applicable to legal texts, policy documents, academic articles, and any genre in which a discursive approach introduces vocabulary from positions the document does not endorse.

</details>


### [145] [Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33987)
*Kai Mei,Zhiyuan Hu,Yutong Dai,Juntao Tan,Yifan Zhang,Dingjie Song,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Silvio Savarese,Ran Xu,Zeyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Opera 口头批评框架，将每次反馈作为持续跟踪的"note"，直到问题真正解决，在多个基准上提升解决率并可生成类 on-policy 训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程编码智能体需要及时纠错，但反馈若误判进行中的工作或未触及根本问题，可能无效甚至有害。现有 critic 只关注评估轨迹和生成反馈，很少追踪反馈交付后发生了什么。

Method: Opera 将每次纠错视为持久 note 并跟踪至问题解决：通过周期性及事件驱动触发决定何时审查；用类型化算子诊断问题；在交付前用可见证据审计反馈；并追踪智能体后续行为以区分"表面服从"与"真正解决"。

Result: 作为测试时 critic，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro 子集、DeepSWE v1.1 上将非 critic 智能体解决率分别提升最高 12.4、15.0、8.9 个百分点（跨四个策略模型），并在三个基准上取得竞品 critic 基线中最高的平均解决率；策略模型自我批评时亦有效。此外，Opera 引导的 rollout 可提供近似 on-policy 训练数据：用其微调 Qwen3.5-9B，在留出 SWE-Bench Pro 仓库上解决率提升 10.2 个百分点（推理时无需 critic），媲美用更强模型 rollout 微调，且在从 Openhands 切换到 Terminus-2 时保持性能（后者通常显著退化）。

Conclusion: Opera 通过"跟踪反馈后结果"的持续批评机制，既提升测试时纠错效果，又能生成高质量 on-policy 训练数据，兼顾推理与训练双重价值。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades.

</details>


### [146] [RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33989)
*Jingyi He,Nier Wu,Shuang Liu,Xin Wang,Mengnan Du,Xia Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RewardExplainer框架，通过反事实改写从奖励模型获取反馈来训练可复用的解释器，生成可干预的自然语言评分机制，并用于偏差识别与去偏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型（RM）只输出标量分数，难以识别其评分决策对应的响应行为。现有解释方法依赖预定义的高层属性，且需对每个响应对反复进行反事实干预来验证候选解释，缺乏一个利用RM反馈训练可复用解释器的闭环机制。

Method: RewardExplainer通过反事实改写从目标奖励模型获取反馈，并用该反馈进一步优化解释器。它生成开放式、原子化、可干预的自然语言评分机制，并将反事实反馈转化为偏好监督，使解释器更忠实地捕捉目标RM的评分偏好和敏感行为。

Result: 在多个目标RM和解释器骨干网络上进行大量实验，均取得一致的性能提升。此外，利用生成的机制识别潜在偏差模式，并构建针对性的去偏数据微调奖励模型，在reward-hacking基准上提升了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: RewardExplainer提供了一个闭环的解释框架，生成更具体、可读、可操作的评分机制，不仅改进了RM解释质量，还能用于偏差识别和去偏，增强奖励模型的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.

</details>


### [147] [Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34033)
*Haiyan Zhao,Zirui Hei,Wei Shi,Huiqi Deng,Na Zou,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AVPO是一个两阶段激活语言化框架，先由隐藏激活重建源文本，再用冻结的问答模型评估，并用DPO优化逆变器，提升语义恢复与词汇保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活语言化方法（如Activation Oracle、Natural Language Autoencoders）会产生不完整或幻觉性描述，难以信任和可靠使用。

Method: 两阶段框架：1) 从隐藏激活重建源文本；2) 用独立的冻结问答模型评估重建文本，得到显式可检查的中间读出。并用DPO优化逆变器，奖励同时捕捉语义可恢复性和词汇保真度。

Result: 在六类文本上，gist级和detail级信息恢复分别比最强基线提升最多17.1和9.3个百分点；增益来自偏好优化而非仅对选定重建的微调；紧凑的跨模型逆变器可超越同源的问题条件语言化器。OOD案例显示AVPO更好恢复高层语义且幻觉细节更少。

Conclusion: AVPO通过重建加评估的两阶段设计与DPO偏好优化，提升了激活语言化的可靠性和可检查性，减少了幻觉。

Abstract: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.

</details>


### [148] [Evaluating Machine Unlearning in ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34092)
*Diogo Dinis,Francisco Teixeira,Bhiksha Raj,Alberto Abad,Isabel Trancoso*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究机器遗忘(MU)在自动语音识别(ASR)中的适用性，发现基于梯度上升的算法在隐私-效用权衡上表现最佳，而复杂方法会过度遗忘；同时指出现有隐私评估方法和顺序/同时遗忘设定存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘在语音任务中受关注，但在自动语音识别(ASR)领域仍缺乏探索。作者希望验证现有MU算法与评估工具是否适用于ASR。

Method: 将多种MU技术应用于ASR模型，评估单主体遗忘的隐私-效用权衡；并对最佳算法在顺序遗忘和同时遗忘设定下进行测试。

Result: 梯度上升类算法取得较强的效用-隐私权衡；复杂方法会过度遗忘样本，使其更易被识别为已遗忘；基于简单成员推理攻击的隐私评估不足以可靠判断遗忘成功；顺序与同时遗忘的隐私和效用均劣于单主体遗忘。

Conclusion: 现有MU方法和评估工具对ASR适用性有限，需改进ASR中的遗忘评估方法，并设计更适合顺序与同时遗忘场景的遗忘构造方案。

Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) offers a path to compliance with "right to be forgotten" regulations. While MU has received increasing attention for speech tasks, it remains largely unexplored for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). In this work, we investigate whether existing MU algorithms and evaluation tools are suitable for ASR. We apply several MU techniques to an ASR model, evaluating privacy-utility trade-offs for single-subject unlearning, then assess the best algorithm under sequential and simultaneous unlearning. Results show that gradient ascent-based algorithms achieve strong utility-privacy trade-offs, whereas more complex approaches over-unlearn samples, making them easier to identify as unlearned. This suggests standard privacy evaluations based on simple Membership Inference attacks are insufficient to reliably assess unlearning success, motivating improved evaluation methods for MU in ASR. Finally, we show that both sequential and simultaneous unlearning yield worse privacy and utility than single-subject unlearning, underscoring the need for unlearning constructions better suited to these settings.

</details>


### [149] [Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34112)
*Nicolás Vera Zúñiga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将三态信息抽取（存在/缺失/未知）与决策逻辑（确定性代码计算分数边界）分离，可让LLM临床风险评分系统只在未知信息会改变决策时提问，从而减半提问量并避免过早判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床自由文本笔记常不完整，把未记录的发现当作"正常"会静默误分类患者。需要在信息缺失情况下安全地计算风险评分并避免不必要的提问。

Method: 在1200个合成急诊案例、6种评分工具上，对比"边界策略"（对未知输入计算分数上下界，仅追问能改变决策的问题）与全量追问、缺失即正常、端到端LLM agent（Claude Opus 5.5）；抽取器用Claude Haiku 4.5和9B本地模型；并在MedCalc-Bench的584份真实病例报告上评估信息充分性。

Result: 边界策略准确率与全量追问相当（99.4% vs 99.4%），提问量减半（0.92 vs 1.78/例）且无无关问题；缺失即正常准确率降至91.2%，8.5%患者被低估分诊。端到端agent理想条件下准确率99.6%但9.5%提问无关，噪声临床医生下准确率低于边界策略（83.5% vs 87.0%，p<0.001），且2.7%过早判断（边界策略0%）。9B本地模型达99.8%准确率。真实报告中仅52%含足够信息（HEART仅13%）。

Conclusion: 通过确定性代码显式推理未知信息来路由决策，可避免过早判断和无关提问、减半提问量，并可用小型本地模型实现，优于端到端LLM agent。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.

</details>


### [150] [Understanding Clinical Cognitive Dialogues Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34125)
*Vishalakshi Arumugam,Dan Schumacher,Veronica Rammouz,Enrique Gonzalez Guerrero,Jeremy Davis,Anthony Rios*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个去标识化的认知评估对话语料库（33段对话、8,250条话语，标注3种说话人角色和56种对话行为），并据此对大型语言模型进行细粒度对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成的基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对面认知评估既是测试也是互动，临床医生与患者在对话中会解释任务、修复误解、犹豫或寻求澄清，但临床对话资源很少标注研究这些行为所需的互动结构，导致难以大规模研究此类行为。

Method: 发布含33段认知评估对话、8,250条话语的语料库，标注3种说话人角色与56种对话行为；用其对大模型进行细粒度对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成基准测试；并检验域外指令数据与解释增强训练是否能迁移到该临床场景。

Result: 指令微调在患者话语参考匹配上表现最好并提升分类准确率；在LLaMA-3.1-8B各变体中，推理感知微调取得最佳分类结果。但即使最好的模型也难以区分相近的对话行为，说明宽泛的会话意图比细粒度的交际功能更易识别。

Conclusion: 该语料库与基准使认知评估中的互动结构变得可测量，支持会话标记、临床医生教育及经严格验证的模拟患者等后续研究。本工作不做诊断性声明，而是为研究这些应用提供数据和评估框架。

Abstract: In-person cognitive assessment is both a test and an interaction. Clinicians explain tasks, repair misunderstandings, and adapt to patient responses, while patients may hesitate, seek clarification, or disengage. Yet clinical dialogue resources rarely label the interaction structure needed to study these behaviors at scale. We present an de-identified corpus of 33 cognitive assessment conversations with 8,250 utterances annotated for three speaker roles and 56 dialogue acts. We use this corpus to benchmark large language models on fine-grained dialogue-act classification and next-patient-utterance generation. We also test whether out-of-domain instruction data and explanation-augmented training transfer to this clinical setting. Instruction tuning produces the strongest patient-utterance reference matching and improves classification accuracy. Reasoning-aware fine-tuning produces the strongest classification results among the LLaMA-3.1-8B variants. However, even the best models struggle to separate closely related dialogue acts, showing that broad conversational intent is easier to recognize than fine-grained communicative function. The corpus and benchmark make interaction structure measurable in cognitive assessments and support follow-up work on conversational markers, clinician education, and carefully validated simulated patients. This work does not make diagnostic claims. Instead, it provides the data and evaluation framework needed to study these applications.

</details>


### [151] [Word Similarity Datasets for Indian Languages: Annotation and Baseline Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34138)
*Syed S. Akhtar,Arihant Gupta,Avijit Vajpayee,Arjit Srivastava,M. Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了六种印度语言（乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、古吉拉特语）的人工标注单语词相似度数据集，并给出乌尔都语、泰卢固语和马拉地语基于最新词表示模型的基线评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 词表示出现后，词相似度任务日益成为评估词表示质量的重要指标，但印度语言缺乏此类标注数据集。

Method: 通过对英语词相似度数据集进行翻译和重新标注，构建六种印度语言的单语词相似度数据集；并在新数据集上评估最先进的词表示模型以获得基线评分。

Result: 获得六种印度语言的人工标注词相似度数据集，并给出乌尔都语、泰卢固语和马拉地语的词表示模型基线评分。

Conclusion: 该工作为印度语言的词表示评估提供了可用资源与基线参考。

Abstract: With the advent of word representations, word similarity tasks are becoming increasing popular as an evaluation metric for the quality of the representations. In this paper, we present manually annotated monolingual word similarity datasets of six Indian languages - Urdu, Telugu, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Gujarati. These languages are most spoken Indian languages worldwide after Hindi and Bengali. For the construction of these datasets, our approach relies on translation and re-annotation of word similarity datasets of English. We also present baseline scores for word representation models using state-of-the-art techniques for Urdu, Telugu and Marathi by evaluating them on newly created word similarity datasets.

</details>


### [152] [Quantitative Measurement of Language Distance among Closely Related Indo-European Languages Using Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on the North Germanic Branch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34152)
*Yiping Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于预训练语言模型的三维语言距离量化框架（语义距离、正字法碎片率、MLM可预测性），对丹麦语、挪威语（书面语）、瑞典语进行测量，三种指标一致得出da–no最近、da–sv最远的排序，与历史语言学结论吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 北日耳曼语支语言距离研究传统上依赖定性方法，缺乏统一的多维计算框架；预训练多语言模型可将不同语言映射到共享向量空间，为定量测量提供可能。

Method: 提出三维度量化框架：(1)句子级语义距离，用LaBSE与mBERT对平行句做余弦相似度；(2)正字法碎片率，测跨语言应用单语BERT词表时的子词切分效率；(3)MLM可预测性，比较mBERT掩码语言建模的置信度与熵。使用Tatoeba语料中150个三语平行句三元组作为控制样本。

Result: 两个独立模型给出一致距离排序：LaBSE下da–no 0.012 < no–sv 0.016 < da–sv 0.020；mBERT下da–no 0.016 < no–sv 0.045 ≈ da–sv 0.046。该排序与历史语言学结论（丹麦统治挪威400年导致书面语高度同源）一致。

Conclusion: 语义、正字法、可预测性三种指标收敛于同一结论，为近缘语言距离量化研究提供了可复现的计算框架，原则上可扩展至印欧语系更多语支，但需在更多语群上验证。

Abstract: Among closely related North Germanic languages, the quantification of language distance has traditionally relied on qualitative methods, lacking a unified multi-dimensional computational framework. Multilingual pretrained models based on the Transformer architecture can map texts from different languages into a shared vector space, enabling quantitative measurement of language distance. This paper focuses on the three North Germanic languages---Danish, Norwegian (Bokmål), and Swedish---and proposes a three-metric quantitative framework based on pretrained language models: (1)~sentence-level semantic distance, computed as cosine similarity between LaBSE and mBERT encodings of parallel sentences; (2)~orthographic fragmentation rate, measuring subword tokenization efficiency when cross-applying monolingual BERT vocabularies to parallel texts; (3)~MLM predictability, comparing prediction confidence and entropy in masked language modeling using mBERT across languages. Using 150 trilingual parallel sentence triplets from the Tatoeba corpus as controlled samples, we obtain consistent distance rankings on two independent models: LaBSE: da--no $0.012 < $ no--sv $0.016 < $ da--sv $0.020$; mBERT: da--no $0.016 < $ no--sv $0.045 \approx $ da--sv $0.046$. This ranking is consistent with the historical linguistic conclusion that ``400 years of Danish rule over Norway (1380--1814) led to highly cognate written languages.'' The three metrics---semantic, orthographic, and predictability---converge on the same conclusion, providing a reproducible computational framework for the quantitative study of distance among closely related languages, extensible in principle to more branches of the Indo-European language family, pending validation on additional language groups.

</details>


### [153] [Toward a Graded Measure of Belief Stability in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34158)
*Samantha Dies,Branden Fitelson,Tina Eliassi-Rad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"分级信念稳定性"(graded belief stability)，一种衡量LLM中某信念在其整体信念系统中是否稳固的关系性指标，与单条信念概率不同。用Direct Conditional估计器从内部表征估计条件信念概率，在12个LLM和3个领域中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益中介人们获取和推理信息的过程，但事实可靠性通常只按单次判断评估。需要一种超越单条信念强度、衡量信念是否在整个信念系统中获得支撑的评估方式。

Method: 提出graded belief stability——关系性度量，考察某主张与模型其他认知承诺共同考虑时其支持是否持续。用Direct Conditional估计器，基于模型内部表征估计条件信念概率。

Result: 在12个LLM、3个领域中，控制单条信念概率匹配后，低稳定性信念在83.3%的模型-领域设置中表现出更大的对话挑战下的行为漂移。

Conclusion: 分级信念稳定性将可靠性评估从"LLM多强支持某主张"扩展到"该信念在其更广泛信念体系中获得多稳固的支持"。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people access and reason with information, yet factual reliability is usually evaluated one judgment at a time. We introduce graded belief stability, a relational measure of how well a belief persists within an LLM's broader belief system. Unlike individual belief probability, it asks whether support for a claim persists when that claim is considered alongside the model's other epistemic commitments. We operationalize this idea with a Direct Conditional estimator that uses internal model representations to estimate conditional belief probabilities. Across 12 LLMs and three domains, lower-stability beliefs exhibit greater mean behavioral movement under conversational challenge in 83.3% of model-domain settings after matching on individual belief probability. Graded belief stability therefore extends reliability assessment beyond how strongly an LLM supports a claim to how robustly that belief is supported within its broader system of beliefs.

</details>


### [154] [LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34187)
*Julia Witte Zimmerman,Calla G. Beauregard,Tabia Tanzin Prama,Parisa Suchdev,Kathryn Cramer,Elisabeth Kollrack*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文用"人造语言"任务测试LLM能否超越统计模式匹配，结果支持意义中介的抽象能力，反驳强随机鹦鹉假说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强随机鹦鹉假说认为LLM虽能生成流畅文本，但只能做统计模式匹配，无法实现抽象或推理。论文希望在无示例输出、且训练数据中的表层统计模式往往与正确答案相悖的条件下，检验模型是否真能依据提示中的约束进行规则遵循。

Method: 设计conlang式任务：只给LLM虚构语言的自然语言描述，这些语言组合了统计上罕见且未出现过的特征，不提供任何示例输出。通过三个互补的任务族，观察模型是否朝"意义预测"的方向系统移动，包括区分"提示暴露"与"被指示使用"、根据新约束改变语义关系、有时精确匹配复杂翻译答案。

Result: 模型系统性地朝意义预测方向移动：能区分提示暴露与指示使用，能依据新约束改变语义关系，有时甚至精确匹配复杂的翻译答案键。性能随模型范围有差异，但整体支持意义中介的抽象，反驳强随机鹦鹉假说。

Conclusion: 在适当的架构与上下文约束下，统计学习可以产生意义中介的抽象，但生成仍强烈受表层合理性约束。研究对模型开发及理解抽象表征如何从"生成合理文本"目标中涌现具有启示。

Abstract: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.

</details>


### [155] [USA: Update-aware SAM for Cross-domain On-Policy Disitllation of Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34225)
*Qiyong Zhong,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Huwei Ji,Houcheng Jiang,Jiajie Su,Li Zhang,Gengsheng Li,Junfeng Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出USA方法，将每个参数的更新幅度转化为逐坐标扰动半径，降低承载合并位移的坐标上的曲率，解决多域蒸馏中模型合并的负迁移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy蒸馏单域易饱和，需引入其他域数据；多域数据混合会导致分布冲突且需重训；模型合并可规避，但发现其效果在域对上两极分化，存在负迁移时所有合并算子都不如单域基线，根源是跨域更新耦合。

Method: USA利用短暂warm-up期间测得的逐参数更新幅度，转换为逐坐标扰动半径，在最承载合并位移的坐标上精确降低曲率，从而缓解跨域更新耦合。

Result: 在数学、科学、代码两学生规模、六种迁移方向上，USA全部最强，平均超单域基线4分以上，并逆转冲突域对的负迁移。

Conclusion: USA通过逐坐标扰动半径降低曲率，有效缓解跨域更新耦合，使模型合并在多域agentic推理中全面超越单域参考。

Abstract: On-policy distillation instils multi-turn agentic reasoning through dense token-level supervision on the student's own trajectories, but a single domain saturates early, so further supervision has to be drawn from other domains. Multi-domain data mixing is the most direct way of incorporating them, at the cost of conflicts between their data distributions and of retraining the entire model whenever one domain is revised. Model merging avoids both by distilling every domain independently and fusing the resulting task vectors afterwards. We find instead that the benefit polarizes across domain pairs: on those exhibiting negative transfer, every merging operator we evaluate falls below the single-domain reference. We attribute this to cross-domain update coupling, where a substantial fraction of coordinates is updated comparably by both domains and a merge can therefore displace them by as much as their own updates. To overcome this limitation, we propose USA, which converts per-parameter update magnitudes measured during a brief warm-up into per-coordinate perturbation radii, reducing curvature precisely on the coordinates that carry most of the merging displacement. Experiments across mathematics, science and code at two student scales show USA strongest in all six transfer directions, ahead of the single-domain reference by more than four points on average, and reverse the negative transfer of the conflicting pairs.

</details>


### [156] [MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34234)
*Qiyong Zhong,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Houcheng Jiang,Jiajie Su,Huwei Ji,Li Zhang,Junfeng Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MAS-OPD，将 on-policy distillation 用于多智能体系统联合后训练，通过 Role-Advantage Specialization 与 Privileged Attribution for Coordination 解决角色专精与跨智能体协作监督问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统在复杂任务上有前景，但现有方法依赖推理时编排；通用API昂贵且难定制，小模型配角色提示难形成稳定角色能力与可靠协作。强化学习的团队级奖励无法定位贡献，局部奖励需逐任务重新设计，因此需要无需局部奖励的密集token级监督，而OPD在相互依赖的MAS中尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出 MAS-OPD：1）Role-Advantage Specialization 将角色优势定义为目标角色条件与非目标角色条件下教师信号的差值，以构建互补专精同时保留所有角色共享知识；2）Privileged Attribution for Coordination 将交互冲突归因到来源，仅作为特权信息提供给教师，从而把跨智能体协作信息转化为OPD可用的监督信号。

Result: 在代码与数学基准上的大量实验表明，MAS-OPD 在两个 student scale 上均取得最高平均分，并促使智能体形成更清晰的角色专精与更有效的协作行为。

Conclusion: 将 on-policy distillation 适配到多智能体系统的联合后训练是可行且有效的，角色条件化的教师信号与特权归因能同时改善角色专精与协作。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) split a task across specialized roles and are promising on complex tasks, yet a prevailing approach relies on inference-time orchestration alone. General-purpose APIs are costly and hard to customize, while small models with role prompts rarely develop stable role competence or reliable collaboration, so post-training a MAS jointly is central. Most attempts use reinforcement learning, whose team-level reward leaves undetermined which step of which agent brought about the outcome, while local rewards need redesigning per task. On-policy distillation (OPD) gives token-level teacher supervision on trajectories the student samples, a denser signal needing no local reward, yet is underexplored for the interdependent agents of a MAS. Two difficulties arise: building complementary specialization from a judgement of which role a behavior belongs to while preserving the knowledge all roles need, and turning cross-agent collaborative information into supervision OPD can exploit. We present MAS-OPD, where Role-Advantage Specialization defines the role advantage as the difference between the teacher signals under target and non-target role conditions, and Privileged Attribution for Coordination attributes an interaction conflict to its source and supplies it to the teacher alone as privileged information. Extensive experiments on code and mathematics benchmarks show that MAS-OPD attains the highest mean score at both student scales and leads the agents to develop clearer role specialization and more effective collaborative behavior.

</details>


### [157] [Coherence-Aware Distributional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34240)
*Jinnuo Liu,Junhao Zhu,Weifeng Jiang,Haoming Liu,Hongyi Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CHORD，一种基于LLM隐状态空间与MMD分布度量的连贯性敏感指标，用于检测开放文本生成中的全局连贯性失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放文本生成指标（似然、词汇多样性、泛表示空间分布相似度）忽略全局连贯性：生成文本可局部流畅却全局矛盾、因果不一致或主题断裂，而这些失效仍保持词元级和词汇统计特征，因此被现有指标漏检。作者认为表示设计是检测此类失效的核心瓶颈。

Method: CHORD在冻结LLM的隐状态空间中，用激发挥连贯性的提示编码生成语料与人类语料，再用RBF核的MMD比较两者的分布。为验证指标对连贯性退化而非一般文本变化敏感，构建反事实评测套件，将分级连贯性退化扰动与保义对照配对。并进行因子消融（表示、核函数、骨干规模、提示）。

Result: CHORD能选择性检测关系、篇章、结构和混合失效，而困惑度、熵、MAUVE、FBD和MMD基线要么漏检，要么无法将其与良性改写区分。消融显示表示为连贯性敏感性的主要来源，RBF-MMD在相关区分可见后提升样本效率；更大骨干捕获更细粒度差异，但连贯性提示仅在骨干能遵循提示时提升选择性。在无条件生成和前缀续写上，CHORD的模型排序与人类关于输出是否合理、是否像人写的判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 表示设计是可靠分布式评测的核心，CHORD验证了连贯性敏感的分布度量可弥补现有指标的盲点，并与人类判断高度对齐。

Abstract: Existing metrics for open-ended text generation measure likelihood, lexical diversity, or distributional similarity in generic representation space, yet they can miss fundamental dimensions of quality. A prominent blind spot is global coherence: a generated passage may be locally fluent while remaining globally contradictory, causally inconsistent, or topically disconnected. Such failures can still preserve the token-level and lexical statistics that existing metrics rely on. We identify representation as a central bottleneck in detecting these failures and introduce CHORD (Coherence-aware Hidden-state Open-generation Reference Distance), a coherence-sensitive distributional metric. CHORD encodes generated and human-written corpora in the hidden-state space of a frozen LLM using a coherence-eliciting prompt, and compares the resulting distributions using MMD with an RBF kernel. To validate that the metric responds to coherence degradation but not generic textual change, we construct a counterfactual evaluation suite that pairs graded coherence-degrading perturbations with meaning-preserving controls. CHORD selectively detects relation, discourse, structural, and mixture failures that perplexity, entropy, MAUVE, FBD, and MMD-based baselines either miss or cannot separate from benign rewriting. Factorial ablations show that representation is the primary source of coherence sensitivity,while RBF-MMD improves sample efficiency once the relevant distinctions become visible. Larger backbones capture finer-grained distinctions, but coherence prompting improves selectivity only when the backbone can follow the prompt.On unconditional generation and prefix continuation, CHORD yields model rankings that strongly align with human judgments of whether outputs make sense and appear human-written. Together, these results establish representation design as central to reliable distributional evaluation.

</details>


### [158] [SALMONN-duo: Adaptive Dual-System Coordination for Full-Duplex Voice Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34247)
*Wenyi Yu,Siyin Wang,Terumi Chiba,Xianzhao Chen,Xiaohai Tian,Jun Zhang,Lu Lu,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SALMONN-duo双系统语音智能体，将实时全双工语音LLM与异步慢思考LLM结合，通过自适应委派和成本感知强化学习，兼顾低延迟交互与复杂推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音LLM虽能实现低延迟自然交互，但现实智能体还需调用工具与进行深思推理，其可变延迟和计算成本与实时对话的严格时序要求相冲突。

Method: 受双过程认知理论启发，构建双系统架构：系统1为常驻的快速全双工语音LLM负责实时交互，系统2为强大的异步慢思考LLM智能体负责深思计算。系统1学习何时直接回答、何时委派，并在后台执行期间保持响应，无缝整合返回信息而不暴露工具痕迹。采用知识边界感知训练避免不必要调用，并用成本感知强化学习优化性能与后端使用权衡。

Result: 在单轮口语问答和多轮对话中，自适应委派显著提升知识密集型和多跳推理问题的准确率；在定制τ-Voice上完成环境接地、策略约束的多轮商业任务；成本感知强化学习进一步改善性能与后端使用权衡，并提升τ-Voice任务成功率与响应安全性。

Conclusion: SALMONN-duo通过双系统自适应委派有效协调实时交互与复杂推理，在保持低延迟响应的同时提升复杂任务性能与安全性。

Abstract: Full-duplex speech large language models (LLMs) enable low-latency, natural voice interaction. However, real-world agents must also use tools and perform deliberative reasoning-operations whose variable latency and computational cost conflict with the stringent timing requirements of real-time conversation. To reconcile these demands, we propose SALMONN-duo, an adaptive dual-system voice agent inspired by dual-process theories of cognition. SALMONN-duo separates real-time interaction from deliberative computation by pairing an always-on, fast-thinking full-duplex speech LLM (system 1) with a powerful asynchronous slow-thinking LLM agent (system 2). Beyond handling real-time interaction, system 1 learns when to answer directly and when to delegate, remaining responsive during backend execution and seamlessly integrating returned information into the ongoing dialogue without exposing tool traces or losing conversational context. Evaluations on single-turn spoken question answering (QA) and multi-turn conversations demonstrate that adaptive delegation substantially improves accuracy on knowledge-intensive and multi-hop reasoning questions, while knowledge-boundary-aware training avoids unnecessary system 2 invocations. On a customized version of $τ$-Voice, SALMONN-duo further demonstrates its ability to complete environment-grounded, policy-constrained tasks through multi-turn interactions in realistic business scenarios. Finally, cost-aware reinforcement learning further enhances the trade-off between task performance and backend usage across the QA and conversation tasks, while improving task success and response safety on $τ$-Voice with an acceptable increase in the delegation rate.

</details>


### [159] [Recursive LLM Degradation in Biomedical Question Answering: A Cross-Generation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34257)
*Bibek Bhandari,Kshitij Lingthep*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究生物医学问答中递归合成数据训练的影响，对比递归条件与人类对照条件，发现递归训练导致多项指标下降，且规模较大的模型退化更明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型反复用自身生成的数据训练可能形成合成数据反馈循环，使错误和分布偏差被重新引入后续训练集。作者希望在生物医学问答领域系统检验这一过程。

Method: 基于PubMedQA，使用Qwen2.5的0.5B与3B两个规模。设置递归条件（G(k+1)用G(k)生成答案训练）与人类对照条件（重复使用原始人类训练数据），进行G0–G3四代训练，采用两个随机种子（42、123），固定1,000条专家标注评估集。评估指标包括疾病与化学实体F1、上下文支持率、词汇与语义相似度、答案长度、重复率等。

Result: 两个模型规模和两个种子下，递归条件在疾病实体F1、化学实体F1、上下文支持率、ROUGE-L和余弦相似度上均比人类对照下降更大。在固定no-repeat 3-gram解码约束下，主要行为变化是答案变长，而3-gram重复率未上升。3B模型的差异变化幅度大于0.5B，尤其在疾病F1、上下文支持率、余弦相似度和答案长度上更明显。

Conclusion: 结果表明递归合成数据训练会在生物医学问答中产生领域特定的性能变化，但研究并未证实临床幻觉率或普遍意义上的模型崩溃。

Abstract: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. The Recursive condition for both model sizes and both seeds showed larger declines than the Human-Control condition in disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity. Under the fixed no-repeat 3-gram decoding constraint, the main observed behavioral change was increased answer length, while the measured 3-gram repetition rate did not increase. The magnitude of the difference-in-change was larger for the 3B model than for the 0.5B model. This difference was particularly apparent in disease F1, context-supported rate, cosine similarity, and answer length. These results show domain-specific changes associated with using recursive synthetic-data training in biomedical QA, but do not establish clinical hallucination rates or universal model collapse.

</details>


### [160] [Over-Personalization Is a Decision Failure: Generation-Induced Apply Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34284)
*Haeun Jang,Yonghyun Jun,Hwanhee Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 个性化LLM需判断每个偏好是否适用于当前情境（适用性）。作者将偏好处理分解为三阶段并分别测量，发现失败主要源于决策阶段，并揭示由生成目标引发的"Apply偏置"，通过从logits读取决策分数并减去一个偏置标量来缓解泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM常过度个性化，即应用了情境本应排除的偏好；但现有基准仅评分最终响应，无法定位失败发生在哪个环节。

Method: 将偏好处理分解为三阶段：(1)知晓偏好是否适用，(2)显式Apply/Suppress决策，(3)生成与标签一致的响应。用线性探针检测隐藏状态中的适用性信号；提出ABIDE，将信号检测理论应用于从logits直接读取的Apply-vs-Suppress决策分数，以区分灵敏度缺失与响应偏置。

Result: 适用性信号在生成过程中仍可从隐藏状态解码；多数设置下错误决策被忠实执行多于正确决策在生成中丢失，失败定位在决策阶段（一旦要求模型回答即失效）。ABIDE揭示生成诱发的Apply偏置：仅声明生成目标即使决策分数偏向Apply而灵敏度基本保留，且该偏移在提示结构、偏好槽级联和措辞控制下依然存在。

Conclusion: 从决策分数中减去在留出集上估计的单一偏置标量，可在解码时减少泄漏同时基本保留偏好满足。

Abstract: Personalized LLMs must decide, for each stored preference, whether the current context calls for applying or suppressing it, which we call its applicability. They frequently over-personalize, applying preferences the context rules out, yet existing benchmarks score only the final response and cannot tell where this failure arises. We decompose preference handling into three stages and measure each separately: (1) knowing whether a preference applies, (2) deciding on an explicit Apply/Suppress label, and (3) generating a response consistent with that label. Using linear probes, we first show that this applicability signal remains decodable from hidden states during generation. By making the decision explicit, we then find that in most settings wrong decisions faithfully followed outnumber correct decisions lost in generation. We thus locate the failure in the decision, which breaks once the model is also asked to answer. To determine whether this reflects lost sensitivity or a response bias, we propose ABIDE (Apply-Bias Investigation via Decision-score), which adapts signal detection theory to Apply-vs-Suppress decision scores read directly from logits. ABIDE reveals a generation-induced Apply bias: merely stating an answer-generation objective shifts the decision score toward Apply while sensitivity is largely preserved, and the shift persists under controls for prompt structure, cascades across preference slots, and prompt wording. Finally, we show that subtracting a single bias scalar, estimated on a held-out split, from the decision score at decoding time reduces leakage while largely preserving fulfillment.

</details>


### [161] [ReScraper: Unified Scraping and Cleaning of Web Data for Effective LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34287)
*Zichun Yu,Jiarui Yan,Shlok Sanghvi,Nihar Atri,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ReScraper，一个仅0.6B参数的统一语言模型，替代LLM预训练语料清洗中整套启发式规则流程，显著提升数据质量和下游模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM预训练语料依靠手工启发式规则清洗（HTML抽取器+大量规则过滤器），其质量受限于规则的粗糙度和准确性，难以突破上限。

Method: 训练一个0.6B的统一模型，用三个教师模型输出精心构建监督数据。模型先抽取HTML主内容，再从四种操作中选择：保留、编辑去除噪声行/片段、删除、或对信息丰富但质量差的页面进行重写。

Result: 在同一爬取数据池上预训练400M/1.4B/2.8B模型，DCLM Core分数相对最强基线提升3.8–4.7%（各规模包含多智能体方案）。分析表明各操作互补，单模型抽取+清洗优于级联分离模型，且操作集中在需要处理的页面上，最显著提升低质量页面同时保持语料多样性。

Conclusion: 证明了AI4AI在预训练数据策管中的可行性与有效性，小型学习模型可接管整个启发式管道阶段。代码已开源。

Abstract: LLM pretraining corpora are normally cleaned by a stack of hand-written heuristics. A heuristic scraper extracts the main content from HTML, and dozens of rule-based filters then clean it, so corpus quality is capped by the coarseness and accuracy of the rules. In this work, we propose ReScraper, a unified language model of only 0.6B parameters that replaces this entire stack. To train ReScraper, we carefully curate supervised data from the outputs of three teacher models, so it learns to first extract the main content from raw data and then choose among four operations: keeping the page as extracted, editing out noisy lines and spans, deleting it entirely, or rewriting it when it is poorly written but informative. Based on the same crawled data pool, pretraining 400M, 1.4B, and 2.8B models on our curated data improves the DCLM Core score by a relative 3.8--4.7% over the strongest baseline at each scale, including the costly multi-agent curation. Our analyses show that each operation plays a distinct and complementary role, and that extracting and cleaning in one model outperforms a cascade of separate models. ReScraper also concentrates its operations on the pages that need them, raising the quality of poor pages the most while keeping the corpus diverse. These results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of AI4AI for pretraining data curation, where a small learned model takes over an entire stage of the pipeline from hand-written heuristics. We open-source our code at https://github.com/cxcscmu/ReScraper

</details>


### [162] [Dr.Credit: Rubric-Grounded Process Credit Assignment for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34296)
*Yingjian Zhu,Zhenyi Wang,Jiaxin Guo,Kun Ding,Ying Wang,Shen Huang,Xunjie Zhu,Pengjun Xie,Shiming Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Dr.Credit，用"基于评分标准的信用（rubric-grounded credit）"对deep research agent的中间工具决策进行过程监督，无需标准答案，结合GRPO结果优势训练，在多个基准上超越开源基线，8B模型性能媲美前沿专有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于rubric的RL任务中，rubric分数只监督最终答案，无法区分中间决策的贡献；而许多信用分配方法依赖标准答案来定义过程奖励，难以应用于无唯一解的开卷任务，如深度研究。

Method: 以任务要求（rubric）作为共享参照，评估工具返回信息相对于该rubric历史已接受支持所提供的"新增支持"，从而区分新证据与已有证据并识别部分支持；用该信用监督RL框架中deep research agent的中间工具轮次，并将过程优势与GRPO的结果优势结合。

Result: 在4个域内与域外基准上，Dr.Credit在每个主要指标和子指标上均优于所评估的开源deep research基线；以8B参数骨干达到与前沿专有模型相当的平均性能。分析显示，在有限研究轮次预算下，证据获取更高效、报告质量更高。

Conclusion: 验证了基于rubric的过程监督在deep research任务中的有效性，并提示可将其扩展到更广泛的基于rubric的任务。

Abstract: Rubric-based tasks are increasingly addressed through reinforcement learning (RL), with rubric scores used as training rewards. However, these rewards typically supervise final answers without distinguishing the contributions of intermediate decisions. Many existing credit assignment methods rely on ground-truth answers to define process rewards, limiting their applicability to open-ended tasks without canonical solutions. To address this limitation, the proposed rubric-grounded credit uses task requirements as a shared reference for final answer evaluation and process supervision. The information returned by tools is assessed for the additional support it provides toward satisfying each rubric relative to that rubric's history of accepted support. By referencing these histories, credit distinguishes new support from evidence already present in the trajectory while recognizing partial support for each rubric. Dr.Credit uses rubric-grounded credit to supervise intermediate tool turns in an RL framework for deep research agents. The resulting process advantages are combined with GRPO outcome advantages to guide research decisions while retaining supervision of final-report quality. Evaluations on four in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that Dr.Credit outperforms the evaluated open deep research baselines on every primary metric and submetric. Meanwhile, with an 8B-parameter backbone, the trained agent achieves average performance competitive with the evaluated frontier proprietary models. Further analyses suggest more efficient evidence acquisition and higher-quality reports under limited research-turn budgets, motivating the extension of rubric-grounded process supervision to a broader range of rubric-based tasks.

</details>


### [163] [Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34320)
*Chengguang Gan,Yunhao Liang,Qinghao Zhang,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出任务级bootstrap证书评估LLM agent，可认证自动评判覆盖率，并用作自训练过滤器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent评估仍依赖人工阅读轨迹，自动评判无法保证错误率；现有选择性评判方法的i.i.d.证书在相关轨迹簇下会高估安全性（97.5%重采样超标却声称98%自动化）。
