### [234] [Telescopic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35769)
*Zhilin Guo,Boqiao Zhang,Hakan Aktas,Kyle Fogarty,Nursena Koprucu Aslan,Wenzhao Li,Canberk Baykal,Albert Miao,Siyu Hong,Yixiao Liu,Adam Wu,Ashish Kumar Singh,Sakar Khattar,Chenliang Zhou,Weihao Xia,Cristina Nader Vasconcelos,Cengiz Oztireli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Telescopic Language Model (TLM)，通过随机前缀监督+全容量锚点训练，使单一模型在任意深度都是有效语言模型，一次训练即可覆盖连续算力预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有部署需为每个算力预算单独训练/压缩模型；固定退出方案（如 MLMS）只监督少数固定深度，其他深度性能跌至随机水平（困惑度 10^2-10^5）。

Method: 嵌套容量 Transformer，每步随机截断一个容量前缀以全量 next-token 目标训练，同时进行一次全容量前向-反向；每步仅两次前向后向，无架构改动，推理无额外开销。

Result: 200M 代理套件（20B FineWeb-Edu token）上，单次 TLM 在全部 20 个层前缀均为有效语言模型；质量-预算曲线下面积比固定退出方案减少 43-44%，全容量性能持平，单次运行 GPU 成本低约 12%。前缀采样密度是可控旋钮。

Conclusion: 使模型具备弹性的是训练目标而非嵌套结构本身；操作点成为训练时选择而非架构选择。

Abstract: One deployed language model must often serve many compute budgets, yet serving each budget still means a separate training or compression run per point. We train a Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to be that continuum: a nested-capacity Transformer supervised by stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor. At every step, one randomly truncated prefix of the capacity axis is trained against the full next-token target, alongside one full-capacity pass, so the trained artifact is a valid language model at every depth. Two forward-backward passes per step, no architectural change, nothing extra at inference. Fixed-exit suites such as Matryoshka Language Model Suites (MLMS) occupy one point in this design space, and the point has a cost: supervising only a few fixed exits leaves the nested model at chance level everywhere else (perplexity 10^2-10^5 in our baselines). On a 200M proxy suite (20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, identical data stream for all methods), a single TLM run is a valid language model at every one of its twenty layer prefixes, in perplexity and on perplexity-sensitive downstream tasks, reducing the area under the quality-budget curve by 43-44% relative to the fixed-exit suites while matching them at full capacity, at ~12% lower GPU cost per run. The prefix sampling density is a dial: concentrating it on a few depths recovers fixed-exit quality there at the price of the continuum, so the operating points become a training-time choice rather than an architectural one. These results indicate that the training objective, not the nesting itself, is what makes a model elastic.

</details>

### [235] [Applications of the Lorentz positive cone in nonconvex quadratic optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32017)
*Samuel Burer,Kurt Anstreicher*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究将 Lorentz 锥映到 Lorentz 锥的矩阵构成的 Lorentz 正锥，给出其优化算法及在非凸二次优化中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非凸二次优化问题（如双线性目标和两信赖域子问题）通常难以高效求解，需要更强的凸松弛来改进 SDP 松弛效果。

Method: 定义 Lorentz 正锥及其对偶——Lorentz 可分矩阵锥，并基于这两个锥设计多项式时间算法。

Result: 该锥与对偶锥为椭球约束下双线性目标最小化问题提供多项式时间算法，并能强化其他非凸二次优化问题（含两信赖域子问题）的 SDP 松弛。

Conclusion: Lorentz 正锥及相关锥为若干非凸二次优化问题提供了有效的多项式时间算法和更强的 SDP 松弛工具。

Abstract: We consider the Lorentz positive cone of $n\times m$ matrices that map the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^m$ into the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^n$. The Lorentz positive cone and its dual, the cone of Lorentz separable matrices, are shown to provide polynomial-time algorithms for the problem of minimizing a bilinear objective over variables contained in ellipsoids in $\Rbb^n$ and $\Rbb^m$. We also demonstrate how these cones can be used to strengthen SDP relaxations of other nonconvex quadratic optimization problems, including the two-trust-region subproblem.

</details>


### [236] [Tight Convergence Bounds for the Classical Kaczmarz Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32034)
*Runbo Yu,Jelena Diakonikolas*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文对经典Kaczmarz方法（循环更新）给出了紧致的收敛性刻画，包括线性与次线性收敛界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Kaczmarz方法自1937年提出，广泛用于求解线性系统及逆问题，但其收敛速率的精确刻画长期被视为难题；已有的界无法解释循环更新方法在实际中的高效收敛。

Method: 推导经典Kaczmarz方法的紧致收敛界（最坏情况紧、由仅依赖A的固定矩阵表达），并进一步给出可用矩阵行范数、行相关性、秩和极端正奇异值表达的松弛界。

Result: 获得线性与次线性收敛界；松弛界可解释矩阵行平行或正交时的单循环收敛；证明各参数依赖的必要性且在最坏情况下与最优界仅差小常数因子。

Conclusion: 该结果解释了行弱相关时经典循环更新快于随机更新的现象，契合逆问题中循环方法的实际表现。

Abstract: The classical method of Kaczmarz, introduced in 1937, is a textbook iterative method for solving linear systems $A x = b.$ Despite its widespread use, particularly in the context of solving inverse problems where it is commonly included in software packages within Matlab, Python, and Julia, the precise characterization of convergence has long been deemed difficult to obtain. While different bounds on convergence rates have been established, they are largely unsatisfying as they cannot explain the classical, cyclic-update method's efficient convergence in practice. In this work, we obtain a tight characterization of convergence of the classical Kaczmarz method, establishing both linear and sublinear convergence bounds. The worst-case tight (i.e., exactly attained by some instances in the considered family) bounds are expressed in terms of a fixed matrix that depends only on $A,$ but are not fully interpretable in terms of the matrix spectrum and row correlations, which had been observed to have an impact on convergence. We thus provide relaxations of these bounds that are fully expressible in terms of matrix row norms, row correlations, rank, and extremal positive singular values. The provided relaxed bounds explain one-cycle convergence in special cases where the matrix rows are all either parallel or orthogonal to each other. We further argue that the dependence on different parameters appearing in the bounds is necessary and within a small constant factor of the best attainable in the worst case. Finally, our bounds explain why the classical cyclic update is faster than the randomized one when matrix rows are weakly correlated, which is often observed in inverse problems where the cyclic method is used.

</details>


### [237] [An Efficient iLQR Algorithm for Optimal Control with Bounded States and Inputs: Application to Spacecraft Maneuvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32075)
*Abhijeet,Suman Chakravorty*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出Box-iLQR方法，用对数障碍函数处理带状态与控制约束的非线性航天器最优控制，兼得约束轨迹优化与约束感知反馈策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航天器最优控制问题常有状态与控制边界约束，需要兼顾高精度轨迹优化与闭环反馈鲁棒性，而传统方法难以在单一框架中同时满足。

Method: 基于约束迭代LQR（Box-iLQR），采用对数障碍函数，双目标使用：将障碍参数趋零以恢复约束最优轨迹，同时保留有限障碍值构建光滑、约束感知的闭环反馈策略。

Result: 在航天器姿态控制、最小燃料平面轨道转移、L2到L2晕轨道转移上验证。Box-iLQR遵守约束，给出标称轨迹与时变反馈策略；扰动、测量噪声与控制不确定性下闭环仿真显著降低终端误差。

Conclusion: Box-iLQR在单一框架内同时实现高精度约束轨迹优化与实用的约束感知反馈。

Abstract: This paper presents a constrained iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (Box-iLQR) method for nonlinear aerospace optimal-control problems with bounded states and controls. Logarithmic barrier functions are used with a two-fold objective: the barrier parameter is reduced toward zero to recover the constrained optimal trajectory, while a finite barrier is retained to construct a smooth, constraint-aware feedback policy for closed-loop operation. The method is demonstrated on spacecraft attitude control, a minimum-fuel planar orbit transfer, and an L2 to L2 halo-orbit transfer. Box-iLQR respects the imposed constraints and produces nominal trajectories together with time-varying feedback policies. Closed-loop simulations under disturbance, measurement noise, and control uncertainty show substantial reductions in terminal error. These results demonstrate that Box-iLQR provides both high-accuracy constrained trajectory optimization and practical constraint-aware feedback within a single framework.

</details>


### [238] [Convergent Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Annealed Noise Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32393)
*Samuel Hurault*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为带退火噪声水平的即插即用(PnP)算法建立收敛保证，涵盖确定性(RED-GD、PnP-PGD)与随机(SNORE、等变RED、PnP-Flow变体)方法，填补了现有理论与实际递减去噪实践之间的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际P_nP实现常在迭代中逐步降低去噪噪声水平σ，但多数现有收敛分析假设去噪器固定不变，理论与实践存在明显脱节。

Method: 针对退火噪声水平的P_nP算法族，识别与终端去噪水平对应的显式非凸目标函数，证明迭代点关于该目标的渐近稳定性；分析不规定噪声调度的衰减速率，假设同时覆盖学习型梯度步去噪器与精确MMSE去噪器。

Result: 在多个成像逆问题上（修复、超分辨、去马赛克、断层成像）验证了递减噪声调度的优势，并观察到与理论预测一致的收敛行为。

Conclusion: 建立了覆盖确定性与随机P_nP方法的退火噪声收敛理论，弥合了P_nP收敛理论与最先进图像恢复方法的实际做法之间的差距。

Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods solve imaging inverse problems by incorporating deep denoisers into iterative optimization algorithms. Although practical implementations often decrease the denoiser noise level $σ$ along iterations, most existing convergence analyses assume a fixed denoiser. In this work, we establish convergence guarantees for a broad family of Plug-and-Play algorithms with annealed noise level, spanning deterministic methods (RED--GD and PnP--PGD) and stochastic methods (SNORE, equivariant RED, and a variant of PnP--Flow). For each method, we identify an explicit, nonconvex objective associated with the terminal denoising level and prove asymptotic stationarity of the iterates with respect to this objective. Our analysis does not prescribe any decay rate for the noise schedule, and our assumptions cover both learned gradient-step denoisers and exact MMSE denoisers. Overall, our theoretical results bridge the gap between existing PnP convergence theory and the decreasing-denoising practices used by state-of-the-art image restoration methods. We empirically demonstrate the benefits of such schedules and illustrate the predicted convergence behavior on several imaging inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, demosaicing and tomography.

</details>


### [239] [Facial distance and diameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32440)
*Antoine Deza,David Martínez-Rubio,Javier Peña,Elias Wirth*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究多面体的面部距离(pyramidal width)，证明其在每一维上被正则单纯形唯一最大化，从而验证了Peña-Wirth猜想并给出最小常数√2，同时计算了Birkhoff多面体的面部距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面部距离出现在Frank-Wolfe算法的收敛界中，Peña和Wirth为其发展了计算法则，并猜想面部距离与直径之比乘以维数平方根被常数界定，但该猜想此前未被证明。

Method: 通过几何分析，证明该比值在每一维上被正则单纯形唯一最大化，据此推导常数界并确定最小常数，同时针对Birkhoff多面体进行具体计算。

Result: 证明了猜想成立，且√2是最小常数；面部距离与直径比值乘维数平方根的极值由正则单纯形达到；并得到了Birkhoff多面体的面部距离。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了Peña-Wirth猜想，确定了最优常数√2，并为具体多面体（如Birkhoff多面体）的面部距离提供了计算。

Abstract: The facial distance of a polytope, equivalently its pyramidal width, is a geometric condition measure that appears in the convergence bounds for Frank--Wolfe algorithms. Peña and Wirth developed calculus rules for this quantity and conjectured that the ratio of the facial distance to the diameter multiplied by the square root of the dimension is bounded by a constant. We show that this quantity is uniquely maximized by a regular simplex in each dimension, which implies that the conjecture holds and that $\sqrt{2}$ is the smallest constant. We also compute the facial distance of the Birkhoff polytope.

</details>


### [240] [Optimal Reinsurance-Dividend Strategy with Fixed Transaction Costs in a Regime-Switching Brownian Risk Model: A Viscosity Solution to the Impulse Control Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32686)
*Wenyuan Wang,Zuo Quan Xu,Kaixin Yan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究布朗风险模型下带内生机制转换的最优比例再保险-分红问题，分红含固定交易成本，证明值函数为HJB方程唯一粘性解，并显式刻画最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在布朗风险模型中同时考虑漂移与波动率的内生机制转换，并纳入固定交易成本，扩展再保险与分红联合优化的建模现实性。

Method: 将问题表述为二维随机控制问题；证明值函数为带非局部算子的HJB方程的唯一粘性解；求解并显式刻画最优策略。

Result: 对几乎所有参数配置显式给出最优策略：最优分红为双障碍脉冲策略，最优再保险比例以反馈形式给出；数值例子验证最优性。

Conclusion: 该研究刻画了内生机制转换与固定交易成本下的最优再保险-分红策略，为相关风险管理决策提供理论依据与数值支持。

Abstract: We consider a problem of optimal proportional reinsurance-dividend distribution under a Brownian risk model, where both the drift and volatility coefficients are subject to endogenous regime-switching. Dividend payments are subject to fixed transaction costs. The problem is formulated as a two-dimensional stochastic control problem, and we prove that the value function is the unique viscosity solution of the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation with nonlocal operator. For almost all parameter configurations, we explicitly characterize the optimal strategy that maximizes the expected total discounted dividends net of transaction costs until ruin. The optimal dividend policy is a two-barrier impulsive strategy, while the optimal reinsurance proportion is given in feedback form. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate the optimality results.

</details>


### [241] [Saddle-Point Problems with a Low-Dimensional Block Do Not Need Accurate Inner Solves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32441)
*Ivan Fomin,Alexander V. Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出"证书传输"方法求解高低维块结构的极小极大问题，通过不精确求解内层问题并复用强凸下模型，实现 x 与 y 调用次数分别最优的复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有割平面法需将每个内层问题解到 ε 精度，导致 x 调用次数约为 O(m√κ log²(1/ε))，在高维块上代价高，而内层问题其实无需精确求解。

Method: 考虑 min_x max_y f(x,y)，X 强凸条件数 κ，分别统计 x、y 的 oracle 调用。方法维护单个切片上的强凸下模型，将其作为下一个切片的先验进行短加速运行；利用 y 方向凹性，每次 y 调用要么切割局部化器，要么把下模型移动到两切片的混合并带来有证书的下界提升。强凹情形下采用两点加速法。

Result: m=1 时 x 调用 O(√κ log(1/ε))（至多初始化项），y 调用 O(log(1/ε))，两者均最优，即使 f(x,·) 仅凹且 Lipschitz。一般 m 下（重心可计算），x 调用 O((m+√(mκ))log(1/ε))，y 调用最优的 O(m log(1/ε))。强凹时 x 调用数与 m 无关。

Conclusion: 内层问题无需精确求解，证书传输可在 x、y 两侧分别达到最优或近最优调用复杂度，适用于 worst-group risk 与少量约束学习等问题。

Abstract: Many learning problems couple a high-dimensional block of parameters with a handful of adversarial or dual variables: worst-group risk over a few groups, or learning under a few constraints. We consider $\min_{x\in X}\max_{y\in Y} f(x,y)$ with $X\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, a compact convex set and strongly convex with condition number $κ$, and we count the oracle calls for $x$ and for $y$ separately. The textbook approach runs a
  cutting-plane method in $y$ and solves every inner problem to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with an accelerated method; it needs $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$ but $O(m\sqrtκ\log^2(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$. We show that the inner problems need not be solved accurately. Our method, certificate transport, keeps a strongly convex lower model of a single slice and uses it as a prior for a short accelerated run on the next slice. By concavity in $y$, every call for $y$ then either cuts the localizer or moves the lower model to a mixture of the two slices with a certified increase of the lower bound. For $m=1$ this gives an $\varepsilon$-saddle point after $O(\sqrtκ\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$, up to an initialization term, and $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$; both counts are optimal, even though $f(x,\cdot)$ is only assumed to be concave and Lipschitz. For general $m$, with centers of gravity of the localizer treated as computable, the method needs $O((m+\sqrt{mκ})\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$ and the optimal $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$. Under strong concavity in $y$, a two-point accelerated method makes the number of calls for $x$ independent of $m$.

</details>


### [242] [Smooth or Separable? Sparse Block Acceleration for Entropy-Regularized Linear Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32558)
*Irina Podlipnova,Maxim Mashtaler,Artem Agafonov,Yuriy Dorn,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏仿射约束的熵正则化线性规划，比较保留或消除冗余归一化约束两种对偶表示，提出一种保持稀疏数据访问代价的加速随机块方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消除归一化约束得到部分可分离的sum-exp对偶，虽稀疏但曲率无界；保留则得到全局有界的log-sum-exp对偶。需要弥合两种表示在优化上的差异，并在稀疏场景下实现加速。

Method: 核心是全局熵特定Hessian-gap界，适用于带符号约束矩阵，支持可计算的块重叠精化与采样前的确定性曲率证书；据此实现平方根重要性采样和精确懒惰实现，使稀疏算术代价由局部曲率加权；并引入gap依赖的曲率维度连接广义平滑与有效秩直觉。对保留约束情形使用梯度正则与三次正则牛顿法。

Result: 加速随机块方法在保持稀疏数据访问代价的同时实现加速；实验从坐标轮次、算术操作数和墙钟时间比较各方法，分离了加速、触及数据稀疏性和问题特定结构的影响。

Conclusion: 给出了两种对偶表示的精确加速方法，统一了曲率分析与稀疏代价，为熵正则化LP的高效求解提供了理论与实验框架。

Abstract: We study entropy-regularized linear programs with sparse affine constraints and compare two exact dual representations induced by whether a redundant normalization constraint is retained or eliminated. Eliminating it yields a partially separable sum-exp dual with sparse affine factors but unbounded curvature. Our main result is an accelerated randomized block method whose acceleration preserves sparse data-access cost. The key ingredient is a global entropy-specific Hessian--gap bound that remains valid for signed constraint matrices, admits computable block-overlap refinements, and provides deterministic curvature certificates before sampling. This geometry supports square-root importance sampling and an exact lazy implementation in which sparse arithmetic cost is weighted by local curvature rather than by a worst-block factor. We further introduce a gap-dependent curvature dimension that connects the generalized-smooth regime to the classical effective-rank intuition for coordinate methods. Retaining the normalization constraint yields a log-sum-exp dual with globally bounded higher derivatives, enabling gradient-regularized and cubic-regularized Newton methods. Experiments compare the resulting methods in terms of coordinate epochs, arithmetic operations, and wall-clock time, separating the effects of acceleration, touched-data sparsity, and problem-specific structure.

</details>


### [243] [Revisiting AdaGrad in Stochastic Convex Optimization: Last Iterates, High Probability, and Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32729)
*Weiming Ou,Xiao Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文深入分析了AdaGrad与AdaGrad-Norm在随机凸优化中的收敛行为，揭示了其普遍速率不可得性、方差假设的作用，并给出了紧的下界与有界迭代条件下的最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AdaGrad和AdaGrad-Norm广泛使用，但其在随机凸优化中的精确行为仍缺乏理解，尤其是最后迭代速率、平均迭代高概率速率以及log T项的来源不清楚。

Method: 通过构造反例和紧的下界，分析在次高斯噪声、有界迭代和有界方差等不同假设下两种方法的收敛性；并在一般ABC条件下证明有界迭代时达到O(1/√T)。

Result: 证明AdaGrad-Norm和AdaGrad不存在普遍的最后迭代速率；仅有界方差不足以保证高概率平均迭代速率或期望收敛；构造了Ω(log T/√T)的紧下界，说明log T不可去除；在有界迭代和ABC条件下可达O(1/√T)。

Conclusion: log T损失源于无界迭代，在有界迭代条件下消失，两种方法可达到最优O(1/√T)速率。

Abstract: AdaGrad and AdaGrad-Norm are widely used adaptive methods, but their precise behavior in stochastic convex optimization remains less understood. We first show that AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad do not admit any universal \textbf{last-iterate} rate, even under sub-Gaussian noise and bounded iterates. We then prove that bounded variance alone is too weak: even with bounded iterates, it cannot yield \textbf{high-probability average-iterate} rates, and without bounded iterates it may not even guarantee convergence in expectation. Besides, we construct tight $Ω(\log T/\sqrt T)$ lower bounds for both AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad under sub-Gaussian noise, showing that $\log T$ in existing average-iterate upper bounds is unavoidable. Finally, we show that this $\log T$ loss disappears once bounded-iterate condition is imposed: under a general ABC condition, both methods achieve rates ${O}(1/\sqrt{T})$.

</details>


### [244] [Sampled-Max Subgradient Method for Convex Finite-Max Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32872)
*Egor Gladin,Anna Popova,Georgii Babinskii*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究采样最大值子梯度法（SMax-SGM）求解大规模凸有限最大值问题，给出子梯度查询O(ε^{-2})、分量值查询Õ((N/k)ε^{-2})的复杂度界，并证明Ω(N/k)下界，实验验证其优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模凸有限最大值问题中，每次迭代计算全部N个分量的最大值代价高昂，需要一种随机子集采样策略来降低分量值查询成本，并理解其理论极限。

Method: SMax-SGM每步在N个分量中随机抽取子集求最大值，并对采样最大值取一个子梯度，等价于采样最大值代理上的随机子梯度下降；通过平均前k间隙加上漏掉全部前k分量的概率来界定代理误差，并用局部化论证仅需在近似最优下水平集上成立这些量。

Result: 在有界子梯度矩假设下获得O(ε^{-2})子梯度查询；当近最优集内约k个分量近似活跃时，分量值查询为Õ((N/k)ε^{-2})，并受全扫描成本限制；一维仿射构造证明即使平均前k间隙处处为零且子梯度查询无限，Ω(N/k)分量值查询仍可能必要；张量网格特例说明子集大小可独立于网格基数；实验在2×10^5和5×10^6分量问题上以更少分量值查询和更低优化时间达到5%参考差距。

Conclusion: SMax-SGM在理论与实验上均能有效降低大规模有限最大值问题的分量值查询成本，且其复杂度对N/k的依赖在一般情况下不可改进；张量网格结构下可进一步放宽子集大小对规模的依赖。

Abstract: We study the Sampled-Max Subgradient Method (SMax-SGM) for large convex finite-max problems. Each iteration maximizes over a fresh random subset of the $N$ components and takes one subgradient of the sampled maximizer. The method is therefore stochastic subgradient descent on a sampled-max surrogate. We bound the surrogate error by an average-top-$k$ gap plus the probability of missing all top-$k$ components. A localization argument requires these quantities only on a near-optimal sublevel set. Under a bounded subgradient-moment assumption, this yields $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ subgradient queries and, when $k$ components remain nearly active in that set, $\widetilde O((N/k)\varepsilon^{-2})$ component-value queries, capped by the full-scan cost. Conversely, a one-dimensional affine construction shows that $Ω(N/k)$ component-value queries can be necessary even when the average-top-$k$ gap vanishes everywhere and subgradient queries are unlimited. A tensor-grid specialization explains when the subset size can become independent of grid cardinality. Experiments on finite maxima with $2\times10^5$ and $5\times10^6$ components show that, under the reported protocols, SMax-SGM reaches a 5% numerical-reference gap with fewer component-value queries and lower optimizer time than each comparison method that reaches the target.

</details>


### [245] [No Spurious Local Minima in Full-Order Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32875)
*Yang Zheng,Yujie Tang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明全阶LQG代价的每个局部最小值都是全局最优的，即不存在次优局部极小点，揭示了虽存在次优驻点但局部极小景观良性的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LQG控制在直接状态空间参数化下可能包含次优驻点，但是否存在次优局部极小点此前尚未解决。作者希望回答这一开放问题。

Method: 通过将状态空间Hessian与基于Youla参数化导出的频域全局最优性条件相联系；并利用解耦的稳定控制器状态扩展次优策略，构造概率为一的负曲率方向。

Result: 证明全阶LQG代价的每个局部极小点全局最优；任意控制器阶数下，不可控或不可观实现的局部极小点达到任意阶稳定策略的全局最优代价；任何次优策略可通过解耦稳定控制器状态扩展，以概率一获得负曲率方向，从而任意次优驻点可转化为严格鞍点。

Conclusion: 尽管存在次优驻点，LQG的局部极小景观是良性的，不存在次优局部极小点。

Abstract: This paper studies the nonconvex optimization landscape of Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control under direct state-space parameterization. Although the LQG cost may possess suboptimal stationary points, whether it admits suboptimal local minima has remained open. We answer this question negatively: Every local minimum of the full-order LQG cost is globally optimal. More generally, at any controller order, every local minimum corresponding to an uncontrollable or unobservable realization attains the globally optimal LQG cost over all stabilizing policies of arbitrary orders. We further show that any suboptimal policy can be augmented with decoupled stable controller states, so that the augmented policy admits a direction of negative curvature with probability one. Consequently, any suboptimal stationary point in full-order LQG cost can be converted into a strict saddle with probability one. One key proof idea connects the state-space Hessian to a frequency-domain global-optimality condition derived from the Youla parameterization. These results reveal a benign local-minimum landscape despite the presence of suboptimal stationary points.

</details>


### [246] [On the T-Adaptive Segment Routing Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32896)
*Amal Benhamiche,Kaoutar Bouaachra,Yannick Carlinet,Morgan Chopin,Eric Gourdin,Nancy Perrot*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出多周期IP/MPLS网络流量工程问题T-ASR，用SEGMENT ROUTING生成适应计划维护的路径序列，通过字典序目标最小化排序后的链路负载向量，并将问题分解为子问题，提出ALEXA和STELA两种MILP建模变体，在中小规模网络上评估比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心IP/MPLS网络在多周期计划维护下需要调整路由，且路径重配置次数有限。传统仅最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）的目标不够精细，无法有效改善所有链路的资源利用。

Method: 将T-ASR分解为一系列子问题；提出两种混合整数线性规划（MILP）建模：ALEXA与STELA，形成两种求解变体；采用字典序目标，最小化排序后的整条链路负载向量，而非仅MLU。

Result: 在小型至中型网络实例上对ALEXA和STELA两种变体进行了评估与效率比较。

Conclusion: 所提分解框架与两种MILP变体能处理多周期段路由优化，字典序目标提升整体链路资源利用；两种变体在中小规模实例上各有性能表现。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a multi-period optimization problem arising from the traffic engineering of core IP/MPLS networks, called T-ASR. This problem aims at computing a sequence of segment routing paths that adapt to a multi-period scheduled maintenance, while allowing limited number of path reconfigurations between successive time steps. Rather than focusing solely on minimizing the classical Maximum Link Utilization (MLU) criteria, we introduce a more refined lexicographic objective that minimizes the entire sorted vector of link loads providing a more efficient resource utilization for all the links. We propose a generic approach that decomposes this problem into a sequence of subproblems. To model each subproblem, we introduce two Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulations, ALEXA and STELA, resulting in two variants of our approach. Finally, we evaluate and compare the efficiency of both variants on small to medium-sized network instances.

</details>


### [247] [The Complexity of Convex Optimization with Mismatched Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32910)
*Timofei Loginov,Alexander Gasnikov,Yuriy Dorn,Aleksandr Shestakov,Nazarii Tupitsa,Osman Osmanov,Darina Dvinskikh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了在 ℓ1 球上梯度仅在欧氏范数下 L-Lipschitz 的"失配"问题中，极小极大最优功能间隙（gap）为 Θ(LR²/N³)（忽略对数因子），并给出基于 Steiner 点层级法的最优上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非欧几里得域上最优一阶方法通常将 prox 函数与光滑性范数匹配。但当梯度仅在欧氏范数下光滑时，欧氏设置给出 O(LR²/N²) 上界，而 Guzmán–Nemirovski 下界为 Ω(LR²/N³)，两者不匹配。Nemirovski 提出的问题即能否将上界降到 N⁻³ 阶。

Method: 提出 Steiner 点层级法：保留所有已见支撑超平面作为层级切割，在所得定位多面体的 Steiner 点附近做下一次查询。核心几何事实是沿 ℓ1 球的嵌套子集 Steiner 点移动距离仅为维数的多对数级（欧氏球则为 √n）。所有查询保持可行，随机选择器保持多项式内部工作量。

Result: 证明失配问题的极小极大 gap 为 Θ(LR²/N³)（至对数因子），对确定性与随机方法、甚至维度正比于查询数时均成立。该几何还给出非光滑目标、Hölder 梯度、高阶 oracle 及 Lipschitz 单调算子（含匹配下界）的最优速率；对凸二次问题，曲率学习法在每个 1≤p<2 的 ℓp 球上达到最优速率且无对数损失。实验在欧氏方法困难的目标准则上验证了 N⁻³ 行为。

Conclusion: 在 ℓ1 球失配光滑设置下，Steiner 点层级法达到极小极大最优 O(LR²/N³) 速率，解决了 Nemirovski 的长期问题，并将该几何框架推广到多种非光滑、Hölder 梯度、高阶 oracle 与单调算子场景。

Abstract: Optimal first-order methods on non-Euclidean domains such as the $\ell_1$ ball $B_1^n(R)=\{x\in\mathbb R^n:\|x\|_1\le R\}$ pair the prox-function with the norm in which smoothness is measured. When the gradient is $L$-Lipschitz in the Euclidean norm only, the accelerated method with a Euclidean prox-setup reduces the functional gap $f(x_N)-\min_{B_1^n(R)}f$ to $O(LR^2/N^2)$ after $N$ first-order queries (an entropic $\ell_1$ prox-setup replaces $L$ by the $\ell_1\to\ell_\infty$ constant $L_1\le L$, at the cost of a factor $\log n$ and with the same exponent). The lower bound of Guzmán and Nemirovski is of order $LR^2/N^3$, and whether the upper bound can be brought down to that order is a question of A. S. Nemirovski. We show that for this mismatched problem the minimax value of the gap is of order $LR^2/N^3$ up to logarithmic factors, for deterministic and for randomized methods alike, and already in dimension proportional to the number of queries. The upper bound is attained by a Steiner-point level method: every supporting hyperplane seen so far is kept as a level cut, and the next query is made near the Steiner point of the resulting localization polytope. The analysis rests on a single geometric fact: along nested subsets of the ball the Steiner points travel a distance that is polylogarithmic in the dimension, in contrast to $\sqrt n$ for the Euclidean ball. All queries stay feasible, and a randomized selector keeps the internal work polynomial. The same geometry yields optimal rates for nonsmooth objectives, Hölder gradients, higher-order oracles and Lipschitz monotone operators, the last with a matching deterministic lower bound. For convex quadratics, a curvature-learning method attains the optimal rate on every $\ell_p$ ball with $1\le p<2$ and without logarithmic loss. Experiments confirm the predicted $N^{-3}$ behaviour on objectives that are hard for Euclidean methods.

</details>


### [248] [Obtaining Game-Stationary Points for Smooth Nonconvex-Nonconcave Minimax Problems via First-Order Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32970)
*Mengxuan Dong,Yao Yao,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一阶方法，在局部逆Lipschitz正则与惩罚子水平集紧致条件下，以 Õ(ε⁻²) 首次一阶迭代找到非凸-非凹极小极大问题的 ε-稳定点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般非凸-非凹极小极大问题求一阶稳定点很难，现有保证依赖全局PL/KL、Minty型条件或局部KL需近优区域初始化，这些假设在许多应用中难以满足。

Method: 在近似max-player稳定点附近的局部逆Lipschitz正则条件加惩罚子水平集紧致条件下，设计一阶方法寻找ε-稳定点；不要求内层极大化问题的稳定点具有全局或局部最优性，并给出该正则性的充分条件。

Result: 在 Õ(ε⁻²) 次一阶迭代内找到 ε-稳定点；无约束情形由稳定点附近Hessian一致非奇异导出正则性，约束上Moreau包络情形由标准KKT正则条件导出。

Conclusion: 为一类未涵盖于PL、KL或Minty型框架的非凸-非凹极小极大问题建立了一阶复杂度保证。

Abstract: Minimax optimization is a fundamental framework in machine learning, robust optimization, and game theory, yet finding first-order stationary points of general nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems remains challenging without additional structural assumptions. Existing guarantees often rely on global PL- or KL-type conditions that connect max-player stationarity to global inner optimality, or on Minty-type conditions that impose a global relation on the game gradient field relative to a reference solution; local KL variants relax the former requirement but typically require initialization and tracking within a near-optimal region. Such conditions may be difficult to satisfy in many applications. In contrast, we develop a first-order method that finds an $ε$-stationary point within $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ first-order iterations under a local inverse-Lipschitz regularity condition around approximate max-player stationary points, together with a compactness condition on a penalty sublevel set. Our condition places no optimality requirement on stationary points of the inner maximization problem: they need not be globally, or even locally, maximizing. We further provide sufficient conditions for the required regularity. In the unconstrained setting, it follows from uniform nonsingularity of the maximization-variable Hessian near stationary points; for constrained upper Moreau envelopes, it follows from standard KKT regularity conditions. These results establish first-order complexity guarantees for classes of nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems not covered by the above PL-, KL-, or Minty-type frameworks.

</details>


### [249] [Optimal Parameter-Free Second-order Acceleration with Inexact Hessians under Generalized Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32977)
*Artem Agafonov,Aslan Ashabokov,Alexander D'yakonov,Martin Takáč,Alexander Gasnikov,Dmitry Kamzolov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究广义Hessian光滑性下（局部Hessian Lipschitz常数随梯度范数线性增长）的二阶凸优化，提出自适应、无参数算法（含加速Monteiro-Svaiter型方法），在不精确Hessian下达到经典Lipschitz-Hessian设定的下界复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典二阶方法假设Hessian全局Lipschitz，但实际中局部Hessian光滑性常随梯度范数增长；同时Hessian不精确度δ和光滑常数通常未知，需要无需调参的自适应方法。

Method: 针对不精确Hessian设计自适应算法，包括加速Monteiro-Svaiter型方法；用单一正则化参数通过回溯同时刻画Hessian不精确度与局部Hessian光滑性，实现无参数化（无需δ及光滑常数）。

Result: 复杂度在δ-不精确Hessian与经典Lipschitz-Hessian设定下达到二阶方法下界；收敛分为两阶段：远离解时由梯度相关光滑项带来几何收敛，靠近解时由普通Hessian光滑性与δ决定，恢复经典保证。

Conclusion: 所提自适应无参数二阶方法在广义Hessian光滑性下兼具最优复杂度与经典收敛保证，无需问题特定参数。

Abstract: We study second-order convex optimization under generalized Hessian smoothness, where the local Hessian Lipschitz constant may grow linearly with the gradient norm. For inexact Hessians, we develop adaptive algorithms, including an accelerated Monteiro-Svaiter-type method whose complexity matches the lower bound for second-order methods with $δ$-inexact Hessians in the classical Lipschitz-Hessian setting. Our methods are parameter-free in the sense that they require no problem-specific parameters as input, including the Hessian inexactness level $δ$ and smoothness constants. Instead, their backtracking adapts a single regularization parameter that jointly captures Hessian inexactness and local Hessian smoothness. The resulting rates split into two regimes. Far from the solution, the gradient-dependent smoothness term yields geometric convergence. Near the solution, the rate is governed by the ordinary Hessian smoothness and the inexactness level $δ$, recovering the classical Lipschitz-Hessian guarantees.

</details>


### [250] [Primal Methods for Constrained Variational Inequalities: Optimal Rates, Feasibility Trade-offs, and Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32981)
*Yonghong Yao,Lateef O. Jolaoso,Yekini Shehu,Jen-Chih Yao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为带凸函数约束的单调变分不等式建立纯原始方法（仅用局部线性约束近似）的复杂度理论，提出OPCGM框架，给出最优收敛速率与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Zhang等提出的首个纯原始方法缺乏对这类oracle的复杂度极限的完整理解，存在速率次优等问题，本文旨在填补这些关键空白。

Method: 提出最优原始约束梯度法（OPCGM）框架：针对强单调算子设计改进的原始梯度法；针对Lipschitz单调算子提出原始外梯度变体（仅用二次规划oracle）；并分析常数步长原始外梯度方法的不可行性。

Result: 强单调下最优O(1/T)，去除先前的次优指数；Lipschitz单调下达到最优O(1/ε)间隙复杂度，代价是平均迭代的常数渐近可行性违背；给出下界Ω(1/ε^2)（Lipschitz常数Θ(1/ε)）和Ω(1/ε)；设计单循环方法达O(1/√T)。

Conclusion: 该理论完善了纯原始约束方法在单调变分不等式中的复杂度刻画，证明若干可行性代价不可回避，强单调问题末次迭代达最优O(1/T)。

Abstract: Since Zhang et al. \cite{Zhang2025} introduced the first purely primal methods for monotone variational inequalities subject to convex functional constraints, the field has lacked a complete understanding of the complexity limits of this oracle class. We develop a theory that resolves the critical gaps left by their pioneering framework. Our Optimal Primal Constrained Gradient Method (OPCGM) establishes convergence rates and lower bounds for algorithms restricted to local linear constraint approximations. For strongly monotone operators, we prove that a refined primal gradient method achieves the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ rate for both optimality gap and constraint violation, eliminating the suboptimal exponent present in prior work. For Lipschitz monotone operators, we propose a primal extragradient variant that achieves the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/ε)$ gap complexity using only quadratic programming oracles, at the cost of a constant asymptotic feasibility violation for the averaged iterate; we prove that the first half-step is necessarily infeasible for the natural class of constant-stepsize primal extragradient methods on smooth convex constraints with positive curvature. We establish lower complexity bounds for primal methods restricted to local linear approximations, proving $Ω(1/ε^2)$ for Lipschitz monotone variational inequalities with Lipschitz constant scaling as $Θ(1/ε)$, and $Ω(1/ε)$ for standard Lipschitz monotone variational inequalities. We design a single-loop primal method that achieves an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ gap rate with only a domain-radius estimate, at the cost of a problem-dependent asymptotic feasibility constant that we prove is unavoidable. For strongly monotone problems, we prove that the last iterate converges at the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ rate.

</details>


### [251] [AltGDA Achieves Global $O(1/T)$ Ergodic Convergence in Matrix Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32995)
*Tianlong Nan,Garud Iyengar,Christian Kroer,Shuvomoy Das Gupta*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明交替梯度下降-上升(AltGDA)在任意有限双人零和矩阵博弈中，对任意初始化和任意时间步T，以O(1/T)遍历速率全局收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AltGDA实用有效，但其理论受限：已有结果仅适用无约束情形，或在约束情形下需对均衡做严格假设。

Method: 受新型性能估计规划(PEP)框架启发（用于紧凸集上的Lyapunov函数搜索），证明AltGDA的均匀平均迭代满足O(1/T)对偶间隙界；并构造反例说明末次迭代对偶间隙不收敛；结果在Lean 4中形式化机器验证。

Result: AltGDA在任意初始化与任意T下全局以O(1/T)遍历速率收敛；末次迭代对偶间隙不趋于零，说明平均迭代是必要的。

Conclusion: AltGDA在有限双人零和矩阵博弈中具有无条件全局遍历收敛保证，且该保证经Lean 4机器验证，显著拓展了现有理论。

Abstract: Alternating gradient descent-ascent (AltGDA) is a simple and practically effective method for solving finite two-player zero-sum matrix games. However, the theory of AltGDA remains limited: existing results either apply only to unconstrained settings or require restrictive assumptions on the equilibrium in constrained settings. We show that AltGDA converges globally at an $O(1/T)$ ergodic rate in every finite two-player zero-sum matrix game. Unlike prior results, our guarantee holds for every initialization and every horizon $T$: the uniform averages of the AltGDA iterates satisfy an $O(1/T)$ duality-gap bound. Our proof is inspired by numerical results obtained using a novel performance estimation programming (PEP) framework for Lyapunov function search over compact convex sets. Additionally, we provide simple counterexamples showing that the last-iterate duality gap of AltGDA does not converge to zero. This justifies why averaging of iterates is indeed necessary to achieve an $O(1/T)$ rate. We have formalized and machine-checked our global ergodic convergence result in Lean 4.

</details>


### [252] [A Riemannian Inertial Adaptive Gradient Method with Momentum Restart](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32997)
*Lateef O. Jolaoso,Professer V. Ndlovu,Maggie Aphane*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出黎曼惯性自适应梯度方法RIAG-R，结合AdaGrad步长、切空间惯性外推与梯度触发重启，理论证明最优复杂度与线性收敛，实验验证其在多种矩阵流形上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在黎曼流形上优化时，动量方法受曲率影响易出现“动量饱和”病态，且自适应步长通常依赖Lipschitz常数，需一种无需该常数并能修正曲率问题的加速方法。

Method: RIAG-R融合三部分：AdaGrad型自适应步长（无需Lipschitz常数）；通过指数映射在切空间进行惯性外推加速；梯度触发重启规则（每步仅多一次内积）检测并修正曲率导致的动量饱和。

Result: 建立每次迭代下降不等式、最优O(ε⁻²)迭代复杂度、聚点收敛性，以及黎曼Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件下的线性收敛率；在球面、Stiefel、对称正定、Grassmann四类矩阵流形实验中持续优于非惯性及无重启惯性基线。

Conclusion: RIAG-R在曲线空间上有效实现动量加速，自适应重启对发挥动量优势至关重要。

Abstract: We propose RIAG-R, a Riemannian Inertial Adaptive Gradient method with gradient-triggered Restart, for optimization on Riemannian manifolds. RIAG-R combines three ingredients: an AdaGrad-type adaptive step-size that requires no knowledge of the Lipschitz constant; inertial extrapolation in the tangent space via the exponential map to accelerate convergence; and a restart rule, costing only one extra inner product per iteration, that detects and corrects the momentum-saturation pathology induced by manifold curvature. We establish a per-iteration descent inequality, an optimal $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$-iteration complexity, a convergence result for cluster points of the generated sequence, and a linear convergence rate under the Riemannian Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality. Numerical experiments on four representative matrix manifold optimization problems including sphere, Stiefel, symmetric positive-definite, and Grassmann manifolds demonstrate that RIAG-R consistently outperforms non-inertial and restart-free inertial baselines, confirming that adaptive restart is essential to realizing the benefits of momentum on curved spaces.

</details>


### [253] [Decentralized Optimization with Cross-Coupled Mixed Affine Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33021)
*Ewsey Obzherin,Ilya Khomchenko,Natalia Shelegeda,Nhat Trung Nguyen,Demyan Yarmoshik,Alexander Rogozin,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究带交叉耦合混合仿射约束的去中心化优化，揭示两个仿射通道组合的内在难度由 Friedrichs 角度决定，并提出加速去中心化方法达到极小极大最优复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部变量与共享变量通过两个仿射通道交互，各通道单独良态但组合困难，需刻画这种跨通道耦合带来的额外复杂度来源。

Method: 引入 Friedrichs 角度刻画跨耦几何，定义无法通过逐通道预条件消除的交叉耦合因子，据此设计加速去中心化算法。

Result: 在光滑强凸情形达到匹配的极小极大保证，并将框架扩展到光滑与非光滑凸目标；实验验证了复杂度对跨通道几何与网络条件的依赖性。

Conclusion: 跨通道几何（Friedrichs 角度）是支配仿射预言机与通信复杂度的关键因素，所提方法在该几何下达到最优性能。

Abstract: We study decentralized optimization with cross-coupled mixed affine constraints, where local and shared variables interact through two affine channels. We show that the intrinsic difficulty of combining separately well-conditioned channels is governed by their Friedrichs angle. This geometry induces a cross-coupling factor that cannot be removed by channelwise preconditioning and governs the additional affine-oracle and communication complexity. We develop an accelerated decentralized method with matching minimax guarantees in the smooth strongly convex regime and extend the framework to smooth and nonsmooth convex objectives. Experiments confirm the predicted dependence on cross-channel geometry and network conditioning.

</details>


### [254] [Cubature-Based Statistical Moment Steering for Nonlinear, Non-Gaussian Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33022)
*Daniel C. Qi,Kenshiro Oguri*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究确定性非线性系统中的离散时间非高斯分布导引问题，提出基于统计矩导引与序列凸优化相结合的方法，并以二维振子为例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布导引需针对轨迹分布而非单条轨迹设计控制策略。非线性系统即使初始为高斯分布，也会演化为非高斯分布，难以获得概率密度的闭式表达，因此需要近似方法。

Method: 采用基于cubature的统计矩导引方法近似非高斯分布，并给出理论支撑，说明如何通过序列凸优化求解该问题。

Result: 以描述二维振子的耦合非线性二阶常微分方程为数值算例进行验证。

Conclusion: 统计矩导引配合序列凸优化可为非线性系统的非高斯分布导引提供具理论支持的近似求解途径。

Abstract: This paper addresses discrete-time non-Gaussian distribution steering in deterministic nonlinear systems. Distribution steering is a problem in which a control policy is designed over a distribution of trajectories rather than optimizing a single trajectory. The challenge with nonlinear systems is that even initially Gaussian distributions evolve into non-Gaussian distributions, often precluding a closed-form representation of the probability density. A method called statistical moment steering applies a cubature-based method to approximate non-Gaussian distributions for an approximate solution to this problem. This paper provides theoretical support and details how it can be solved with sequential convex optimization. A coupled, nonlinear, second-order ordinary differential equation describing a two-dimensional oscillator is provided as a numerical example.

</details>


### [255] [Plug-and-Play Methods Provably Converge Even with Improperly Trained Denoisers: Convergence by Architectural Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33087)
*Henry Pritchard,Rahul Parhi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文厘清LPN的理论基础，扩展激活函数类别，并研究两种控制学习先验的实用机制：与恒等映射平均和直接缩放隐式正则项，为缩放近端算子提出收敛算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PnP方法用学习到的去噪器替换近端算子，重建质量好但失去变分解释与收敛保证；LPN通过设计去噪器架构使其恰为正则项的近端算子来解决此问题，但其理论基础和先验控制机制尚不完善。

Method: 澄清LPN的理论基础并将其框架扩展到更广类别的激活函数；研究两种控制学习先验的机制：(i) 将LPN与恒等映射平均（PnP常见启发式），(ii) 直接缩放近端算子诱导的隐式正则项；刻画平均所诱导的正则项，并开发评估缩放近端算子的收敛方法。

Result: 扩展了LPN框架至更广激活函数；刻画了平均操作所诱导的正则项；开发了可收敛的缩放近端算子评估方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为LPN提供更坚实的理论基础并使其先验可控，兼顾PnP的重建质量与近端方法的变分解释及收敛保障。

Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods replace proximal operators with learned denoisers, which produce state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, but sacrifice the variational interpretation and convergence guarantees of proximal methods. Learned Proximal Networks (LPNs) address this problem by designing the denoiser architecture so that it is exactly the proximal operator of a regularizer. In this work, we clarify the theoretical foundations of LPNs and extend the framework to a broader class of activation functions. We then study two practical mechanisms for controlling the learned prior: (i) averaging the LPN with the identity, a common heuristic in PnP methods, and (ii) directly scaling the implicit regularizer induced by the proximal operator. In particular, we characterize the regularizer induced by averaging and develop a convergent method for evaluating the scaled proximal operator.

</details>


### [256] [Sharp Critical Minimax Laws and No-Learning Thresholds in Continuous-Time Adaptive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33154)
*Chen Jia*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究未知向量控制增益的连续时间情景控制（标量状态、二次动作代价、光滑凸终端代价），刻画极小极大改进量的临界律并给出高斯问题的精确无学习相变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未知控制增益下的情景连续控制缺乏对最优可达改进与学习-不学习边界的精确理论刻画，需要极小极大框架下的临界标度与相变结果。

Method: 用极小极大分析：对Δ(H)证明匹配的上下界，下界来自对全自适应、无界幅度控制成立的均匀亏缺-能量不等式，上界由移动软阈值反馈实现；将局部参数下N回合归一化极小极大遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制比较；对高斯问题刻画精确无学习相变。

Result: 证得临界律 Δ(H)≍δ^4√log(1/δ)（δ=√2H²−1↓0），上下界匹配；局部参数θ=N^{−1/4}h下归一化极小极大遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制相差O(N^{−1/2})，无额外维度因子，终端任务仅通过c_g=Var(g(Z))进入极限；高斯问题相变 C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 ⟺ H⁴T≤d²/2，渐近任务边界 c_gH⁴=d²/2。

Conclusion: 给出了未知增益连续时间控制的精确临界标度与无学习相变边界，表明局部渐近中遗憾由固定视界高斯序贯控制主导且维度不额外进入。

Abstract: We study episodic continuous-time control with an unknown vector control gain, scalar state, quadratic action cost, and smooth convex terminal cost. In the scalar Gaussian experiment, let $Δ(H)$ denote the minimax improvement over zero control and set $δ=\sqrt2H^2-1$. We prove the critical law
  $$ Δ(H)\asymp δ^4\sqrt{\log(1/δ)} \qquad (δ\downarrow0), $$
  with a matching lower and upper bound. The lower bound follows from a uniform deficit--energy inequality valid for fully adaptive controls with unbounded amplitudes, while a moving soft-threshold feedback attains the rate.
  For local parameters $θ=N^{-1/4}h$, $|h|\le H$, we show that the normalized minimax regret over $N$ episodes is within $O(N^{-1/2})$ of a fixed-horizon Gaussian sequential control problem, without an additional dimension factor. The terminal task enters the limit only through $c_g=\operatorname{Var}(g(Z))$. The Gaussian problem exhibits an exact no-learning phase transition:
  $$ C_d^T(H)=TH^2/2 \iff H^4T\le d^2/2, $$
  yielding the asymptotic task boundary $c_gH^4=d^2/2$.

</details>


### [257] [Notes on Generative Modeling for Feedback Control and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33164)
*Karthik Elamvazhuthi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文从"动态约束采样"的视角重新审视控制问题，将流匹配、归一化流和去噪扩散等生成建模方法扩展到控制系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希望为控制理论与机器人领域的研究者提供一个易于理解的入门视角，将控制问题与生成建模方法建立联系。

Method: 把控制视为控制系统的状态空间上的动态约束采样问题，借助可控性、最优控制和轨迹规划等概念，指导生成模型的扩展并分析算法的适定性。

Result: 所提方法可应用于将系统引导至目标状态或目标分布，以及从可达集中采样。

Conclusion: 本笔记为控制与机器人背景的读者提供了生成建模方法用于控制的入门性介绍。

Abstract: In these notes, we view control as a dynamically constrained sampling problem on the state-space of a control system. With this viewpoint, we extend methods from generative modeling, such as flow matching, normalizing flows and denoising diffusions to control problems. Concepts such as controllability, optimal control and trajectory planning play an important role in guiding the extension and understanding well-posedeness of the corresponding algorithms, with application to steering systems to target states or distributions and sampling from reachable sets. The notes are intended as an accessible introduction for readers with a background in control theory and robotics.

</details>


### [258] [An Adaptive, Parallel, and Inexact Newton Method for Large-scale Nonlinear Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33206)
*Luke Bhan,Michael W. Mahoney,Sen Na*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: AOTD是首个在线自适应重叠尺寸的并行SQP方法，用于长时域非线性最优控制，理论证明KKT残差收敛并给出局部线性率，实验降低约2.5倍FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统重叠时间分解（OTD）需事先固定合适的重叠尺寸，缺乏灵活性；长时域非线性OCP计算量大，亟需自适应且可并行的分解方法。

Method: 将长时域分为重叠非线性子问题，各子问题并行执行一步SQP，并在线自适应选择重叠尺寸与局部KKT系统的求解精度；采用两个条件控制接受步：自适应残差条件（约束拼接非精确方向与全问题精确牛顿方向的距离）和基于自适应惩罚参数的下条件（对精确增广拉格朗日函数保证下降）。残差条件与求解器无关，兼容确定性迭代与随机sketching求解器。

Result: 在标准正则假设下，证明KKT残差从任意初值收敛到零，并对收敛到严格局部极小值的序列建立局部线性速率；在电力系统频率调节OCP与Burgers PDE OCP上验证，相比最佳固定重叠变体，估计FLOPs降低约2.5倍，并可用单一参数设置在多个时域长度上收敛。

Conclusion: AOTD通过在线自适应重叠尺寸与求解精度，消除了先验调参需求，兼顾理论收敛保证与实际计算效率，为长时域非线性OCP提供了可扩展的并行求解框架。

Abstract: We design adaptive overlapping temporal decomposition (AOTD), a parallel sequential quadratic programming (SQP) method for long-horizon nonlinear optimal control problems (OCPs). As designed, AOTD is the first overlapping temporal decomposition (OTD) algorithm that adapts the overlap size online, eliminating the need to fix a suitable overlap a priori. Specifically, at each iteration, it partitions the long horizon into overlapping nonlinear subproblems, performs one SQP step on each in parallel, and adaptively selects both the overlap size and the accuracy to which the resulting local KKT systems are solved. Two conditions govern the accepted step: an adaptive residual condition bounding the distance from the concatenated inexact direction to the exact Newton direction of the full problem, and a descent condition on the adaptive penalty parameters that certifies descent for a carefully chosen exact augmented Lagrangian. The residual condition is solver independent and accommodates both deterministic iterative solvers and randomized sketching solvers. Under standard regularity assumptions, we prove that the KKT residual converges to zero from any initialization and establish a local linear rate for sequences converging to a strict local minimizer. We validate AOTD on a power-system frequency regulation OCP and a Burgers PDE OCP, attaining a reduction in estimated FLOPs of approximately $2.5\times$ to the best fixed-overlap variant while converging across multiple horizon lengths with a single parameter setting.

</details>


### [259] [Tensor nuclear norm minimization with linear constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33219)
*Renjie Chen,Nanxi Zhang,Bo Jiang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带一般线性约束的张量核范数最小化问题，提出有限支撑的精确半定规划（SDP）表示，并给出离散化与自适应两种求解方法，在合成与真实交通数据上验证了自适应方法的高精度恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量核范数是张量秩的凸松弛，广泛用于计算机视觉、推荐系统、收益管理与交通研究，但直接计算核范数本身是NP难问题，且一般线性约束下优化约束数看似无穷多，导致计算困难。因此需要揭示其隐藏的有限结构以实现可解优化。

Method: 提出SDP框架：证明张量核范数可由单位球上有限个点支撑的精确SDP表示。基于此发展两种互补方法：(1) 用有限球面离散化替代未知支撑集，具有最坏情况近似保证；(2) 自适应选取球面点，有限终止时返回精确最优解，否则渐近收敛到最优解。

Result: 在合成张量补全实例与真实高速公路交通数据上的数值实验表明，自适应方法与现有方法相比具有竞争力，且常显著提升恢复精度。

Conclusion: 该工作通过有限点SDP表示突破了张量核范数优化的计算瓶颈，两种方法分别提供近似保证与精确/渐近最优性，为低秩张量优化提供了有效且实用的求解途径。

Abstract: We study the tensor nuclear norm minimization with general linear constraints, a fundamental model for low-rank tensor optimization that includes many practical applications in computer vision, recommendation systems, revenue management, transportation research. Although the tensor nuclear norm is a convex surrogate for the tensor rank, optimizing it remains computationally challenging because evaluating the nuclear norm itself is NP-hard. We propose a semidefinite programming framework that exposes a finite structure hidden in this problem, even though it appears to possess infinitely many constraints. In particular, we show that the tensor nuclear norm admits an exact SDP representation supported by a finite number of points on the unit sphere. Based on this representation, we develop two complementary solution approaches. The first replaces the unknown support set by a finite sphere discretization which yields a solution with a provable worst-case approximation guarantee. The second selects spherical points adaptively, returns an exact optimum upon finite termination, and otherwise converges asymptotically to an optimal solution. Numerical experiments on synthetic tensor completion instances and real highway traffic data demonstrate that the adaptive method achieves competitive, and often substantially improved, recovery accuracy relative to existing methods.

</details>


### [260] [Complexity analysis of trust-region methods under $(α,L_0,L_1)$-smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33238)
*Youssef Diouane,Mohamed L. Habiboullah,Awa Khouna,Dominique Orban*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出无需预知参数的信赖域方法，在(α,L0,L1)-光滑假设下达到最优复杂度界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习中目标函数梯度可能非Lipschitz连续，(α,L0,L1)-光滑假设受关注，但现有最优复杂度方法需已知参数，而参数无关方法又达不到最优界。

Method: 采用信赖域方法，建立新的分析工具（超越经典信赖域复杂度分析），并允许使用一般模型Hessian近似，包括有限内存拟牛顿更新。

Result: 信赖域方法在无参数先验知识下达到(α,L0,L1)-光滑目标函数的最优复杂度界，且该复杂度界在非凸情形下是紧的。

Conclusion: 信赖域方法可实现参数无关的最优复杂度，并兼容有限内存拟牛顿等Hessian近似。

Abstract: Generalized smoothness assumptions have attracted growing attention in recent years, motivated in part by machine learning problems in which the gradient of the objective function may not be Lipschitz continuous. Among the most prominent of these is the $(α, L_0, L_1)$-smoothness assumption. Existing methods that attain the best known complexity bounds require knowledge of, or upper bounds on, $α$, $L_0$ and $L_1$, while the few parameter-agnostic methods available do not recover those bounds. In this paper, we show that trust-region methods attain the best known bounds for $(α, L_0, L_1)$-smooth objective functions without prior knowledge of these parameters. Establishing these results requires new analytical tools, beyond those used in classical trust-region complexity analyses. We further show that our working model assumption allows the use of general model Hessian approximations and, in particular, accommodates limited-memory quasi-Newton updates. Finally, we show that our complexity bound is sharp in the nonconvex setting.

</details>


### [261] [Exact oracle complexity for function-value suboptimality under weighted initial conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33360)
*Yoel Drori*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文在L-光滑、μ-强凸函数上，针对初始距离、函数次优值与梯度范数平方的加权组合，精确刻画了N次一阶oracle调用后的最坏情况次优性，并在d≥2N+1时给出了由单标量方程唯一解确定的确定性极小极大风险，且构造了达到下界的常内存方法ITEM-w。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶方法在光滑强凸优化中的最坏情况性能（极小极大风险）对理解算法最优性至关重要。已有结果多针对特定初始条件（如初始距离或函数值），缺乏在初始距离、函数次优值与梯度范数平方加权组合下的统一精确刻画，尤其是对应最优算法是否存在尚不明确。

Method: 通过构造显式难例实例给出下界，并设计常内存一阶方法ITEM-w；证明在维度d≥2N+1、排除无法保证函数值严格改进的情形下，极小极大风险由涉及N步递推的单标量方程的唯一解给出，使ITEM-w的最坏情况性能与下界匹配。

Result: 在d≥2N+1时得到了L-光滑μ-强凸函数上N次一阶oracle调用后加权组合风险的精确确定性极小极大值，由单标量方程唯一解刻画。该方法在标准初始条件下恢复了Kim与Fessler的Optimized Gradient Method所得精确凸界，并证明了Kim、Ryu与Das Gupta的ITEM-f在初始函数值条件下是极小极大最优的。

Conclusion: 研究统一并精确刻画了光滑强凸一阶优化的极小极大风险，提出最优的常内存方法ITEM-w，同时验证并推广了OGM与ITEM-f的最优性结论。

Abstract: We determine the exact worst-case function-value suboptimality after $N$ first-order oracle calls on $L$-smooth, $μ$-strongly convex functions under a nonnegative weighted combination of the initial squared distance, function-value suboptimality, and squared gradient norm. Excluding the case where no strict improvement in function-value suboptimality can be guaranteed, the exact deterministic minimax risk in dimension $d\geq2N+1$ is characterized by the unique solution of a single scalar equation involving an $N$-step recurrence. The proof constructs an explicit hard instance for the lower bound and a constant-memory first-order method, ITEM-w, whose worst-case performance matches this lower bound. On the standard initial conditions, the result recovers the exact convex bound attained by the Optimized Gradient Method of Kim and Fessler, and establishes the minimax optimality of the recently introduced ITEM-f method of Kim, Ryu, and Das Gupta for the initial function-value condition.

</details>


### [262] [Local LMO is Secretly a Projection Method!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33383)
*Peter Richtárik,Ammar Mahran*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 局部LMO步骤等价于对可行集与分离超平面交集的投影，且可仅用线性预言机计算；该步骤属于一类按半空间深度索引的投影方法族，在Hölder连续梯度下达到最优通用收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 避免计算投影，仅用线性最小化预言机(LMO)求解带约束凸问题，并理解Local LMO方法的本质与收敛性质。

Method: 证明当球半径不超过Polyak半径时，Local LMO步骤等于当前迭代点向可行集与某分离超平面交集的欧氏投影；将该方法归入按半空间深度索引的投影方法族，并分析其收敛率。

Result: 对ϑ-Hölder连续梯度目标，足够深的半空间方法族使前K次迭代最优值以O(K^{-(1+ϑ)/2})收敛，匹配Nesterov(2015)非加速通用梯度法。Polyak半径下，当约束最优也是无约束最优(‖∇f(x⋆)‖=0)时达到同速率，否则为O(K^{-1/(2-ϑ)})。

Conclusion: Local LMO是更广泛投影方法族的特例，可通过线性预言机实现投影效果，并在Hölder光滑目标下取得最优或依赖于最优条件的收敛率。

Abstract: The local linear minimization oracle (Ferris and Zavriev, 1996; arXiv:2605.08850), or Local LMO, solves constrained convex problems without having to compute a projection: it minimizes a linear model over the intersection of the feasible set with a ball around the current iterate. We show that, whenever the ball radius does not exceed the Polyak radius, the Local LMO step is the Euclidean projection of the current iterate onto the intersection of the feasible set with a half-space that separates the iterate from the solution set; this projection is nonetheless computable by a linear oracle alone. We demonstrate that Local LMO belongs to a broader family of projection methods which may be indexed by the depth of the localizing half-space. For objectives with $\vartheta$-Hölder continuous gradient, every method from this family whose half-space lies sufficiently deep drives the best of its first $K$ iterates to optimality at the universal rate $\mathcal{O}(K^{-(1+\vartheta)/2})$, matching the non-accelerated universal gradient method of Nesterov (2015). Run at the Polyak radius, Local LMO attains the same rate when the constrained optima are also unconstrained ($\|\nabla f(x_\star)\| = 0$), and the rate $\mathcal{O}(K^{-1/(2-\vartheta)})$ otherwise.

</details>


### [263] [Accelerated Stochastic Method under $(H_0,H_1)$-Smoothness and Heavy-Tailed Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33415)
*Aleksandr Lobanov,Darina Dvinskikh,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在重尾噪声下求解凸(H0,H1)-光滑优化的加速随机方法，结合加速更新、裁剪、投影和阶段重启，每次迭代仅用单个随机梯度样本，实现高概率收敛且保持对H0和H1的平方根依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾噪声下凸优化缺乏高效加速方法，现有方法常依赖小批量采样或对噪声矩有严格假设，本文旨在用单样本、高概率收敛的方式处理一般p阶噪声矩及梯度/间隙相关噪声。

Method: 方法结合加速更新与裁剪、投影、阶段重启；每次迭代使用单个随机梯度样本，无需小批量。针对有限p阶噪声矩（1<p≤2）及常数、梯度相关、间隙相关三类噪声建立分析，并扩展到噪声矩随(f(x)-f*)的α次幂缩放的情形。

Result: 证明了在裁剪偏差下仍能高概率收敛到任意精度；确定性项保持对H0和H1的平方根依赖。在三组分噪声模型中，强凸性下仅常数分量带来多项式精度代价，若去掉该分量即使p<2也仅需对数代价。更一般地，当噪声矩按(f(x)-f*)的α次幂缩放时，凸目标在α=p、强凸在α=p/2时随机代价变为对数。

Conclusion: 该加速裁剪方法在重尾噪声下以单样本实现高概率收敛，并给出与噪声结构相关的精确复杂度刻画，统一了凸与强凸情形下的对数/多项式代价边界。

Abstract: We develop an accelerated stochastic method for convex $(H_0,H_1)$-smooth optimization under heavy-tailed noise. The unbiased oracle has a finite $p$-th noise moment, $1<p\le2$, with constant, gradient-dependent, and gap-dependent terms. Our method combines accelerated updates with clipping, projection, and phase restarts. Each iteration uses a single stochastic-gradient sample, without minibatching. We prove high-probability convergence to any desired accuracy despite clipping bias. The deterministic terms retain square-root dependence on both $H_0$ and $H_1$. In our three-component noise model, strong convexity leaves a polynomial accuracy cost only for the constant component; without it, the dependence is logarithmic even for $p<2$. More generally, for noise moments scaling as $(f(x)-f^\star)^α$, the stochastic cost becomes logarithmic at $α=p$ for convex objectives and $α=p/2$ under strong convexity.

</details>


### [264] [lapanda: A Matrix-Free Differentiable Solver for Nonconvex Constrained Optimization Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33630)
*Yuankun Chen,Zifei Nie,Kangyu Lin,Ján Drgoňa,Liang Wu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出 lapanda，一种针对非凸约束优化的无矩阵可微求解器，通过增广拉格朗日与一阶内层求解高效前向，并以灵敏度对齐实现高效反向，显著降低时间与内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微优化能为网络流水线带来数学优化的结构保证，但现有可微求解器依赖特定问题结构、表达能力受限，且前向与反向的时间和内存开销大，难以处理非凸约束问题。

Method: 将问题重写为一系列增广拉格朗日子问题，每个子问题由带自适应线搜索的近端平均拟牛顿一阶内层求解器处理以加速前向；证明解映射的局部适定性与外层收敛，并在反向推导原问题与最终子问题的灵敏度对齐，用无矩阵方式高效计算子问题灵敏度作为精确优化器灵敏度的近似。

Result: 在非凸约束 Rosenbrock 基准、多种代表性约束最优控制的模仿学习以及嵌入式机器人避障任务上评估，相比 SOTA 可微求解器大幅降低计算时间与内存占用，同时保持可靠的约束满足与学习性能。

Conclusion: lapanda 为通用约束非凸优化提供了一种高效可微、理论有保证的求解方案，在效率与性能之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Differentiable optimization brings the structural guarantees of mathematical optimization to network pipelines, allowing them to be trained end-to-end. However, its application remains challenging for nonconvex constrained problems, as existing differentiable solvers often suffer from limited modeling expressiveness due to their reliance on specialized problem structures, while also incurring substantial computation time and memory overhead in both the forward and backward passes. To address these challenges, we propose lapanda, a matrix-free differentiable solver for nonconvex optimization with general constraints. It reformulates the problem to a sequence of augmented Lagrangian subproblems, each handled by a first-order inner solver through a proximal averaged quasi-Newton algorithm with adaptive linesearch, thus enabling efficient forward optimization. We establish local well-posedness of the solution map and convergence of the outer iterations, and further derive a sensitivity alignment between the original problem and the final subproblem in the backward pass, demonstrating that the subproblem sensitivity, which can be computed efficiently in a matrix-free manner, provides a principled approximation to the exact optimizer sensitivity. We evaluate lapanda on nonconvex constrained Rosenbrock benchmarks, imitation learning with several representative constrained optimal control problems, and embedded robotic obstacle-avoidance tasks. Compared with state-of-the-art differentiable solvers, lapanda delivers substantial reductions in computation time and memory footprint while maintaining reliable constraint satisfaction and learning performance.

</details>


### [265] [Restricted-Multiplier Positivstellensätze for Polynomial Optimization with Affine Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33697)
*Jie Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文为仿射参数多项式建立了仅依赖主变量的平方和乘子型正性证书，在受限Archimedean序单位条件下给出严格正标量多项式的证书，并构造收敛的受限矩-SOS层级用于带仿射参数的多项式优化，实现全局最优性检测与最小点恢复；结果推广到多项式矩阵约束及多参数情形，应用于鲁棒LP、鲁棒Lyapunov设计、min-max优化和输入仿射动力系统，数值上显著降低SDP块规模与求解时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带仿射参数的多项式优化问题在鲁棒优化与控制中很常见，但标准矩-SOS方法直接处理参数会导致半定规划块规模过大、求解缓慢。作者希望利用参数仅以仿射形式出现这一结构，构造更紧凑且仍具收敛保证的正性证书与优化层级。

Method: 针对仿射参数多项式，构造平方和乘子仅依赖主变量的正性证书；在受限Archimedean序单位条件下证明严格正标量多项式存在此类证书；据此建立受限矩-SOS层级并给出用于全局最优性检测和全局最小点恢复的flatness判据；将标量定理推广至任意数量仿射参数的多项式矩阵约束，并区分单参数点态正性与多参数需均匀自由正性的情形。

Result: 证明受限Archimedean条件下严格正标量多项式具有所述证书；得到收敛的受限矩-SOS层级及全局最优性flatness判据；标量结果可推广到多项式矩阵约束；矩阵目标下单参数时点态正性足够，两参数及以上可能失效，均匀自由正性是一般性充分替代；数值实验显示该方法显著减小半定规划块尺寸和求解时间，且大多数测试中界质量几乎不退化。

Conclusion: 提出的受限正性证书与矩-SOS层级为仿射参数多项式优化提供了更高效且具收敛保证的框架，扩展至矩阵约束与多参数情形，并在鲁棒优化与控制等应用中有效降低计算成本。

Abstract: We develop positivity certificates for polynomials that are affine in auxiliary parameters, with sum-of-squares multipliers depending only on the principal variables. Under a restricted Archimedean order-unit condition, every strictly positive scalar polynomial admits such a certificate. We construct a convergent restricted moment-SOS hierarchy for polynomial optimization problems with affine parameters and establish a flatness criterion for global optimality detection and global minimizer recovery. The scalar theorem extends to polynomial-matrix constraints with any number of affine parameters. For matrix-valued objectives, pointwise positivity is sufficient with one parameter but can fail with two or more parameters; uniform free positivity provides a general sufficient replacement. Applications include robust linear programming, robust Lyapunov design, min-max polynomial optimization, analysis and control of input-affine dynamical systems. Numerical experiments show that the proposed approach substantially reduces semidefinite block sizes and solution times while incurring little or no degradation in bound quality for most test cases.

</details>


### [266] [Annealed Sinkhorn with Momentum: Certified Unregularized Optimal Transport in Linear Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33814)
*Samuel J. K. Chin,Maximilian Schiffer*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将Bregman Douglas-Rachford splitting (BDRS)刻画为单步内迭代的IPOT，并揭示其等价于带隐式退火温度调度的Sinkhorn；提出线性内存的原对偶证书与过松弛BDRS，在大规模最优传输上实现更低代价与显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无正则化离散最优传输的求解通常内存开销大（二次复杂度）、缺乏可计算的停止准则，且温度参数作用不明确。作者希望统一BDRS与IPOT视角，降低内存并给出可验证的最优性证书，以支撑超大规模传输问题。

Method: 1) 证明BDRS等价于单次内层Sinkhorn迭代的热启动IPOT；2) 消去原始传输计划得到等价对偶形式，显示BDRS为隐式逆线性温度调度下的退火Sinkhorn，含log-scaling动量项与更冷的核，从而把内存从二次降到线性；3) 基于退火视角提出过松弛BDRS，将退火与过松弛缩放统一在单一递推中；4) 为两种方法推导无需构造传输计划、线性内存可计算的原对偶证书作为停止准则。

Result: 在DOTmark上，动量结合更冷核在同一调度下最优性间隙显著小于退火Sinkhorn；1024×1024图像像素级颜色迁移中，BDRS比MDOT-TNT修复传输代价更低且加速9倍，24分钟达到1.59%相对对偶间隙；4238×2365图像（每图约千万像素、约百万亿隐式传输项）单张NVIDIA L40S上35小时内双向分别达到2.41%与2.80%的最佳相对对偶间隙。

Conclusion: BDRS可被理解为隐式退火Sinkhorn，兼具线性内存与可计算原对偶证书；过松弛BDRS在大规模无正则化最优传输中表现优于基线，能扩展到百亿亿级隐式传输条目。

Abstract: We characterize Bregman Douglas-Rachford splitting (BDRS) for unregularized discrete optimal transport and develop an anytime primal-dual certificate in linear memory. We first establish that BDRS coincides with warm-started Inexact Proximal point method for exact Optimal Transport (IPOT) using a single inner Sinkhorn iteration. By eliminating the primal transport plan from the updates, we derive an equivalent dual formulation that reveals BDRS as annealed Sinkhorn under an implicit inverse-linear temperature schedule, with an additional log-scaling momentum term and a cooler kernel. While this explains the role of the temperature parameter in BDRS as an initial temperature, it also reduces the solver's memory requirement from quadratic to linear. Utilizing this annealing perspective, we introduce overrelaxed BDRS, which combines annealing and overrelaxed scaling within a single recursion. We derive a primal-dual certificate for both methods that can be evaluated in linear memory without transport plan construction, thus providing a computable stopping rule. On the DOTmark benchmark, combining momentum with the cooler kernel produces substantially smaller optimality gaps than annealed Sinkhorn under the same schedule. For pixel-level color transfer between $1024\times1024$ images, BDRS attains a lower repaired transport cost than MDOT-TNT with a 9$\times$ speed up, reaching a relative duality gap of $1.59\%$ in 24 minutes. We further demonstrate a color transfer with $4238\times2365$ images, yielding 10 million pixels per image and approximately one hundred trillion implicit transport entries, reaching a best relative duality gap of $2.41\%$ and $2.80\%$ within 35 hours in each direction on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU.

</details>


### [267] [Accelerated Consensus and Decentralized Optimization over Slowly Varying Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33824)
*Darina Dvinskikh,Anton Novitskii,Demyan Yarmoshik,Alexander Rogozin,Vladislav Matyukhin,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 论文提出WAVE——一种加窗Chebyshev方法，通过有限窗口后重启递推来限制网络变化累积影响，实现慢时变网络上的平均一致性并应用于去中心化优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究慢时变网络上的平均一致性问题及其在去中心化优化中的应用，核心挑战是网络时变带来的累积误差会阻碍经典一致性方法达到固定网络中的收敛速率。

Method: 提出WAVE——窗口化Chebyshev方法，在有限时间窗口后重启Chebyshev递推，以限制网络变化对一致性的累积影响。方法通过网络条件数χ和连续通信算子变化界β刻画性能。

Result: 当χ为网络条件数界且‖L_{k+1}-L_k‖≤β时，WAVE在O((√χ+min{βχ²,χ})ln(e/ε))轮达到ε-一致性，在β=O(χ^{-3/2})时匹配固定网络√χ速率。对于分段常数网络（变化即时检测且相邻变化间隔≥τ），达到O((√χ+χ/τ)ln(e/ε))轮。用于加速去中心化优化时，对α-光滑凸局部目标和μ-强凸平均，慢变化网络下每个智能体在Õ(√(α/μ)√χ)轮获得ε-解。

Conclusion: WAVE在慢时变网络上平滑插值于不同变化程度，在缓变情形下达到与固定网络相同的收敛速率，并可有效支撑去中心化优化的加速。

Abstract: We study average consensus over slowly time-varying networks and its application to decentralized optimization. We introduce WAVE, a windowed Chebyshev method that limits the accumulated effect of network variation by restarting the recurrence after finite windows. If $χ$ bounds the network condition number and successive communication operators satisfy $\|L_{k+1}-L_k\|\leqβ$, WAVE reaches $ε$-consensus in $O((\sqrtχ+\min\lbraceβχ^2,χ\rbrace)\ln(e/ε))$ communication rounds. This rate matches the fixed-network $\sqrtχ$ dependence when $β=O(χ^{-3/2})$ and smoothly interpolates across the full range of network variation. For piecewise-constant networks where each change is detected when it occurs and consecutive changes are at least $τ$ rounds apart, WAVE reaches $ε$-consensus in $O((\sqrtχ+χ/τ)\ln(e/ε))$ communication rounds. Finally, we use WAVE as the consensus step in an accelerated decentralized optimization method for $α$-smooth convex local objectives with a $μ$-strongly convex average. For sufficiently slow network variation, every agent obtains an $ε$-solution to the global optimization problem after $\widetilde O(\sqrt{α/μ}\,\sqrtχ)$ communication rounds, matching the fixed-network dependence.

</details>


### [268] [Higher-Order Mean-Field Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33852)
*Levon Nurbekyan,Samy Wu Fung*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出高阶平均场控制障碍函数（MF-CBF）理论，通过高阶微分不等式保证障碍泛函的正性，解决了传统一阶MF-CBF无法处理无控制一阶导数约束的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MF-CBF公式（如随机覆盖与shepherding应用）使用一阶微分不等式，无法直接施加那些障碍函数一阶导不含控制的约束。类比有限维情形，需要发展高阶MF-CBF理论。

Method: 引入平均场安全泛函的相对阶（relative degree）概念，建立计算其高阶导数的解析框架；针对互相关与自相关泛函等实例，证明沿平均场动力学的重复微分具有结构保持性，并可化简为核递归（kernel recursions）。

Result: 在双积分器群体跟踪与避障问题中应用高阶MF-CBF，其中仅位置约束导致相对阶为二的MF-CBF，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 高阶MF-CBF为群体安全提供了更通用的理论工具，扩展了平均场安全约束的可处理范围。

Abstract: Mean-field control barrier functions (MF-CBFs) enforce swarm safety through constraints on the agents' distribution. Previous formulations, including applications to stochastic coverage and shepherding, use first-order differential inequalities. These cannot directly enforce constraints whose barrier functions yield control-free first derivatives. Thus, we develop the theory of higher-order MF-CBFs, which ensures the positivity of the barrier functionals through higher-order differential inequalities, as in their finite-dimensional analogs. More specifically, we introduce the notion of relative degree for mean-field safety functionals and develop an analytic framework for computing their higher-order derivatives. Moreover, for practical examples of cross-correlation and self-correlation functionals, we show that repeated differentiation along mean-field dynamics is structure-preserving and reduces to kernel recursions. As an illustration, we apply higher-order MF-CBFs to double-integrator swarm tracking and avoidance problems, where position-only constraints lead to MF-CBFs of relative degree two.

</details>


### [269] [DCEmbed: Scalable Optimization over Neural Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33879)
*Akshay Sreekumar,Nicolas Christianson,Priya L. Donti,Ellen Vitercik,Ram Rajagopal*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出DCEmbed，一种针对嵌入神经网络代理的优化问题启发式方法，利用ReLU网络的差分凸表示避免引入激活二值变量，仅用两个线性不等式和一个连续辅助变量即可精确嵌入凸分量，通过迭代惩罚凸凹过程求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用神经代理替代昂贵或难解的模型组件可加速大规模优化，但嵌入问题本身求解代价高。ReLU网络的精确混合整数编码需引入大量二值变量处理激活非线性，导致计算不可行。

Method: 利用网络的差分凸（DC）表示，避免激活二值变量；挖掘ReLU网络DC表示中的共享结构，为凸分量导出降维的精确表达式，每个隐藏神经元仅需两个线性不等式和一个连续辅助变量；采用迭代惩罚凸凹过程，每步仅近似神经项的凹部分，保留原目标、约束和离散决策，使凸或混合整数求解器可联合优化主机与代理。

Result: 在二次规划、混合整数资源分配和神经两阶段随机规划实验上，相比精确混合整数嵌入方法更快获得高质量可行解。资源分配问题上归一化原始积分比最佳精确基线低4倍；两阶段随机规划中达到全局代理最优比Gurobi ML快约5倍。

Conclusion: DCEmbed通过DC表示和连续松弛有效规避二值变量爆炸，在保持原问题结构的同时显著提升嵌入神经代理优化问题的求解效率。

Abstract: Neural surrogates can accelerate large-scale optimization by replacing expensive or intractable model components with efficient learned approximations, but solving the resulting embedded problems can remain prohibitively costly. For instance, standard exact encodings of neural networks with ReLU activations allow the problem to be solved by mixed-integer solvers, but add large numbers of binary variables to accommodate the nonlinearity of the activations, which can render the problem computationally prohibitive. To address this, we propose DCEmbed, a heuristic for optimization problems with embedded neural surrogates that leverages the difference-of-convex (DC) representation of the network and avoids adding activation binaries. Exploiting shared structure within the DC representation of a ReLU network, we derive a reduced-size, exact formulation for its convex components that can be embedded in optimization problems using just two linear inequalities and one continuous auxiliary variable per hidden neuron. Using this, the problem is solved via an iterative penalty convex-concave procedure, where only the concave portions of the neural terms are approximated at each stage. The original objective, constraints, and any discrete decisions are retained, allowing standard convex or mixed-integer optimization solvers to optimize the host and surrogate jointly at each iteration. In experiments on quadratic programs, mixed-integer resource allocation, and neural two-stage stochastic programming, our method demonstrates much faster progress toward high-quality feasible solutions than approaches using exact mixed-integer embeddings. In particular, DCEmbed achieves $4\times$ lower normalized primal integral than the best exact baseline on the resource allocation problem, while in two-stage stochastic programming it reaches the global surrogate optimum $\sim 5\times$ faster than Gurobi ML.

</details>


### [270] [Mixed-Noise Plug-and-Play with Infimal Convolution Fidelities and Multiple Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33897)
*Ziqi Qin,Hong Ye Tan,Ander Biguri,Jingwei Liang,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出可证明收敛的PnP算法，用下卷积保真项处理混合噪声，并扩展到多先验情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PnP算法结合保真项与预训练去噪器处理逆成像问题，但对混合噪声前向过程缺乏可证明收敛的方法，且传统方法仅支持单一先验。

Method: 用下卷积作为保真项，将其解释为对两种噪声的联合MAP估计，保留贝叶斯MAP解释；并用Davis-Yin三算子分裂将PnP扩展到多先验，可与标准或混合噪声保真项结合。在标准Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz条件下证明收敛性。

Result: 在Laplace-Gaussian和Poisson-Gaussian噪声实验中，单/多先验PnP稳定收敛，保真项不匹配时发散；下卷积保真项可扩展至38%标准差噪声，多先验到达不同驻点并更好保留纹理。

Conclusion: 所提PnP方法对混合噪声具有收敛保证和良好的噪声鲁棒性，多先验扩展能改善纹理重建质量。

Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) algorithms are a class of iterative methods for inverse imaging. Within an optimization algorithm, they combine a flexible fidelity term, encoding the forward operator, and a pretrained image denoiser, in order to deal with more severe corruptions such as blurring or downsampling when reconstructing an image. This work studies provably convergent PnP methods for mixed-noise forward processes by using the infimal convolution as a fidelity term, providing a statistical interpretation as a joint maximum a-posteriori estimator over both noises, and preserving the Bayesian MAP interpretation of PnP methods. Independently, we extend the PnP formulation to multiple prior terms using the Davis--Yin three-operator splitting. This extension can be combined with either standard fidelities or the proposed mixed-noise infimal-convolution fidelities. We verify that these generalized PnP methods are convergent under standard Kurdyka--Lojasiewicz conditions. Numerical experiments on Laplace-Gaussian and Poisson--Gaussian noise demonstrate stable convergence of single-prior and multiple-prior PnP methods, and divergence under fidelity mismatch. Furthermore, PnP with infimal convolution fidelities are able to scale to noise up to 38% standard deviation, with multiple priors reaching different stationary points that qualitatively preserve more textural properties.

</details>


### [271] [On the Relevance of Incorporating Decision Dependence in Distributional Ambiguity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33926)
*Hamed Rahimian,Sanjay Mehrotra*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文从建模与计算双重角度研究决策依赖模糊集的分布鲁棒优化，权衡建模精度、解质量与计算代价，并与决策无关DRO比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策依赖模糊集DRO研究多聚焦计算与理论挑战，缺乏对建模保真度、解质量与计算努力之间权衡的系统理解。作者由价格依赖需求的报童问题与位置依赖需求的选址问题驱动，希望厘清决策依赖模糊集相对决策无关模糊集的收益与代价。

Method: 考虑带(非)凸连续recourse的两阶段随机混合整数规划，假设有限样本空间，用多面体模糊集刻画决策依赖分布模糊性，重构为非凸混合整数非线性规划；提出基于分解的割平面算法高效求解。

Result: 基准算例显示，决策依赖模糊集显著降低报童问题的后决策失望(平均最多65%)与选址问题的样本外成本(平均7%)，缓解了相对决策无关DRO的“优化者诅咒”；但计算代价上升，中大规模报童实例绝对运行时间比在2–25之间，选址实例在2–12之间。

Conclusion: 决策依赖模糊集能提升解质量并缓解优化者诅咒，但以更高计算努力为代价；研究为建模精度、解质量与计算效率间的权衡提供了量化依据。

Abstract: Most existing studies on distributionally robust optimization (DRO) with a decision-dependent ambiguity set focus on the computational and theoretical challenges posed by this class of problems. In this paper, we adopt a combined modeling and computational perspective to understand the trade-offs between modeling fidelity, solution quality, and computational effort, particularly in comparison with DRO models using decision-independent ambiguity sets. Motivated by representative applications in joint pricing-stocking newsvendor problems with price-dependent demand and facility location problems with location-dependent demand, we consider a two-stage stochastic mixed-integer program with (non)convex continuous recourse. Assuming a finite sample space, we model the decision-dependent distributional ambiguity with a polyhedral ambiguity set and reformulate the problem as a nonconvex mixed-integer nonlinear program. To efficiently solve the reformulations, we propose decomposition-based cutting-plane algorithms. Our experiments on benchmark instances indicate that a decision-dependent ambiguity set substantially reduces the postdecision disappointment for the newsvendor and out-of-sample cost for the facility location problems, up to 65% and 7% on average, respectively; thereby mitigating the optimizer's curse relative to a decision-independent DRO. However, this improvement is achieved at the expense of increased computational effort, with the absolute runtime ratio falling between 2 and 25 for medium- to large-sized newsvendor instances and between 2 and 12 for facility location instances.

</details>


### [272] [An Intersection Cutting Plane Algorithm for Chance-Constrained Programs with Finite Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33946)
*Soumya Ranjan Pathy,Hamed Rahimian*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 针对有限支撑机会约束规划，提出基于S-free集合的两类相交割及分解型分支割框架，提升Big-M松弛强度与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Big-M混合整数重构在场景数增大时松弛弱、扩展性差，需要更强的割平面与算法框架。

Method: 从问题特定的S-free集合导出两类相交割：一类利用场景需求函数的次模结构，另一类利用概率覆盖；并设计基于分解的分支割框架，结合经典混合不等式、分位割与所提相交割的混合分离策略。

Result: 在集成生产-配送规划实例上的计算实验表明，混合方法相比纯方法减少了计算时间。

Conclusion: 所提相交割与混合分离策略能有效强化机会约束模型并加速求解。

Abstract: Standard Big-M mixed-integer programming reformulations of chance-constrained programs (CCPs) with finite support often yield weak linear relaxations and scale poorly as the number of scenarios increases. To address this limitation, we derive two families of intersection cuts from problem-specific S-free sets and develop decomposition-based branch-and-cut frameworks. The first one exploits the submodular structure of the scenario requirement function, while the second one uses probability covers. We propose hybrid separation strategies that combine classical mixing inequalities and quantile cuts with the proposed intersection cuts. Computational experiments on integrated production-distribution planning instances show that the proposed hybrid methods reduce computational time compared to pure methods.

</details>


### [273] [Constrained Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with One Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34099)
*Yuyang Deng,Mohammadreza M. Kalan,Eitan J. Neugut,Mehrdad Mahdavi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究能否将投影操作推迟到非凸随机优化的最后只做一次，提出一种惩罚近端方法，达到 $\widetilde O(\epsilon^{-4})$ 随机次梯度复杂度并仅需一次投影，返回精确可行解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习（如安全LLM对齐/微调、迁移学习、秩约束持续学习）中常需约束非凸优化，常用Projected SGD每次迭代都投影；但功能约束上的投影代价远高于随机一阶更新。因此作者希望探究能否将投影推迟到最后一次性完成。

Method: 针对弱凸、可能非光滑目标加正则凸约束，提出惩罚近端方法（penalized proximal method），中间更新只用简单欧氏球投影；针对光滑非凸约束，假设不可行约束斜率的全局下界，允许任意甚至不可行初始化，并给出精确惩罚（exact-penalty）变体。

Result: 弱凸非光滑情形：使用 $\widetilde O(\epsilon^{-4})$ 随机次梯度并仅一次约束投影，返回点精确可行且具有小的Moreau包络稳定性度量；光滑目标下同一算法可控制投影梯度映射。光滑非凸约束下，精确惩罚变体达到相同随机oracle阶数，返回精确可行点并位于 $\epsilon$-KKT 点的 $O(\epsilon)$ 邻域内。

Conclusion: 结果属于oracle复杂度保证：单次终端投影代价单独计算，且不假设一般非凸集存在高效投影算法。表明投影可推迟至优化结束，仅需一次即可。

Abstract: Constrained nonconvex optimization has seen increasing application in modern machine learning, such as safe LLM alignment/finetuning, transfer learning and rank-constrained continual learning. The commonly used approach is Projected SGD which requires projection at every iteration. However, projection onto a functional constraint can cost substantially more than a stochastic first-order update. We study whether this operation can be deferred until the end of nonconvex stochastic optimization, and only do it once. For weakly convex, possibly nonsmooth objectives with regular convex constraints, we give a penalized proximal method that uses $\widetilde O(ε^{-4})$ stochastic subgradients and one projection onto the constraint set. The returned point is exactly feasible and has a small Moreau-envelope stationarity measure; for smooth objectives, the same algorithm controls the projected-gradient mapping. For smooth nonconvex constraints, we assume a global lower bound on the infeasible constraint slope which permits arbitrary, possibly infeasible initialization. An exact-penalty variant attains the same stochastic-oracle order and returns an exactly feasible point within $O(ε)$ of an $ε$-KKT point. All intermediate updates use only projections onto a simple Euclidean ball. These are oracle-complexity guarantees: the cost of the single terminal projection is separate, and no efficient projection algorithm for a general nonconvex set is assumed to follow from regularity.

</details>


### [274] [Predictor-Based Stabilization of a Delayed Hetero-Dimensional Shoreline--Bathymetry System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34938)
*Amadou Cissé,Mohamed Boutayeb*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究了带输入时滞的一维岸线子系统与无驱动二维水深动力学的异维抛物耦系统的指数镇定问题，采用谱分解与预测器补偿实现全系统稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异维耦合抛物系统（一维岸线 + 二维水深动力学）中存在恒定输入时滞，无补偿的延迟反馈会放大岸线与水深响应，需要设计有效的镇定控制。

Method: 通过谱分解将有限维临界岸线模态与指数稳定的残余动力学分离；在临界子空间设计状态反馈并提升到完整岸线空间；用辅助输运方程表示时滞，并用预测器消除标称预测动力学中的显式输入时滞；结合加权输入-输出估计与异维交互的小增益条件证明指数稳定性。

Result: 小增益条件下建立了完整耦合系统的指数稳定性；数值仿真显示未补偿的延迟反馈会显著放大岸线与水深响应，而预测器补偿可恢复临界岸线动力学的衰减并阻止延迟引起的放大传播到无驱动水深子系统。

Conclusion: 预测器补偿能有效镇定带输入时滞的异维抛物耦合系统，并抑制延迟放大效应向无驱动子系统传播。

Abstract: Exponential stabilization is investigated for a hetero-dimensional parabolic system in which a one-dimensional shoreline subsystem, subject to a constant input delay, is bidirectionally coupled with unactuated two-dimensional bathymetric dynamics.
