A spectral decomposition separates the finite-dimensional critical shoreline modes from the exponentially stable residual dynamics. State feedback is designed on the critical subspace and lifted to the full shoreline space. An auxiliary transport equation represents the delay, while a predictor removes the explicit input delay from the nominal predictor dynamics. Exponential stability of the full coupled system is established by combining shoreline stabilization and bathymetric coercivity using weighted input--output estimates and a small-gain condition on the hetero-dimensional interaction. Numerical simulations show that uncompensated delayed feedback can strongly amplify both shoreline and bathymetric responses, whereas predictor compensation restores decay of the critical shoreline dynamics and prevents delay-induced amplification from propagating to the unactuated bathymetric subsystem.

</details>


### [275] [On the Optimal Linear Minimization Oracle Complexity of Active-Hull Methods for Minimizing Convex Hölder Smooth Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34101)
*Renbo Zhao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究凸复合优化问题在Hölder光滑下的最优LMO复杂度，提出单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法达到最优复杂度，并给出两个参数无关的元搜索算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在凸复合问题中对AH方法求解的最优LMO复杂度尚缺乏刻画，且已有达到最优复杂度的方法依赖问题参数（M、D、ν），实际应用中难以获知。

Method: 针对问题(P)（f为(M,ν)-Hölder光滑，g允许广义LMO），在高维情形下分析AH方法类的最优LMO复杂度；采用单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法达到该复杂度；并设计两个元参数搜索算法以实现参数无关。

Result: AH方法类的最优LMO复杂度为O(M^{2/(1+ν)} D^2 ε^{-2/(1+ν)})，由单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法达到；两个参数无关算法仅增加对数因子。

Conclusion: 明确了AH方法求解此类凸复合问题的最优LMO复杂度，并提供了参数无关的实用算法，仅付出额外对数因子代价。

Abstract: We consider the convex problem $(P): {\min}_{y\in \mathbb{R}^n}\, f(Ay)+g(y)$, where $A:\mathbb{R}^n\to \mathbb{R}^m$ is a linear operator, $f$ is convex and $(M,ν)$-Hölder smooth on $\mathbb{R}^m$, and $g$ is proper, closed convex on $\mathbb{R}^n$, and admits a (generalized) linear minimization oracle (LMO). An active-hull (AH) method %refers to the one that %is the one that that calls the LMO in each iteration and outputs a point that lies in the convex hull of all the past LMO returns. We show that in the high-dimensional regime, the optimal LMO complexity for the class of AH methods to solve $(P)$ is $O\big(M^{{2}/({1+ν})}D^2\varepsilon^{-{2}/({1+ν})}\big)$, where $D$ denotes the diameter of the feasible region and $\varepsilon$ the objective sub-optimality gap. In particular, the optimal LMO complexity is achieved by a single-loop first-order primal-dual splitting method. Since this method requires knowledge of the problem parameters (e.g., $M$, $D$ and $ν$), we propose two meta parameter-search algorithms that aim to resolve this issue. These algorithms are parameter-free, but come with the price of an additional log-factor in their LMO complexities.

</details>


### [276] [Amortized Feedback Planning: Turning Model-Based Rollouts into Executable Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35012)
*Jeonggyu Huh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出Bellman-gradient (BG)精化方法，通过微分条件rollout修正动作并存入可执行策略，在无需学习价值critic的情况下实现高效闭环规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环规划考虑未来依赖观测的动作，但部署时重复计算代价高昂，需要一种将闭环反馈离线精化并存入可执行策略的高效方法，避免依赖学习价值函数或反复在线优化。

Method: BG精化对经过现有actor的条件rollout进行微分，修正当前动作并将结果存入可执行策略；采用反向扫描复用已部署的未来反馈；在高斯信念模型中做全时域rollout，无需学习价值critic。通过非线性误差递推关联二次续段误差、局部修正与策略存储。

Result: 受控non-LQG例子显示二阶策略精度且存储一致，理想仿射LQG可精确反向恢复。非二次推力任务中BG使actor代价降低2.47-3.20%，距被测反馈MPC仅0.13-0.53%；原始策略执行5-6微秒。匹配存储下，构建时间约为feedback-teacher-plus-student的1/9（arm）和1/60（docking，单GPU）。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了学习反馈、局部修正与策略存储在可执行控制中的作用，BG能在低成本下接近反馈MPC性能并大幅缩短构建时间。

Abstract: Closed-loop planning accounts for future observation-dependent actions but can be expensive to repeat at deployment. Bellman-gradient (BG) refinement differentiates conditional rollouts through an existing actor, corrects the current action, and stores the result in an executable policy. A backward sweep reuses deployed future feedback; full-horizon rollouts in an identified Gaussian belief model need no learned value critic. A nonlinear error recursion links quadratic continuation error, local correction, and policy storage. A controlled non-LQG example exhibits second-order policy accuracy with consistent storage, while ideal affine LQG admits exact backward recovery. In nonquadratic thrust, BG reduces actor cost by 2.47-3.20% and remains within 0.13-0.53% of the tested feedback MPC; original policies execute in 5-6 microseconds in a seed-0 native audit. With matched storage, BG attains competitive plant costs at about one ninth (arm) and one sixtieth (docking) of feedback-teacher-plus-student construction time on one GPU, excluding shared learning and node preparation. Richer common maps substantially narrow some student-BG gaps. These results expose the roles of learned feedback, local correction, and storage in executable control.

</details>


### [277] [Regular simplex tensors: optimization landscape, conjecture proof, and beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34197)
*Lei Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文通过建立鲁棒特征对与局部最优特征对的联系，将正则单纯形张量鲁棒特征向量的猜想证明转化为对框架向量的检验，从而对任意高阶和高维情形证明了该猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正则单纯形张量的鲁棒特征对猜想此前仅在 n=3 的三角形情形获得理论证明，n 更高时穷举所有特征对并导出鲁棒性判据的显式公式十分复杂，缺少可行的通用证明途径。

Method: 建立鲁棒特征对与优化中的局部最优特征对之间的等价/联系，据此转向检验所有特征对的局部最优性；构造一个结构良好的高效模型，便于枚举全部特征对并刻画模型的优化景观；由此将鲁棒特征对的范围收窄到局部极大者。

Result: 将鲁棒特征向量收窄为局部极大特征对后，其恰好是正则单纯形框架中的向量，证明最终只需检验框架向量，且其鲁棒性对任意 n、m 均易验证。结论：除例外情形 (m,n)=(3,3)/(3,4)/(4,3) 无鲁棒特征对之外，正则单纯形张量的鲁棒特征向量（在符号等价意义下）仅为框架中的向量。

Conclusion: 本文证明了此前关于正则单纯形张量鲁棒特征向量的猜想，给出适用于任意高阶与高维的完整结论，并指出仅有的三个例外情形。

Abstract: The concept of tensor eigenpairs has attracted increasing research attention in the past decades. Recent works have focused on a special class termed regular simplex tensors, which are constructed from an equiangular tight frame of n vectors in (n-1) dimensional space for n >= 3 and order m >= 3. Existing works focus on analyzing the robustness of eigenpairs obtained by the tensor power method. At the end of that work, a conjecture was made that if they exist, the only robust eigenvectors of a regular simplex tensor, up to sign equivalence, are the vectors in the regular simplex frame. A subsequent study theoretically proved that this holds for the simplest triangle case where n = 3. However, for cases with higher n, the process becomes complicated in both checking all eigenpairs and determining the explicit formula for the robustness criterion. In this paper, to deal with this issue, a connection between robust and locally optimal eigenpairs is built, recognizing the latter as another pivotal concept in the field of optimization. Then, we turn to checking the local optimality of all eigenpairs, for which we have developed an efficient model with a favorable structure that facilitates the enumeration of all eigenpairs and delineates the optimization landscape for the model. Then, integrating the two advances enables us to narrow the scope of the robust eigenpairs to those locally maximized ones, which are exactly the vectors in the regular simplex frame. Finally, the proof of the conjecture reduces to only examining the vectors in the frame, whose robustness can be easily checked for any higher n and m. This work shows that, up to sign equivalence, excluding the exceptional cases (m, n) = (3, 3)/(3, 4)/(4, 3) where no robust eigenpairs exist, the only robust eigenvectors of a regular simplex tensor are the vectors in the regular simplex frame.

</details>


### [278] [A One-Factorization Predictor-Corrector Long-Step Arc-Search Method and a Curvature-Amplified Variant for Semidefinite Programming with a Homogeneous Self-Dual Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34275)
*Makoto Yamashita,Yaguang Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出单次分解弧搜索法(OFAS)及其曲率放大变体(CA-OFAS)求解半定规划,每迭代仅需一次KKT分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预测-校正弧搜索法在弧上选点后计算校正量时,KKT矩阵随所选点变化,需在每次迭代中做第二次分解,计算开销大。

Method: 对弧上所选点处的互补性失配作三项分解,使校正量可基于当前迭代点的分解求解线性系统来组装;提出曲率放大的CA-OFAS变体放大二阶弧项,并用齐次自对偶嵌入建模。

Result: 在较宽的long-step邻域内,两方法均能在O(n log(1/ε))次迭代内将齐次互补性与残差降到ε以下;数值实验中CA-OFAS相比Mehrotra型方法在SDPLIB上几何平均计算时间减少17%,神经网络验证SDP问题减少13%。

Conclusion: 单次分解结构与弧步后校正有效降低了计算时间,同时保持理论迭代复杂度。

Abstract: In a predictor-corrector arc-search method, a point on the predictor arc is first selected and a corrector is then computed at that point. Since the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) matrix changes with the selected point, this correction may require a second factorization in each iteration. We propose a one-factorization arc-search method (OFAS) for semidefinite programming (SDP) that avoids this second factorization, retains the corrector after the arc step, and uses only one KKT factorization per iteration. The key is a three-term decomposition of the complementarity mismatch at the selected point on the arc, which allows the correction to be assembled from linear-system solutions using the factorization at the current iterate. We also propose a curvature-amplified variant (CA-OFAS) that amplifies the second-order arc term. The proposed methods are formulated with a homogeneous self-dual embedding. For a wide long-step neighborhood, we prove that both methods reduce the homogeneous complementarity and residuals below $\varepsilon$ in $O(n \log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations for an $n$-by-$n$ SDP matrix variable. Numerical experiments show that the one-factorization structure and the correction after the arc step are associated with reductions in computation time. Compared with the Mehrotra-type method, CA-OFAS reduces the geometric-mean computation time by 17% on SDPLIB and 13% on neural network verification SDP problems.

</details>


### [279] [Linesearch-Free Nonlinearly Preconditioned GD with Semiautomatic Geometry Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34288)
*Daiki Iwade,Shota Takahashi,Akiko Takeda*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出自适应对偶预条件梯度下降(adaptive DPGD)，结合曲率预条件设计与无线性搜索的自适应步长，凸目标下线性收敛，并扩展到弱凸目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性预条件可让梯度更新适应目标曲率增长，但将其设计与合适的步长选择结合起来颇具挑战。

Method: 提出adaptive DPGD，将基于曲率的预条件器设计与基于局部信息的无线性搜索步长规则结合；通过调整步长规则扩展到弱凸目标；给出由目标曲率引导的半自动配方，导出一族预条件器（含归一化与双曲梯度下降）。

Result: 对凸目标，在局部强凸条件下建立线性收敛；对弱凸目标，无需全局Lipschitz光滑性即可获得渐近稳定性；在真实数据的凸与弱凸问题上实验验证了预条件设计与自适应步长的有效性。

Conclusion: adaptive DPGD在理论与实验上均展现有效性，局部假设赋予预条件器设计更大自由度，统一了多种梯度下降方法。

Abstract: Nonlinear preconditioning makes it possible to adapt gradient updates to the growth of the objective's curvature, but combining its design with suitable stepsize selection is challenging. We propose adaptive dual preconditioned gradient descent (adaptive DPGD), which combines curvature-based preconditioner design with a linesearch-free stepsize rule based on local information. For convex objectives, we establish linear convergence under local strong convexity of the objective. By adapting the stepsize rule, we extend the method to weakly convex objectives and establish asymptotic stationarity without global Lipschitz smoothness. Moreover, our local assumptions give greater freedom in preconditioner design. We exploit this freedom to develop a semiautomatic recipe guided by the objective's curvature, yielding a family of preconditioners that includes those underlying normalized and hyperbolic gradient descent. Experiments on convex and weakly convex problems with real data demonstrate the effectiveness of the preconditioner design and adaptive stepsize selection.

</details>


### [280] [Beyond Polytopes: Damped Newton Frank--Wolfe Methods over Compact Convex Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34290)
*Shota Takahashi,Akiko Takeda*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出阻尼牛顿-弗兰克沃尔夫方法，用FW/away-step FW内迭代近似求解约束阻尼牛顿子问题，在Hölder光滑下实现全局线性与局部高阶收敛，实验表现稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有二阶Frank-Wolfe方法在一般凸集上仅有局部线性收敛，只有在多面体上才能同时获得全局线性与局部二次收敛，因此需要新方法在一般紧凸集上兼具全局与快速局部收敛。

Method: 针对正定Hessian的二阶可微目标，通过线性最小化预言机访问可行集，提出阻尼牛顿Frank-Wolfe方法：使用Frank-Wolfe或away-step Frank-Wolfe内迭代近似求解约束阻尼牛顿子问题，并采用以根牛顿步长为安全参考的残差回溯与最终取全步的切换规则。

Result: 在p阶导数Hölder光滑假设下，证明全局线性收敛；局部收敛阶至少为1+ν（p=2），p=3时达到局部二次收敛。矩阵感知与岭正则逻辑回归实验中，残差回溯变体始终稳健且常优于一阶与二阶基线。

Conclusion: 该工作将二阶Frank-Wolfe方法的快速收敛扩展到一般紧凸集，残差回溯策略保证稳健性并具实践优势。

Abstract: We study convex optimization over compact convex sets for twice differentiable objective functions with positive definite Hessians, assuming access to the feasible set through a linear minimization oracle. Existing second-order Frank--Wolfe methods either provide only a local linear rate over general convex sets or achieve global linear and local quadratic convergence only over polytopes. We propose damped Newton Frank--Wolfe methods that approximately solve constrained damped Newton subproblems using Frank--Wolfe or away-step Frank--Wolfe inner iterations. We develop residual backtracking, using a root Newton stepsize as a safe reference, together with a switching rule that eventually takes full steps. Under Hölder smoothness assumptions for $p$th derivatives, we establish global linear convergence and local convergence with Q-order at least $1+ν$ ($p=2$) and local quadratic convergence ($p=3$). Experiments on matrix sensing and ridge-regularized logistic regression show that the residual-backtracking variant is consistently robust and often achieves the best performance among the tested first- and second-order baselines.

</details>


### [281] [Asymptotic Lower Bounds for Continuous Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34303)
*Oliver Hinder,Yuntian Jiang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将非渐近下界构造转化为希尔伯特空间上渐近下界的通用技术，证明若干渐近上界是紧的，并为随机凸优化给出匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非渐近收敛率及其最坏情况下界已被广泛研究，但渐近区域中收敛率常可改进，而对应的渐近下界大多未知，导致无法判断渐近上界是否紧。

Method: 提出一种通用技术，将已有的非渐近下界构造转化为希尔伯特空间上的渐近下界；并针对随机凸优化设计一种在有限维下达到 o(n^{-1/2}) 次优性保证的方法，同时构造一维匹配下界。

Result: 证明了希尔伯特空间中若干已知渐近上界的紧性：包括加速梯度下降在光滑凸函数上的 o(n^{-2})、梯度下降在光滑非凸函数上的 o(n^{-1/2})；随机凸优化中给出有限维 o(n^{-1/2}) 算法与一维匹配下界。

Conclusion: 该技术为渐近下界提供了通用工具，表明多个已有渐近收敛保证是紧的，并补全了随机凸优化中有限维上界与一维下界之间的匹配关系。

Abstract: Nonasymptotic convergence rates for optimization problems have been extensively studied across a wide range of settings, with carefully constructed worst-case instances establishing matching lower bounds for many algorithm classes. Recent work has shown, however, that these rates can often be improved in the asymptotic regime, while the corresponding asymptotic lower bounds remain largely unknown. We propose a general technique for converting existing nonasymptotic lower bound constructions into asymptotic lower bounds on Hilbert spaces. This allows us to show that several known asymptotic convergence upper bounds in Hilbert spaces are tight. In particular, we recover tightness of the $o(n^{-2})$ suboptimality guarantee for accelerated gradient descent on smooth convex functions \cite{attouch2016rate}, as well as the $o(n^{-1/2})$ suboptimality guarantee for gradient descent on smooth nonconvex functions \cite{gratton2025refining}. For stochastic convex optimization, we also develop a method that achieves an $o(n^{-1/2})$ suboptimality guarantee in finite dimensions, and prove a matching one-dimensional lower bound.

</details>


### [282] [Accelerated Bregman Proximal Gradient Methods from Dual Geometric Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34773)
*Yuya Yamashita,Shota Takahashi,Akiko Takeda*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一族几何加速的Bregman近端梯度（BPG）算法，在近端梯度与镜像空间中双重利用Bregman几何，无需三角缩放等额外几何条件，通过局部回溯自适应步长，实现凸目标O(k^{-2})、相对强凸线性、非凸O(k^{-1})收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有凸目标的加速BPG算法通常需要Bregman散度的额外假设（尤其是三角缩放条件），这些条件会导致收敛速率变慢，并限制了算法的适用范围。

Method: 提出一族几何加速BPG算法，在近端梯度更新和镜像空间更新中同时利用Bregman几何；通过局部回溯和可计算的接受准则自适应调整步长与镜像空间更新，无需全局相对光滑常数作为输入，且不施加三角缩放等额外几何条件。

Result: 收敛界以迭代中接受的参数表示：当几何加速参数一致有界时，凸目标达到O(k^{-2})速率，相对强凸目标达到线性速率；非凸目标在无需下界Bregman界或全域Bregman散度的条件下，对稳定性度量达到O(k^{-1})速率。在逆问题、熵正则最小二乘、D-最优设计和非负矩阵分解上的实验表明比已有Bregman基线收敛更快。

Conclusion: 该算法在更弱假设下实现了加速收敛，兼顾凸、相对强凸与非凸目标，并在多个实际问题上展现出优于现有Bregman基线的实用性能。

Abstract: We study Bregman proximal gradient (BPG) algorithms under relative smoothness for convex, relatively strongly convex, and nonconvex objectives. Existing accelerated BPG algorithms for convex objectives typically require additional assumptions on Bregman divergences, most notably triangle-scaling conditions, which can lead to slower convergence rates. We propose a family of geometry-accelerated BPG algorithms that exploit Bregman geometry in both proximal-gradient and mirror-space updates, without imposing additional geometric conditions such as triangle-scaling conditions. Our methods adapt the stepsizes and mirror-space updates through local backtracking and computable acceptance criteria, without a global relative-smoothness constant as input. We derive convergence bounds in terms of the parameters accepted during the iterations. These bounds yield an $Ø(k^{-2})$ rate for convex objectives and a linear rate for relatively strongly convex objectives when the geometry-acceleration parameters remain uniformly bounded. For nonconvex objectives, we establish an $Ø(k^{-1})$ rate for a stationarity measure without requiring a lower Bregman bound or a full-domain Bregman divergence. Numerical experiments on inverse problems, entropy-regularized least squares, D-optimal design, and nonnegative matrix factorization demonstrate faster practical convergence than established Bregman baselines.

</details>


### [283] [Finite-Time Concentration and Convergence Rates for Projected Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation with Markov Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34791)
*Rahul Singh,Vivek S. Borkar,Eric Moulines*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究投影双时间尺度随机逼近的有限时间集中与收敛速率，处理边界处不连续向量场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影慢迭代在边界处导致投影ODE向量场不连续，标准Lipschitz分析失效，需建立新的收敛与速率理论。

Method: 用Skorokhod映射刻画投影动态，分离鞅波动、Markov噪声残差与时间尺度偏差；构造满足一致下降条件的Lipschitz Lyapunov函数，分析多项式与对数间隔步长下的速率。

Result: 获得高概率跟踪界与几乎必然收敛；多项式步长联合速率近1/3；对数间隔步长在Euclidean收缩下达O(n^{-1/2}log n)，含边界均衡；Actor-critic值差距O(n^{-1}log n)；并扩展到投影TD(0)、投影SGD及快速递归投影。

Conclusion: 该工作为不连续投影双时间尺度随机逼近提供了统一有限时间与渐近速率分析，并适用于多种强化学习与优化场景。

Abstract: We study finite-time concentration and convergence rates for projected two-time-scale stochastic approximation driven by a controlled Markov chain. The averaged fast map is contractive, while the slow iterate is projected onto a compact convex polyhedron. The associated projected ordinary differential equation may have a discontinuous vector field at the boundary, preventing a direct application of standard analyses based on Lipschitz vector fields.
  Using the Skorokhod map, we establish explicit high-probability bounds for tracking the moving fast equilibrium and the projected slow dynamics. These bounds separate martingale fluctuations, Markov-noise residuals, and the bias due to time-scale separation. A Lipschitz Lyapunov function satisfying a uniform decrease condition over fixed time intervals yields almost-sure convergence, with explicit last-iterate rates when the decrease admits a power lower bound. Under uniform Lyapunov contraction, polynomial step sizes yield joint fast-tracking and slow Lyapunov-error exponents arbitrarily close to $1/3$. Under the additional assumption that the reduced slow update map is a Euclidean contraction, logarithmically separated step sizes improve the joint rate to $O(n^{-1/2}\log n)$ almost surely, including for boundary equilibria. The same rate holds under a distinct geometric condition involving a strictly attracting face of a box and a fast equilibrium that is constant on that face.
  An actor-critic application achieves an almost-sure value-gap rate of $O(n^{-1}\log n)$ relative to the optimum within the constrained policy class. Further applications include projected TD(0) and projected stochastic gradient descent. We also extend the analysis to projection of the fast recursion under Euclidean contractivity.

</details>


### [284] [An Online Non-Stationary Simulation Optimization Approach Based on Regime Switching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.12634)
*Jianglin Xia,Haowei Wang,Songhao Wang,Szu Hui Ng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 论文研究具有马尔可夫切换( regime-switching )动态、非平稳输入分布的仿真优化问题，同时处理预测不确定性与输入不确定性，提出基于MSM的贝叶斯框架、渐近理论保证及在线元模型算法，并扩展到未知状态数场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态演变的经济与运营环境给决策带来挑战。现有仿真优化多假设输入分布平稳，难以应对序贯决策中状态切换带来的预测不确定性与有限数据导致的输入不确定性。

Method: 用马尔可夫切换模型(MSM)近似真实目标函数，构建贝叶斯框架；证明目标函数与最优解的一致性及渐近正态性；提出利用历史阶段仿真结果的元模型在线算法；用贝叶斯非参数方法处理未知状态数。

Result: 数值实验表明所提算法性能更优，且具有稳健的适应能力。

Conclusion: 该贝叶斯MSM框架能有效应对带状态切换的在线仿真优化问题，兼具理论保证与实用适应性，并可推广到未知状态数情形。

Abstract: Dynamic and evolving operational and economic environments present significant challenges for decision-making. We explore a simulation optimization problem characterized by non-stationary input distributions with regime-switching dynamics across sequential decision stages. This problem encompasses both prediction uncertainty, arising from the regime-switching behavior of input distributions, and input uncertainty, resulting from parameter estimation for these distributions and their dynamics using finite data streams. To address these uncertainties, we develop a Bayesian framework that approximates the true objective function using a Markov Switching Model (MSM). We rigorously validate this approximation by establishing the consistency and asymptotic normality of the objective functions and optimal solutions. To solve the problem in an online fashion, we propose a metamodel-based algorithm that leverages simulation results from previous stages to enhance decision-making. Furthermore, we tackle scenarios with an unknown number of regimes through a Bayesian nonparametric method. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm achieves superior performance and robust adaptability.

</details>


### [285] [Contraction-Based Model Predictive Control using Bilinear Koopman Realizations with Proportional Error Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34844)
*Yuki Higuchi,Kazuhiro Sato*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一种基于双线性Koopman实现的鲁棒MPC框架，通过重投影处理提升状态偏离流形问题，并利用比例近似误差界构建收缩度量管，实现非线性约束下的鲁棒稳定控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman算子理论为未知非线性系统的约束控制提供了数据驱动方法，但有限维Koopman实现中多步预测可能偏离有效提升状态流形，使得单步误差保证失效，现有方法通常假设字典不变性，限制实用性。

Method: 采用带状态和输入相关的比例近似误差界（在目标平衡点消失）的双线性Koopman实现；将每步预测的提升状态重投影回原始坐标再重新提升，构造误差感知的离散时间控制仿射预测器；基于离散时间鲁棒控制收缩度量构建同态管，管半径显式计入比例误差界；管道收紧处理任意连续可微非线性约束；MPC含终端成分与利用不确定性消失特性的管半径惩罚项。

Result: 证明了原非线性约束的鲁棒满足性、递归可行性，以及采样真实闭环系统以高概率（关于训练数据）指数稳定，且无需MPC问题全局最优解。数值算例（含非线性避障约束）显示，相比现有Koopman MPC方法，闭环代价更小、灵活性更高，实现鲁棒镇定与更优性能。

Conclusion: 该框架无需假设Koopman字典不变性，通过重投影与收缩度量管设计，在数据驱动下实现了带任意非线性约束的鲁棒MPC，兼顾理论保证与实际性能提升。

Abstract: Data-driven model predictive control based on Koopman operator theory is a promising approach for constrained control of nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics. This paper proposes a robust model predictive control framework for such systems using bilinear Koopman realizations with state- and input-dependent proportional approximation-error bounds that vanish at the target equilibrium. Since prediction in lifted coordinates with a finite-dimensional Koopman realization need not remain on the manifold of valid lifted states, multi-step prediction may leave the region where one-step error certificates apply. We avoid this difficulty by reprojecting each predicted lifted state onto the original state coordinates and lifting it again, yielding an error-aware discrete-time control-affine predictor in the original state space without assuming invariance of the Koopman dictionary. For this predictor, we develop a homothetic tube construction based on a discrete-time robust control contraction metric whose radius explicitly accounts for the proportional approximation error bounds. The tube tightening handles arbitrary continuously differentiable nonlinear constraints, and the resulting model predictive control problem includes terminal ingredients and a tube-radius penalty that exploits the vanishing uncertainty near the target. We prove robust satisfaction of the original nonlinear constraints, recursive feasibility, and exponential stability of the sampled true closed-loop system with high probability over the training data without requiring a globally optimal solution to the model predictive control problem. Numerical examples, including nonlinear obstacle-avoidance constraints, demonstrate robust stabilization and higher performance of the proposed approach compared to existing Koopman-based model predictive control methods in terms of smaller closed-loop cost and flexibility.

</details>


### [286] [Sharp Observability Costs for Strongly Coupled Parabolic Systems with Vanishing Principal Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35087)
*Xiaomin Zhu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究强耦合抛物系统在耦合参数趋于零时的可观测性损失，确定最优可观测性代价的精确爆破率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耦合参数趋于零时系统可观测性会退化，需要量化这种退化程度，并理解状态各分量及组合的可观测性代价如何随参数变化。

Method: 在Kalman秩条件下，通过分析对(B,K)的代数结构，研究由固定观测矩阵B在正测度时空子集上的观测，推导最优可观测性代价的爆破率。

Result: 确定了精确的爆破率；不同状态分量及其组合可有不同的爆破率，由(B,K)的代数结构决定；全状态可观测性代价由最大爆破率决定。

Conclusion: 零点控制的最小L∞范数的最坏情况具有相同的渐近行为，说明可观测性代价与控制代价的爆破率一致。

Abstract: We study the loss of observability for a class of strongly coupled parabolic systems as the coupling parameter tends to zero. The system is observed through a fixed matrix $B$ on a measurable subset of space-time with positive measure. Under the Kalman rank condition, we determine the exact blow-up rates of the optimal observability cost. Different components of the state, as well as different combinations of them, may have different blow-up rates, and these rates are determined by the algebraic structure of the pair $(B,K)$. The full-state observability cost is determined by the largest of these rates. We also show that the worst-case minimum $L^\infty$-norm of null controls has the same asymptotic behavior.

</details>


### [287] [Stochastic Model-Based Methods for Minimizing Paraconvex Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35095)
*Tan Khiem Huynh,Van Ngai Huynh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究最小化paraconvex函数（弱凸函数的推广）的随机算法，证明了随机次梯度法和随机近端次梯度法的收敛性，并扩展至更广的算法族，核心分析基于广义Moreau包络上的扰动下降方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: paraconvex函数推广了弱凸函数，涵盖Hölder光滑函数及凸函数与Hölder光滑映射的复合，研究其随机优化算法有助于拓展非凸优化的理论适用范围。

Method: 分别针对无约束和复合paraconvex优化，建立随机次梯度法与随机近端次梯度法的收敛性；再将其扩展到通过满足近似质量和连续性假设的随机模型访问目标的算法族；核心原理是将算法解释为原paraconvex问题广义Moreau包络上的扰动下降方法。

Result: 证明了随机次梯度法与随机近端次梯度法在相应设定下的收敛性，并将收敛性分析推广到一类更广泛的随机算法。

Conclusion: 通过广义Moreau包络上的扰动下降视角，可统一分析paraconvex随机优化的收敛性。

Abstract: This paper studies stochastic algorithms for minimizing paraconvex functions, a function class that generalizes weakly convex functions and includes, for instance, Hölder smooth functions and compositions of convex functions with Hölder smooth maps. We first establish the convergence of the stochastic subgradient method and the stochastic proximal subgradient method for unconstrained and composite paraconvex optimization, respectively. The analysis is then extended to a broad family of algorithms that access the objective through stochastic models satisfying certain approximation-quality and continuity assumptions. The main principle that underlies the convergence analysis is that the algorithms under consideration can be interpreted as perturbed descent methods on the generalized Moreau envelope of the original paraconvex problem.

</details>


### [288] [A Sharper Theory of Ball-Proximal Optimization: Convergence and Radius Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35147)
*Peter Richtárik,Hanmin Li*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究凸函数的精确欧氏球近端点法，在无需光滑性或强凸性假设下，给出了更精确的目标值、平稳性与Bregman距离收敛界，并完整刻画了任意半径序列的收敛行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球近端点法在每步以当前点为中心在球内最小化目标，是比经典近端点法更一般的算法。已有收敛结果通常假设光滑性或强凸性，且对目标值、平稳性等量的界不够精细。本文希望在完全不假设光滑性和强凸性的条件下，强化该方法的基础与收敛保证。

Method: 在平方距离下降中保留目标间隙，从而得到目标值、平稳性及对称Bregman距离的更尖锐界。对常数半径t和初始距离D0，给出目标间隙的指数衰减；对任意正半径序列进行分类：(i)半径和发散时有限步到达最小点（若存在），(ii)否则目标值收敛到下确界且迭代逃出有界集，(iii)半径可和时代点收敛到可能非最优的点。引入自收缩性质，分析自适应半径规则（基于次梯度或目标间隙）、epigraph重构和松弛更新，并构造多面体族验证维度无关二次界的渐近最优性。

Result: 常数半径下K次迭代后目标间隙不超过初值乘以exp(-2K²t²/D0²)。自收缩给出有界迭代的有限轨迹长度和常数半径终止界O_d(1+D0/t)，其隐含常数仅依赖维度。多面体族表明维度无关的二次界渐近最优。识别出最小成功几何衰减因子。

Conclusion: 这些结果在无光滑性和强凸性假设下加强了球近端点法的基础与收敛保证，完整刻画了不同半径序列的收敛模式，并给出最优终止界和自适应半径规则分析。

Abstract: We study the exact Euclidean ball-proximal point method for proper, closed, convex functions, where each iteration minimizes the objective over a ball centered at the current point. Retaining the objective gap in the decrease of squared distance yields sharper bounds on objective values, stationarity, and the symmetric Bregman distance to a minimizer. For constant radius $t>0$ and initial distance $D_0>0$ to the solution set, the objective gap after $K$ iterations is at most its initial value multiplied by $\exp(-2K^2t^2/D_0^2)$.
  We characterize convergence for arbitrary positive radius sequences. If their sum diverges, the method reaches a minimizer in finitely many iterations whenever one exists; otherwise, the objective values converge to the infimum and the iterates escape every bounded set. If the radii are summable, the iterates converge to a possibly nonoptimal point. Self-contraction gives finite trajectory length for bounded iterates and a constant-radius termination bound $O_d(1+D_0/t)$, whose implicit constant depends only on the dimension. A polyhedral family shows that the dimension-independent quadratic bound remains asymptotically sharp.
  We also identify a minimum successful geometric decay factor and analyze adaptive radius rules based on subgradients or objective gaps, epigraph reformulation, and relaxed updates. Together, these results strengthen the foundations and convergence guarantees of the method without assuming smoothness or strong convexity.

</details>


### [289] [Coordinated Lane-Level Variable Speed Limits and Ramp Metering for Successive Weaving Segments Considering Merging/Diverging Risks: A Hybrid Model Predictive Control and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35152)
*Guodong Ma,Baofeng Sun,Wenyu Yang,Zhihong Yao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出混合框架MPC-STMAPPO协调车道级可变限速与匝道控制，兼顾模型驱动韧性与数据驱动自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市快速路连续交织区是常发性拥堵与碰撞的瓶颈，需精细化主动交通管理；现有方法难以兼顾数据驱动优化的自适应性与模型驱动控制的韧性和可迁移性。

Method: 1) 重构L-METANET车道级宏观交通流模型，刻画自由与强制换道；2) 结合XGBoost-SHAP与RPBL推导合流/分流碰撞风险解析式，构建系统成本与奖励函数；3) 提出MPC-STMAPPO分层控制器：上层MPC基于L-METANET长时域滚动优化生成基线指令，下层ST-MAPPO（融合Mamba单元与图注意力）输出短时域残差修正动作。

Result: 在长春东18公里快速路实测中，L-METANET准确再现换道引起的流量重分布与通行能力下降，状态演化与真实一致；XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL多数任务AUC超0.80，优于传统logit模型；MPC-STMAPPO收敛更快、多指标优于MPC与MARL基线；随机波动需求下泛化能力显著优于纯MARL。

Conclusion: 该混合框架有效协调交织区VSL与匝道控制，展现较强工业部署潜力。

Abstract: Successive weaving segments (SWSs) on urban expressways are bottlenecks prone to recurrent congestion and collisions, requiring fine-grained active traffic management (ATM). Existing approaches struggle to balance the adaptive performance of data-driven optimization with the resilience and transferability of model-based control. We propose a hybrid framework to coordinate lane-level variable speed limits (VSLs) and ramp metering across SWSs. First, we reconstruct L-METANET, a lane-level macroscopic traffic flow model that captures free and forced lane changes. Second, we combine XGBoost-SHAP with a random-parameters binary logit (RPBL) model to derive analytical equations for merging and diverging collision risks and formulate system cost and reward functions. Third, we develop MPC-STMAPPO, a hierarchical controller integrating model predictive control (MPC) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Its upper MPC layer uses L-METANET for long-horizon rolling optimization and generates baseline commands; its lower spatiotemporal MAPPO (ST-MAPPO) layer, enhanced with Mamba cells and graph attention, produces residual actions for short-horizon adjustment. Real-world experiments on the 18-km Eastern Expressway in Changchun, China, show that L-METANET accurately reproduces lane-changing-induced flow redistribution and capacity drops, with state evolution aligned with ground truth. XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL achieves AUCs above 0.80 in most tasks, outperforming conventional logit models. MPC-STMAPPO converges faster and performs better across multiple metrics than MPC- and MARL-based baselines. Under randomly fluctuating demand, it also significantly outperforms pure MARL in generalization, demonstrating strong potential for industrial deployment.

</details>


### [290] [Optimal Control of a Non-Stationary Inventory-Queue, with Applications to EV-Battery Swapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35153)
*Hanyu Cheng,David Yao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究带有多台并行服务器和有限缓冲的非平稳排队系统，用连续时间MDP求解EV换电站电池充电管理的最优控制策略，得到显式阈值结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EV换电站中，如何最优管理从电动车换下的电池充电是核心运营问题。该场景具有到达率和服务成本率随离散时间点跳变的非平稳特征，传统方法难以处理。

Method: 建立有限规划期内的连续时间马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）模型，允许到达率与服务成本率均为时间函数且在离散时间点跳变，推导最优控制策略的精确显式阈值结构。

Result: 得到刻画最优策略的精确显式阈值结构；给出阈值随时间和关键系统参数（服务能力、缓冲容量等）单调的条件；并通过大量数值实验验证理论并展示阈值结构在实践中的稳健性。

Conclusion: 该MDP方法能有效处理非平稳换电站的电池充电调度，阈值结构具有可解释性和稳健性，便于实际实现。

Abstract: We study a non-stationary queueing system with multiple parallel servers and a finite buffer capacity, over a finite planning horizon. Motivated by an operation that is central to an EV (electric vehicle) battery-swapping station -- how to best manage the charging of batteries swapped off from EVs, we develop a continuous-time MDP (Markov decision process) approach to the problem. The main technical challenge is to allow both the arrival rate and the service-cost rate to be functions of time with jumps at discrete time points, key features of the EV swapping station's operation. We derive an exact and explicit threshold structure that characterizes the optimal control policy. Moreover, we give conditions under which the thresholds are monotone over time, and with respect to key system parameters such as service and buffer capacities. Extensive numerical experiments are carried out to supplement as well as validate the theoretical results, and also to illustrate the robustness of the threshold structure in practical implementations.

</details>


### [291] [Tight Lower Bounds for Stochastic Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35206)
*Siqi Zhang,Qilong Wu,Junchi Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究光滑非凸-强凹极小极大优化中随机一阶oracle复杂度的下界，改进了条件数依赖并提出首个平均光滑下界，且与上界匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究极小极大优化中寻找ε-稳定点的随机一阶oracle复杂度下界，改进已有界对条件数κ的依赖不足（此前仅为κ^{1/3}），并填补平均光滑设定下下界的空白。

Method: 基于统一的二次提升（quadratic lifting）构造，将随机非凸最小化的困难实例转化为无约束极小极大优化问题，同时保持所需的方差与光滑性质。

Result: 在有限方差假设下得到Ω(κLΔσ²ε⁻⁴)的下界；在额外平均光滑假设下得到首个Ω(κ^{3/2}L̄Δσε⁻³)下界。两者在κ和ε的依赖上均与现有上界匹配。

Conclusion: 所提下界将有限方差情形的条件数依赖从κ^{1/3}提升至κ，并首次给出平均光滑下界，证明了相应算法的紧致性。

Abstract: We study the stochastic first-order oracle complexity of finding $ε$-stationary points of the primal function in smooth nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. For sufficiently small $ε$, we establish lower bounds of $Ω(κLΔσ^2ε^{-4})$ under the bounded-variance assumption and $Ω(κ^{3/2}\bar LΔσε^{-3})$ under the additional assumption of averaged smoothness. Here, $L$ and $\bar L$ denote the smoothness and averaged-smoothness constants, respectively, $Δ$ is the initial primal gap, $σ^2$ bounds the oracle variance, and $κ=L/μ$ or $\bar L/μ$ in the respective settings, where $μ$ is the strong-concavity parameter. Our bounded-variance lower bound improves the dependence on the condition number from $κ^{1/3}$ in previous lower bounds to $κ$, while our averaged-smoothness lower bound is the first of its kind. In both settings, the resulting lower bounds match existing upper bounds in their dependence on $κ$ and $ε$. Our proofs are based on a unified quadratic lifting construction that transfers a hardness instance for stochastic nonconvex minimization to unconstrained minimax optimization while preserving the required variance and smoothness properties.

</details>


### [292] [Robust identification of drive-by sensing ride-hailing market with Points of Interest monitoring under uncertain ride demand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35220)
*Binzhou Yang,Bin Shuai,Minhao Xu,Boyang Du*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出基于分布鲁棒优化(DRO)的主动移动感知框架，用于出租车环境监测，兼顾覆盖与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统"被动优先、主动次之"范式受乘车需求随机且空间不均影响，导致覆盖有限且不均，延误关键POI监测并增加系统成本。

Method: 1)增强A*路径策略，整合车辆-任务匹配，兼顾全局路由效率与局部感知机会；2)DRO模型，用概率分布模糊集刻画乘车需求不确定性，实现空驶出租车路由与车辆-任务匹配的鲁棒决策。

Result: 在静态与动态场景下用真实数据评估，感知覆盖、运营成本与鲁棒性均优于基准策略。

Conclusion: 将分布鲁棒性引入出租车感知运营具有显著价值。

Abstract: Taxi-based mobile sensing has emerged as a cost-efficient paradigm for large-scale urban environmental monitoring. In practice, both passive and active sensing strategies are adopted by ride-hailing platforms. Passive sensing, conducted during passenger-serving trips, is constrained by stochastic and spatially imbalanced ride demand, leading to limited and uneven coverage. Active sensing, executed by vacant taxis, provides greater control over sensing operations but incurs additional operational costs, and is thus typically treated as a supplementary strategy. To address the inefficiencies of the conventional "passive-first, active-second" paradigm, which may delay the monitoring of critical Points of Interest (POIs) and increase system-wide costs, we propose a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO)-based framework for active mobile sensing. First, we develop an enhanced A*-based drive-by sensing routing policy that integrates vehicle-task matching while capturing both global routing efficiency and local sensing opportunities. Second, we formulate the active sensing problem as a DRO model that explicitly accounts for uncertainty in ride demand through an ambiguity set of probability distributions, enabling robust decision-making for vacant taxi routing and vehicle-task matching. The proposed framework is evaluated on both static and dynamic mobile sensing settings using real-world data. Computational results demonstrate that our approach achieves better performance in terms of sensing coverage, operational cost, and robustness compared to benchmark strategies, highlighting the value of integrating distributional robustness into taxi-based sensing operations.

</details>


### [293] [Projection-Free Algorithms for Nonsmooth Stochastic Convex-Concave Saddle-Point Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35275)
*Khanh-Hung Giang-Tran,Soroosh Shafiee*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出针对非光滑凸-凹随机鞍点问题的单循环无投影算法，直接使用次梯度并达到 O(ε^{-2}) 复杂度，且证明其极小极大最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有无投影方法多依赖光滑化，难以直接处理非光滑问题，作者希望在不牺牲统计效率的前提下利用线性最小化预言机的计算优势。

Method: 基于随机次梯度的单循环无投影算法，使用原始与对偶域上的线性最小化预言机（LMO），并设计可模块化替换为投影预言机的更新结构，涵盖全无投影与混合预言机配置。

Result: 在标准无偏随机预言机且有界方差假设下证明任意时间强鞍点间隙保证，达到 O(ε^{-2}) 迭代复杂度，与投影随机次梯度法相当，并给出匹配下界证明极小极大最优性。

Conclusion: 对非光滑随机极小极大问题，线性最小化预言机的计算优势不必以统计或预言机效率为代价。

Abstract: We study nonsmooth convex-concave saddle-point problems over compact convex sets, assuming access to stochastic subgradients of the payoff function. We develop single-loop projection-free algorithms that use linear minimization oracles over the primal and dual domains. Unlike prior projection-free approaches that rely on smoothing, our methods are purely subgradient-based and handle nonsmoothness directly. This design makes the framework modular: when a linear minimization oracle is not used over a specific domain, the corresponding update can be replaced by a standard projection oracle without changing the single-loop structure. Thus, our framework covers both fully projection-free and hybrid oracle configurations. We prove anytime strong saddle gap guarantees under standard unbiased stochastic oracle assumptions with bounded variance. Our algorithms achieve an $O(ε^{-2})$ iteration complexity, matching projected stochastic subgradient methods. We also provide matching lower bounds for the corresponding oracle models, establishing minimax optimality. Our results show that, for nonsmooth stochastic minimax problems, the computational advantages of linear minimization oracles need not come at the expense of statistical or oracle efficiency.

</details>


### [294] [Convex Optimization Is Free When Accuracy Is Expensive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35418)
*Arthur Paing,Arthur Jacot*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究梯度只能近似计算（成本δ^{-γ}）时的凸优化：在HTMC regime(γ>2)下，用随机多级oracle将确定精度替换为无偏估计，使单次调用成本降至δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}，凸情形期望计算量达Θ(ε^{-γ})，强凸情形为Θ(ε^{-γ/2})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度无法精确求值，只能是精度δ、成本约δ^{-γ}的近似。当γ>2时进入Harder-Than-Monte-Carlo regime，精度代价超过Monte Carlo方差缩减收益。作者希望探究最优化损失的成本能否不超过在所需精度下单次梯度评估的成本。

Method: 提出随机多级oracle，用无偏估计替代精度δ的确定性近似，其方差σ²成为独立定价的第二调节参数，单次调用成本由δ^{-γ}降为δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}；用该oracle驱动朴素不精确梯度下降，并分析凸与μ-强凸情形下的期望计算量。

Result: 凸情形损失达ε的期望计算量为Θ(ε^{-γ})，而固定精度下同方法需Θ(ε^{-(γ+1)})，随机化省下ε的一整次幂；μ-强凸情形指数减半至ε^{-γ/2}，因迭代稳定在噪声底且偏置预算放宽。两个界均与步长（因而与光滑常数）无关，且成本是底层梯度流的泛函，不依赖于其任何离散化。

Conclusion: 在HTMC regime下，随机多级oracle使最小化损失的成本仅比单次梯度评估多一个只依赖γ的因子；随机化带来一个完整ε幂次的加速，强凸时指数减半；成本本质上是梯度流的泛函，而非离散化的产物。

Abstract: This paper studies convex optimization when the gradient cannot be evaluated exactly, but only approximated by a hierarchy of algorithms whose compute grows like $δ^{-γ}$ in the accuracy $δ$. When $γ>2$, falling into the Harder-Than-Monte-Carlo (HTMC) regime, the price of accuracy outruns the variance reduction that Monte Carlo would buy and we show that minimizing a loss function costs no more, up to a factor depending only on $γ$, than a single evaluation of its gradient at the accuracy the problem demands. A randomized multilevel oracle replaces the deterministic approximation of accuracy $δ$ by an unbiased estimator of it, whose variance $σ^2$ becomes a second, independently priced dial: the cost of one call drops from $δ^{-γ}$ to $δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}$. Plain inexact gradient descent driven by that oracle reaches loss $\varepsilon$ at expected compute $Θ(\varepsilon^{-γ})$ in the convex case, against $Θ(\varepsilon^{-(γ+1)})$ for the same method run at a fixed accuracy: randomization buys a full power of $\varepsilon$. Under $μ$-strong convexity the exponent halves, to $\varepsilon^{-γ/2}$, because the iterates settle at a noise floor and the bias budget relaxes accordingly. Both bounds are independent of the step size, and hence of the smoothness constant, and we show that the cost is a functional of the underlying gradient flow rather than of any discretization of it.

</details>


### [295] [Entrywise nonnegativity of the inverse relative gain array in dimension six](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35558)
*Jie Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 证明了阶数≤6的实对称正定矩阵G满足(G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹逐元素非负，即Uhlmann的逆相对增益阵列猜想在≤6阶成立；7阶存在反例说明维数界是紧的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决Jeffrey Uhlmann提出的"逆相对增益阵列猜想"：关于(G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹的非负性，需要确定成立的矩阵阶数范围并刻画其边界。

Method: 在Λ²R⁴上构造显式的平方和（sum-of-squares）恒等式，结合两次加边（bordering）论证；并建立双二次不等式、二次正定性性质与逆相对增益阵列非负性在连续三个维数上的等价关系。

Result: 对阶数至多6的实对称正定G，证明(G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹逐元素非负；给出7阶有理反例，说明两个维数上界均为最优；并刻画逆交互算子的不动空间与平均性质，证明关于由实对称正定矩阵对角化矩阵的逆向Schur–Horn优超不等式。

Conclusion: Uhlmann猜想在≤6阶成立，7阶失效，维数边界紧；相关结果揭示了双二次不等式、二次正定性与逆相对增益阵列非负性之间的深层联系，并推广到算子性质与优超不等式。

Abstract: We prove that $(G\circ G^{-1})^{-1}$ is entrywise nonnegative for every real symmetric positive definite matrix $G$ of order at most six, resolving the inverse relative gain array conjecture of Jeffrey Uhlmann. The proof combines an explicit sum-of-squares identity on $Λ^2\mathbb R^4$ with two bordering arguments. More generally, we establish an equivalence between a biquadratic inequality, a quadratic positivity property, and inverse relative gain array nonnegativity in three consecutive dimensions. As consequences, we characterize the fixed space and averaging properties of the inverse interaction operator and prove a reverse Schur--Horn majorization inequality for matrices diagonalized by real symmetric positive definite matrices. A rational example of order seven shows that both dimension bounds are sharp.

</details>


### [296] [Quantitative Stability, Coercivity and Uniqueness of Optimal Transport Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35574)
*William Ford*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明二次最优传输计划在边际扰动下的Wasserstein稳定性，假设一个初始测度满足指数严格大于d-1的上Ahlfors正则性，并给出紧性、定量唯一性及尖锐指数示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究二次最优传输在边际测度扰动下的定量稳定性，以及Brenier唯一性定理的定量版本，刻画"几乎唯一性"。

Method: 假设一个初始测度满足指数严格大于d-1的上Ahlfors正则性，在固定紧集上分析Wasserstein距离下的稳定性和最优传输映射。

Result: 证明最优传输计划的定量稳定性、传输映射的定量稳定性、关于最优计划集的紧性定理，以及控制最优计划集Wasserstein直径的定量唯一性定理；示例表明所有估计指数尖锐。

Conclusion: 几乎唯一性可由源测度的几乎正则性量化，且估计指数最优。

Abstract: For probability measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$ supported in fixed compact sets, we prove that quadratic optimal transport plans are quantitatively stable in Wasserstein distance under perturbation of both marginal measures, assuming that one of the initial measures satisfies an upper Ahlfors regularity condition with exponent strictly greater than $d-1$. Under the same assumption, we also prove novel quantitative stability results for optimal transport maps.
  Furthermore, we prove a coercivity theorem which states that any probability measure on the product space must be quantitatively close to the set of optimal plans, if it has similar marginals and a similar transport cost to the optimal value.
  Finally, we prove a quantitative uniqueness theorem which acts as a quantitative counterpart to Brenier's theorem. The Wasserstein diameter of the set of optimal plans is controlled by the distance of one marginal measure to a regular measure for which uniqueness holds. In this way, "almost uniqueness" of optimal plans is quantified by the source measure being "almost regular".
  Examples are provided which prove that the exponents of all estimates are sharp.

</details>


### [297] [Treewidth and the complexity of box-constrained quadratic programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35595)
*Alberto Del Pia,Aida Khajavirad*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究单位超立方体上稀疏二次函数最小化问题，发现树宽在连续域下不再决定可解性：森林（树宽1）可强多项式求解，但树宽2即强NP难，并给出更一般的可解类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二进制二次规划中交互图的有界树宽可保证多项式时间可解，作者想探究当二元域替换为单位超立方体（连续域）后，树宽是否仍起同样核心作用。

Method: 对森林交互图，基于动态规划并结合单变量值函数的结构分析（证明其为凹、分段二次且片数为线性）；通过分析平方项系数非正的变量可取二值这一性质，将问题分解为组合部分与连续部分，并控制两部分及其交互的复杂度。

Result: 森林情形存在强多项式算法；但交互图树宽为2时问题已强NP难；进一步给出交互图可有无界树宽的多项式可解类。

Conclusion: 单位超立方体上稀疏二次最小化的可解性由组合部分、连续部分及其交互的复杂度决定，而非整个交互图的树宽，树宽角色与二进制情形显著不同。

Abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing a sparse quadratic function over the unit hypercube. In binary quadratic programming, treewidth of the interaction graph is a central parameter for tractability: bounded treewidth yields polynomial-time solvability. Motivated by this fact, we investigate whether treewidth plays a similar role when the binary domain is replaced by the unit hypercube. We show that the situation is strikingly different. If the interaction graph is a forest, we give a strongly polynomial-time algorithm based on dynamic programming and a structural analysis of the resulting univariate value functions, which are shown to be concave and piecewise quadratic with linearly many pieces. However, the problem becomes strongly NP-hard already when the interaction graph has treewidth two. We then identify substantially more general polynomial-time solvable classes whose interaction graphs may have unbounded treewidth. Our approach exploits the fact that there exists an optimal solution in which every variable with a nonpositive coefficient for its square term is binary-valued, thereby separating the problem into a combinatorial part and a genuinely continuous part. We show that tractability can be recovered by controlling the complexity of these two parts and their interaction, rather than the treewidth of the entire interaction graph.

</details>


### [298] [Accelerated Algorithms for Stochastic Monotone Inclusions with Fixed Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35631)
*Sucheol Lee,Donghwan Kim*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究单调Lipschitz包含问题的随机一阶方法加速，提出VRAF达到最优O(1/ε)复杂度，并证明O(LD/√ε+σ²/ε)不可实现，进而提出RRSEG方法逼近最优复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在单调Lipschitz包含问题中要么oracle复杂度次优，要么每次迭代需要增加oracle查询次数，缺乏在固定每次迭代查询次数下达到最优复杂度的方法。

Method: 在同样本oracle访问和均方Lipschitz随机噪声假设下，提出方差缩减锚定前向-后向方法（VRAF），每次迭代两次查询；并扩展Foster等(2019)下界证明不可能性；再提出近端正则化随机外推梯度法（RRSEG）。

Result: VRAF达到首个无对数项的O(1/ε)复杂度及最优O(σ²/ε)方差依赖；证明了O(LD/√ε+σ²/ε)复杂度一般不可达；RRSEG以固定查询次数达到此前仅靠增加查询次数才能实现的近最优复杂度。

Conclusion: 在固定每次迭代查询次数下，VRAF实现了最优方差依赖，但确定了确定性最优项的不可达性，RRSEG进一步逼近最优oracle复杂度，解决了固定查询次数下加速的核心开放问题。

Abstract: We study acceleration of stochastic first-order methods for monotone Lipschitz inclusions with a fixed number of oracle queries per iteration, measured by the expected squared residual. Existing methods either have suboptimal oracle complexity, require an increasing number of oracle queries per iteration, or both. Under same-sample oracle access and mean-square Lipschitz stochastic noise, we develop variance-reduced anchored forward-backward (VRAF), an anytime composite method that makes two oracle queries per iteration. VRAF attains the first log-free $O(1/ε)$ complexity under these oracle assumptions and hence the optimal $O(σ^2/ε)$ variance dependence. This, however, leaves open whether the optimal $O(1/\sqrtε)$ deterministic term can also be attained. We establish an impossibility result by extending the lower bound of Foster et al. (2019) to stochastic oracles permitting repeated queries to sampled stochastic operators, showing that $O(LD/\sqrtε+σ^2/ε)$ oracle complexity is unattainable in general. We therefore develop recentered regularized stochastic extragradient (RRSEG), which attains the near-optimal oracle complexity previously achievable only with an increasing number of queries per iteration, while using a fixed number of queries.

</details>


### [299] [Learned Preconditioning for a Primal-Dual Interior-Point Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35665)
*Abhinav Madabhushi,Jialin Liu,Minxin Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出pdLIP：将学习到的预处理与全平移原对偶投影搜索IPM结合，用循环网络预测对角预条件子，避免Hessian和牛顿系统求解，实现高效热启动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内点法依赖昂贵的二阶信息与大规模线性系统求解；学习优化可提供便宜更新，但log障碍在约束边界附近的奇异性使IPM对扰动敏感，导致热启动和可靠学习更新困难。

Method: pdLIP基于pdProj（全平移原对偶投影搜索IPM）。共享的坐标级循环网络预测正对角预条件子，用于缩放原步约化牛顿系统右端，其余松弛与乘子方向解析恢复；迭代仅用一阶和坐标级操作，适合GPU并行。训练为自监督，损失基于罚-障碍价值函数与扰动最优性条件残差，无需目标方向或预解。

Result: 在四类200维凸与非凸约束问题上，10^-8 KKT残差容差下，热启动将pdProj精化迭代减少63-67%，热启动生成开销可忽略；在1000变量盒约束QP及投资组合优化、SVM、非线性控制等应用上改进持续。

Conclusion: 学习预条件结合原对偶平移可有效缓解障碍敏感性，实现高效热启动，在多种约束优化任务上显著加速。

Abstract: Interior-point methods (IPMs) are among the most widely used algorithms for constrained optimization, yet their Newton-based search directions require costly second-order information and large linear-system solves. Learning to optimize offers cheaper updates learned from data, but the singular behavior of logarithmic barriers near constraint boundaries makes IPMs highly sensitive to perturbations, complicating both warm starting and learning reliable updates. We introduce pdLIP, an IPM for smooth nonlinear programs that integrates learned preconditioning with pdProj, an all-shifted primal-dual projected-search IPM. A shared coordinate-wise recurrent network predicts a positive diagonal preconditioner that scales the right-hand side of the reduced Newton system for the primal step, and the remaining slack and multiplier directions are recovered analytically. The learned iterations avoid Hessian evaluations and Newton-system solves, using only first-order and coordinate-wise operations amenable to GPU parallelization. Training is self-supervised, with a loss based on a penalty-barrier merit function and the residual of perturbed optimality conditions, requiring neither target directions nor precomputed solutions. Primal and dual shifts mitigate the barrier's sensitivity to perturbations near constraint boundaries, enabling effective warm starting. Across four classes of 200-dimensional convex and nonconvex constrained problems, pdLIP warm starts reduce pdProj refinement iterations by 63-67% compared with cold starts at the same KKT residual tolerance of $10^{-8}$, with negligible warm-start generation cost relative to the subsequent pdProj solve. Improvements persist on box-constrained QPs with 1000 variables and extend to applications including portfolio optimization, support vector machines, and a nonlinear control example.

</details>


### [300] [From detectability of abstract linear systems to exponential output-to-state stability and back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35735)
*Qiaoling Chen,Andrii Mironchenko,Fabian Wirth*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究Banach空间中有界输出算子的线性无穷维系统的指数输出-状态稳定性(eOSS)，建立了eOSS与Lyapunov函数的等价刻画，并给出一系列反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指数输出-状态稳定性(eOSS)是无穷维系统的重要稳定性概念，但其与Lyapunov函数、可检测性之间的关系尚未被完全厘清，尤其在一般Banach空间框架下。本文旨在系统刻画这些概念之间的等价与蕴含关系。

Method: 采用Lyapunov方法，区分蕴含形式与耗散形式的eOSS Lyapunov函数；结合指数可检测性、零可检测性等概念进行理论分析与反例构造；在非稳定子空间为有限维时给出等价刻画，并用抛物方程举例。

Result: 证明eOSS等价于存在强制性的蕴含形式eOSS Lyapunov函数；指数可检测性保证耗散形式Lyapunov函数存在从而eOSS。反例表明：指数零可检测性不蕴含eOSS；eOSS不蕴含耗散形式Lyapunov函数存在；耗散形式也不蕴含指数可检测性。若非稳定子空间有限维，零可检测性蕴含指数可检测性并给出eOSS的等价刻画。

Conclusion: 在一般Banach空间线性无穷维系统中，eOSS与Lyapunov函数、可检测性的关系并非完全等价，需要区分不同形式；非稳定子空间有限维时才能得到较强的等价刻画。结果对抛物方程进行了验证。

Abstract: We study exponential output-to-state stability (eOSS) of linear infinite-dimensional systems in Banach spaces with bounded output operators. It is shown that eOSS is equivalent to the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in implication form. Also exponential detectability guarantees the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form and therefore eOSS. Counterexamples demonstrate that the converse implications fail in general: exponential zero-detectability does not imply eOSS, eOSS does not imply the existence of an eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form, which, in turn, does not imply exponential detectability. If the unstable subspace is finite-dimensional, zero-detectability implies exponential detectability and yields equivalent characterizations of eOSS. The results are illustrated with a parabolic equation.

</details>


### [301] [Peppy: An AI-Assisted Workflow for Tight Convergence Analysis of Optimization Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35762)
*Jaewook J. Suh,TaeHo Yoon,Edward Duc Hien Nguyen,Bicheng Ying,Shiqian Ma*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: Peppy是一个AI辅助工作流，用领域知识结构化地发现一阶优化算法的紧致解析收敛证明，并通过SymPy实现最小化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用LLM数学研究方法面向宽泛问题、缺乏针对性且常依赖Lean 4形式化，效率与可验证性受限；作者希望更充分利用领域知识，实现结构化、可复现的证明合成。

Method: Peppy重度利用优化领域特定知识，以结构化方式构造收敛证明，并借助SymPy进行最小且易获取的验证。

Result: 实验表明Peppy提供了严格、实用、可复现的AI辅助定理合成范式，并解决了若干一阶优化算法紧致收敛分析的开放问题，包括Nesterov FGM的猜想。

Conclusion: Peppy将优化算法分析从艺术转变为科学。

Abstract: This paper presents Peppy, an AI-assisted workflow for discovering tight, analytic convergence proofs for first-order optimization algorithms. Generic approaches to using LLMs to conduct mathematical research target an unspecified, broad spectrum of problems and sometimes use the Lean 4 proof assistant for formalization. On the other hand, Peppy leverages domain-specific knowledge more heavily and is thereby capable of constructing the proofs in a more structured manner, which allow a minimal and accessible verification through SymPy. We experimentally demonstrate through examples that Peppy provides a rigorous, practical, and reproducible paradigm for AI-assisted theorem synthesis in optimization. We further highlight its capability of closing several open problems on tight convergence analysis of first-order optimization algorithms, including conjectures for Nesterov's FGM. Overall, Peppy is designed to turn the art of optimization algorithm analysis into a science.

</details>

### [302] [Packets, Transactions and Queues: Design Principles for HFT Systems from a Measurement Study of CME Market Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32848)
*Vincent Maciejewski*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 基于一年多CME NQ期货市场数据测量，挑战HFT系统“单线程事件循环”铁律，提出何时单线程最优、何时双线程更优的设计原则，并给出解析框架支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HFT系统传统上采用单线程事件循环，遵循“每次线程跳转都增加延迟”的规则。本文用实测数据检验该规则是否普遍成立。

Method: 追踪一年多CME NQ前月合约的每个数据包和撮合引擎交易（含两个交易所时间戳），并与实际生产接收器对比验证。同时构建解析框架，包括突发极限吞吐恒等式与将串联系统精确归约为单一瓶颈服务器。

Result: 数据包以自激近临界簇到达，其根源是撮合交易时序而非打包方式；引擎常在亚微秒内连续处理交易，而发布器每~7.5µs最多发一个包。据此：①单发布周期内处理完每个包则不会排队，单线程最优；②超过该周期出现排队尾部，拆分为两线程两阶段可消除大部分尾部（代价是中位数多一跳）；③只有最慢阶段重要；④接近周期处（生产接收器所在），尾部来自多消息包与可变服务时间，杠杆是每消息成本和服务分布而非线程数。

Conclusion: 线程跳转并非总是有害：在超出发布周期的排队尾部场景下，两线程拆分可显著降低延迟尾部，是否拆分取决于能否缩短最慢阶段。设计应围绕服务成本与服务时间分布优化。

Abstract: HFT systems are conventionally built as a single-threaded event loop, on the rule that every thread hop adds latency. We test that rule against a measurement study of more than a year of CME market data for the NQ front-month contract, following every packet and matching-engine transaction through the feed's two exchange timestamps, and checking the results against a live production receiver. Packets arrive in near-critical self-exciting clusters that belong to the matching engine's transactions, not to how the exchange packs them. The engine often processes consecutive transactions within a fraction of a microsecond, while the market-data publisher sends at most one packet per publisher period of about 7.5 microseconds, so a burst reaches the receiver as a train of packets one period apart. This yields design principles for HFT systems. First, a receiver that handles each packet within one publisher period never queues on arrivals, however bursty the market; there one thread is best. Second, above that period a queueing tail appears, driven by the timing of transactions, not by packet rate or size, and two threads can be better than one: splitting the servicing chain into two stages on separate threads removes most of the tail at the cost of one hop on the median. Third, only the slowest stage matters, so a split pays only if it shortens it. Fourth, just under the period, where the production receiver runs, the remaining tail comes from multi-message packets and variable service times, and the levers are cost per message and spread of service, not thread count. An analytic framework, a burst-limit throughput identity and an exact reduction of the tandem to a single bottleneck server, supports these results.

</details>


### [303] [Oracle-Parametrized Constant Function Market Makers: From Price Feeds to Pricing Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33799)
*Hamed Amini,Zachary Feinstein*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文提出预言机参数化自动做市商（OP-AMM），其报价同时依赖池储备与外部预言机价格，将信息无关AMM框架扩展到链下价格发现场景（如代币化证券）。在严格的预言机收缩条件下，报价在预言机价格与池储备隐含的自给价格之间插值，并给出分离市场滞后暴露与预言机误差损失的LVR分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统信息无关AMM假设价格发现发生在链上，但代币化证券等场景中价格发现发生在链下，因此需要将外部预言机价格引入AMM报价机制。

Method: 提出OP-AMM框架；在预言机收缩条件下刻画报价插值性质；推导一般化LVR分解，分离市场滞后残差暴露与预言机误差损失；扩展至陈旧、离散更新预言机及预言机更新周围的夹击攻击；用SPY NBBO秒级数据做反事实回测。

Result: 给出OP-AMM同时提升局部资本效率并降低归一化LVR的条件；发现预言机噪声或陈旧可能逆转这些收益；通过回测刻画OP-CFMM在不同预言机情境下的帕累托有效前沿。

Conclusion: OP-AMM为链下价格发现场景提供了理论框架，量化了预言机质量与AMM设计之间的权衡，并为OP-CFMM设计选择提供指导。

Abstract: This paper introduces oracle-parametrized automated market makers (OP-AMMs), i.e., automated market makers whose quoted price depends jointly on the pool reserves and an external oracle price. In doing so, we extend the information-agnostic AMM framework to settings, such as tokenized securities, for which price discovery occurs off-chain. Under a strict oracle-contraction condition, we show that the quoted price of any OP-AMM interpolates between the oracle price and an implicit autarkic price determined by the pool reserves. We then derive a general loss-versus-rebalancing (LVR) decomposition that separates the residual exposure to market lags from the losses induced by oracle errors. This analysis is further extended to stale, discrete-update oracles and to sandwich attacks around oracle updates. Using this framework, we find conditions under which OP-AMMs simultaneously increase local capital efficiency and reduce normalized LVR relative to information-agnostic AMMs. However, sufficiently noisy or stale oracles can reverse these gains. A counterfactual backtest using one-second SPY NBBO data is provided to demonstrate these trade-offs. In particular, we map the Pareto-efficient frontier of oracle-parametrized constant function market maker (OP-CFMM) designs across stylized oracle regimes.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [304] [Bridging Stochastic Flow Maps and Boltzmann Generators with Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31978)
*Louis Grenioux,RuiKang OuYang,Luhuan Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出NF²M，将随机流映射与归一化流的可解似然结合，构建Boltzmann生成器，在每步去噪中重加权以提升采样效率与质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模生成分子系统的独立平衡样本是计算统计力学的核心难题。Boltzmann生成器通过生成模型加重要性采样来获得一致样本，但现有方法通常只在末尾校正生成模型，导致被丢弃轨迹上的计算浪费，且似然多为近似或难算，影响统计可靠性。

Method: NF²M结合随机流映射与经典归一化流：在每一步去噪中，用条件归一化流在当前噪声状态下提出干净构型，其精确似然可对每个提议向目标Boltzmann分布的真实去噪转移进行校正，从而逐步重加权。作者证明了校正转移的一致性，并界定了近似误差在采样链中的传播。

Result: 在肽系统上评估，NF²M展现出更好的采样效率和样本质量。

Conclusion: NF²M将可解似然的归一化流融入流映射去噪过程，实现逐步校正与误差可控，为高效、可靠的Boltzmann生成器提供了新思路。

Abstract: Generating independent, equilibrium samples of molecular systems at scale remains a central obstacle in computational statistical mechanics. Boltzmann Generators address this by pairing a generative model with importance sampling to obtain consistent samples from the target distribution. We introduce Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF$^2$M), which combines the strengths of recent stochastic flow maps with the tractability of classic normalizing flows to build a Boltzmann Generator. Unlike most methods, which correct the generative model only at the end, NF$^2$M reweighs each denoising transition as generation proceeds, avoiding wasted compute on trajectories that are ultimately discarded. At each denoising step, a conditional normalizing flow proposes clean configurations given the current noisy state (a simpler task than sampling directly from the target) and its exact likelihood enables correcting each proposal toward the true denoising transition of the target Boltzmann distribution. This is in contrast to most existing methods, whose likelihoods are approximate or expensive to evaluate, undermining the statistical reliability of the correction. We establish consistency of the corrected transitions and bound how approximation errors propagate through the sampling chain. We evaluate NF$^2$M on peptide systems, demonstrating improved sampling efficiency and sample quality.

</details>


### [305] [Continuous-Time Trajectory Generation from Discrete Observations with Stochasticity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32026)
*Ruifeng Shang,Shu Liu,Yuhua Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: PhiBE-Flow直接估计SDE诱导的概率速度场，仅需离散观测即可建模连续时间演化，无需已知SDE系数或分数估计，并有收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统连续演化，但状态常在离散时间点被观测；仅学习相邻观测间的转移映射无法刻画连续时间演化，难以生成符合概率密度的轨迹。

Method: 提出PhiBE-Flow框架，直接从离散观测中以无模型方式学习由SDE驱动的概率速度场，无需已知SDE系数，也无需估计score函数；理论上分析时间离散化与有限样本误差并给出收敛保证。

Result: 从受控随机数值系统到Navier-Stokes动力学及真实视频等复杂度递增的任务上，方法能准确恢复随机动力学的概率流、保持多尺度物理统计量，且视频生成性能优于代表性基线。

Conclusion: PhiBE-Flow提供了一种无需模型先验与score估计的连续时间概率流建模方法，兼具理论收敛保证与实际多场景有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Physical systems evolve continuously in time, yet their states are typically observed only at discrete times. Generating trajectories consistent with their probability densities from such observations therefore requires capturing the continuous-time evolution rather than only learning transition mappings between consecutive observations. We propose PhiBE-Flow, a framework that directly estimates the probability velocity field induced by the stochastic differential equation (SDE) which governs this continuous-time distributional evolution. PhiBE-Flow learns from discrete observations using a model-free approach requiring neither known SDE coefficients nor score estimation. We establish convergence guarantees for the method, accounting for both time-discretization and finite-sample errors. We evaluate PhiBE-Flow on systems of increasing complexity, from controlled stochastic numerical systems to Navier--Stokes dynamics and real-world videos. Our results show that PhiBE-Flow accurately recovers probability flows of stochastic dynamics, preserves multiscale physical statistics, and improves video generation performance over representative baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/R1fe/PhiBE-Flow.

</details>


### [306] [A Unified Optimism-Agnostic Framework for Linear Bandits over Spherical Action Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32149)
*Arda Güçlü,Subhonmesh Bose,John R. Birge*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化框架，通过设计矩阵最小特征值刻画参数估计质量，将估计质量与最优遗憾积累显式联系，统一分析线性bandit的UCB与TS算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性bandit中UCB和TS等算法需平衡探索与利用，而参数估计质量取决于设计矩阵特征值。作者希望建立一条不同于经典乐观椭圆势论证的分析路径，并显式连接估计质量与最优遗憾。

Method: 提出算法无关的分析：若探索带来的推断质量（设计矩阵最小特征值）随时间以约√t增长，且动作足够集中以支持利用，则对球面动作集可得到最优高概率遗憾；随后证明UCB和TS的变体满足这些推断与集中性质。

Result: 在所给条件下，算法达到最优高概率遗憾率O(√T log T)（时间跨度T）；UCB与TS变体满足条件，因而同样享有该最优遗憾率。

Conclusion: 该结果为线性bandit算法提供模块化分析框架，明确将参数估计质量与最优遗憾累积联系起来，并作为替代经典乐观势论证的分析途径。

Abstract: Linear bandits model sequential decision-making problems with noisy rewards that are linear in the decision variable, where an agent must simultaneously learn about an unknown parameter that governs the mean rewards, while maximizing (expected) rewards over time. Two prominent algorithmic families--upper confidence bound (UCB) and Thompson sampling (TS)--achieve a balance of exploration (to estimate said parameter) and exploitation (utilization of knowledge about it) across time. The quality of estimation of that parameter depends on the eigenvalues of a design matrix. In this paper, we begin by showing that if the inference quality obtained from exploration, encoded in the minimum eigenvalue of the design matrix, grows $\gtrsim \sqrt{t}$ with time $t$, while actions remain sufficiently concentrated for exploitation, then an algorithm produces optimal high-probability $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T}\log T)$-regret rate over a time-horizon $T$ for spherical action sets. This analysis is algorithm-agnostic and follows an alternative route to the classical optimism-based elliptical-potential argument for regret analysis. Then, we illustrate that variants of UCB and TS satisfy the inference and concentration properties and in turn, enjoy optimal regret rate. In effect, our results provide a modular framework that can be used to analyze linear bandit algorithms and explicitly connect quality of parameter estimation to optimal regret accumulation.

</details>


### [307] [FOCUS: Fixed-Confidence Online Causal Learning Using Sequential Adaptive Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32165)
*Haijie Xu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究无历史数据的全在线固定置信度因果发现，从零样本出发，顺序选择干预以恢复线性高斯SEM的因果DAG和边权重，提出FOCUS算法并证明其样本复杂度最优（在log(1/δ)依赖上匹配下界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果发现通常依赖历史观测数据或离线样本，而现实中可能从零样本开始且需在线决策。本文旨在解决无任何历史观测数据下的全在线固定置信度因果发现问题。

Method: 建立任意(ε,δ)-正确算法的实例依赖下界；提出FOCUS，通过在线max-min博弈自适应分配干预；给出涉及跨干预共享因果参数的累积KL散度的可计算浓度不等式。

Result: 证明FOCUS是(ε,δ)-正确的，其期望停止时间在下界的Θ(log(1/δ))依赖上匹配（至多相差实例依赖常数）；实验显示结构与边权重恢复更优，并验证预测的停止时间趋势。

Conclusion: FOCUS在全在线、无历史数据的因果发现中达到样本复杂度最优（阶意义上），为在线因果发现提供了理论保证与实用算法。

Abstract: We study fully online fixed-confidence causal discovery without any historical observational data. Starting from zero samples, the learner sequentially selects interventions to recover both the causal DAG and its edge weights under a linear-Gaussian structural equation model. We establish an instance-dependent lower bound for any $(ε,δ)$-correct algorithm and propose \textsc{FOCUS}, which adaptively allocates interventions through an online max--min game. A key contribution is a computable concentration inequality for the accumulated KL divergence involving causal parameters shared across interventions. We prove that \textsc{FOCUS} is $(ε,δ)$-correct and that its expected stopping time matches the lower bound in its $Θ(\log(1/δ))$ dependence up to an instance-dependent constant. Experiments demonstrate improved structure and edge-weight recovery and confirm the predicted stopping-time trend. Our codes are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FOCUS_code-76E5

</details>


### [308] [Uncertainty Quantification of Next Generation Reservoir Computing with Applications to Memory-Driven Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32169)
*Livia Popa,Sumanta Basu,Martin T. Wells*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究NGRC的贝叶斯岭回归与共形预测区间的不确定性量化，刻画二者一致或分歧的条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 含记忆的非线性动力系统广泛存在，但NGRC等高效预测方法的不确定性量化仍不成熟，需要理论指导选择与解释。

Method: 分析贝叶斯岭回归与共形预测区间；低维下考察渐近宽度所依赖的残差分布摘要；高维下考察正则化带来的估计方差、收缩偏差与后验不确定性权衡；扩展到二次NGRC特征映射，并给出向时间相关预测窗口迁移的充分条件。

Result: 低维下二者渐近宽度由不同残差摘要决定，一致性取决于残差形状而非仅维度；高维下存在贝叶斯区间比共形区间更宽或更窄的显式转变；仿真与真实数据实验支持理论预测，展示残差分布、正则化、维度与分布漂移对校准和效率的影响。

Conclusion: 结果为基于储备池的预测中选择与解释不确定性量化方法提供了有原则的框架。

Abstract: Nonlinear dynamical systems with memory arise across science and engineering, yet uncertainty quantification for efficient forecasting methods such as Next Generation Reservoir Computing (NGRC) remains underdeveloped. We study Bayesian ridge and conformal prediction intervals for NGRC and characterize when their uncertainty estimates agree or differ. In low dimensions, their asymptotic widths are governed by different summaries of the residual distribution, so agreement depends on residual shape rather than dimensionality alone. In high dimensions, regularization introduces a further tradeoff between estimation variance, shrinkage bias, and posterior uncertainty, leading to an explicit transition between regimes where Bayesian intervals are wider or narrower than conformal intervals. We extend these results to quadratic NGRC feature maps and give sufficient conditions for transferring the analysis to temporally dependent forecast windows. Simulations and real-data experiments support the theoretical predictions and illustrate how residual distribution, regularization, dimensionality, and distribution shift affect interval calibration and efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for choosing and interpreting uncertainty quantification methods in reservoir-based forecasting.

</details>


### [309] [High-Probability Guarantees for SGD under $β$-Heavy-Tailed Gradient Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32195)
*Qijun Tong,Masahiro Ikeda,Ryota Kawasumi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文用Orlicz空间中的Young函数刻画SGD梯度噪声的重尾特性，提出β-重尾噪声模型，并给出非凸损失下SGD的高概率优化与风险平稳性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SGD训练中数据子采样会引入梯度噪声，其高概率保证依赖于噪声尾部的建模。深度学习中被广泛报告的重尾梯度噪声促使研究者放宽常用有界噪声和亚高斯假设。

Method: 使用Orlicz空间理论的Young函数统一描述噪声尾部；提出β-重尾类（保持所有多项式矩有限但尾部重于亚Weibull，包括对数正态分布）；建立该类噪声的集中不等式；结合SGD轨迹上经验梯度与总体梯度差的统一界，分析光滑非凸损失。

Result: 获得优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界，不限于特定学习率衰减规则，并显式体现噪声尾部与学习率调度的影响；在Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件下给出最后迭代的风险界；还分析了梯度裁剪下的SGD。

Conclusion: 该工作为重尾噪声下SGD的高概率分析提供了统一框架，能够涵盖比亚Weibull更重的尾部及对数正态分布，并适用于梯度裁剪等场景。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is widely used to train machine learning models, but subsampling the training data introduces noise into its updates. The strength and applicability of high-probability guarantees therefore depend critically on how the tails of gradient noise are modeled. Reports of heavy-tailed gradient noise in deep learning motivate relaxing the bounded-noise and sub-Gaussian assumptions commonly used in high-probability analyses of SGD. We use Young functions from Orlicz space theory to describe noise tails in a common framework. We model SGD gradient noise by adopting a Young function that preserves the finiteness of all polynomial moments while allowing tails heavier than sub-Weibull, including lognormal distributions. The resulting class is called $β$-heavy-tailed, with $β$ controlling the tail heaviness. We establish concentration inequalities for $β$-heavy-tailed noise and combine them with a uniform bound on the difference between empirical and population gradients along the SGD trajectory to obtain high-probability bounds on optimization and population-risk stationarity for smooth nonconvex losses under trajectory assumptions. The bounds are not restricted to a particular learning-rate decay rule and make explicit the effects of noise tails and learning-rate schedules. Under the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, we bound the risk at the last iterate. We also analyze SGD with gradient clipping under the $β$-heavy-tailed noise model.

</details>


### [310] [Overfitting of Spectral Gradient Descent: How Matrix Geometry shapes Generalization and Implicit Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32270)
*Guillaume Braun,Ichiro Hashimoto,Masaaki Imaizumi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究过参数化矩阵分类中谱梯度下降（SpecGD）在标签被污染下的泛化行为，揭示shortcut几何（collapsed vs dispersed）会反转GD与SpecGD的相对泛化优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解谱方法/谱梯度下降在存在可记忆但不泛化的shortcut时的泛化机制，并厘清shortcut几何结构如何影响GD与SpecGD的比较。

Method: 构造过参数化矩阵分类模型：输入=共享低秩信号+秩一样本特定扰动（shortcut）；区分collapsed（共享奇异方向）与dispersed（不同奇异方向）shortcut。结合SpecGD选择方向的精细对偶分析与归一化损失权重的指数梯度动力学来刻画所选方向。

Result: 仅改变shortcut几何即可反转GD与SpecGD的相对泛化：collapsed可能利好SpecGD，dispersed可能利好GD。在dispersed情形，精确shortcut正交会使晚期SpecGD方向丢失信号；而消失的随机相关通过二阶效应集体产生虽小但泛化相关的信号。此外，单步SpecGD即可插值且泛化良好，继续训练收敛到泛化显著更差的方向。

Conclusion: SpecGD的泛化强烈依赖shortcut的几何与训练时长；其晚期方向不由谱最大间隔问题单独决定，而需结合对偶与权重动力学解释，且早停/单步可能优于持续训练。

Abstract: We study the generalization of spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) in overparameterized matrix classification with corrupted labels. Each input combines a shared low-rank signal with a rank-one sample-specific perturbation, referred to as a shortcut, that enables memorization but does not generalize. We contrast collapsed shortcuts, which share a singular direction, with dispersed shortcuts, which occupy distinct singular directions. Changing only this geometry can reverse the relative generalization of GD and SpecGD: collapsed shortcuts can favor SpecGD, while dispersed shortcuts can favor GD. In the dispersed regime, exact shortcut orthogonality eliminates the signal from the late-stage SpecGD direction, while vanishing random correlations collectively generate a small but generalization-relevant signal through a second-order effect. To identify the direction selected by SpecGD, which the spectral max-margin problem alone does not determine, we combine a refined analysis of its dual with the exponentiated-gradient dynamics of normalized loss weights. Finally, we show that a single SpecGD step can already interpolate and generalize well, while continued training converges to a direction with substantially worse generalization.

</details>


### [311] [AECSF: Adaptive Ensemble Conditional Score Filtering for High-Dimensional Nonlinear Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32411)
*Yangwen Zhang,Shiwei Ni,Xiaoping Zhang,Xiaofei Guan,Lili Ju*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的AECSF自适应集成条件分数滤波器，通过条件Tweedie恒等式构建可解析的分数估计器，用共享自适应加权提议集成高效估计条件均值，提升高维非线性系统的后验采样与滤波精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性动力系统贝叶斯状态估计面临统计保真度与计算可处理性的矛盾：粒子权重会崩塌，而高斯集成更新会遗漏非高斯后验结构。现有无需训练的分数扩散滤波器依赖启发式似然修正，忽略了与每个含噪反向粒子相关的不确定性，损害后验精度。

Method: AECSF从条件Tweedie恒等式构造可解析处理的分数估计器，将含噪后验分数估计转化为在给定含噪反向粒子和观测下估计系统状态的条件均值；采用共享自适应加权提议集成高效估计这些条件均值，粒子特定的条件权重为每个反向粒子提供估计而无需单独提议采样；在同一反向扩散过程中用反向粒子信息更新提议集成。理论上刻画了固定加权提议度量产生精确含噪后验分数的条件，并在给定假设下建立条件均值估计误差与反向采样端点误差之间的界。

Result: 数值实验表明，AECSF在预报集成受限的高维问题中提升了后验采样与非线性滤波的精度。

Conclusion: AECSF为高维非线性贝叶斯状态估计提供了一种无需训练、兼顾统计保真与计算效率的分数滤波方案，缓解了权重崩塌与非高斯后验结构遗漏的问题。

Abstract: Bayesian state estimation for high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems entails a fundamental tension between statistical fidelity and computational tractability, as particle weights can collapse, while Gaussian ensemble updates can miss non-Gaussian posterior structure. Score-based diffusion filters offer a sampling-based alternative, but existing training-free score filters often rely on heuristic likelihood corrections, which can compromise posterior accuracy by neglecting uncertainty about the system state associated with each noisy reverse particle. To address these issues, we propose AECSF, a training-free adaptive ensemble conditional score filter. AECSF constructs an analytically tractable score estimator from the conditional Tweedie identity, which recasts noisy posterior score estimation as estimating the conditional mean of the system state given a noisy reverse particle and the observation. To estimate these conditional means efficiently, AECSF employs a shared adaptive weighted proposal ensemble, while particle-specific conditional weights yield an estimate for each noisy reverse particle without separate proposal sampling. The proposal ensemble is updated using reverse-particle information within the same reverse-diffusion run to improve conditional-mean estimation. Theoretically, we characterize when a fixed weighted proposal measure yields the exact noisy posterior score. Under stated assumptions, we establish a bound relating conditional-mean estimation errors to reverse-sampling endpoint error. Numerical experiments demonstrate that AECSF improves the accuracy of posterior sampling and nonlinear filtering in high-dimensional problems with limited forecast ensembles.

</details>


### [312] [Agnostic Smoothed Online Regression with Adversarial Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32478)
*Xuanyu Chen,Yue Yu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究带界对抗响应的平滑在线预测，提出Hedge-Cover算法，在有限伪维函数类上达到近最优自适应regret，并给出匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平滑在线预测框架连接i.i.d.采样与对抗协变量选择，其平滑参数C_cov刻画条件协变量密度相对固定未知基测度的界。此前blanchard2025agnostic提出了关于平滑在线回归minimax最优自适应regret的开放问题，本文旨在解决该问题。

Method: 提出信息论算法Hedge-Cover：构造一族专家，利用Hedge进行聚合；先验将regret与一致选择器和目标函数之间的不一致数联系起来，并通过协变量平滑性界定该不一致数。下界方面，显式构造支持在互相正交超平面上的挑战性序列协变量分布。

Result: 对有限伪维数Pdim(F)的函数类，Hedge-Cover达到次线性regret ~O(sqrt(Pdim(F)·C_cov·T))；对线性预测器类给出匹配下界。在well-specified设定下，对条件ν²-subGaussian响应，证明VC维为d的函数类minimax期望regret为Ω((1∨ν)sqrt((C_cov−1)dT))，且ERM上界匹配该ν依赖。

Conclusion: 本文解决了平滑在线回归中minimax最优自适应regret的开放问题，给出了近最优上界与匹配下界；下界的正交超平面构造可能具有独立技术价值；同时量化了响应噪声对well-specified设定regret的影响。

Abstract: We study smoothed online prediction with bounded adversarial responses. This widely studied framework bridges i.i.d. sampling and adversarial covariate selection through a smoothness parameter $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$, which bounds conditional covariate densities relative to a fixed, unknown base measure. We propose \textsc{Hedge-Cover}, an information-theoretic algorithm that achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for function classes with bounded pseudo-dimension. The algorithm aggregates a carefully constructed family of experts using \textsc{Hedge}, with a prior that links regret to the number of disagreements between a consistent selector and a target function. We bound this number by exploiting covariate smoothness. This answers an open problem posed in \cite{blanchard2025agnostic} on the minimax optimal adaptive regret of the smoothed online regression problem. We establish a matching lower bound for the class of linear predictors. The main intricacy of the lower bound lies in explicitly constructing a challenging sequential covariate distribution supported on mutually orthogonal hyperplanes. This construction may be of independent technical interest. Finally, we revisit the well-specified setting and quantify the effect of response noise. For conditionally $ν^2$-subGaussian responses, we extend the existing lower bound under realizable responses by showing that the minimax expected regret is $Ω((1\vee ν)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$ for a function class of VC dimension $d$. A corresponding upper bound for ERM matches this dependence on $ν$.

</details>


### [313] [Learning What to Evaluate: Correlation-Aware Decoupling for Multiobjective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32632)
*Ashwin Renganathan,Peter Bachman*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出多任务GP联合建模目标与约束，并用总相关度量挑选每轮最优子集进行解耦评估，理论上保证一致性与最大熵减，实验优于主流耦合/解耦基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
