Motivation: 现有MOBO用独立GP分别建模目标与约束，每轮需耦合评估全部目标与约束，效率受限；但目标与约束间常存在可利用的相关性，若加以利用可实现只评估部分任务的解耦评估。

Method: 采用多任务GP联合学习所有目标与约束，提出总相关（total correlation）度量，在均匀评估代价下识别每轮待评估的最优目标/约束子集，形成解耦的贝叶斯决策论采集策略。

Result: 理论上证明该采集策略在解耦情况下仍具渐近一致性，且所提子集选择规则在温和条件下最大化未评估任务的后验熵期望减少量；实证上优于当前最先进的耦合与解耦基线。

Conclusion: 利用任务间相关性进行解耦评估能有效提升MOBO的样本效率，为多目标约束优化提供兼具理论保证与实证优势的新方案。

Abstract: Multiobjective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) with Gaussian process (GP) surrogates is a sample efficient approach to solving multiobjective optimization problems. In MOBO, a Bayesian decision theoretic acquisition function guides the adaptive selection of new candidate inputs, on which objectives and constraints are evaluated to update the surrogate model sequentially. Existing approaches maintain independent GP models for the objectives and constraints, with new observations evaluating all objectives and constraints in a coupled fashion. However, the objectives and constraints often contain inherent correlations which, if exploited, can enable ${decoupled}$ evaluations where only a subset of them are evaluated at each round. We present a new approach that leverages a multitask GP model to jointly learn all objectives and constraints, and propose a total correlation metric that enables identifying an ${optimal}$ subset of objectives and constraints to be evaluated at every round, even under uniform evaluation costs. Theoretically, we show that our acquisition policy is asymptotically consistent despite decoupling and that our proposed decoupled subset selection rule maximizes the expected posterior entropy reduction about unevaluated tasks under mild conditions. Empirically, we show that our approach outperforms coupled and decoupled baselines in the state of the art.

</details>


### [314] [Affine Geometry of Gaussian ReLU Networks via Conditional Kac-Rice Formulas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32695)
*Recep Özkan,Christian Hirsch*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究有限宽度 ReLU 网络在随机初始化时的仿射几何，以及监督训练如何重排这些区域；通过条件 Kac-Rice 公式精确刻画激活切换与标量扭结数，并给出宽度成比例增长时的确定性极限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解 ReLU 网络分段仿射结构在初始化时如何形成、训练中如何变化，是解释其表达能力与泛化的关键，但现有研究缺乏对有限宽度网络激活切换与仿射区域数量的精确有限宽度刻画。

Method: 定义隐藏预激活变号零点为 activation switch、输出不可导点为 scalar kink。对一维输入，条件在先前层后各预激活在随机有限分割单元上为高斯且仿射，从而导出沿区间的期望激活切换数的精确条件 Kac-Rice 公式；对高维输入给出条件曲面公式，预测标量扭结集的 (d-1) 维 Hausdorff 测度。还进行可见性估计并给出固定深度、宽度成比例增长下的显式极限。

Result: 得到期望激活切换数的精确有限宽度公式，并在固定深度、宽度成比例增长时收敛到显式确定性极限；可见性估计表明不产生标量扭结的激活切换期望数可忽略，因而给出期望标量扭结数与仿射区域数的显式主导公式；高维下得到扭结集 Hausdorff 测度的主导期望。在 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 数据上，初始化公式能准确预测留出段上的切换数；训练后类内段切换数减少、类间段增加。

Conclusion: 训练并非简单收缩仿射复杂度，而是重新分配激活切换：类内减少、类间增加，说明网络通过学习重组分段仿射几何。

Abstract: We study how the affine geometry of finite ReLU networks is created at random initialization and reorganized by supervised training. We call a sign-changing zero of a hidden preactivation an activation switch and a point where the scalar network output is nondifferentiable a scalar kink. For one-dimensional input, conditioning on the preceding layers makes each preactivation Gaussian and affine on the cells of a random finite partition. This yields an exact finite-width conditional Kac-Rice formula for the expected number of activation switches along an input interval. For fixed depth and proportionally growing widths, the resulting switch intensities converge to explicit deterministic limits. A visibility estimate shows that the expected number of switches that do not produce scalar kinks is negligible, yielding an explicit leading formula for the expected number of scalar kinks and hence affine regions. In higher input dimensions d >= 2, the analogous conditional surface formula yields the leading expected (d-1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the scalar kink set. On the Breast Cancer Wisconsin data, the initialization formula accurately predicts switch counts along held-out segments. After training, switch counts decrease along within-class segments and increase along between-class segments. Thus, training redistributes rather than merely contracts affine complexity.

</details>


### [315] [Domain Adaptation with Target Information via Doubly-Anchored Distributionally Robust Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32730)
*David Kepplinger,Anand N. Vidyashankar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出双锚定DRO框架，将歧义集设为源分布与源补全目标参考分布两个φ-散度球的交集，推导对偶对抗桥几何，并给出桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计器的理论保证与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域适应（DA）缺乏最坏情况保证，而仅基于源数据的DRO将歧义集中心置于源分布，忽略了目标结构信息。需要弥合两者差距。

Method: 提出双锚定DRO框架：歧义集为以源分布和源补全目标参考分布（目标协变量分布配源条件分布）为中心的两个φ-散度球交集。推导对称与非对称散度对偶诱导的对抗桥几何，引入KL/平方Hellinger（KL/HD）桥。在有限重叠条件下建立结构、损失无关密度桥风险的有限样本泛化界。构建桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计器，证明源回归函数的一致一致性和逐点渐近正态性。

Result: KL/HD非对称桥产生Lambert-W几何，源侧指数风险倾斜与目标侧Hellinger稳定化通过不同项进入，减弱但不约束大似然比影响。在协变量偏移下可实现目标恢复。在域偏移Fashion-MNIST上验证了严重合成目标协变量污染下非对称KL/HD桥的有限样本稳定性。

Conclusion: 双锚定DRO框架在不假设协变量偏移下提供泛化保证，桥加权估计器具有理论一致性；非对称KL/HD桥在目标协变量严重污染时表现出有限样本稳定性。所提泛化界不直接适用于损失感知的DRO min-max估计器。

Abstract: Domain Adaptation (DA) often lacks worst-case guarantees, while Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) based only on source data centers its ambiguity set at the source law and ignores available target structure. To bridge this gap, we introduce a doubly-anchored DRO framework whose ambiguity set is the intersection of $φ$-divergence balls centered at the source law and a source-completed target reference law, the latter pairing the target covariate law with the source conditional law. We derive dual-induced adversarial bridge geometries for symmetric and asymmetric divergence pairings, notably introducing a Kullback--Leibler/squared-Hellinger (KL/HD) bridge. This asymmetric formulation yields a Lambert-$W$ geometry in which source-side exponential risk tilting and target-side Hellinger stabilization enter through distinct terms, attenuating, but not bounding, the effect of large likelihood ratios. Furthermore, without imposing covariate shift, we establish finite-sample generalization bounds for the minimizer of a structural, loss-agnostic density-bridge risk under bounded-overlap conditions; these bounds do not apply directly to the loss-aware DRO min--max estimator. We translate our framework into a bridge-weighted Nadaraya--Watson estimator, proving uniform consistency for the source regression function and pointwise asymptotic normality, with target recovery when the source and target regression functions coincide, as under covariate shift. Finally, an empirical evaluation on a domain-shifted Fashion-MNIST dataset illustrates the finite-sample stability of the asymmetric KL/HD bridge under severe synthetic target-covariate corruption.

</details>


### [316] [Sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32847)
*Binh Thuan Tran,Khai Nguyen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出切片Orlicz-Wasserstein(SOW)距离，将SW中的L^p范数替换为Orlicz函数诱导的Luxemburg范数，理论证明其为度量、拓扑与样本复杂度最优性，并给出算法与实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SW距离基于L^p范数，灵活性受限；作者希望用Orlicz函数推广以获得更灵活的距离度量，同时保持可计算性。

Method: 定义SOW距离：以Orlicz函数φ诱导的Luxemburg范数替代SW中的L^p范数；证明其为度量并推广SW(φ(x)=x^p)；分析拓扑性质(收敛蕴含弱收敛，紧支撑下反之)；推导距离及幂泛函的样本复杂度与极小极大最优性；用Monte-Carlo估计与二分搜索近似并分析误差与复杂度。

Result: SOW是度量且可恢复SW；收敛性等价弱收敛(紧支撑)；样本复杂度达极小极大最优；计算效率优于Orlicz-Wasserstein；在两样本检验与图像生成模型评估中灵活性强于SW。

Conclusion: SOW为SW的灵活推广，兼具理论保证与计算优势，在分布差异检测与生成模型评估中表现优越。

Abstract: We propose sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) distance which is a generalization of sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. SOW replaces the $L^p$ norm in SW with a Luxemburg norm cost induced by an Orlicz function $φ$. First, we prove that SOW distance is a metric on the space of measures with finite Orlicz norm, and show that it recovers the SW distance when the Orlicz function is $φ(x)=x^p$. Next, we derive the topological properties of the SOW distance. In particular, we show that convergence under SOW implies weak convergence, and the converse is true under the compact support condition. We then present the theoretical results for estimating the SOW distance. We derive sample complexity for both the distance itself and the powered functional of the distance, and prove their minimax optimality. In addition, we discuss the computational algorithm for approximating the SOW distance by Monte-Carlo estimation and bisection search, as well as the associated approximation error and computational complexity analysis. Our experimental results reveal the superior computational efficiency of SOW compared with Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW) distance. Also, in the experiments, we demonstrate the favorable flexibility of SOW distance over SW in detecting differences between distributions by comparing their performance in two-sample tests and evaluating generative models on image datasets.

</details>


### [317] [Byzantine-Robust Federated RAG via Aligned Calibration and Fixed-Membership Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33037)
*Prasanjit Dubey,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出联邦RAG中抗拜占庭节点的共形预测方法，利用校准和查询阶段诚实节点一致的特点，保证答案集合覆盖正确答的概率，且集合更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦RAG中部分节点（拜占庭）可能被攻陷或误导，报告任意分数；现有方法假设所有节点诚实或仅保护校准阶段，无法同时抵御校准和查询阶段的攻击。

Method: 让所有节点对相同校准问题打分，中心仅保留那些存在某组不超过声明数量的诚实节点（两阶段用自身分数）会支持的候选答案，从而构造共形预测集合。

Result: 证明在有限样本下集合以选定概率包含正确答案，且不牺牲诚实节点支持的答案时无法更小；模拟中在真实问答任务（含医疗考试）和语言模型节点、部分被劫持情况下，达到目标覆盖率，优于简单平均，且比其他同等保护方法集合更小。

Conclusion: 该方法在保证覆盖率的前提下显著减小预测集合，声明界限宽松时优势更大，说明保守界限代价很小。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets language models answer questions more accurately by consulting relevant documents. Many valuable collections, such as medical records, cannot be pooled because of privacy rules. Federated RAG leaves each collection with its owner, or node, which scores candidate answers from its own documents; a central hub combines the scores. Some nodes, called Byzantine, may be compromised, faulty, or misled by instructions hidden in documents, and report arbitrary scores. Conformal prediction returns a set containing the correct answer with a chosen probability, using a cutoff set in a calibration step on questions with known answers. An unknown group of nodes, no larger than a declared bound, may misreport both in this step and at query time. Existing methods assume every node is honest or protect only the calibration step. We observe that the honest nodes are the same in both steps. The hub therefore has all nodes score the same calibration questions, and keeps a candidate only if some plausible group of honest nodes, using its own scores in both steps, would keep it. We prove that the resulting sets contain the correct answer with the chosen probability in finite samples, whatever the Byzantine nodes report. No method using the same information can return smaller sets without risking the loss of an answer the honest nodes support. If nodes fail at random, the guarantee weakens only by the probability that more nodes fail than declared. In simulations, on real question-answering tasks including medical exams, and with language models as nodes, some hijacked, our sets reached the target whenever no more nodes misbehaved than declared, while plain averaging could miss it. They were also clearly smaller than those of simpler methods with the same protection, most of all when the declared bound was generous, so a cautious bound costs little.

</details>


### [318] [Can Tabular Foundation Models Amortize Statistical Inference?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33114)
*Kai Ye,Shijin Gong,Hongyi Zhou,Valentina Zangirolami,Chengchun Shi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出TabCon，一种基于表格基础模型的摊销推理系统，通过前向传播直接为数据集生成置信区间，实现近名义覆盖且计算高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统统计推断长期针对单一问题单独设计估计器与不确定性量化程序，缺乏通用性且计算昂贵，作者希望探索一种可摊销的通用推断范式。

Method: 聚焦置信区间构造问题，构建TabCon系统：基于表格基础模型，采用稀疏专家混合（MoE）架构，并通过强化学习后训练将置信区间校准到目标覆盖水平。

Result: 在大量基准数据集上，TabCon达到接近名义的覆盖水平，同时产生较短的置信区间；推理速度比经典bootstrap快50倍，即便后者仅使用50个bootstrap样本。

Conclusion: TabCon展示了摊销式推断的可行性，为置信区间构造提供了通用、高效的新范式，突破了传统逐问题设计估计器的思路。

Abstract: For decades, statistical inference has largely been developed one problem at a time. Given a scientific target, such as a treatment effect or a regression function, statisticians design a problem-specific estimator together with a procedure for quantifying its uncertainty. This paper proposes a different paradigm. We focus on a classical problem in statistical inference, confidence interval construction, and develop TabCon, an amortized inference system built on a tabular foundation model that produces confidence intervals for new datasets through a simple forward pass. The key methodological ingredients of TabCon are a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture and reinforcement-learning-based post-training that calibrate the resulting confidence intervals to a desired coverage level. Across a wide range of benchmark datasets, TabCon attains near-nominal coverage while producing short confidence intervals. At inference time, it also offers considerably greater computational efficiency, running 50 times faster than the classical bootstrap procedure, even when the latter uses only 50 bootstrap samples.

</details>


### [319] [Which Self-Improvements Should We Trust? Reliable Self-Improvement When Agents Reuse Their Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33180)
*Xiaojing Sun,Yuhan Zeng,Zihua She,Xiao Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出REUSE框架，在递归自我改进中控制有限评估集重复使用导致的过拟合，提供统计保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RSI依赖有限评估资源（固定的benchmark）决定哪些修改被保留及下一步提议。当资源被反复使用时，候选会基于同一评估集的反馈提出，搜索轨迹会自适应过拟合，经验性提升可能无法反映在真实任务分布上的改进。现有方法虽考虑多重比较，但假设候选与评估集独立选择，无法控制这种自适应依赖。

Method: 提出REUSE（Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution），一个带认证的评估与晋升框架。它允许固定评估集支持重复自适应决策并提供统计保证：对于用户指定的误差水平α，以至少1-α的概率，每个被晋升的修改都是真实任务分布上的真正群体改进。REUSE通过严格限制返回给搜索过程的评估反馈，并在误差预算内计入可能的晋升历史来实现。论文建立了此设定下RSI评估的详细统计理论，包括同时误差控制、累积改进的有效下界，以及自适应评估复用根本极限的刻画。

Result: 在实时自我改进实验中，REUSE比当前RSI系统的评估框架和误差控制基线显著减少了错误晋升，将错误晋升比例从最高20.7%降至0%，同时最终真实群体性能与最佳基线相当。

Conclusion: REUSE通过控制评估反馈和计入晋升历史，为有限评估资源下的RSI提供统计保证，有效消除错误晋升而不牺牲真实性能。

Abstract: As recursive self-improvement (RSI) rapidly advances, reliable evaluation becomes critical for guiding adaptive search. RSI typically relies on finite evaluation resources, such as fixed benchmarks, to determine which modifications are retained and what is proposed next. However, when these finite resources are repeatedly reused, new candidates are proposed based on feedback from the same evaluation set, so the search trajectory can adaptively overfit and empirical improvement may not reflect genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. Some existing methods account for multiple comparisons but assume that candidates are chosen independently of the evaluation set, and therefore do not control this adaptive dependence. To address this, we propose REUSE (Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution), a certified evaluation and promotion framework that allows a fixed evaluation set to support repeated adaptive decisions while providing statistical guarantees. For a user-specified error level $α$, with probability at least $1-α$, every promoted modification is a genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. REUSE achieves this by strictly limiting the evaluation feedback returned to the search process and accounting for possible promotion histories within the error budget. We develop detailed statistical theory for RSI evaluation in this setting, including simultaneous error control, valid lower bounds on cumulative improvement, and a characterization of the fundamental limits of adaptive evaluation reuse. In live self-improvement experiments, REUSE commits substantially fewer false promotions than evaluation frameworks from current RSI systems and error-controlled baselines, reducing the proportion of false promotions from up to 20.7% to 0%, while achieving final true population performance comparable to the best baselines.

</details>


### [320] [Offline Policy Evaluation via Mixed Bellman Residuals and Adaptive Critic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33186)
*Amitakshar Biswas,Yuhan Li,Ruoqing Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合一步与两步Bellman残差的离策略评估方法，通过数据依赖的critic核与样本分割，在偏差-方差间取得更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略评估（OPE）用行为策略数据评估目标策略是RL的核心难题。现有多数方法仅用标准一步Bellman残差，忽略了多步信息带来的潜在收益与权衡。

Method: 采用一步与两步残差的凸组合（固定混合权重），构建极小极大（minimax）形式，含critic函数。不依赖固定函数类，而用预测的未来特征方向构造数据依赖的critic表示，诱导适配转移动力学的核，使critic聚焦于对估计Bellman误差最相关的方向。用样本分割在独立子集上构造critic并估计值函数以控制过拟合。

Result: 仿真研究与MetaWorld任务验证了混合参数的作用，表明中间残差组合（非单步/双步极端）在困难场景下能改善值估计。

Conclusion: 混合Bellman残差提供自然的偏差-方差权衡；数据依赖critic核与样本分割有效控制过拟合，中间混合权重在挑战性任务中优于标准一步方法。

Abstract: Evaluating a target policy using data generated by a different behavior policy remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning. While most existing work relies on the standard one-step Bellman residual, we consider a convex combination of one-step and two-step residuals with a fixed mixing weight. In ideal settings, this mixed Bellman formulation can provide a natural bias--variance trade-off between approximation error under a restricted value-function class and the increased variance arising from multi-step importance weighting. To solve this mixed residual optimization, we adopt a minimax formulation involving a critic function. Unlike standard approaches that rely on a fixed functional class, we construct a data-dependent critic representation using predicted future feature directions which effectively induces a kernel adapted to the underlying transition dynamics. This allows the critic to focus on directions that are most relevant for the estimated Bellman error. To control overfitting, we use sample splitting to construct the critic and estimate the value function on separate data subsets. Simulation studies and MetaWorld tasks illustrate the effect of the mixing parameter and show that intermediate residual combinations can improve value estimation in challenging settings.

</details>


### [321] [Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33239)
*Yuling Jiao,Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Jincheng Ying*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SFAC，一种通过条件扩散实现KL正则化策略改进的离线到在线RL方法，用Doob h-变换将优势加权目标表示为对参考扩散漂移的修正，并用配对SNIS估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略能表示多模态动作分布，但优势加权更新未指明如何从所得目标分布中采样。

Method: 用minimax Bellman评论家估计优势函数，定义指数倾斜目标策略；用Doob h-变换将其表达为对参考扩散漂移的修正；推导修正的后验均值表示并用配对自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计；通过对漂移目标做监督回归更新神经演员，无需评论家动作梯度。

Result: 在小更新情形下，KL正则化更新沿自然策略梯度方向，Doob修正表示扩散漂移空间中的相同局部变化；在适当条件下导出有限样本界，分离评论家估计、神经漂移回归、有限样本SNIS、扩散离散化和继承演员误差的影响。合成实验验证对指定优势倾斜目标的逼近精度及对采样预算的敏感性；在六个离线到在线连续控制任务上，参考锚定实现取得高于其离线初始化的最终窗口回报。

Conclusion: SFAC为扩散策略的KL正则化改进提供了有理论保证的实现，能在离线到在线连续控制中超越离线初始化。

Abstract: Diffusion policies represent multimodal action distributions, but an advantage-weighted update does not specify how to sample from the resulting target distribution. We propose Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic (SFAC), an offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) method for Kullback--Leibler (KL)-regularized policy improvement through conditional diffusion. A minimax Bellman critic estimates the advantage function, which defines an exponentially tilted target policy. A Doob $h$-transform expresses this update as a correction to the reference diffusion drift. We derive a posterior-mean representation of the correction and estimate it using paired self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Supervised regression on these drift targets updates the neural actor without critic action gradients. In the small-update regime, the KL-regularized update follows the natural policy-gradient direction, and the Doob correction represents the same local change in the space of diffusion drifts. Under suitable conditions, we derive finite-sample bounds that separate the effects of critic estimation, neural drift regression, finite-sample SNIS, diffusion discretization, and inherited actor error on expected average policy suboptimality. Synthetic experiments assess the accuracy of approximation to prescribed advantage-tilted targets and sensitivity to sampling budgets. On six offline-to-online continuous-control tasks, a reference-anchored implementation achieves higher final-window returns than those of its corresponding offline initialization.

</details>


### [322] [The Statistical Benefits of Multiple Responses for Learning from Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33291)
*Chandramauli Chakraborty,Cong Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究非最优示教者场景下，生成式模型返回多个候选响应（pass@k）对学习样本复杂度的收益，发现收益比最优示教者情形更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作证明在示教最优时，pass@k 能将样本复杂度按 log k 因子降低；但实际示教者往往非最优，作者探究此时多候选响应是否仍有收益以及收益形式。

Method: 在无奖励反馈的有限奖励类模型下，理论分析 pass@1 与 pass@k（k≥2）的最坏情况目标精度依赖；区分标准评估（奖励训练前固定）与鲁棒评估（单一策略需对所有奖励同时竞争示教者）两种设定，并给出匹配的上下界及贪心乘性权重学习器。

Result: 从 pass@1 到 pass@k（k≥2），最坏情况对目标精度 ε 的依赖由 1/ε² 变为 1/ε，且对任意示教质量一致成立；标准评估下对奖励类规模 N 的依赖由 log N 改进为 log N/log k；鲁棒评估下 1/ε 的快速依赖保持，但 1/log k 改进可能消失。

Conclusion: 多候选响应在非最优示教下带来定性更强的样本复杂度收益，两种收益效应可分离；所提出的贪心乘性权重学习器在无示教质量假设下达到上界。

Abstract: Many generative systems return multiple candidate responses and are evaluated according to the best one. Recent work shows that, when demonstrations are optimal, pass@$k$ can reduce the sample complexity of learning from demonstrations by a logarithmic factor in $k$. We ask what happens when the demonstrator is not assumed to be optimal. We find that multiple responses provide a qualitatively stronger benefit in this setting. In a finite reward-class model with no reward feedback, moving from pass@$1$ to any pass@$k$ with $k\ge2$ changes the worst-case dependence on target accuracy from $1/\varepsilon^2$ to $1/\varepsilon$, uniformly over demonstrator quality. Under standard evaluation, where an unknown reward is fixed before training, increasing $k$ provides an additional and distinct benefit: the optimal dependence on a reward class of size $N$ improves from $\log N$ to $\log N/\log k$. We further show that these two effects can be separated. Under robust evaluation, where one learned policy must compete with the demonstrator simultaneously for every reward in the class, the fast $1/\varepsilon$ dependence persists, while the $1/\log k$ improvement can disappear. We establish matching upper and lower bounds in the corresponding regimes and give a greedy multiplicative-weights learner achieving the upper bounds without any assumption on demonstrator quality.

</details>


### [323] [Sharp training-conditional coverage for conformal prediction under covariate shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33456)
*Mehrdad Pournaderi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究加权split conformal prediction在给定校准数据下的条件覆盖，给出显式训练条件界，并揭示速率与卡方散度贡献的内在性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权split conformal prediction能在协变量漂移下保证边际覆盖，但其条件于校准数据的覆盖性质缺乏显式、无未知常数的刻画，也缺少对各方法优劣区域的定量比较。

Method: 基于固定总体分位数处的单一集中不等式给出初等论证，得到显式训练条件界；指出关键尺度是方差代理（由漂移的卡方散度及似然比在测试总体最大部分的均值构成），而非似然比上确界；用两点下界证明根号m速率与卡方贡献的内在性；在显式膨胀水平下运行使加权分位数成为确定性PAC预测集；与随机拒绝采样及重要性加权的learn-then-test比较，并通过认证的似然比裁剪水平刻画各自给出更窄有效集的区域；分析扩展到估计似然比及由无标签源样本估计的尾部泛函。

Result: 得到无未知常数的显式训练条件覆盖界；证明根号m速率和卡方散度贡献是漂移的内在性质；加权分位数在膨胀水平下成为确定性PAC预测集；通过裁剪水平的认证选择，明确各方法给出更窄有效集的参数区域；对估计似然比与尾部泛函给出完全有限样本证书。

Conclusion: 该工作为加权conformal prediction提供了显式、可认证的训练条件分析，解释了覆盖误差由卡方散度而非似然比上确界控制，并刻画了与拒绝采样、learn-then-test等方法相比更优的适用区域。

Abstract: Weighted split conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio between the test and training covariate distributions and guarantees marginal coverage under covariate shift. We study its coverage conditional on the calibration data. An elementary argument, based on a single concentration inequality at a fixed population quantile, gives explicit training-conditional bounds without unspecified constants, and shows that the relevant scale is not the supremum of the likelihood ratio but a variance proxy built from the chi-squared divergence of the shift and from the average of the ratio over the part of the test population, of probability equal to the miscoverage level, where it is largest. A two-point lower bound shows that the root-m rate and the chi-squared contribution are intrinsic to the shift. Run at an explicitly inflated level, the weighted quantile becomes a deterministic PAC prediction set. We compare it with randomized rejection sampling and with importance-weighted learn-then-test and, through a certified choice of a clipping level for the likelihood ratio, map the regime in which each gives the narrower valid set. The analysis extends to estimated likelihood ratios and to tail functionals estimated from an unlabeled source sample, which yields a fully finite-sample certificate.

</details>


### [324] [Domain-Adapted Diffusion Models for Conditional Independence Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33490)
*Yanfeng Yang,Junda Zhao,Yijie Gao,Jiaqi Yang,Xinyu Shi,Ziqi Chen,Shunyu Zhao,Shuai Li,Wei Huang,Eshant English,Kenji Fukumizu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将条件生成建模视为域适应问题，提出 Domain-Adapted Diffusion (DA-Diff) 及基于其的 DA-CIT 条件独立性检验方法，实现渐近 Type I 误差控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于生成模型的条件独立性检验依赖估计的条件分布生成随机样本，但估计误差会累积到 Type I 误差界中，且生成估计器的一致性无法保证渐近 Type I 误差控制。

Method: 将条件生成建模形式化为域适应问题，利用多个源域的辅助数据，提出 DA-Diff——基于目标域与源域加权经验风险最小化的多源域适应条件扩散模型框架；并在其基础上构建 DA-CIT 检验方法。

Result: 建立了 DA-Diff 的收敛速率，证明可迁移源数据通过增大有效样本量提升目标域估计并控制迁移偏差；DA-CIT 的 Type I 误差满足 P(p ≤ α) ≤ α + o(1)。实验显示 DA-Diff 的条件生成质量优于迁移学习扩散基线，DA-CIT 提供强 Type I 误差控制与有竞争力的检验功效。

Conclusion: 通过多源域适应提升条件扩散模型估计精度，可为基于生成模型的条件独立性检验提供理论上的渐近 Type I 误差控制，并兼顾生成质量与检验功效。

Abstract: Conditional independence (CI) is a fundamental concept in statistics and machine learning. Recent advances in conditional generative modeling provide flexible tools for generative-model-based CI tests, which rely on an estimated conditional distribution to generate randomized samples. However, errors in estimating this distribution accumulate in existing Type I error bounds, and consistency of the generative estimator alone does not guarantee asymptotic Type I error control. To address this limitation, we formulate conditional generative modeling as a domain adaptation problem and leverage auxiliary data from multiple source domains to improve estimation in the target CI testing domain. We propose Domain-Adapted Diffusion (DA-Diff), a multi-source domain adaptation framework for conditional diffusion models based on weighted empirical risk minimization over both target and source domains. We establish the convergence rate of DA-Diff and show how transferable source data can improve target-domain estimation through an increased effective sample size while controlling transfer bias. Building on DA-Diff, we further propose Domain-Adapted Conditional Independence Testing (DA-CIT) and show that its Type I error satisfies $P(p \leq α) \leq α+ o(1)$. Experiments demonstrate that DA-Diff improved conditional generation quality compared with transfer-learning diffusion baselines, while DA-CIT provides strong Type I error control and competitive power.

</details>


### [325] [Neural Scaling Laws of Transformer Operator Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33533)
*Haoran Yan,Zhongjie Shi,Yuanzhe Xi,Peng Chen,Wenjing Liao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文构建了基于Transformer的算子学习的理论框架，分析其逼近与泛化误差，揭示了数据规模与预测误差之间的幂律缩放规律，并强调输入函数类的内在维度对收敛速率的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在物理系统算子学习中表现强大，经验上随数据与模型规模增大误差下降，但缺乏针对Transformer算子学习的神经缩放定律的理论理解。

Method: 提出"局部到全局"逼近原则，与softmax注意力机制自然契合，并产生离散化不变的输出函数；据此推导Hölder正则算子的通用逼近误差，并建立数据规模与泛化误差之间的幂律缩放分析。

Result: 得到幂律泛化率，其指数显式反映输入/输出域维度、函数与算子正则性以及输入函数类的内在维度；相比前馈神经网络算子学习中的对数型幂律率，该分析利用内在低维结构获得更好的幂律率；数值实验验证了预测的幂律缩放，并确认收敛速率随内在维度系统性变化。

Conclusion: 为Transformer算子学习提供了逼近与泛化的理论刻画，凸显内在维度在缩放规律中的作用，并以实验验证理论预测。

Abstract: Transformers have emerged as powerful architectures for learning solution operators of physical systems. Empirically the prediction error has been observed to decrease when the data size and model size increase, suggesting neural scaling behavior. Yet a theoretical understanding of such scaling laws for transformer-based operator learning remains limited. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for characterizing the approximation and generalization errors of transformer-based operator learning. Our analysis builds on a local-to-global approximation principle that is naturally aligned with the softmax attention mechanism and yields discretization-invariant output functions. On approximation theory, we derive a universal approximation error of transformer-based operator learning for Hölder-regular operators. On generalization theory, we establish a power scaling law between the prediction error and the training data size. The rate of convergence represented by the scaling exponent explicitly reflects the dimensions of the input and output domains, the regularity of the underlying functions and operators, and crucially, the intrinsic dimension of the input function class. By exploiting this intrinsic low-dimensional structure, our analysis yields a power-law generalization rate for operator learning, in contrast to the logarithmic-type power-law rates appearing in existing analyses of operator learning with feedforward neural networks. Numerical experiments validate the predicted power-law scaling and confirm that the convergence rate varies systematically with the intrinsic dimension of the input function class.

</details>


### [326] [Calibrated Derivative-Process Sensitivity for Gaussian-Process Variable Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33549)
*Jia Cai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出基于学生化乘子bootstrap的GP导数敏感度变量选择方法，实现渐近FDR/FWER控制，修复了null输入下检验过于保守的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARD通过逆长度尺度排序输入，衡量的是函数变化快慢而非输入对预测的贡献，且缺乏校准规则来决定保留哪些输入。导数敏感度ν_j是预测为中心的选择指标，但在null输入下估计量为退化二次型，导致Wald和Bernstein-von Mises截断过于激进（anti-conservative），残差bootstrap也存在尺度错误。

Method: 提出对GP导数过程进行学生化乘子bootstrap（studentized multiplier bootstrap），通过二次型的不变性原理证明其有效性，并获得跨输入的渐近FWER和FDR控制；另提出块平均变体，代价随n线性增长。

Result: 100次重复中，该方法在真正null的输入处控制FDR；未校准的导数排序超出目标达2倍，Bernstein-von Mises截断超出2.2倍；匹配FDR下无损功率；Matérn核与输入相关性高至0.99时仍成立；真实数据中虚假输入减少5-12倍；开销仅为GP拟合的5-18%。

Conclusion: 学生化乘子bootstrap为GP导数敏感度的变量选择提供了校准的推断框架，在保持功率的同时严格控制FDR/FWER，且计算代价低、适用范围广。

Abstract: Automatic relevance determination (ARD), the default tool for variable selection in Gaussian-process (GP) regression, ranks inputs by inverse lengthscales -- which measure how fast a function varies, not how much an input contributes to prediction -- and offers no calibrated rule for deciding which inputs to keep. The prediction-centred alternative, the derivative sensitivity $ν_j = \mathbb{E}[(\partial f/\partial x_j)^2]$, is available in closed form from a fitted GP, but turning it into a selection rule is harder than it looks: at a null input the estimator is a degenerate quadratic form, so Wald and Bernstein-von Mises cutoffs are anti-conservative, and the natural residual bootstrap is mis-scaled. We show that a studentized multiplier bootstrap of the GP derivative process repairs both, prove its validity through an invariance principle for quadratic forms, and obtain asymptotic family-wise and false-discovery-rate control across inputs. Over 100 replications the rule controls FDR wherever inputs are truly null, while uncalibrated derivative rankings breach the target by up to 2x and a Bernstein-von Mises cutoff by 2.2x; at matched FDR it loses no power; it holds under a Matérn kernel and input correlation up to 0.99; on real data with planted and authentic null inputs it admits 5-12x fewer spurious inputs; it costs 5-18% of the GP fit; and a block-averaged variant retains validity at cost linear in $n$.

</details>


### [327] [Sparsity by Default: The Theory and Practice of ARD in Gaussian Process Regression for Variable Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33550)
*Jia Cai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 综述高斯过程回归中自动相关性判定(ARD)的输入选择机制,追溯其贝叶斯奥卡姆剃刀根源,梳理算法、理论并与其他稀疏/收缩方法对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARD是GP回归中输入选择的标准工具,但其机制、理论保证与局限尚需系统性梳理,尤其是在高维选择一致性与plain ARD的开放问题上。

Method: 通过为协方差核的每个输入赋予独立长度尺度,并以最大化边际似然学习这些长度尺度,推导其剪枝输入的梯度,揭示其"有效而非精确"稀疏性;并综述相关算法与实践中的选择规则。

Result: 区分了固定域下长度尺度可辨识性障碍与分层GP先验近期的选择一致性保证,指出plain ARD仍有开放问题;并与spike-and-slab、稀疏轴对齐及全局-局部收缩先验(贝叶斯lasso、horseshoe)、惩罚似然克里金、敏感性/投影准则、可加核等方法进行比较。

Conclusion: ARD因其与核学习的无缝集成、广泛的软件支持与低计算成本而具有持久生命力,但仍存在局限,文中给出了相应补救措施。

Abstract: Automatic relevance determination (ARD) is the standard device for input selection in Gaussian process (GP) regression. By giving the covariance kernel a separate lengthscale for every input and learning those lengthscales by maximizing the marginal likelihood, ARD lets the data decide which coordinates matter: irrelevant inputs receive very large lengthscales and are effectively switched off. We trace this mechanism to the Bayesian Occam's razor embodied in the marginal likelihood, derive the gradient through which it prunes inputs, and emphasize that ARD delivers effective rather than exact sparsity. We review the algorithms used in practice and the rules that turn lengthscales into selections, and we survey the asymptotic theory, distinguishing the fixed-domain identifiability obstruction on the lengthscales from the high-dimensional selection-consistency guarantees recently established for hierarchical GP priors, and noting what remains open for plain ARD. We compare ARD with spike-and-slab priors, sparse axis-aligned and global-local shrinkage priors including the Bayesian lasso and horseshoe, penalized likelihood kriging, sensitivity and projection criteria, and additive kernels. We argue that ARD endures because of its seamless integration with kernel learning, universal software support, and low cost, and we close with its limitations and remedies.

</details>


### [328] [Reliable Replay through Spatial Coherence in Online Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33725)
*Haixiang Sun,Jiefu Zhang,Yinghao He,Yang Xu,Vaneet Aggarwal,Bharat Bhargava,Andrew L. Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SPHERE，一种通用的经验回放分配方法，通过空间相干风险控制改进持续学习中的缓冲区分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续适应新任务需在有限内存和算力下保留旧知识。经验回放虽能应对，但基于单样本损失增幅的优先级忽略了相关记忆对同一更新的响应，易过度强调孤立响应。

Method: SPHERE用表示核聚合带符号的预期损失变化，抑制无支撑的尖峰、保留相干增幅；并将分配建模为熵正则化最优传输，把均匀源质量分配至有支撑的高风险区域，同时惩罚长距离转移。由传输目标对原始损失变化的敏感度导出回放系数，并与均匀回放混合以维持基线排练。

Result: 理论分析给出核聚合改善风险估计的条件，并界定了残余噪声与平滑偏差导致的传输价值膨胀。实验表明在噪声标签视觉任务、持续语言模型指令微调、测试奖励不完整的代码生成强化学习中，SPHERE提升准确率并减少遗忘。

Conclusion: SPHERE是一种通用、可跨多种学习场景应用的回放分配方法，兼顾记忆保留与训练稳定性。

Abstract: Continually adapting models to new tasks requires retaining earlier knowledge under limited memory and computation. Experience replay addresses this challenge, but priorities based on individual loss increases overlook how related memories respond to the same update and can overemphasize isolated responses. We introduce SPatial coHErent risk control for REplay (SPHERE), a general replay-allocation method applicable across a broad range of learning settings. SPHERE uses a representation kernel to aggregate signed prospective loss changes, attenuating unsupported spikes while retaining coherent increases. It then formulates allocation as entropy-regularized transport, redistributing uniform source mass toward supported high-risk regions while penalizing long-distance transfers. We derive replay coefficients from the transport objective's sensitivity to the original loss changes and blend them with uniform replay to maintain baseline rehearsal. Our analysis establishes conditions under which kernel aggregation improves risk estimation and bounds transport-value inflation due to residual noise and smoothing bias. Experiments demonstrate that SPHERE improves accuracy and reduces forgetting across noisy-label vision tasks, continual language-model instruction tuning, and code-generation reinforcement learning with incomplete test rewards.

</details>


### [329] [A Statistical Perspective on Knowledge Distillation: Foundations, Classical Methods, and Large Language Model Extensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33727)
*Luyang Fang,Haoran Lu,Jiazhang Cai,Tao Wang,Huimin Cheng,Wenxuan Zhong,Ping Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文综述了知识蒸馏（KD），提出统一的贝叶斯公式，将教师预测视为先验信息，为KD提供统计视角并与不确定性量化建立联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KD在实践中广泛使用，但常被视为工程技巧，缺乏统一的统计视角。

Method: 提出统一的贝叶斯框架，把教师预测建模为先验信息，用于解释教师信息如何融入学生学习。

Result: 该视角统一了经典蒸馏与现代生成模型、基础模型中的扩展，表明新发展仍根植于相同统计原理。

Conclusion: 综合理论与新兴方法及应用，为该领域提供概念路线图并指出关键开放问题。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has emerged as a vital paradigm for transferring the capabilities of high-capacity models to efficient ``student'' counterparts, addressing critical challenges in computational cost, deployment constraints, and privacy-sensitive settings. Although KD is widely used in practice, it is often viewed primarily as an engineering technique, with a unified statistical perspective remaining less developed. This review bridges that gap by presenting a unified Bayesian formulation of KD that formulates teacher predictions as prior information. This provides a principled interpretation of how teacher information is incorporated into student learning and establishes a rigorous connection to uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate how this foundational lens reconciles classical distillation with modern extensions in generative and foundation-model systems, showing that contemporary developments remain rooted in these same statistical principles. By synthesizing theory with emerging methodologies and diverse applications, this review provides a conceptual roadmap and identifies critical open problems for the future of the field.

</details>


### [330] [Weighted Spline-Expanded Networks with Distributional Balancing for Continuous Treatment Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33740)
*Shucheng Liu,Chan Park,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出WSENet，一种端到端神经网络框架，用于在观察性研究中估计连续处理变量的因果效应，结合协变量平衡、结构化处理嵌入与偏差校正结果估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察性研究中估计连续处理变量的因果效应面临混杂、模型设定错误及高维协变量等挑战，现有方法难以兼顾灵活性与稳健性。

Method: WSENet包含三部分：1）距离协变量最优权重（Distance Covariate Optimal Weights），无需参数模型即可诱导协变量与处理的分布独立性；2）结构化网络融合协变量的结果相关表示与样条扩展的处理输入，实现平滑灵活的剂量-反应建模；3）加权目标正则化（Weighted Targeted Regularization），基于有效影响函数进行偏差校正，得到双稳健估计量。

Result: 在半合成与真实世界数据集（含高维基因组及环境健康数据）上，WSENet在准确性与稳定性上均持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: WSENet通过整合协变量平衡、结构化处理嵌入与影响函数偏差校正，有效应对连续处理因果推断中的混杂、模型误设与高维问题，具备良好的精度与稳健性。

Abstract: Estimating causal effects with continuous treatments in observational studies is challenging due to confounding, model misspecification, and high-dimensional covariates. We propose the Weighted Spline-Expanded Network (WSENet), an end-to-end neural framework that addresses these challenges by combining covariate balancing, structured treatment embedding, and bias-corrected outcome estimation. WSENet first applies Distance Covariate Optimal Weights to induce distributional independence between covariates and treatment without relying on parametric models. It then learns the conditional outcome via a structured network that fuses outcome-relevant representations of covariates with a spline-expanded treatment input, enabling smooth and flexible modeling of the dose-response relationship. To mitigate residual bias, we introduce Weighted Targeted Regularization, a correction technique based on efficient influence functions that yields a doubly robust estimator. Extensive evaluations on semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, including high-dimensional genomic and environmental health data, demonstrate that WSENet consistently outperforms existing baselines in both accuracy and stability.

</details>


### [331] [Multi-Marginal Inverse Optimal Transport for Contrastive Learning Via Explicit Anchor-Positive-Negative Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33741)
*Ngoc-Hai Nguyen,Thuan Nguyen,Prakash Ishwar,Shuchin Aeron*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出Neg-MMIOT-CL，一种利用负样本对的多边缘逆最优传输对比学习方法，缓解维数崩溃并证明其表征具有等角/神经崩溃性质，并给出高效替代Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于逆最优传输(IOT)的表征学习方法只让全局OT耦合集中于正样本对，未利用负样本对，因此并非真正的对比学习，会导致维数崩溃和下游性能下降。

Method: 提出多边缘逆OT对比学习Neg-MMIOT-CL：设计三元组(锚点-正-负)的ground cost，使全局多边缘OT(MMOT)耦合集中于正负三元组；并对其高效替代版本Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull进行实现。

Result: 在潜在类别模型下实证Neg-MMIOT-CL缓解维数崩溃；对特定ground cost证明其最优表征在类内/类间呈等角性质，并在表征维度大于类别数减一时出现神经崩溃，首次将该结论从成对对比学习推广到此框架；在合成与真实数据上显著优于现有OT对比学习方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入负样本对与多边缘逆OT，可构建真正对比的表征学习，既缓解维数崩溃又具备理论保证，且所提高效变体使之实用。

Abstract: Inverse Optimal Transport (OT) based methods for representation learning learn representations such that the global OT coupling between a pair of data marginals in the representation space, concentrates on the positive pairs. This is in contrast to previous methods that primarily focused on pairwise matching. However, these methods $\textit{DO NOT}$ utilize negative pairs and hence are not truly contrastive in their approach. We show that this leads to issues of dimensional collapse and hence degraded downstream performance. To alleviate this, we develop a novel multi-marginal (MM) inverse OT (IOT) contrastive learning (CL) approach called Neg-MMIOT-CL, which learns representations such that the global multi-marginal OT (MMOT) coupling between a triple of data marginals, with respect to a carefully designed ground-cost between triplets of data points in the representation space, concentrates on the anchor-positive-negative $\textit{triplets}$. For a latent class model, we empirically show that Neg-MMIOT-CL alleviates dimensional collapse. Furthermore, for a specific choice of ground cost for all triplets in representation space, we prove that the optimal representation configuration for Neg-MMIOT-CL exhibits equiangular property for within-class and across-class representations, which translates to Neural-Collapse when the representation dimension is larger than the number of classes minus one -- a result that is $\textit{previously established only}$ for pairwise contrastive learning methods. Finally, we propose Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull, that is a computationally efficient alternative to Neg-MMIOT-CL, alleviating the high cost of computing MMOT plans needed during implementation. We apply these methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets and show significant improvements over existing OT-based contrastive learning methods.

</details>


### [332] [An Active-Bottleneck Mechanism for Weak-to-Strong Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33835)
*Mohammad Zeinalpour,Amir Najafi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究弱到强泛化(W2SG)何时发生，在完全收敛、无岭回归的两阶段学习中，无需早停、显式正则化或学生模型更强表达力的假设，揭示了有限数据与有限宽度本身可作为隐式正则化机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱到强泛化现象（学生在教师预测上训练后超越教师）的成功条件尚不清晰。作者希望在无早停、无显式正则化、且不假设学生表达力更强的严格设定下，厘清其发生机制。

Method: 采用两阶段线性回归：教师用n个有标注样本拟合，学生在m个新无标注输入的教师预测上训练，两者共享假设类与训练规则；进一步研究学生特征数严格多于教师的随机特征模型，并通过功率律协方差推导闭式阈值。

Result: 线性回归中学生仅在m处于显式中间区间时超越教师；功率律协方差下该区间有闭式解，且存在改善区域分裂为两个不相交区间的情形。随机特征模型存在两种区域：改善仅在m有界区间内，或学生宽度N_S超过阈值时发生，二者由"主动瓶颈"原则统一支配。

Conclusion: 有限数据与有限宽度本身即可对两阶段学习器起正则化作用，无需任何显式机制；"主动瓶颈"原则指出m与N_S中更稀缺者决定过滤教师误差的程度。

Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization (W2SG) occurs when a student trained on a teacher's predictions outperforms that teacher. We study when this happens under fully converged, ridgeless two-stage learning, with no early stopping, no explicit regularization, and no assumption that the student is more expressive than the teacher. In two-stage linear regression, a teacher is fit from $n$ labeled examples and a student is trained solely on the teacher's predictions on $m$ fresh, unlabeled inputs. Although both stages share the same hypothesis class and the same training rule, we show that the student outperforms the teacher exactly when $m$ lies in an explicit intermediate range: too few pseudo-labels leave the student without enough signal, too many let it inherit the teacher's noise. Under power-law covariance, we derive this range in closed form as a function of the spectral decay and noise level, including regimes where the improving region splits into two disjoint intervals of $m$. We then study a random-feature model in which the student has strictly more features than the teacher, and identify two regimes, again given by explicit thresholds: one where improvement occurs only for $m$ in a bounded interval, and one where it occurs only once the student width $N_S$ exceeds an explicit threshold. Both regimes are governed by a single "active-bottleneck" principle: whichever of $m$ or $N_S$ is scarcer controls how much teacher error is filtered out, while increasing the other resource only reduces estimation noise. Together, these results show that finite data and finite width can themselves regularize a two-stage learner, with no explicit mechanism doing so.

</details>


### [333] [Two-Sample Testing for Inhomogeneous Random Graphs in Non-Integral $L_r$ Norms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33968)
*Soham Dan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了非整数 r>2 时 IER 模型两样本网络检验的样本复杂度下界猜想，提出组合 L_2 与 L_{⌈r⌉} 统计量的检验，证明其达到猜想速率 n^{max{4/r-1,2/r}}/ε^2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 IER 模型下，对每个整数 L_r 范数及 1≤r<2 已有最优样本复杂度，但非整数 r>2 的上下界不匹配，下界被猜想为紧。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 针对对齐顶点的两样本检验，提出在同一数据上运行两个已发表的统计量（阶数 2 和 ⌈r⌉），若任一拒绝则拒绝；阈值通过 Hölder 插值确定，使两统计量具有相同样本代价。

Result: 证明该检验达到猜想速率，结合已有结果得出对每个固定 r≥1，极小极大样本复杂度为 n^{max{4/r-1,2/r}}/ε^2。模拟中 n 从 32 到 256，80% 功效所需图数量增长率与理论一致，如 r=2.5 时拟合指数 0.78 接近理论 0.8。

Conclusion: 两个统计量按插值论证分工：少量边变化时高阶统计量更强，大量边变化时 L_2 统计量更强；理论猜想得到证实。

Abstract: Testing whether two populations of networks share the same edge probabilities is a basic problem in network inference. How hard it is depends on the norm used to measure the difference. For the inhomogeneous Erdős--Rényi (IER) model, the optimal sample complexity is known for every integer $L_r$ norm and for $1\le r<2$. For non-integral $r>2$, however, the known upper and lower bounds do not match, and the lower bound was conjectured to be tight. We study this gap for two-sample testing on aligned vertices. We propose a test that runs two published statistics, of orders $2$ and $\lceil r\rceil$, on the same data and rejects if either one rejects. Its thresholds come from Hölder interpolation, so that both statistics have the same sample cost. We prove that this test attains the conjectured rate. Combined with earlier results, this shows that for every fixed $r\ge1$ the minimax sample complexity is of order $n^{\max\{4/r-1,\,2/r\}}/ε^2$, even when the separation changes with $n$. In simulations with $n$ between 32 and 256, the number of graphs needed for 80\% power at level $0.05$ grows with $n$ at a rate consistent with the theory. For $r=2.5$, for example, the fitted exponent is $0.78$, against the theoretical value $0.8$. Interestingly, the two statistics split the work as the interpolation argument suggests: the higher-order statistic is more powerful when only a few edges change, and the $L_2$ statistic when many edges change.

</details>


### [334] [HARMONIA: Interpretable Graph Learning through Mixtures of Neural Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33972)
*Quan D. Bui,Nguyen Do,An Nguyen Dang,Huyen Nguyen,Nhu Duc Minh Nguyen,My T. Thai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HARMONIA是一个可解释的图加性模型框架，通过特征侧的"神经基混合"(MoNB)与结构侧的"稀疏RRWP聚合"(SRA)解决既有方法在可扩展性与建模灵活性上的不足，实现忠实、可扩展且预测有效的图学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释图加性模型在计算可扩展性或建模灵活性上存在局限：结构建模方面要么是二次方扩展成本，要么牺牲显式的源-目标贡献分解；特征建模方面要么依赖逐特征神经网络，要么只用单一共享基导致特征特化不足。

Method: 提出可解释设计框架HARMONIA。特征建模引入Mixture of Neural Bases (MoNB)，将特征路由到专门的基专家，在参数共享的同时保留特征特化；结构建模使用Relative Random Walk Probabilities (RRWP)捕捉多跳、多路径关系，并提出Sparse RRWP Aggregation (SRA)，通过稀疏图传播计算交互，避免二次方成对复杂度。整体保持简单加性形式，预测分解为被结构影响调制的特征响应。

Result: 相比现有可解释图基线，HARMONIA取得更强的解释恢复能力，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能，并可扩展到数百万节点的图。

Conclusion: 结果表明可解释图学习能够在不牺牲预测效果的前提下兼具忠实性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Existing interpretable graph additive models still face limitations in either computational scalability or modeling flexibility. In terms of structural modeling, previous approaches either face quadratic scaling costs or sacrifice explicit source-to-target contribution decomposition. In terms of feature components, they rely either on per-feature neural networks or on single shared bases with limited feature specialization. We address both problems by introducing HARMONIA: Interpretable Graph Learning through Mixtures of Neural Bases, an interpretable-by-design framework. For feature modeling, HARMONIA introduces a Mixture of Neural Bases (MoNB), which routes features to specialized basis experts, enabling parameter sharing without sacrificing feature-specific specialization. For structural modeling, HARMONIA uses Relative Random Walk Probabilities (RRWP) to capture multi-hop and multi-path relationships, and proposes Sparse RRWP Aggregation (SRA) to compute these interactions through sparse graph propagation without quadratic pairwise complexity. HARMONIA retains a simple additive form in which predictions decompose into feature responses modulated by structural influence. Empirically, HARMONIA achieves stronger explanation recovery than existing interpretable graph baselines while maintaining competitive predictive performance and scaling to graphs with millions of nodes. These results show that interpretable graph learning can remain both faithful and scalable without sacrificing predictive effectiveness.

</details>


### [335] [Singularities of Non-negative Matrix Factorization and their application to Bayesian inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34043)
*Naoki Hayashi,Yota Maeda,Yasushi Esaki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究非负矩阵分解(NMF)的贝叶斯渐近性，推导其实对数规范阈值(RLCT)的上界与精确值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NMF是奇异统计模型，其贝叶斯渐近由RLCT决定，而NMF的RLCT此前缺乏精确刻画，需要改进已有上界。

Method: 分析分解映射的局部几何，使用局部解析正规形，将独立线性坐标与残差矩阵乘积分离。

Result: 在真矩阵内部严格正分解假设下，证明λ≤{(H-H0)min(M,N)+H0(M+N-H0)}/2，当H0≥3时严格改进已有界；当H=H0且等于普通秩时，得到精确值λ=H0(M+N-H0)/2。

Conclusion: 该结果在奇异学习理论标准假设下，界定了贝叶斯泛化误差与自由能的首项系数。

Abstract: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a singular statistical model whose Bayesian asymptotics are governed by the real log canonical threshold (RLCT). We study the local geometry of the factorization map and derive an upper bound for the RLCT of NMF. Let $H$ be the model inner dimension and $H_0$ the non-negative rank of the true $M\times N$ matrix. Assuming that the true matrix admits a strictly positive factorization of inner dimension $H_0$ in the interior of the parameter domain, we prove, for smooth positive priors, that $λ\leq \{(H-H_0)\min(M,N)+H_0(M+N-H_0)\}/2$. This bound strictly improves the previous bound when $H_0\geq3$. The proof uses a local analytic normal form that separates independent linear coordinates from a residual matrix product. When $H=H_0$ also equals the ordinary rank of the true matrix, we obtain the exact value $λ=H_0(M+N-H_0)/2$. Under the standard assumptions of singular learning theory, these results bound the leading coefficients of the expected Bayesian generalization error and the Bayesian free energy.

</details>


### [336] [The Statistical Cost of Causal Discovery with Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34050)
*Sunmin Oh,Seungsu Han,Gunwoong Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文首次为循环线性非高斯因果模型中的精确凝聚恢复（识别强连通分量划分及分量间所有边）建立了样本复杂度的信息论下界，并提出达到结构匹配样本界的 BlockExo 算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环因果结构的样本代价由什么决定尚不清楚，缺乏对精确凝聚恢复任务的信息论下界，也缺少样本高效且不需预知结构参数的实用算法。

Method: 针对循环线性非高斯模型，刻画样本复杂度下界，区分 SCC 归属与外部父节点选择的代价；在主可逆性且不假设相关忠实性的条件下，提出总体块外生性原则，通过残差独立性与包含极小性识别未知根 SCC；给出稀疏调整刻画，证明小调整集即可识别 SCC 及其直接外部父节点，无需对所有已恢复变量回归；据此设计 BlockExo 算法。

Result: 对 p 个变量、最大 SCC 规模 s_max、最大外部父节点数 d_B，任意估计器在最坏情况下至少需要约 s_max log(ep/s_max) + d_B log(ep/d_B) 个样本；BlockExo 在合适条件下无需已知 s_max 或 d_B 即可达到结构匹配的样本界；仿真验证了样本界的结构依赖性及 BlockExo 相比其他循环因果发现方法的样本效率。

Conclusion: 精确凝聚恢复的样本代价由 SCC 归属与外部父节点选择两部分构成，且存在匹配该下界的样本高效算法，可在未知结构参数下实现高效循环因果发现。

Abstract: What determines the unavoidable sample cost of learning cyclic causal structure? For cyclic linear non-Gaussian models, we study exact condensation recovery from observational data: identifying the strongly connected component (SCC) partition and all edges between components. We establish the first information-theoretic lower bounds on sample complexity for this target. For $p$ variables, maximum SCC size $s_{\max}$, and maximum external-parent count $d_B$, any estimator requires order $s_{\max}\log(ep/s_{\max})+d_B\log(ep/d_B)$ samples in the worst case over a regular model class. These bounds distinguish the costs of SCC membership and external-parent selection. Under principal invertibility and without correlation faithfulness, we establish a population block-exogeneity principle that identifies unknown root SCCs through residual independence and inclusion minimality. A sparse-adjustment characterization shows that small adjustment sets suffice to identify SCCs and their direct external parents, without regressing on all previously recovered variables. These characterizations yield BlockExo, which attains a structurally matching sample bound without knowing $s_{\max}$ or $d_B$ under suitable conditions. Simulations support the structural dependence of our sample bound and demonstrate BlockExo's sample-efficient recovery in comparisons with other methods for cyclic causal discovery.

</details>


### [337] [GT-PSSM: Unified Probabilistic Framework for Stochastic Dynamics Modeling and Dependency Learning in Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34161)
*Wonmo Koo,Jaeyeong Lee,Taeseong Yoon,Heeyoung Kim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出GT-PSSM，将概率状态空间模型与Graph Transformer结合，统一建模随机性、长程时序依赖和变量间依赖，提升多元时间序列异常检测鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多元时间序列异常检测多依赖确定性模型和逐点误差打分，而真实数据因测量噪声和系统内在随机性本质上是随机的，大误差可能来自正常波动而非异常，导致误报。概率方法（尤其PSSM）能通过隐状态转移和发射模型量化不确定性，但现有PSSM方法多用对噪声敏感的循环结构，缺乏显式跨变量建模，难以捕捉长程时序和变量间依赖。

Method: 提出Graph-Transformer-Enhanced Probabilistic State-Space Model (GT-PSSM)。在统一概率框架下，紧密集成PSSM对随机动态的概率建模与Graph Transformer对时序及变量间依赖的学习，联合建模随机性、长程时序依赖和变量交互。

Result: （摘要未给出具体实验结果或数据集指标）

Conclusion: GT-PSSM通过统一概率框架融合随机动态建模与图Transformer的依赖学习，实现更鲁棒的多元时间序列异常检测。

Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTAD) is crucial for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of complex systems. Many existing methods learn normal patterns by training reconstruction or forecasting models on predominantly normal data. However, a large portion of these approaches rely on deterministic models and their associated point-wise output errors for anomaly scoring. Since real-world multivariate time series are inherently stochastic due to measurement noise and intrinsic system randomness, purely error-based scores can be unreliable, as large errors may arise from benign fluctuations rather than true anomalies. Probabilistic approaches address this limitation by quantifying uncertainty in model outputs. In particular, probabilistic state-space models (PSSMs) provide a principled framework by modeling stochastic system dynamics through latent state transitions and measurement noise via emission models. Despite this advantage, existing PSSM-based MTAD methods often struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies and inter-variable dependencies, as they typically rely on noise-sensitive recurrent architectures and lack explicit cross-variable structure modeling. To address these limitations, we propose Graph-Transformer-Enhanced Probabilistic State-Space Model (GT-PSSM), a novel PSSM-based MTAD method that tightly integrates PSSM-based probabilistic modeling of stochastic dynamics with Graph Transformer-based learning of temporal and inter-variable dependencies. By jointly modeling stochasticity, long-range temporal dependence, and variable interactions within a unified probabilistic framework, GT-PSSM enables more robust anomaly detection.

</details>


### [338] [AlphaPareto: Formulaic Alpha Discovery with LLM-Guided Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34188)
*Yingbo Zhao,Zeyu Yang,Zhoufan Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出AlphaPareto，用LLM编码alpha池解决MDP非平稳性，并用多目标向量奖励（预测力、时序稳定性、鲁棒性、多样性）通过Pareto正则学习发现公式化alpha，效果优于同类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公式化alpha发现中，现有强化学习方法存在两个问题：一是alpha池演化导致奖励函数变化，MDP本质非平稳；二是大多只优化单一目标（如预测力），忽略了优质alpha池的其他重要性质。

Method: AlphaPareto：1) 状态增强，包含正在构建的alpha和当前alpha池，并用大语言模型(LLM)编码alpha池，使agent适应演化中的搜索环境；2) 将标量奖励替换为多目标向量奖励，同时涵盖预测力、时序稳定性、扰动鲁棒性和多样性，并通过Pareto正则化学习过程优化这些目标。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，AlphaPareto优于其竞争对手。

Conclusion: 通过LLM编码alpha池应对MDP非平稳性并引入Pareto多目标优化，AlphaPareto有效提升了公式化alpha发现的质量和综合性能。

Abstract: Formulaic alpha discovery is a core challenge in quantitative trading, as identifying alphas that work well together remains difficult. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods formulate this task as a Markov decision process (MDP), but two important issues remain unresolved. First, as the alpha pool evolves, the reward function changes accordingly, making the MDP inherently non-stationary. Second, most existing methods optimize a single objective, typically predictive power, while ignoring other important properties of a high-quality alpha pool. Motivated by these challenges, we propose AlphaPareto, an RL method for formulaic alpha discovery. To address non-stationarity, AlphaPareto augments the state to include both the alpha under construction and the current alpha pool, and applies a large language model (LLM) to encode the pool. This design allows the agent to adapt to the evolving search environment. To overcome the limitation of single-objective reward design, AlphaPareto replaces the scalar reward with a multi-objective vector-valued reward that simultaneously captures predictive power, temporal stability, perturbation robustness, and diversity, and optimizes these objectives through a Pareto-regularized learning procedure. Empirical applications to real-world datasets show that our AlphaPareto method outperforms its competitors.

</details>


### [339] [Functional Autoencoders for Amplitude-Phase Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34207)
*Peida Wu,Xinyang Xiong,Pengcheng Zeng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出AP-FAE无监督框架，将潜空间分解为幅值与相位嵌入，处理单变量及多元函数数据的相位变化，兼顾非线性幅值变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数数据本质无穷维且常含相位变化（事件时间错位）。现有线性降维难以应对非线性幅值变化，而无显式warp的函数自编码器会将时间错位与形状纠缠在一起。

Method: AP-FAE从所有通道提取幅值与相位嵌入，用平滑函数解码器在规范时间重建各通道幅值函数，并用共享的单调、端点保持warp捕捉相位变化；理论上证明幅值恢复与配准、重建、噪声误差的界并数值验证。

Result: 在合成数据与六个真实基准上，AP-FAE在多数聚类与对齐指标及全部重建指标上优于SOTA基线；仅用幅值嵌入聚类始终优于联合幅值-相位聚类。

Conclusion: 显式解耦幅值与相位有助提升聚类与重建性能，验证了框架有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Functional data are intrinsically infinite-dimensional, and often exhibit phase variation, where corresponding events occur at different times across observations. Existing linear dimension reduction methods struggle with nonlinear amplitude variation, while functional autoencoders without an explicit warp entangle temporal misalignment with shape. We propose the Amplitude--Phase Functional Autoencoders (AP-FAE), an unsupervised framework for functional data that spans both univariate and multivariate cases, with emphasis on the multivariate setting, and factorizes the latent space into separate amplitude and phase embeddings derived from all channels. A smooth functional decoder reconstructs channel-specific amplitude functions in canonical time, and a shared monotone, endpoint-preserving warp captures phase variation. We prove a bound linking amplitude recovery to registration, reconstruction, and noise errors, and validate it numerically. Across synthetic data and six real-world benchmarks, AP-FAE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on most clustering and alignment metrics and on all reconstruction metrics. Clustering with amplitude embeddings alone consistently surpasses joint amplitude--phase clustering, confirming the benefit of explicit disentanglement. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/APFAE-418C/}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/APFAE-418C/.

</details>


### [340] [Understanding Generalization Requires Universal Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34458)
*Aram Ebtekar,Marcus Hutter,Danica J. Sutherland*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 经典统计学无法解释通用AI的成功，因NFL定理要求任何学习者都需引入外部归纳偏置。文章将Solomonoff归纳法相对化到"信息视角"，主张偏好相对于视角的可达性而非绝对简单性，并论证算法信息论是解释AI泛化的唯一已知答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用AI的成功无法用经典统计理论解释。NFL定理表明，任何在某环境上超越随机猜测的学习器必然在其他环境上表现不佳，且该结论对元学习同样成立。因此任何有意义的预测方法都必须始于一个数据之外的归纳偏置。作者希望为"元NFL"找到一个有原则的解答，从而解释现代AI系统的泛化行为。

Method: 选择偏向短程序可得到Solomonoff归纳法(SI)，其在所有可计算学习器间具竞争力，但对比利用背景信息的专用方法时"常数"会变大。作者因此将SI相对化到一个信息视角：偏向带有全部既有信息访问权的短程序。这一重构把归纳偏置从追求绝对简单性转为偏好相对于观察视角的可达性，并据此分析算法能否超越相对化SI。

Result: 一个算法只有在其代码包含关于数据的额外信息时，才能超越相对化SI的预测能力，而没有算法能自行生成此类信息。SI虽不可计算，因此不是实用算法，但它提供了无限计算极限下推断的形式化最优解，且有证据表明前沿AI系统大致近似它。

Conclusion: 元NFL的唯一已知解答植根于算法信息论，因此应预期算法信息论在解释现代及未来AI系统的泛化行为中扮演根本性角色。

Abstract: Classical statistical theory is insufficient to explain the successes of general-purpose AI models, because it depends on handcrafted inductive biases that it cannot justify. No Free Lunch (NFL) theorems force any learner that beats chance on some environments to underperform on others. We might hope that past experience informs which environments to expect, but NFL applies equally to meta-learning. Thus, any method that makes meaningful predictions necessarily begins with an inductive bias external to the data. Choosing to bias toward short programs yields Solomonoff induction (SI), whose performance is competitive against all computable learners - albeit up to "constants" that become large when comparing against specialized methods that exploit background information. We therefore relativize SI to an information vantage point, biasing toward short programs with access to all preexisting information. This reframes the inductive bias: instead of seeking some absolute notion of simplicity, we favor accessibility with respect to our vantage point. An algorithm can only outpredict the relativized SI to the extent that its code contains additional information about the data, and no algorithm can generate such information. While SI is incomputable and hence not a practical algorithm, it provides a formal optimum for inference in the limit of infinite compute, and there is evidence to suggest that frontier AI systems roughly approximate it. Thus, the only known answer to meta-NFL is rooted in algorithmic information theory, which we should expect to play a fundamental role in explaining the generalization behavior of modern (and future) AI systems.

</details>


### [341] [Probabilistic Geodesic Flow Matching on Location-Scale Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34613)
*Zeyuan Yu,Zhi Chang,Shiwei Lan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将流匹配（FM）推广到位置-尺度族，提出在概率分布流形上的测地线路径（概率测地线流匹配），以更好处理非均匀复杂数据，实验证明其性能优于或可比于SOTA几何生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FM方法主要依赖高斯分布间的最优传输（OT）导出的概率路径，对具有重尾、锐利对比等非均匀结构的复杂数据建模能力有限，可能并非概率空间中的最优路径。

Method: 将FM推广至更广泛的位置-尺度族，并引入定义在概率分布流形上的测地线构成的新型概率路径，称为概率测地线流匹配（区别于输入空间中的黎曼测地线FM）。

Result: 在合成基准与不同规模的科学数据集上，该方法更有效地捕捉复杂分布，性能优于或可比于当前几何动机的SOTA生成模型。

Conclusion: 欧氏OT路径在概率空间中未必最优，会限制建模灵活性；在分布流形上采用测地线路径可更灵活地建模非均匀数据。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) has recently emerged as a promising framework for generative modeling due to its conceptual simplicity and strong empirical performance. In FM, samples are transported along a vector field parameterized by a neural network, inducing a probability path that evolves from a simple noise distribution to the target data distribution, governed by an ordinary differential equation (ODE). However, existing FM approaches predominantly rely on probability paths derived from optimal transport (OT) between Gaussian distributions, which may be suboptimal for capturing complex data with inhomogeneous structures such as heavy tail or sharp contrast. In this work, we generalize FM to the broader class of location-scale families for handling data inhomogeneity and introduce a novel class of probability paths defined as geodesics on the manifold of probability distributions. We name this approach probabilistic geodesic flow matching to distinguish it from prior geodesic (Riemannian) FM methods defined in input space. We argue that Euclidean OT-based paths are not necessarily optimal in probability space and may limit modeling flexibility. Through synthetic benchmarks and scientific datasets at different scales, we demonstrate that the proposed method more effectively captures complex distributions, leading to improved or comparable performance compared with SOTA geometry-motivated generative models.

</details>


### [342] [Two-Timescale Fine-tuning Provably Learns New Features for Two-Layer ReLU Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34667)
*Etienne Boursier,Nicolas Flammarion*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出高斯多指标设定，研究两层ReLU网络微调的理论机制，证明两时间尺度训练能学习新特征并保留预训练特征，仅需O(d)样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调在数据稀缺的专化任务上广泛成功，但其理论基础仍不清楚，缺乏对预训练为何带来统计优势的解释。

Method: 引入高斯多指标设定：教师网络含m+1个特征，其中m个在预训练中学得，1个需在微调中学得。对两层ReLU网络分析两时间尺度训练（外层权重更新速度无限快于隐藏层）。

Result: 两时间尺度训练能学习新任务特征并保留预训练特征；仅需O(d)个微调样本即可恢复，且与预训练特征数无关。相比之下，随机初始化下同样样本量不足以恢复目标参数。

Conclusion: 预训练可诱导隐式偏置，相比随机初始化具有明显统计优势，使稀缺微调数据下也能实现特征学习。

Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained models on specialized tasks with scarce data is central to modern deep learning. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of fine-tuning remains limited. We introduce a Gaussian multi-index setting to study fine-tuning from pre-trained weights, where the teacher network has $m+1$ features, $m$ of which are learned during pre-training and one of which must be learned during fine-tuning. For two-layer ReLU networks, we show that two-timescale training, i.e., updating the outer weights infinitely faster than the hidden ones, learns the new task-specific feature while preserving the pre-trained ones in the model representation. Moreover, only $\mathcal{O}(d)$ fine-tuning samples are required for this recovery, independently of the number of pre-trained features. In contrast, with random initialization, the same number of samples is insufficient to recover the target parameters. Our results therefore demonstrate that pre-training can induce an implicit bias with a clear statistical advantage over random initialization, enabling feature learning from scarce fine-tuning data.

</details>


### [343] [Information-Theoretic Analysis of Next-Token Prediction under Markovian Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34731)
*Masoud Kavian,Abdellatif Zaidi,Milad Sefidgaran*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个信息论框架，研究时间依赖数据下下一词预测的泛化问题，区分算法依赖（互信息）与时间依赖（混合性），给出交叉熵和基于间隔的泛化界，并用实验验证上下文长度对泛化差距的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有泛化理论多假设数据独立同分布，难以刻画下一词预测中由有限记忆马尔可夫过程产生的时序依赖数据，需区分算法依赖与时间依赖对泛化的不同影响。

Method: 采用有限记忆马尔可夫过程生成独立轨迹；利用Donsker–Varadhan变分表示与马尔可夫链McDiarmid型集中不等式推导期望泛化界；通过历史状态过程的混合性刻画上下文长度与时间混合的联合效应；引入率失真框架，用最小信息率替代互信息；对线性与自注意力预测器通过噪声低维压缩推导显式界。

Result: 得到交叉熵的期望泛化界及其率失真扩展，可覆盖连续假设空间上的确定性算法；给出线性与自注意力下一词预测器的显式基于间隔界，揭示上下文长度、模型复杂度、样本量、间隔和时间混合的作用；TinyStories和ETTh2实验显示更长上下文更多降低训练损失，从而扩大泛化差距，ETTh2有效预测记忆尺度约为24小时。

Conclusion: 该框架统一刻画算法依赖与时间依赖，为时序数据下一词预测提供可解释的泛化保证，并解释了上下文增大时测试性能饱和的现象。

Abstract: We develop an information-theoretic framework for generalization in next-token prediction under temporally dependent data. We consider independent trajectories generated by finite-memory Markov processes and distinguish algorithmic dependence, quantified by mutual information, from temporal dependence, characterized by mixing. For cross-entropy loss, we derive an expected generalization bound using the Donsker--Varadhan variational representation and a McDiarmid-type concentration inequality for Markov chains. A refinement captures the joint effect of context length and temporal mixing through the mixing properties of the history-state process. We then extend the bound through a rate--distortion formulation, replacing mutual information with the minimum information rate required to represent the learned model within a prescribed distortion in the generalization gap, yielding informative guarantees for deterministic algorithms over continuous hypothesis spaces. For margin-based prediction, we derive explicit bounds for linear and self-attention next-token predictors via noisy low-dimensional compression, revealing the roles of context length, model complexity, sample size, margin, and temporal mixing. Experiments on TinyStories and ETTh2 show that longer contexts can reduce both training and test losses, but typically reduce training loss more, enlarging the generalization gap. A complementary ETTh2 analysis identifies an effective predictive-memory scale near 24 hours, with no statistically supported improvement beyond this scale, offering a plausible explanation for test-performance saturation at larger contexts.

</details>


### [344] [Statistical Benefits of Fine-Tuning from Pretrained Initialization in Diagonal Linear Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34756)
*Alexandre Declèves,Etienne Boursier,Nicolas Flammarion*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从稀疏线性回归与两层对角线性网络的视角，理论分析了微调如何利用预训练权重中的支持(及符号)信息，并证明其可降低下游任务所需样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调预训练模型虽在实践中广泛成功，但其如何从预训练中获益的理论理解仍然不足，尤其缺乏对样本复杂度影响的刻画。

Method: 在稀疏线性回归和两层对角线性网络设定下，将预训练信息建模为初始化预测器的支持与符号，分析其对隐式偏差和训练动态的重塑作用，并与显式利用预训练支持的加权Lasso估计器进行样本量对比。

Result: 对于符号正确继承的干净初始化，恢复目标参数与支持所需的样本量与精心选择正则化器的加权Lasso估计器相当。

Conclusion: 预训练权重中编码的信息可被基于梯度的微调隐式利用，从而减少恢复下游任务所需的数据量。

Abstract: Adapting pretrained models to downstream tasks with limited data has become a central paradigm in modern deep learning. Yet, despite its widespread practical success, how fine-tuning leverages information from pretraining remains poorly understood theoretically. We study fine-tuning from pretrained weights through the lens of sparse linear regression and two-layer diagonal linear networks. In our setting, pretraining provides information through the support (and signs) of the initialization predictor, which may contain coordinates relevant to the downstream task. We show how pretrained information reshapes the implicit bias and training dynamics, and can thereby reduce the sample complexity of recovering the target parameters and support. In particular, for a clean initialization with correctly inherited signs, we show that the required sample size is comparable to that of a weighted Lasso estimator that explicitly exploits the pretrained support through a suitably chosen regularizer. Our results thus show how information encoded in pretrained weights can be implicitly exploited by gradient-based fine-tuning, reducing the amount of data needed to recover a downstream task.

</details>


### [345] [Conformal Prediction and Conditional Coverage for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34887)
*Sungwoo Park,Sunghee Park,Won Chang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出轻量级方法C-USIM，为表格基础模型（TFM）回归预测构造更可靠的分位数区间，改善覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFM虽能给出预测分布，但其预测区间可能出现欠覆盖或过覆盖，即使点预测准确。

Method: 基于最高预测密度分裂共形预测，适配多模态预测；用校准与测试输出，无需额外训练或推理。

Result: 在有限样本假设下具边际有效性；用分布估计误差与分数离散度界定条件-边际覆盖差距；TabPFN与TabICL实验中边际覆盖更准、平均条件与分组覆盖误差更低。

Conclusion: 固定数据预算下，增加校准样本可降低边际覆盖误差，即使点预测略降。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) provide predictive distributions for regression, but their prediction regions can exhibit undercoverage or overcoverage even when point predictions are accurate. We introduce C-USIM (Conditionally-Uniformized Score Integration Method), a lightweight application of highest predictive density split conformal prediction that accommodates multimodal predictions. Given calibration and test outputs, it requires no additional training or model inference. It provides finite-sample marginal validity under our assumptions. We bound conditional-marginal coverage gaps using distribution-estimation error and score discreteness, and examine coverage heterogeneity through percentile rank-score plots. Experiments with TabPFN and TabICL show improved marginal coverage accuracy and lower average conditional and group coverage errors. Under a fixed data budget, allocating more observations to calibration can reduce marginal coverage error despite less accurate point predictions.

</details>


### [346] [GUIDE-FBO: Guidance via Uncertainty Intervention and Distributional Exchange for Federated Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35038)
*Jintao Wei,Chenxi Li,Songhao Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出GUIDE-FBO：智能体交换各自最优位置的紧凑分布（由本地GP后验推断），服务器合并重加权后返回子集，各智能体构建联邦干预GP（FI-GP）进行决策；GUIDE-UCB证明有界不确定性干预保持GP-UCB的主阶累积遗憾率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦贝叶斯优化需在通信受限与任务异构下实现有效知识迁移，但共享原始观测、查询点或代理参数均存在通信与隐私问题。

Method: 智能体不交换原始数据，而是交换从本地GP后验推断的最优位置分布；服务器合并并重加权这些分布分量，返回子集给各智能体；智能体据此构建FI-GP，在保持本地后验均值的同时对协方差做空间重缩放，用于本地决策。

Result: 理论上证明任何有界FI-GP不确定性干预均保持标准GP-UCB的主阶累积遗憾率；当迁移分布更支持最优区域时，选择次优区域需更大的本地后验不确定性。12个合成基准与3个真实任务上，从同质到严重异构均有效；消融显示空间局部化不确定性干预关键，通信分析表明仅交换紧凑分布消息。

Conclusion: GUIDE-FBO以紧凑分布消息实现通信高效的联邦知识迁移，在异构任务下鲁棒有效，同时保持理论遗憾保证。

Abstract: Federated Bayesian Optimization (FBO) enables distributed agents to collaboratively optimize expensive black-box objectives without sharing raw local observations. However, effective knowledge transfer remains challenging under communication constraints and task heterogeneity. We propose GUIDE-FBO, in which agents exchange compact distributions over the locations of their respective optima inferred from local Gaussian process (GP) posteriors, rather than raw observations, query points, or surrogate parameters. The server merges and reweights these distributional components before returning a subset to each agent. Each agent then constructs a Federated Interventional GP (FI-GP), which preserves the local posterior mean and spatially rescales its covariance for local decision making. For the upper confidence bound (UCB) instantiation, GUIDE-UCB, we prove that any bounded FI-GP uncertainty intervention preserves the leading-order cumulative regret rate of standard GP-UCB. When the transferred distributions place greater support near an optimum than in a suboptimal region, selecting the latter requires greater local posterior uncertainty. Experiments on 12 synthetic benchmarks and three real-world optimization tasks show that GUIDE-FBO remains effective across settings ranging from homogeneous to severely heterogeneous. Ablation results highlight the importance of spatially localized uncertainty intervention, while the communication analysis shows that GUIDE-FBO exchanges only compact distributional messages.

</details>


### [347] [A Hierarchy of Entropy-Shapley Games for Multivariate Predictive Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35217)
*Niklas Koenen,Claudia Battistin,Jeriek Van den Abeele,Martin Jullum*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出基于熵的Shapley博弈层级，为多变量输出预测中的不确定性归因显式处理输出分量依赖，分离出跨分量归因项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量概率模型输出依赖结构复杂，现有归因方法将输出聚合为标量或逐分量分析，无法区分特征是影响边际不确定性还是依赖结构。

Method: 构建三层熵基Shapley博弈（从逐分量边际熵到完全联合熵），隔离跨分量归因项；用条件总相关刻画该术语，提供闭式与基于采样的估计器，并给出联合归因的链式法则分解。

Result: 跨分量归因项可捕捉各特征如何改变输出分量间依赖，为逐分量方法所遗漏；框架能揭示从分布回归到零样本时间序列基础模型的不同联合结构差异。

Conclusion: 该层级框架使输出侧依赖处理选择显式化，统一了边际与联合不确定性归因，有助于风险决策与模型诊断。

Abstract: Modern probabilistic machine learning models increasingly produce multivariate outputs with complex dependence structure, from multi-step time-series forecasts to sample path predictions. Understanding which input features drive the predictive uncertainty is important for risk-aware decisions, model diagnostics, and deciding whether the uncertainty should be mitigated or hedged against. This attribution problem requires a choice of how dependencies between output components are treated. Existing approaches reduce the output to a scalar through aggregation or projection before attribution, thereby obscuring whether features affect marginal uncertainty, dependence structure, or both, while component-wise analyses can miss dependence effects entirely. We close this gap by introducing a hierarchy of three entropy-based Shapley games that make this output-side choice explicit for any ordered multivariate outcome, ranging from per-component marginal entropy to fully joint entropy. The hierarchy isolates a cross-component attribution term that captures how each feature shifts the dependence between output components, a quantity invisible to component-wise methods. We establish a chain-rule decomposition of the joint attribution and characterize the cross-component term through conditional total correlation, providing both closed-form and sample-based estimators. Finally, we demonstrate how the framework captures differences in learned joint structure across probabilistic models from distributional regression to a zero-shot time series foundation model.

</details>


### [348] [Multi-Task Learning of Conditional Mean Operators: applications to dynamical systems and uncertainty quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35429)
*Sami Chemlal,Thibaut Germain,Rémi Flamary,Vladimir R. Kostic,Karim Lounici*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出MTL-CMO多任务框架，联合学习共享函数空间与任务专属算子，并扩展出T-CMO迁移方法，用于条件分布算子的估计与表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件统计估计与条件分布表示在不确定性量化、动力系统分析中很关键，CMO可提供条件统计，但现有方法独立估计每个CMO或限制在预设函数空间中，无法利用相关分布间的共享结构。

Method: 假设相关CMO共享有限维输入输出函数空间，每个任务仅用线性算子映射这些空间。基于此提出MTL-CMO，多数据集联合学习共享函数空间与任务特定算子；进一步提出T-CMO，复用共享空间以闭式估计新条件分布的算子。

Result: 建立了统计保证，量化联合学习共享函数空间的收益。实验表明，共享函数空间在广泛条件分布上提升不确定性量化；在Langevin与plasma动力学中，得到保留物理意义信息、支持参数辨识的紧凑动力学表示。

Conclusion: 通过共享有限维函数空间并学习任务专属线性算子，可有效利用相关条件分布间结构，提升CMO估计与表示效果，并在迁移到新任务及复杂动力学分析中表现良好。

Abstract: Estimating conditional statistics and learning representations of a population of conditional distributions are central problems in many data-driven applications, including uncertainty quantification and dynamical systems analysis. Conditional mean operators (CMOs), a class of linear operators between function spaces, resolve these objectives by providing access to a broad class of conditional statistics. However, existing methods typically estimate each CMO independently or constrain it to prespecified function spaces, thereby preventing the exploitation of shared structure across related distributions. In this work, we posit that related CMOs share finite-dimensional input and output function spaces, and are specialized for each task with a linear operator mapping these spaces. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce MTL-CMO, a multi-task framework that jointly learns shared function spaces and task-specific operators across multiple datasets. We further introduce T-CMO, a transfer learning method that reuses the shared spaces to estimate, in closed form, the operator of a new conditional distribution. We establish statistical guarantees quantifying the benefits of jointly learning the shared function spaces. Our experiments demonstrate that learning shared function spaces improves uncertainty quantification across a broad range of conditional distributions and, when applied to Langevin and plasma dynamics, yields compact representations of complex dynamics that retain physically meaningful information and enable parameter identification.

</details>


### [349] [Learning Conditional Expectation Operators via Functional Newton Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35598)
*Thiago Ramos,Alek Fröhlich,Daniel Perazzo,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出功能谱-牛顿方法（FSNM），无需预设基或再生核希尔伯特空间即可学习条件期望算子的主奇异结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习条件期望算子的谱结构通常依赖固定基或RKHS，限制灵活性。作者希望提出一种不依赖这些设定的方法。

Method: FSNM通过对中心化联合-乘积分密度比核进行交替功能牛顿更新，拟合其低秩表示；每次更新化为预条件回归，并用向量值回归树以分阶段提升（stagewise boosting）逼近。

Result: 总体层面证明了下降性，并在相对弱学习器精度条件下给出O(1/T)最优迭代块稳定率；同时证明中心化L^2空间上任意非退化局部极小都是全局最优rank-d逼近。合成实验显示FSNM能恢复低秩密度比及其主谱结构，且同一学习核可回答多个条件查询而无需重新拟合。

Conclusion: FSNM提供了一种无需固定基/RKHS的条件期望算子低秩谱学习方法，兼具理论保证与可复用性。

Abstract: We introduce the Functional Spectral-Newton Method (FSNM) for learning the leading singular structure of a conditional expectation operator without fixing a basis or reproducing kernel Hilbert space.
