FSNM fits a low-rank representation of the centered joint-to-product density ratio kernel by alternating functional Newton updates. Each update reduces to a preconditioned regression, which we approximate with vector-valued regression trees in a stagewise boosting procedure. At the population level, we establish descent and an $O(1/T)$ best-iterate block-stationarity rate under a relative weak-learner accuracy condition, and show that every nondegenerate local minimum over the full centered $L^2$ spaces is a globally optimal rank-$d$ approximation. Synthetic experiments show that FSNM recovers a low-rank density ratio and its leading spectral structure, and that the same learned kernel can answer multiple conditional queries without refitting.

</details>


### [350] [Elicitation and Decision Geometry in Single-Index Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35622)
*Sakshi Arya,Cheng Soon Ong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 Natural Boundary Learning (NBL),一种直接学习最优边界的贪心算法,用于双臂上下文赌博机,无需估计奖励函数或公共链接即可实现 O(log n) 遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂上下文赌博机中,单调链接使最优动作仅依赖索引方向对比,因此无需估计各臂的奖励函数。作者希望利用这一结构直接学习最优边界,避免奖励函数和公共链接的估计。

Method: 提出 NBL 贪心过程,使用顺序 Stein 对比 (sequential Stein contrast) 直接学习最优边界。通过决策稳定性系数刻画 NBL 的局部黎曼动力学,该系数平衡臂分离度、链接几何与上下文分布,并将其与潜在凸势的诱导几何联系起来。

Result: 在局部决策稳定性下,NBL 向最优边界收缩并达到 O(log n) 期望遗憾。数值实验验证了预测的稳定性区间,并在链接误设下与参数化贪心基准进行比较。

Conclusion: NBL 提供了一种无需估计奖励函数或公共链接的直接边界学习方法,其稳定性由凸势的诱导几何刻画,在局部稳定条件下获得对数遗憾,数值实验支持理论预测。

Abstract: We study two-arm contextual bandits with arm-specific single indices and a shared unknown monotone link. Monotonicity makes the optimal action depend only on the contrast between the index directions, hence arm-specific reward functions need not be estimated. We introduce Natural Boundary Learning (NBL), a greedy procedure that uses a sequential Stein contrast to learn the optimal boundary directly, without estimating the reward functions or the common link. We characterize the local Riemannian dynamics of NBL through a decision stability coefficient balancing arm separation, link geometry, and the context distribution. We show that this stability is connected to the elicitation geometry of the underlying convex potential. Under local decision stability, NBL contracts toward the optimal boundary and achieves $O(\log n)$ expected regret. Numerical experiments illustrate the predicted stability regimes and compare NBL with a parametric greedy benchmark under link misspecification.

</details>


### [351] [$l_{1-2}$ GLasso: $L_{1-2}$ Regularized Multi-task Graphical Lasso for Joint Estimation of eQTL Mapping and Gene Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.02225)
*Wei Miao,Lan Yao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出L1-2正则化多任务图Lasso（L1-2 GLasso），用于联合估计eQTL定位与基因网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因调控学习中两大任务——eQTL定位（SNP-基因关系）与基因网络估计（基因-基因关系）——可共享信息，但需统一模型协同估计。

Method: 提出L1-2正则化的多任务图Lasso（L1-2 GLasso），在统一框架下联合估计eQTL映射与基因网络。

Result: 在人工数据集上能有效捕捉稀疏结构；在ADNI-1真实数据集上比常用方法获得更稀疏、更准确的解。

Conclusion: L1-2 GLasso在联合估计eQTL与基因网络中具有竞争性表现，可得到更稀疏准确的解。

Abstract: A critical problem in genetics is to discover how gene expression is regulated within cells. Two major tasks of regulatory association learning are : (i) identifying SNP-gene relationships, known as eQTL mapping, and (ii) determining gene-gene relationships, known as gene network estimation. To share information between these two tasks, we focus on the unified model for joint estimation of eQTL mapping and gene network, and propose a $L_{1-2}$ regularized multi-task graphical lasso, named $L_{1-2}$ GLasso. Numerical experiments on artificial datasets demonstrate the competitive performance of $L_{1-2}$ GLasso on capturing the true sparse structure of eQTL mapping and gene network. $L_{1-2}$ GLasso is further applied to real dataset of ADNI-1 and experimental results show that $L_{1 -2}$ GLasso can obtain sparser and more accurate solutions than other commonly-used methods.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [352] [An Exact Lyapunov Characterization of Regional Rate Performance for Rational Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31854)
*Declan S. Jagt,Matthew M. Peet*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文给出区域有理稳定性（预设速率性能）的精确逆Lyapunov刻画，并提出可用SOS编程求解的分层凸松弛，数值验证了保守性缩放因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有理稳定性是常微分方程的一种定量稳定性概念，收敛由解的有理时间衰减界刻画。已有的Lyapunov刻画条件均未被证明能精确刻画有理速率性能，因此需要一个精确的逆Lyapunov刻画。

Method: 提出精确的、针对预设速率性能的区域有理稳定性的逆Lyapunov刻画；为数值检验该条件，设计了一套分层凸松弛，可通过Sum-of-Squares（SOS）编程实现；每层对应一个关于速率性能的猜想保守性缩放因子。

Result: 数值验证了各层对应的保守性缩放因子；第一层松弛看上去是新颖的，并优于经典SOS方法；数值算例验证了结果，并计算出可保证指定性能水平的嵌套状态空间区域。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了有理稳定性缺乏精确Lyapunov刻画这一空白，提供了可计算的SOS分层验证框架，并给出性能保证的状态空间区域。

Abstract: Rational stability is a quantitative stability notion for nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), under which convergence is characterized by a rationally-in-time decaying bound on solutions. Although Lyapunov characterizations of rational stability have been proposed, no existing condition has been shown to exactly characterize rational rate performance. The paper resolves this issue by providing an exact converse Lyapunov characterization of regional rational stability with prescribed rate performance. To test the resulting converse Lyapunov conditions numerically, a tiered set of convex relaxations is proposed which can be enforced using Sum-of-Squares (SOS) programming. A conjectured conservatism scaling factor in rate performance is associated with each tier and validated numerically. The first proposed tier appears to be novel and is shown to outperform classical SOS-based approaches. Numerical examples are used to validate the results and compute nested regions of state-space on which prescribed levels of performance can be guaranteed.

</details>


### [353] [Reducing Combinatorial Redundancy in Mixed-Integer MPC via Ranking-Based Feasible-Set Restriction for Reconfigurable Batteries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32029)
*Albert Škegro,Torsten Wik,Changfu Zou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于排序的可行集限制方法，用于混合整数MPC中同类单元选择问题，将组合选择降为线性，并以可重构电池组实例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个同尺寸单元组合选择会产生接近的预测结果，分支定界法难以在一个采样周期内证明最优性。

Method: 按每个采样时刻的适用性得分对单元排序，用单调约束仅允许排名靠前的单元激活；优化器只决定激活数量。电池实例中按归一化SOH、SOC和电压裕度的固定权重给电芯打分。

Result: 20电芯动态驾驶循环、每次在线求解限1秒：在线受限求解全部在根节点终止并获认证最优，无限制子集选择仅77.83%获认证；95分位求解时间降低13.4倍。SOC单元间标准差下降8.7倍且无功率削减，代价是开关次数增至3.45倍。最优成本平均仅增加0.26%和0.14%。

Conclusion: 该限制显著提升认证最优性和求解速度，SOC均衡效果更好，成本损失很小，但增加单元切换。

Abstract: When mixed-integer model predictive control must select which of several similar units to activate, many same-size selections can yield closely spaced predicted outcomes, and branch-and-bound may fail to certify optimality within one sampling period. We propose a ranking-based feasible-set restriction for this class of decisions: the units are ordered by a suitability score computed at each sampling instant, and a monotone constraint permits only the top-ranked units to be active. The optimizer then chooses only how many units to activate, so the admissible selections per prediction stage grow linearly instead of combinatorially, while the model, cost function, and remaining constraints are retained. We instantiate the method for reconfigurable battery packs in which each series-connected cell can be bypassed, scoring cells with fixed weights on normalized state of health, state of charge, and voltage headroom. In a 20-cell simulation over a dynamic drive cycle with a 1 s limit per online solve, all active online restricted solves terminate at the root node with certified optimality, compared with 77.83% certification for unrestricted subset selection, and the 95th-percentile solver time is lower by a factor of 13.4. The cycle-mean cell-to-cell standard deviation in state of charge falls 8.7-fold without power curtailment, at the expense of 3.45 times as much cell switching. Solving both problems from identical states along two trajectories shows that the restriction raises the optimal cost by 0.26% and 0.14% on average at states where both solves are certified and uncurtailed.

</details>


### [354] [RFSR-MI-MPC: Ranking-Based Feasible-Set Restriction for Real-Time Control of Reconfigurable Battery Packs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32032)
*Albert Škegro,Quan Ouyang,Torsten Wik,Changfu Zou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出"排序前缀可行集约束"，将可重构电池组MPC的每步投入模式组合数从指数级降为线性，实现实时混合整数MPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 串联可重构电池组每步需从2^n种旁路开关组合中选最优，混合整数MPC求解组合爆炸，难以实时运行。

Method: 按一步目标值给出"适宜性评分"，对电芯排序，将投入变量限制为该排序的前缀；模型、目标与物理约束不变。

Result: 20电芯、WLTC工况：每步均认证成功、无分支求解，95百分位求解时间降为1/6.8；电芯SOC标准差降为1/3.4，无功率削减；同状态参考解的平均约束间隙<0.11%。

Conclusion: 该前缀约束在多种初始条件、异构度、电池规模和预测时域下均保持计算增益且无需重新调参，适合实时控制。

Abstract: A ranked-prefix feasible-set restriction is proposed for real-time mixed-integer model predictive control of series-connected reconfigurable battery packs with per-cell bypass switching. Cells are ordered at each sampling instant by a one-step objective-informed suitability score, and the engagement variables are constrained to prefixes of that ordering. The restriction reduces the number of admissible per-step engagement patterns from combinatorial to linear in the number of cells while leaving the model, objective, and physical constraints unchanged. For a 20-cell pack driven over a worldwide harmonized light vehicles test cycle, the proposed controller certifies every active step, solves every instance without branching, and reduces the 95th-percentile solver time by a factor of 6.8 relative to the full subset-selection controller. The cycle-mean cell-to-cell state-of-charge standard deviation decreases by a factor of 3.4, and no power curtailment occurs. Same-state reference solves show a mean restriction gap below 0.11% on jointly certified steps, and the computational gains persist across the tested initial conditions, cell heterogeneity levels, pack sizes, and prediction horizons without retuning.

</details>


### [355] [A Priority-Aware Dual-Channel Feature Fusion Method for Urban Rail Service Traffic Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32168)
*Xinpeng Liu,Junhui Zhao,Zhengyuan Wu,Huaicheng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种优先感知双通道特征融合框架，用于城轨5G/IoT异构业务流分类，兼顾高精度、低时延与边缘部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城轨通信系统面临设备故障、维护干扰及多业务交织的复杂传输环境，且私有协议与加密流量普遍，传统基于端口和DPI的分类方法失效，亟需能区分安全关键业务的高精度分类方案。

Method: 将原始流量字节与统计特征映射为灰度图像，采用双分支架构：迁移学习增强的ResNet提取字节级细粒度纹理，轻量CNN捕获宏观统计模式；用通道注意力机制动态重校准跨模态特征；设计优先敏感损失（PSL），融合业务关键性意识与类平衡加权，最大化安全关键业务的召回率。

Result: 在真实城轨数据集上按优先级加权指标评估，达到98.74%准确率和99.24%加权召回；两个安全关键业务CBTC和ERD的召回分别为99.94%和99.41%；模型仅0.18M参数，端到端时延0.4–0.7 ms。

Conclusion: 该方法在高精度分类、低推理时延和边缘部署可行性之间取得良好平衡，为城轨通信中优先级感知的资源调度提供了可靠分类基础。

Abstract: With the deep integration of 5G and IoT in urban rail transit, service traffic grows explosively and accurate classification of heterogeneous service flows is essential for safe and efficient railway operations. Urban rail communication systems are subject not only to operational disturbances such as equipment failures and maintenance interference, but also to complex transmission patterns characterized by the interleaving of multi-service traffic flows. Under these operating conditions, the widespread deployment of proprietary protocols and the high prevalence of encrypted traffic further diminish the applicability of conventional port-based and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) classification methods. To address these challenges, we propose a priority-aware dual-channel feature fusion framework. Raw traffic bytes and statistical features are mapped into grayscale images and processed by a dual-branch architecture: a transfer learning-enhanced ResNet extracts fine-grained byte-level textures, while a lightweight CNN captures macroscopic statistical patterns. A channel attention mechanism dynamically recalibrates cross-modal features, and a novel Priority-Sensitive Loss (PSL) that integrates business-criticality awareness with class-balance weighting to maximize recall for safety-critical services. Evaluated on a real-world urban rail dataset using priority-weighted metrics, the method achieves 98.74\% accuracy and 99.24\% weighted recall, with recall of 99.94\% and 99.41\% on the two safety-critical services:Communication-Based Train Control(CBTC) and Emergency Radio Dispatch(ERD), providing a reliable classification foundation for priority-aware resource scheduling in urban rail communications. With only 0.18M parameters and 0.4--0.7 ms end-to-end latency, offering an excellent balance between high-precision classification, low inference latency, and edge-deployment feasibility.

</details>


### [356] [Neural Decentralized Conditions for Power System Stability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32219)
*Tong Han,Yan Xu,Rui Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用精心设计的神经网络来建立电力系统分散稳定性条件（DSC）的新方法，并通过定制损失函数迭代训练，得到比传统解析DSC更少保守性的神经DSC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统解析推导的分散稳定性条件（DSC）往往较为保守，需要一种能降低保守性的新方法。

Method: 基于对现有解析DSC结构与特性的洞察，用精心设计的神经网络来表达DSC，并定制损失函数进行迭代训练，以保证DSC的有效性并降低其保守性。

Result: 数值结果表明，所得到的神经DSC比传统解析DSC保守性更低；当使用相对大规模系统进行训练时，神经DSC还具有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该神经网络方法能够有效建立低保守性的电力系统分散稳定性条件，并具备泛化潜力。

Abstract: This letter proposes a novel method to establish decentralized stability conditions (DSCs) of power systems. This method formulates DSCs with meticulously crafted neural networks, based on the insight into the structure and properties of the existing analytically derived DSCs. A tailored loss function is further devised to iteratively train the neural networks, ensuring validity and reducing conservatism of the DSCs. Numerical results demonstrate that the resultant neural DSCs are less conservative than the conventional analytical DSCs, and become generalizable if a relatively large-scale system is used for training.

</details>


### [357] [Neural-Analytica Energy Functions for Power System Stability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32221)
*Tong Han,Yan Xu,Rui Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"神经-解析能量函数"（neural-analytic EF），将神经网络组件与解析能量函数相加，用于电力系统稳定性分析，兼顾神经网络的表达能力与解析EF的可推广性和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解析能量函数（EF）在电力系统稳定性分析中具有可推广性和可扩展性，但表达能力有限；而纯神经网络具有强表达能力，却缺乏解析EF的泛化与可扩展优势。因此需要一种融合两者优点的新型能量函数。

Method: 将神经-解析EF设计为基于神经网络的组件与一个解析EF之和，其结构由已有解析推导出的EF指导。通过带有定制损失函数的迭代神经网络训练，得到满意的神经-解析EF。

Result: 数值结果验证了所提神经-解析能量函数相比现有方法的优越性。

Conclusion: 神经-解析EF通过融合神经网络表达力与解析EF的可推广性和可扩展性，为电力系统稳定性分析提供了一种有效的新方法。

Abstract: This letter proposes a novel form of energy function (EF), called neural-analytic EF, for the stability analysis of power systems. The neural-analytic EF is designed as the sum of neural networks (NNs)-based components and an analytic EF, with the structure informed by the existing EFs derived analytically. It thus integrates NN's expressivity with the generalizability and scalability of analytic EFs. The satisfactory neural-analytic EF is further derived by iterative NN training with a tailored loss function. Numerical results finally demonstrate its superiority.

</details>


### [358] [Physics-Informed Learning of Feedback-Linearizing Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32223)
*Pavlos Kallinikidis,Fengjun Yang,David Snyder,Jacob H. Seidman,Nikolai Matni,Paris Perdikaris,George J. Pappas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出级联PINN框架近似求解反馈线性化PDE，缓解高阶Lie导数拟合的误差累积，并给出跟踪控制误差理论界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反馈线性化依赖求解由Frobenius定理保证适定性的PDE以寻找线性化坐标变换，但大维度系统下求解计算上不可行。

Method: 采用级联物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架近似求解这些PDE，通过分别参数化不同Lie导数阶数的项来缓解高阶Lie导数拟合中的误差累积；并用所学变换设计跟踪控制器，建立其对学习表示误差的理论界。

Result: 在广泛的反馈线性化系统上验证，包括多输入多输出平面四旋翼及解析方法不可行的合成例子，表明该方法能计算地发现有效的反馈线性化表示用于控制任务。

Conclusion: 该级联PINN方法可有效近似反馈线性化变换并支持控制设计，为高维非线性系统的反馈线性化提供可行计算途径。

Abstract: Feedback linearization is a powerful tool in nonlinear control, but finding the linearizing coordinate transform remains challenging. Feedback linearizing transforms are governed by well-established partial differential equations (PDEs) whose well-posedness is based on the Lie-algebraic Frobenius theorem, but solving the PDEs becomes computationally intractable for large system dimensions. To address this challenge, we propose a cascaded physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework to approximately solve these PDEs. By separately parameterizing terms of different Lie derivative orders, we mitigate the compounding errors inherent in fitting high-order Lie derivatives of neural networks. Furthermore, we use the learned transform to design a tracking controller and establish theoretical bounds on its error with respect to inaccuracies in the learned feedback-linearizing representation. We validate our method on a broad class of feedback linearizable systems, including a multi-input, multi-output planar quadrotor and synthetic examples for which analytical approaches are impractical, and demonstrate that our approach can computationally discover effective feedback-linearizing representations of nonlinear systems for control tasks.

</details>


### [359] [Neural ODEs Meet Concurrent Learning: Stable Online Learning with Lyapunov Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32289)
*Omkar Sudhir Patil*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文证明Neural ODE的伴随梯度可分解为半正定轨迹算子乘参数误差加有界扰动，从而用Lyapunov函数给出在线训练稳定性保证，并据此提出存储数据方法NODE-CL，在多个控制任务上优于并发学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Neural ODE基于轨迹损失学习动力学，但伴随梯度缺少在线自适应Lyapunov分析所需的“回归量×参数误差”结构，导致流式数据训练缺乏稳定性保证。论文旨在揭示该结构确实存在并据此建立理论保证与实用算法。

Method: 将伴随梯度精确分解为半正定轨迹算子作用于参数误差，加上具有显式、依赖时域的界的非线性扰动；据此构造二次Lyapunov函数，在可计算的增益与时域条件下证明滑动窗口在线Neural ODE训练的稳定性。该证书扩展到存储数据：漂移分支恢复并发学习，轨迹分支导出NODE-CL——基于批量前向灵敏度的存储分段Gauss-Newton方法，无需状态导数估计。

Result: 在四个DeepMind Control Suite域上，速度测量含噪时NODE-CL在其中三个取得最低中位预测误差，而基于观测器的并发学习退化最高达8倍；干净测量下NODE-CL在摆任务最优，在cartpole和reacher上最差仅为最佳存储数据基线的1.6倍。

Conclusion: 伴随梯度的结构化分解为在线Neural ODE训练提供可计算的稳定性认证，并统一解释了并发学习与所提出的NODE-CL，后者在噪声测量下表现出更强的鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: Neural ODEs learn dynamics from trajectory losses, but their adjoint gradients lack the regressor-times-parameter-error structure on which Lyapunov analyses of online adaptation rest, so training on streaming data comes without stability guarantees. We show that this structure is in fact present: the adjoint gradient decomposes exactly into a positive semi-definite trajectory operator acting on the parameter error plus a nonlinear perturbation with explicit, horizon-dependent bounds. A quadratic Lyapunov function then certifies online Neural ODE training over sliding windows under computable gain and horizon conditions, and the same certificate extends to stored data: its drift branch recovers concurrent learning, and its trajectory branch yields NODE-CL, a stored-segment Gauss-Newton method built on batched forward sensitivities that needs no state-derivative estimates. On four DeepMind Control Suite domains, NODE-CL attains the lowest median prediction error on three under velocity measurement noise, where observer-based concurrent learning degrades by up to 8x; with clean measurements it is best on the pendulum and within a factor of 1.6 of the best stored-data baseline on the cartpole and reacher.

</details>


### [360] [Schur-Neural KF: Learned Schur-Consistent Corrections to the Extended Kalman Filter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32640)
*Min Kim,Lianghao Cao,Soon-Jo Chung,Andrew M. Stuart*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出 SN-KF，一种保持 EKF 概率条件解释的学习型修正，通过 Schur 补参数化确保联合预测协方差半正定，在数据稀缺场景下提升鲁棒性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EKF 在数据稀缺或非理想条件下可能失准，而现有学习方法常破坏其概率条件解释。作者希望在保留 EKF 理论性质的同时引入学习型修正。

Method: 扰动预测状态-量测互协方差与量测噪声协方差的 Cholesky 因子；采用基于 Schur 补的参数化保证联合预测协方差半正定；用递归神经架构实现，矩阵输出由幅度门调制。

Result: 证明融合量测不会增加状态不确定性，且单个量测不会因其统计意外性引发任意大的状态修正；扰动分析表明其在数据稀缺下具结构优势。两雷达实验中 Schur 一致性带来更宽的无故障超参区域并降低小训练集 RMSE；单轮车实验中在基于新息的传感器故障剔除下取得最佳精度、召回率、虚警率和门控 RMSE。

Conclusion: SN-KF 在保留 EKF 概率解释的同时提供有效学习型修正，理论与实验均验证其在数据稀缺与故障剔除场景下的优势。

Abstract: We present Schur-Neural KF (SN-KF), a learning-based correction to the extended Kalman filter (EKF) that preserves the probabilistic conditioning interpretation of the EKF. The method perturbs the predictive state-measurement cross-covariance and the Cholesky factor of the measurement noise covariance so that the resulting joint predictive covariance is always positive semidefinite. The positive semidefiniteness is ensured by a Schur complement-based parametrization. We instantiate the parametrization with a recurrent neural architecture whose matrix outputs are modulated by amplitude gates. We prove that incorporating a measurement does not increase the filter's state uncertainty, and show that no measurement can induce an arbitrarily large state correction relative to its statistical surprise. We also present a perturbative analysis suggesting SN-KF's structural strength in the data-scarce regime. We provide two numerical experiments to illustrate the practical benefits of SN-KF. In a two-radar experiment, enforcing Schur-consistency provides a much broader failure-free hyperparameter region and reduces RMSE for small training subsets, consistent with our theoretical analysis in the data-scarce regime. In the unicycle experiment, SN-KF achieves the best precision, recall, false alarm rate, and gated RMSE under innovation-based sensor-fault rejection.

</details>


### [361] [Characterization and Monitoring of Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos in Complex Physiological Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32735)
*Hui Yang,Yun Chen,Fabio Leonelli*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本章提出面向医疗健康的非线性动力学理论与工具，聚焦基于传感器的多重分形分析与多尺度递归量化，用于刻画心率变异性与时空ECG信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心血管等生理系统由众多成分协同、竞争与干扰产生高度非线性动力学，传统还原论方法难以理解；现代医疗监测产生大数据，而现有非线性动力学技术要么不面向医疗分析目标，要么无法有效处理大数据，亟需能充分利用生理系统非线性动力学的新方法以推进个性化、响应性强的医疗服务。

Method: 提出理论发展与工具，将非线性动力学原理应用于医疗；重点关注基于传感器的非线性动力学表征与建模，即多重分形分析与多尺度递归量化。

Result: 检视了这些方法的当前发展与实际应用，用于表征和利用心率变异性及时空ECG信号。

Conclusion: 需发展能充分挖掘生理系统非线性动力学的分析方法，以提升医疗服务质量，实现个性化、响应性与高质量等特性。

Abstract: Nonlinear dynamics arise whenever multifarious entities of a system cooperate, compete, or interfere. For example, cardiovascular system involves a great level of complexity. Multi-lead ECG signals are generated through orchestrated depolarization and repolarization of cells and manifest significant nonlinear dynamics. Nonlinear dynamical systems defy understanding based on the traditional reductionist's approach, in which one attempts to understand a system's behavior by combining all constituent parts that have been analyzed separately. In order to cope with system complexity, modern healthcare systems are investing in advanced physiological sensing and patient monitoring, thereby giving rise to big data. Realizing the full potential of big data for healthcare intelligence requires fundamentally new methodologies to harness and exploit complexity. However, available nonlinear dynamics techniques are either not concerned with healthcare analytical objectives or fail to effectively analyze big data to extract useful information for improving healthcare services. There is an urgent need to develop analytical methodologies that fully exploit the underlying nonlinear dynamics in physiological systems for advancing healthcare services with exceptional features such as personalization, responsiveness, and superior quality. This chapter presents some theoretical developments and tools to advance the applications of nonlinear dynamics principles in health care. Specifically, we focus on sensor-based characterization and modeling of nonlinear dynamics (i.e., multifractal analysis and multiscale recurrence quantification). Then, current developments and applications of these methodologies are examined for characterizing and exploiting heart rate variability and space-time ECG signals.

</details>


### [362] [Path Invariance of a Quadrotor System under Cyber Attacks with Theoretical Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32747)
*Hamza Mahmood,Usman Ali,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对四旋翼在虚假数据注入(FDI)攻击下提出一种基于横向反馈线性化的路径跟随控制器，保证前向路径不变性并确保任务成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼系统在赛博物理攻击下安全机动性受威胁，尤其攻击者可控制任一旋翼，需要保证路径不变性的控制方法。

Method: 假设对手通过FDI攻击控制任一旋翼，采用横向反馈线性化设计反馈控制器，具有闭式解析表达、计算高效，可抑制有界恶意信号影响。

Result: 在现实假设下提供FDI攻击下前向路径不变性的理论保证，并通过仿真验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: 所提控制器能在FDI攻击下保证四旋翼沿一类平滑曲线安全机动并完成任务。

Abstract: This paper presents a path-following controller for a quadrotor system to guarantee safe maneuvers, in terms of forward path invariance, in the presence of cyber-physical attacks. We assume that an adversarial agent can control any one of the rotors through a false data injection (FDI) type of attack. A feedback controller is designed using transverse feedback linearization which guarantees that the system follows a class of smooth curves under FDI attacks. Our proposed controller is computationally efficient, with a closed-form analytical expression, that not only mitigates the effect of bounded malicious signal but also ensures mission success. We provide theoretical guarantees of forward path invariance under FDI attacks with realistic assumptions and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulation.

</details>


### [363] [DAOCP: a dual active set solver for optimal control problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33451)
*Alberto Zaupa,Samuel Erickson,Mikael Johansson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: DAOCP是一种对偶主动集求解器，用于带逐阶段等式与不等式约束的线性二次最优控制问题，通过递归计算直接在原问题上运行主动集迭代，避免显式构造压缩QP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动集方法是全身机器人MPC的有力基准，但现有求解器基于稠密QP，而典型问题维度更适合利用最优控制结构的求解器，因此需要结合两者优势。

Method: 利用Riccati递推与压缩Hessian的Cholesky分解关系的一种推广，使对偶主动集迭代能通过递归计算直接作用于原最优控制问题，无需显式形成压缩二次规划。

Result: 在机器人基准的五种场景中，DAOCP在其中四种为四款求解器中最快；对58维状态的Atlas模型，平均求解时间比DAQP和HPIPM缩短9倍。

Conclusion: DAOCP将主动集算法的热启动能力与结构利用求解器的计算扩展性结合，在机器人MPC基准上取得显著加速。

Abstract: We present DAOCP, a dual active set solver for linear quadratic optimal control problems with stage-wise equality and inequality constraints. Active set methods are leading Model Predictive Control benchmarks for full-body robotics, but existing solvers operate on dense QPs, while typical problem dimensions favor methods that exploit the optimal control structure. DAOCP combines the warm-starting capabilities of active set algorithms with the better computational scaling of structure exploiting solvers, by relying on a generalization of the relationship between the Riccati recursion and the Cholesky factorization of the condensed Hessian. This result enables dual active set iterations to operate directly on the original optimal control problem through recursive computations, without explicitly forming the condensed quadratic program. On robotics benchmarks, DAOCP is the fastest of four solvers in four of five scenarios, cutting average solve time on a 58-state Atlas model by 9$\times$ relative to state of the art solvers DAQP and HPIPM.

</details>


### [364] [Grid-Forming E-STATCOMs for Stable Integration of Large-Scale Data Centers: Modeling and Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33553)
*Prabhat Ranjan Bana,Novan Zakkia,Jean-Philippe Hasler,Christer Danielsson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究使用构网型增强STATCOM（E-STATCOM）支持大规模AI数据中心在弱电网中的稳定接入，建立了基于功率-导纳的线性建模框架，并通过EMT仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模AI数据中心的快速扩张带来了新的稳定性挑战，尤其是在弱电网或低惯量网络中，其需求变化快、呈阶梯状，且对电压和动态性能要求严格。

Method: 建立基于功率-导纳的线性建模框架来捕捉系统交互，并通过详细的EMT仿真进行验证；采用负载均衡器、虚拟阻抗以及协调的有功-无功支撑实现可调动态行为。

Result: E-STATCOM对突变负载提供快速、阻尼良好的响应，有效抑制低频振荡及与电网谐振的交互；可实现系统响应的精确塑造并改善并网点调节性能。

Conclusion: E-STATCOM是将大型数据中心接入弱电网和长输电系统的灵活、可扩展解决方案，其面向设计的框架有助于参数选择和性能评估，减少对EMT研究的依赖，以满足电网规范和AIDC互联要求。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of large-scale AI data centers (AIDC) is introducing new stability challenges, particularly in weak or low-inertia networks characterized by fast, step-like demand variations and strict requirements on voltage and dynamic performance. This paper investigates the use of grid-forming (GFM) Enhanced STATCOMs (E-STATCOMs) to support reliable integration of such facilities. A power-admittance-based linear modelling framework is developed to capture system interactions and is validated through detailed EMT simulations. The results demonstrate that E-STATCOMs provide fast, well-damped responses to abrupt load changes while effectively mitigating low-frequency oscillations and interactions with network resonances. By enabling tunable dynamic behavior via a load balancer, virtual impedance, and coordinated active-reactive power support, the proposed approach allows precise shaping of system response and improved regulation at the point of connection. These features make E-STATCOMs a flexible and scalable solution for integrating large data centers into weak grids and long transmission systems, supported by a design-oriented framework that facilitates parameter selection and performance assessment without extensive reliance on EMT studies to meet grid codes and AIDC interconnection requirements.

</details>


### [365] [Control Data Scheduling over Shared Communication Channels: A Sparse and Collision-Free Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33592)
*Yuxing Zhong,Zhaohua Yang,Fuhai Nan,Daniel E. Quevedo,Ling Shi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究远程控制系统中共用通信信道的调度问题，提出一种联合协调不同控制器与不同时间步控制动作的新调度机制，并基于ADMM设计了具有明确物理解释、保证收敛且计算高效的求解算法，仿真验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在控制器远程运行并通过共享通信信道与执行器通信的系统中，需要高效调度控制数据传输，以降低带宽占用和执行器负担。

Method: 提出一种联合协调不同控制器和不同时间步控制动作的调度机制，并基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）求解所得优化问题；该算法不同于常被视为黑箱求解器的ADMM，具有清晰的物理解释，并保证收敛到稳定点。

Result: 仿真结果验证了理论结果，并证明了所提算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提联合调度机制与ADMM算法能够高效解决远程控制系统的通信调度问题，兼具理论保证与计算效率，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: In systems where controllers operate remotely and communicate with actuators over shared communication channels, it is crucial to efficiently schedule the control data transmission to reduce bandwidth usage and actuator effort. In this article, we investigate a novel scheduling mechanism that jointly coordinates control actions across different controllers and different time steps. We propose an algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to solve the resulting optimization problem. While ADMM is often treated as a black-box solver, the proposed algorithm offers a clear physical interpretation, ensures convergence to a stationary point, and is computationally efficient. Simulation results validate our theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

</details>


### [366] [A Minimum-Order Functional Observer Beyond the Darouach and Luenberger Constructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33615)
*Tyrone Fernando*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用的最小阶函数观测器框架，将经典Darouach函数观测器和降阶Luenberger观测器作为特例纳入其中，并给出确定最小阶的条件与存在性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Darouach函数观测器与降阶Luenberger观测器各自适用，但缺乏统一框架来刻画最小阶函数观测器的存在性与维数，且两类经典结果无法覆盖中间阶观测器的情形。

Method: 通过函数可观测性指标从三元组(A,C,L)确定所需函数维数；刻画代数观测器存在条件允许的最小维数，并给出达到该维数的全部增广族；进而建立谱可行性充要条件，使该维数成为可实现的最小观测器阶数。

Result: 所得存在条件在无需增广时精确退化为Darouach条件，在降阶Luenberger情形退化为经典可观测性条件；框架还允许存在中间阶最小函数观测器，即使两种经典观测器均不可用。

Conclusion: 该框架统一并推广了经典函数观测器理论，给出了最小阶函数观测器的完整存在性判据，并揭示中间阶观测器可在经典方法失效时仍存在。

Abstract: This paper develops a general minimum-order functional observer
  framework that contains the classical Darouach functional observer and
  the reduced-order Luenberger observer as special cases. The required
  functional dimension is determined from the triple $(A,C,L)$ through a
  set of functional observability indices. The minimum dimension permitted
  by the algebraic observer-existence condition is characterized, and the
  complete family of augmentations attaining this dimension is determined.
  Necessary-and-sufficient spectral feasibility conditions are then
  established for this dimension to be the minimum achievable observer
  order. The resulting existence conditions reduce exactly to the
  Darouach conditions when no augmentation is required and to the
  classical observability condition in the reduced-order Luenberger case.
  More generally, the framework admits minimum-order functional observers
  of intermediate order, which may exist even when neither classical
  observer is available.

</details>


### [367] [Hierarchical Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Warehouse Robot Coordination under Communication Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33637)
*Weihao Sun,Gehui Xu,Andreas A. Malikopoulos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出分层多智能体强化学习框架，用于通信丢失下的仓库机器人团队协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决仓库环境中机器人团队在通信丢失情况下的协调问题，降低通信开销并保证安全。

Method: 将机器人分组，组内集中协调、组间分布协调；每组用循环预测器估计因通信丢失而缺失的交互信息；高层策略生成紧凑协调参考以约束组内局部控制策略；预测安全滤波器检测并修正违反安全约束的控制。

Result: 仿真显示通信丢失下任务完成度提升，团队规模增大时通信增长降低，测试场景中运行安全。

Conclusion: 该分层框架在通信受限条件下兼顾协调性能、通信效率与安全性。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating robot teams in warehouse environments under communication loss. We partition the robot team into groups, with centralized coordination within each group and distributed coordination across groups. Each group uses a recurrent predictor to estimate unavailable interaction information due to communication loss. A higher-level policy then generates a compact coordination reference that conditions the local control policy within each group. A predictive safety filter evaluates and modifies the proposed controls when they violate safety constraints. Simulation results show improved task completion under communication loss, reduced communication growth as the team size increases, and safe operation in the tested scenarios.

</details>


### [368] [Nonlinear Participation Factor-based Power System Model Reduction Addressing Near-Resonance Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33654)
*Mahsa Sajjadi,Kai Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于非线性参与因子(NPF)的自适应模型降阶方法，用于电力系统时域仿真加速，并引入张量收缩技术实现在线计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为加速全系统时域仿真，需有效选择可线性化的次要发电机；传统线性参与因子方法在系统非线性行为不可忽略时精度不足。

Method: 基于Normal Form理论计算NPF，用模态能量对故障下系统模态排序，对高能量模态计算NPF；引入张量收缩技术加速NPF计算以支持在线应用；支持全阶模型与混合降阶模型间的动态切换，并采用分区与不分区两种策略。

Result: 在48机140节点NPCC系统上测试，实现显著仿真加速；相比基于线性参与因子的方法精度更好，尤其存在近共振条件时。

Conclusion: NPF自适应降阶方法在保证精度的同时显著加速仿真，适用于非线性行为显著的电力系统在线应用。

Abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive model reduction approach based on nonlinear participation factors (NPFs) which determines the most effective selection of unimportant generators in a power system to be linearized to accelerate time-domain simulation for the entire system. The method enables a dynamic transition between the full-order model, and a hybrid reduced model. It uses modal energies to rank system modes under contingencies, and computes NPFs for highly energized modes based on Normal Form theory. To accelerate the computation of NPFs and make it achievable online, a tensor contraction technique is introduced. The proposed approach is tested on a 48-machine, 140-bus NPCC system using both partitioned and unpartitioned strategies. It demonstrates significant simulation speedup while preserving better accuracy than a linear participation factor-based method if the nonlinear behaviors of the system cannot be ignored, especially when a near-resonance condition is presented.

</details>


### [369] [Deep Behaviour Cloning of Model Predictive Control for Real-Time Operation of a Hydrogen-Diesel Dual-Fuel Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33795)
*Alexander Winkler,Neeraj Naduvath Mana,David Gordon,Jakob Andert*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文首次将行为克隆（BC）深度神经网络用于内燃机逐周期燃烧控制，通过模仿MPC专家实现氢柴油双燃料发动机控制，实验验证在嵌入式硬件上实现3.5倍以上加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 氢柴油双燃料（H2DF）发动机对难以电气化的运输部门脱碳意义重大，但其高度非线性动力学和耦合过程变量需要约束感知控制策略（如MPC）；而MPC每燃烧周期需在线优化，难以部署在低成本嵌入式硬件上。

Method: 在改装Cummins QSB 4.5L氢双燃料发动机上以1500 min-1采集86,000个发动机循环的MPC专家演示数据，训练前馈深度神经网络（DNN）通过行为克隆模仿MPC专家，开发带过程反馈和不带反馈两种变体并实验验证。

Result: 两种变体在未见快速瞬态负载阶跃（3-8 bar IMEP）下NRMSE为7.80%和9.03%，专家为8.01%；NOx和颗粒物排放均值不高于专家。Raspberry Pi 400上推理≤2 ms（含1 ms通信延迟），专家MPC最高7 ms，加速3.5倍；ESP32（180 MHz）上单次推理4.3 ms，比18 ms周期窗口要求快4倍。超出训练范围时克隆策略控制量饱和并超过压升率限制。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个基于发动机自身采集演示训练的、用于内燃机逐周期燃烧控制的实验性行为克隆控制器，验证了模仿学习在嵌入式发动机控制中的可行性与加速优势，同时揭示了外推时约束违反的局限。

Abstract: Hydrogen-diesel dual-fuel (H2DF) combustion engines offer a promising pathway for decarbonising hard-to-electrify transport sectors, yet their highly nonlinear dynamics and coupled process variables demand constraint-aware control strategies. Model Predictive Control (MPC) meets these requirements but requires an online optimisation in every combustion cycle, which limits deployment on low-cost embedded hardware. This paper trains a feedforward deep neural network (DNN) by behaviour cloning (BC) to imitate an MPC expert, using 86,000 engine cycles of demonstration data collected at 1500 min-1 on a modified Cummins QSB 4.5-litre hydrogen dual-fuel engine. Two variants, one with process feedback and one without, are validated experimentally. Both track unseen fast-transient load steps (3-8 bar indicated mean effective pressure, IMEP) with normalised root mean square error (NRMSE) values of 7.80% and 9.03% against the expert's 8.01%, while keeping mean NOx and particulate matter emissions at or below those of the expert. Inference takes 2 ms or less on a Raspberry Pi 400 (ARM Cortex-A72 at 2.2 GHz), including 1 ms communication latency, compared to up to 7 ms for the MPC expert, a 3.5x speedup. Open-loop profiling on a low-cost ESP32 microcontroller at 180 MHz gives 4.3 ms per inference, 4x faster than required for the 18 ms cycle window. Beyond the training range the cloned policy saturates its controls but exceeds the pressure-rise-rate limit. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first experimental BC controller for cycle-to-cycle combustion control of an internal combustion engine (ICE), trained from demonstrations recorded on the engine itself.

</details>


### [370] [Regime-Dependent Value of CVaR in Preventive Maintenance Scheduling under RUL Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33988)
*Jerzy Baranowski,Waldemar Bauer*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究小规模机队的预防性维修调度：在RUL不确定、每期最多维修K个资产的约束下，比较风险中性（最小化期望成本）与风险感知（期望成本+CVaR）策略。风险感知策略在RUL不确定性中低且K>1时收益最大，最坏情形下CVaR降低13.4%，期望成本仅增0.2单位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多资产竞争有限维修槽位且剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测存在不确定性，如何在预防性维修调度中兼顾成本与风险（尤其最坏情形的尾部风险）尚需量化。

Method: 将计划期离散化，每资产至多维修一次、每期至多维修K个资产；用情景表示未来使用与RUL误差。对比风险中性策略（最小化期望成本）与风险感知策略（期望成本+CVaR_0.90，即最差10%情景的平均成本），两者均通过枚举所有满足容量约束的调度方案精确求解。开展3×5实验：K=1,2,3与五级递增的RUL不确定性组合，每组10次配对重复。

Result: 风险感知策略在RUL不确定性低至中等、且每期可执行多于一个维修动作时收益最大；最佳情况下CVaR降低13.4%，期望成本仅增加0.2个相对成本单位。高不确定性下收益可忽略，两策略甚至可能选择相同调度。

Conclusion: 风险感知调度只有在预测信息足够有效、且维修系统具备足够灵活性来利用该信息时，才产生实际运营价值。

Abstract: We study preventive-maintenance scheduling for a small fleet when several assets compete for a limited number of maintenance slots and their remaining useful lives (RULs) are uncertain. The planning horizon is divided into discrete periods; each asset may be maintained at most once, and at most $K$ assets may be maintained in any one period. Future usage and RUL errors are represented by scenarios. We compare a risk-neutral policy that minimizes expected cost with a risk-aware policy that minimizes expected cost plus conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), where $\operatorname{CVaR}_{0.90}$ is the mean cost among the worst 10\% of scenarios. Both policies are solved exactly by enumerating all capacity-feasible schedules. A $3\times5$ experiment combines capacities $K=1,2,3$ with five increasing levels of RUL uncertainty, with ten paired replications for each combination. The risk-aware policy provides its largest benefit when RUL uncertainty is low-to-moderate and more than one maintenance action can be executed per period. In the best observed case, it reduces CVaR by 13.4\% with an expected-cost increase of only 0.2 relative cost units. At high uncertainty, the benefit becomes negligible and the two policies can select identical schedules. The results show that risk-aware scheduling creates operational value only when prognostic information is sufficiently informative and the maintenance system has enough flexibility to act on it.

</details>


### [371] [Integrated Thermal and Power Management for Wave-Powered Subsea Data Centers via Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34109)
*Wanqun Yang,Jun Chen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出波能供电海底数据中心的集成建模与NMPC框架，协调热管理、柔性负载、波能利用与电池运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海底数据中心由波能供电，需在波能间歇性与电池限制下同时保障热安全并灵活调度负载，缺乏统一协调的建模与控制方法。

Method: 基于MIT Supercloud作业级CPU/内存/GPU数据构建真实负载，划分为交互式与可延迟柔性任务；用IT设备、循环氮气、压力壳（海水为热边界）三节点集总模型描述热行为；NMPC联合优化柔性负载功率预算与冷却指令，受热、电池与负载约束。

Result: 闭环仿真表明可在不同工况下维持热安全，并按波能可用性与电池SOC调整冷却及柔性负载执行；电池与波能容量显著影响电池可用性与柔性队列积压，过大可再生容量导致弃能增加；蒙特卡洛与距离相关分析显示柔性任务延迟对参数不敏感，终端SOC主要受电池能量容量与波能容量影响。

Conclusion: 该NMPC框架能有效协同海底数据中心热管理、柔性负载调度与波能/电池运行，实现热安全并适应可再生能源波动；后续可关注容量配置以平衡弃能与队列积压。

Abstract: This paper develops an integrated modeling and nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for coordinating thermal management, flexible workload scheduling, wave-power utilization, and battery operation in a wave-powered subsea data center. Realistic data center workloads are constructed from job-level CPU, memory, and GPU measurements from the MIT Supercloud dataset and divided into interactive and delay-tolerant flexible jobs. Thermal behavior is represented by a three-node lumped model of the IT equipment, recirculating nitrogen, and pressure hull with surrounding seawater as the thermal boundary. The NMPC jointly optimizes the flexible workload power budget and cooling command subject to thermal, battery, and workload constraints. Closed-loop simulations under different workload, thermal, battery, and renewable-generation conditions demonstrate that the proposed framework maintains thermal safety while adapting cooling operation and flexible workload execution to wave-power availability and battery state-of-charge. The parametric studies show that battery capacity and wave-generation capacity strongly affect battery availability and flexible-workload queue accumulation, while excessive renewable generation capacity may lead to increased energy curtailment. Monte Carlo and distance-correlation analyses further show that flexible-job delay is relatively insensitive to the investigated system parameters, whereas terminal battery state-of-charge is primarily influenced by battery energy capacity and wave generation capacity.

</details>


### [372] [A Weak Notion of Symmetry for Control Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34173)
*Jake Welde,Riley Link,Pieter van Goor*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出"弱不变性"（weak invariance）这一放松的对称性概念，其中动力学的非对称残差可由对称群上的另一控制系统完全刻画，从而在保留对称性优点的同时获得更大灵活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典不变性（对称性）虽能为估计与控制提供高效方案，但其约束过于刚性：对称性可能被外力打破，或仅存在于系统的一部分。因此需要一种更灵活的对称性推广。

Method: 作者定义"弱不变性"：将动力学的非对称部分（残差）由对称群上演化的另一控制系统捕获；进而证明弱不变系统具有级联分解（被驱动子系统为群仿射），并分析自主动态残差的误差动力学可分解性。

Result: 弱不变系统严格比经典不变系统更一般，但仍具备诸多优良性质：可级联分解为群仿射子系统，统一了经典对称与群仿射系统两类；自主动态残差可从误差动力学中因式分解，实现比经典对称更大的降维。以受重力的飞行器为例，提出九维弱对称（严格包含其熟悉的四维经典对称）。

Conclusion: 弱不变性推广了经典对称性，同时保留关键结构性质，为更灵活的对称信息控制方法奠定了基础。

Abstract: Symmetry (or invariance) is a powerful structural property that enables efficient, effective solutions for estimation and control. However, the constraints imposed on a system's dynamics by classical invariance make symmetry a very rigid property, which may be broken by external forces or confined to only a portion of the overall system. Seeking greater flexibility, this work introduces a novel relaxed notion of symmetry, termed ``weak invariance'', in which the non-symmetric part of the dynamics (the ``residual'') can be captured entirely by another control system evolving on the symmetry group. Weakly invariant systems are strictly more general than classical invariant systems, but they nonetheless enjoy many similar favorable properties. In particular, we prove that any weakly invariant system admits a cascade decomposition in which the driven subsystem is group affine, showing that weak symmetry generalizes not only classical symmetry, but also the (thus far distinct) class of group affine systems. We also show that a weak symmetry with autonomous residual can be factored out of the system's error dynamics, enabling yet a greater reduction of dimensionality as compared to classical symmetries. Finally, we study the example of an aerial vehicle under the influence of gravity, for which we propose a nine-dimensional weak symmetry (strictly containing the system's familiar four-dimensional classical symmetry). Weak invariance thus generalizes classical symmetry while also preserving key structural properties, thereby laying a foundation for more flexible methods of symmetry-informed control.

</details>


### [373] [Derivative-Free Generalized Multivariable Super-Twisting Control for Constrained Euler-Lagrange Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34379)
*Chidre Shravista Kashyap,Jishnu Keshavan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种无导数广义多变量super-twisting框架，用于负载突变下机械臂的预设时间轨迹跟踪，消除对扰动导数的依赖并保证预设时间收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械臂升降搬运需在负载突变、执行器受限及模型不精确下跟踪轨迹，其Euler--Lagrange动力学具多变量耦合。现有super-twisting算法多限于标量滑模，且依赖扰动导数假设，而负载阶跃使一阶滑模动力学不连续、该导数无定义。

Method: 用连续分数幂项替代不连续符号函数积分项，使其动力学不依赖扰动导数；将扰动的已知状态相关缩放纳入控制律与自适应增益更新；采用时间平移障碍函数保证预设时间收敛至指定边界，仅依赖质量矩阵范数界。

Result: 在带执行器饱和的7自由度机械臂上进行仿真与实验，验证了所提方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 该无导数广义多变量super-twisting框架解决了负载突变下EL系统滑模控制的导数依赖问题，实现与初值无关的预设时间收敛。

Abstract: Robotic manipulators performing payload lift-and-transfer must track prescribed trajectories under abrupt load changes, with limited actuation and inaccurate plant knowledge. Such plants are inherently described by multivariable Euler--Lagrange~(EL) dynamics with cross-coupling established through inertial and Coriolis terms. The super-twisting algorithm~(STA) is the standard approach to regulating a first-order sliding mode~(FOSM) in such settings, yet existing designs are largely restricted to scalar sliding variables, and rest on a disturbance-derivative assumption that EL systems violate. In particular, the FOSM dynamics depend on the disturbance and become discontinuous under the step changes in load produced by payload engagement and release, rendering that derivative ill-defined. This study resolves both with a derivative-free generalized multivariable super-twisting framework. The discontinuous sign-function integral term is replaced with a continuous fractional-power term whose dynamics are independent of the disturbance derivative, while the known state-dependent scaling of the perturbation is incorporated into both the control law and the adaptive gain update. A time-shifting barrier function guarantees prescribed-time convergence to a user-specified bound independently of initial conditions, with the design relying only on mass-matrix norm bounds. Simulation and experimental results on a 7-DoF manipulator under actuator saturation are used to validate the proposed scheme.

</details>


### [374] [Frequency Measurement Practices for Inertia Assessment in Inverter Based Resources Dominated Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34531)
*Christos M. Nikolakakos,Hassan Haes Alhelou,Nikos Hatziargyriou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 不同频率测量窗口（数十至数百毫秒）下，窗口化惯量估计受窗口内快速响应功率影响而失真；论文给出精确恒等式与闭式预测，并用IEEE 9节点与希腊电网仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电网规范要求从数十至数百毫秒的平均频率计算RoCoF，任何在此窗口内交付的响应都会降低测得RoCoF，导致反推惯量依赖窗口长度与在运响应类型，因此需要量化这种偏差。

Method: 定义窗口化惯量估计；推导其精确恒等式（系统惯量除以1减窗口内扰动能量占比）及线性响应模型轨迹的闭式预测；在IEEE 9节点系统上做RMS仿真（同步机、跟网型、构网型配置，不同扰动大小与参数扫描），并在简化希腊输电网验证。

Result: 线性响应模型能复现全部仿真，恒等式在实测响应功率上闭合。快速频率响应使估计值最显著虚高：500 ms下少20%同步惯量的跟网型系统报告与全同步系统相同的值，构网型则更高；希腊电网500 ms估计超出惯量17-26%，少10%同步惯量的场景报告值仍高于全同步场景惯量。

Conclusion: 窗口化惯量估计可被精确预测，运行人员可据窗口与在运响应计算实际报告值，避免因测量窗口与快速响应导致惯量误判。

Abstract: Transmission system operators and protective relays compute the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) from frequency averaged over tens to hundreds of milliseconds, as standards and grid codes specify. Any response delivered inside that window lowers the measured RoCoF, so the inferred inertia depends on the window and the responses in service. This paper defines the windowed inertia estimate and derives an exact identity the system inertia divided by one minus the fraction of the disturbance energy delivered inside the window and a closed-form prediction that applies the same estimator to the trajectory of a linear response model. Eleven IEEE 9-bus RMS runs synchronous, grid-following and grid-forming configurations, disturbance sizes and parameter sweeps are reproduced by that model, and the identity closes on the measured response powers. Fast frequency response inflates the estimate most: at 500 ms a grid-following system with 20 % less synchronous inertia reports the same value as the all-synchronous system, the grid-forming system a higher one. On a reduced Greek transmission system the 500ms estimate exceeds the inertia by 17-26%, and a scenario with 10% less synchronous inertia reports more than the all-synchronous scenario's inertia. Operators can thus compute what their measurement reports.

</details>


### [375] [Robust Variable-Horizon MPC for Landing a Multirotor UAV on a Moving Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34574)
*Sander Doodeman,Niels Berkers,Paula Chanfreut,Elena Torta,Duarte Antunes*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种计算高效的鲁棒变时域MPC方法，实现多旋翼无人机在有界扰动下着陆于运动平台（非平衡目标）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多旋翼无人机因欠驱动性，着陆运动平台的目标状态通常为非平衡态，传统收缩/变时域方法对扰动缺乏鲁棒性，而鲁棒变时域MPC计算复杂，难以用于高维系统实时实现。

Method: 将在线时域搜索限制在上一时域附近的邻域，保持有界扰动下的递归可行性；采用固定的鲁棒正不变管实现与时域无关的约束收紧；利用无人机微分平坦特性在解耦线性化系统上应用，实现机载Raspberry Pi 5上20 Hz实时运行。

Result: 仿真表明限制时域搜索在大幅降低计算量的同时对目标函数影响有限；Gazebo实时仿真验证了鲁棒性；实物实验成功实现多旋翼无人机在运动Stewart平台上的着陆。

Conclusion: 所提方法在保证鲁棒性与可行性的同时实现了计算高效，可在低成本机载硬件上实时运行，并成功完成运动平台着陆任务。

Abstract: Landing a multirotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) on a moving platform is challenging because a UAV is underactuated and the desired landing state is generally a non-equilibrium state. Shrinking- and variable-horizon approaches are promising for reaching such non-equilibrium targets, but often lack robustness to disturbances. Robust Variable-Horizon Model Predictive Control (VH-MPC) addresses this limitation but is computationally complex for a high-dimensional system such as a multirotor UAV.
  This paper presents a computationally efficient robust Variable-Horizon MPC method for reaching non-equilibrium targets under bounded disturbances. The online horizon search is restricted to a neighborhood of the previously selected horizon, while maintaining recursive feasibility under bounded disturbances. A fixed robust positively invariant tube provides horizon-independent constraint tightening. By exploiting the differential flatness property of a UAV, this approach is applied to a decoupled linearized system, enabling real-time implementation on an onboard Raspberry Pi 5 at 20 Hz. Simulations show that restricting the horizon search substantially reduces computation with limited impact on the objective, while real-time Gazebo simulations demonstrate the robustness of the method. Physical experiments demonstrate successful landing of a multirotor UAV on a moving Stewart platform.

</details>


### [376] [On the Achievable Inertia Constant of Inverter Based Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34580)
*Christos M. Nikolakakos,Hassan Haes Alhelou,Nikos Hatziargyriou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文推导逆变型资源(IBR)可提供惯量的三重闭式边界，并组合为统一包络 H_eff(t,λ,V_g)=min(H_E,H_P,H_C)，用于量化机组在给定负载率、电网电压和扰动后时刻的实际惯量贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着IBR替代同步机，其可实际贡献的惯量成为关键规划参数，但该贡献同时受能量储备、变流器功率额定与低电压穿越(VRT)义务、惯量模拟控制及其激活延迟三方面限制，缺乏统一的量化方法。

Method: 分别以闭式解析推导三重边界：能量储备边界、变流器功率/VRT边界、控制激活延迟边界，再取最小值构成统一惯量包络；并在IEEE 9节点系统上进行仿真验证。

Result: 发现：低于与负载相关的临界电压时，VRT无功电流优先会耗尽有功电流裕度而无法注入惯量功率；变流器过载比κ主要在电压跌落期间起作用；减载带来线性可量化的惯量增益；配置储能(ESS)可解除源-耦合约束，使GFL与GFM电站在激活后等效，仅差GFL在短RoCoF测量窗口内的激活延迟折损。

Conclusion: 提出以二维惯量能力曲线 H(λ,V_{g,min}) 作为类似同步机P–Q图的并网导则工具，用于评估和规范IBR的惯量供给能力。

Abstract: As inverter-based resources (IBRs) displace synchronous generators, the inertia they can actually contribute to the grid becomes a critical planning parameter. Unlike synchronous machines, this contribution is bounded simultaneously by the available energy reserve, the converter power rating combined with voltage ride-through (VRT) obligations, and the inertia-emulation control scheme with its activation delay. This paper derives each bound in closed form and combines them into a unified envelope $\Heff(t,λ,V_g)=\min(\HE,\HP,\HC)$, which uses parameters accessible to the system operator to quantify how much inertia a plant can provide at a given loading $λ$, grid voltage $V_g$, and time $t$ after a disturbance. The analysis shows that below a loading-dependent critical voltage, VRT reactive-current priority does not leave active-current headroom for inertial power injection; that the converter overload ratio $κ$ matters mainly during voltage dips; and that de-loading yields a linear, quantifiable inertia gain, while collocated energy storage (ESS) removes the source-coupling constraint, making grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) plants with storage equivalent post-activation, up to the GFL activation-delay discount within short RoCoF measurement windows. Simulations on the IEEE 9-bus system confirm the framework and motivate a two-dimensional inertia capability curve $H(λ,V_{g,\min})$ as a grid-code instrument analogous to the P--Q diagram of synchronous generators.

</details>


### [377] [Two-Timescale Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Optimization and Economic NMPC: Experimental Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35141)
*Saket Adhau,Jose Matias,Sebastien Gros,Sigurd Skogestad*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种强化学习框架，同时调节RTO与经济非线性模型预测控制（ENMPC），以应对过程系统中的对象-模型失配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过程系统普遍存在对象-模型失配，传统RTO与ENMPC难以在扰动和噪声下保持经济性与约束可行性，且缺乏实验层面的验证。

Method: 借鉴modifier-adaptation思想，对动态模型、阶段代价、约束以及RTO修正项进行参数化，并利用Q-learning在两个时间尺度上更新：ENMPC快速更新、RTO慢速更新。

Result: 在三井海底采油网络实验台上验证：相比名义ENMPC，该方案经济收益提高8.6%，保持输入可行性，在扰动与测量噪声下经验性满足路径约束，并使模型参数沿对经济目标影响最大的方向趋近于独立辨识的参考对象参数。

Conclusion: 该工作首次通过实验示范了RL调优的ENMPC与RTO的集成方案，验证了其在真实过程系统上的有效性。

Abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that tunes both Real-Time Optimization (RTO) and Economic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (ENMPC) to address plant--model mismatch in process systems. Drawing on modifier-adaptation concepts, the method parameterizes the dynamic model, stage costs, constraints, and RTO modifiers, and uses Q-learning to adjust these parameters at two timescales: a fast update for the ENMPC layer and a slow update for the RTO layer. The framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory rig emulating a three-well subsea oil-production network. Using plant measurement data, the proposed RTO-RLMPC scheme achieves 8.6% higher economic profit than nominal ENMPC, preserves input feasibility of the deployed ENMPC policy and empirically satisfies the path constraints under disturbances and measurement noise, and drives the learned model parameters toward reference plant values, independently identified from experimental data, along the directions that most affect the economic objective. This work provides one of the first experimental demonstrations of RL-tuned ENMPC integrated with RTO.

</details>


### [378] [Strategically Robust Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35142)
*Victor L. Qin,Nicolas Lanzetti,Saverio Bolognani,Hamsa Balakrishnan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种"策略鲁棒"的动态势博弈轨迹规划方法，应对非集中式AAM中智能体不精确执行均衡轨迹的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AAM交通管理去中心化，需要飞行器通过预测他机控制输入自主规划轨迹。现有博弈论方法将多机避碰建模为精确动态势博弈，能高效求开环均衡，但假设各机严格遵循均衡轨迹，忽略了执行、感知与计算的不确定性，不切实际。

Method: 构造策略鲁棒博弈：每个智能体针对一个虚拟对手进行防护，该对手在每步以有限预算扰动他机控制输入以最小化当步距离。证明在合理的距离代价与鲁棒水平假设下，该博弈仍为精确动态势博弈，且对线性动力学，内层对抗问题存在准闭式解，从而控制计算开销。

Result: 最多8个智能体、采用对数距离代价的实验表明：策略鲁棒性能在高碰撞风险构型下选出更鲁棒的轨迹，而低风险轨迹几乎不变，运行时仅小幅增加。

Conclusion: 策略鲁棒性可在保持势博弈高效求解的同时提升轨迹对扰动的鲁棒性，代价是有限的额外计算。

Abstract: Aviation authorities worldwide expect Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) traffic management to be decentralized among service providers, requiring AAM flights to autonomously plan trajectories by predicting other flights' control inputs rather than relying on centralized coordination. Game-theoretic approaches that formulate multi-agent collision avoidance as an exact dynamic potential game can efficiently find open-loop equilibria, but they assume that agents exactly follow their equilibrium trajectories---an unrealistic assumption given uncertainties in actuation, perception, and computation. We propose a strategically robust formulation where each agent protects against a fictitious adversary that, for each timestep, perturbs other agents' control inputs within a bounded budget to minimize distance at that timestep. We show that, under reasonable assumptions on agents' distance cost and robustness levels, the strategically robust game remains an exact dynamic potential game and admits a quasi-closed-form solution to the inner adversarial problem for linear dynamics, which limits computational overhead. Experiments with up to eight agents using logarithmic distance costs show that strategic robustness selects more robust trajectories in high-collision-risk configurations while leaving low-risk trajectories nearly unchanged, with only a modest increase in runtime.

</details>


### [379] [Hard-Constrained Probabilistic Factor Graph Neural Network for Distribution System State Estimation under Non-Gaussian Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35246)
*M. Furqan Azam,Marta Vanin,Chris Hermans,Geert Deconinck*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出HCP-PINN，将配电网状态估计建模为因子图上的概率约束估计问题，结合硬物理约束与非高斯不确定性建模，精度、物理一致性和鲁棒性优于深度学习基准和数值估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电网可靠运行需要鲁棒准确的状态估计。传统数值估计器（如加权最小二乘）计算慢，且在稀疏、非高斯噪声测量下易出现收敛问题。现有物理信息神经网络（PINN）通过残差惩罚项引入物理原理，虽提升噪声鲁棒性和效率，但惩罚方式无法在推理时严格满足物理约束，且缺乏原则性的不确定性建模支持。

Method: 提出硬约束物理信息因子图神经网络（HCP-PINN），将配电网状态估计表述为因子图上的概率约束估计问题。通过灵活的闭式似然损失函数显式建模非高斯（伪）测量不确定性；引入基于可微优化的估计层，严格强制非线性等式约束和测量一致性，在训练和推理阶段均产生物理可行的状态估计。据称是首个将硬物理约束与非高斯不确定性建模相结合、面向不平衡三相网络的PINN型DSSE框架。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提方法比深度学习基准和数值估计器提供更准确、物理更一致的状态估计，同时对网络模型误差具有更强鲁棒性，并在真实测量场景下具备更高的计算效率。

Conclusion: HCP-PINN通过硬约束+非高斯不确定性建模，克服了传统数值估计器和惩罚式PINN的局限，为不平衡三相配电网状态估计提供了更准确、鲁棒且高效的方案。

Abstract: Robust and accurate state estimation is fundamental for the reliable operation and monitoring of active distribution networks. Conventional numerical estimators, such as weighted least squares, are computationally slower and often suffer from convergence issues in the presence of sparse measurements affected by non-Gaussian noise. Physics-informed neural networks have recently emerged as a promising alternative by incorporating physical principles through residual-based penalty terms in the objective, which can improve robustness to noise and computational efficiency. However, such penalty-based approaches do not guarantee strict enforcement of physical constraints during inference and provide limited support for principled uncertainty modeling. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Hard-Constrained, Physics-Informed Factor Graph Neural Network (HCP-PINN) that formulates distribution system state estimation as a probabilistic constrained estimation problem on a factor graph. The proposed approach explicitly models non-Gaussian (pseudo-)measurement uncertainty through flexible, closed-form likelihood-based loss functions. It further incorporates a differentiable optimization-based estimation layer that strictly enforces nonlinear equality constraints and measurement consistency, producing physically feasible state estimates during both training and inference. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first PINN-based DSSE framework to combine hard physical constraints with non-Gaussian uncertainty modeling for unbalanced three-phase networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method delivers more accurate and physically consistent state estimates than deep learning benchmarks and numerical estimators, while exhibiting greater robustness to network model errors and improved computational efficiency under realistic measurement scenarios.

</details>


### [380] [Scalable Small-Signal Stability Assessment of Power Systems Based on Frequency-Domain Quadratic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35424)
*Xiaoying Liu,Linbin Huang,Hangyu Chen,Huanhai Xin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出基于频域二次约束(FQC)的可扩展小信号稳定性评估方法，统一多种现有稳定判据，并通过全乘子FQC降低保守性，实现规模化稳定性认证与设备级诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFL与GFM异构换流器大规模接入使电力电子主导系统的稳定性分析愈发困难。经典集中式方法(特征值分析、广义Nyquist判据)可扩展性差，且现有稳定条件保守性高，难以进行设备级诊断。

Method: 基于频域二次约束(FQC)构建稳定性判据，证明DW壳、数值范围、x-z图、SRG、混合增益-相位条件、无源性条件等均为其特例；进一步提出全乘子FQC条件，构造优化问题，结合混合增益-相位条件形成分层筛选-诊断流程。

Result: 所提方法比现有判据保守性更低；可提供量化稳定指标，实现无需图形检查的可扩展稳定性认证和设备级诊断；案例验证能有效识别与潜在失稳风险相关的故障设备。

Conclusion: FQC框架为多换流器系统提供了统一、可扩展且低保守的稳定性分析与诊断方法，兼具理论统一性与工程实用性。

Abstract: Small-signal stability analysis of power electronics-dominated power systems is becoming increasingly challenging due to the large-scale integration of heterogeneous grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) converters. Classical centralized methods, such as eigenvalue analysis and the generalized Nyquist criterion, provide direct stability assessment tools but exhibit limited scalability as the system size increases. This motivates scalable analysis methods for stability assessment and device-level diagnosis, and calls for less conservative stability conditions. To this end, this paper proposes a scalable small-signal stability assessment method with quantitative stability indices for multi-converter systems based on frequency-domain quadratic constraints (FQCs). It is shown that several existing stability conditions, including geometric conditions based on the Davis-Wielandt (DW) shell, numerical range, $x$-$z$ graph, scaled relative graph (SRG), mixed gain-phase condition, and passivity condition, are special cases of the FQC-based stability condition. This FQC-based formulation also clarifies the requirements for decentralized verification of these existing stability conditions. To further reduce conservatism, a full-multiplier FQC-based stability condition is developed, based on which an optimization problem is formulated for scalable stability certification and device-level diagnosis using quantitative stability indices without relying on graphical inspection. Combined with the mixed gain-phase condition, this optimization problem forms a hierarchical screening-diagnosis procedure that improves efficiency. Case studies demonstrate that the proposed method is less conservative than existing criteria and can effectively identify problematic devices associated with potential instability risks.

</details>


### [381] [Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35758)
*Min Kim,José Leonardo Brenes,Fred Hadaegh,Soon-Jo Chung*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种表示学习框架，将经典干扰抑制控制(DAC)与末层自适应方法连接，用hard-EM学习均匀收缩的干扰动态表示，实现复合自适应跟踪控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态耦合干扰下的复合自适应跟踪控制具有挑战性。经典DAC与近期末层自适应干扰抑制方法之间存在割裂，且既有末层方法多为"固定衰减"表示，缺乏对干扰动态演化的学习与预测能力。

Method: 引入统计意义上的hard-EM过程：hard E步使用Kalman平滑器，识别潜伏演化为均匀收缩的动态干扰表示。该表示从测量到的被控对象特征与控制输入中演化出潜在干扰激励状态，并解码为作用于名义对象的时变干扰，从而把固定衰减的末层自适应方法推广为可学习的、预测式DAC表述。再结合对学习到的潜在状态的贝叶斯滤波，构成具预测能力的复合自适应跟踪控制器。

Result: 理论上证明控制器指数收敛到一个有界邻域。实验在带液体晃动罐与摆负载的湿滑地面车辆上验证，并在耦合Duffing振子系统中评估鲁棒性；相比固定衰减表示学习消融、LTI干扰抑制基线和基于模型的PD基线，实现了更准确的干扰预测与更优的整体跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了DAC与末层自适应表示学习，赋予控制器预测能力并具收敛保证，在多种复杂干扰场景下优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: We present a representation-learning framework for composite adaptive tracking control under dynamically coupled disturbances. The framework connects classical disturbance-accommodating control (DAC) to recent last-layer adaptive disturbance-rejection methods. Specifically, we introduce a statistically principled hard expectation-maximization (hard-EM) procedure, with a Kalman smoother in the hard E-step, to identify dynamical representations of disturbance whose latent evolution is uniformly contractive. The learned representation evolves a latent disturbance-excitation state from measured plant features and control inputs and decodes that state into the time-varying disturbance acting on the nominal plant, thereby extending prior "fixed-decay" last-layer adaptive methods to a learned, predictive DAC-style formulation. Combined with Bayesian filtering of the learned latent state, this representation yields a composite adaptive tracking controller with predictive capability and provable exponential convergence to a bounded neighborhood. We validate our approach experimentally on a slippery ground vehicle carrying a liquid-sloshing tank and a pendulum load, and we further assess its robustness on a system of coupled Duffing oscillators. Across both settings, the method achieves accurate disturbance prediction and improved overall tracking performance relative to fixed-decay representation-learning ablations, LTI disturbance-accommodating baselines, and model-based PD baselines.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.PM'></div>

# q-fin.PM [[Back]](#toc)

### [382] [Taming the Greeks: Option Portfolios with Inductive Biases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33767)
*Wee Ling Tan,Stephen Roberts,Stefan Zohren*

Main category: q-fin.PM

TL;DR: 提出端到端深度学习期权交易框架，通过可微风险敏感度惩罚显式嵌入对冲行为，在历史数据上联合优化风险调整收益与风险中性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络优化的风险调整策略虽优于规则策略，但对组合在特定风险因子上的敏感度无控制；强化学习方法依赖模拟市场动态近似对冲策略，存在局限。

Method: 将性能驱动损失与可微风险敏感度惩罚结合，构建通用训练目标以强制选定风险维度中性。完全基于历史数据，在单一学习问题中联合优化。实例化为静态delta中性跨式组合，针对一阶方向性暴露，测试两种惩罚变体：暴露归一化惩罚与希腊字母比率漂移惩罚。

Result: 在纳斯达克100股票期权上的实证表明，适当校准的正则化相比无正则化基线同时提升样本外风险调整表现并降低实际方向性暴露。

Conclusion: 该框架为系统性期权交易提供了在历史数据上直接嵌入对冲行为、同时优化收益与风险约束的有效途径。

Abstract: We present an end-to-end deep learning framework for systematic options trading that directly embeds hedging behavior through explicit control of portfolio-level risk exposures. While neural networks trained to optimize risk-adjusted performance have been shown to outperform traditional rules-based strategies, such approaches remain agnostic to the sensitivities of the resulting portfolios with respect to specific underlying risk factors. We propose a general training objective that combines a performance-driven loss with a differentiable risk-sensitivity penalty, enforcing neutrality to selected risk dimensions. Unlike reinforcement learning methods that approximate optimal hedging policies via simulated market dynamics, our framework operates entirely on historical data and jointly optimizes risk-adjusted returns and targeted risk constraints in a single learning problem. We instantiate the framework on static delta-neutral straddle portfolios with the penalty directed at first-order directional exposure, and evaluate two penalty variants -- an exposure-normalized penalty and a Greek-ratio drift penalty. Empirical results on Nasdaq 100 equity options demonstrate that appropriately calibrated regularization simultaneously improves out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance relative to an unregularized baseline while reducing realized directional exposure.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [383] [The Death of the Legal Author. Authority, Intention, And Law-Creation in the Advent of GenAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31621)
*Julieta A. Rabanos,Bojan Spaić*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨"AI能否创造和解释法律"这一被忽视的前置问题，论证LLM（如ChatGPT）能在无意图的情况下生成法律文本，进而支持"法律可以在无意图下被创造和解释"的论点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI（基于大语言模型的聊天机器人）正在冲击法律领域，但法哲学多聚焦于规范性追问"AI是否应当创造和解释法律"，却很少关注更根本的前置问题——"AI是否有能力创造和解释法律"（即AI能否成为"法律作者"）。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 概念分析与论证。首先界定法律权威、法律作者身份与法律解释，指出确定性的权威作者之意图常被视为创造和解释当代法律文本的可能性条件；其次论证LLM/ChatGPT在无意图状态下生成法律文本；再次考察那些淡化或取消"意图"在规范性文本法律性讨论中作用的学者立场；最后论证应支持这一立场。

Result: LLM（尤其ChatGPT）能够生成法律文本，但其中不包含任何意图。这一事实对"法律必须在创制背后存在意图"的传统观点构成挑战。

Conclusion: 无意图的能动者（如ChatGPT）能够创造法律文本，这支持了"法律可以在创制背后没有意图的情况下被创造，且非意图性创制可被解释以得出法律规范"这一论点。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence in the form of chatbots based on large language models (LLMs) has taken the world of law by storm. Philosophy of law is struggling to catch up with the theoretical significance of the advent of technological development and the way it may modify traditionally established understanding of legal phenomena, such as law-creation and authority. In this sense, for the most part, heated philosophical debates have circled around a normative question: "Should AI create and interpret law?". Much less attention has been given to a different, albeit previous, question: "Can AI create and interpret law?" That is, is AI capable of producing outputs that can be deemed as "law" (at least, law as we know it)? Can AI be a "legal author"? This paper explores this unattended question and endeavours to provide some provisional answers. In the first part, we define legal authority, legal authorship, and legal interpretation and claim that the intention of a determinate authoritative author is often considered the condition of the possibility of creating and interpreting contemporary legal texts. In the second part, we argue that LLM AI, in general, and ChatGPT, in particular, generate legal texts without having any intention. In the third part, we consider the positions of the authors that downplay or even eliminate intention from the discussions about the legal character of prescriptive texts. Finally, we argue that there are good reasons to side with the second group of authors. The ability of agents without intentions, like ChatGPT, to create legal text is an argument in favour of the thesis that law can be created without intention behind the creation and that nonintentional creation can be interpreted to arrive at legal norms.

</details>


### [384] [The Multi-Lab Enterprise: Governance, FinOps, and Telemetry Challenges of Multi-Model AI Adoption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31622)
*Fabricio F. Costa*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 企业普遍采用多模型供应商授权（multi-lab），这是市场的结构性特征而非过渡阶段，由此带来治理、FinOps 和遥测三大运营难题，而根本缺失的是一个跨供应商的企业级 AI 控制平面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业并非只选一家前沿 AI 供应商，而是全都要授权——2026 年初 81% 的全球 2000 强企业运行三种以上模型家族。作者意在证明多实验室授权是市场结构性特征（由任务级的持久模型差异化驱动），而非等待商品化的过渡阶段，并揭示由此产生的运营问题。

Method: 综合调查数据、交易数据、供应商披露及金融、法律、咨询、医疗、生命科学、零售和政府等行业的案例研究进行分析；并构建一个五指标框架评估 API 与智能体成本消耗，配合一个实操示例。

Result: 揭示三大运营问题——治理碎片化（P1，异构安全态势与合规面需在重叠监管框架下协调，影子 AI 蔓延）、FinOps 失效（P2，基于 token、行为驱动的消耗使预算失效，过去一年 79% 企业超支，FinOps 成熟组织平均超支 30.9%，无跨供应商标准化支出单位）、遥测碎片化（P3，各实验室控制台/API/指标定义不兼容，需定制统一层）。并梳理了 LLM 网关、可观测性平台及 Tokenomics Foundation 的 FOCUS 扩展等应对方案。示例显示：每次尝试成本最低的模型，在每次成功任务上反而最贵。

Conclusion: P1、P2、P3 共同指向一个缺失的抽象：跨供应商的企业级 AI 控制平面。

Abstract: Enterprises are not choosing a single frontier AI provider; they are licensing all of them. As of early 2026, 81% of Global 2000 enterprises run three or more model families, and OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini together account for roughly 88 to 89% of enterprise LLM usage and spend. Drawing on survey data, transaction data, provider disclosures, and case studies across finance, legal, consulting, healthcare, life sciences, retail, and government, this paper shows that multi-lab licensing is a structural feature of the market, driven by durable task-specific model differentiation rather than a transitional phase awaiting commoditization. This structure creates three operational problems. Governance fragmentation (P1): heterogeneous vendor security postures, documentation, and compliance surfaces must be reconciled across overlapping regulatory frameworks while shadow AI proliferates. FinOps breakdown (P2): token-based, behavior-driven consumption defeats budgeting. In the past year, 79% of enterprises overran AI budgets, with FinOps-mature organizations overshooting by a mean of 30.9%, and no standardized cross-provider unit of spend exists. Telemetry fragmentation (P3): each lab exposes adoption and cost data through incompatible consoles, APIs, and metric definitions, forcing bespoke unification layers. We map the emerging responses, including LLM gateways, observability platforms, and the Tokenomics Foundation's FOCUS extension. We then develop a five-metric framework for evaluating API and agent cost burn, with a worked example where the cheapest model per attempt is the most expensive per successful task. We conclude that P1, P2, and P3 reflect one missing abstraction: a cross-provider enterprise AI control plane.

</details>


### [385] [Digital Twins for Small Towns and Rural Regions: Data Integration, Simulation and Visualisation Across Three Use Cases in Lower Austria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31623)
*Thomas Delissen,Lukas Daniel Klausner,Maximilian Lackner,Torsten Priebe,Lőrinc Thurnay*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该论文针对小城镇和农村地区，采用设计科学研究方法将数字孪生概念本地化，在下奥地利州通过利益相关者研讨会确定并实现了三个原型（交通流量规划、人口增长、共享空间），并对可行性进行了技术评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智慧城市与数字孪生虽有助于改善地方治理与规划，但实践几乎都集中于大都市地区。小城镇和农村面临数据有限、预算紧张、数字化能力低等独特挑战，无法直接照搬城市方法。

Method: 依托"下奥地利州智慧城市与数字孪生"项目，采用设计科学研究方法，通过与市政当局的利益相关者研讨会确定三个用例，并实现为原型数字孪生：交通流量规划（侧重数据集成）、人口增长（侧重仿真）、共享空间（侧重可视化）。

Result: 描述并实现了三个原型数字孪生的设计与实现，并对其可行性进行了技术评估，揭示了资源受限环境下数字孪生的潜力与具体局限。

Conclusion: 研究为小城镇和农村等非城市场景中的市政当局、政策制定者和研究人员提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Smart city and digital twin concepts hold considerable potential for improving local governance and planning, yet practical implementations have almost exclusively focused on large metropolitan areas. Small towns and rural regions face a distinct set of challenges -- limited data availability, constrained budgets and lower digital capacity -- that make a direct transfer of urban approaches infeasible. This article presents results from the ongoing project "Smart Cities and Digital Twins in Lower Austria", which adapts digital twin concepts for small-town and rural contexts following a design science research approach. Based on stakeholder workshops with municipalities in Lower Austria, three use cases were identified and implemented as prototype digital twins: traffic flow planning (emphasising data integration), population growth (emphasising simulation) and shared spaces (emphasising visualisation). We describe the design and implementation of each prototype and report on a technical evaluation of their feasibility. Our findings highlight both the potential and the specific limitations of digital twins in resource-constrained settings and offer practical guidance for municipalities, policymakers and researchers working in non-urban contexts.

</details>


### [386] [Analysis of Regional Disparities of Location of Sports Facilities and Sports Education Using Scientific Satellite Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31624)
*Shoichi Otomo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文是日文论文（Otomo, 2024）的英文翻译扩展版，利用夜间灯光数据（nightlight data）分析体育设施空间分布、健身产业演变及区域体育获取的环境差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICT与数据分析技术进步使大数据处理成为可能，开放数据推广也在推进；但发展中地区和部分市町村的本地统计数据稀缺、不可靠，且宏观经济指标在跨区域/国际比较中存在固有局限。夜间灯光数据作为高频卫星数据，应用潜力大，为弥补统计缺口提供了新途径。

Method: 基于夜间灯光辐亮度与城市化相关性的既有发现（人口多、商业发达地区辐亮度高，而公共卫生、医疗等公共基础设施与灯光强度相关性低，Otomo 2021），将夜间灯光数据与体育设施空间分布、健身产业演变及区域体育获取差异进行关联分析，并对比公共与私营部门。

Result: 分析证实体育设施的空间分布格局在公共部门与私营部门之间存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 夜间灯光数据可作为补充传统统计与宏观经济指标的替代性数据源，用于揭示体育设施分布与体育获取的区域环境差异，尤其适用于统计数据匮乏的地区。

Abstract: This manuscript is an English translation and extended version of a paper originally published in Japanese (Otomo, 2024).
  With the advancement of information and communication technology (ICT) and data analysis techniques, handling massive datasets (big data) has become feasible in spatial information science. Consequently, infrastructure is being established to generate new utility value from spatial data. Furthermore, nationwide initiatives are actively promoting the use of open data - public information provided under terms allowing secondary usage.
  However, in developing regions and specific municipalities, local statistical data remain scarce, unreliable, or difficult to acquire. Additionally, long-standing concerns exist regarding the inherent limitations of standard macroeconomic indicators when performing cross-regional or international comparisons.
  Meanwhile, high-frequency satellite data has become widely accessible. Among various observational products, nightlight data has attracted significant attention due to its versatile applications.
  Generally, nightlight radiance correlates with urbanization. Prior work indicates that areas with larger populations and higher commercial development display higher radiance, whereas public infrastructure - such as sanitation systems and healthcare facilities - shows little correlation with nightlight intensity (Otomo, 2021). Building on these findings, this paper analyzes the relationship between nightlight data and the spatial distribution of sports facilities, the evolution of the fitness industry, and regional environmental disparities in sports access. The analysis confirms that the spatial distribution patterns of sports facilities differ significantly between the public and private sectors.

</details>


### [387] [Perceived and Actual AI Deepfakes: The Case of Sudan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31625)
*Eilaf Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 苏丹的AI深度伪造风险更多源自需求侧脆弱性，而非伪造内容数量。公众出于动机性推理和语境依赖而怀疑AI内容，而非基于检测能力，这使信息环境易受未来深度伪造攻击并可能麻木于真假之分。短期应优先采用与模态无关的需求侧干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别苏丹AI深度伪造风险的真实驱动因素，纠正对供给端内容的过度关注，为资源有限环境下的干预优先级提供依据。

Method: 对苏丹信息环境中的相关案例进行分析，考察AI生成内容的实际数量，以及公众对（疑似）深度伪造和AI的认知、态度与应对方式，区分动机性推理、语境依赖与技术检测能力的作用。

Result: 苏丹信息流中AI生成虚假信息数量有限；主要立场为不信任；接受或拒绝AI深度伪造更多反映信念驱动判断而非技术评估；这些薄弱防御加剧不确定性并易被未来复杂伪造行动利用。

Conclusion: 短期干预应优先发展模态无关的需求侧措施，如预先辟谣、AI素养、规模化事实核查和线索热线，以增强公众对各类虚假信息的抵抗力；技术性和供给端干预可随机构能力与技术成熟逐步发展。

Abstract: Sudan's AI deepfake risk currently appears driven more by demand-side vulnerabilities than the volume of AI deepfake content. While AI-generated disinformation in Sudanese feeds remains limited, perceived (alleged) AI deepfakes and general AI skepticism worsen the situation and contribute to general uncertainty in multimedia content. Within the analyzed cases, we found that the prominent stance was distrust driven more by motivated reasoning and contextual reliance than by durable AI detection skills. In practice, rejection or acceptance of AI deepfakes often reflects belief-driven judgment more than technical assessment. These weak defenses leave the information environment vulnerable to future sophisticated AI deepfake campaigns and risk normalizing truth indifference. Short-term interventions should prioritize modality-agnostic demand-side interventions such as pre-bunking, AI literacy, scaled fact-checks, and tiplines that strengthen public resilience across all forms of disinformation. More technical AI- specific and supply-side interventions can be developed as institutional capacity and technology allow.

</details>


### [388] [The Potential of Nighttime Light Imagery for Detailed Local Economic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33859)
*Shoichi Otomo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文是日文论文(2022)的英文翻译扩展版，介绍一种针对夜间灯光影像的栅格处理技术，并以新潟县汤泽町为案例，分析旅游到访量与当地经济及体育/旅游吸引物之间的时空关系，展示夜间灯光数据可捕捉传统宏观指标难以察觉的市町村内部经济动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感与大数据处理技术进步推动空间技术在经济研究中应用。卫星夜间灯光强度虽广泛用于追踪区域GDP、就业、人口等宏观经济指标，但针对地方旅游经济的精细化空间处理方法关注不足，尤其缺乏对市町村内部经济动态的刻画。

Method: 首先详细介绍一种应用于夜间灯光影像的栅格处理技术；随后以新潟县鱼沼郡汤泽町为案例，分析当地经济与体育/旅游吸引物，具体考察旅游到访量与多类地方统计数据之间的时空关系。

Result: 研究揭示夜间灯光数据能够捕捉通过标准宏观经济指标无法探测到的市町村内部经济动态，并呈现旅游到访量与当地统计数据的时空关联。

Conclusion: 夜间灯光栅格处理为地方旅游经济提供细粒度空间分析工具，可弥补宏观指标的不足，对地方经济研究具有方法与应用价值。

Abstract: This manuscript is an English translation and extended version of a paper originally published in Japanese (2022). Driven by remarkable advances in remote sensing and big data processing, spatial technologies are increasingly leveraged in economic research.
