While satellite nighttime light intensity is widely recognized for tracking macroeconomic parameters - such as regional GDP, employment, and population - less attention has been paid to fine-grained spatial processing methodologies for local tourism economies. This study first details a raster processing technique applied to nightlight imagery. It then focuses on Yuzawa Town (Uonuma District, Niigata Prefecture), analyzing the local economy and sports/tourist attractions. Specifically, I investigate the spatio-temporal relationships between tourist arrivals and various local statistical datasets. Furthermore, this paper highlights how nightlight data can capture intra-municipal economic dynamics that remain undetectable through standard macroeconomic indicators.

</details>


### [389] [HIPAA-Compliant AI Deployment Patterns in Clinical Settings: Privacy-Preserving Techniques and Governance Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31626)
*Vinod Dhiman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出临床AI的五个可复用部署模式，联合满足HIPAA隐私与安全规则，并映射到NIST AI RMF和ISO/IEC 42001。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床AI需处理受保护健康信息（PHI），受HIPAA约束，且缺乏共享工程指导；现有研究把隐私保护机器学习与监管治理割裂，从业者缺少从架构决策到合规义务的具体映射。

Method: 提供五个部署模式目录：去标识化分析区、跨实体联邦学习、可信执行环境内机密推理、PHI最小化检索增强临床助手、合成数据沙箱；每个模式按上下文、治理力量、结构、残留风险规范，并映射HIPAA安全规则 safeguard 及NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001；另提出临床AI威胁模型与基于数据敏感性、信任边界、延迟需求的决策流程。

Result: 给出五个模式及其合规映射、威胁模型和选择决策程序，将抽象监管义务转化为可验证的架构控制。

Conclusion: 为安全工程师、合规负责人和临床信息学家提供共同词汇，促进HIPAA合规的临床AI部署。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from research prototypes into clinical workflows, yet the deployment of AI systems that process protected health information (PHI) remains constrained by the U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and by the absence of shared engineering guidance for satisfying it. Existing work tends to treat privacy-preserving machine learning and regulatory governance as separate concerns, leaving practitioners without a concrete mapping from architectural decisions to compliance obligations. This paper contributes a catalog of five reusable deployment patterns for clinical AI that jointly address the HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules: a de-identified analytics zone, cross-entity federated learning, confidential inference within trusted execution environments, a PHI-minimizing retrieval-augmented clinical assistant, and a synthetic data sandbox for development. Each pattern is specified in terms of context, governing forces, structure, and residual risk, and is mapped to the administrative, physical, and technical safeguards of the HIPAA Security Rule as well as to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC~42001. We further present a threat model for clinical AI and a decision procedure for selecting patterns based on data sensitivity, trust boundaries, and latency requirements. The goal is to give security engineers, compliance owners, and clinical informaticists a common vocabulary that turns abstract regulatory duties into verifiable architectural controls.

</details>


### [390] [Anatomy of a Spreadsheet Failure, Analysing the EuSpRIG Horror Story Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31815)
*Simon Thorne,Angela Collins*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于EuSpRIG恐怖故事档案，清洗去重后分析1995–2026年间121起电子表格事故，划分为十二类失效，指出风险已从"数字算错"扩展到"隐藏/嵌入数据导致的可见性、披露、治理与信任问题"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子表格灾难已被记录三十余年却仍未消失，需要系统证据说明普通电子表格如何失效、后果如何，以及为何旧有分类不足以解释当前危害。

Method: 对EuSpRIG horror stories档案进行清洗与去重，得到1995–2026年共121起事故，按失效机制、情境与后果归为十二个类别进行分析。

Result: 公式错误、录入失误与数据处理错误共71起，贯穿整个时期（1995年Fidelity漏写负号至2024年挪威主权基金因日期笔误损失约9200万美元）；隐藏行、隐藏工作表、数据透视表缓存、嵌入对象与保留源层等"不可见信息"类事故报告增长最明显，最严重为2022年英国国防部因隐藏行泄露约18700名阿富汗申请人信息。

Conclusion: 电子表格风险不再只是数字错误问题，还涉及可见性、披露、治理与信任；既有分类仍适用于公式/录入/处理错误，但无法充分涵盖电子表格作为"失控运营基础设施"带来的公共危害——三十年错误未变，变的是组织赋予电子表格的权威。

Abstract: Spreadsheet disasters have been documented for more than thirty years, but they have not gone away. This paper examines the EuSpRIG horror stories archive as evidence of how ordinary spreadsheets fail and the consequences that follow. After cleaning and deduplication, 121 incidents from 1995 to 2026 were classified into twelve failure categories and analysed by mechanism, context and consequence. Formula errors, data-entry slips and data-handling mistakes account for 71 cases and recur across the whole period, from Fidelity's missing minus sign in 1995 to a mistyped date that cost Norway's sovereign wealth fund about $92 million in 2024. A second pattern concerns information present in a workbook but not visible to the recipient: hidden rows, hidden sheets, pivot-table caches, embedded objects and retained source layers can cause harm even when no calculation is wrong. The clearest rise in reported cases is in this hidden or embedded data category, whose most serious example is the 2022 Ministry of Defence spreadsheet that exposed details of roughly 18,700 Afghan applicants through hidden rows. The paper argues that spreadsheet risk is no longer only a problem of wrong numbers. It also involves visibility, disclosure, governance and trust. Existing taxonomies remain useful for formula, entry and handling errors, but do not fully capture the public harm caused by spreadsheets used as uncontrolled operational infrastructure. The same mistakes have persisted for three decades, what has changed is the authority organisations give to the spreadsheets that contain them.

</details>


### [391] [Who Governs Data in the AI Era? A Computational Analysis of the U.S. Privacy Workforce in Job Postings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32030)
*Ramazan Yener,Muhammad Hassan,Masooda Bashir*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 分析1143份美国隐私岗位招聘信息，发现隐私职位高度混合，融合法律、技术与人际能力；AI相关内容出现在超半数岗位中，AI治理职责常嵌入现有隐私角色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私保护涉及法律、技术与管理多重职责，隐私专业人才需求增长，但雇主如何定义这些角色尚不清楚。

Method: 分析LinkedIn与Indeed上的1143份美国隐私招聘信息，采用规则文本挖掘考察职位名称、薪资、能力、证书、教育、经验、监管引用及AI语言，并用BERTopic主题建模识别18个潜在主题，归为四类。

Result: 隐私岗位呈混合特征，结合法律知识、技术技能与人际能力；AI出现在过半招聘信息中，相关语言分布于合规、法律、治理与安全等主题。

Conclusion: AI治理职责常嵌入既有隐私角色，催生混合岗位，同时也出现专门的AI治理职位。

Abstract: Privacy protection now spans legal, technical, and managerial duties, and demand for privacy professionals is growing across sectors. However, little is known about how employers define these roles. We analyze 1,143 U.S. privacy job postings from LinkedIn and Indeed. We examine job titles, salaries, competencies, certifications, education, experience, regulatory references, and AI-related language by using rule-based text mining. We also apply Topic Modeling (BERTopic) to the same postings and identify 18 latent themes which we grouped them into four categories. Our findings show that privacy roles are hybrid and they combine legal knowledge, technical skills, and interpersonal competence. Artificial intelligence appears in more than half of postings, with AI language spread across compliance, legal, governance and security themes. Our research indicates that AI governance responsibilities are often embedded within existing privacy roles, contributing to the rise of hybrid positions alongside dedicated AI governance roles.

</details>


### [392] [Period Segmentation in Transition Network Analysis: A Topological Data Analysis Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32094)
*Hitoshi Inoue,Koichi Yasutake*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文用Zigzag持续同调的连通分量(β₀)变点对TNA中的学习行为做数据驱动分段，发现其分段比时间分段更能捕捉期间差异，但末段行为与学业结果相关性更低，表明β₀变点更适合识别干预窗口而非提升预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cristea等发现将课程按二分之一/四分之一分段可揭示学习策略演化与学业表现的关系，但这类时间分段是人为设定的。本文希望探索Topological Data Analysis（TDA）能否提供数据驱动的分期边界，从而识别更有效的干预窗口。

Method: 分析Open University Learning Analytics Dataset中的22门课程，采用Zigzag Persistent Homology中的连通分量（β₀）变点作为分段边界，并与基于时间的分段进行对比；使用方差比(VR)、置换检验等评估分段效果。

Result: β₀分段捕捉的期间间变异大于时间分段（中位VR=4.10×，21/22门课VR>1.1）；18%的课程置换检验显著(p<0.05)，73%优于随机断点，仅1门课时间分段更优。但末段行为与学业结果的相关性低于时间分段，反映学习者快速脱离的"行为崩溃"现象。

Conclusion: 末段行为反映而非导致结果：将及格的学生保持参与，将不及格的学生脱离。因此β₀变点的价值不在于提升预测，而在于识别行为结构发生转移、针对性支持最可能有效的干预窗口。

Abstract: Temporal dynamics in learning behavior can be revealed through period segmentation in Transition Network Analysis (TNA). Cristea et al. demonstrated that segmenting courses into halves and quarters reveals how learning strategies evolve and relate to academic performance. Building on this approach, we investigate whether Topological Data Analysis (TDA), specifically connected components ($β_0$) change points from Zigzag Persistent Homology, can provide data-driven period boundaries that identify intervention windows. Analyzing 22 courses from the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset, we find that $β_0$-based segmentation captures greater between-period variation than time-based segmentation (median variance ratio (VR) = 4.10$\times$; 21/22 courses show VR $>$ 1.1). Permutation tests confirmed significance ($p < 0.05$) in 18% of individual courses, with 73% showing positive improvement over random breakpoints. Only one course showed better performance with time-based segmentation. However, analysis of academic outcomes reveals a key insight: final-period behavior shows lower correlation with outcomes in $β_0$-based segmentation than in time-based segmentation, reflecting a marked behavioral collapse where engaged learners rapidly disengage. We interpret this as evidence that final-period behavior reflects rather than causes outcomes: students who will pass maintain engagement, while those who will fail disengage. This reframes the value of $β_0$: rather than improving prediction, change points identify intervention windows. These are periods where behavioral structure shifts and targeted support may be most effective.

</details>


### [393] [Generative AI & Two Forms of Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32637)
*Shira Gur-Arieh,Sina Fazelpour*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI带来的"解耦问题"：文本可脱离其生产过程而被生成，从而削弱该过程所承载的价值（证据、诱导与构成性功能），并提出机构应对的理论框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本的价值常不只在文字本身，而在于其背后的人类活动（如用心写邮件、真诚道歉、法官撰写判决理由）。AI使人们可以不经历这些活动就产出文本，切断了文本与这些价值的联系，构成"解耦问题"。作者欲厘清此举究竟威胁了什么。

Method: 概念与规范分析，提出三层论证框架：一是对"生产过程为何有价值"的分类（证据性、诱导性、构成性）；二是将文本视为"边界物"，说明机构可共用同一文本而回避对实践价值的分歧，并指出AI造成"二阶解耦"；三是分析机构"修复"解耦的努力的后果。

Result: 修复解耦往往只能恢复部分功能而非全部；机构倾向保留更易识别、损失更紧迫或相关利益方更有影响力的功能，导致部分利益被忽视。

Conclusion: 呼吁对"应保留一项实践的哪些具体功能"进行更明确的审议，并确保那些利益易被忽视者的实质性代表，以在AI时代重构基于文本的机构实践。

Abstract: Textual artifacts are sometimes valued not only for the words on the page, but for the human activity involved in producing them. The effort invested in a carefully tailored email can signal genuine interest; composing an apology might involve attending to another person's hurt and deciding how to respond; and requiring a judge to give written reasons may induce more careful deliberation. AI models create what we call a decoupling problem: they make it possible to produce text without undergoing the relevant human activity, severing its connection to values traditionally sustained by that activity. This Article develops a framework for understanding what decoupling puts at stake, and how institutions that use text to make consequential decisions may reshape their practices in response. First, it offers a taxonomy of the grounds for valuing the production process, distinguishing whether that process matters for what it evidences, induces, or helps constitute. Second, it argues that text can function as a kind of boundary object, allowing institutions to rely on the same artifact without resolving disagreements about why the practice is valuable. AI can separate functions previously served by the same practice - a second-order decoupling that brings unresolved questions about the practice's purposes into view. Third, it argues that institutional efforts to repair decoupling may recover some functions without preserving others. Such responses are likely to favor functions that are more legible, whose loss demands immediate attention, or whose stakeholders have greater influence. It therefore calls for more explicit deliberation about which particular functions of a practice to preserve, with meaningful representation for those whose interests might otherwise be overlooked.

</details>


### [394] [Environmental Impact of Generative and Agentic AI: An in-Depth Analysis and Green Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32960)
*Abderaouf Bahi,Amel Ourici,Ibtissem Gasmi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对现代AI系统（LLM、多模态基础模型、智能体工作流）全生命周期的环境影响进行概念性分析，提出生命周期分类法、SAFIA评估框架及政策建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式与智能体AI的算力需求激增，但其环境后果（能耗、碳排放、水资源、电子废弃物）尚未得到充分审视。

Method: 概念性分析，基于已发表数据的数量级估算，未进行原始物理测量；构建生命周期分类法（生命周期阶段×五类影响维度×排放范围）与九项指标的SAFIA框架，并对比传统、生成式与智能体AI。

Result: 推理能耗在部署周期内可媲美或超过训练；智能体工作流能耗可达单次推理的1至数个数量级；间接水耗与隐含碳被系统性低估；测量工具、披露实践与监管落后于智能体部署。

Conclusion: 呼吁面向智能体的能耗测量、基于生命周期的碳与水核算，以及对大规模AI训练与部署的强制披露。作者还提出七大开放挑战、多方政策建议与2035年研究路线图。

Abstract: The proliferation of generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems has introduced computational demands whose environmental consequences are substantial yet underexamined. This paper examines the environmental footprint of modern AI systems across energy consumption, carbon emissions, water usage, and electronic waste over the full lifecycle of large language models, multimodal foundation models, and agentic workflows, from hardware fabrication and training through fine-tuning and inference to end-of-life disposal. This work provides a conceptual analysis, utilizing order-of-magnitude estimations based on published data, without conducting original physical measurements. We contribute a lifecycle taxonomy that crosses lifecycle phases with five impact dimensions and emission scopes; a Sustainability Assessment Framework for AI Systems (SAFIA) comprising nine indicators; a comparative analysis of traditional, generative, and agentic AI; seven open challenges; policy recommendations for regulators, cloud providers, hardware manufacturers, and AI developers; and a research roadmap to 2035. The analysis indicates that inference can rival or exceed training energy over a deployment lifetime, that agentic workflows can multiply the energy of equivalent single-pass inference by one to several orders of magnitude depending on the number of model and tool calls, that indirect water use and embodied carbon are systematically underreported, and that measurement tools, disclosure practices, and regulation have not kept pace with agentic deployment. These findings call for agent-aware energy measurement, lifecycle-based carbon and water accounting, and mandatory disclosure for large-scale AI training and deployment.

</details>


### [395] [His Name, Their Judgment: Expert Authority in Posthumous Persona AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32989)
*Hanjing Shi,Dominic DiFranzo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该文分析小红书/RedNote上关于已故教育顾问张雪峰的非官方AI人格化账号（persona）的115篇帖子及评论，探讨"获取专家身份"与"获取专业帮助"之间的区别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI人格化可让已故专家为生前未曾遇到的问题提供决策建议，而用户恰恰因缺乏判断其建议的知识才寻求这类人格化服务，由此产生信任与风险问题。

Method: 对小红书（RedNote）上115篇聚焦帖子及嵌套评论样本进行主题分析，研究中国教育顾问张雪峰的未授权AI人格化现象。

Result: 安装推销承诺提供专家指导，但家庭实际使用需依赖最新记录与情境判断；部分帖子将人格化定位为提问辅助而非专家替代；评论者把持续的专业性联系到更新、授权以及拒绝继续服务的能力。

Conclusion: 研究区分了"获取专家身份"与"获取专业帮助"。保持人格化更新会让在世者掌控已故者"所推荐"的内容，因此运营者需承担人格化所承诺的支持，并使其继续使用该身份的做法可被质疑。

Abstract: Persona AI can make deceased experts available for decisions they never encountered. Users may seek these personas precisely because they lack the knowledge needed to judge their advice. We thematically analyze 115 focal RedNote/Xiaohongshu posts and a nested comment sample concerning unofficial personas of Chinese education advisor Zhang Xuefeng. An installation offer promised expert guidance, while a family's reported use required current records and contextual judgment. Other posts positioned the persona as a questioning aid rather than an expert replacement. Commenters connected continued expertise to updating, permission, and the ability to refuse further work. These findings distinguish access to an expert identity from access to professional help. Keeping the persona current puts living actors in control of what the deceased appears to recommend. Operators therefore need to undertake the support promised by the persona while making their continued use of the person's identity open to challenge.

</details>


### [396] [Is AI Widening the Wage Gap? A Hybrid Agentic Simulation for Labor Equity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33367)
*Zhongbo Hu,Zonghang Wu,Georgina Curto,Aocheng Tang,Yilei Shao*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的混合智能体框架，结合社会人口数据模拟AI冲击下工资分布演变。结果显示AI冲击持续扩大工资差距、加剧收入不平等，而针对低收入工人的教育补贴可部分缓解该不平等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI正在重塑劳动力市场，但其对工资分布的影响及机制尚不清晰。传统分析方法难以直接考察持续AI冲击及反事实政策情景下工人行为和收入分布的动态演化；同时规则模型缺乏可扩展性，LLM智能体框架可解释性有限。

Method: 提出混合智能体（hybrid agentic）框架，兼顾规则模型的可扩展性与LLM智能体框架的可解释性；使用中国社会人口数据，在重复AI冲击下模拟工资分布变化，并进行反事实政策实验（如针对低收入工人的教育补贴），辅以多种LLM决策引擎与30次蒙特卡洛模拟做稳健性检验。

Result: 最高与最低收入十分位工人平均工资比（T10/B10）及基尼系数持续上升，表明AI冲击扩大工资差距并加剧收入不平等；该结论在不同LLM决策引擎和30次蒙特卡洛模拟下保持稳健。反事实实验显示，面向低收入工人的教育补贴增加技能升级尝试与成功次数，尤其提升最低收入十分位工人的升级成功概率，从而部分缓解工资不平等。

Conclusion: 该框架为考察AI冲击对工资分布的影响及机制提供了可解释的模拟方法，也为政策制定者评估干预政策提供了补充分析工具。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping labor markets, yet its effects on wage distribution and the underlying mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. Conventional analytical approaches are limited in their ability to directly examine the dynamic evolution of worker behavior and income distribution under sustained AI shocks and counterfactual policy scenarios. To address this limitation, we present a hybrid agentic framework that aims to challenges of scalability of rule-based models and the limited explainability in LLM-agentic frameworks. Using this framework and sociodemographic data from China, we simulate changes in wage distribution under repeated AI shocks. The results show that both the average-wage ratio between workers in the top and bottom income deciles (T10/B10) and the Gini coefficient increase persistently, suggesting that AI shocks widen the wage gap and exacerbate income inequality. This pattern of a widening wage gap remains robust across alternative large language model decision engines and 30 Monte Carlo simulations. We further conduct counterfactual policy experiments. The results show that education subsidies targeted at low-income workers increase both the number of skill-upgrading attempts and the number of successful upgrades, with particularly pronounced improvements in the upskilling success probability of workers in the bottom income decile. These effects enable the policy to partially mitigate wage inequality. The proposed framework provides an interpretable simulation approach for examining the effects and mechanisms of AI shocks on wage distribution. It also offers policymakers a complementary analytical tool for evaluating policy interventions.

</details>


### [397] [Latent Class Analysis of Digital Content Use Contexts in AI-Generated Synthetic Personas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33525)
*Eunjeong Song,Sehee Hong*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究对NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea全部100万条合成人格数据，用韩语编码词典标注五种数字内容使用模式，并通过考虑分类误差的三步潜类别分析识别出四类使用情境画像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI合成人格日益用于内容规划与虚拟用户模拟，但其叙事中嵌入的数字内容使用情境尚未得到充分考察。

Method: 使用全部1,000,000条Nemotron-Personas-Korea记录，以公开的韩语编码词典标注五种参与模式（观看、发现与分享、互动、阅读、收听）的提及，并采用考虑分类误差的三步法潜类别分析。

Result: 得到四类：观看为中心（20.8%）、阅读为中心（3.8%）、收听为中心（2.1%）和低提及（73.3%）。年龄关联最强：观看为中心相对于低提及类的几率每增加10岁乘以0.15，非观看模式提及率从30岁以下的49.4%降至70岁及以上的2.3%。性别差异不足1个百分点，省级差异最高5.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 这些类别描述的是叙事配置而非消费者细分，为评估合成人格使用情境的多样性提供了基础。

Abstract: AI-generated synthetic personas are increasingly used for content planning and virtual-user simulation, yet the digital content use contexts embedded in their narratives remain underexamined. Using all 1,000,000 records of NVIDIA's Nemotron-Personas-Korea, this study coded mentions of five engagement modes-viewing, discovering and sharing, interacting, reading, and listening-with an openly released Korean coding dictionary and applied latent class analysis with a three-step approach accounting for classification error. Four classes emerged: viewing-centered (20.8%), reading-centered (3.8%), listening-centered (2.1%), and low-mention (73.3%). Age showed the strongest association: the odds of the viewing-centered versus low-mention class were multiplied by 0.15 per 10-year increase, while mentions of any non-viewing mode declined from 49.4% among those under 30 to 2.3% among those aged 70 and over. Sex differences in predicted class probabilities were below 1 percentage point, and provincial differences reached at most 5.0 percentage points. These classes describe narrative configurations, not consumer segments, and provide a basis for assessing diversity in synthetic persona use contexts.

</details>


### [398] [An Empirical Study on how Computing Students Interact with Large Language Models for Learning Purposes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33750)
*Opetunde Ibitoye,Saheed Popoola*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究基于自我调节学习(SRL)理论，通过调查225名计算专业学生，探究其使用LLM工具的学习用途、感知影响及交互策略，并提出Probe-Monitor-Shape启发式框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已成为教育常用工具，但现有研究多关注模型性能、特定用例和学生态度，缺乏对学生与LLM交互策略的实证研究，尤其在计算教育领域。

Method: 基于SRL理论，对225名计算专业本科生和研究生进行问卷调查，分析学生的LLM使用方式、感知学习影响及所依赖的策略。

Result: 学生将LLM用于九个功能类别，最常见为解释概念、学习新知识、查找信息、调试和生成想法；采用的策略包括提供详细上下文和迭代提示；主要困难包括信息不准确、回答泛化及难以信任模型推理。

Conclusion: 通过SRL视角综合这些模式，提出Probe-Monitor-Shape启发式框架，将学生LLM交互策略映射到自我调节学习的各阶段。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) have become popular tools in education. Therefore, understanding how students interact with LLMs for learning purposes is an important aspect of the responsible design and development of LLM based learning tools. However, existing research has focused on evaluating model performance, specific use cases, and students' attitudes toward LLM in education. There has been limited empirical work exploring students' interaction strategies with LLMs in computing education. This study draws on Self Regulated Learning (SRL) theory and conducts a survey of 225 undergraduate and graduate computing students to investigate how students use LLM tools during learning, the perceived learning impact, and the strategies they rely upon when using these tools. Students used LLMs across nine functional categories, most often to explain concepts, learn new material, find information, debug, and generate ideas. They also adopted some strategies such as supplying detailed context and iterative prompting. The most common difficulties encountered with LLM tools were incorrect information, generic responses, and difficulty trusting the model's reasoning. We synthesized these patterns through an SRL lens and offer a Probe Monitor Shape heuristic to map students' LLM interaction strategies onto the phases of self-regulated learning.

</details>


### [399] [Internet and Enterprise Strategy Revisited: From Digital Connectivity to AI-Enabled Enterprises, 1996 - 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33850)
*Carlos J. Costa*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文回顾1996年《互联网与企业战略》一文，评估其命题在2026年AI赋能企业环境下的验证、转变与矛盾，主张互联网战略并未被取代，而是被延伸。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字连接已演变为AI赋能的企业环境，需要重新审视经典互联网战略理论在当代是否仍适用，厘清其被证实、转化或否定的部分。

Method: 结合历史诠释与结构化比较，围绕互联网赋能能力、产业结构、价值链转型、平台中介、网络安全、数据治理、人工智能与数字主权等维度展开分析。

Result: 原文准确预见了电子市场、网络中介、交易安全、在线社区与内部互联网使用规则的战略意义；但当代互联网已超出原框架，呈现平台化、数据密集、云依赖、受监管、地缘政治竞争及日益AI中介化等特征。

Conclusion: 从连接性到AI赋能企业系统的演进并非取代互联网战略，而是对其的延伸；企业战略如今通过数字基础设施、算法协调、生态参与与治理能力来实施。

Abstract: This paper revisits the 1996 article Internet and Enterprise Strategy and assesses how its propositions were confirmed, transformed, or contradicted as digital connectivity evolved into an AI-enabled enterprise environment by 2026. The reassessment combines historical interpretation with a structured comparison of Internet-enabled capabilities, industry structure, value-chain transformation, platform intermediation, cybersecurity, data governance, artificial intelligence, and digital sovereignty. The analysis shows that the article correctly anticipated the strategic relevance of electronic markets, cybermediaries, transaction security, online communities, and internal rules for Internet use. However, the contemporary Internet exceeds the original framing: it is now a platformized, data-intensive, cloud-dependent, regulated, geopolitically contested, and increasingly AI-mediated environment. The paper argues that this progression from connectivity to AI-enabled enterprise systems does not replace Internet strategy; it extends it. For many firms, enterprise strategy is now enacted through digital infrastructures, algorithmic coordination, ecosystem participation, and governance capabilities.

</details>


### [400] [Correlation Between Nighttime Light and Various Statistical Indicators in Japan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33861)
*Shoichi Otomo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文是日文论文的英文翻译扩展版，介绍日本都道府县及市町村夜间灯光强度的测算方法，并以日本为例验证夜间灯光强度作为多种社会经济指标代理变量的有效性，最后探讨其在COVID-19等突发社会冲击下进行快速经济影响评估的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来卫星遥感与大数据在经济分析中的应用迅速扩展，夜间灯光强度已被证明与GDP、就业率、人口密度、教育水平等关键社会经济指标高度相关，但需要进一步评估其在日本区域层面的适用性与多功能性。

Method: 首先概述日本都道府县和市町村层面夜间灯光强度的计算方法；随后以日本为例，考察城市级夜间灯光强度与多种公共社会经济指标之间的关系；最后探讨夜间灯光数据在突发社会冲击（如COVID-19）期间用于快速经济影响评估的可能性。

Result: 研究结果表明，夜间灯光强度可作为上述多种社会经济指标的有效代理变量。

Conclusion: 夜间灯光数据在日本区域经济分析中具有较好的通用性，并有望在COVID-19等突发社会扰动期间支持快速的经济影响评估。

Abstract: This manuscript is an English translation and extended version of a paper originally published in Japanese(otomo 2021) Recent years have seen a rapid expansion in applying satellite remote sensing and big data to economic analysis. In particular, satellite-observed nighttime light intensity has proven to be closely correlated with key socio-economic indicators, including gross domestic product, employment rates, population density, and educational attainment across countries. In this paper, I first outline the methodology for calculating regional nightlight intensity across Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Next, to evaluate the versatility of nightlight data, I examine the relationship between city-level nightlight intensity and various public socio-economic metrics, using Japan as a case study. The findings suggest that nightlight intensity can serve as a effective proxy for these diverse indicators. Finally, I explore the potential of nightlight data for enabling rapid economic impact assessments during sudden social disruptions, such as the COVID-19 pandemic.

</details>


### [401] [Greenpixie's AI Token Methodology: Assessing the Energy, Water and $\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$ Impact of AI Tokens for Open and Closed Weight Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33965)
*Joshua Horswill,Ross Hunter,Matt Clifford,James Hall*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出一种估计云端LLM推理每token能耗的方法，区分prefill与decode，并扩展到碳排与水耗估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端LLM推理的能耗、碳排放与水耗缺乏可量化的每token数据，阻碍了云及SaaS在成本、用电和环境影响方面的优化。

Method: 在推理基准测试中测量GPU能耗（开源权重模型、多类文本任务），非GPU服务器能耗由推理墙钟时间估算；用贝叶斯线性回归建模每token能耗与模型规模、请求流量、硬件部署配置的关系；对规模和部署未知的专有前沿LLM按命名与性能先验分桶，并用蒙特卡洛采样配置空间以获得代表性均值与不确定性；进而估计使用与隐含的CO2-eq及水耗。

Result: 得到区分输入（prefill）与输出（decode）token的每token能耗估计，以及专有前沿LLM的每token平均能耗与不确定性，并可换算为使用与隐含CO2-eq排放及水消耗。

Conclusion: 该方法论提供可操作数据，帮助云和SaaS降低LLM推理的成本、用电、CO2-eq排放与水耗。

Abstract: We describe a methodology for estimating the per-token energy cost of cloud-hosted large language model (LLM) inference, separating between input (prefill) and output (decode) tokens. Graphics processing unit (GPU) energy usage is measured during inference benchmarking with open-weights models on a wide range of text-based tasks. The remaining server energy contribution from non-GPU hardware is estimated from the inference wall time. Bayesian linear regression is used to model the relationship between energy per token and LLM size, request traffic, and hardware deployment configuration. Proprietary frontier LLMs of unknown size and deployment are binned into size buckets based on naming conventions and performance priors, and the space of possible LLM configurations is sampled with Monte-Carlo methods to give a representative average energy per token and uncertainty. We also describe how these energy measurements can be used to estimate the carbon-dioxide equivalent ($\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$) emissions, both usage and embodied, and water consumed per token of AI inference. This methodology provides actionable data that enables reductions in cost, electricity usage, $\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$ emitted and water consumed in cloud and Software as a Service (SaaS).

</details>


### [402] [Investigating Human--AI Discrepancies via Multiple-Solution Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34258)
*Zihao Wang,Francesco Insulla,Andrea Montanari*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该论文研究人类与AI模型在多解推理谜题上解分布差异，发现模型之间更像彼此而非人类，且模型解分布多样性低于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AI评测只看答案对错，但许多问题有多个正确解，重复采样会形成解的分布。作者想探究人类与模型在有效解选择分布上是否不同，这一差异对AI社会部署评估很重要。

Method: 构建270个推理谜题，覆盖5个谜题族，每个有3至8个有效解且人类和模型都能可靠求解；比较人类与多个模型的解分布，并考察推理强度设置、提示方式及不改变解的扰动的影响。

Result: 人类与模型解分布差异显著：模型彼此之间相似度远高于与人类的相似度；在每个谜题族内，模型解分布多样性均低于人类；这些差异随推理设置、提示和扰动而变化。

Conclusion: 人类与AI在解题过程及对同等合理答案的选择上存在重大差异，AI部署评估应超越单一准确率指标，关注解的分布性差异。

Abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models are benchmarked on whether they reach a correct answer. Yet many problems admit several correct answers and repeated attempts, by different people or by the same model resampled, trace out a distribution over them. In this work, we ask whether human and model reasoning lead to different distributions over valid solutions. Our testbed comprises 270 reasoning puzzles across five puzzle families. These multiple-solution puzzles each have 3 to 8 valid solutions and are simple enough that humans and models can solve them reliably. The resulting distributions differ markedly: models differ from one another, yet resemble each other far more than they resemble humans. Model distributions are, moreover, within every puzzle family, less diverse than human ones. We compare these discrepancies across puzzle categories, and trace how they respond to reasoning-effort settings, to prompting, and to perturbations of the puzzle that leave its solutions unchanged. Together, these results point at significant differences between human and AI problem-solving processes, and their choice among equally defensible solutions. As progressive deployment of AI systems in society comes into focus, evaluating such differences (beyond one-dimensional accuracy metrics) is increasingly important. Data and code are available at https://hai-discrepancies.github.io/

</details>


### [403] [Loyal Agents: Training LLM Agents to Protect Principal Interests Under Strategic Information Asymmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34714)
*Zimeng Huang,Shilei Chen,Jiatong Zhao,Wenxin Xu,Tonghan Wang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 论文形式化"Agent Loyalty"（代理忠诚）为信息控制属性，要求LLM代理在委托场景中防止可被利用的信息泄露（EIL）并抵抗操纵性信息吸收（MIU），提出LoyalAgent-Bench基准与在线GRPO对抗训练框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益作为委托代理与外部方交互，但现有的helpfulness、harmlessness、honesty等对齐目标并未规定代理应如何在委托关系下保护委托人的战略利益，因此忠诚性缺乏明确规范与保障。

Method: 将Agent Loyalty形式化为信息控制属性，包含防止EIL与抵抗MIU两方面；构建LoyalAgent-Bench，含10,298样本、42个子场景、6个领域；提出在线GRPO框架，让模型与LLM对手对抗以生成机制专属奖励信号进行训练。

Result: 零样本评估下忠诚性无法由通用能力或现有对齐保证，存在可测量的EIL与MIU差距；训练后的8B模型在单轮交互中每响应泄露降低31-44pp，任务效用、证据忠实度和决策准确率分别提升最多11pp、49pp、29pp；Qwen3-4B在分布外数学与叙事推理基准上无退化。

Conclusion: Agent Loyalty是独立于通用能力与现有对齐的重要属性，可通过针对性对抗训练有效提升，且不损害其他推理能力，为委托代理场景下的LLM对齐提供了新方向。

Abstract: As LLMs increasingly act as delegated agents, they are expected to protect principals' interests when interacting with external parties. Standard alignment objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, do not specify how agents should protect principals' strategic interests under delegation. We formalize Agent Loyalty as an information-control property requiring agents to prevent Exploitable Information Leakage (EIL) and resist Manipulative Information Uptake (MIU). We introduce LoyalAgent-Bench, comprising 10,298 samples across 42 subscenarios and six domains, and an online GRPO framework that trains against a LLM opponent to generate mechanism-specific reward signals. Experiments show that loyalty is not guaranteed by general capability or existing alignment, with measurable EIL and MIU gaps under zero-shot evaluation, while our trained 8B models reduce per-response leakage in single-turn exchanges by 31-44pp and improve task utility, evidence faithfulness, and decision accuracy by up to 11pp, 49pp, and 29pp, respectively. For the trained Qwen3-4B model, no degradation is observed on out-of-distribution benchmarks in math and narrative reasoning.

</details>


### [404] [Conspiracy and Environment Communities on Reddit Sort Along Different Demographic Axes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34846)
*Miguel Á. Sánchez-Cortés,Corrado Monti,Gianmarco De Francisci Morales*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过网络方法研究Reddit用户进入环保与阴谋论社区的不同人口统计路径，发现人口分化在两个领域运作机制不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线平台对政治动员的影响已被广泛记录，但其对不同人口群体的差异化影响仍不清楚，需要揭示不同群体如何被嵌入在线政治社区。

Method: 推断Reddit用户的年龄、性别、富裕度和党派倾向，构建分层转移网络，对比不同人口群体进入环保和阴谋论社区的路径。

Result: 阴谋社区进入主要由性别和党派结构：男性用户多经政治和另类右翼空间，女性用户多经神秘和精神类子版块。环保社区主要由年龄和富裕度区分：富裕用户经个人能源管理、技术和金融讨论，较不富裕用户经抗议和气候运动空间。

Conclusion: 社会人口排序在不同极化议题中并不一致，不同人口群体构建各自的参与路径和信息生态。基于注意力流图的方法细化了我们对不同群体如何嵌入在线政治社区的理解。

Abstract: The impact of online platforms in political mobilization is widely documented, yet it remains unclear how it affects different demographic groups. To shed light on this phenomenon, we examine two contrasting cases: engagement with environmental causes on one side, and with conspiracy theories on the other. Both are well represented on Reddit, allowing us to study the different origins of these groups using a network-based method. By inferring age, gender, affluence, and partisanship of Reddit users, we construct stratified transition networks to compare the entry pathways of different demographic groups toward these communities. We find that demographic differentiation operates differently in these two domains. Entry into conspiracy communities is primarily structured by gender and partisanship: masculine users disproportionately arrive through overtly political and alt-right spaces and share right-wing media sources, whereas feminine users more often pass through esoteric and spiritual subreddits before converging on r/conspiracy. In contrast, environmental communities are differentiated mainly by age and affluence. Affluent users tend to approach environmental subreddits via discussions of individual energy management, technology, and finance, while less affluent users arrive through protest-oriented and climate movement spaces. By comparing these two issue domains, the study shows that sociodemographic sorting does not operate uniformly across polarized topics. Instead, distinct demographic groups build their own paths, shaping both the routes through which they engage with political content and the informational ecosystems that sustain their engagement. Our approach, based on the attention-flow graph, refines our understanding of how different groups become embedded in online political communities.

</details>


### [405] [KITA AI: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Pluralistic Policy Deliberation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34890)
*Arnau Mayoral-Macau,Jiaqi Lai,Manala Tyobeka,Vukosi Marivate,William Chandra Tjhi,Georgina Curto*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出KITA AI，一个模块化系统，通过多个基于不同人口统计利益相关者角色与概念框架的大语言模型智能体，对政策情景进行审议，将不收敛作为可解释的一类输出，帮助决策者理解政策权衡与人类影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共政策应对紧迫的社会与环境挑战时，需明确考虑受影响利益相关者多样且常相互冲突的视角；现有计算决策支持方法虽能跨人类价值体系给出建议，但仍倾向于输出单一的共识结果，忽视了分歧本身的价值。

Method: KITA AI采用模块化设计，包含多个大语言模型智能体，每个智能体分别锚定于不同的人口统计利益相关者角色和概念框架，对政策情景展开审议；系统自动识别受影响的群体，并为每种立场提供背后的理据和量化指标。

Result: KITA AI不仅告知首选政策提案，还能自动浮现受影响者，并给出各立场背后的理据与量化指标；系统将"不收敛"作为一类可解释的输出。

Conclusion: 通过将不收敛视为首要的可解释输出，KITA AI帮助政策制定者更好理解所讨论政策的权衡取舍与人类影响。

Abstract: Public policies addressing urgent social and environmental challenges need to explicitly consider the diverse, often conflicting perspectives of the affected stakeholders. Despite computational decision-support approaches increasingly offering recommendations across diverse human value systems, they still tend to deliver a single consensus-driven outcome. We present KITA AI, a modular system in which multiple large language model agents, each grounded in distinct demographic stakeholder personas and conceptual frameworks, deliberate on policy scenarios. The objective of KITA AI is not merely to inform about a preferred policy proposal, but also to automatically surface who is affected by the scenario and provide decision-makers with the rationales and quantitative indicators behind each position. KITA AI treats non-convergence as a first-class explainable output, enabling policymakers to better understand the trade-offs and human impacts of the policies being discussed.

</details>


### [406] [Adaptive Resource Allocation for Effective and Efficient LLM Social Survey Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35216)
*Yuanzi Li,Xueyang Feng,Junhao Wang,Lei Wang,Xu Chen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出 E2Sim 自适应资源分配框架，为每个调查请求联合选择模型与历史预算，实现更准更省的社会调查模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 社会调查模拟管线对每个请求都用同一强模型和固定（通常很大）的受访者历史，忽略了三点：强模型可能依赖自身知识而非受访者证据且成本高；额外历史在证据有限时有帮助，但不相关回答会引入噪声并增加输入长度；最优模型与历史预算相互依赖。

Method: E2Sim 使用轻量策略，输入受访者人设、排序响应历史和目标问题，预测各配置（模型+历史预算）的准确率与成本并选择最合适者；采用 drop-and-swap 历史增广提升对不完整/可变历史的鲁棒性，并用基于 margin 的课程学习从易到难推进分配决策。

Result: 在四个真实社会调查数据集、多个模型池和不同历史预算空间上，E2Sim 超过 oracle 最优固定配置，准确率提升最高达 6.3 个百分点，成本降低最高达 55.3%。

Conclusion: 联合自适应选择模型与历史预算能显著提升社会调查模拟的准确率并降低成本，优于任何固定配置。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable scalable social survey simulation, yet existing pipelines typically use the same strong general-purpose model and a fixed, often large, respondent history for every respondent-question request. This uniform approach overlooks three factors. First, stronger models may rely on their own knowledge rather than respondent-specific evidence while costing more. Second, additional history can help when evidence is limited, but irrelevant responses may add noise and increase input length. Third, the preferred model and history budget can depend on each other. We propose E2Sim, an adaptive resource allocation framework that jointly selects a model and history budget for each request. Given a respondent persona, ranked response history, and target question, a lightweight policy predicts the accuracy and cost of each configuration and selects the most suitable one. We use respondent-history drop-and-swap augmentation to improve robustness to incomplete or variable histories, and a margin-based curriculum that progresses from easier allocation decisions to harder ones. Experiments on four real-world social survey datasets, multiple model pools, and different history-budget spaces show improvements over the oracle best-fixed configurations, with accuracy gains of up to 6.3 percentage points and cost reductions of up to 55.3 percent. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/E2Sim-DE66.

</details>


### [407] [Beyond Energy: When Sustainability Dimensions Reshape LLM Serving Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35569)
*Tianyao Shi,Xipeng Shen,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出PRISM统一框架，跨能源、碳、水、生物多样性四维度刻画并优化LLM服务，揭示配置与部署影响的本质差异，在区域路由实验中较最强基线降低50.2%中位最坏情况遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务的环境影响涵盖能耗、碳排放、水耗与生物多样性损失，但现有研究多孤立评估各维度，不清楚何时、如何导致不同优化决策。

Method: PRISM统一框架，跨能源、碳、水、生物多样性四维度刻画与优化LLM服务；分析配置与部署对各类影响的决定机制，识别embodied影响打破配置不变性的生命周期跨界条件，量化跨维度遗憾并做四维平衡；开展区域路由实验。

Result: 发现计算配置决定能耗，而部署地点与时间决定碳、水、生物多样性影响；固定部署且仅运营核算时各维度保持一致的能耗配置排序；部署排序会跨维度分化；embodied影响超过生命周期临界值时会破坏配置不变性。区域路由实验中中位最坏情况遗憾较最强基线降低50.2%。

Conclusion: PRISM揭示了LLM服务多环境影响的配置-部署分工机制及条件，实现四维度平衡优化，显著降低最坏情况遗憾，为可持续LLM服务提供统一决策框架。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving has environmental impacts across energy consumption, carbon emission, water consumption, and biodiversity loss. Yet these dimensions are largely evaluated in isolation, leaving it unclear when and how they lead to different optimization decisions. We present PRISM, a unified framework for characterizing and optimizing LLM serving across energy, carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Our analysis reveals a fundamental distinction: computing configurations determine energy consumption, whereas where and when LLM serving is deployed determine its carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Under a fixed deployment choice and operational-only accounting, all dimensions preserve the same energy-based configuration ranking. Deployment rankings can diverge across dimensions, while embodied impacts can break configuration invariance when they exceed a lifecycle crossover boundary. PRISM identifies these conditions, quantifies cross-dimensional regrets, and balances the four dimensions. In regional-routing experiments, PRISM reduces median worst-case regret by 50.2% relative to the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [408] [AI Agent Swarms as Researchers: Progress, Challenges, and Open Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35719)
*Sergey Gusev,David E. Bernal Neira*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 给一群现成编码智能体一个简短范围说明和"持续做真实有用进展、不要停"的指令后，它们在数周内于五个优化理论与物理科学领域产出研究笔记、论文级草稿和形式化证明，并在第六领域提出未验证的实验方案；作者初查未发现重大科学错误，部分结果已在证明助手中形式化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体已能在极少监督下完成长程多步任务，作者想测试在几乎不提供科学想法、仅给范围与工具的条件下，智能体群能否自主推进理论研究，并借此反思科研机构的应对能力。

Method: 向成群的现成编码智能体提供简短的范围说明（从狭窄主题到整个领域）、文献与计算工具访问权限，以及一条固定指令：做真实、正确、有用的进展且不要停止；不提供任何科学想法，随后对其产出进行初步核查与评审。

Result: 数周内在优化理论与物理科学的五个领域产出大量研究笔记、论文长度草稿与形式化证明，并在第六个领域提出未测试的实验设想；已核查部分未发现重大科学错误，若干结果在证明助手中得到证明；产出速度超过人工评审速度，完整评审估计需数月。

Conclusion: 结合2026年两项相关数学成果，作者认为智能体已在实验领域内可完成相当一部分常规理论研究。这带来信任与稀缺资源转向评审、学术credit与发表计量、机构为何雇人而非买算力、以及人类如何学习并保持控制等未解问题；研究机构尚未准备好，模型能力增长快于制度变革，应尽早决定应对方式。作者给出初步立场并公开截至2026年9月25日的未编辑产出，邀请他人重复实验。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents, language models connected to tools and run in a loop, can now carry out long, multi-step tasks with little supervision. We gave swarms of off-the-shelf coding agents a short statement of scope, from a narrow topic to a whole field, access to the literature and to computing tools, and one standing instruction: make real, correct, useful progress, and do not stop. We supplied no scientific ideas. Within weeks, the agents produced a large body of research notes, paper-length drafts, and formal proofs in five areas of optimization theory and physical science, and proposed untested laboratory experiments in a sixth. We do not claim that all of it is correct or new, but it is not noise: in what we have checked so far, we found no major scientific error, and several results are proved in a proof assistant. The agents produced results faster than we could review them; we estimate that a full review would take us months. Together with two widely discussed 2026 results in mathematics obtained with swarms, our runs suggest that agents can already do a large part of routine theoretical research, at least in areas that we experimented with. This raises questions we cannot yet answer: how to trust results when review, not production, is the scarce resource; what credit and publication counts mean when the human input is a prompt, and why institutions would pay researchers rather than buy computing time; and how people can learn a field, add to what agents do, and stay in control of research they cannot keep up with. Research institutions are not ready: models improve faster than institutions change, so they should decide now how to respond as capabilities increase. We offer tentative positions, release the agents' unedited output as of 25 September 2026, and invite readers to repeat the experiment in their own fields.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [409] [Evolution of Market Microstructure in the Age of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33058)
*Irene Aldridge*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文综述市场微观结构的演化，围绕“市场能否在不完全揭示信息的前提下实现高效公平配置”这一核心问题，梳理从场内交易到AI代理交易的技术变迁及其约束转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 市场交易规则反复被重建，但已有研究多聚焦特定技术或阶段，缺少统一视角理解市场设计的约束如何随技术变迁而转移。作者希望用“信息揭示与稀缺品配置”这一问题贯穿市场微观结构的演化历程。

Method: 综述性研究：以“市场能否在参与者不揭示全部所知与所愿的情况下高效公平地配置稀缺品”为主线，追踪从场内交易者、电子限价订单簿与高频交易、批量拍卖与暗池、区块链AMM与区块构建者，到AI代理交易的技术演化，并综合高频交易、交易场所、自动做市商、可提取价值与算法合谋等证据。

Result: 每次技术变革都将市场设计的约束从交易者理性转向速度，再转向交易排序控制，进而转向参与者可报告信息的维度。不可能性定理依然存在，只是其代价发生转移。

Conclusion: 市场设计的不可能性结果并未消失，而是成本与表现形式不断变化；作者指出“配置”是代理商务协议栈中缺失的关键层。

Abstract: Market microstructure studies how trading rules turn orders into prices and allocations. Those rules have been rebuilt repeatedly: for floor traders, electronic limit order books and high-frequency trading, batch auctions and dark pools, blockchains run by automated market makers and block builders, and now AI agents that discover, pay for, and compete over resources. This survey traces that evolution through one question: can a market allocate scarce goods efficiently and fairly without participants revealing everything they know and want? Each technological shift moved the binding constraint of market design from trader rationality to speed, to control over transaction ordering, to the dimensionality of what participants can report. Impossibility results persist; only their cost moves. We review evidence on high-frequency trading, trading venues, automated market makers, extractable value and algorithmic collusion, and identify allocation as the missing layer of the agent-commerce protocol stack.

</details>


### [410] [An Adversarial Approach to Identification, Computation, and Inference in Models with a Linear-in-Measures Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32076)
*Irene Botosaru,Isaac Loh,Chris Muris*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于线性-in-measures表示的计量经济模型的识别、计算与推断框架，通过对抗性差异函数刻画识别集，并应用于二元选择面板与多均衡进入博弈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多计量模型（含非线性结果方程）的限制可表示为对观测与潜在变量联合概率测度线性的矩条件，但潜在输入可能无限支撑，使识别与推断困难。作者希望统一处理识别集刻画、计算与置信集构建，并解决二元选择面板固定效应等开放问题。

Method: 构建线性-in-measures表示：限制为关于观测与潜在输入联合概率测度的线性矩条件，且该测度线性映射到输出分布。构造对抗性差异函数，其零点刻画结构参数与反事实参数的识别集。在输出支撑有限时，用有限线性规划计算差异函数或给出认证边界，即使潜在输入支撑无限；并用惩罚自助法得到具有均匀逐点覆盖的置信集。

Result: 框架应用于二元选择面板固定效应与离散协变量的两个开放情形：（1）序列外生性且条件边际误差分布未指定；（2）条件边际误差分布已知但序列相依未受限。在多均衡进入博弈中，框架恢复已知的尖锐识别区域。

Conclusion: 该框架为线性-in-measures模型提供了统一的识别、计算和推断工具，能处理无限潜在支撑，并解决若干开放识别问题，同时恢复博弈中的已知尖锐识别结果。

Abstract: We develop a framework for identification, computation, and inference in econometric models with a linear-in-measures representation. These models express maintained restrictions as moment conditions linear in the joint probability measure of observed and latent inputs, and map that measure linearly to the distribution of outputs, even with nonlinear outcome equations. We construct an adversarial discrepancy function whose zeros characterize the identified set for structural and counterfactual parameters. With finite output support, finite linear programs compute the discrepancy function or provide certified bounds even when latent inputs have infinite support, and a penalized bootstrap yields confidence sets with uniform per-point coverage. We apply the framework to two open cases in binary choice panels with fixed effects and discrete covariates: sequential exogeneity with unspecified conditional marginal error distributions, and known conditional marginal error distributions with unrestricted serial dependence. In an entry game with multiple equilibria, the framework recovers the known sharp identification region.

</details>


### [411] [Minimax Choice of Projection Geometry under Linear Inequality Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32725)
*Joachim Freyberger,Julius Kappenberg*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 研究线性不等式约束下投影估计量的投影几何选择问题，在局部高斯实验与二次损失下分析不同投影几何的风险性质，提出以边界最坏风险最小化并满足无损害条件来选取投影几何的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经济理论常对参数施加线性不等式约束，常用做法是将无约束估计量投影到可行集。但当抽样协方差、损失函数与投影准则诱导的几何结构不一致时，投影几何的选择会显著影响风险，而现有做法对此缺乏系统指导。

Method: 在固定维局部高斯实验、二次损失框架下分析投影估计量的风险；比较逆协方差投影等不同投影几何；在仅一个不等式紧的确切边界处证明点最优性，在至多两个不等式相关时证明弱优于无约束估计且为极小极大，对任意数量不等式给出边界极小极大性的充分条件并构造反例；进而提出在局部无损害条件下最小化最坏边界风险来选择投影几何，并给出可行实现。

Result: 逆协方差投影在仅一个约束紧时点最优；至多两个约束相关时在整个局部实验中弱优于无约束估计，并在确切边界配置上极小极大；但三个约束可紧时，逆协方差投影未必是边界极小极大（给出反例）。

Conclusion: 投影几何的选择对风险影响重大，逆协方差投影并非普遍最优；所提出的基于最坏边界风险最小化与局部无损害条件的几何选择方法具有可行性，并在模拟与汽油需求应用中验证了有限样本表现。

Abstract: Economic theory frequently implies linear inequality restrictions on parameters or functions of interest. A common way to impose such restrictions is to project an unrestricted estimator onto the feasible set. Projection estimators arise naturally from constrained least squares, instrumental variables, generalized method of moments, maximum likelihood, and related extremum procedures. When the sampling covariance, loss function, and projection criterion induce different geometries, the choice of projection geometry can substantially affect risk. We study this choice in a fixed-dimensional local Gaussian experiment under quadratic loss. At exact-boundary configurations where only one maintained inequality binds, inverse-covariance projection is pointwise optimal. When at most two inequalities are locally relevant, it weakly improves on the unrestricted estimator throughout the corresponding local experiment and is minimax over exact-boundary configurations. For an arbitrary number of inequalities, we provide a sufficient condition for boundary minimaxity, but show by counterexample that inverse-covariance projection need not be boundary minimax once three inequalities can bind. Motivated by these results, we propose selecting the projection geometry to minimize worst-case boundary risk subject to a local no-harm condition relative to unrestricted estimation. We develop a feasible implementation and study its finite-sample performance in simulations and an application to gasoline demand.

</details>


### [412] [A One-Saddle 1/5 Approximation Algorithm for Common-Kernel Bimatrix Games: Recognition, Exact Segment Optimization, Sharp Selector Bounds, and Certified Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33471)
*Davit Gondauri*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究由公共核生成的一类固定归一化对称双矩阵博弈，证明尽管精确对称均衡计算仍是PPAD难，但该类博弈可高效（多项式时间）近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确对称均衡计算在一般对称双矩阵博弈中属于PPAD难问题，因此寻找可高效近似且结构化的博弈子类是重要方向。作者希望识别由公共核生成、固定归一化的博弈类是否构成一个可处理且可认证的结构化博弈体制。

Method: 对固定归一化对称双矩阵博弈类，利用单一辅助零和鞍点计算得到有理对称Nash均衡；给出精确识别与唯一核恢复算法；提出沿所选鞍点策略连线最小化遗憾的多项式时间后处理算法；对任意有理方阵博弈，将最近公共核投影建模为带显式对偶证书的线性规划；并给出关于遗憾-均匀性常数的选择器结果。

Result: 该博弈类中每个有理博弈，通过一次辅助零和鞍点计算即可在多项式时间内得到有理对称1/5近似Nash均衡；可实现精确识别与唯一核恢复，并有精确后处理算法最小化连线上的遗憾；对任意有理方阵博弈，最近公共核投影LP给出认证的(1/5+2η*)近似保证；选择器结果为全子集构造证明尖锐的遗憾-均匀性常数。

Conclusion: 结果提供了可处理且可认证的结构化博弈体制，并澄清了哪些公共核归约架构无法支撑某些细粒度近似难性目标。

Abstract: We study a fixed-normalization class of symmetric bimatrix games generated by a common kernel and show that it admits efficient approximation despite exact symmetric-equilibrium computation remaining PPAD-hard. For every rational game in the class, a single auxiliary zero-sum saddle computation yields a rational symmetric \(1/5\)-approximate Nash equilibrium in polynomial time. We also give exact recognition and unique kernel recovery, and an exact polynomial-time post-processing algorithm that minimizes regret along the segment joining the selected saddle strategies. For arbitrary rational square games, we formulate the nearest common-kernel projection as a linear program with an explicit dual certificate, obtaining a certified \((1/5+2η^*)\)-approximation guarantee. A separate selector result proves a sharp regret-to-uniformity constant for the full-subset construction. The results provide a tractable and certifiable structured-game regime and clarify which common-kernel reduction architectures cannot support certain fine-grained approximation-hardness objectives.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.ST'></div>

# q-fin.ST [[Back]](#toc)

### [413] [From Cointegration to Out-of-Sample Failure: A Pairs-Trading Case Study on PEP-KO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35359)
*Davide Graziano*

Main category: q-fin.ST

TL;DR: 本文检验百事可乐与可口可乐之间基于协整的配对交易策略是否具有统计稳健性和经济可获利性，结果发现样本外价差均值回归动力减弱，导致策略失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望验证经典配对交易策略（百事可乐 vs 可口可乐）在统计上是否稳健、在经济上是否真正可获利，而不仅仅是样本内表现良好。

Method: 先用2013–2018年数据检验协整性并估计价差均值回归动态；固定统计参数后在2018–2023年样本内优化阈值型交易策略；通过交易成本与参数敏感性测试、前向滚动验证及调整/紧缩夏普比率评估稳健性；再在2023年至今进行样本外检验，并用滚动OLS和卡尔曼滤波分析时变对冲比率。

Result: 样本外结果显示价差的均值回归动力减弱，削弱了策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 尽管该配对交易策略样本内表现可能良好，但由于均值回归关系随时间减弱，其在样本外难以维持经济可获利性，提示协整关系的稳定性对配对交易至关重要。

Abstract: This paper examines whether a cointegration-based pairs trading strategy between PepsiCo and The Coca-Cola Company is statistically robust and economically exploitable. We first test for cointegration and estimate the spread's mean-reversion dynamics over 2013-2018, then hold these statistical parameters fixed and optimise a threshold-based trading strategy in-sample over 2018-2023. Robustness is assessed through transaction-cost and parameter sensitivity tests, walk-forward validation, and Adjusted and Deflated Sharpe Ratios. The strategy is then evaluated out-of-sample from 2023 to the present, including an analysis of time-varying hedge ratios using rolling OLS and a Kalman filter. The results show that weakening mean-reversion dynamics in the spread undermine the effectiveness of the strategy out-of-sample.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

### [414] [SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31763)
*Srini Ramaswamy,Deveeshree Nayak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMARtCARE 提出一种四状态（Stable/Meta-cognitive/Assisted/Regulated）临床决策支持架构，用有损六通道指纹而非自动检索来识别跨就诊的病情恶化模式，在 MIMIC-III/IV 演示数据上验证了状态转移逻辑与可追溯性，但固定模式库存在匹配率低等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文临床 AI 系统在既往病历超出当前推理上下文时会遗漏相关病史。在 ICU 监护中，这会使早期生命体征漂移看似非特异性，即使其与既往恶化模式相似。SMARtCARE 旨在填补这一"中间上下文"风险的识别空白。

Method: 采用四状态临床决策支持架构：Stable、Meta-cognitive、Assisted、Regulated（Revoked）。不自动检索既往记录，而是使用患者既往轨迹的有损六通道指纹；当当前漂移匹配指纹且既往记录不在上下文中时，触发 Meta-cognitive 升级供临床医生审查；仅在 Assisted 状态下由临床医生操作才进行完整检索。设计患者身份守卫，在数据加载、日志和审计层强制正确归因。评估包括验证状态转移逻辑与估计量稳定性的合成蒙特卡洛研究，以及 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 演示库的真实数据运行。

Result: MIMIC-III 上 14 名两次入院患者中识别出 1 例既往模式复发；MIMIC-IV 上同一流程在 9 名两次入院患者中未产生任何指纹匹配，暴露了固定规范模式库的关键局限。两次运行中所有记录的决策均完全可追溯且归因正确。

Conclusion: 结果表明 SMARtCARE 是一种可追溯、隐私感知的中间上下文风险提示机制，但并非临床疗效主张；合成研究仅验证状态转移逻辑与估计量稳定性，而非临床性能。

Abstract: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.

</details>


### [415] [Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31784)
*Siyuan Li,Haoxuan Zeng,Xin Luo,Fernando Jia,Florence Li,Zhengyang Geng,Zico Kolter,Tai Sing Lee,Tianqin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Witness Overlap方法，通过引入同族见证checkpoint进行局部几何比较，实现LLM checkpoint的方向性溯源（判断父子先后）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重模型常被微调、对齐、合并后重新发布，溯源审计不仅需判断checkpoint是否相关，还需确定谁在前（方向性）。现有方法多为"已知源-嫌疑人"设定，且证据多为对称的（表征相似度、权重相似度、行为指纹等），只能检测关联，无法区分A与B的父-child方向。

Method: 引入局部几何比较：不直接比较两个checkpoint，而是加入第三个同族checkpoint作为"见证"，比较每个候选端点周围的几何结构，通过判断哪个候选更像"分支父节点"来推断方向。基于此提出Witness Overlap——免提示、免训练的白盒方向性溯源测试，利用父锚定与子锚定见证重叠分布的经验不对称性。

Result: 在16个家族、176个LLM checkpoint上，单见证测试用Frobenius余弦正确判断95.3%的父子方向。进一步评估了根节点识别、兄弟区分、向VLM和扩散模型的泛化，以及链式排序。信号对权重噪声和稀疏剪枝鲁棒，提出的SVD权重降维变体比Frobenius余弦更鲁棒。

Conclusion: 对称的成对比较只能检测相关性而无法定向，引入同族见证的局部几何比较可有效推断方向性；Witness Overlap为实现白盒方向性溯源提供了免提示、免训练且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

</details>


### [416] [Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32773)
*Maya Kodeih,Aliaa Alnaggar,Mucahit Cevik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统计归因方法，将货币政策沟通分解为可解释渠道，并在FDR控制下量化其对汇率预测的增量贡献，发现预测价值集中在少数信号上，且不仅限于情绪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 货币政策公告与央行沟通在汇市中作用关键，但其定性、非结构化特征使其预测价值难以量化；已有研究多关注金融新闻情绪，对不同沟通维度的相对贡献了解有限，且仅评估整体预测表现而无法识别哪些沟通渠道驱动改进。

Method: 提出统计归因方法，将货币政策沟通分解为可解释渠道；利用LLM与时间特征工程将货币政策新闻转化为结构化沟通信号；在滚动窗口实验中用基于树的机器学习模型评估，并在错误发现率（FDR）控制下量化各渠道增量预测贡献。

Result: 货币政策沟通包含可测量的预测信息；预测价值集中在少数信号上，其中沟通时机（timing）贡献最强的单特征效应，针对性沟通活动指标也正向贡献，LLM情绪在组层面提供互补信息。

Conclusion: 基于沟通的预测价值超出情绪本身，评估新闻衍生信号应以归因而非仅整体准确率为核心。

Abstract: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.

</details>


### [417] [CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31790)
*Samuel Onimpa Alfred,Abhishek Kumar,Veera Sundararaghavan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CP-Agent，一个基于 LLM 的 harness 工程化智能体，可在自然语言任务下自主执行完整的晶体塑性（CP）建模流程，并在四个案例中验证其有效性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶体塑性模拟可预测多晶金属力学行为，但其常规应用受限于手动配置异构工具、编排多步数据流程及校准本构参数等瓶颈，阻碍了系统性参数研究的效率，因此需要自动化工作流。

Method: 采用 ReAct 范式的 LLM 智能体，自主进行工具选择与排序推理，将数值搜索委托给现有优化器。其 harness 包含极简系统提示、类型化工具定义、调度器及安全约束的迭代循环，通过工具 schema 而非硬编码逻辑来编码领域知识。

Result: 在四个案例中验证：校准增材制造 316L 不锈钢的四个滑移参数；对照已发表铜基准复现应力-应变与织构演化；恢复铜的初始晶体织构（正确识别为弥散织构）；复现 Mg-Zn-Ca 合金多道次轧制织构演化（串联五次变形并恢复实验观察到的弱化分裂基面织构）。所有案例中智能体均能从任务陈述推断正确执行顺序，重复运行稳定，并给出物理可解释结果。

Conclusion: 本工作确立了 harness 工程作为自动化 CP 建模流程的系统化方法，在保持物理可解释性与可审计性（通过可见推理轨迹）的同时实现自动化。

Abstract: Crystal plasticity (CP) simulations predict the mechanical behavior of polycrystalline metals, yet their routine use is hindered by the manual effort of configuring heterogeneous tools, orchestrating multi-step data pipelines, and calibrating constitutive parameters against experiments. These bottlenecks impede productivity in systematic parameter studies, motivating interest in automated workflows. This study presents CP-Agent, a harness-engineered LLM-based agent that autonomously executes complete CP modeling workflows from natural-language tasks. Operating under the ReAct paradigm, the agent reasons about tool selection and sequencing while delegating numerical search to established optimizers. The harness comprises a minimal system prompt, typed tool definitions, a dispatcher, and a safety-bounded iteration loop, encoding domain knowledge through tool schemas rather than hard-coded logic. CP-Agent is demonstrated on four case studies: calibrating four slip parameters of additively manufactured stainless steel 316L against tensile data; validating the workflow against published copper benchmarks, reproducing stress-strain and texture evolution; recovering the initial crystallographic texture of copper, where the agent correctly identifies a diffuse initial texture; and reproducing the multi-pass rolling texture evolution of a Mg-Zn-Ca alloy, where the agent chains five deformation passes and recovers the experimentally observed weakened, split basal texture. In all cases, the agent inferred the correct execution sequence from the task statement, robustly across repeated runs, and delivered physically interpretable results. This work establishes harness engineering as a systematic approach to automating CP modeling workflows while maintaining physical interpretability and auditability through visible reasoning traces.

</details>


### [418] [EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33524)
*Siyuan Li,Jiangfeng Zhang,Rui Yao,Weihua Qiu,Mingyang Xu,Zixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EverMine 框架，在长周期 alpha 发现中受控评估"自进化研究能力"（累积的技能/工具/规则）是否真正提升后续研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化 agent 试图把研究反馈转化为可复用的技能、工具与研究规则，但这些累积能力能否持续改善后续研究缺乏受控评估。长周期 alpha 发现具有"状态依赖"特性：新因子进入组合后，已覆盖的预测信息改变，同一候选或经验的价值随时间变化，因此需要专门框架来检验能力累积的真实价值。

Method: 将研究状态分解为 Hist（历史）、Frontier（当前因子组合）、Cap（可复用能力）；在资源限制匹配下比较固定 Cap 与进化 Cap 的完整运行，并保持 Hist 与 Frontier 不变替换 Cap，以估计累积能力的条件价值；结合完整轨迹与历史状态回放，考察经验驱动决策对候选筛选与组合结果的影响。

Result: 在 18 条长周期轨迹中，端到端比较未发现 Cap 进化带来一致增益；在共享 Hist 与 Frontier 的 48 条延续分支中，累积 Cap 也未稳定优于初始 Cap；对已有因子结构调参仍可改善组合。对一条 Evolving 轨迹两个筛选批次的探索性回放显示：部分被筛掉的候选在原状态下有正边际价值，但按序全部提交后两批的最终组合 IC 均略降。

Conclusion: 候选价值取决于演化中的组合状态与提交顺序，自进化研究能力应通过端到端结果、条件能力价值以及经验驱动决策的后果三方面进行评估。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.

</details>


### [419] [LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33470)
*Haochen Luo,Yifan Li,Binh Minh An,Xiaolong Luo,Zhengzhao Lai,Yuan Zhang,Chen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LiveOption，一个评估LLM-based agent在期权交易中结构化决策能力的框架，包含三类任务套件和分层指标体系，实验显示现有agent大多难以获得有竞争力的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM与多agent系统在金融决策的评估集中于股票交易，且仅评估方向性预测，忽视了衍生品市场（期权）的结构复杂性，如非线性收益与多腿策略构建，需要结构化决策而非简单方向性押注。

Method: 将问题建模为在真实执行与资金约束下的结构化序贯决策，提供可复现环境与标准化交互协议；设计三个任务套件（组合叠加、事件驱动财报交易、0DTE日内交易）；提出分层指标套件，从动作有效性、决策质量、风险特征和结果层面表现进行评估。

Result: 实验表明当前agent在大多数场景下难以取得有竞争力的收益。

Conclusion: LiveOption为超越结果导向指标、评估结构化决策提供了有原则的测试平台。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. The framework includes three task suites covering portfolio overlays, event-driven earnings trading, and 0DTE intraday trading. We further propose a hierarchical metric suite that evaluates action validity, decision quality, risk characteristics, and outcome-level performance. Experiments show that current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns in most scenarios. LiveOption offers a principled testbed for evaluating structured decision-making beyond outcome-based metrics.

</details>


### [420] [ConflictVLA-Bench: Benchmarking Behavioral Responses of Vision-Language-Action Models to Premise Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31792)
*Liyu Hou,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ConflictVLA-Bench基准，研究VLA模型在面对无效任务前提时的"失败坚持（Failed Persistence）"现象：即使任务失败，模型仍继续朝原目标行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA评估多关注终态任务结果，但任务失败无法区分"行为脱离"与"持续追求后执行出错"（Failed Persistence）。前者是合理拒绝，后者说明模型并未真正理解前提冲突。

Method: 构建ConflictVLA-Bench，基于LIBERO，包含2,826个提示条件化的冲突任务，涵盖四个冲突族、四种结构配置和两种提示条件。将冲突rollout与前提一致的参考rollout配对，同时评估结果与执行过程（轨迹结构、动作幅度等）。

Result: 在全部八个VLA上，无效前提使原目标完成率至少下降17.3个百分点，OpenVLA下降达56.2个百分点。即便模型在前提一致任务成功、在匹配冲突任务失败，它们仍常继续接近原目标、保留早期轨迹结构，动作幅度抑制有限。显式前提检查无法稳定产生选择性且协调的行为改变。

Conclusion: Failed Persistence在评估模型中普遍存在。仅凭终态失败既不能证明行为脱离，也不能证明拒绝，说明单纯用结果指标评估VLA是不充分的，需引入过程性评估。

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform strongly on manipulation tasks, their responses to invalid task premises remain underexplored. Existing evaluations of premise conflicts often focus on terminal task outcomes, yet task failure alone cannot distinguish behavioral disengagement from continued pursuit followed by an execution error. We call the latter pattern Failed Persistence. To study this phenomenon, we introduce ConflictVLA-Bench, which pairs conflict rollouts with premise-consistent reference rollouts and evaluates both outcomes and execution processes. Built on LIBERO, the benchmark contains 2,826 prompt-conditioned conflict tasks spanning four conflict families, four structural configurations, and two prompt conditions. Across all eight VLAs, invalid premises reduce original goal completion by at least 17.3 percentage points, with the reduction reaching 56.2 percentage points for OpenVLA. Crucially, even when models succeed on premise-consistent tasks and fail on their matched conflict tasks, they often continue to approach the original targets, retain early trajectory structure, and show limited action magnitude suppression. Failed Persistence therefore recurs across the evaluated models. Explicit premise checking does not consistently produce selective and coordinated behavioral changes. These findings show that terminal failure alone establishes neither behavioral disengagement nor refusal and that outcomes alone are insufficient for VLA evaluation. Experimental data and additional details are available on the project page: https://github.com/EmbodiedAISurvey/ConflictVLA-Bench

</details>


### [421] [Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31793)
*Yuqian Lu,Regina Lee,Rui Zhou,Lixin Jiang,Andrew McDaid,Amy Lawrence*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本白皮书提出一个设计人-AI协作的实用框架，涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织与社会环境五个维度，并通过协作装配与cobot用例展示框架应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI（尤其GenAI）在工业场景中日益重要，但成功采用不仅取决于技术能力，还取决于人的体验与协作方式，因此需要明确如何设计对人与组织均有良好效果的人-AI协作。

Method: 提出一个涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织及更广泛社会环境的设计框架，阐明有效协作的特征、影响因素、应满足的要求及组织需考虑的设计决策；并引入人-AI协作装配系统（含cobot）用例，将设计要求转化为具体协作特性并通过案例研究进行评估。

Result: 通过用例展示设计要求可被转化为具体的协作功能，并通过案例研究加以评估，验证了框架的实践可操作性。

Conclusion: 该白皮书为设计有效、以人为本且负责任的人-AI协作提供了清晰且实用的指南。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly GenAI, is becoming an increasingly important part of modern work. In industrial settings, AI can support decision-making, automate routine activities, assist humans, and improve productivity. However, successful AI adoption depends on more than what the technology can do. It also depends on how people experience and work with it. This raises an important question: how should human-AI collaboration be designed so that it works well for both people and organisations? This white paper addresses that question by presenting a practical framework for designing human-AI collaboration. The framework considers the human, the AI system, the task, the organisation, and the wider societal environment. It explains what effective collaboration looks like, what conditions influence it, what requirements should be met, and what design decisions organisations should consider. The report also includes a human-AI collaborative assembly system with cobot use case to demonstrate how the framework can be applied in practice. The use case shows how design requirements can be translated into specific collaboration features and evaluated through a case study. The aim of this white paper is to provide a clear and practical guide for designing human-AI collaboration that is effective, human-centred, and responsible.

</details>


### [422] [DriveHierarchy: A Benchmark for Diagnosing VLM Driving Capabilities from Open-Loop Understanding to Closed-Loop Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31814)
*Chengkai Xu,Jiaqi Liu,Yicheng Guo,Peng Hang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DriveHierarchy，一个面向VLM自动驾驶的分层基准，将能力组织为感知、记忆、推理和闭环执行四个层级，并构建了大规模开环问答基准和闭环仿真平台，用于评估与改进VLM自动驾驶系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM自动驾驶能力是复合的，需要同时具备感知、上下文整合、未来推理和闭环交互能力，但现有基准多侧重开环理解或闭环驾驶，缺乏对能力组织结构及其关系的解释，难以支持模型诊断与改进。

Method: 提出四层级（感知grounding、上下文记忆、心智推理、闭环执行）的DriveHierarchy基准；整合多个开源自动驾驶数据集，构建含76,798个问答对、覆盖84,279帧的开环基准；并基于真实道路网络搭建交互式闭环仿真平台，筛选100个驾驶场景进行具身评估；在15个VLM上进行实验。

Result: 实验表明DriveHierarchy能捕捉结构化但非冗余的能力差异，将开环理解与闭环驾驶相关联，并为模型诊断和基准引导优化提供实用基础。

Conclusion: DriveHierarchy为评估和改进VLM自动驾驶系统提供了一个统一框架，并已发布匿名项目。

Abstract: Evaluating VLM-based autonomous driving remains difficult because driving competence is composite, where a capable system must ground traffic participants and hazards, integrate context across views and time, reason about future evolution, and act appropriately under closed-loop interaction. Existing benchmarks usually assess either open-loop understanding or closed-loop driving but provide limited structure for explaining how these abilities are organized, how they relate, and how they may inform model diagnosis and improvement. We present \textsc{DriveHierarchy}, a hierarchical benchmark that organizes VLM-based autonomous driving into four ranks, spanning perceptual grounding, contextual memory, mental reasoning, and closed-loop execution. To instantiate this hierarchy, we integrate multiple open-source autonomous-driving datasets into a unified open-loop benchmark with 76,798 question-answer pairs over 84,279 frames and develop a closed-loop simulation platform with interactive scenario construction on a real-world road network, from which 100 driving scenarios are curated for embodied evaluation. Experiments on 15 VLMs show that \textsc{DriveHierarchy} captures structured but non-redundant capability variation, relates open-loop understanding to closed-loop driving, and provides a practical basis for diagnosis and benchmark-guided optimization. \textsc{DriveHierarchy} therefore serves as a unified framework for evaluating and improving VLM-based autonomous driving systems. An anonymized project has been released on https://github.com/PerfectXu88/DriveHierarchy

</details>


### [423] [LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31857)
*Junxuan Li,Arko Mukherjee,Soumyabrata Pal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文证明，在验证LLM-as-a-judge时，标注的"重叠稀疏性"（overlap sparsity）是导致错误部署决策的首要因素，并提出通过提高重叠量与优化重叠分配来缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证LLM评判者需估计其与人类标注的一致性，但标注预算通常不允许对每个样本进行多次标注，导致重叠稀疏。作者指出这种重叠稀疏是错误部署决策的一阶决定因素，亟需量化其影响并寻找可行解决方案。

Method: 作者从理论上分析重叠稀疏对决策错误的影响；针对重叠量，推导出最小重叠公式，指出ρ≥0.25对非边界评判者足够；针对重叠分配，提出一种零成本的 stratified 分配方案，在分层信息有效时可降低错误率。实验在10个LLM评判者、四个评估矩阵（涵盖视觉评估、因果推理和摘要）上进行验证。

Result: 在5%成对重叠下，错误决策率达到25%，从十个候选者中选出错误最佳评判者的概率为65%。分层分配方案在分层信息有效时，相较于随机采样可将错误拒绝率减半。

Conclusion: 重叠稀疏性是LLM评判者验证的关键瓶颈；通过设定最小重叠量和采用零成本分层分配策略，可在有限标注预算下显著改善评判者选择与部署决策的准确性。

Abstract: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

</details>


### [424] [FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35744)
*Hoyoung Lee,Suyeol Yun,Jack Haverty,Yunju Cho,Meesong Kim,Daekyung Park,Sumin Kim,Jihoon Kwon,Jasmine Jia Geng,Andrew Chin,Yin Luo,Edward Tong,Yu Yu,Zach Golkhou,Minkyu Kim,Igor Halperin,Young Cha,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Chanyeol Choi,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FinAutoRubric 提出一种专家指导、代理与代码协同的金融研究评估标准自动生成方法，在多个金融基准上超过现有生成器并获分析师偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家评审的金融基准依赖固定、逐项的评分标准，扩展成本高，且无法编码各机构自身的标准。同时需要保证数值在信息截止日期前的正确性。

Method: 专家提供可复用评估指导，代理和代码完成查询特定的标准生成、审查与验证。专家指导以提示和代码规则形式约束所有代理，并构建任务库跨任务传递标准。长期循环中由写作代理研究期望值、审查代理核验，失败则升级给人工。

Result: 在三个人工编写的金融基准上，其标准与专家评分的接近程度达到最强评估生成器水平，同时为更多标准给出专家标准的期望值；得分与人工评分一致，内部分析师盲审中更偏好该方法。发布的 100 查询 FinAutoRubric Benchmark 覆盖 78 个任务、8 类资产。

Conclusion: 该方法可低成本生成符合专家标准的金融评估标准，但早期模型生成的评分标准对后期模型仍留有提升空间。

Abstract: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. On three expert-authored finance benchmarks, its rubrics track expert scoring as closely as the strongest evaluated generator while stating the expert rubric's expected value for more criteria, their scores agree with human grading, and in-house analysts prefer them in a blind review. The released 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark, built from in-house analysts' key questions across 78 tasks and eight asset classes, shows that rubrics from an earlier model generation still leave headroom for a later one.

</details>


### [425] [Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31868)
*Royson Lee,Fady Rezk,Titouan Parcollet,Timothy Hospedales,Cristina Cornelio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Metro-WM，用检索真实状态代替生成隐式子目标，构建图实现长程规划，显著提升成功率和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA模型预测控制的零样本目标规划仅适用于短时程。分层方法用macro规划器预测中间隐式子目标来扩展时程，但无约束的隐式子目标预测存在根本缺陷——顶尖macro规划器常输出物理上无法实现的子目标。
