Method: Metro-WM从先验经验（离线专家示范或随机动作轨迹）中检索真实状态作为子目标，而非生成无依据的隐向量。构建以观测帧为顶点的图，连接不同episode的帧并拼接成通往目标的路径。在全图上规划使系统对执行误差鲁棒：当micro规划器偏离时能立即从当前状态找到新最优路径。

Result: 长时程成功率比次优分层方法高最多37.33个百分点，速度快最多10.9倍，离线计算少13-56倍且需调的超参数更少。分析显示Metro-WM找到比离线示范更短的路径，优于依赖查询自身示范的oracle，并在极稀疏数据下保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 用真实状态检索替代隐式子目标生成，是解决分层规划中物理不可实现子目标问题的有效途径，兼顾性能、效率与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

</details>


### [426] [IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31871)
*Liang Ding,Zhiang Xu,Yuyang Sheng,Bin Chen,Songlin Bai,Run Zhu,Dingjun Wu,Hui Xu,Yandi Wang,Fulin Shi,Leilei Gan,Linlin Yu,Qihuang Zhong,Keqin Peng,Yalong Li,Chengfu Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IndustryLLM：从 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 训练的开源工业语言模型，通过失败驱动的 CPT+SFT 适配配方（~100B tokens）与证据门控约束评估接口，在工业采购任务上显著提升离线准确性并带来线上 GMV +4.25%、满意询盘 +8.3%、延迟从 6-7s 降至 1.5s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业采购要求语言模型在严格安全容差下，弥合非正式买家术语、稀疏市场属性与权威工程标准之间的鸿沟，通用文本扩展难以满足。

Method: 基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base（35B 总参、约 3B 激活，冻结视觉编码器），采用失败驱动的 CPT+SFT 配方：CPT 使用约 100B token 语料（5B 国家标准 GB/T 与技术档案、10B 去标识真实交易与询盘记录、60B 通用回放）；通过多种语体改写（10 类体裁、8 种文风）、置信度路由的最小事实编辑与错误定向 QA 合成，重构约 20B token 领域子集以解决语体错配与事实脆弱性（如"42-luo-mu"→42CrMo、"16674"→GB/T 16674）；部署侧形式化证据门控约束评估接口，采用三值逻辑使未验证产品证据保持未知而非满足。

Result: 离线评测中采购查询结构化在 No-Think 模式下精确匹配提升 +2.97 个百分点（95% CI [2.11, 3.86]）；生产环境随机在线 A/B 实验显示 GMV +4.25%、满意询盘 +8.3%，延迟从 6-7 秒降至 1.5 秒。模型权重与配置已开源。

Conclusion: 面向工业采购的领域适配需结合领域语料 CPT、错误定向数据重构与证据门控评估，而非单纯文本规模扩展；该方案在离线与线上均取得一致收益并显著降低延迟。

Abstract: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

</details>


### [427] [COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31874)
*Hongji Pu,Ruixiang Tang,Yongfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出COUNTERMEM，一个跨任务构建和使用经核验的反事实记忆的强化学习框架，通过评估失败动作的反事实替代方案来提升LLM智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数智能体记忆框架仅通过与事实世界交互来构建记忆（如记住行动反馈），很少追问"如果当时采取不同动作，反馈是否会改变，能否成为有用记忆"。而直接在活跃环境中获取此类反事实反馈代价高昂，且会改变用于对比所需的状态。

Method: COUNTERMEM在失败动作后，借助可执行世界模型（测试、证明检查器、求解器）从原始状态的副本或重置中评估局部替代方案；存储包含原动作与修正动作、核验结果及复用条件的改进记录。学习一个记忆使用策略，选择检索记录或跳过记忆，以平衡任务成功率与交互成本，而基础LLM保持固定。评估时记忆与策略均被冻结。

Result: 在六个领域12个基准设置上，使用gpt-oss-120b时COUNTERMEM在全部12个基准上同时改进ReAct和Reflexion，平均提升12.6个百分点。两骨干四领域对比中任务运行token减少7.7%至42.0%（不含离线选择器训练成本）。消融显示去除核验或持久存储会削弱增益，将核验修正应用于不适宜决策会适得其反。

Conclusion: 经核验的反事实记忆能有效提升跨任务智能体性能并降低交互成本，核验与持久存储是关键，需谨慎选择记忆复用条件。

Abstract: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [428] [Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31897)
*Haorui Ma,Zehua Zang,Jiangmeng Li,Yi Li,Fanjing Xu,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 NashEval，将上下文相关（context-dependent）的智能体评估建模为双人零和博弈，用纳什均衡的支撑集定义各上下文下的赢家集合，并给出可从离线反馈中稳健学习该均衡的通用框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用需要在上下文信息（提示、任务、用户群体）下评估智能体。现有基于打分的方法（如 Bradley-Terry）强制偏好满足传递性，无法反映人类判断异质时的集体偏好；且离线日志中每个上下文只揭示部分智能体的反馈，朴素的插入式估计会有偏差。

Method: 受社会选择理论启发，把评估看作两名玩家各选一个智能体分布以争取更大集体偏好的上下文博弈。NashEval 先构造上下文收益矩阵的去偏估计，再用专门设计的正交损失（orthogonal loss）学习"上下文→均衡"的映射，避免为每个上下文单独求解博弈。

Result: 理论上证明：收益矩阵背后的 nuisance 函数估计误差仅通过高阶项影响所学均衡的风险（exploitability）。多组实验中，NashEval 提升了均衡学习的稳健性，并一致地识别出各上下文下表现最好的智能体集合。

Conclusion: NashEval 为上下文相关的智能体评估提供了稳健的均衡学习框架，能克服传递性偏好假设与离线数据偏差问题，稳定识别各上下文中的最优智能体集合。

Abstract: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

</details>


### [429] [Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31903)
*Yidi Qi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Choir 是一个用于分布式形式化的开放协议，将证明项目拆分为可独立完成的任务，让各自运行代理的贡献者通过 GitHub 协作，并用确定性门控保证质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前在 Lean 等证明助手中形式化教科书和定理的努力多为集中式：单一团队运行所有代理并承担全部计算成本，限制了参与度和可扩展性。

Method: Choir 将项目分解为可独立贡献者完成的任务，每位贡献者使用自己的 LLM 订阅运行代理，完全通过项目 GitHub 仓库进行协调；每个贡献在合并前需通过确定性门控检查。协议支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq，且开源、模块化，项目可替换单个组件或扩展协议。

Result: 论文提出并实现了 Choir 协议，支持三种证明助手，开源且模块化，但摘要未给出具体实验数据或形式化成果指标。

Conclusion: Choir 通过开放、分布式、可验证的协作模式，降低形式化项目的集中式计算成本，促进开放参与和可扩展性。

Abstract: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

</details>


### [430] [EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31906)
*Mukul Singh,Mansi Uniyal,Devin Devlin,Wen Xie,Big Thadawasin,Ritam Dutt,Vivian Lai,Hyeonsu B. Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EmailBench，一个针对企业邮件智能体的自包含基准测试，包含 206 个场景和 16 个任务类别，采用类型化邮件 API 与混合评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业邮件智能体需整合信息检索、结构化状态变更、时间推理与多步协作，但现有生产力基准少有聚焦自包含环境下的类型化邮件工作流。

Method: EmailBench 结合类型化邮件 API 规范与提供商中立命名、确定性的合成 Enron 风格语料库，以及基于交互原型任务意图遥测选定的场景套件；评估采用 258 个可执行静态断言与 211 个 LLM 评分标准的混合协议，在固定单用户语料上评测 8 种 LM 配置。

Result: 最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 的场景，尽管其 99.7% 的工具调用未出现 API 失败，且各类别通过率差异显著。

Conclusion: 有效工具执行不等同于任务完成；EmailBench 为端到端邮件智能体评估提供自包含环境，未来将扩展工具覆盖、多角色测试与重复运行评估。

Abstract: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

</details>


### [431] [Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31908)
*Tianshi Ming,Yingying Zhang,Xian Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MedCode 框架，让 LLM 生成嵌入式可执行代码来完成医疗计算，并配合加权 DPO，在多个模型上取得 20–30 个百分点的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在医疗考试和问答上表现良好，但在需要精确数值的医疗计算任务（如给药剂量、器官功能评估、预后评分）上不可靠，而这些高风险决策中即使微小错误也可能造成严重后果。

Method: MedCode：给定临床上下文，模型识别相关计算器、抽取输入变量，并生成脚本把算术运算交给确定性解释器执行，输出计算值、解释及单位。基于 MedCalc 基准构建 SFT 与偏好数据集，并额外整理 ICU 场景计算数据集；同时提出加权直接偏好优化 wDPO，自适应强调模型难以区分的偏好对。

Result: 在 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B 上实验，绝对准确率提升 20–30 个百分点。

Conclusion: 嵌入式代码生成能有效提升 LLM 的医疗计算能力，为高风险的临床数值决策提供更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

</details>


### [432] [BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31939)
*Xingbo Du,Fadli Aulawi Al Ghiffari,Leonard Song,Loka Li,Duzhen Zhang,Zixiao Wang,Xiuying Chen,Le Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BioDyad 通过在蒙特卡洛图搜索中耦合"科学发现"与"ML工程"两个层级，实现生物医学智能体ML的程序搜索协调，在BioXArena基准上取得最优成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体生物医学ML系统虽具备证据获取与可执行程序搜索能力，但难以在整个程序搜索过程中协调二者：新证据需指导候选构建，执行结果需反馈后续发现与复用，且验证需求须符合搜索预算。

Method: 提出 BioDyad，在蒙特卡洛图搜索内构建两个层级：（1）科学层级——结合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并将生物医学计划与执行结果关联存入记忆以供候选间复用；（2）工程层级——让候选程序依次经历烟雾执行、训练/验证评估到全数据重训练。

Result: 在 BioXArena 的 76 项任务、每任务两小时预算、三种匹配 LLM 后端下评测，BioDyad 在四种智能体方法和单次（one-shot）基线中均取得最高的惩罚后全任务分数和任务成功率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，协调生物医学发现与ML工程有助于将外部知识整合进可执行程序，从而应对异构生物医学任务。

Abstract: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

</details>


### [433] [Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31963)
*Ben Rachmut,Ning Zhang,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,William Yeoh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过符号引导分类法调节LLM智能体的自主性，发现中等自主性在分布式协调中表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为多智能体系统中的自主智能体日益普及，但其执行分布式协调协议的可靠性尚不明确；完全给予推理自主权在复杂领域常导致性能不稳定或下降。

Method: 提出符号引导分类法（SGT），刻画从开放式自然语言推理到完全既定算法执行的自主性谱系，中间层级提供部分伪代码引导。

Result: 中间自主性水平持续优于无引导智能体和完全规定式规范。

Conclusion: 自主性调节是LLM分布式协调的关键设计原则。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

</details>


### [434] [Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31980)
*Xiangyang Ju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究以仓库级案例验证通用编码代理能否进行严谨的科学性能工程，让Codex与Claude Code自主优化粒子追踪的FRNN搜索，展示了代理作为实验性性能工程师的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理能跨多轮工具使用持续追求目标，但通用代理能否开展严谨的科学性能工程仍缺乏证据，需通过真实案例检验。

Method: 采用仓库级案例研究，基于可执行目标（含精确正确性测试、性能剖析要求与验收标准，但不规定代码变换），让现成Codex和Claude Code代理从依赖PyTorch的CUDA实现出发自主优化FRNN搜索。

Result: 代理自主移除PyTorch依赖，通过假设驱动实验得到独立C++/CUDA库，精确复现参考结果；同步NumPy接口比原GPU常驻PyTorch接口快1.6倍（含主机传输），跨GPU架构与软件栈均类似；独立重跑得到不同假设序列并实现更优性能。

Conclusion: 目标持久型编码代理可作为实验性性能工程师；可执行的科学契约既能引导也能验证其优化过程。

Abstract: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

</details>


### [435] [CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31990)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CSI-Agent，一个基于 LLM 的跨域 Wi-Fi CSI 感知自适应框架，将跨域适配重新表述为部署时决策问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CSI 感知模型跨域部署脆弱，且已有方法多为离线模型设计（预训练更强表示或对整个目标域固定适配），未考虑目标标签稀缺及不同类别在同一域偏移下失败方式不同的问题。

Method: CSI-Agent 不处理原始 CSI 也不做样本级预测，而是将目标域行为汇总为有感知依据的类级证据；从互补 CSI 视图建立强目标自适应默认基线，由 LLM 规划器逐类决策保留默认或调用专门动作；并引入确定性验证与有界执行以减少不可靠干预。

Result: 在 4 个公开数据集、5 种跨域划分（设备、用户、环境及组合偏移）上评测，1-shot 适配下所有划分均取得最佳目标域性能，平均 Macro-F1 较最强基线提升约 16%。

Conclusion: 将跨域 CSI 适配转化为部署时的类级 LLM 决策问题，可在标签稀缺和多样域偏移下有效提升感知性能。

Abstract: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

</details>


### [436] [SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32000)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SenseAgent，用 LLM 作为运行时规划器，在跨域 IMU 活动识别中动态诊断目标域偏移并选择合适的感知工具，实现闭环感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IMU 模型在跨用户、设备、身体位置时常失效；现有方法把问题当作静态模型设计任务（预训练更强表征、数据增强、预先选定一种自适应方法），但实际目标域是逐步观察到的、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同的感知动作。

Method: SenseAgent 不直接让 LLM 分类原始 IMU 信号，而是将 LLM 用作运行时规划器，结合感知工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器。它从目标流构建无标签诊断报告，据此决定保留原始推理或调用专门工具（重力感知、原型迁移、风格归一化）；验证器检查源校准、目标记忆可靠性和无害准则后再接受高风险决策，并支持无需重训练骨干的少量反馈。

Result: 在多个 IMU 数据集和部署偏移上评估，验证后的路径选择改善了跨域感知，尤其在较难的佩戴位置和复合偏移下更明显，并从有限的用户反馈中进一步获益。

Conclusion: 该设计将跨域 IMU 感知从固定推理流程转变为闭环感知过程：诊断目标偏移、选择合适感知动作并拒绝不安全的自适应。

Abstract: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

</details>


### [437] [What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32002)
*Babak Barazandeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文挑战"LoRA的rank控制模型容量"这一常见直觉，证明在逐因子范数预算下rank不构成容量约束，rank实际决定的是可达更新集合与谱抵消的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA中rank r被普遍视为容量控制：rank越小模型越简单、泛化越好。作者质疑这一直觉在实践常用的逐因子范数/权重衰减预算下是否成立。

Method: 在逐因子硬范数预算下做理论分析：刻画LoRA可达更新集为核范数球内rank≤r的矩阵；分析线性读出模型类、Rademacher复杂度与分布位移泛函；对比逐因子预算与联合预算，并研究谱方向上rank与预算对抵消预训练主奇异方向的作用，给出rank上下界。

Result: 每个复杂度/位移泛函都在rank-one更新处取最大，rank上限从不生效；线性读出模型类对所有r≥1完全相同，Rademacher复杂度与r无关，分布位移有与rank无关且紧的上界。改用联合预算可恢复依赖rank的数据相关复杂度界，但仅在特征分布良好散布时有效，最坏情况仍与rank无关。谱上，抵消预训练主奇异方向需足够rank与预算，在双侧谱衰减下rank上下界匹配。

Conclusion: rank不应被理解为容量大小，而应理解为决定哪些更新可达、以及抵消需付出多少代价的谱控制参数。

Abstract: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

</details>


### [438] [Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32019)
*Valeriy Vyaltsev,Anton Andreychuk,Taisia Zlotnikova,Konstantin Yakovlev,Aleksandr Panov,Alexey Skrynnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DMM 用多轮离散迭代"意图"精炼替代一次性动作采样，解决去中心化多智能体路径规划中局部有效选择被重组为不兼容联合动作的问题，显著提升成功率并保持去中心化执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化 MAPF 需在部分可观测下无碰撞到达各自目标。可学习策略虽有效，但当同一情境存在多个协调联合动作时，独立从各智能体分布采样会把局部有效的选择重组为互不兼容的联合动作；该失败源自最终采样机制，即便各智能体动作分布学得正确也会发生。

Method: 提出 DMM（Decentralized Master-Mind）：受扩散模型去噪启发，用离散、迭代式的动作意图精炼取代一次性采样。智能体初始化随机动作意图，通过局部通信在多轮中精炼，在承诺前耦合彼此选择。用模仿学习在专家 MAPF 解上预训练，再用 MICPO（面向多智能体多轮动作精炼的无 critic 组相对强化学习）进一步优化。

Result: 总体成功率更高、解代价低于所评估的可学习基线。在 1,600 个 MovingAI 任务上，经 MICPO 微调的 DMM 解出 1,598 个，覆盖率最高，解代价接近最强基线；并可扩展到障碍密集环境中超过一百万个同时行动的智能体。

Conclusion: 轮级意图精炼能在保持去中心化执行的同时改善联合动作协调，验证了迭代精炼作为采样替代方案的可行性。

Abstract: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

</details>


### [439] [A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32020)
*Noah L. Schroeder,Yessy Eka Ambarwati,Yuji Zhang,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个符合NGSS标准的中高中科学基准，用合成数据管道、多评审验证和心理测量分析评估9个开源LLM，发现模型规模不能稳定预测性能，并指出合成题目与标准对齐不足，需人工介入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益融入教育，但缺乏针对K-12科学、与标准对齐的评估工具；现有基准多测通用语言或高级科学推理，忽视中学科学课程相关内容。

Method: 开发NGSS对齐的中高中科学综合基准，采用严格的合成数据管道、多评审验证和题目级心理测量分析；系统评估9个开源权重LLM；并引入人工评审检验生成题目与NGSS标准的对齐度。

Result: 若干较小的、可本地部署的模型在多样科学领域和题型上达到高准确率；模型规模不能一致预测性能；人工评审显示合成生成题目与NGSS标准并非完全对齐。

Conclusion: 教育部署需有意识地选择模型；人工在环的题目开发有价值；需探索内容知识与教学知识的交叉，并扩展基准以评估LLM在交互式、基于证据的教育反馈方面的能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

</details>


### [440] [Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32035)
*Asaad Althoubi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现推理模式并非提升模型可靠性，而是"集中"模型错误：独立采样答案更容易一致地错，动摇了self-consistency"一致即正确"的前提，且各类置信度加权方法均无法胜过简单多数投票。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Self-consistency假设独立采样的不一致代表不确定，因此一致性可视为正确性证据。作者想检验当只切换推理模式、固定权重时，这一假设是否仍然成立，以及置信度信号在决策层面是否真正有效。

Method: 在五个基准、74,944个样本上，固定权重仅切换推理模式进行对比实验；分析错答重合概率、不同答案数量、选项空间与位置先验；在八个模型五个基准上比较280种方法-数据集-模型组合的多数投票与加权投票；测试六信号学习组合的域外泛化。

Result: 推理在所有十个数据集-规模对比中提高两个独立错答重合概率（p=0.00098），限定同错题后九比九成立；无界答案空间中推理将不同答案数降至0.43-0.65倍，有界空间中错误质量集中且位置先验无法解释；加权投票仅98.5%与多数投票一致、其余仅56.3%正确，无一方法经校正后胜过多数投票；信号方向可反转，六信号学习组合域外无增益。

Conclusion: 推理模式集中而非减少错误，破坏self-consistency的一致性假设；置信度信号应在决策结果上评估而非区分度上评估，简单多数投票仍难被超越。

Abstract: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

</details>


### [441] [Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32046)
*Maximillian Rossi,Prajwal Raghunath,Haoqing Xuan,Yusen Zhang,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CacheBack，一种基于接收方条件训练无关的KV缓存压缩方法，用于多智能体通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统中，文本通信需解码且可能遗漏证据；近期的潜在通信直接传输KV缓存，虽避免文本生成并提升准确率和延迟，但完整KV缓存随上下文及智能体数量线性增长，内存和上下文开销常超出GPU资源和上下文窗口限制。

Method: 关键观察是智能体只需发送接收方完成任务所需的信息（称为接收方条件通信）。接收方给发送方一个信息需求的小描述，用以过滤和压缩发送方的KV缓存。CacheBack是一个简单、鲁棒、无需训练的接收方条件实现，基于发送方的注意力权重进行压缩。

Result: 在FanOutQA上，CacheBack配合Qwen 3去除75%的状态，准确率提升14.7个百分点，中位任务完成延迟相对文本通信降低3.2倍。在密集Transformer、Mamba-注意力混合和滑动窗口注意力等模型家族中显示类似提升。

Conclusion: 接收方条件通信可有效压缩多智能体KV缓存传输，CacheBack在多种模型架构上实现准确性提升与延迟降低。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

</details>


### [442] [EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32049)
*Bhavyateja Potineni,Lohit Giri,Anu Jain,Vadim Kutsyy,Rajasekhar Pentakota*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EngramRAG是一个基于互补学习系统原理的自适应记忆架构，通过清醒态反射与异步梦境态巩固双循环，解决LLM智能体多会话记忆的三大问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主LLM智能体在多会话环境中面临三大记忆缺陷：联想盲区（无法多跳遍历关系依赖）、脚手架遗忘（时间衰减驱逐核心人格不变量）、静态拓扑停滞（图结构忽略使用动态）。

Method: 提出EngramRAG，包含四个模块：(1)使用调制的个性化PageRank(U-PPR)，通过Hebbian可塑性自适应转移概率，促进持久实体形成高中心性认知宏枢纽；(2)巩固激活的拓扑衰减(CATD)，按拓扑承载权重而非墙钟时间缩放保留半衰期，含冷启动宽限期；(3)有向SUPERSEDES DAG过滤，在事实变更时抑制过时状态；(4)三源混合检索，融合稠密向量、BM25与U-PPR，采用动态RRF。

Result: 在LoCoMo基准10个长期对话的1,982个QA对上：Recall@5相对提升38.9%(53.21% vs 38.29%, p<0.001)，MRR提升43.1%(0.4203 vs 0.2937)，优于BM25(48.66%)和静态图检索(8.50%)。时序推理Recall@5达62.33%。突变测试中SUPERSEDES将分裂脑幻觉从70.0%降至0.0%，90天仿真实现100.0%脚手架保留，检索反射仅26.21ms。

Conclusion: EngramRAG有效解决了LLM智能体长期记忆的关键缺陷，在检索精度、时序推理与状态一致性上显著超越现有方法，同时保持低延迟交互。

Abstract: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

</details>


### [443] [Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32061)
*Enric Boix-Adsera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AI安全框架，将worker agents绑定到限定允许动作的合约，由monitor和judge agent负责执行，并通过不对称计算资源保证安全，可实证测量统计安全保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理能力增强，需要一种可行方法限制其行为，使其不越界并保持安全性。

Method: 将worker agents绑定到合约（specifying permitted actions）；分配给monitor agents与judge不同职责以执行和规约合约；给monitor与worker分配不对称的计算资源。

Result: 该框架能够经验性地测量统计意义上的安全保证（statistical safety guarantees），适用于代码安全、escape-the-box等多种场景。

Conclusion: 合约+角色分工+不对称资源是一种通用且可度量的AI安全方案，适配广泛场景。

Abstract: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

</details>


### [444] [Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32081)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Jesse Thomason,Jonathan May*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PAU基准，用于评估模型在仅有黑盒API访问（无代码读取权限）下理解Python代码片段的能力，并发现即使前沿模型也表现不佳，随后用AAC范式微调提升交互式理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码理解与生成系统依赖对相关代码的读取权限，但在面对外部API时该假设不成立，因此需要研究仅通过交互来理解黑盒工具的问题。

Method: 提出PAU（Python API Understanding）基准：模型仅有API级别的黑盒访问，需通过探索性输入查询API并从输出中推断代码片段的真实功能；同时借鉴机器人学习中的非对称Actor-Critic（AAC）范式对模型进行后训练。

Result: 即便前沿模型在PAU上也表现不佳，最佳模型Claude-4-Opus在超过45%的测试集上理解失败；错误分析显示模型过度自信，常高估当前假设质量，导致探索不足和过早终止；经AAC微调的Qwen3-8B可匹配GPT-5-mini的性能。

Conclusion: 黑盒API理解是更具挑战性的无监督工具理解问题，AAC后训练能有效增强模型的主动探索与交互式代码理解能力。

Abstract: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

</details>


### [445] [Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32091)
*K. R. Jayaram,Vatche Isahagian,Vinod Muthusamy,Gegi Thomas,Punleuk Oum,Gaodan Fang,Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文主张"智能体记忆"应作为一等可插拔中间件层（如同数据访问、消息、持久化），并提出六大系统挑战与参考实现 ALTK-Evolve。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 默认情况下，AI 智能体跨会话无状态，导致"操作性失忆"：每次会话几乎不了解既往失败、修复、偏好或成功策略，因而重复犯错、丢弃经验。主流方案是"定制记忆"，将检索、持久化与学习逻辑硬编码到单个智能体并绑定单一存储引擎，造成记忆无法替换、共享、隔离或独立推理的碎片化格局。

Method: 将智能体记忆重构为中间件问题，提出"一等、可插拔记忆层"的愿景，并通过六大系统挑战展开：双向可插拔性、宿主原生拦截（host-native interposition）、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带溯源（provenance）的联邦共享、生命周期治理。据此实现参考系统 ALTK-Evolve，用于自我改进型智能体。

Result: 给出 ALTK-Evolve 作为演示性参考实现，以具体化上述挑战；并未提供定量评测结果。

Conclusion: 智能体记忆应被当作独立的中间件层来设计，作者以 ALT-K-Evolve 为例提出面向未来记忆中间件的更广泛研究议程。

Abstract: AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns.
  We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

</details>


### [446] [GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32093)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Adam Shen,Aslan Huo Feng,Chinmay Khanna,Jun Rui Huang,Raghav Sarmukaddam,Surendira Balaji Natarajan,Xiaotong Cui,Xincan Zhang,Thomson Yen,Hongseok Namkoong,Jonathan May,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 GameBoyWorlds 测试平台，用于评估智能体在电子游戏中自我改进的能力，发现现有前沿模型与自我改进方法均表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体依赖专家指导在多交互环境中运作，但其能否从自身经验中自主学习仍不明确，因此需要构建测试平台来评估自我改进方法。

Method: 提出 GameBoyWorlds，含两部分：GameBoyWorlds-Execution 在 5 个游戏系列上评估任务执行，提供训练游戏但无演示、文档或奖励，智能体需自主探索并推断可操作知识（500 个短时任务）；GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough 评估两款同人宝可梦游戏的端到端通关，需从自身经验学习并自主提升。评估了世界建模、自主技能发现、好奇心驱动探索写指南及多模态记忆+层级子目标的流水线等方法。

Result: 前沿模型开箱即用完成不足 50%（因多模态 grounding 失败）；世界建模与自主技能发现失败，好奇心探索写指南仅部分成功；Playthrough 中多模态记忆与层级子目标流水线连首个重大里程碑都未达成。

Conclusion: 当代自我改进方法仍显不足，GameBoyWorlds 为自我改进智能体设定了雄心勃勃的目标。

Abstract: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.

</details>


### [447] [AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32184)
*Hailin Zhong,Shengxin Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文刻画了基础模型智能体在"提议—运行时—工具"边界上的可认证性问题：若将历史条件下的提议过程坍缩为仅依赖状态的提议包络，可能保持提议覆盖但破坏可认证性，只有当每个提议条件下的坍缩纤维都存在共同的鲁棒安全干预时该坍缩才是无损的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的基础模型智能体通常在模型已生成语义提议后，运行时才介入。此时提议既是动作候选，也是由历史条件过程生成的决定时观测。传统"状态上的策略"建模忽略了这一结构，论文要揭示这种忽略在认证意义上的代价。

Method: 在有限鲁棒接口中定义坍缩模型与历史增广模型，比较二者的可生存核（viability kernel）；用提议条件下的坍缩纤维是否共享共同鲁棒安全干预作为无损判据；将单步结果用精确有限信念与标准安全/可达不动点扩展到时间维度；并用受控的model-in-the-loop实验验证。

Result: 坍缩模型的可生存核包含于历史增广核的物理投影中，且坍缩无损当且仅当每条提议条件下的纤维保留共同鲁棒安全干预；即使提议与历史字母表为常数大小，该差距也可达最大。同一条件给出对偶结论：观测当前提议可在其区分需要不兼容干预的潜在模式时恢复鲁棒可行性。实验中移除遥测或效果验证、或限制干预权限时，能复现预测的障碍。

Conclusion: 论文的贡献不是新的不动点演算，而是刻画了何时模型—工具边界上的"提议—历史相关性"对认证是必要的，并区分了无限期运行可生存性与有限最坏情形下的可验证进展。

Abstract: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.

</details>


### [448] [Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32102)
*Wenlong Wang,Fergal Reid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将全局工作空间理论从Transformer扩展到状态空间语言模型（Mamba-1/2/3），通过对残差流和循环状态拟合Jacobian透镜，发现递归状态是工作空间内容的补充载体，但其恢复、持续性和因果应用需单独测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局工作空间假说此前主要用于解释Transformer的表征，尚不清楚它能否推广到状态空间（SSM）语言模型。作者希望检验Mamba等递归模型中是否存在类似可读的"工作空间"内容载体。

Method: 在Mamba-1、Mamba-2、Mamba-3的残差流和递归状态上，使用原始1000提示词配方拟合Jacobian透镜，并构建残差—状态的联合读出；开展时间映射和词表实验；提出"符号保护引导"（sign-guarded steering）编辑方法，与坐标交换法对比。

Result: 联合残差—状态读出在至少5/6任务族上优于仅残差透镜；Mamba-2上仅状态读出在全部6个任务族超过残差和对数透镜，归一化联合读出在5个族上优于两个分量；符号保护引导在5个模型的口头报告试验中提升目标前五成功率；关系型答案上改进不一致，引导编辑常输出被编辑概念本身。

Conclusion: 递归状态是工作空间内容的互补载体，仅靠递归状态即可支持口头访问，但对其内容的恢复、持续性和因果用途需要分别测量，现有增益尚未稳定扩展到关系型答案。

Abstract: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.

</details>


### [449] [Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32116)
*Marco Biroli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战Best-of-N越狱ASR服从幂律的传统观点，提出一个简单势垒模型，用四个可解释参数刻画完整(N,M,T)攻击曲面，并实现跨模型坍缩及外推预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作认为Best-of-N越狱的ASR随N呈幂律增长，但作者发现指数随N漂移，存在有限尺寸伪影；且几乎无人系统探索整个(N,M)双预算攻击曲面及其对生成温度T的依赖。

Method: 引入势垒模型：每个提示有基线安全水平，每个augmentation对应一个随机热激活势垒。以四个可由安全机制解释的数字参数决定整个(N,M)攻击曲面。

Result: 四个参数可从N≤100的拟合外推到N=10^4；将五个不同模型坍缩到同一标度函数；并能从单一温度拟合预测其他温度下的ASR。

Conclusion: BoN攻击的成功率不遵循简单幂律，而由势垒模型统一刻画，提供跨模型、跨预算、跨温度的可解释且可外推的预测框架。

Abstract: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.

</details>


### [450] [Artificial intelligences and human scientists exhibit complementary strengths in theory building](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32562)
*Ke Li,Spyros I. Zoumpoulis,Phanish Puranam,Philip Parker,Matthew Eshbaugh-Soha,Izzy Gainsburg,Michael Gilead,Igor Grossmann,Britt Hadar,Yoel Inbar,Almog Simchon,Robb Willer,Rui Ai,Ruicheng Ao,Gavin J. Bala,Matthew Bidwell,Shuang Cai,Kai Chang,Skyler Y. Chen,Cory J. Clark,Irmak Dai,Abhinandan Dalal,Connor Douglas,Alexis Du,Zhehang Du,Leyun Feng,Isabel Fernandez-Mateo,Linnea Gandhi,Cyrille Grumbach,Anmol Gupta,Vansh Gupta,Maria Hademer,Jay H. Hardy,Chen Kai Huang,Jacob Xiangyu Jin,Ufuk Keskin,Na Hyun Kim,Mert Kobaş,Byounghoon Koh,Gabrielle Lamont-Dobbin,Gregory Lanzalotto,Sun Young Lee,Dingzhe Leng,Chenjun Li,Weiyuan Li,Zeyuan Li,Zhongyuan Liang,Ning Liu,Peihong Liu,Yuhan Liu,Jiuyao Lu,Wanteng Ma,Nicolas Martinet,Natnael Mulat,Christina A. Nguyen,Khai Nguyen,Quang Minh Nguyen,Naja Pape,Chanwoo Park,Stefanos Poulidis,Jeffrey Sanchez-Burks,Michael Schaerer,Isabelle Solal,Yanbo Song,Junghyo Sun,Qingyao Sun,Rui Sun,Roderick Swaab,Kevin Tan,Dequn Teng,Michelle A. Vaccaro,Robin Vigerbaeck,Xiaomeng Wang,Randol H. Yao,Duygu Yilmaz,Shun Yiu,Ecem Yucesoy,Allen Zang,Ruijia Zhang,Xilan Zhang,Yichi Zhang,Zhanhao Zhang,Eric Luis Uhlmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究比较25个LLM与13位资深研究者及60位博士生在社科（性别与种族不平等）理论构建、预测和修正任务上的表现，发现AI个体表现多超人类，但人类理论更多样、聚合后预测增益更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究AI（LLM）在社会科学高层认知任务上是否可媲美或超越人类科学家，明确其优势与局限。

Method: 以性别与种族不平等学术论述为领域，让25个LLM与13位资深研究者、60位博士生完成理论构建、对新实证结果的预测及依据新证据的理论修正任务，并由不知来源的独立评分者评估理论质量。

Result: AI在多数任务上个体表现优于多数人类；人类理论更多样、聚合后预测准确性提升更大；AI理论更详尽（更多路径与潜变量）且质量评分更高，但其复杂性部分为"装饰性"，未带来更准预测；人类用更简单理论实现更高预测效率；AI更常依据新证据修正理论，人类则有选择性地、对先前预测误差敏感地更新信念。

Conclusion: AI强大的处理能力使其适合应对复杂性任务，但人类观点的多样性对群体智慧和集体创造力至关重要。

Abstract: We investigate the effectiveness of artificial intelligences (AI)-specifically large language models (LLMs)-relative to human scientists at high-level cognitive tasks in social science such as theory formulation, predictions of novel empirical results, and theory revision in response to new evidence. The research domain was academic discourse regarding gender and race inequality. Our findings, comparing 25 LLMs with 13 senior researchers and 60 doctoral scholars, reveal that the AIs outperformed most humans individually on most of the present tasks, while human theories were more diverse and exhibited greater gains in predictive accuracy from aggregation. AI-generated theories were more extensively elaborated, involving additional theoretical paths and latent variables, and were rated as higher quality than human theories by independent raters blinded to source. However, this theoretical complexity was in part ornamental, in that it was not associated with more accurate predictions about empirical patterns in data; in contrast, human scientists achieved greater predictive efficiency with simpler theories. The AIs were significantly more likely than human scientists to revise their theories to incorporate new evidence; human scientists updated their beliefs in a selective way that is sensitive to prior prediction errors. We speculate that the superior processing capacity of artificial intelligences makes them especially well-suited to tasks requiring grappling with complexity, but that the greater diversity of human ideas is essential to wise crowds and collective creativity.

</details>


### [451] [READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32123)
*Gerardo Pastrana,Haojun Li,Dhruv Mehta,Anoushka Vyas,Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad,Henrik Ohlsson,John Paparrizos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 READ-Bench 基准，研究多变量时序诊断中的历史案例检索，发现重排序阶段的少量有标签监督（高斯过程重排序器）比更强表示或语言模型推理更关键，并据此构建融合检索+重排序系统，在12个数据集上提升 NDCG@10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序诊断系统很少依赖检索相关历史案例，即便使用，检索也仅通过下游预测间接评估；同时缺乏以"共享故障/事件类型"而非信号形状定义相关性的检索基准。

Method: 构建 READ-Bench 基准，覆盖12个诊断数据集，以多变量时序为核心，用共享故障/事件类型定义相关性。将检索视为"基础检索器+重排序器"两阶段，在统一协议下（变化监督、污染、语料规模并做显著性检验）评估经典距离、符号检索器、自监督与基础模型嵌入器及其融合，以及标签感知与语言模型重排序器。最终方案：将正常残差打分嵌入器与动态时间规整（DTW）分支通过倒数排序融合结合，再用高斯过程重排序器传播少量邻居标签。

Result: 在统一通道独立接口下，预训练表示在单独搜索上相对强经典/符号基线无统计显著优势。少量已解决案例监督的重排序（高斯过程重排序器）收益最大，优于更复杂表示或语言模型推理，且在污染和全语料规模下依然有效。最终融合系统在全部12个数据集上提升 NDCG@10：重排序带来 +0.11，相对最强单一基础检索器提升 +0.16。

Conclusion: 在时序诊断的历史案例检索中，重排序阶段的小量有标签监督是决定性因素，而非更强的表示或语言模型推理；所提融合检索+高斯过程重排序方案在多数据集上稳定优于单一基线。

Abstract: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.

</details>


### [452] [PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32166)
*Taehwan Park,Changmin Lee,Hayeon Lee,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PastForward系统，通过在普通任务执行中积累的计算经验进行细粒度验证复用，加速边缘设备上的GUI智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘设备上运行GUI智能体可保护隐私，但每步动作的VLM推理成本高，部署困难。现有系统要么每步做完整VLM推理，要么复用粗粒度知识，难以适应动态移动环境和用户任务。

Method: 解码时检索先前输出序列作为设备自适应多token提议，并在单次VLM前向传播中验证；跨动作步骤，用先前GUI转移在当前动作执行时启动下一步推理，仅当预测屏幕与观察屏幕匹配时保留早期计算，并传递可复用的KV状态。

Result: 在基于真实移动使用模式的AndroidWorld工作负载上，跨服务器和边缘平台、多种VLM骨干进行评估。设备端实现1.63-2.36倍的动作步延迟加速，同时保持任务成功率。

Conclusion: PastForward通过验证的细粒度计算经验复用，有效加速边缘GUI智能体，兼顾延迟与任务成功。

Abstract: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

</details>


### [453] [STRIDE: Automated Evaluation of Text-to-Trajectory Alignment across Diverse Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34799)
*Wanchun Ni,Tao Qi,Leonel Aguilar,Jiugeng Sun,Marlene Wagner,Verena Zimmermann,Mennatallah El-Assady*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出STRIDE，首个评估场景描述与行人轨迹间上下文对齐的框架，无需人类轨迹数据即可实现可复现、可扩展的自动化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言条件轨迹生成已实现，但评估滞后。现有行人轨迹指标依赖真实人类数据比较，难以扩展到多样化上下文的文本到轨迹生成；逐场景收集人类轨迹成本高昂且不可行。加之行人行为异质且依赖上下文，不存在唯一正确答案，现有评估框架无法迁移，导致可靠的规模化评估困难。

Method: STRIDE通过三个设计实现：1）基于社会学理论推导VRDST评估协议，定义完整评估空间；2）将高层上下文分解为场景自适应的行为问题；3）每个问题由确定性测量工具库解答，产生可复现答案。并在人群领域实例化为STRIDE-Bench，涵盖1K场景、6K行为问题、11K测量，跨30个真实地图，并标定期望答案。

Result: 人类验证表明STRIDE-Bench与人类行为和判断一致，达到80%人类一致性。对多个文本到轨迹模型评估发现，其上下文对齐能力有限，细粒度上下文条件化仍存在持续挑战。

Conclusion: STRIDE为上下文对齐的行人轨迹生成提供了原则性评估的第一步，实现完整、可验证、自动化且可扩展的评估。

Abstract: Language-conditioned trajectory generation is here, but its evaluation has not kept pace. Existing pedestrian trajectory metrics compare trajectories with real-world human data. This does not scale to text-to-trajectory generation across diverse contexts, as collecting human trajectories for every scenario is costly and infeasible. Moreover, pedestrian behavior is heterogeneous and context-dependent, with no single metric as the correct answer, and current evaluation frameworks are not transferable to this domain. These challenges make scalable, reliable evaluation difficult. We introduce STRIDE, the first framework for evaluating context alignment between scenario descriptions and pedestrian trajectories. STRIDE addresses these challenges through three design choices. First, we derive our VRDST evaluation protocol from sociological theories to define a complete evaluation space. Second, it decomposes high-level context into scenario-adaptive behavioral questions. Third, every question is resolved against a deterministic measurement tool library that yields reproducible answers. Together, STRIDE enables complete, verifiable, automated, and scalable evaluation across diverse contexts without requiring human trajectory data. We instantiate STRIDE in the crowd domain as STRIDE-Bench, comprising 1K scenarios, 6K behavioral questions, and 11K measurements with calibrated expected answers across 30 real-world maps. Comprehensive human validations show that STRIDE-Bench is consistent with human behavior and judgment, achieving 80% human agreement. We further evaluate several text-to-trajectory models, finding limited context-alignment capability and persistent challenges in fine-grained context conditioning. We believe that the STRIDE framework provides a first step toward principled evaluation of context-aligned pedestrian trajectory generation.

</details>


### [454] [Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32172)
*Xikai Yang,Hieu Trung Nguyen,Dunyuan Xu,Yuzhi Zhao,Jinpeng Li,Wenao Ma,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NTRL-Code框架，仅用测试阶段的无标注噪声数据实现代码大模型的鲁棒自进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户指令常含糊且有错，而鲁棒性微调依赖成对的干净-噪声样本，标注成本高且需复杂噪声模拟。

Method: 测试阶段利用保守自去噪获得更干净的语义锚点以估计目标，并用基于AST的结构聚合机制从多个候选程序中估计代理目标；随后在原始噪声提示上以格式有效性、代码相似度与抗重复信号的混合奖励优化策略。

Result: 在三个基准（各含字符级、词级、段落级扰动）上取得鲁棒且一致的提升，稳定了多种基座模型的预测。

Conclusion: 无需成对干净-噪声样本即可实现代码LLM的鲁棒自进化，验证了NTRL-Code的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code.

</details>


### [455] [Feedback Makes Perfect: A Closed-Loop Framework for NL-to-STL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33287)
*Bowen Ye,Xiang Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将自然语言到STL的翻译重新表述为闭环反馈过程，通过将生成的STL公式反向翻译为自然语言供用户校验并迭代修正，大幅提升翻译准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM一次性、开环的NL-to-STL翻译存在准确率上限，根源在于任务本身定义不完善：自然语言存在歧义，且用户所写未必等于其真实意图，目标规格并未完全包含在输入文本中。

Method: 提出闭环反馈框架：每次生成的STL公式被反向翻译为自然语言供用户核对，用户以自然语言给出修正驱动修订，直至接受规格，用户全程无需读写形式化语法。框架基于反馈控制理论中的不对称性——正向路径（歧义语言到形式逻辑）困难易错，而反馈路径（结构化STL到语言）可做到高精度，从而让不精确的正向路径实现精确的闭环行为。

Result: 在500条专家撰写的需求与7个LLM上实验：反向翻译解释与专家判断一致率达99.5%；闭环细化使强模型从约89%开环准确率提升至98.0–99.2%，弱模型提升超30个百分点（如17.6%→48.0%）。消融实验表明提升来自反馈的语义内容而非重复尝试。专家审查和280次会话的用户研究进一步验证了环路的可靠性，并识别出反馈不再有帮助的能力阈值。

Conclusion: 将NL-to-STL翻译重构为闭环反馈过程可有效突破开环翻译的准确率上限，且用户无需掌握形式化语法；同时存在一个能力阈值，超过该阈值后反馈不再带来增益。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) enables rigorous verification and control of cyber-physical systems, but writing correct specifications requires expertise that most requirement holders lack. Large language models can translate natural-language (NL) requirements into STL, yet stronger translators alone approach an accuracy ceiling. We argue that this ceiling stems from how the task is posed: one-shot, open-loop translation is somewhat ill-defined. Natural language is ambiguous, and, more fundamentally, what a person writes may not always be what they intend, so the target specification is not fully contained in the input text. We therefore reformulate NL-to-STL translation as a closed-loop feedback process. Each generated formula is translated back into natural language for the user to check, and natural-language corrections drive revision until the user accepts the specification. Users never read or write formal syntax. This framework rests on an asymmetry familiar from feedback control theory. The forward path, from ambiguous language to formal logic, is hard and error-prone. The feedback path, from structured STL back to language, can be made highly precise, and a precise feedback path lets an imprecise forward path achieve precise closed-loop behavior. Experiments on 500 expert-authored requirements and seven LLMs support this view. Back-translated explanations agree with expert judgments in 99.5\% of cases. Closed-loop refinement raises strong models from about 89\% open-loop accuracy to 98.0--99.2\%, and yields gains of over 30 percentage points for weaker models (e.g., 17.6\%$\rightarrow$48.0\%). Ablations show these gains come from the semantic content of the feedback rather than from repeated attempts. An expert audit and a 280-session user study further confirm the reliability of the loop. We also identify a capability threshold above which feedback no longer helps.

</details>


### [456] [CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32192)
*Sen Zhao,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Xinyu He,Ding Zou,Xu Zhang,Qinghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出CoMemBench基准，用于评测多智能体工作流拓扑下的协作记忆边界（共享与隔离），填补现有基准对拓扑条件化记忆边界测量不足的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体工作流需在任务相关信息共享与无关、陈旧、未验证或不兼容信息隔离之间取得平衡，这一"任务条件化的信息范围"即协作记忆边界。工作流拓扑决定了哪些中间产物对哪些下游工作者适用、何时失效，因此提供了共享与隔离的结构性压力维度。然而现有记忆基准主要评估保持与检索，多智能体基准强调协调与端到端完成，拓扑条件化的记忆边界基本未被测量。

Method: 提出CoMemBench，一个基于执行评测的基准。它从来源锚定的依赖图构建跨四个领域的800个复合工作流，包含节点局部规范、可验证的产物交接、原生评估器和配对的隔离挑战。评测指标包括：工作流完成度、已验证节点进展、必需交接可靠性、隔离鲁棒性和token成本。

Result: 实验揭示了"共享—隔离"权衡：更广的上下文提升信息可用性，但可能削弱隔离能力；同时系统排名会随拓扑结构和产物违规情况发生变化。

Conclusion: CoMemBench为拓扑条件化的多智能体协作记忆边界提供了可执行、可验证的评测手段，暴露了现有系统在共享与隔离之间的权衡，并表明单一拓扑下的评测结论难以推广。

Abstract: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.

</details>


### [457] [Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32201)
*Hantao Yu,Sandy Han,Udaya Ghai,Ferhat Erata,Joe Lilien,Aman Goel,Ali Torkamani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在OPCD中，用针对学生常见错误的通用指令替代逐实例gold作为特权信息，可显著提升OOD性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPCD常用实例级gold答案或示范作为特权，会损害训练性能，尤其OOD场景。

Method: 设计针对训练样本中学生常见错误的通用指令（每句仅几句话、对所有样本统一使用），作为OPCD特权进行on-policy上下文蒸馏。

Result: 在autoformalization任务中匹配的格式指令OOD准确率大幅超过gold；在ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA及Qwen3-Thinking、Olmo3-Thinking的8个实验中7个OOD超出gold 4-17点，域内与gold相当。

Conclusion: 通用指令同时适用于源域和目标域，比实例级gold更具迁移性，且不损失域内性能。

Abstract: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.

</details>


### [458] [From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35618)
*Shamil Chandaria,Arvo Muñoz Morán,Fernando Rosas,Anil Seth,Henry Shevlin,Marcus Hutter,Thore Graepel,Adam Bales,Iulia Comsa,Murray Shanahan,Ruben Laukkonen,Morten Kringelbach,Chris Frith,Shane Legg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将AI意识问题与"困难问题"分离，聚焦可操作的"映射问题"：在承认意识随附于系统组织的基础上，探讨超随附基础处于何种描述粒度。作者扩展Marr三层次为五层功能描述层级，将主要意识理论定位其中，为每层建立可操作指标并评估当前AI系统，再用贝叶斯模型整合理论与证据得出意识概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI意识是哲学与计算机科学的紧迫先发问题，但众多相互竞争的理论各说各话、难以对话，导致进展受阻。作者希望绕开最深层的形而上学分歧，找出可推进的路径。

Method: 1) 区分困难问题与映射问题，搁置形而上学分歧，聚焦超随附基础的描述粒度；2) 将Marr三层次扩展为五层功能描述层级（行为、计算、内在因果结构、有机体、有机体-环境），以超随附、粗粒化与多重可实现性为基础；3) 把主要意识理论按其所重视的层级定位；4) 为每层开发可操作指标并评估现有AI系统；5) 用贝叶斯模型将理论信念与指标证据整合为系统具有意识能力的总体可信度。

Result: 在对当前LLM的示例评估中，结论既取决于理论信念的分配，也取决于证据的解读：在不同假设性解读与信念分布下，评估结果从低于0.01到约0.8不等，显示出对假设的高度敏感性。此外，各层的意识指标与通用智能所需的架构特征高度重叠，暗示能力日益增强的AI可能成为意识更强的候选者。

Conclusion: 该框架支持一种"结构化的不可知论"：明确表达理论承诺，随证据积累更新信念，评估以聚合概率而非断言性结论呈现。

Abstract: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.

</details>


### [459] [Witness: Discovery, Deciphering, and Epiphany in Interactive Puzzle Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32208)
*Guanghan Ning,Ping Liu,Linyi Li,Huangjie Zheng,Arjun Neervannan,Huu Nguyen,Michael Sklar,Deniz Zorlu,Nicolai Ouporov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出WITNESS二维网格谜题环境及WitnessGym/WitnessBench，研究语言模型在隐藏规则发现任务上的局限，发现规则习得是前沿模型的主要瓶颈，强化学习可提升小模型表现并迁移至外部基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化科学需要智能体通过交互推断陌生环境的规则。交互式规则发现谜题可受控研究该能力，但当前语言模型在此类任务上的限制因素及RL能否泛化到未见规则尚不清楚。

Method: 构建WITNESS环境（2D网格、ASCII观测、可控规则访问），通过智能体流水线生成WitnessGym训练集与WitnessBench（公开验证+私有测试）。验证集分别测试已训练规则原语的新组合与未训练原语。统一测试框架下评估18个前沿专有及开源模型，并做提供真值规则与RL训练对比实验。

Result: 最佳模型仅解决私有测试24%的关卡槽位，成绩对观测接口和智能体配置敏感；提供真值规则使Opus-5验证RHAE-L5从59.9升至97.8，而27B开源模型仅提升2.1点仍受限；RL使27B私有测试RHAE-L5从2.1升至5.4，并在四个外部发现基准上平均提升4.1点。

Conclusion: 规则习得是Opus-5等前沿模型的主要难点，小模型还额外受困于规则执行；在隐藏规则谜题上的RL可迁移至更广泛规则与真实任务。

Abstract: Automated science needs agents that can work out the rules of an unfamiliar environment by interacting with it. Interactive rule-discovery puzzles offer a controlled setting for studying this ability: an agent infers hidden rules through experimentation and uses what it has inferred to reach a stated goal. We ask what limits current language models on these puzzles and whether reinforcement learning (RL) improves performance on rules held out from training. To study both, we introduce WITNESS, a 2D grid-based puzzle environment with ground-truth ASCII observations and controlled access to rules. An agentic pipeline generates games for WitnessGym, the RL training suite, and WitnessBench, comprising public validation and private test games.
