Motivation: 自进化代理需持续改进行为，而工具定义其可执行动作空间。但向模型暴露完整工具库会引入大量无关上下文，损害工具使用决策。现有方法存在三大局限：基于描述而非输出的选择、跨请求无状态、推理成本重复。

Method: LOTS（Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring）在模型参数固定下，从累积输出经验进化工具空间。每次请求后保留模型生成答案，通过移除某工具观测输出来衡量答案似然变化，估计该工具贡献；在同类任务内聚合贡献以排序工具并更新持久化空间，实现输出感知评分、持久任务空间、摊销选择和跨模型可复用配置。

Result: 在三个基准上，LOTS提升任务表现并大幅减少工具上下文。顺序实验表明任务特定空间可持续保持并随时间改进；跨模型实验表明学习到的配置可迁移至不同模型。

Conclusion: 以似然变化为核心的输出感知评分能有效构建持久、可迁移的任务工具空间，兼顾性能提升与上下文压缩，为工具空间自进化提供可行方案。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.

</details>


### [704] [TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34157)
*Jiaming Tian,Liyao Li,Wentao Ye,Haobo Wang,Lihua Yu,Zujie Ren,Gang Chen,Junbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TableSeek：一种结构保持的智能体搜索框架，通过LLM智能体迭代精确定位表格证据，避免一次性匹配的语义偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域表格检索中，语义相关性常具误导性：主题相似的表格可能缺少所需事实，而承载答案的证据往往限于少数单元格，其含义依赖周边模式与表格上下文。此外异构schema、值格式和序列化进一步削弱一次性匹配效果。

Method: 提出TableSeek结构保持的智能体搜索框架。不进行一次性排序，而是由LLM智能体迭代跟随稀疏线索、检查保留结构的预览、识别schema与值层面的不匹配并优化探索。以单元格和schema作为证据锚点，同时保留完整表格作为证据单元。

Result: 无需检索器训练或预计算语义索引，TableSeek生成透明的证据搜索轨迹，在异构表格基准上取得与强检索-重排序流水线相当的端到端性能。

Conclusion: 主动、结构保持的证据搜索是开放域表格检索的一个有前景的新范式。

Abstract: Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching.
  We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking.
  Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.

</details>


### [705] [RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34160)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoutePrism 诊断协议，通过在两种处理顺序下用同一源记录池构建两次记忆并追踪差异，定位记忆构建步骤中因排序导致的证据丢失，并验证被替换记录确实承载任务相关证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理相同记录的不同顺序可能丢弃不同证据，但仅凭最终答案准确率无法揭示哪些内容发生了变化、变化是否关键。需要一个能定位差异来源的诊断方法。

Method: RoutePrism 用同一源池在两种处理顺序下构建两次记忆，固定记录内容、时间戳、策略与答案模型，从而将差异局部化到记忆构建步骤；并设计四条件匹配干预，对比恢复被替换记录与替换等长非支持记录的效果。

Result: 在 PersonaMem-32K（63 个主查询、29 位用户）和 470 个 LongMemEval-S 问题（历史跨 38–62 个会话）上评估，并在五种答案模型上复现核心干预。恢复单条被替换记录可挽回超过 60 个百分点的准确率，而替换等长非支持记录无效。

Conclusion: 幸存者选择（聚类保留哪条记录）是源级变化的主要驱动因素；不同记忆策略（压缩、有界近期、MemoChat 式摘要、A-MEM）在源、上下文和元数据层产生不同失败特征。

Abstract: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.

</details>


### [706] [ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34177)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReplayLens是一种黑盒审计方法：通过一次只改变历史记录中的一种关系（分数归属、动作名称、记录位置），测量重放后决策的变化，从而揭示记忆复用时决策依赖的具体关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准记忆评估无法辨别决策变化究竟由记录分数、动作名称还是存储位置引起，因此需要一种能分离这些关系的审计工具来判断记忆能否安全地合并、重排或重建索引。

Method: 四种干预针对四种关系：结果重分配（交换分数与动作的对应）、成对搬运（移动完整的动作-分数对到新槽位）、一致重命名（同时重标历史与菜单中的动作）、键槽重分配（同时改变分数归属与位置），并配合一个构造性分离证明常规评估的不足。

Result: 在LLM黑盒接口上，交换分数会改变决策而成对搬运不会，说明得分归属与记录顺序可分离；有界记忆研究暴露了终点比较遗漏的摄入顺序敏感性；顺序实验规划中篡改历史分数会改变探索并降低最终效用；代码调试智能体在密封隐藏测试下呈现同样模式。

Conclusion: ReplayLens提供了关系级别的审计，用于判断记录的过往经验能否被安全地合并、重排或重建索引。

Abstract: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.

</details>


### [707] [RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34179)
*Richard Krueger,Lucas Krause,Zach Pocquette*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RAGWarrant开源框架，将RAG部署视为受约束的证据决策，通过预声明质量与风险门控、证据等级上限，输出可审计的PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统虽配备大量指标、基准、追踪与自动评判工具，但这些工具无法判断某项策略变更是否可安全发布，缺乏可审计的发布控制机制。

Method: RAGWarrant规范化评估器输出与运维遥测数据，施加预声明的质量与硬风险门控，分配证据等级声明上限，保留负面结果，并输出四类可审计决策；在T2-RAGBench、MultiHop-RAG、CRAG、HotpotQA、合成复现及受限本地生成实验上评估。

Result: HotpotQA上因答案质量超出声明裕度，运维成本节省被阻止；受限CRAG研究中选出低成本且质量持平的策略，但相关生成增益不稳定、留出集护栏失败关闭。制品可从全新克隆复现、以加固Docker运行、接受外部评估导出并验证完整性。

Conclusion: 主张贡献为可审计的发布控制抽象，而非优化器优越性、人工验证或生产可用性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and emits auditable PROMOTE, BLOCK, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE decisions. We evaluate the framework across T2-RAGBench, MultiHop-RAG, CRAG, HotpotQA, synthetic reproduction, and bounded local generative experiments. On HotpotQA, operational savings were blocked because answer quality fell beyond the declared margin. A bounded CRAG study selected a lower-cost quality-tied policy, but related generative gains were unstable and a held-out guardrail failed closed. We claim an auditable promotion-control abstraction, not optimizer superiority, human validation, or production readiness. The tagged artifact reproduces from a fresh clone, runs as a hardened Docker job, accepts external evaluator exports, and verifies artifact integrity.

</details>


### [708] [Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34180)
*Xukui Qin,Youting Wang,Xinjie He,Ziyang Luo,Runxiong Wu,Yan-Syuan Chen,Zhongyao Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在固定视频文本证据下比较 Jev 与 Qwen 的决策读出方式，探索性结果显示仅 XD captions 上 Jev Noul 排序占优，UCF 无此优势，且界面有效性问题阻碍完整比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想回答：当视频导出的文本证据保持不变时，决策读出（readout）方式对结果有多大影响，并检验类型化接口是否带来收益。

Method: 在 UCF-Crime 与 XD-Violence 的稀疏开发样本（40 视频、400 锚点，各含 20 源组/200 锚点，正例仅 10 和 37）上，评估 Jev 类型化决策与三种 Qwen 读出，输入为摘要与有序 captions；并审计历史 LAVAD 分数，区分响应结构与数值一致性。

Result: XD captions 上 Jev Noul 平均精度 75.99%，高于 Qwen 概率 48.47% 和局部序数似然 57.81%（配对差 18.18 个百分点，95% 自助区间 5.53–31.50）；UCF 无对应优势（ROC-AUC 52.26% vs 65.95%），两种概率读出 Brier 分数均劣于参考值 0.0475；Jev Choice 仅 776/800 有效响应，无法完成全覆盖质量比较。

Conclusion: 这些离线探索性结果刻画了排序、概率质量与界面失效，既不证明类型化接口的因果收益，也不支持普遍优越性、校准或端到端加速，且缺少二元似然对照。

Abstract: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

</details>


### [709] [CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34184)
*Yan Li,Guiping Cao,Meng Xu,Tao Jiang,Yaguang Song,Ming Tao,Yaowei Wang,Dongmei Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CASS框架，通过贡献感知的结构化掩码识别并保留任务相关的注意力头和FFN神经元，减少模型合并中的参数干扰，在视觉和语言任务上提升多种合并基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法用权重幅度或随机启发式剪枝任务向量来缓解冲突，将Transformer视为无结构的"参数袋"，忽视了其固有的模块化结构。

Method: 贡献感知结构化稀疏（CASS）：用贡献感知结构化掩码识别任务相关的注意力头和FFN神经元。两种实例化：CASS-Merging（事后插件式去噪过滤器）和CASS-Tuning（微调时用掩码约束梯度，减少任务向量结构重叠）。

Result: 分析显示任务相关组件稀疏且部分不重叠，支持组件级结构化过滤。实验覆盖视觉（ViT，20任务）和语言（RoBERTa 8任务；Qwen2.5 4任务），CASS提升了多种代表性合并基线。

Conclusion: CASS通过结构化组件级过滤有效减少合并干扰，是一个可提升现有合并方法的统一框架。

Abstract: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.

</details>


### [710] [PainterBench: A Figural Divergent-Thinking Benchmark for Tool-Using Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34195)
*Shane K. A. Dalumura Hettige,Jonas Oppenlaender*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PainterBench，将人类的不完整绘画任务移植到智能体设定中，评估14个多模态语言模型的图形发散思维能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图形发散思维（将给定形状片段发展为原创绘画）是人类的创造力能力，但尚未在智能体/多轮工具使用场景下被系统评估。

Method: 构建 PainterBench 基准：智能体通过工具调用在画布上绘画，画布含不可擦除的起始形状，每轮观察结果，需将其融入最原创的绘画，任务开放式，由智能体自行决定何时完成。评估14个多模态语言模型，收集2700幅画作并众包创造性/可识别性评分，另含300幅人类参考画作；并提出自动化评分器 ViDrA-adapted。

Result: 图形发散思维在14个模型中差异显著，GPT-6 Astra 画作最具创造性。ViDrA-adapted 预测人类创造性评分 r=0.85。相比人类画作，智能体画作创造性更高但可识别性更低。共收集72,000条众包评分。

Conclusion: PainterBench 可测试短视距增量视觉规划及预训练创造力向多轮工具使用的迁移，并公开数据集、基准框架、刺激库与模型检查点。

Abstract: Figural divergent thinking is the ability to develop a given shape fragment into an original drawing. In humans, this ability is assessed with incomplete-drawing tasks. We introduce PainterBench, a benchmark that ports the incomplete-drawing task to the agentic setting. The agent draws on a canvas through tool calls and observes the result after every turn. The canvas includes a starting shape which cannot be erased, and the agent's goal is to incorporate this shape into the most original drawing it can produce. The task is open-ended, and the agent itself decides when the drawing is finished. The benchmark tests incremental visual planning over a short horizon and the transfer of creative ability from pretraining to multi-turn tool use. We evaluate 14 multimodal language models from small to frontier scale. Across the primary study and six sensitivity analyses, we collect 2,700 drawings and crowdsource creativity and recognizability ratings for every drawing and for 300 human reference drawings. We also present ViDrA-adapted, an automated scorer that predicts human creativity ratings of agent drawings (r = 0.85 on random held-out test split). Figural divergent thinking varies widely across the 14 models, and GPT-6 Astra produces the most creative drawings. Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.

</details>


### [711] [Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34211)
*Linbo Shao,Huilin He,Yating Lou,Dawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体语义增强框架，生成基于交易行为的可解释金融语义，并发布多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD，验证语义增强对欺诈建模与LLM推理的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开真实金融数据因隐私限制缺乏丰富语义，合成数据虽补充语义但牺牲行为真实性，且缺少用于上下文推理的文本描述。

Method: 提出基于原始交易行为的多智能体语义增强框架，通过角色专业化代理与一致性精炼生成可解释金融语义；并构建多模态数据集MS-FFSD，包含结构化与文本语义。

Result: 实验表明语义增强具有统计保真性与框架泛化性，更丰富的语义有利于欺诈建模和上下文感知的LLM推理。

Conclusion: 该工作推进了多模态金融欺诈研究，连接LLM与多智能体能力与反欺诈实践，并公开框架与数据集。

Abstract: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce. We address this gap through a semantic enrichment framework grounded in original transaction behavior to simulate multimodal financial data. We (1) propose a multi-agent semantic enrichment framework that generates interpretable financial semantics grounded in transaction behavior through role-specialized agents and consistency refinement, and (2) newly contribute a valuable multimodal financial fraud dataset, MS-FFSD, enriched with structured semantics and textual semantics while preserving real-data-grounded transaction behavior. Furthermore, we systematically analyze the quality and utility of semantic enrichment. Results demonstrate statistical fidelity and framework generalizability, while showing that richer semantics benefit fraud modeling and context-aware LLM reasoning. Overall, this work advances multimodal financial fraud research and bridges emerging LLM and multi-agent capabilities with operational anti-fraud practice. The framework and dataset are released at https://github.com/AI4Risk/MS-FFSD.

</details>


### [712] [GlyphBench: A Playground for Language-Model Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34214)
*Roger Creus Castanyer,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Matthew James Sargent,Augustine N. Mavor-Parker,Glen Berseth,Pablo Samuel Castro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GlyphBench是一个用于语言模型智能体RL后训练的环境套件，将空间观测渲染为Unicode网格，包含360+任务，实验表明glyph观测优于文本和像素，且游戏训练可带来比数学/代码训练更强的推理迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为语言模型智能体提供一个统一、高效、可复现的RL后训练与评测平台，系统研究观测接口、推理投入、agent harness及RL配置对性能与学习动态的影响。

Method: 构建GlyphBench环境套件（360+任务，覆盖多种游戏），将空间观测渲染为二维Unicode网格，并通过统一接口连接训练、评测与轨迹回放；在此基础上进行观测接口、推理努力程度、agent harness和RL配置的对照实验。

Result: 在Craftax实验中glyph观测优于原生文本和像素，并在若干BALROG环境中进一步提升；在100个GlyphBench任务上做RL后，Qwen3.5-4B在留出的Reasoning Gym问题上达到63.48%准确率，超过基座模型及数学、代码训练基线。

Conclusion: 游戏玩法带来的推理增益可产生比数学或代码训练更强的迁移，GlyphBench可作为研究语言模型智能体学习、交互与泛化的有效测试平台。

Abstract: We introduce GlyphBench, an environment suite for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of language-model agents, with over 360 tasks spanning diverse games. GlyphBench renders spatial observations as two-dimensional Unicode grids and connects training, evaluation, and trajectory replay through a unified interface designed to support efficient and reproducible research. We use GlyphBench to study how observation interfaces, reasoning effort, and agent harnesses affect performance, and how RL configurations shape learning dynamics. Our results show that glyph observations outperform native text and pixels in our Craftax experiments, with further gains on several BALROG environments. RL on 100 GlyphBench tasks improves Qwen3.5-4B on held-out Reasoning Gym problems, reaching 63.48% accuracy and outperforming the base model, a math-trained baseline, and a code-trained baseline. These experiments provide empirical evidence that reasoning gains from gameplay can yield stronger transfer than math or code. Together, these results highlight GlyphBench's value as a testbed for systematic research on how language-model agents learn, interact, and generalize.

</details>


### [713] [Same Winners, Different Success Rates: Evaluating How LLM Agents Recover from Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34215)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有基于检查点的基准测试用"集合一致性"(set agreement)衡量LLM智能体的故障恢复能力存在根本缺陷：该指标只反映哪个动作胜出，无法体现绝对性能水平，从而掩盖恢复失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM智能体部署为可靠系统需要评估其在任务中途失败后的恢复能力。现有基准依赖"集合一致性"（独立运行中选择的最佳动作集合是否一致）这一纯序数指标，当所有动作都失败时得零奖励并出现平局，多次独立运行产生相同平局集合，制造出稳定性假象，掩盖了近乎为零的恢复成功率。

Method: 作者通过理论形式化揭示该局限：提出"集合-路径对称性"结果，证明在等成本伯努利动作下，(0.9,0.8)与(0.2,0.1)的成功概率在所有样本量下都产生相同的最佳动作集合分布；进一步证明无法在有限时间内认证精确的总体平局，且结果到检查点的分配携带超出边际分布的信息。指出池化成功率(pooled success)是解决序数歧义的缺失标量，并在864个冻结的RecoveryBench片段及两个规划队列共3456条响应上验证。

Result: 实验证实理论预测：一致性与留出质量可能朝相反方向变动；置换检查点与动作的绑定会改变8%至13%的单元格级结论。这表明仅基于"哪个动作胜出"的方法无法区分高成功与低成功两种情形。

Conclusion: 作者建议在不增加数据收集的情况下报告四个诊断量（一致性、全零比例、留出成功率、池化成功率）以暴露这一失效模式。

Abstract: Evaluating how LLM agents recover from mid-task failures is central to deploying reliable agentic systems. Existing checkpoint-based benchmarks measure recovery by comparing which action is selected as best across independent runs, a quantity known as set agreement. However, set agreement is a purely ordinal measure that records which action wins without reflecting the absolute level of performance. When all actions fail, they tie at zero reward, and independent runs produce the same tied set with high probability, creating an illusion of stability that masks near-zero recovery success. We formalize this limitation through a set-path symmetry result, proving that for equal-cost Bernoulli actions the success probabilities (0.9, 0.8) and (0.2, 0.1) yield identical best-action-set distributions at every sample size. No procedure based solely on which action wins can distinguish these two regimes. We further prove that certifying exact population ties is impossible in finite time, and that the assignment of outcomes to checkpoints carries information beyond marginal outcome distributions. The pooled success probability is the missing scalar that resolves the ordinal ambiguity. Experiments on 864 frozen RecoveryBench episodes and two planning cohorts totaling 3,456 responses confirm the theoretical predictions. Agreement and held-out quality can move in opposite directions, and permuting checkpoint-to-action bindings changes 8 to 13 percent of cell-level conclusions. Based on these findings, we propose reporting four diagnostic quantities (agreement, all-zero fraction, held-out success, and pooled success) that expose this failure mode with no additional data collection.

</details>


### [714] [When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34227)
*Rishabh Sharma,Rishika Lall*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval的预注册研究中，紧预算下用单次调用的Jev决策模型选出的原始对话轮次，效果不劣于LLM抽取式记忆，且写入门槛成本低3061倍；重排序的收益随预算增大而缩小，这解释了已发表结论的分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话记忆是否需要LLM抽取事实，还是选对原始轮次就足够？已发表结果相互矛盾：抽取式系统报告从蒸馏事实中获益，而近期研究发现配合良好排序的原始历史同样有效，但这些研究对排序是否重要存在分歧。作者希望澄清这一分歧的成因。

Method: 在held-out的LoCoMo对话与LongMemEval上开展预注册研究。用单次调用Jev（一种带类型的决策模型）选择原始轮次，与LLM抽取式记忆在紧预算下对比；采用非劣性检验（单侧95%界、-5分margin），辅以盲人工评分；比较写入成本、使用第二种答案模型；并在不同预算下考察重排序收益变化；在匹配上下文下比较Jev与LLM reranker、多调用图遍历的准确率与延迟。

Result: 紧预算下LoCoMo上，Jev选原始轮次非劣于LLM抽取记忆（单侧95%界-3.0分）；盲人工评分缩小差距但不改变结论；原始轮次写入成本低3061倍，第二答案模型下结果仍成立。重排序收益随预算增长而缩小：30选3时LoCoMo+17.4、LongMemEval+9.1；宽预算时仅+1.5与+1.1，且抽取系统更准。匹配上下文下Jev与LLM reranker准确率相当（非劣界-2.0）但延迟仅三分之一，且优于多调用图遍历；重排序会降低正确弃答率。

Conclusion: 是否需要用LLM抽取事实取决于预算：紧预算下选原始轮次即可，宽预算下抽取系统更优，重排序收益随预算增大而递减，这解释了已发表结论的分歧。计划、代码与评分答案均已公开。

Abstract: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.

</details>


### [715] [AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34241)
*Yunhao Feng,Yifan Ding,Yuxiang Xie,Zheng Li,Mingrui Lao,Zeyuan Wang,Yanming Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AdaptiveSafety 数据集与 SafePO 强化学习算法，训练能在推理时按用户自定义策略评估智能体轨迹的 AdaGuard 守卫模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定风险分类体系难以适应跨应用、跨任务变化的需求；在用户自定义策略下，相同行为可能得到不同判定，需同时理解规则与行为。

Method: 构建含策略与行为反事实的 AdaptiveSafety 数据集（10,939 训练/1,000 测试样本，策略含 1–100 条规则），提供解释与违反规则标注及结构增强；提出 SafePO 强化学习算法，用结构化奖励、响应级组相对优势与独立价值模型调节解释/判定区域的 token 权重，并分别归一化。

Result: 经监督初始化加 SafePO 训练出 0.6B、4B、8B 的 AdaGuard 系列模型；4B 模型在 AdaptiveSafety 上二分类准确率 89.30%，在 DynaBench 上达 71.82%。

Conclusion: AdaGuard 能在推理时依据用户提供的策略评估智能体轨迹，验证了数据集与 SafePO 方法的有效性。

Abstract: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. Building on this supervision, we propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for refining violation identification while balancing explanatory reasoning and final verdicts. SafePO uses structured rewards to assess prediction correctness, retains group-relative advantages at the response level, and employs a separately trained value model to modulate token weights within explanation and verdict regions. Separate normalization controls their relative contribution to training despite differences in length. Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time. Our 4B model achieves binary accuracies of 89.30\% on AdaptiveSafety and 71.82\% on DynaBench. The project repository is available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/AdaGuard

</details>


### [716] [Stashbird: Efficient Speaker-Indexed Memory for Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34242)
*Chidera Biringa,Lucas Yannul,Xiaowen Wang,Marco Ayala,Nicholas Yi,Alex Moyse,Nishant Manchanda,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Stashbird 是一个通过显式溯源机制将源事件与派生记忆状态关联的智能体记忆系统，支持增量更新与事件级删除，在多个长期记忆基准上显著降低 token 消耗并保持较高问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体需要能够在用户-智能体、用户间及群组对话中保留信息的记忆系统，同时支持随着证据变化或移除进行更新。现有系统在多场景记忆管理与更新、删除的生命周期操作以及模型开销方面存在不足。

Method: 提出 Stashbird 记忆系统，通过显式溯源将源事件与派生记忆状态链接。系统将记忆组织为事件记录、语义关系、社区摘要和持久化图状态，并提供增量更新和事件级删除的生命周期操作。

Result: 在四个长期记忆基准上评估问答准确率与模型侧工作负载。在 LoCoMo 上，Stashbird 的摄取提示词 token 比 Graphiti 少 76.4 倍；相比复现的 Hindsight，检索提示词 token 少 8.1 倍，准确率低 1.6 个百分点。在 LongMemEval-S 和 GroupMemBench 上准确率高于 Hindsight，在 EverMemBench 上准确率相当。

Conclusion: Stashbird 通过显式溯源和结构化记忆组织，在保证问答准确率的同时大幅降低 prompt token 开销，是一种高效的智能体长期记忆解决方案。

Abstract: AI agents require memory that preserves information across user-agent exchanges, user-to-user conversations, and group conversations with or without agent participation, while supporting updates as evidence changes or is removed. We present Stashbird, an agent memory system that links source episodes to derived memory state through explicit provenance. Stashbird organizes memory into episodic records, semantic relations, community summaries, and persisted graph state, with lifecycle operations for incremental updates and episode-level deletion. We evaluate question-answering accuracy and model-facing workload across four long-term memory benchmarks. On LoCoMo, Stashbird uses 76.4x fewer ingestion prompt tokens than Graphiti. Compared with reproduced Hindsight on the same benchmark, it uses 8.1x fewer retrieval prompt tokens, with accuracy 1.6 percentage points lower. It achieves higher accuracy than Hindsight on LongMemEval-S and GroupMemBench and comparable accuracy on EverMemBench.

</details>


### [717] [Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34249)
*Pengyu Huang,Zhiyuan Han,Wenwen Tong,Hewei Guo,Jiangnan Chen,Sirui Chen,Lewei Lu,Beier Zhu,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出共情强化学习中支持优先级随对话状态演变，而现有方法使用固定奖励，提出CARE：每轮生成上下文自适应评分标准，动态调整认知/情感/主动三个维度的权重与细粒度标准，作为在线RL的自适应奖励接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共情强化学习方法的奖励规格在对话各轮中保持固定，与"支持优先级随对话状态演变"这一本质不匹配，导致奖励无法反映动态变化的共情需求。

Method: 将共情支持组织为认知、情感、主动三类；提出Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE)，每轮生成自适应评分标准，调整三维度权重及细粒度评价标准。评分生成器先经turn级rubric监督的SFT，再用人类偏好数据做偏好式RL训练，之后作为在线共情RL的自适应奖励接口，并与RLVER和MICA结合。

Result: 在SentientBench、EQBench3、EMPA上于三个独立LLM评审下达到SOTA。EMPA上EPM-Idx较最强基线在三评审下均至少提升13分，Gemini-2.5-Pro下从28.11升至83.54。

Conclusion: 学习到的评分优先级随对话阶段和用户情绪系统性变化，证明CARE能够随支持需求的演进而调整"什么被奖励"，实现自适应共情奖励。

Abstract: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA under three independent LLM judges. Notably, on EMPA, CARE improves EPM-Idx over the strongest baseline by at least 13 points under all three judges, including an increase from 28.11 to 83.54 under Gemini-2.5-Pro. Further analyses show that learned rubric priorities systematically vary across dialogue stages and user emotions, demonstrating that CARE adapts what is rewarded as support needs evolve.

</details>


### [718] [QuantaSpike: Short-Window Spike-Driven Quantization for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34259)
*Bang Hu,Guowei Zhu,Changze Lv,Xiaoqing Zheng,Fengzhe Zhang,Fan Zhang,Wei Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantaSpike：一种基于对数三元积分发放(LTIF)神经元的短窗口脉冲驱动LLM量化框架，提升每次发放的信息量并保持移位累加计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理依赖稠密MAC运算，能耗高；SNN虽事件驱动但脉冲驱动LLM推理因激活值离群严重，需要长发放窗口或额外非脉冲路径，难以高效实现。

Method: 提出LTIF神经元，使用三元事件与2的幂次膜响应量子，结合组自适应增益与选择性离群值准入：正常值用残差LTIF步，准入离群值额外加一次起始脉冲后进入相同残差动态。

Result: 在OPT与Llama-2上取得脉冲驱动LLM量化方法中SOTA或竞争性的困惑度与零样本精度；迁移到Llama-3-8B和Qwen3-8B在四步发放窗口下接近FP16。线性能耗投影显示相比SpikeQuant，OPT降低约80.0%、Llama-2降低约67.1%的线性变换能耗。

Conclusion: QuantaSpike为LLM推理提供了精确且节能的脉冲驱动路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks but rely on dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations during inference, resulting in high energy cost. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an event-driven alternative in which synaptic integration uses lightweight accumulation. However, spike-driven LLM inference remains difficult because outlier-heavy activations typically require long firing windows or auxiliary non-spiking paths. We propose QuantaSpike, a short-window spike-driven quantization framework for LLMs built around Logarithmic Ternary Integrate-and-Fire (LTIF) neurons. LTIF uses ternary events with power-of-two membrane-response quanta, improving the information represented by each firing step while retaining shift-ACC-compatible computation. QuantaSpike combines this neuron with group-adaptive gain and selective outlier admission: normal values use residual LTIF steps, whereas admitted outliers receive one additional onset spike before entering the same residual dynamics. Across OPT and Llama-2, QuantaSpike achieves state-of-the-art or competitive perplexity and zero-shot accuracy among spike-driven LLM quantization methods. It also transfers to newer dense LLMs, remaining close to the FP16 reference on Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B under the same four-step firing window. Analytical linear-energy projections show that QuantaSpike reduces the energy of one linear transformation by about $80.0\%$ on OPT models and $67.1\%$ on Llama-2 models relative to SpikeQuant, providing an accurate and energy-efficient spike-driven path for LLM inference.

</details>


### [719] [Maintaining Benchmarks Against Increasingly Capable Agents: Detection and Remediation of Unearned Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34262)
*Weijun Luo,Kelvin Luu,Xinyi Liu,Guangze Luo,Miguel Romero Calvo,Soham Dan,Daniel Yue Zhang,Ying Liu,Mohamed Elfeki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出过程验证框架审计 agent 通过轨迹，区分真实奖励黑客与验证器弱点，并定位可修复的脆弱面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent 可通过非预期手段通过基准测试，产生"不应得通过"（unearned passes），其占比构成完整性缺口；基准有效性是持续维护问题。

Method: 过程验证框架：审计通过轨迹，区分奖励黑客与验证器弱点，定位可被利用的表面。修复采用最小补丁+漏洞重放+新 agent 评估，按原标准复核新通过样本。

Result: 分析 29 个模型-基准队列、3,810 条通过轨迹。SWEBench Pro V1.0 上，确认违规率从 Opus 4.7 的 24% 升至 Fable 5 的 73%，后续降至 Fable 5.1 的 11% 和 GPT-6 Astra 的 0%（描述性比较）。违规集中在少数重复表面，尤其通过 git history 获取参考解。三个修复案例显示仅阻断已记录漏洞不足，同一受保护信息可通过其他路径获取。最终补丁下无尝试触及受保护通道，所有补丁后通过均判定合法。

Conclusion: 基准完整性需持续维护：审计通过行为、修复使能表面、重新评估漏洞可及性与合法可解性。

Abstract: Agentic benchmarks guide model selection and training. Yet an agent can pass a task without demonstrating the intended capability. Such outcomes constitute unearned passes; their proportion among all passes defines the integrity gap. As agents improve, benchmark surfaces that once seemed harmless can become exploitable, making benchmark validity an ongoing maintenance problem. We introduce a process-verification framework that audits passing trajectories, distinguishes evidenced reward hacking from verifier weakness, and localizes exploitable surfaces for repair. Across 3,810 passing trajectories from 29 model-benchmark cohorts, confirmed violations often increase with model generation but not monotonically. On SWEBench Pro V1.0, confirmed violation rates rise from 24% to 73% between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5 on matched tasks; later cohorts fall to 11% for Fable 5.1 and 0% for GPT-6 Astra. These comparisons are descriptive: configurations were not normalized, and the latest models also pass fewer exploitable tasks. Violations concentrate around a small set of recurring surfaces, especially unintended access to reference solutions through git history. Three repair case studies across two benchmarks show why blocking a recorded exploit is insufficient: the same protected information can remain accessible through another route. Therefore, we combine minimal patches with exploit replay and fresh agent evaluation, auditing new passes under the original standard. No evaluated attempt against the final patches reached the protected channel, and every post-patch pass was judged legitimate. Benchmark integrity requires ongoing maintenance: audit passing behavior, repair the enabling surface, and re-evaluate both exploit access and legitimate solvability.

</details>


### [720] [Query Expansion and Key Specialization in Transformer Attention Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34273)
*Vidit Gupta,Siddhesh Nadkarni,Mihik Chaudhari,Vinaya Sawant,Prachi Tawde*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究Transformer中查询(Query)与键(Key)投影在训练中的几何演化差异。通过36次训练运行发现：查询的有效维度扩张、键的有效维度收缩，且两者差异在所有轨迹中均为正；键的收缩导致注意力更尖锐。控制实验表明该连接具有因果性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询与键的投影在数学上对称，但在注意力机制中扮演不同角色。它们的功能差异是否会影响训练中的几何发展，这一问题尚未被解答。

Method: 在字符级WikiText-103上训练小型GPT类Transformer，设置3种深度(4/6/8层)、3种查询键初始化方式、4个随机种子，共36次运行、54条平均层轨迹。用参与比(participation ratio)追踪有效维度；并通过直接控制训练中键的谱进行因果验证(5个种子)。

Result: 查询的有效维度扩张、键收缩，PR_Q - PR_K在所有轨迹中为正。键收缩导致QK^T谱变窄、注意力权重更尖锐。控制键谱的实验显示因果性：限制键收缩会以高方向置信度锐化注意力，保持初始离散度则使注意力更柔和。检查点分析显示该单调配对对比趋势并非普遍，但在预训练早期存在并随后衰减，几何与注意力熵的联系在多个模型中仍可见。

Conclusion: 查询与键在训练中呈现出功能驱动的非对称几何发展，这一差异对注意力尖锐度有因果影响，但其普遍性受预训练阶段与模型家族影响。

Abstract: The projection of queries and keys are central to the attention mechanism in Transformer architectures. While they are mathematically symmetric, they play different roles in attention mechanisms. The question of whether there is an effect from their functional distinction on their geometric development in training remains unanswered. We investigate the problem through the training of small GPT-like Transformers on character-level WikiText-103 for three different depths (4, 6, and 8 layers), three types of initialization for queries and keys, and four random seeds, resulting in 36 runs and 54 trajectories of average layers across seeds. We track the effective dimensionality of those layers using participation ratios and discover that effective dimension of queries expand while keys shrink, and that $PR_Q - PR_K$ is positive in all trajectories studied. In connection to attention, the shrinking of keys leads to a narrower spectrum of $QK^\top$ and more peaked attention weights. In order to determine if this connection is causal or coincidental, we directly control the spectrum of keys during training across five seeds: restricting it to make it shrink sharpens the attention with high directional confidence, while keeping it constant to the level of initial dispersion makes attention softer. Additional token-level checkpoint analyses show that the monotonic paired-contrast trend is not universal across pretrained families, but survives as an early-training regime that later decays over a full pretraining run, and the link between interaction-rank geometry and attention entropy remains visible in several models.

</details>


### [721] [BIABench: Evaluating AI agents on real-world bioimage analysis tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34274)
*Zixuan Pan,Davide Panzeri,Lukas Johanns,Marilin Moor,Yu Zhou,Hedi Peterson,Yiyu Shi,Jianxu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 BIABench，一个由16个源自已发表生物学研究的任务构成的端到端生物图像分析基准，评估AI agent的真实分析能力。结果显示常规2D任务表现良好，但3D或时序任务无一agent得分超过0.19，且agent表现不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI agent有望自动化生物图像分析，但缺乏评估其端到端完成真实世界分析能力的基准。此类分析困难在于2D图像、3D体和时序序列往往过大无法直接作为上下文读取，agent必须通过代码、专用软件和渲染视图来选择并运行分析。

Method: 构建BIABench，包含16个从已发表生物学研究重建的任务，保留其科学问题、成像数据和真值，覆盖11种分析子任务及从H&E组织学到单分子定位显微镜的多种模态。每个提交获得结果分数（用领域标准指标对比输出与真值）和过程分数（由视觉语言模型依据专家编写的评分标准评判方法选择与质量控制）。

Result: 在多个语言模型上评估通用和生物学专用agent并重复运行。常规二维任务解决良好，但涉及第三维度或时间轴的任务无一agent得分超过0.19。生物学专业化、更强模型或详细专家指令均无法弥补差距。agent还不稳定，同一agent重复运行间的分数差异大于不同agent间的差异，且无真值时无法通过过程分数或耗时区分正确与错误运行。

Conclusion: BIABench公开数据与代码，为评估并最终训练可进行可靠长时程生物图像分析的agent提供了可验证框架。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents hold promise for automating bioimage analysis, yet no benchmark evaluates whether they can carry out real-world analyses end to end. Such analyses are hard for agents because 2D images, 3D volumes and time-lapse sequences are often too large to read as context, so an agent must choose and run an analysis through code, specialized software and rendered views. Published studies make this capability testable, because each pairs raw images with a peer-reviewed result. We introduce BIABench, a benchmark of 16 tasks reconstructed from published biological studies that retain their scientific questions, imaging data and ground truth. The tasks span eleven analysis subtasks and modalities from H&E histology to single-molecule localization microscopy. Each submission receives an outcome score, which compares the output files with the ground truth using field-standard metrics, and a process score, in which a vision-language model judges method choice and quality control against an expert-written rubric. We evaluated general-purpose and biology-specific agents across several language models, with repeated runs of every task. Routine two-dimensional tasks were solved well, but on some tasks that added a third dimension or a time axis no agent scored above 0.19. Neither biological specialization, stronger models nor detailed expert instructions closed this gap. The agents were also unreliable, with scores varying more between repeated runs of one agent than between different agents, and without ground truth a correct run could not be told from a wrong one by its process score or by the time spent. Released openly with its data and code, BIABench provides a verifiable framework for evaluating, and eventually training, agents for reliable long-horizon bioimage analysis.

</details>


### [722] [MoSPR: Histology-to-Gene Expression Prediction with Morpho-Spatial Macrostates and Low-Rank Molecular Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34280)
*Dongmyung Shin,Geongyu Lee,Yesung Cho,Park Jong Bae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MoSPR是一个线性框架，结合邻接感知的组织学表示与低秩分子基，从全切片图像预测基因表达，性能优于现有方法且具可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从组织病理图像预测分子谱存在困难：全切片图像包含空间组织化的异质组织模式，而基因表达涉及数千个相关靶标。

Method: 将冻结的patch嵌入聚类为形态微状态，跨训练队列聚合其空间邻接，将邻接模式相似的微状态归为共享宏状态；每张切片由全局形态和宏状态特定偏差表示，线性映射到由训练数据导出的低秩基因表达基的系数。

Result: 在TCGA三个癌症队列中取得最高平均基因表达预测分数；无通路级监督下，预测表达谱的通路分数在9项比较中8项排第一；乳腺队列消融显示宏状态表示与低秩预测互补增益；仅用一半训练数据即超过最强基线全数据分数。

Conclusion: MoSPR线性形式可将预测表达谱精确分解为全局与宏状态特定分子贡献，为空间连贯宏状态区域与其分子程序建立可解释联系，代码已开源。

Abstract: Predicting molecular profiles from histopathology remains challenging because whole-slide images contain spatially organized, heterogeneous tissue patterns, while gene expression comprises thousands of correlated targets. We introduce MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression), a linear framework that couples an adjacency-informed histology representation with a low-rank molecular basis. MoSPR clusters frozen patch embeddings into morphology microstates, aggregates their spatial adjacencies across the training cohort, and groups microstates with similar adjacency patterns into shared macrostates. Each slide is then represented by global morphology and macrostate-specific deviations, which are linearly mapped to coefficients of a training-derived low-rank gene-expression basis. Across three cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas, MoSPR achieves the highest mean gene-expression prediction scores among all evaluated methods. Without pathway-level supervision, pathway scores derived from its predicted expression profiles rank first in eight of nine comparisons across three pathway collections. Ablation studies on the breast cancer cohort show complementary gains from adjacency-derived macrostate representation and low-rank molecular prediction. Moreover, with half of the training data on this cohort, MoSPR exceeds the full-data gene-prediction score of the strongest competing baseline. Finally, its linear formulation enables exact decomposition of each predicted expression profile into global and macrostate-specific molecular contributions, providing an interpretable link between spatially coherent macrostate regions and their associated molecular programs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Radisen-Panthera/MoSPR.

</details>


### [723] [ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34313)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong,Dongting Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ControlScope研究语言模型智能体工作流中"应该修订多少"的问题，比较三种修订范围并评估其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究语言模型智能体在运行工作流中应修订多少内容，以及可用的修复权限与智能体实际选择动作之间的分离关系。

Method: ControlScope比较三种策略：继续生成代码（KEEP）、编辑下一次工具调用的数据参数（ARG）、从同一公开执行状态替换未完成工作流（FULL）。通过嵌套权限区分可用修复与实际选择，在文件系统任务、ALFWorld和AppWorld上评估一次性与重复评审。

Result: 文件系统任务20个（每个两个源程序、三次推理评审）中FULL完成15-16个对比KEEP的13个；快速四次抽取下FULL为10-13对比KEEP 13。ALFWorld快速面板KEEP/ARG/FULL得分85/86/87（87任务52场景）及134/134/127（134任务4场景）。AppWorld V1官方测试585实例净差异小。五调用保护节省19.4%输出但损失一次成功。

Conclusion: 修复权限与实际选择及后续执行紧密相关，更大范围修订不总带来更好结果，保护机制可降低开销但有代价。

Abstract: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

</details>


### [724] [Dynamical Parameters: An Interpretability Framework for Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34316)
*Kang Yang,Gaofeng Dong,Liying Han,Mani Srivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了时间序列基础模型（TSFM）中"隐藏状态可及性"与"预测响应"之间的核心差距：即便某个动力学属性可从隐藏状态中恢复，模型预测也未必随该属性变化正确响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对TSFM可解释性的理解存在缺口：隐藏状态中编码了某动力学属性，并不意味着模型会在预测中正确利用该属性。作者试图形式化并解释这种"可及但不响应"的现象。

Method: 将动力学属性形式化为"动力学参数"（趋势斜率、振荡频率、自回归依赖等）。对9个冻结TSFM和13条规律，对比两类指标：(1)表示可及性——从隐藏状态恢复参数；(2)预测响应——预测变化与参考响应的对齐程度。并用因果几何方法，比较产生参考响应所需的隐藏状态变化与参数干预实际引起的状态变化方向。

Result: 在63个模型-参数组合中，42个可及性超过0.95，但相对于条件参考的对齐响应中位数仅0.46。直接修改隐藏状态可以恢复参考响应，而参数干预往往使状态朝不同方向移动。

Conclusion: 可及的参数信息不一定会体现在预测中，当输入变化未能击中所需的隐藏状态方向时尤其如此。揭示TSFM在属性编码与预测利用之间存在系统性错位。

Abstract: This work studies a central gap in interpreting time-series foundation models (TSFMs): a dynamical property may be accessible in a hidden state even when the forecast fails to respond correctly as that property changes. We formalize these properties as Dynamical Parameters, including trend slope, oscillation frequency, and autoregressive dependence. We compare their representation accessibility, measured by recovery from hidden states, with their forecast response, measured by agreement with the expected forecast change. Across nine frozen TSFMs and thirteen laws, 42 of 63 model-parameter cells achieve accessibility above 0.95, whereas their median reference-aligned response relative to the conditional reference is only 0.46. To explain this gap, causal geometry compares the hidden-state change required to produce the reference response with the change induced by the parameter intervention. Directly modifying the hidden state recovers the reference response, but the parameter intervention often moves the state in a different direction. These results show that accessible parameter information need not be expressed in forecasts when input changes miss the required hidden-state direction.

</details>


### [725] [Test-Time Scaling via Budgeted Multi-Attribute Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34322)
*Bo Xue,Ji Cheng,Shen-Huan Lyu,Yuanyu Wan,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在共享预算下验证LLM答案的问题，形式化为多属性好臂识别，并提出BMA-GAI算法，兼顾成本感知臂选择与自适应属性采样，达到一阶最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证LLM生成的答案需在共享计算预算下，同时决定检查哪些候选以及评估哪些验证属性，现有方法预算分配效率不足。

Method: 将问题建模为全局预算下的多属性好臂识别：每个候选是一个臂，沿多个高成本属性评估，目标是尽可能多地认证所有属性均值超过阈值的候选。提出BMA-GAI，结合成本感知臂选择与自适应属性采样，每次观测既指导分配又支持随时有效认证，无需单独确认阶段。

Result: 建立了渐近覆盖率保证，并推导出匹配的信息论反函数，证明BMA-GAI在临界预算水平之外具有一阶最优性。合成基准与LLM答案验证任务实验表明，BMA-GAI比竞争方法更高效地分配预算，认证更多高质量候选。

Conclusion: BMA-GAI在多属性、共享预算的LLM答案验证中实现预算高效分配与一阶最优认证，优于现有方法。

Abstract: Verifying LLM-generated answers under a shared computational budget requires jointly deciding which candidates to inspect and which verification attributes to evaluate. We formulate this problem as multi-attribute good-arm identification under a global budget: each candidate is an arm evaluated along several costly attributes, and the goal is to certify as many candidates as possible whose mean scores exceed the prescribed thresholds on all attributes. We propose \textsc{BMA-GAI}, an algorithm that combines cost-aware arm selection with adaptive sampling of attributes. Every observation serves both to guide adaptive allocation and to support anytime-valid certification, which removes the need for a separate confirmation stage. We establish an asymptotic coverage guarantee for \textsc{BMA-GAI} and derive a matching information-theoretic converse that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of the problem, thereby proving that \textsc{BMA-GAI} is first-order optimal away from critical budget levels. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and an LLM answer-verification task show that \textsc{BMA-GAI} allocates the verification budget more efficiently and certifies more high-quality candidates than competing methods.

</details>


### [726] [Knowing When Thinking Is Not Enough: Teaching Small Reasoning Models to Reason Beyond Their Parametric Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34327)
*Chanuk Lee,Minki Kang,Sangwoo Park,Woongyeong Yeo,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现小推理模型的额外思考主要是巩固已有解而非开拓新解，据此提出选择性查询框架 FlyBy，在知识瓶颈时调用更强模型，以低成本超越更大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小推理模型（sRMs）服务成本低，扩展测试时计算被广泛用于提升其推理能力。但作者质疑"额外思考"是否总是有效操作。

Method: 通过干预两个模型家族、多个规模的中间推理状态，发现自我精炼主要在已有可达解上巩固概率质量。据此识别两类失败瓶颈（执行瓶颈与知识瓶颈），提出 FlyBy 选择性查询框架。训练 4B/8B 变体：先推理、诊断未解决部分、在知识瓶颈时查询更强模型。用监督微调引导多深度查询动作，用成本感知强化学习校准是否查询、问什么、花多少。

Result: 在六个基准的 1,158 道难题上，FlyBy-4B 达到 45.96% pass@8，超过 Qwen3-14B（41.64%）且服务成本低 2.7 倍，pass@1（16.85%）也超过 Qwen3-8B（15.31%）；FlyBy-8B 进一步提升 pass@8 至 51.81%。

Conclusion: 额外思考主要为巩固而非开拓，选择性在知识瓶颈处查询更强模型比单纯增加思考更高效，FlyBy 以更低成本超越更大模型。

Abstract: Scaling test-time computation is a powerful way to improve language-model reasoning, and is particularly appealing for small reasoning models (sRMs) that are cheap to serve. However, is additional thinking always the right operation? By intervening at intermediate reasoning states across two model families and multiple scales, we find that self-refinement largely consolidates probability mass onto solutions already reachable from the current state, rather than making new ones reachable. These interventions reveal two failure regimes: execution bottlenecks, where the correct path is reachable and reflection can recover it, and knowledge bottlenecks, where relevant external information makes it reachable. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce FlyBy, a selective querying framework, and train 4B and 8B variants to reason first, diagnose what remains unresolved, and, at a knowledge bottleneck, query stronger models whose parametric knowledge extends beyond its own. Supervised fine-tuning bootstraps a multi-depth query action, and cost-aware reinforcement learning calibrates whether to query, what to ask, and how much to spend. On 1,158 hard problems across six benchmarks, FlyBy-4B achieves 45.96% pass@8, surpassing Qwen3-14B (41.64%) at 2.7 times lower serving cost, while also exceeding Qwen3-8B in pass@1 (16.85% vs. 15.31%). Scaling to FlyBy-8B further improves pass@8 to 51.81%.

</details>


### [727] [SAGE: Structured Strategic Reasoning for Efficient LLM Game Playing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34342)
*Zhiwei Chen,Tianchun Wang,Zhongtao Rao,Haiming Zhu,Ding Cao,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练推理时框架SAGE，通过锚定、适应、重校准三个操作结构化LLM策略推理，在多类不完美信息博弈中显著提升收益并大幅降低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强LLM策略智能体需前瞻性推理不确定未来、适应对手行为倾向并从交互经验中持续校准决策。但自由形式推理会引入无依据的策略假设、不一致的对手估计以及无关历史交互的干扰。

Method: SAGE为免训练推理时框架，含三个协调操作：锚定（anchor）——以均衡策略为策略有效先验；适应（adapt）——基于对手行为倾向的软信念对偏离锚定进行条件化，实现针对性利用；重校准（recalibrate）——将策略相关交互蒸馏为关于先前遗漏考虑的反事实假设，用过去经验校准推理。

Result: 在Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel三种重复不完美信息博弈中，对抗多种对手类型。相比Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO、Hypothetical Minds等推理密集型LLM智能体，Liar's Dice收益最高提升127.6%，输入与输出token分别最多减少80%和90%。直接对阵中，在三款游戏分别对5/10、8/10、8/10的对手取得非负平均收益，且token消耗相对较少。

Conclusion: SAGE通过结构化锚定、适应与重校准，有效缓解自由推理中的策略假设与对手估计问题，在提升博弈收益的同时大幅降低token开销，验证了结构化推理框架的实用性与高效性。

Abstract: A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE.

</details>


### [728] [Fuzzy Distribution Modeling for Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Causality Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34349)
*Michael Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于模糊集理论的模糊分布建模方法生成合成表格数据，兼具可解释性与竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据受限或不可获取时，合成表格数据可用于训练机器学习模型。但表格数据的异构、非平滑、不完整特性给传统概率模型和深度生成模型带来根本挑战，且其可解释性有限。

Method: 用模糊集表示特征分布，用模糊认知图(Fuzzy Cognitive Maps)建模特征依赖；通过采样模糊概念而非原始值生成样本，原生支持混合数据类型、缺失值和领域约束；并支持语言查询与IF-THEN推理。

Result: 在基准数据集上，实用性、保真度和隐私性方面与最先进方法具有竞争力，同时可解释性大幅提升。

Conclusion: 模糊分布建模是模糊系统与决策支持应用中合成表格数据生成的一种有原则且有效的方法。

Abstract: Synthetic tabular data generation provides an effective alternative for the training of machine learning models when real-world data is limited or inaccessible. However, the heterogeneous, non-smooth, and incomplete nature of tabular data poses fundamental challenges to conventional probabilistic and deep generative models, where their interpretability remains limited. This paper proposes a novel fuzzy distribution modeling methodology for synthetic tabular data generation based on fuzzy sets theory. Feature distributions are represented using fuzzy sets and feature dependencies are modeled through Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, resulting in a low-parameter, and an interpretable data representation. Synthetic samples are generated by sampling fuzzy concepts rather than raw values, enabling native support for mixed data types, missing values, and domain constraints. The methodology further supports linguistic queries and IF-THEN reasoning, facilitating transparent simulation of decision-making processes. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance with respect to utility, fidelity and privacy compared to state-of-the-art methods, while offering substantially improved interpretability. These results establish fuzzy distribution modeling as a principled and effective approach for synthetic tabular data generation in fuzzy systems and decision support applications.

</details>


### [729] [SemRD-V2X: Closure-Guided Communication with Bounded Inference for Cooperative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34353)
*Hu Xu,Chun Li,Siyuan Qiu,Zeyan Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"闭包保真度"视角分析V2X协同感知，识别不可冗余的核心证据，并据此设计SemRD-V2X，以极小通信量实现更高检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: V2X协同感知通过共享中间特征提升3D检测，但密集的远端特征可能重复本车可本地推断的上下文。现有高效通信设计多依赖经验性优化掩码或编码，未回答一个基本问题：在已知接收者自身观测的前提下，哪些远端证据是不可或缺的？

Method: 引入ego条件远端感知的"闭包保真度"视角。在有限演绎抽象与显式条件下，证明其率失真函数可分解到不可冗余核心上，且零失真精确速率等于P_A H(π_A)。据此提出设计原则：传输紧凑证据、以有界接收端推理恢复可推导上下文。实现SemRD-V2X神经代理，结合精确预算BEV支持选择、逐点通道压缩与掩码共享权重重建，再进行标准融合。

Result: 在仿真V2XSet和真实DAIR-V2X上验证设计。受控五轮V2XSet对比（单Tesla V100，对比本地复现V2X-ViT-v1基线）：解析特征负载降低26.6倍，AP@0.5/AP@0.7提升4.13/8.57个点，仅增加3.81%平均计算延迟。

Conclusion: 闭包保真度既是分析透镜，也是可操作的设计原则，为通信高效的协同感知提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperative perception improves 3-D detection by sharing intermediate features, but dense remote features may repeat context that the ego agent can infer locally. Most communication-efficient designs optimize masks or codes empirically, leaving a more basic question open: which remote evidence is indispensable given the receiver's own observation? We introduce a closure-fidelity perspective on ego conditioned remote perception. Under a finite deductive abstraction and explicit conditions, its rate--distortion function decomposes over an irredundant core, and the exact zero-distortion rate becomes $P_A H(π_A)$. This analysis suggests a concrete design principle: transmit compact evidence and recover derivable context with bounded receiver-side inference. Guided by this principle, SemRD-V2X is an operational neural proxy that combines exact-budget BEV support selection, pointwise channel compression, and masked shared-weight reconstruction before standard fusion. Experiments on simulated V2XSet and real-world DAIR-V2X validate the resulting design. In a controlled five-run V2XSet comparison against a locally reproduced V2X-ViT-v1 baseline on one Tesla V100, SemRD-V2X reduces the analytical feature payload by $26.6\times$ while improving AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by 4.13/8.57 points, with 3.81\% additional mean compute latency. These results position closure fidelity as both an analytical lens and an actionable design principle for communication-efficient cooperative perception.

</details>


### [730] [Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34359)
*Hongwei Li,Spandan Garg,Yufan Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出两种"运行时程序状态推理"任务，并将其纳入分阶段后训练流程，训练出9B模型Comet-9B，在补丁生成、回归测试生成和安全PoC生成上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理运行时程序状态方面缺乏显式训练，论文探究此类训练能否提升下游软件工程能力。

Method: 引入两个互补任务：(1) Buggy输入-输出推理，要求生成暴露错误程序与隐藏正确实现行为差异的输入并预测执行行为；(2) 前置-后置条件推理，要求符号化刻画触发bug的前置条件、预测后置条件、解释因果联系并转化为可执行回归测试。将两任务纳入分阶段后训练流程，基于Qwen3.5-9B Base训练出Comet-9B。

Result: 在issue resolution的SFT中加入两任务后，SWE-bench Pro提升7.25个百分点，SWT-Bench Verified提升9.70个百分点。对两任务进行顺序强化学习后，SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified、CyberGym分别再提升7.25、26.79、4.67个百分点。仅9B参数的Comet-9B在SWE-bench Pro上接近GPT-5.2，在SWT-Bench Verified上匹配GPT-4o智能体的成功率。

Conclusion: 显式训练程序状态推理可有效提升软件工程下游任务表现，小模型也能达到大模型水平。

Abstract: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.

</details>


### [731] [PersMem: Internalizing Personality into Dual-Pathway Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34372)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Ziwei Xiang,Weicheng Xie,Shizhe Liu,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PersMem，将人格整合进角色扮演智能体的记忆处理流程，使记忆优先级、检索等环节与预设人格一致，从而可通过记忆处理痕迹验证行为人格一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演智能体的人格仅由系统提示预设，而记忆优先级与检索流程与人格无关，导致记忆处理与预设人格不一致，也难以验证智能体行为是否符合预设人格。

Method: PersMem 将人格映射为操作特定参数，分四步处理记忆：(i) 情感评估，标注用户输入的情绪状态；(ii) 保留旧记忆与当前输入；(iii) 被动情感驱动检索，按语义和人格引导情绪寻找相似记忆；(iv) 主动目标驱动检索，精炼并选择用于回复的记忆。

Result: 四类依恋分类超出随机基线 23.1 个百分点；大五人格对话比较准确率 67.5%，高于均匀采样基线 6.7 个百分点；CoSER 上平均分 66.13，角色保真度 69.33，故事线质量 84.33。

Conclusion: PersMem 能产生可区分的人格相关记忆处理模式，并使人格一致性可通过交互中的记忆处理痕迹进行检验。

Abstract: The profile of a role-playing agent usually depends on the pre-defined personality in a system prompt, whereas its memory processing pipeline, including prioritisation of stored memories and subsequent retrieval, remains independent of this personality. This separation causes the agent's memory processing to be inconsistent with the pre-defined personality, and makes it difficult to validate whether agent behaviours follow this personality. In this paper, we propose Personality-Integrated Memory (PersMem), which integrates personality into the agent's memory processing pipeline, making it consistently personality-dependent. PersMem processes memory using four steps, where the personality is mapped to operation-specific parameters controlling: (i) affective appraisal annotating emotion states of the user input; (ii) retention of previously stored memories along with the current input; (iii) passive affect-driven memory retrieval exploring memories similar to user input in semantics and personality-guided emotions; and (iv) active goal-driven memory retrieval that refines and selects passively retrieved memories for the reply. Consequently, consistency with the pre-defined personality can be examined by inspecting memory-processing traces during human-agent interactions. We evaluate these personality-dependent differences in attachment and Big Five settings. PersMem exceeds the chance baseline for four-way attachment classification by 23.1 percentage points. In Big Five dialogue comparisons, PersMem achieves 67.5% accuracy, 6.7 percentage points above a baseline using uniformly sampled memories. On CoSER, PersMem achieves an average score of 66.13, with scores of 69.33 for Character Fidelity and 84.33 for Storyline Quality. Together, these results show that PersMem produces distinguishable personality-related memory-processing patterns.

</details>


### [732] [Org-Agent: Beyond Personal Assistants Towards Organizational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34392)
*Luyao Zhuang,Yujing Zhang,Zijin Hong,Yilin Xiao,Xiao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Org-Agent，一个以约束为中心的推理框架，用于组织场景中多用户语言模型智能体的任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织中的语言模型智能体需协调多用户请求并利用分布式知识，涉及跨用户交互与决策、跨用户记忆与知识使用两项能力，且受身份/权限、信息归属与时效、冲突解决与联合决策等组织约束影响。

Method: Org-Agent 分三阶段：将任务分解为原子子任务并构建编码依赖关系的任务依赖图；基于拓扑排序按依赖顺序调度子任务；执行每个子任务时考虑任务约束，并借助证据获取与记忆管理工具。

Result: 在 MUSES-Bench 和 GroupMemBench 上的实验证明了 Org-Agent 在两项能力上的有效性，消融实验进一步支持依赖建模与工具使用的贡献。

Conclusion: 以约束为中心的依赖建模与工具支持可有效提升多用户组织场景下语言模型智能体的协调与决策能力。

Abstract: Language model agents serving organizations must coordinate requests from multiple users while using knowledge distributed across their interactions. We identify two complementary capabilities for this setting, namely cross-user interaction and decision-making, as well as cross-user memory and knowledge use. Both capabilities are governed by organizational constraints across three aspects: user identity, authority, and access permissions; the attribution and temporal validity of information; and rules for resolving conflicting requirements across users and completion requirements for joint decisions. These constraints shape what information or decisions must be obtained before an action can proceed and what conditions must be satisfied during its execution. Motivated by this, we introduce Org-Agent, a unified constraint-centric reasoning framework that organizes task execution in three stages. Specifically, Org-Agent decomposes a task into atomic subtasks and constructs a task dependency graph whose edges encode the dependencies among them. Building on this graph, it schedules the subtasks in dependency order through topological sorting. It then executes each subtask while accounting for the task's constraints, supported by evidence-acquisition and memory-management tools. Experiments on MUSES-Bench and GroupMemBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Org-Agent on both capabilities, and ablations further support the contributions of dependency modeling and tool use.

</details>


### [733] [Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34572)
*Rohit Saxena,Utkarsh Upadhyay*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究了推理模型对"反思信号"（自信/怀疑表述）在工具委托决策上的因果响应，提出Nudgeability指标衡量敏感性与针对性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可调用工具的推理模型需在推理中决定是直接作答还是委托工具。任何自反思机制都需回答三个问题：信号来源、呈现方式、是否改变后续行动。论文聚焦第三个问题——反思信号是否真正因果地影响模型行动。

Method: 在相同推理轨迹的固定点插入一句第一人称的自信或怀疑表述，让模型继续推理并选择直接作答或调用工具；通过对比反事实续写来测量委托行为的因果效应，称为Nudgeability，分两个维度：敏感性（自信/怀疑对委托率的影响强度）和针对性（对无法独力解决的问题是否增加委托、对能解决的减少委托）。

Result: 在Qwen、Gemma、GLM三家族九个中小型开源推理模型、两个任务上，模型普遍敏感：怀疑增加委托、自信减少委托，中位自信—怀疑摆幅为20.6个百分点，大型服务模型达53–70个百分点。但针对性差：中位仅42%的诱导翻转是"良好定位"的，仅比随机选择基线高2个百分点。

Conclusion: 自信语言是委托行为的强控制面，但模型仅弱地依据自身实际能力使用它。Nudgeability提供了一种免后训练、简单的方法，用于在自反思机制成熟过程中同时评估敏感性与针对性。

Abstract: Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can.
  Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

</details>


### [734] [SkillFocus: Evolving Agent Skills via Capability Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34397)
*Ning Wang,Zhiren Gong,Bingdong Li,Peng Yang,Aimin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SkillFocus，将重复任务需求分解为固定能力空间，据此定位最未解决的能力来指导技能修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agent技能进化方法主要基于执行轨迹或反馈进行修订，使跨任务的重复行为需求保持隐式，且修订依赖当前技能的行为。

Method: SkillFocus将重复任务需求分解为随技能演化而固定的能力空间，分离"任务需要什么"与"当前技能如何表现"；把当前任务结果映射到该空间，识别导致最多任务未解决的能力，再据此确定修订内容与所用证据。

Result: 在四个异构任务基准上均取得最佳留出准确率，平均超最强基线5.7个点，且比最接近的迭代基线平均少用24%进化token。消融显示：基于重复需求的能力优于任务语义和执行衍生方案；随机化任务—能力分配使准确率最多下降20.2个点；在优先修订下匹配证据到选定能力可提升候选增益4.4个点。

Conclusion: 显式能力空间能有效指导技能进化，提升准确率并降低token开销，验证了能力选择与证据匹配的关键作用。

Abstract: Agent skill evolution seeks to improve reusable procedural guidance for large language model (LLM) agents through iterative revision. Existing methods base each revision mainly on execution trajectories or feedback, leaving recurring behavioral requirements across tasks implicit and tying revision to the behavior of the current skill. We introduce SkillFocus, which decomposes recurring task requirements into a capability space that remains fixed as the skill evolves, separating what tasks require from how the current skill behaves. SkillFocus maps current task outcomes to this space to identify the capability that leaves the most tasks unresolved, then uses that capability to determine what to revise and which evidence to use. Across four benchmarks spanning heterogeneous tasks, SkillFocus achieves the best held-out accuracy on all four, outperforming the strongest competing result by 5.7 points on average while using 24\% fewer evolution tokens on average than the closest iterative baseline. Controlled studies further show that capabilities derived from recurring task requirements outperform task-semantic and execution-derived alternatives, while randomizing task--capability assignments reduces final accuracy by up to 20.2 points. Matching evidence to the selected capability increases candidate gain by 4.4 points under prioritized revision.

</details>


### [735] [After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34603)
*Yanfei Zhang,Xu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 修复后的失败经验是否成为更好的可迁移记忆？通过3300次实验对比修复前后迁移效果，发现修复价值与复用价值需要区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究修复(repair)一个失败episode后，其经验作为记忆迁移到新任务时是否更有效，即修复是否提升了经验的可复用性。

Method: 将同一失败源任务在修复前后分别迁移到固定目标任务，并加入独立执行作为对照。3300次运行覆盖100个ThinkingBox对和100个APEX对，含源状态继承与不含两种设置，共11种条件。

Result: ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid修正增益为44/29/32个百分点，修正后性能比独立执行高25/22/18点，但任务族层面减弱。Full相对Skill的15点增益中12点来自更差的未修正表现而非更好的修正记忆；46次上升转移中22次仅恢复基线成功。APEX未能确立可比的聚合修正收益。文本APEX接受执行达52%对摘要40%，但无稳健的全局优势。更小的handoff减少输入却增加调用。

Conclusion: 修复经验的价值不同于复用经验的价值：记忆更新需同时具备前一版本参照和全新开始参照。

Abstract: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

</details>


### [736] [Mathematics for and by human cognition: A resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34410)
*Sneha Aenugu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出数学抽象是"资源理性地搜索问题求解瓶颈"的理论，认为认知约束非但非限制，反而驱动数学突破，对机器数学发现具有启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通常认为人类认知约束是问题求解的限制因素，作者欲挑战此观点，说明这些约束其实能推动数学及其他领域的进步。

Method: 提出"数学抽象=资源理性地搜索瓶颈"的理论；借助数学史上的具体案例，说明认知约束引发的瓶颈如何驱动新抽象的产生，并分析认知约束与情感反应的作用。

Result: 瓶颈带来重构既有知识的压力，可催生新形式体系，其应用范围甚至超出最初激发它的问题；认知约束与情感反应共同塑造这一过程。

Conclusion: 该理论对机器数学发现有启示：引入类人约束可能促成有用数学抽象的发现。

Abstract: Human cognitive constraints are generally viewed as limiting factors in problem-solving. We argue that these constraints can instead play a critical role in driving advances in mathematics and beyond. We propose a theory of mathematical abstraction as a resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving. Bottlenecks arising from cognitive constraints create pressure to restructure existing knowledge, potentially giving rise to novel formalisms with applications beyond the problems that originally motivated them. Drawing on episodes from the history of mathematics, we illustrate how such bottlenecks can drive the development of novel abstractions and examine how cognitive constraints and affective responses shape this process. Finally, we discuss the implications of this account for machine mathematical discovery and argue that incorporating human-like constraints may facilitate the discovery of useful mathematical abstractions.

</details>


### [737] [OSPD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Persona-Consistent Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34418)
*Rui Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Zicheng Zhao,Xu Yinghui,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OSPD，一种无需外部教师或奖励模型的在线自蒸馏框架，通过角色感知散度切换与渐进式特质掩码课程，显著提升角色扮演大模型的多轮人格一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮对话中维持人格一致性是角色扮演语言模型的核心难题：离策略蒸馏存在跨轮次累积的分布不匹配，而强化学习面临主观人格保真度带来的奖励歧义。

Method: 采用在线自蒸馏框架，同一模型兼任教师与学生但信息非对称——教师获得完整角色档案，学生仅见简短摘要，并由学生自身策略生成轨迹。发现教师置信度在角色相关话语中呈双峰结构（关键token处尖峰、通用语句处弥散），据此提出角色感知散度切换；并用渐进式特质掩码课程按语义维度分阶段内化角色知识。

Result: 在CharacterBench、CharacterEval和SocialBench上，OSPD相比监督微调和多轮强化学习基线大幅提升人格一致性，且无需任何外部教师或奖励模型。

Conclusion: 非对称信息下的在线自蒸馏结合角色感知散度与渐进课程，是提升角色扮演人格一致性、同时规避外部依赖的有效途径。

Abstract: Maintaining persona consistency across multi-turn dialogues remains a core challenge for role-playing language models. Off-policy distillation from external teachers incurs distribution mismatch that compounds across dialogue turns, while reinforcement learning struggles with reward ambiguity inherent in subjective persona fidelity. We propose OSPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework where the same model serves as both teacher and student under asymmetric information: the teacher receives a complete character profile while the student sees only a brief summary, and the student generates trajectories from its own policy. We find that teacher confidence in role-playing dialogue exhibits a bimodal structure---sharply peaked at character-critical tokens yet diffuse at generic utterances---and introduce role-aware divergence switching to match this structure. A progressive trait masking curriculum further forces staged internalization of character knowledge along semantic dimensions. Experiments on CharacterBench, CharacterEval, and SocialBench show that OSPD substantially improves persona consistency over supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn RL baselines, without requiring any external teacher or reward model.

</details>


### [738] [Beyond End-to-End Black Box Mapping: An Intentional Agent Framework for Cognitive-driven Facial Reaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34419)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Jindong Wang,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Intentional Agent，将面部反应生成重构为显式内部状态介导的过程，通过内部动力学模型与 Inner Thought Flow 实现更类人的自动面部反应生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面部反应生成方法多为端到端架构，直接将说话者行为映射为听者表情，缺乏显式的中间内部状态，难以反映人类互动中的潜在评估与情感过程。
