Method: 构建基于汇流定性物理的 MechReasoner 模拟器，并据此确定性地生成基准题目，涵盖模糊性、量化断言、情景图转移证据、修复与轨迹支持判断等任务；机理经结构拓扑转换检查与定量仿真行为校验。

Result: 在 1,120 题上，GPT-5.5 准确率随复杂度从 B1 的 76.1% 降至 B4 的 38.0%，且控制提示与答案长度后负相关仍显著。

Conclusion: 定性模拟器可支撑可审计的机理推理 NLP 基准，揭示 LLM 在复杂机理约束下的推理不足。

Abstract: This work introduces MechReasoner, a mechanistic qualitative simulator grounded in confluence-based qualitative physics, together with a benchmark for mechanistic inference. Current large language models (LLMs) generate fluent mechanistic descriptions that do not reliably follow from underlying structural and causal constraints. The benchmark tests whether answers preserve simulator-licensed ambiguity, quantified claims, episode-graph transition evidence, repairs, and trace-support judgments. Its 1,120 items are generated deterministically from admissible interpretation sets, component states, scenario restrictions, confluence constraints, and derivation steps across 18 catalog mechanisms and six task families. Each mechanism undergoes converter checks of structure and topology and behavioral checks against quantitative simulations. GPT-5.5 accuracy decreases as family-specific mechanistic complexity increases, from 76.1% in the lowest-complexity bucket (B1) to 38.0% in the highest-complexity bucket (B4). The negative association remains after controls for rendered-prompt and expected-answer length. These results show that qualitative simulators can support auditable NLP benchmarks for mechanistic inference.

</details>


### [774] [Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34649)
*Weiyuan Li,Jinghan Xu,Aili Chen,Xintao Wang,Shuang Liang,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ContextEvo框架，从长程轨迹中学习上下文策略以提升LLM智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于经验和技能的harness进化方法在长程任务中效果不佳：随着交互增长，有用证据被冗余或过时上下文淹没，上下文管理成为关键瓶颈。

Method: ContextEvo从长程轨迹中学习上下文策略：在关键决策点重建模型可见上下文，识别与上下文相关的失败，并施加针对性的策略更新。以开源Pi-agent harness为起点。

Result: 在三个长程任务基准上，性能媲美或优于Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw等主流agent harness。分析显示固定或局部演化的上下文策略在长程信息压力下表现不足，而本方法能适应各环境的信息需求。

Conclusion: 上下文管理是长程任务的关键瓶颈，学习式上下文策略相比固定或局部演化方法更能适应环境的信息需求。

Abstract: Harness evolution improves LLM agents by learning from execution trajectories, but existing experience- and skill-based methods are less effective on long-horizon tasks. As interactions grow, useful evidence can be buried by redundant or outdated context, making context management itself a key bottleneck. We introduce ContextEvo, a framework that learns a context policy from long-horizon trajectories. ContextEvo reconstructs the model-visible context at key decision points, identifies context-related failures, and applies targeted policy updates. Starting from the open-source Pi-agent harness, ContextEvo improves performance across three long-horizon task benchmarks, achieving results comparable to or better than several prominent agent harnesses, including Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. Additional analyses show that fixed or locally evolved context strategies can fall short under long-horizon information pressure, while our methods adapt to the information demands of each environment.

</details>


### [775] [Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35706)
*Priyanka Kargupta,Silviu Cucerzan,Shweti Mahajan,Allen Herring,Jiawei Han,Ryen W. White,Sujay Kumar Jauhar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AI Night-Scientist智能体框架，用强化学习训练LLM学会何时、如何偏离可预测推理，从而在科学构思中产生更多样、更有价值的创意。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM擅长结构化、可验证任务，但低熵偏置导致输出同质化、可预测，限制了其在开放式科学构思中的价值；而真正的科学发现需要涵盖从"日科学"到"夜科学"的广泛创意谱系。

Method: 基于认知科学，将创造力建模为三个维度：行动(做什么及如何创造)、过程(何时探索vs利用)、结果(创意的新颖性与有用性)，并据此用GRPO强化学习训练模型，让其在训练中接触不同形式和程度的创造力。

Result: 相比基座模型，研究方向范围扩大27.8%，贡献类型增加14.9%；预测引用影响最多提升32.0个百分点，原创性提升66.2分。这些增益无法仅靠提高解码温度复现，语义引导(指定追求何种创造力)是关键。

Conclusion: 创造力是一种可学习的多层次能力，可被塑造以帮助研究者探索超越LLM常规范围的想法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.

</details>


### [776] [OmniTide: Co-Designing Algorithms and Systems for Efficient On-Device Omni-LLM Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34653)
*Zongshang Shen,Wangsong Yin,Daliang Xu,Mengwei Xu,Xuanzhe Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OmniTide 是首个面向端侧流式全模态推理的算法-系统协同设计，通过算法级 OmniPick 保留关键多模态上下文、系统级 OmniPage 优化物理内存布局，实现高效无限上下文流式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧流式全模态推理可保护隐私并省去高昂的按 token API 成本，但持续涌入的多模态数据导致 KV cache 单调增长，迅速耗尽内存与算力。现有稀疏注意力方法存在在线估计延迟高、破坏跨模态交错上下文、无法解决物理内存碎片等问题。

Method: 基于模态感知结构稀疏性的观察，采用 unit 抽象，包含两个组件：算法级 OmniPick 依据 unit 边界和模态重要性逻辑保留关键多模态上下文以维持任务精度；系统级 OmniPage 按保留可能性物理划分缓存，并动态压缩存活稀疏 token，减少内存碎片与数据搬运开销。

Result: 在三个流式基准和两种消费级设备架构上，kernel 加速最高 12.72×，流循环延迟降低 2.40×；StreamingBench 上同等会话成本下精度较滑窗基线提升最高 18.0 个百分点；OmniPage 相比原生逻辑驱逐进一步降低物理 KV span 最高 26.7%。

Conclusion: OmniTide 通过算法-系统协同设计有效解决了端侧流式全模态推理的内存与延迟瓶颈，在边缘设备上实现实时、无限上下文的流式推理。

Abstract: On-device streaming omni-modal inference safeguards user privacy and eliminates prohibitive per-token API costs, but faces a critical bottleneck: the continuous influx of multimodal data rapidly exhausts constrained memory and compute budgets via monotonic KV cache growth. Existing sparse attention methods fall short, either incurring prohibitive online estimation latency or destroying interleaved cross-modal context, while failing to resolve physical memory fragmentation. We present OmniTide, the first algorithm-system co-design tailored for efficient on-device streaming omni-modal inference. Driven by the observation of modality-aware structural sparsity, OmniTide adopts a unit-based abstraction with two components: (1) At the algorithm level, OmniPick logically retains critical multimodal context based on unit boundaries and modality importance to preserve task accuracy; (2) At the system level, OmniPage physically partitions the cache by retention likelihood and dynamically compacts surviving sparse tokens, minimizing both memory fragmentation and data-movement overhead. Extensive evaluations across three streaming benchmarks and two consumer-device architectures show that OmniTide achieves up to $12.72\times$ kernel speedups and $2.40\times$ lower stream-loop latency. On StreamingBench, it improves accuracy by up to 18.0 percentage points over sliding-window baselines at comparable session cost. OmniPage further reduces the physical KV span by up to 26.7% relative to native logical eviction, unlocking real-time, infinite-context streaming on edge devices.

</details>


### [777] [Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35741)
*Jonathan Light,Christopher Zhang Cui,Jeonghye Kim,Roger Creus Castanyer,Emiliano Penaloza,Zhengyan Shi,Alessandro Sordoni,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Xingdi Yuan,Minseon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ROFT：让语言模型智能体仅通过对自身经历的回顾性解释做微调，就能提升后续任务表现，超越GRPO且无需验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类不仅靠重复成功行为学习，还通过叙述和解释经历、修正理解来指导未来行为。作者想探究：语言模型智能体能否仅靠训练自身经历的"解释"来提升未来行动能力。

Method: Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT)：一个极简在线流程。智能体尝试任务、观察反馈、生成回顾性解释，仅对该解释token用下一token预测损失微调。不使用外部教师，也不使用基于奖励的策略更新。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B的软件工程实验中，训练数据混合成功与失败的尝试。在held-out SWE-bench Verified和Pro上，20次更新后达49.2%和26.8%解决率（无验证器），对比GRPO 40次更新的48.0%和25.3%，且早期进度更快。还能学会解决所有64次采样基础模型尝试均失败的任务。行为分析显示ROFT间接为动作分配信用，鼓励正确动作；强调更直接解决方案的回顾提示可缩短后续尝试长度（无需显式长度惩罚）。

Conclusion: 学习"解释"也能改进"做事"的能力，确立自生成回顾作为有效训练目标，并推动对"解释到行动"迁移的进一步研究。

Abstract: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.

</details>


### [778] [A General Harness for Protein Foundation Model Fitness Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34654)
*Yang Tan,Qijia Tian,Gangyu Sun,Bozitao Zhong,Mingchen Li,Yuanxi Yu,Nanqing Dong,Liang Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练、模型无关的检索增强突变框架VRH，融合PFM分数与MSA证据，配合结构置信度门控校正，在三大基准上普遍提升适应度预测，并构建出VenusREM2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型(PFM)在适应度预测中广泛使用，但其偏好受训练语料影响，且不可靠输入会进一步扭曲预测；需要引入家族特异进化证据与结构上下文作为互补约束。

Method: VRH：模型无关、免训练的检索增强突变框架。将冻结模型分数与MSA证据按模型不确定性融合，再基于结构置信度与溶剂暴露度进行门控背景校正与分数收缩。

Result: 在ProteinGym、VenusMutHub及新构建的病毒基准VenusViroHub共1211个实验、310万变体上，全部71种配置在3个基准上均提升Spearman相关，平均+0.073，5项指标普遍增益；并分析检索增益与模型-MSA偏好差异、域级增益、免疫逃逸及计算加速。基于VRH的VenusREM2在功能、分类、MSA深度、突变深度四类中均排第一，ProteinGym平均Spearman达0.556，超此前最优0.038。

Conclusion: 检索增强与结构上下文校正能有效弥补PFM与输入不可靠带来的偏差，VRH为通用、免训练的即插即用方案，VenusREM2确立了当前适应度预测的最优性能。

Abstract: Accurate fitness prediction is central to protein engineering and understanding sequence-function relationships. With advances in deep learning, protein foundation models (PFMs) have become widely used for this task. Recent analyses, however, show that these models share preferences reflecting their training corpora, while unreliable inputs can further distort fitness predictions. Family-specific evolutionary evidence and structural context can help address these limitations by providing complementary constraints on model scores, motivating VenusREM-Harness (VRH), a general, model-agnostic, training-free Retrieval-Enhanced Mutation harness. It fuses frozen model scores with multiple sequence alignment (MSA) evidence according to model uncertainty, then applies gated background correction and score shrinkage based on structural confidence and solvent exposure. Across 1,211 assays and 3.1 million measured variants from ProteinGym, VenusMutHub, and the newly curated viral benchmark VenusViroHub, all 71 configurations improve Spearman correlation on all 3 benchmarks by 0.073 on average, with broad gains across 5 metrics. Extended analyses relate retrieval gains to model-MSA preference differences, assess domain-level gains and immune-escape cases, and quantify computational speedups. Built with VRH, VenusREM2 is the first to rank highest in all function, taxon, MSA-depth, and mutation-depth categories, with a ProteinGym Average Spearman of 0.556, 0.038 above the prior best.

</details>


### [779] [Jailbreak Context Lingers: Divergent Safety Routing and Its Cross-Task Predictability in Tool Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34686)
*Xi Wang,Songlei Jian,Yiming Zhang,Bin Ji,Zhaoye Li,Ma Jun,Baosheng Wang,Jie Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究越狱后安全反馈如何影响智能体后续行为，提出配对续写框架，发现安全反馈导致模型依赖的分流行为（救助/持续不安全/误拒），并揭示跨架构共享的"晚期提交"机制，构建了预测路由结果的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型作为工具使用智能体时，通常假设越狱后的安全反馈是可靠保障，但残留越狱上下文如何塑造后续行为尚不清楚，需要系统性地检验这一动态。

Method: 提出配对续写框架，覆盖42个领域的192个父任务，评估8个智能体的12148对续写样本；采用逐层激活修补定位因果干预效应，并用留一父任务评估局部干预特征的预测能力。

Result: 相同安全反馈引发模型依赖的行为分流：救助、持续不安全、附带损失；发现晚期提交模式（相对深度0.958–0.984），峰值幅度跨架构变化超30倍；关键层表征与宏观路由结果相关，干预可改变具体工具动作；预测信号在响应型智能体上AUC达0.675（救助）、0.777（附带损失）、0.702（持续不安全）。

Conclusion: 研究为理解越狱后反馈在自主智能体中的安全—效用权衡提供了机制解释视角和预测基线。

Abstract: As large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, post-jailbreak safety feedback is often assumed to serve as a reliable safeguard; however, how lingering jailbreak context shapes subsequent agent behavior remains largely unexplored. To systematically examine this dynamic, we introduce a paired continuation framework across 192 parent tasks spanning 42 domains, evaluating 12,148 analyzed continuation pairs (curated from a 12,288-pair initially design) across eight diverse agents. We find that identical safety feedback induces sharply model-dependent behavioral routing rather than uniform protection: redirecting unsafe trajectories toward legitimate completion (\emph{rescue}), sustaining unauthorized execution (\emph{persistent unsafe}), or triggering over-refusal on benign tasks (\emph{collateral loss}). Through layer-wise activation patching, we discover a shared \emph{late-commit pattern} where causal intervention effects surge sharply near the final layers (relative depths of 0.958--0.984) despite an over 30-fold variation in peak magnitude across architectures. Crucially, critical-layer representations correlate with macroscopic routing outcomes, and intervening at these layers causally alters concrete next-step tool actions. Building on this causal foundation, we test whether localized intervention-derived features can serve as predictive proxies for full-trajectory routing outcomes on unseen parent tasks under leave-one-parent-task-out evaluation, finding that they provide viable predictive signals in responsive agents with peak ROC AUCs reaching 0.675 for \emph{rescue}, 0.777 for \emph{collateral loss}, and 0.702 for \emph{persistent unsafe}. These findings establish a mechanistic lens and a predictive baseline for anticipating the safety and utility trade-offs of post-jailbreak feedback in autonomous agents.

</details>


### [780] [VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34687)
*Siqi Zhang,Meng Wei,Chenyang Wan,Shaohao Zhu,Shufan Shen,Xihui Liu,Zhihua Wei,Tai Wang,Jiangmiao Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VCN-Bench基准与MV-DualVLN基线，探索MLLM在闭环空间推理中的导航能力，发现其表现有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准止步于离线预测，而导航基准将空间推理视为指令跟随与探索的一部分，尚不清楚空间理解能否延续以指导序列交互。

Method: 构建VCN-Bench（基于Matterport3D的视频情境化导航基准，含5种指令类型、100k训练与1250评估回合），以导航为主要评测，辅以目标识别诊断；并提MV-DualVLN规划基线。

Result: 实验显示导航性能有限，存在显著的目标识别到导航的差距，且即使在正确识别目标后仍频繁出现导航失败。

Conclusion: MLLM尚难将先验视觉经验中的空间理解有效延续至闭环顺序交互，空间推理落地导航仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k training episodes, and 1,250 evaluation episodes. Navigation serves as the primary evaluation, while diagnostic goal identification helps distinguish destination-resolution errors from subsequent navigation failures. We further propose MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations. Experiments reveal limited navigation performance, a substantial destination-resolution-to-navigation gap, and frequent navigation failures even after correct destination identification.

</details>


### [781] [ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34701)
*Tarun Chintada,Neelamadhav Gantayat,Ishaan Romil,Renuka Sindhgatta,Soujanya Soni,Sameep Mehta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ResonAct运行时自愈框架，通过流式指标监控、诊断并修复多智能体系统故障，无需修改应用逻辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统故障（工具退化、上下文传播错误、协调失败等）常在事后才被诊断和修复，运行时缺乏恢复机会。

Method: 作为外部控制平面，摄取执行轨迹、智能体交互与工具调用到流式分析层，持续推导任务进度、上下文健康与工具可靠性指标；用结构化故障模型检测异常并定位根因，再动态选择修复策略执行动作。

Result: 在企业工作流与AppWorld基准上，流式指标分析可识别执行退化并定位故障；策略驱动修复提升任务完成率最高10个百分点，检测精确率70.59%–82.91%，召回率63.09%–100%，恢复率10.48%–46.67%，开销-0.25%–14.12%。

Conclusion: ResonAct实现运行时持续监控与自愈，无需修改智能体或编排逻辑，能有效提升多智能体系统可靠性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics. These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns and localizing root causes using a structured failure model. Based on the diagnosed failure, ResonAct dynamically selects remediation policies and performs actions. The framework operates as an external control plane, enabling intervention without modifying application agents or orchestration logic. We evaluate ResonAct across enterprise workflow scenarios and AppWorld benchmarks. The results show that the streaming metric-based analysis identifies execution degradations and localizes faults. Furthermore, policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points, with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%, recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67%, and runtime overhead ranging from $-0.25%$ to 14.12% across the evaluated configurations.

</details>


### [782] [FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34710)
*Peiyu Zang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FromPitch2Board确定性足球管理基准，通过配对种子与冻结校准，解耦基座模型、脚手架、责任范围、匹配控制粒度和时间跨度五个因素对智能体长程表现的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长程智能体基准只报告进展程度，无法区分性能来源是基座模型、脚手架、责任范围、匹配控制粒度还是时间跨度，缺乏可控对比手段。

Method: 在单一模拟器上构建确定性足球管理基准，采用配对种子与冻结校准，系统评估4个基座模型与4种智能体脚手架，对五个可配置因素进行受控比较。

Result: Model Track中Coach分数Z跨度0.19、Manager达0.68；GPT-5.6在责任扩展下被动性骤增，其责任阶梯从46.1升至58.1再降至46.8，跨越最后责任边界时跳过决策率从1.1%升至57.9%；Flash-Pro组合中脚手架选择使Manager分数Z变化达0.48；3Y队列在第一与第三年出现排名方向反转，某Claude Code+Pro配置第三年达峰后回落。

Conclusion: 责任范围与时间跨度会暴露被单一总分掩盖的行为变化，需通过多因素受控对比才能准确归因智能体长程能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing the regression to the final responsibility boundary. Across that boundary, its skipped-decision rate rises from 1.1% to 57.9%. Within the Flash-Pro pair crossed across every scaffold, scaffold choice changes Manager points Z-scores by up to 0.48 relative to the fixed stateless scaffold. The 3Y cohort shows a directional reversal in mean ranking between years one and three, while a selected Claude Code+Pro configuration peaks in year three and remains below that peak, showing that responsibility scope and horizon expose behavior changes that a single headline score conceals.

</details>


### [783] [RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34712)
*Hao Li,Hangfan Zhang,Zhiyao Cui,Chunjiang Mu,Yiqun Zhang,Bo Zhang,Danyang Jia,Shuyue Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RSI-router，一个通过递归自我改进实现子任务级大-小模型协作路由的框架，在多个agent基准上以约一半推理成本超越大模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent实际部署需兼顾任务性能与推理成本。长程agentic任务中，小模型虽无法独立完成全任务，但可胜任部分阶段，因此任务内大-小模型协作有潜力改善性能-成本权衡。

Method: RSI-router通过递归自我改进构建子任务级模型分配与模型专属技能，每轮迭代含四阶段：Subtask Mining（从轨迹中提取子任务定义与识别规则）、Routing Strategy Evolution（提出并评估多样模型分配）、Model-Specific Skill Evolution（对比路由与大模型专属轨迹，诊断失败并开发可复用执行技能）、Pareto-Optimal Router Selection（更新帕累托种群，保留被支配路由作为经验）。

Result: 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与Qwen3.5-9B间路由，在五个agent基准上以约48.3%推理成本持续超越DeepSeek-only基线。ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop上成本降74.7-82.2%且性能提升；Terminal-Bench 2.0上以18.0%更低成本获16.7%相对性能增益。性能-成本帕累托前沿优于9种路由方法。

Conclusion: RSI-router通过递归自我改进实现高效子任务级大-小模型协作路由，显著改善agentic任务的性能-成本权衡，并建立更强的帕累托前沿。

Abstract: Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and large-model-only trajectories to diagnose failures and develop reusable execution skills; and Pareto-Optimal Router Selection updates the Pareto population using historical and newly generated routers while retaining dominated routers as experience for subsequent evolution. Routing between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-9B, RSI-router consistently surpasses the DeepSeek-only baseline at roughly half the inference cost (48.3%) across five agentic benchmarks. In particular, on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, it cuts inference cost by 74.7-82.2% while simultaneously improving performance; on Terminal-Bench 2.0, it achieves a 16.7% relative performance gain at 18.0% lower cost. Moreover, RSI-router establishes a stronger performance--cost Pareto frontier than 9 routing methods.

</details>


### [784] [PDE-JEPA: Predictive Representation Learning of Latent Dynamics Modeling for Parametric PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34715)
*Zhentao Tan,Jianrong Zhang,Ruijie Quan,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 PDE-JEPA，用预测式表征预训练替代传统的重构式学习，用于参数化 PDE 动力学建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统参数化 PDE 表征学习依赖重构目标，只强调恢复观测物理场；而物理轨迹蕴含状态在控制条件下的演化规律，仅靠重构无法保证准确的场演化。

Method: 先用 masked-latent prediction 训练编码器捕捉 PDE 动力学规律；再引入 geometry projector 将隐轨迹几何与物理场演化几何对齐；最后在几何对齐的隐空间中设计 physics-structured latent predictor，将动力学分解为参数无关的演化与参数相关的响应。

Result: 在九个常用 PDE 基准上，分布内平均超越现有最优方法 33.4%，外推到未见控制参数时平均提升 51.4%。

Conclusion: 预测式表征有助于保留物理信息，但需配合动力学对齐与物理结构化建模才能实现准确的场演化，PDE-JEPA 在参数化 PDE 上显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Physical trajectories contain more than snapshots of a system: they also reveal how its states evolve under governing conditions. However, representation learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) has largely relied on reconstruction-based objectives that emphasize recovering observed physical fields. In this paper, we investigate predictive representation pretraining as an alternative to reconstruction-based learning. We find that predictive representations preserve rich physical information, yet this advantage alone does not ensure accurate field evolution. Based on these observations, we introduce PDE-JEPA for parametric PDE dynamics. Specifically, we first train an encoder using a masked-latent prediction to capture the underlying regularities of PDE dynamics. To explicitly adapt the pretrained representation toward a more dynamics-aligned state space, we then introduce a geometry projector that aligns latent trajectory geometry with the evolution geometry of physical fields. Finally, building on this geometry-aligned latent space, we further develop a physics-structured latent predictor that decomposes the dynamics into parameter-independent evolution and parameter-dependent response components. Extensive experiments on nine widely used PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by an average of 33.4\% in-distribution, while achieving an average improvement of 51.4\% when extrapolating to unseen governing parameters. The project page is available \href{https://tanpig-x.github.io/PDE-JEPA/}{here}.

</details>


### [785] [From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34735)
*Josef Pavlíček,Petra Pavlíčková,Irena Štrausová*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究比较Bob Dylan等6首叙事流行歌曲的人类和声与可解释计算和声器输出，发现高旋律-和弦兼容性并不保证保留人类原始和声决策模式，提出"叙事条件化和声结构"视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI音乐生成虽能满足调性与音乐连贯性的形式要求，但音乐表达能否仅由数学属性描述仍是根本问题。人类作曲者受个人与文化背景影响，其和声决策及对既定模式的刻意偏离难以被纯形式化方法捕捉。

Method: 选取Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash、Ritchie Valens的6首叙事驱动流行歌曲，将人类原始和声与在同一旋律、无原始和弦进行条件下运行的可解释计算和声器输出进行对比。通过和弦轮图（Chord Wheel Diagrams）和BPMN表示，分析和声词汇、功能持续性、重复、非自然音事件及紧张-解决模式。

Result: 高旋律-和弦兼容性并不必然意味着保留人类原始和声决策模式。部分生成和声保留了参考曲目的经济性结构，另一些则改变和声多样性或抑制特征性事件，同时仍与旋律保持兼容。

Conclusion: 研究不量化艺术质量，而是引入"叙事条件化和声结构"作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。结果表明生成系统不应仅建模和声正确性，还需考虑结构身份、语境与人类创作意图。

Abstract: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.

</details>


### [786] [Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34768)
*Shuxing Zhang,Yongquan Ni,Zhenyu Ding,Yawen Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出跨模态师生框架，将商用单芯片毫米波雷达提升到全身、逐帧、度量级3D网格重建并给出逐关节不确定性。SAM 3D Body作为零训练教师生成全身MHR真值，学生模型StudentPoseFormer输出姿态均值与逐关节方差。在MM-Fi上达7.45 cm MPJPE，证明点累积、多普勒与速度损失的因果价值；自建语料端到端21.47 cm，部署仅用雷达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用毫米波雷达点云极度稀疏（约6.5点/帧，约28%空帧），使现有工作局限于人体关键点或离散动作分类，无法实现全身度量级3D重建。同时，全身网格标注成本极高，成为制约因素。

Method: 三项创新：(1) 用网格基础模型SAM 3D Body作为零训练教师，从单张RGB帧生成全身MHR真值（70关节、18,439网格顶点），大幅降低标注成本；(2) 学生模型StudentPoseFormer，含集合编码与掩码注意力池化、时序Transformer、CVAE多假设头，同时输出姿态均值与逐关节方差；(3) 多阶段真值质量流水线（置信度门控、深度验证、时序平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除）及系统性信息杠杆消融。

Result: MM-Fi基准（同款TI IWR6843、跨被试）全配置达7.45 cm（12关节MPJPE）；消融显示点累积(k=3,-0.34 cm)、多普勒(-0.85 cm，快速动作手腕处-2 cm)、速度损失(-0.27 cm)的因果价值。自建同步雷达+RGB-D语料（块级留出）端到端21.47 cm，逐关节从髋部4.8 cm到手腕34.7 cm，符合物理信息极限；约3万多样本可改善至15 cm；缩放律表明样本多样性而非数量是瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该框架首次将商用单芯片雷达推进到逐帧全身度量级3D网格重建，并能诚实报告不可见区域的逐关节不确定性。部署推理仅依赖雷达，无需相机或图像，兼顾隐私保护与实用性。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

</details>


### [787] [Before the Token Commits: Trajectory-Level Benchmarking of Visual Hallucinations in Diffusion VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34772)
*Yadong Wang,Siping Yue,Yu Tian,Chuanxing Geng,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DynaHall轨迹级幻觉基准与PGS方法，发现扩散VLM的视觉幻觉在答案提交前就已确定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准只评估最终输出，无法判断扩散VLM中无依据的主张是晚期出现还是提前稳定。

Method: 构建含对象存在、计数、属性、关系的二元视觉命题基准（含按视觉先验分级的困难负样本），配套记录每步解掩码的承诺感知协议；并据此提出Pre-commitment Gradient Steering（PGS）。

Result: 五个扩散VLM（三架构）中视觉幻觉在提交前已定型；跨解码调度、答案格式和开放生成均成立。DynaHall揭示计数/关系崩塌、先验驱动假阳性等被最终指标掩盖的失败；PGS降低假阳性，逼近平衡，并可跨架构迁移且不损通用能力。

Conclusion: 幻觉应在扩散VLM的生成轨迹上测量和缓解，而非仅看最终答案。

Abstract: Multimodal diffusion language models generate responses by iteratively unmasking tokens, making each answer the endpoint of a multi-step trajectory rather than an immediate commitment. Hallucination benchmarks built for autoregressive models evaluate only the final output, and therefore cannot determine whether an unsupported claim in diffusion VLMs appears late or has already stabilized before any answer token is revealed. We introduce DynaHall, a trajectory-level benchmark of annotation-backed binary visual propositions covering object existence, counting, attributes, and relations, with controlled hard negatives graded by visual prior. DynaHall is paired with a commitment-aware protocol that records the intermediate answer tendency at every unmasking step alongside the committed output. Across five diffusion VLMs from three architecture families, visual hallucination is settled before commitment: an unsupported answer is already the preferred state while the answer position is still masked, and later unmasking steps rarely reverse it, so the failure is not introduced at the write step. This holds across decoding schedules, answer formats, and open-ended generation. DynaHall also exposes failures hidden by final-output metrics, including counting and relation collapse, prior-driven false positives, and attribute errors whose direction changes by type. Guided by this diagnosis, PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) edits still-masked answer states to reduce false positives, bringing the affirmation rate close to balance, and transfers to another architecture without degrading general ability. DynaHall and PGS suggest that hallucination should be measured and mitigated along the generation trajectory of diffusion VLMs, not only at the final answer.

</details>


### [788] [Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34776)
*Abdelhak kelious*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究法文PDF文档的检索增强生成(RAG)，重点在于同时评估答案与支撑页面。在BM25基础上逐步加入稠密检索、排名融合、重排序与查询分解，最终系统MRR@10为0.4450、Recall@10为0.4013，显著优于BM25(0.3430/0.2994)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG评估多关注答案质量而忽视支撑文档页面的检索质量；本文希望同时评估答案与页面检索，探索在法文PDF场景下提升RAG系统的关键因素。

Method: 构建五种系统变体，以BM25为基线，逐步加入稠密检索、排名融合、重排序和查询分解，在595道挑战性问题（法文PDF）上同时评测答案指标与页面检索指标。

Result: 完整系统MRR@10=0.4450、Recall@10=0.4013，优于BM25(0.3430/0.2994)。单独稠密检索及简单词法-稠密融合均不如BM25；重排序改善混合系统；查询分解带来最大额外增益，但延迟更高、输出伪影更多。完整系统在两项答案指标上略高于匿名总体均值，但在多数页面检索指标上低于该均值。

Conclusion: 在此场景下，改进的主要机会在于提升页面选择的准确性，而非孤立的语义检索能力。

Abstract: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.

</details>


### [789] [Applying Language Models in medical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34780)
*Erik Aerts*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学研究与临床实践中的应用，探讨其带来的机遇与挑战，并展望其在医疗领域的当前及新兴角色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在医学中的应用日益受到关注，而LLMs的出现拓展了医疗AI的应用讨论。相比传统聚焦特定任务的深度学习应用，LLMs具备更广泛的能力与灵活性，但其融入医疗场景也引发了可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性及恰当定位等关键问题，因此有必要对相关进展进行梳理与讨论。

Method: 本文通过介绍并讨论近期关于LLMs在医学中应用的相关演讲与文章，聚焦其在研究与临床实践中的潜在用途，综合分析这些技术带来的机遇与实施过程中面临的挑战。

Result: 文章呈现了LLMs在医疗领域的应用现状，涵盖其技术优势与灵活性，同时指出了可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性及医疗定位等方面的核心挑战，为理解LLMs的当前与新兴角色提供了视角。

Conclusion: LLMs在医学研究与临床实践中具有重要潜在价值，但其可靠性与安全性等问题仍需重视。文章旨在提供对LLMs在医疗领域当前及未来角色的全面认识与展望。

Abstract: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. It considers both the opportunities offered by these technologies and the challenges associated with their implementation, aiming to provide a perspective on the current and emerging role of LLMs within the medical field.

</details>


### [790] [BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34785)
*Yuheng Wu,Berk Gokmen,Sujeeth Jinesh,Lauren McLane,Aarav Wattal,Qi Yang Huang,Zhaozhuo Xu,Thierry Tambe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出BEHAVE，一个通过功能行为建模实现多轮联合硬件设计与验证的智能体框架，解决周期级比对会误杀合法设计的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件规格允许不同延迟的正确实现，逐周期匹配设计与参考输出会拒绝合法设计，因此需要关注功能行为而非实现时序的正确性反馈。

Method: 定义Behavior IR将任务功能表达为可执行行为模型，不预设规定外的实现时序；智能体迭代开发RTL设计与行为模型作为验证参考；BEHAVE-Sim用随机采样和求解器引导搜索生成的输入激励，分别校验两个产物与隐藏黄金行为模型；训练中同一评估器从规格-行为对提供可验证RL奖励，且智能体持续搜索能力缺口相关的高层实现、构建检查规格-行为对并扩展任务池。

Result: 发布BEHAVE-Train与BEHAVE-Eval，含600个人工审核的规格-行为对；从60个种子任务并新增100个任务，自我提升使Qwen3.8-27B在BEHAVE-Eval上的RTL pass@1从55.0%提升至75.0%，达到使用540任务池进行RL的相当性能。

Conclusion: BEHAVE支持跨允许延迟与微架构的PPA探索，实现无需参考RTL的可验证RL奖励与自我提升，显著提升硬件设计与验证智能体性能。

Abstract: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.

</details>


### [791] [SIPO: Selective-Inference Policy Optimization for Tree-Structured Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34805)
*Zenghuang Fu,Ningqi Chen,Mingda Jia,Xiaofeng Han,Zhaoyang Li,Qiuyuan Ai,Zelong Zheng,Haoyu Wu,Tianyu Fu,Chenxu Zhao,Minghui Wu,Guannan He,Changwei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SIPO，将选择历史纳入树搜索强化学习的信用估计，解决自适应扩展造成的统计不对称问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树结构强化学习通过比较候选续写并传播奖励训练搜索智能体，但自适应扩展存在统计不对称：现有分支用自身生成统计量被选中，而新兄弟分支在选择后才采样。当该统计量与回报相关时，分支价值会混入选择历史而非续写质量，即使共享父节点也如此。

Method: SIPO包含三项机制：尺度无关的分支判据，使生成分数与兄弟惩罚保持一致的相对尺度；可交换分支，从每个被选父节点提供多个新续写；次序统计校正，利用选择排名与估计的分数-结果关联调整保留分支价值。同时保持叶子预算与宿主策略优化目标不变。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B与Qwen2.5-7B上的七个QA基准中，SIPO取得对比方法中最高的多跳与单跳平均成绩。Qwen3-8B上较AT²PO分别提升1.31与1.07个百分点，并在七个基准中六个排名第一。消融实验评估各组件，早期训练配对诊断显示选中-新分支价值差与近零的新-新参照。

Conclusion: 结果表明在构造与评估搜索智能体rollout时应纳入选择历史，代码已开源。

Abstract: Tree-structured reinforcement learning trains search agents by comparing alternative continuations and propagating terminal rewards to intermediate decisions. Adaptive expansion, however, creates a statistical asymmetry: an incumbent is selected using its own generation statistic, whereas fresh siblings are sampled after selection. When that statistic is associated with return, branch values can reflect selection history as well as continuation quality, even for a shared parent. We propose Selective-Inference Policy Optimization (\SIPO{}), which incorporates this distinction into tree-based credit estimation. Its scale-free branch criterion keeps generation scores and sibling penalties on a consistent relative scale; exchangeable branching supplies multiple fresh continuations from each selected parent; and order-statistic correction adjusts retained incumbent values using selection rank and the estimated score--outcome association. These mechanisms preserve the leaf budget and the host policy optimisation objective. Across seven QA benchmarks using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, \SIPO{} achieves the highest reported multi-hop and single-hop averages among the compared methods. On Qwen3-8B, it improves these averages over AT\textsuperscript{2}PO by $1.31$ and $1.07$ percentage points, respectively, and ranks first on six of seven benchmarks. Component ablations evaluate the individual and combined changes, while early-training paired diagnostics show a selected--fresh value gap alongside a near-zero fresh--fresh reference. Together, these results support accounting for selection history when constructing and evaluating search-agent rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SIPO

</details>


### [792] [UniOPSD: Unifying Outcome and Hindsight Feedback for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34810)
*Zenghuang Fu,Zhaoyang Li,Qiuyuan Ai,Xiaofeng Han,Zelong Zheng,Haoyu Wu,Tianyu Fu,Chenxu Zhao,Minghui Wu,Guannan He,Changwei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniOPSD 提出统一在线策略自蒸馏框架，通过自适应局部信用仲裁融合环境回报与事后反馈，提升语言模型智能体的训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中稀疏、延迟的结果奖励难以在长交互序列中有效分配信用；现有在线策略自蒸馏虽提供补充监督，但结果反馈与事后反馈在平均一致的同时存在大量局部不一致，如何分配二者影响尚不明确。

Method: 在共享交互锚点上从环境回报与成功同伴事后信息构造可比较的信用估计；历史一致性决定全局混合水平，当前信号可用性与相对精度调节各来源在单步决策的影响；保留回合级结果贡献，并用有界 token 调制精炼融合后的步信用用于策略优化。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct 上，ALFWorld 成功率 82.8%/83.6%，WebShop 成功率 75.0%/82.0%，Search-QA 聚合准确率 45.3%/49.8%；3B WebShop 上较 SDAR 提升 7.0 个百分点。

Conclusion: UniOPSD 通过自适应局部信用仲裁统一多种反馈来源，在多个智能体任务上取得显著性能提升，验证了融合结果奖励与事后反馈的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach to training language model agents, but sparse and delayed outcome rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment across long interaction sequences. Recent work on on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers complementary supervision by evaluating a policy's sampled responses under privileged training-time context. However, our diagnostics show that positive average agreement between outcome and hindsight feedback coexists with substantial local disagreement, raising the question of how to allocate influence between them at each decision. We introduce UniOPSD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation), which unifies these feedback sources through adaptive local credit arbitration. UniOPSD constructs comparable credit estimates from environmental returns and successful-peer hindsight at shared interaction anchors. Historical agreement determines the global mixing level, while current signal availability and relative precision adjust each source's influence at individual decisions. The episode-level outcome contribution is retained, and bounded token modulation refines the fused step credit for policy optimization. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, UniOPSD achieves ALFWorld success rates of $82.8\%$ and $83.6\%$, WebShop success rates of $75.0\%$ and $82.0\%$, and Search-QA aggregate accuracies of $45.3\%$ and $49.8\%$, respectively. On 3B WebShop, UniOPSD improves over SDAR by $7.0$ percentage points. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/Uniopsd

</details>


### [793] [Simulating Respondents, Not Single Questions: Coherent Survey Generation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34828)
*Ji Huang,Mengfei Li,Shuai Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FR-LLM：用微调的两个专门LLM分别建模单题分布与答题间依赖，再通过边际约束联合投影(MCJP)生成完整问卷响应，兼顾单题准确与跨题一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM模拟社会调查只在单个问题上达到准确的人口级分布，但真实问卷要求同一受访者在整份问卷上表现出连贯偏好。单题方法无法复现同一人对完整问卷的作答模式。

Method: FR-LLM微调两个专门LLM：一个是各题响应分布的边际模型，另一个是跨答案依赖的受访者级自回归模型。再用边际约束联合投影(MCJP)将自回归联合分布投影到满足第一模型学到的题目边际的集合上，从而生成完整问卷。

Result: 在两个真实社会调查数据集上，FR-LLM更准确地复现多题响应模式，保持有竞争力的单题准确率，并对未见人群和问题泛化更好。在一个小型商业调查数据集中，用模拟响应做定价与备货决策，FR-LLM获得最高实际利润。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模单题边际与跨题依赖，可在保证单题精度的同时实现整份问卷的连贯模拟，并在实际商业决策中带来收益。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate response distributions in social surveys. Prior work has achieved accurate population-level simulation for individual questions. Real questionnaires, however, ask each respondent a sequence of related questions. A simulated respondent should show coherent preferences across the whole questionnaire, not merely accurate distributions for isolated items. Existing single-item methods cannot accurately reproduce how the same person answers a complete survey. We propose FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM), which fine-tunes two specialized LLMs: a marginal model for each item's response distribution and a respondent-level autoregressive model for dependencies across answers. Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) then projects the autoregressive joint distribution onto the set satisfying the item-level marginals learned by the first model. This yields complete questionnaires with realistic cross-item relationships while retaining strong item-level accuracy. On two real-world social survey datasets, FR-LLM more accurately reproduces multi-question response patterns, maintains competitive single-item accuracy, and generalizes better to unseen populations and questions. In a small commercial-survey dataset, we use simulated responses to make pricing and stocking decisions; FR-LLM achieves the highest realized profit.

</details>


### [794] [Nociception as a Control Primitive: Afferent Channels and Nociceptive Memory for Agents Deployed in One Body](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34840)
*Wolfgang Maass*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究"epoch-one"设定：固定策略在身体被抽取前设定、终生不更新，单身体无法预知自身磨损速度。作者提出带负载门控伤害感受通道与记忆的机制，证明感知成本驱动任务分配并给出价值条件，模拟显示感知+记忆+替代将工作寿命从55.2延至59.6年，69.3%身体获益且无一受损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在单一躯体中部署的智能体无法在不消耗该躯体的情况下了解其磨损抗性——任何揭示耐磨性的试验都同时磨损了它本要保护的躯体。因此需在无法跨生命学习的情况下，研究智能体如何在生命开始前设定策略、并在不更新参数的前提下保护身体。

Method: 采用"epoch-one"设定：固定权重策略参数在抽体前设定、终生不更新。为智能体配置负载门控的伤害感受通道与记忆，以保留所感受到的成本。通过理论证明感知成本会驱使任务分配向"尚未感受过的最优报酬工作"而非最温和工作，并刻画通道有价值的三条件（威胁个体不可预测、避让便宜、忽视昂贵）。在2000个模拟地板层膝盖上，以磨损锚定已发表损耗率，进行个体内对照实验（有/无通道与记忆），并给出消融均值与per-body价值的恒等关系。

Result: 在2000个模拟膝盖上，感知、保留与替代将工作寿命从55.2岁延长至59.6岁，职业产出从33.7升至36.1，69.3%的身体获益且无一受损。仅感知但无保留仅贡献+4.4年中的1年，保留贡献其余。群体训练智能体从同一通道仅获+0.65年却损失0.54产出。恒等关系表明消融均值只报告per-body价值的(1-χ)，χ为盲式日程已捕获的份额。在预测有价值的场景中，护理机器人认证寿命增至6倍，现场船队报废率从0.55降至0.15；在预测无价值处，漫游车相对盲式谨慎获益甚微。

Conclusion: 伤害感受通道的价值仅在威胁个体不可预测、避让便宜且忽视昂贵时才显现；记忆保留是价值的主要来源。该regime map在正反两方向均成立：预测有价值处收益显著，预测无价值处增益甚微。单身体缺乏物种先验，因而与群体训练存在本质差异，两者由恒等关系联系，应同时报告消融均值与per-body价值。

Abstract: An agent deployed in a single body cannot learn how fast that body wears, because every trial that would reveal its wear resistance wears the body it would protect. We study this \emph{epoch-one} setting, in which the parameters of a fixed-weight policy are set before the body is drawn and never updated in life. The agent carries a load-gated nociceptive channel and a memory that retains what was felt. We prove that felt cost moves the allocation to the best-\emph{paid} work not yet felt rather than the gentlest, that an agent without retention never sees the felt-cost constraint bind, and that the channel pays only where the threat is individually unpredictable, cheap to avoid and expensive to ignore. We measure per body, setting the agent with channel and memory against the same individual without them, where neither carries a schedule learned across lives. On $2{,}000$ simulated floor-layer knees, with wear anchored to published loss rates, feeling, retaining and substituting extends the working life from age $55.2$ to $59.6$ and raises career output from $33.7$ to $36.1$. $69.3\%$ of bodies gain and \textbf{none lose}. A body that feels but retains nothing past the day gains one of the $+4.4$ years, and retention carries the rest. A population-trained agent gains $+0.65$ years from the same channel at $-0.54$ output. The difference is what a species prior already supplies, and a single body has none. The two are related by an identity, the ablation mean reporting $(1-χ)$ of the per-body value with $χ$ the share a blind schedule already captures, so we report both. Where the regime map predicts value, a care robot sextuples its certified service life and a field-anchored fleet writes off $0.15$ of its machines instead of $0.55$. Where it predicts none, a rover gains little over blind caution, so the map holds in both directions.

</details>


### [795] [Can We Trust the Teacher? Decoupled Credit Direction-Magnitude for Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34848)
*Yugu Li,Zehong Cao,Peizhen Li,Yang Zhang,Siyi Hu,Jianglin Qiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DCSD方法，将credit方向与大小解耦，校准teacher监督以优化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR提供可靠的轨迹级credit，OPSD提供稠密的token级监督，但二者在更新step级credit方向和大小上存在耦合，导致step无法获得可靠的credit方向和贡献大小，且易受teacher判断错误和偏好方差影响。

Method: DCSD将credit方向和大小理论解耦为两个可靠信号，用其校准privileged teacher监督：设计belief-margin probing确定credit方向，用marginal information gain量化credit大小，实现step-to-token的credit分配用于策略优化。

Result: 在11个基准上，DCSD整体得分优于GRPO、OPSD、RLSD和RLCSD。相比base模型，数学推理整体提升8.45分，多模态推理提升7.01分，同时纠正6% token的credit方向，token credit大小降低1.5倍。

Conclusion: DCSD通过解耦credit方向与大小，有效利用可靠的step-to-token credit分配提升策略优化效果。

Abstract: RLVR provides reliable trajectory-level credit, while OPSD offers dense supervision for token-level credit. This exposes a fundamental coupling when updating step-level credit direction and magnitude with teacher supervision, preventing steps from receiving reliable credit directions and contribution magnitudes, while making both vulnerable to teacher judgment errors and preference variance, as supported by our theoretical analysis. To separate credit direction from its contribution magnitude, we introduce \textit{Decoupled Credit Self-Distillation (DCSD)}, which theoretically decouples credit direction and magnitude into two reliable signals and uses them to calibrate privileged teacher supervision. Specifically, we design belief-margin probing to determine credit direction and marginal information gain to quantify credit magnitude, enabling step-to-token credit assignment for policy optimization. Across 11 benchmarks, DCSD achieves the best overall scores against GRPO, OPSD, RLSD, and RLCSD. Compared with base models, DCSD improves the overall score by 8.45 points on mathematical reasoning and 7.01 points on multimodal reasoning, while correcting the credit direction for 6\% of tokens and yielding a 1.5$\times$ reduction in token credit magnitude.

</details>


### [796] [From Soft Targets to Reward Signals: How Assignment and Reward Objectives Interact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34850)
*Jiangtao Lin,Bangyang Wei,Siyi Liu,Yihang Ding,Yuhan Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文引入"分配几何"研究软偏好目标与奖励目标的交互，发现目标放置与奖励目标共同决定奖励性质，超出偏好准确性本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软偏好目标设定监督强度，奖励目标将其转化为学习信号。核心问题是：给不同回复对分配固定强度集合，会如何改变不同奖励目标产生的奖励？

Method: 提出分配几何框架。用均值匹配平滑控制目标离散度；用层内重分配改变对应关系并保持目标分布完整。在五种奖励目标上，配合独立重分配及相关的源构造进行实验，并用衰减-保留剖面从裕度幅度、编辑响应和准确性三方面比较。

Result: 在共同准确性等价预算内，完整的对应关系保留了最大的干净偏好裕度；衰减排序随奖励目标变化，说明不同目标对相同目标分配反应不同。独立重分配与相关源构造复现了保留方向。相比独立校准的缩放，APLOT均匀目标在聚合和呈现编辑上产生额外衰减。

Conclusion: 目标放置与奖励目标共同构成联合设计空间，二者塑造奖励性质的方式超越偏好准确性，为软偏好目标设计提供新视角。

Abstract: Soft preference targets specify supervision strength, and reward objectives convert that strength into learned reward signals. A central design question remains: how does assigning a fixed set of preference strengths to different response pairs change the rewards produced by different objectives? We introduce assignment geometry to study this interaction. Mean-matched smoothing controls target dispersion, while within-stratum reassignment changes correspondence and preserves the complete target distribution. Across five reward objectives, intact correspondence retains the largest clean preference margins among the compared soft targets within a common accuracy-equivalence budget. Attenuation orderings change with the reward objective, revealing different responses to the same target assignments. Independent reassignments and a related source construction reproduce the retention direction. An attenuation-retention profile compares these combinations through margin magnitude, edit response, and accuracy. Against independently calibrated scaling, APLOT uniform targets deliver additional attenuation on both aggregate and presentation edits. These findings establish a joint design space in which target placement and reward objective shape reward properties beyond preference accuracy.

</details>


### [797] [AUV-Bench: Aesthetic Understanding and Generation Evaluation for User Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34854)
*Zhijie Deng,Ling Li,Junhao Ji,Siwei Lyu,Zhipeng Xu,Zulong Chen,Rongyao Fang,Shuai Bai,Xuming Hu,Jiaheng Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 AUV-Bench，一个与专业 UI 设计师合作构建的基准（1,395 个可执行网页界面、4 项任务），用于系统评估多模态基础模型的 UI 美学能力。评估12个模型发现存在“判断-行动鸿沟”：模型能大致判断美学问题，但难以准确诊断、修复或生成高质量界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型在 UI 美学评估与生成上输出看似合理，但在专业设计标准下与人类设计师差异显著。现有评测将美学判断与设计行动孤立评估，难以判断任务成功是否源于统一的美学理解，还是碎片化的任务特定能力。

Method: 与专业 UI 设计师合作构建 AUV-Bench，包含约 1,395 个可执行网页界面与四项任务：美学打分、诊断、修复、文本生成 UI。任务共享界面池与美学原则；诊断与修复在 660 个受控退化实例上对齐，支持实例级分析。对 12 个模型进行评测。

Result: 模型在整体美学打分上与专业设计师呈中等一致性；但精确诊断链成功率最高仅 24.7%。在对齐的诊断-修复案例中，判断正确与修复成功并不一致，暴露“判断-行动鸿沟”。在开放式生成中，领先模型经人工校准评估也仅达中等美学质量。

Conclusion: 当前模型只具备部分美学能力，缺乏可靠 UI 设计所需的细粒度理解与判断-行动一致性。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used for evaluating and generating user interfaces (UIs), often producing seemingly reasonable aesthetic judgments and visually plausible pages. However, under professional design scrutiny, their behavior can differ substantially from that of human designers. In professional design practice, designers rely on a systematic set of aesthetic principles that consistently guide judgment, diagnosis, repair, and creation. A coherent aesthetic capability should therefore connect aesthetic judgment with design actions. Existing evaluations, however, typically assess these abilities in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether task-level success reflects a shared aesthetic understanding or merely fragmented task-specific competence. To address this gap, we introduce AUV-Bench, developed in collaboration with professional UI designers around 1,395 executable web interfaces and four tasks: aesthetic scoring, diagnosis, repair, and text-to-UI generation. The tasks share a pool of UIs and aesthetic principles, with diagnosis and repair further aligned on 660 controlled-degradation instances to enable instance-level analysis of judgment and action. Evaluation of 12 models reveals a capability imbalance: models show moderate agreement with professional designers in holistic aesthetic scoring, yet exact diagnosis-chain success peaks at only 24.7%. On the aligned diagnosis-repair cases, correct judgments and successful repairs do not consistently coincide, exposing a Judgment-Action Gap between identifying aesthetic problems and successfully acting on them. In open-ended generation, even leading models achieve only moderate aesthetic quality under human-calibrated evaluation. Overall, current models exhibit partial aesthetic competence, but still lack the fine-grained understanding and judgment-action coherence required for reliable UI design.

</details>


### [798] [On the Limits of Metacognitive Monitoring in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34864)
*Dongqi Han,Yifan Yang,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现四个前沿语言模型的任务准确率与错误辨别能力（元认知监控）可相互分离：高准确率并不代表能可靠识别自身错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠决策需要识别答案何时可能出错。生物认知中元认知监控可与任务表现脱钩，作者由此提出：语言模型中的“解题”与“判断”是否紧密关联。

Method: 分析四个前沿模型在15个基准上的置信度报告，考察答案时置信对正确/错误的区分能力，并比较参考模型解题、自审、交叉评估（同伴监督）等情形。

Result: 高准确率可与弱错误辨别共存：某模型解出97%竞赛数学题，但其答案时置信将正确答案排在错误答案之上的能力仅略高于随机。置信在参考模型能解的题上区分更有效；对参考模型困难的题，自审改进有限。聚合区分度还受益于“易题正确>难题错误”的排序，而仅凭问题的预测已能做到。交叉评估在评估者自身答对时最有用；两模型共享的错误通常仍保持高置信。

Conclusion: 难题与共享错误是提示式自审和同伴监督的难点，即使解题能力强的模型也难以可靠监控自身错误。

Abstract: Reliable decisions depend on recognizing when an answer may be wrong. In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models. Here we study the confidence reports of four frontier models across 15 benchmarks. High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance. Confidence separates correct answers from errors more effectively on questions solved by a separate reference model, while review brings limited improvement on reference-hard questions. Aggregate discrimination also rewards ranking correct answers on easy questions above errors on hard ones, which question-only forecasts already do well. Cross-evaluation helps most where the evaluator answered correctly, and errors shared by the two models usually retain high confidence. Hard questions and shared errors remain difficult targets for prompted self-review and peer oversight, even in models with strong problem-solving performance.

</details>


### [799] [Fewer Assumptions by Design: A Reusable Skill for LLM-Assisted Verus Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34886)
*Andrada-Livia Antoneac,Dorel Lucanu,Dragoş Teodor Gavriluţ*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究LLM代理能否在为Rust双向链表(DLL)生成Verus强规范时,最小化可信基(减少axiomatic lemmas与assume)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM辅助Verus验证虽减轻负担,但自引用结构(如DLL)形式化验证极难;且依赖未证明假设会导致规范弱点。

Method: 比较三种方法:手工验证、属性特定验证,以及针对DLL及其属性定义的验证skill(编码领域知识与任务分解策略)。

Result: 配备精心设计验证skill的LLM代理能为Verus中的DLL生成强且低信任度的规范。

Conclusion: 验证skill可有效指导LLM代理,在DLL验证中兼顾强规范与最小化可信基。

Abstract: LLM-assisted Verus verification is a less tedious method to verify Rust implementations, but paired with self-referential structures, e.g., Doubly Linked Lists (DLLs)—notoriously difficult to formalise for verification—it becomes a substantially more demanding verification task.    Moreover, a specification weakness can arise when verification relies on unproven or invalidated assumptions, such as axiomatic lemmas and assume statements. We investigate whether LLM agents can synthesize strong DLL specifications while minimizing these trusted base. The analysis follows three different approaches: manual verification, property-specific verification, and a defined skill for the specific case of DLLs and certain properties of this type of data structure. The skill encodes domain knowledge and a task-decomposition strategy. We show that an LLM agent equipped with a carefully designed verification skill can generate strong, low-trust specifications for DLLs in Verus.

</details>


### [800] [DeShortcut-Align: Decoupling Spurious Shortcuts for Robust Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34896)
*Qirui Liu,Yichen Sun,Yan Wang,Zhixuan Chu,Linbo Jiang,Jianan Lin,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DeShortcut-Align框架，通过识别并解耦"格式捷径"和"词汇捷径"，缓解大型推理模型安全对齐中的过度拒绝与能力退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LRM安全对齐（SFT/RL）虽取得近乎完美的安全分数，但代价是严重过度拒绝和通用能力下降。作者通过实证分析发现，这些失败源于模型学习了虚假捷径（格式捷径和词汇捷径），而非真正理解意图的安全性评估。

Method: DeShortcut-Align采用三阶段协同框架：(1) 拒绝敏感性归因——通过掩码输入token量化其对拒绝响应对分布的影响；(2) 归因引导的对比增强——用高敏感性token构造良性对比样本以缓解词汇捷径；(3) 反事实一致性正则化——通过注意力屏蔽构造模板消融状态，强制SFT与RL间决策一致性以缓解格式捷径。

Result: 在7B和14B模型上，DeShortcut-Align显著提升对模板剥离绕过攻击的鲁棒性（性能下降减少多达72%），过度拒绝减少超过58%，并更好地保持通用推理能力，缓解了安全训练中的对齐税。

Conclusion: 通过解耦并抑制虚假捷径依赖，DeShortcut-Align能在维持安全性的同时降低过度拒绝、增强鲁棒性并保留通用能力，为缓解安全对齐税提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Safety alignment of large reasoning models (LRMs) via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) often yields near-perfect safety scores, yet this apparent success comes at the cost of severe over-refusal and degraded general capabilities. Through systematic empirical analysis, we find that these failures are closely associated with the learning of spurious shortcuts rather than robust intent-sensitive safety evaluation. Specifically, we identify two dominant shortcuts: formatting shortcuts, where refusal behaviors are overly bound to structural prompt templates that frequently appear in safety alignment corpora; and lexical shortcuts, where sensitive keywords reflexively trigger refusals on benign queries. To mitigate reliance on these shortcuts, we propose DeShortcut-Align, a shortcut-decoupling alignment framework that reduces dependence on superficial cues. DeShortcut-Align operates across three coordinated stages: (1) Refusal Sensitivity Attribution, which masks input tokens to quantify their impact on the final refusal response distribution; (2) Attribution-Guided Contrastive Augmentation, which constructs benign contrastive samples using high-sensitivity tokens to mitigate lexical shortcuts; and (3) Counterfactual Consistency Regularization, which constructs template-ablated states via attention blinding to enforce decision consistency across SFT and RL, mitigating formatting shortcut dependence. Experiments on 7B and 14B models demonstrate that DeShortcut-Align significantly improves robustness against template-stripping bypass attacks (reducing performance drops by up to 72%), substantially reduces over-refusal by over 58%, and better preserves general-purpose reasoning capabilities, thereby mitigating the alignment tax commonly observed in safety training.

</details>


### [801] [Dual-Stream Simultaneous Translation via 2D Grid Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34902)
*Yu Pu,Wei-Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出双流注意力框架，将源/目标流建模为二维隐状态网格，用四种注意力类型经联合QK Softmax建模交互，并借助两种近似降低复杂度，实现无需外部对齐的流式同传。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同传需在源输入完成前生成目标词，现有方法依赖事后读写策略，注意力机制无法感知双向流依赖。

Method: 将源流与目标流表示为二维隐状态网格，用四种结构不同的注意力类型经联合QK Softmax归一化建模交互；采用broadcast与Hadamard两种近似将每层复杂度从O(X^2Y+XY^2)降至O(X^2+Y^2+XY)，误差可证衰减。训练用自引导循环：逐格损失热图驱动动态规划路径恢复，自动生成读写决策监督标签。推理用带锚定旋转位置嵌入的增量KV缓存。

Result: 中英同传中，在相当延迟下比Wait-k基线提升+5.66 BLEURT和+10.36 COMET，并在更低的响应延迟下在COMET上超过非流式参考。

Conclusion: 双流注意力使注意力机制直接感知双向流依赖，无需外部对齐即可训练，兼顾质量与延迟。

Abstract: Simultaneous machine translation must generate target tokens before the source input is complete. Existing approaches address this through post-hoc read-write policies, leaving the attention mechanism unaware of bidirectional stream dependencies. We propose a dual-stream attention framework that represents source and target streams as a two-dimensional grid of hidden states and models their interaction through four structurally distinct attention types merged via joint QK Softmax normalization. Two approximations---broadcast and Hadamard---reduce the per-layer complexity from O(X^2Y+XY^2) to O(X^2+Y^2+XY) with provably decaying error. Training uses a self-guided loop: a per-cell loss heatmap drives dynamic-programming path recovery, which generates read/write decision supervision labels without external alignment. An incremental KV cache with anchored rotary position embeddings enables efficient streaming inference. On Chinese-to-English simultaneous translation, the proposed model outperforms the Wait-k baseline by +5.66 BLEURT and +10.36 COMET at comparable latency, and surpasses the non-streaming reference on COMET at a fraction of the response delay.

</details>


### [802] [DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34913)
*Jeremy Canale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DGF-Bench是一个评测工具使用型语言模型智能体作为治理委员会审查项目抗欺骗能力的基准，通过61条可执行规则生成档案，衡量模型对固定攻击的阻断率（DGF分数），并揭示任务对齐型攻击的显著风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业项目治理中的智能体需阅读来自供应商和利益相关方的证据并依规决策，但证据可能被植入欺骗性内容。现有工作缺乏系统化基准来量化这类智能体对证据注入攻击的鲁棒性，尤其缺乏可归因、可判定的评测方式。

Method: 构建DGF-Bench：由权威记录（42条）与叙事文档（32条）组成的合成档案，基于61条可执行规则从规范事实生成；设专家门与General门组成的委员会。攻击不改变权威值，故被攻击档案保留干净副本的参考决策；成功须可归因（智能体收到注入并采取与干净档案不同的确切注入动作）。DGF分数为模型阻断的适用固定攻击比例。开源包dgf-bench一键计算。

Result: 六个模型中五个在自读文档与记录时对82~85/85个门结果严格正确。2,622次被攻击门运行中，七类直接命令、虚假数据与虚假权威攻击仅获1次可归因成功；但任务对齐攻击（如引用虚假审查程序的记录注释）对四个模型奏效，使GPT-6 Luna Pro从34降至6、DeepSeek V4 Pro从33降至7个结果严格门。DGF分数范围96.2至26.9，策略感知自适应攻击者对六个模型中五个成功。批准工具未执行伪造批准，但被欺骗智能体提交了规则禁止的批准。

Conclusion: 当前智能体对简单注入攻击较鲁棒，但对模仿组织流程的任务对齐攻击高度脆弱，DGF-Bench为量化与改进此类治理智能体的抗欺骗能力提供了可复现基准。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents can review enterprise projects as governance boards do: they read the evidence, apply written rules and decide whether the project may proceed. Part of that evidence comes from suppliers and project members with a stake in the decision. DGF-Bench is a benchmark in which a board of agents (specialist gates and a General gate that consolidates their decisions) reviews synthetic dossiers while an attacker plants deceptive content in evidence the organization does not vouch for. Dossiers are generated from canonical facts under 61 executable rules, with 42 authoritative records and 32 narrative documents; every gate is certified decidable from those records. Attacks never change an authoritative value, so an attacked dossier keeps the reference decisions of its clean copy. A success is attributable only when the agent receives the injection and takes the exact injected action, which it does not take on the paired clean dossier; the DGF score is the share of applicable fixed attacks a model blocks. Reading documents and records themselves, five of six models were outcome-strict (disposition, findings, actions and authorization all correct) on 82 to 85 of 85 gates. Over 2,622 attacked gate runs, seven direct-order, false-data and false-authority attacks obtained one attributable success against these five, whereas task-aligned attacks imitating the organization's own process passed against four of them: a record note citing a fake review procedure lowered GPT-6 Luna Pro from 34 to 6 outcome-strict gates and DeepSeek V4 Pro from 33 to 7. DGF scores ranged from 96.2 to 26.9, and a policy-aware adaptive attacker writing in records succeeded against five of six models. The approval tool executed no forged approval, yet deceived agents submitted approvals that the rules forbid. The open-source package dgf-bench computes the DGF score with one command.

</details>


### [803] [RISE: Red-teaming via Iterative Strategy Evolution for Modern Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34920)
*Dmitrii Kharlapenko,Sergei Bratchikov,Konstantin Korolev,Aleksandr Nikolich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对现代T2I系统红队测试中的评估不可靠与探索不足问题，提出严格的成功判据并校准VLM评估器，同时提出RISE方法，通过进化可复用策略而非改写提示来生成攻击，在多平台上实现最高13%人工验证ASR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代T2I系统上成功的策略违规很少，且此前有效的人工种子常被修复。现有自动红队方法存在两个问题：一是成功测量不可靠（常用评估器在模糊的不安全目标下会漏报或误判），二是探索能力差（提示修改流程在更严格护栏下依赖种子提示、无法迁移、无法引导正例）。

Method: 作者定义了严格的类别特定成功判据，并用人工标签校准强VLM评估器；提出RISE，进化用于生成提示的可复用策略，而非逐条重写提示，并将最优策略复用于新场景生成攻击。

Result: 在DALL-E 3、Nano Banana 2 (Google) 和 GPT-Image-2 上，RISE达到最高13%人工验证ASR；在相同校准评估下，此前报告ASR约30%的先前方法降至接近零。

Conclusion: 可靠的评估校准与策略级探索对现代T2I红队测试至关重要；RISE在严格评估下优于现有提示修改方法，并揭示了以往ASR报告可能被高估。

Abstract: On modern production text-to-image systems, successful policy violations are rare, and previously effective human-written seeds are often patched out. Current automated red-teamers are poorly matched to this regime in two ways: unreliable success measurement and poor exploration. First, we find that judges widely used in prior T2I red-teaming work are unreliable under vague unsafe-content targets: they either miss true violations or reward benign borderline images on hardened APIs. We therefore define strict category-specific success criteria and calibrate strong VLM judges against human labels. Second, we show that broadly used prompt-modification pipelines do not solve the exploration problem: on harder guardrail settings they remain tied to seed prompts, fail to transfer, or cannot bootstrap positive examples. We introduce RISE, which evolves reusable strategies used to generate prompts rather than rewriting them one by one. The best discovered strategies are then reused to generate attacks across new scenarios. On DALL-E 3, Nano Banana 2 (Google) and GPT-Image-2, RISE reaches up to 13% human-verified ASR; under the same calibrated evaluation, prior methods with reported ASR as high as roughly 30% fall to near zero.

</details>


### [804] [PDEU-Bench: Benchmarking the Personalized Planning Lifecycle of Tool-Calling LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34930)
*Huayi Lai,Shichao Song,Qingchen Yu,Simin Niu,Mengwei Wang,Hanyu Wang,Xun Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PDEU-Bench，用于评估个性化工具智能体全规划生命周期（定义、执行、更新），覆盖214个长程任务、12个领域、94个工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多评估孤立工具调用或被动执行，无法检验智能体在长程交互中能否制定、执行并修订显式计划并保持用户偏好。

Method: 构建 PDEU-Bench，含214个长程交互任务、12个日常领域和94个工具，分阶段评估偏好遵循与计划质量；测试15个开源/闭源LLM，并评估主流个性化与记忆增强方法。

Result: LLM能局部实例化偏好，但难构建连贯的计划定义与更新；个性化/记忆方法仅改善个别阶段，无法可靠贯穿全生命周期，且收益难迁移到后续执行。

Conclusion: 偏好遗漏与冲突贯穿整个规划生命周期，未来需让LLM参数化偏好感知的检索与记忆能力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from tool-calling systems that execute isolated instructions into task-oriented agents that pursue user goals through sustained, multi-step interactions. However, existing benchmarks for personalized tool use largely assess isolated calls or reactive execution, leaving unclear whether agents can formulate, execute, and revise an explicit plan while preserving user preferences throughout long-term interaction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{PDEU-Bench} (\textbf{P}ersonalized plan \textbf{D}efinition, plan \textbf{E}xecution, and plan \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{Bench}mark), a benchmark for evaluating the complete planning lifecycle of personalized tool-using agents. PDEU-Bench comprises 214 long-horizon interaction tasks spanning 12 everyday domains and 94 tools, with stage-specific assessments of preference adherence and plan quality. Extensive evaluations of 15 representative open-source and closed-source LLMs reveal a pronounced gap between local tool execution and dynamic planning: LLMs can often instantiate preferences in individual calls, yet struggle to construct coherent plan definition and plan update. We further evaluate mainstream personalization and memory-augmentation methods. Although these methods improve particular stages, none of the evaluated methods reliably propagates user preferences throughout the complete lifecycle, and their gains frequently fail to transfer to subsequent execution. Fine-grained error analysis further reveals that preference omissions and conflicts persist throughout the planning lifecycle, highlighting the need for future research to parameterize LLMs with preference-aware information retrieval and memory capabilities. We provide the relevant code and data in the appendix to support future research.

</details>


### [805] [Proactive Dialogue Policy Optimization via Cognitive-State Transition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34948)
*Minghui Ma,Mengqi Chen,Bin Guo,Jingqi Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出认知用户模拟器Cog-Sim与认知状态转移驱动的策略优化方法CSTPO，以提升主动对话中用户反馈的状态依赖性与动作表示的细粒度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于用户模拟器的交互数据优化方法存在两点不足：一是模拟器未显式建模用户认知演化，导致多轮反馈的一致性与状态依赖性受限；二是仅用高层策略标签表示动作，忽略话语空间，无法区分同一策略的不同实现方式。

Method: Cog-Sim维护用户认知与情感状态，通过受约束的状态转移生成多轮响应，使反馈同时依赖实际话语和当前用户状态。CSTPO将动作组织为“策略-话语”层级表示：高层策略标签约束话语采样，并在各标签内优化话语。稀疏完整分支采样复用共享对话前缀，分别估计策略级与话语级优势，实现两级细粒度优化。

Result: 在三个任务上，Cog-Sim表现出单调的剂量-反应关系，且自然度优于基于提示的模拟器。CSTPO将Qwen3-14B的性能提升至与基于GPT-5.5的规划方法相当的水平。

Conclusion: 联合设计认知用户模拟器与层级策略优化，可有效增强交互反馈的一致性和动作建模的细粒度，使较小模型达到强基线方法的性能。

Abstract: Proactive dialogue requires agents to continually adapt their policies to user feedback while progressing toward task objectives over multiple turns. To move beyond imitation learning on static datasets, recent approaches use user simulators to collect interactive data for policy optimization. However, many simulators do not explicitly model the evolution of user cognition, limiting the consistency and state dependence of feedback across turns. Moreover, representing each action only by a high-level strategy label overlooks the large utterance space and cannot distinguish alternative realizations of the same strategy. To this end, we jointly design a $\textbf{Cog}$nitive User $\textbf{Sim}$ulator $\textbf{(Cog-Sim)}$ and $\textbf{C}$ognitive-$\textbf{S}$tate $\textbf{T}$ransition--Driven $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{O}$ptimization $\textbf{(CSTPO)}$. Cog-Sim maintains the user's cognitive and affective states and generates responses through constrained state transitions across turns, so feedback depends on both the realized utterance and the user's current state. CSTPO organizes each action as a hierarchical strategy--utterance representation: a high-level strategy label constrains utterance sampling, and utterances are optimized within each label. Sparse complete-branch sampling reuses shared dialogue prefixes and estimates separate strategy-level and utterance-level advantages, enabling fine-grained optimization at both levels. Across three tasks, Cog-Sim exhibits monotonic dose--response relationships and is preferred over prompt-based simulators for naturalness. CSTPO improves Qwen3-14B's performance to a level comparable to that of GPT-5.5-based planning methods.

</details>


### [806] [VD-DeepStack: Bridging Visual Comparison and Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34949)
*Mengyang Zhao,Zhuolin He,Haiyang Yu,Yuxuan Liang,Yifang Xu,Yuchuan Wu,Xiaolei Chen,Zhengtao Yao,Fan Shi,Yang Liu,Bin Li,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VD-DeepStack，用查询-参考视觉差异显式引导LVLM语言推理，提升少样本视觉异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本视觉异常检测本质是细粒度视觉比较，但现有LVLM方法依赖离散抽象的语言思维链，难以表达密集细粒度视觉差异，导致视觉比较与语言表达之间存在鸿沟。

Method: 融合DINO特征与LVLM视觉层级以增强细粒度表示；通过查询特征与软匹配参考特征的残差构建密集差异证据；将空间加权差异向量注入多解码器深度的查询图像状态，辅以视觉上下文路径提供外观信息以支持解释。

Result: 在4个工业和2个医疗异常基准上，相比依赖文本比较推理的基线，少样本异常检测性能大幅提升。

Conclusion: 通过联合设计比较表示并将其集成到解码器，可有效缓解视觉比较与推理之间的鸿沟；代码将在论文接收后发布。

Abstract: Few-shot visual anomaly detection is fundamentally a visual comparison task, requiring fine-grained inspection of a query against normal references. Many recent methods based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) emphasize comparative reasoning through language chain-of-thought. Yet discrete, abstract descriptions may underrepresent dense, fine-grained visual differences, leaving a gap between visual comparison and its expression in language. To address this gap, we propose Visual Difference DeepStack (VD-DeepStack), which explicitly conditions language reasoning on query-reference visual differences. Specifically, we fuse DINO features with the LVLM visual hierarchy to strengthen fine-grained representations, then construct dense difference evidence from residuals between query features and softly matched reference features. The difference-evidence path injects spatially weighted difference vectors into query-image states at multiple decoder depths, while an auxiliary visual-context path provides fine-grained appearance information to support their interpretation. Experiments on 4 industrial and 2 medical anomaly benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in few-shot anomaly detection over baselines relying on textual comparative reasoning. These results support mitigating the visual comparison-reasoning gap through the joint design of comparison representations and their integration into the decoder. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [807] [AX is the New AEO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34951)
*Ido Finder,Assaf Elovic,Gad Shalev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"agent experience (AX)是新AEO"的论点：在AI代理时代，被检索到不再足够，代理会真正打开并阅读网站；通过37,927次代理旅程实验证明，网站对代理可读性(AX)比传统AEO更决定最终推荐结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2023年企业被建议通过AEO(论坛、清单、站外引用)提升AI可见度。但如今模型知识被实时网页搜索取代，代理会多轮搜索并打开结果阅读。此时决定结果的不再是被"提及"，而是代理能否抓取并读懂企业自己的网站，即AX。作者因此主张AX取代AEO成为核心杠杆。

Method: 在1,056家真实企业上，按知名度、先前模型知识、两项AEO代理指标匹配，再按AX水平分组；用四个独立harness运行37,927次代理旅程(每次一个买家问题)。对比控制企业、harness、问题固定时，答案是否来自网站对准确率等结果的影响。

Result: 仅7-10%最终答案来自模型训练知识。Agent-ready企业78%的答案基于自家页面(vs 56%)，被明确推荐率高1.9倍；关于非agent-ready企业的每个有据答案多耗代理64%成本。控制变量后，基于网站的答案准确率高41%。主要失败是"遗漏"而非"捏造"：网页构建答案缺失买家所需事实的概率高3.7倍。四harness基线差异大(明确推荐率相差7倍)，但效应在每个harness中都成立。

Conclusion: 在agentic web时代，"可读"胜于"被谈论"。提升网站的AX是企业最强杠杆，AX取代AEO成为核心优化方向。

Abstract: In 2023, AI models answered from training data and hallucinated when it ran out, and businesses were told to seed that knowledge. Models' training knowledge has since given way to live web search, and the advice followed it there: answer-engine optimization, or AEO, now tells businesses to scatter breadcrumbs across forum threads, listicles, and off-site citations, so AI engines are likelier to surface and recommend them. But being surfaced is no longer enough: an agent opens the results and reads them before deciding, and one buyer question sends it through several rounds of search and fetch.
