The difficulty is that a posterior-sampled transition model is coupled with its own continuation value. We overcome this with a common empirical transition reference that isolates the resulting value mismatch and a Bellman-based variance argument that controls it without an extra leading-order state-space factor. For finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous tabular MDPs with unknown stochastic rewards, this yields the minimax $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ regret rate under arbitrary joint priors over rewards and transitions. The same proof principle gives the minimax $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$ rate for linear-mixture MDPs under arbitrary joint parameter priors.

</details>


### [948] [SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32108)
*Aayushi Shrivastava,Xunlan Zhou,Hongrui Zhao,Ziyu Chen,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAMBAR是一种无需回放旧任务演示的VLA持续学习方法，通过约束优化与乘子法防止灾难性遗忘，在LIBERO和真实硬件上保留所有已学任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型需持续学习新任务，但朴素微调会导致灾难性遗忘并损害泛化能力。现有持续学习方法多依赖回放旧任务演示，而旧数据往往不可得。

Method: 将持续学习建模为约束优化问题，用乘子法求解：通过双变量在约束违反累积时增大惩罚，驱动策略学习新任务的同时避免参数偏离旧值过远；并选择性锚定对旧任务关键的参数，释放其余参数用于新任务学习。

Result: 在LIBERO仿真基准和真实硬件上评估；顺序微调VLA时，所有无回放基线完全遗忘第一个任务，而SAMBAR保留所有已学任务。

Conclusion: 双变量与选择性锚定结合，平衡知识获取与保持，实现无需旧演示的VLA持续学习。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks. However, the old task demonstrations are not always readily available. In this paper, we introduce SAMBAR, a continual learning algorithm that prevents catastrophic forgetting during VLA finetuning without requiring access to the demonstrations of any previously learned task. We propose to cast continual learning as a constrained optimization problem and solve it with the method of multipliers. In our approach, the method of multipliers drives the policy to learn the new task without the model parameters drifting far away from their previous values. In contrast to a standard regularization penalty, the method of multipliers raises the penalty as the constraint violation accumulates by using a dual variable. We also selectively anchor the parameters critical to previous tasks to preserve past knowledge, leaving other parameters free for new task acquisition. The combination of dual variable and selective anchoring, therefore, balances knowledge acquisition with knowledge retention. We evaluate our method, SAMBAR, on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on hardware. When sequentially finetuning on a VLA, every replay-free baseline we compare against completely forgets the first task it learned, whereas SAMBAR retains every task it has learned.

</details>


### [949] [SLP-ProbHard: Probabilistic Hard-Constrained Learning via Structural Latent Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33515)
*Wondesen Teshome Bekele,Marco D'Oria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SLP-ProbHard表示中心框架，通过结构可行潜参数化(SFLP)直接在可行坐标中生成满足硬约束的概率预测，无需事后投影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常见硬约束方法先在原始坐标中预测再修正/投影，无法保证每个随机实现的精确结构，且预测律的支撑与边界概率未被直接刻画。

Method: 核心为结构可行潜参数化(SFLP)：结构潜律Z~P^Z_θ(·|x)配合对每个潜实现都满足约束的可行映射Y=h_φ(x,Z)。研究可行坐标与映射对随机维度、依赖、校准、表达力和计算的影响；实验用高斯潜律与固定几何导出映射。

Result: 在仿射等式、排序与单纯形约束、非线性流形及七流域FDC三种结构表示上实验。与ProbHardE2E/DPPL对比：两者零实际约束违反；SLP-ProbHard用8个随机坐标(对比11)并改善MSE/MAE，DPPL边缘CRPS更好、覆盖率更接近名义值；配对检验显示10个种子下Energy Score无差异。真实FDC表示将环境坐标13→7、14→8。

Conclusion: 精确可行性本身不能唯一决定预测律，当存在有意义的可行坐标时，应直接进行结构生成。

Abstract: Many probabilistic predictors must satisfy exact structure in every stochastic realization, yet common hard-constraint approaches form predictions in ambient coordinates and then correct or project them. We introduce SLP-ProbHard, a cross-family, representation-centered framework for probabilistic hard-constrained learning when explicit structural parameterizations are available. Its core object, a Structural Feasible Latent Parameterization (SFLP), combines a structural latent law $Z \sim P^Z_θ(\cdot\mid x)$ with a feasible map $Y=h_φ(x,Z)$ that satisfies the constraint for every latent realization. Together these components define the predictive law itself, including its support and boundary probabilities, rather than serving as a final feasibility wrapper. We study how feasible coordinates and maps affect stochastic dimension, dependence, calibration, expressiveness, and computation. Experiments use Gaussian latent laws and fixed geometry-derived maps across affine equalities, ordering and simplex constraints, nonlinear manifolds, and three structural representations of seven-basin hydrological flow-duration-curve (FDC) data. In an official-source affine comparison with ProbHardE2E/DPPL, both methods achieve zero practical constraint violations. SLP-ProbHard uses 8 instead of 11 stochastic coordinates and improves MSE/MAE, while DPPL yields better marginal CRPS and closer-to-nominal coverage; a paired test detects no Energy Score difference across ten seeds. Real-world affine and nonlinear FDC representations reduce 13 to 7 and 14 to 8 ambient versus computational coordinates, respectively. Exact feasibility alone thus does not determine a predictive law, motivating direct structural generation when meaningful feasible coordinates are available.

</details>


### [950] [Correct then Forecast: Observer State-Space Models for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33566)
*Alexis-Raja Brachet,Guillaume Clavier--Frémond,Abdelhakim Ziani,Pierre-Yves Richard,Céline Hudelot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观察者状态空间模型(OSSM),将观测序列视为自主动力系统的测量,分离潜状态传播与测量校正,统一了现有SSM并提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归预测模型把观测当作直接控制潜动态的输入,当预测时观测不可用会导致"regime change"问题,破坏动态一致性。

Method: 借鉴状态估计视角,将观测输入视为自主动力系统的测量,显式分离潜状态传播与测量校正:单一转移同时支配上下文和预测区间,观测通过observer校正估计状态。可暴露可观测性和估计误差收敛等控制理论性质,并证明传统及近期SSM均为其特例。

Result: 在多个基准上,OSSM在参数量与训练设置与对应SSM基线相同的情况下取得显著提升,并揭示现有SSM的建模不一致性。

Conclusion: 支持一条原则:递归预测中观测应校正估计的潜状态,而非控制用于传播的动态。

Abstract: Time series forecasting requires extrapolating the dynamics of an observed process beyond the last available measurement. Yet recurrent forecasting models typically treat observations as inputs that directly control their latent dynamics. It leads to a regime change when these observations become unavailable at prediction time. Following a state-estimation perspective, we introduce Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs), a class of recurrent models that interprets the observed input time series as measurements of an underlying autonomous dynamical system. OSSMs explicitly separate latent-state propagation from measurement assimilation: a single transition governs the dynamics across both context and forecasting intervals, while available observations correct the estimated state through an observer. This formulation naturally exposes classical control-theoretic properties, including observability and convergence of the state estimation error. We further show that conventional and recent SSMs can be recovered as particular instances of our OSSM framework, thereby providing a unified interpretation of their recurrent dynamics and revealing modeling inconsistencies. We perform experiments across several benchmarks showing that OSSM achieves substantial improvements while maintaining the same parameter count and training setup as the corresponding SSM baseline. These results support a simple principle for recurrent forecasting: observations should correct the estimated latent state, rather than control the dynamics used to propagate it.

</details>


### [951] [Handwritten Digit Leakage from Smartphone Motion Sensors Across Unseen Users and Phone Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32117)
*Constantino Álvarez Casado,Erkka Rantahalvari,Matteo Pedone,Matti Matilainen,Manuel Lage Cañellas,Le Nguyen,Simo Hosio,Olli Silvén,Miguel Bordallo López*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究手机运动传感器读数在已知绘制区间下，能否跨用户、跨设备预测手写数字，并评估其隐私泄露风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动传感器虽用于交互应用，但可能无意中泄露触摸屏输入，需探究该泄露是否在熟悉用户和设备之外仍然存在。

Method: 基于HuMIdb数据集（481名参与者、19,628条记录），将问题建模为10类手写数字识别；比较手工特征+经典机器学习、MiniRocket核方法与紧凑传感器patch transformer，使用加速度计、线性加速度、陀螺仪和重力信号。

Result: Transformer在75名未见用户上达57.74%准确率、82.64% top-3；在9款未见手机上跨3个随机种子为58.77±0.95%。低运动记录仍有信息量，准确率与运动强度非单调；对比预训练、数据增强和派生信号无一致增益。

Conclusion: 在假设已知分割条件下，数字可跨用户和手机型号预测，但采集顺序捷径限制了关于实际隐私暴露的结论。

Abstract: Smartphone motion sensors support interactive applications, but their readings may also reveal touchscreen input beyond their intended use. Assuming known drawing intervals, we study whether handwritten digits remain predictable across users and devices, as a 10-class problem on 19,628 HuMIdb recordings from 481 participants. We compare handcrafted features with classical machine learning algorithms, MiniRocket kernels, and a compact sensor patch transformer on accelerometer, linear acceleration, gyroscope, and gravity signals. The transformer achieves 57.74\% accuracy and 82.64\% top-3 accuracy on 75 unseen participants, and 58.77$\pm$0.95\% over 3 seeds for unseen participants on 9 unseen phone models. Low motion recordings remain informative, accuracy is not monotonic in motion level, and the tested contrastive pretraining, augmentation, and derived signals give no consistent gains. Digits are thus predictable beyond familiar users and phone models under assumed segmentation, while acquisition-order shortcuts limit conclusions about practical privacy exposure. Code available at: https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage.

</details>


### [952] [Quantifying Behavioral Tails in Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33638)
*Elsayed Eshra,Ali Al-Lawati,Dongwon Lee,Suhang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RareTrap提出一个在黑盒LLM中估计严重行为概率的框架，通过代理LLM构造从低维潜空间到token嵌入空间的几何感知映射，诱导显式可复现的输入提示分布，并结合响应级性能函数和序贯稀有事件模拟，以少量评估（低至200次）估计严重行为概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计黑盒LLM严重行为概率的核心挑战在于难以定义输入空间上可处理的分布；严重行为本身稀有，直接测量概率代价过高。

Method: 利用代理LLM建立低维潜参考空间到token嵌入空间的几何感知映射，诱导输入提示的显式可复现分布；用响应级性能函数量化行为严重性；采用序贯稀有事件模拟，逐步聚焦更严重行为同时保持诱导分布下的概率正确性。

Result: 在10个开源模型及两个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）上，RareTrap成功诱导出严重资源消耗行为，并以少至200次评估计算出其概率。

Conclusion: RareTrap为模型开发者提供了在统一分布下评估语言模型的原则性方法，有助于优先分配对齐工作以提升安全性并降低风险。

Abstract: We introduce RareTrap, a framework for estimating the probability of severe behaviors in black box large language models (LLMs). A key challenge for probability estimation is defining a tractable distribution over the input space. To accomplish that, RareTrap uses a surrogate LLM and constructs a geometry-aware mapping from a lower-dimensional latent reference space into its token-embedding space to induce an explicit and reproducible distribution over input prompts. A response-level performance function is utilized on the response to quantify behavior severity. This enables sequential rare event simulation that concentrates evaluations on progressively more severe behaviors while preserving probability under the induced prompt distribution, which would otherwise be prohibitive to measure. Across 10 open-weight and two frontier models (GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), we find that RareTrap successfully induces severe resource consumption behaviors and computes their probability with as few as 200 evaluations. RareTrap provides model developers a principled approach for evaluating language models under a common distribution, and prioritizing alignment effort to improve safety and mitigate risks. Code is published online: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rare_trap-D7F0.

</details>


### [953] [What Should We Freeze? Guarded Freezing: Connectivity Shapes the Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32124)
*Leonel Aguilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究预训练模型微调中的冻结选择问题，提出 removal-value 和 drift-value 两种评分，并据此提出 Guarded Freezing 策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单独冻结权重不足以保证性能，因为其他位置的更新会改变冻结核心的输入，从而影响整体表现。

Method: 针对冻结核心可隔离的情形，提出基于容量的 removal-value 评分；针对 Transformer 共享残差流的情形，提出 drift-value，作为局部更新模型下权重更新引发输出扰动的前向代理。

Result: VGG-8 中 70% 冻结比 DEFT 多保留 5.22±0.51 个百分点旧任务精度；语言模型 40 轮超过 Wanda 和 RIA，与 Fisher 差异未定，160 轮在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上比静态 Fisher 多保留 0.0433±0.0102；DINOv3 点云适配中保留 0.440 图像精度，对比随机掩码 0.187。

Conclusion: 据此提出 Guarded Freezing：当输入路径被切断时按 removal-value 选择，当路径保持时按 drift-value 选择。

Abstract: When adapting pre-trained models through fine-tuning, freezing weights alone might not preserve performance, as updates elsewhere can change the inputs to the frozen core, ultimately affecting overall performance. We first analyse the case where a selected frozen core can be isolated and propose removal-value, a capacity-based score that approximates HOPE's removal cost averaged over removal orders. We show that in VGG-8, cutting paths from trainable neurons into a frozen core makes selection using this score useful: $70\%$ frozen preserves $5.22\pm0.51$ percentage points more old-task accuracy than DEFT at similar new-task accuracy. In transformers, shared residual streams leave paths into frozen neurons open. For this case, we derive drift-value, a forward-only proxy for the output disturbance from updating each weight entry under a local update model. In language models, at 40 epochs, this policy exceeds adapted Wanda and RIA freezing scores in settings with substantial retention loss, while its differences from Fisher remain unresolved. After 160 epochs on Qwen2.5-1.5B, it retains $0.0433\pm0.0102$ more than static Fisher. In DINOv3 vision-transformer adaptation to point clouds, drift-value retains $0.440$ image accuracy versus $0.187$ for a random mask of the same count. These results motivate Guarded Freezing: select by removal-value when incoming paths are cut, and by drift-value when they remain.

</details>


### [954] [Benign Overfitting for General Norms and Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33675)
*Daniel Barzilai,Ohad Shamir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分析一般范数与次高斯分布下线性回归良性过拟合的方法，证明p>1最小p范数插值可良性过拟合非高斯分布，而1范数在非高斯分布下一般不再良性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有良性过拟合研究多基于最小2范数线性回归（对应梯度下降），但Adam、Muon等现代优化器采用非欧几里得几何，偏好其他范数解。非欧范数分析极难，已知结果基本局限于高斯分布。

Method: 发展一套适用于一般范数与一般次高斯分布的线性回归良性过拟合分析框架，通过分析对偶优化问题的几何性质，结合集中不等式与中心极限工具，证明其在许多高维情形下近似欧几里得。

Result: 证明了p>1的最小p范数插值在适当条件下对非高斯分布也能良性过拟合；反直觉的是，1范数在性质良好但非高斯的分布下一般不能良性过拟合，说明已有1范数正面结果关键依赖高斯性。

Conclusion: 良性过拟合并非仅由插值本身决定，而与范数几何及数据分布密切相关；高斯假设在1范数情形中起关键作用，一般范数分析可通过对偶问题的近似欧几里得性实现。

Abstract: Understanding why predictors can generalize despite interpolating noisy training data is a central puzzle in machine learning. Most work on such "benign overfitting" studies minimum-2-norm linear regression, reflecting the inductive bias of gradient descent. However, modern optimizers such as Adam and Muon use non-Euclidean update geometries, favoring solutions associated with other norms. Analyzing regression for non-Euclidean norms is substantially more difficult, with known results essentially limited to Gaussians. In this paper, we develop a method to analyze benign overfitting in linear regression for general norms and general (sub-Gaussian) distributions. As a special case, we prove that minimum-p-norm interpolation with p>1 can benignly overfit even for non-Gaussian distributions, under suitable conditions. Perhaps surprisingly, for the 1-norm, benign overfitting does not hold in general for well-behaved (but non-Gaussian) distributions, showing that existing positive 1-norm results rely crucially on Gaussianity. Our proof analyzes the geometry of the dual optimization problem, using concentration and central limit tools to show it is approximately Euclidean in many high-dimensional cases.

</details>


### [955] [Latency-Aware Client Assignment for Parallel Split Learning With Global Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32132)
*Mohammad Kohankhaki,Valentin Rentschler,Anke Schmeink*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出延迟预算感知的并行拆分学习调度方法，通过将类别目标与客户端选择解耦来降低建模训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在跨机构的拆分学习中，现有全局采样并行拆分学习在构建池化批次时忽略客户端延迟，即使多个客户端可提供相同类别，也未考虑各客户端的完成时间差异。

Method: 提出Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling，将池化批次的整数类别目标与提供样本的客户端选择分离。flow变体将分配建模为整数网络流问题，最小化建模的客户端完成时间；fast变体采用贪心下一完成规则降低调度构建成本；并设计规划规则在选择变体时考虑两种候选调度的构建开销。

Result: CIFAR-10上flow变体建模时间降低6.75%，最终精度下降0.30个百分点；Tiny ImageNet（每客户端20个候选类）上fast变体建模时间降低16.87%，且比延迟无关基线更早达到全部四个验证目标。405次调度比较中，规划规则96.54%的情况下在最低实际成本的2%以内。

Conclusion: 延迟感知的提供者分配可在不改变指定类别目标的前提下降低建模训练时间，而首选变体取决于分配收益是否超过调度构建开销。

Abstract: In cross-silo split learning, Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling forms representative pooled batches when class distributions differ across clients, but ignores client delay when several clients can supply the same class. We introduce Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling, which separates each pooled batch's integer class target from the choice of clients that supply its examples. The flow variant formulates this assignment as an integral network-flow problem and minimizes modeled client-side completion time for the current target. The fast variant uses a greedy next-completion rule to reduce schedule-construction cost. Both preserve the target stream and use every local example once per epoch. A planning rule selects between the variants while accounting for the cost of constructing both candidate schedules. On CIFAR-10, the flow variant reduces modeled training time by 6.75%, with a 0.30 percentage-point decrease in final accuracy. On Tiny ImageNet with 20 candidate classes per client, the fast variant reduces modeled time by 16.87% and reaches all four validation targets earlier than the latency-unaware baseline. Across 405 schedule comparisons, the planning rule stays within 2% of the lower realized cost in 96.54% of cases. In our evaluation, latency-aware provider assignment reduces modeled training time without changing the prescribed class targets, while the preferred variant depends on whether assignment savings outweigh schedule-construction overhead.

</details>


### [956] [Oracle-Efficient Online Classification with Stochastic Inputs and Adversarial Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33760)
*Gon Buzaglo,Elad Hazan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的 Gaussian 扰动 Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) 算法用于上下文二分类预测，达到最优的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$（或 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)})$）期望 regret，每轮仅需一次优化 oracle 调用，且无需枚举专家类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 Lazaric 和 Munos (2012) 提出的开放问题，证明 hybrid classification 在计算上与统计学习同样简单：即在 i.i.d. 上下文与自适应损失设定下，能否以计算高效的方式达到统计最优 regret。

Method: 采用带 Gaussian 扰动的 Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader 算法；对每个观测到的上下文施加扰动，每轮只需一次优化 oracle 调用，无需显式枚举专家类或假设类。

Result: 对 $N$ 个专家类达到最优 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ 期望 regret；对无限假设类 $\mathcal H$，达到 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)})$ regret。

Conclusion: 该算法以极低的计算代价（每轮一次 oracle 调用）取得统计最优的 regret，解决了长期开放问题，表明 hybrid classification 计算上不逊于统计学习。

Abstract: We consider contextual binary prediction with i.i.d. contexts from an unknown distribution and adaptively chosen losses. We show that a simple Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader algorithm with Gaussian perturbation for each observed context achieves the optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ expected regret for a class of $N$ experts, while requiring one optimization-oracle call per round and no explicit enumeration of the class. For an infinite hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, the algorithm attains $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)})$ regret. This resolves an open problem posed by Lazaric and Munos (2012), showing that hybrid classification is computationally as easy as statistical learning.

</details>


### [957] [Posterior Regimes and Latent Deception: Variational Bayesian Inference in Hidden Markov Models for Sequential Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34031)
*Joseph Uririoghene Obukofe,Anthony O'Hare,Chioma Sandra Dike*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出三层HMM（Baum-Welch、VBEM、Neural VBEM）对客户交易序列建模，发现潜在行为状态中一个与欺诈高度相关，但需警惕后验概率被误读为欺诈概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欺诈检测需要可解释、可校准的建模方式。现有判别模型（如XGBoost）虽排序强但缺乏行为状态层面的可解释性；同时文献中HMM的状态后验概率常被错误当作欺诈概率使用，导致校准问题。

Method: 构建三层递进HMM：Baum-Welch最大似然、变分贝叶斯VBEM、以及Neural VBEM。后者用学习的编码器将741维交易表示压缩为64维隐空间，VBEM后验在此空间运行。区分批量（平滑，含未来信息）与滤波（仅前向）推断，并提出校正的posterior-predictive分数以修正状态归属概率被误当欺诈概率的偏差（MRIE）。

Result: UMAP投影显示发现的行为状态并非离散簇，而是单一连续行为流形上的有序片段，确认欺诈集中于极端端。神经层在识别出的状态上实现14.4倍欺诈富集；其AUPRC低于判别式XGBoost基线，但分析表明该差距是结构性的而非偶然。

Conclusion: 该模型最适合作为校准的分流（triage）与可解释性层，而非直接替代排序模型。状态后验概率需经校正后方可作为欺诈分数使用。

Abstract: We present a three-tier progression of Hidden Markov Models: maximum-likelihood (Baum-Welch), variational Bayesian (VBEM), and a neural variational extension (Neural VBEM), that model each customer's transaction history as a trajectory through a small number of latent behavioural regimes, one of which is empirically identified as fraud-associated. The Neural VBEM HMM replaces the fixed Gaussian-multinomial emission family with a learned encoder, compressing a 741-dimensional transaction representation into a 64-dimensional latent space in which the VBEM HMM's posterior operates; a UMAP projection of this space reveals that the discovered regimes are not discrete clusters but ordered segments of a single continuous behavioural manifold, with confirmed fraud concentrated at its extreme. We show that the model's natural output, that is, the posterior probability of regime membership, is routinely mistaken for a fraud probability, and quantify the resulting miscalibration (the regime-membership interpretation error, MRIE); a corrected posterior-predictive score, closes most of this gap. We further distinguish batch (smoothed) inference, which uses look-ahead unavailable at deployment time, from filtered (forward-only) inference, and report both. On IEEE-CIS transaction data, the neural tier achieves a 14.4$\times$ fraud enrichment in its identified regime; while its AUPRC trails a discriminative XGBoost baseline, we show this gap is structural and not incidental, and argue the model is best positioned as a calibrated triage and interpretability layer rather than a drop-in ranking replacement.

</details>


### [958] [Spectral Reversal: Counteracting Singular Value Bias for Graph Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32143)
*Hanxu Yang,Yuhuan Zhao,Xiaodong He,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示预训练GNN存在"频谱偏差"现象，并提出频谱反向提示（SRP）框架，通过频谱域软阈值掩码重平衡冻结编码器的频谱贡献，实现参数高效的图适配并达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图提示方法将预训练模型视为不透明特征提取器，忽略其内部频谱结构。作者发现预训练GNN存在频谱偏差：优化过程过度对齐大奇异值方向，导致低能量方向未被充分利用，而这些方向在分布偏移下含有关键互补信息。

Method: 提出SRP框架：1) 在频谱域施加可学习软阈值掩码，降低主导方向权重、增强较弱方向；2) 引入零空间增强模块，捕捉冻结编码器下激活极小的方向变化。

Result: 在多个基准上取得SOTA性能，且额外参数极少，验证了频谱分量重加权作为参数高效图适配策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 重加权频谱分量是一种有原则且有效的参数高效图适配策略。

Abstract: Pre-training Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via self-supervised learning has become a dominant paradigm, yet efficiently adapting frozen encoders remains a challenge. Graph prompting offers a parameter-efficient alternative to fine-tuning, but existing methods largely treat pre-trained models as opaque feature extractors, ignoring their internal spectral structure. In this work, we identify a systematic phenomenon in pre-trained GNNs, which we term spectral bias: optimization during pre-training disproportionately aligns representations with directions associated with large singular values, leaving low-energy directions under-explored. We show that these underutilized directions can encode complementary information that is beneficial for downstream adaptation, especially under distribution shift. To leverage this insight, we propose Spectral Reverse Prompt (SRP), a prompting framework that rebalances the spectral contributions of frozen GNN encoders. SRP applies a learnable soft-thresholding mask in the spectral domain to down-weight dominant directions while amplifying weaker ones. In addition, SRP incorporates a null-space augmentation module that captures variation in directions with minimal activation under the frozen encoder. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SRP achieves state-of-the-art performance with minimal additional parameters, highlighting that reweighting spectral components is a principled and effective strategy for parameter-efficient graph adaptation.

</details>


### [959] [Playing to Par: Reinforcement Learning for Provably Optimal Quadrilateral Block Decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32146)
*Arjun Narayanan,Per-Olof Persson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练强化学习智能体在平面域上生成全四边形网格分解，达到由离散高斯-博内定理限定的顶点不规则度下界（par），并在大域上超越Gmsh。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四边形块分解质量取决于是否完整、形状良好及不规则顶点数量；离散高斯-博内恒等式给出基于拓扑和角角的顶点不规则度下界，但随机探索难以达到该下界。

Method: 智能体直接在半边数据结构上通过局部编辑操作，策略网络卷积沿网格自身连接性；先用易构造的最优网格反向走成演示进行行为克隆，再用PPO训练；奖励直接针对下界，稀疏。

Result: 96个保留域全部生成全四边形网格，平均95.7可用，90个可证最优；Gmsh最强配置51完成、38可用、0最优，即使3-14倍元素也不更规则。64个两倍训练规模域全部完成、62可用，中位超出par小于1，而Gmsh为39。

Conclusion: 该方法可扩展到大域并接近理论最优，显著优于Gmsh。

Abstract: A quadrilateral block decomposition of a planar domain is judged by whether it is complete, whether its elements are well shaped, and how many of its vertices are irregular. The last has a provable floor: the discrete Gauss-Bonnet identity enforces a lower bound on the total vertex irregularity of any all-quadrilateral mesh of a given domain purely based on its topology and corner angles. We train a reinforcement learning agent to build decompositions that reach this bound, which we call par. It acts directly on the mesh's half-edge data structure through local edits, with a policy network whose convolutions follow the mesh's own connectivity, so it applies unchanged to domains larger than any seen in training. The reward targets the floor directly, and it is sparse: random play reaches it on no domain with more than eight sides. We overcome this exploration barrier via behaviour cloning on optimal meshes that are trivial to construct, walked backward into demonstrations, before training it with PPO. On 96 held-out domains the agent produces an all-quadrilateral mesh on every one, a usable one on 95.7 on average, and a provably optimal one on 90; Gmsh's strongest configuration at the same element count completes 51, is usable on 38 and optimal on none, and even at three to fourteen times the elements never produces a more regular mesh. On 64 domains twice the training size the agent completes all, is usable on 62, and keeps a median excess over par below one against Gmsh's 39 at the same element count.

</details>


### [960] [ABC-Align: Prediction-Powered Alignment with Adaptive Bias Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34374)
*Eric Frankel,Banghua Zhu,Sewoong Oh,Lillian J. Ratliff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ABC-Align，利用丰富的伪标签信号最小化方差，并结合基于人类标注子集的自适应校正，缓解语言模型后训练中人类偏好数据稀缺的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型后训练依赖昂贵且难以扩展的人类偏好数据；RLAIF等利用伪标签的方法虽丰富但引入系统性偏差，降低对齐效果；现有半监督方法虽能校正教师偏差，但在人类标注稀缺时方差过高。

Method: ABC-Align：借助大量伪标签信号降低方差，并在人类标注子集上施加轻量级自适应校正；校正强度通过相关偏差-方差量的插入式估计在训练过程中自动调节。

Result: 在人类反馈稀缺条件下的LLM对齐任务中（RLHF、DPO、GRPO），一系列逐步扩大规模的实验表明，ABC-Align优于先前的半监督基线。

Conclusion: ABC-Align通过结合伪标签的低方差优势与人类标注的自适应校正，有效提升了稀缺人类反馈下的LLM对齐性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Language model post-training is often bottlenecked by the need for human-collected preference data, which is expensive and difficult to scale. Reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) style approaches that leverage pseudo labels offer an abundant alternative but introduce systematic biases that degrade downstream alignment. Recent general-purpose semi-supervised methods correct for teacher bias using a small set of human-labeled examples, but suffer from high variance especially when human annotations are scarce. To this end, we propose ABC-Align, leveraging abundant pseudo label signal to minimize variance and applying a lightweight, adaptive correction grounded in the human-labeled subset. The correction strength is tuned automatically during training using plug-in estimates of the relevant bias--variance quantities. On LLM alignment with RLHF, DPO, and GRPO where human feedback is scarce, we empirically demonstrate that ABC-Align achieves superior performance over prior semi-supervised baselines in a series of experiments on an increasing scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/abc-align .

</details>


### [961] [CAFE: Counterfactual Prediction via Fast Posterior Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32167)
*Xinyan Han,Xiaoyu Lin,Hao Zou,Xingxuan Zhang,Bo Li,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出CAFE框架，用摊销推理直接近似贝叶斯反事实后验预测分布，从而在存在结构不确定性时准确预测个体反事实结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实预测通常无法从观测数据中辨识。即使在完全观测的加性噪声模型（ANM）中，不同因果图可能产生相同观测分布却蕴含不同的个体反事实结果，而基于单一估计图的预测忽略了这种结构不确定性。

Method: 提出CAFE（Counterfactual Prediction via Fast Posterior Estimation），一种摊销推理框架，直接近似贝叶斯反事实后验预测分布。在多样先验的ANM合成反事实任务上预训练transformer模型；给定观测数据集、个体事实观测和干预后，单次前向传播即可近似对应后验预测分布。

Result: 实验表明CAFE在可辨识设定下能准确预测个体反事实结果；当存在由观测不可区分因果图引发的结构不确定性时，能很好地近似后验预测分布；在真实制造业和葡萄栽培场景中也表现强健，超出训练先验假设仍具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CAFE通过摊销贝叶斯推断有效整合结构不确定性，实现了快速、准确且鲁棒的个体反事实预测。

Abstract: Counterfactual prediction estimates an individual's outcome under an alternative intervention given their factual observations. Such outcomes are generally not identifiable from observational data without additional assumptions. Even within the class of fully observed additive noise models (ANMs), different causal graphs can generate the same observational distribution yet imply different individual counterfactual outcomes. Predictions based on a single estimated graph ignore this structural uncertainty. We therefore target a Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution that combines predictions from plausible SCMs. We introduce CAFE (\textbf{C}ounterf\textbf{A}ctual Prediction via \textbf{F}ast Posterior \textbf{E}stimation), an amortized inference framework that directly approximates the Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution. We pretrain a transformer-based model on synthetic counterfactual tasks generated from a diverse prior over ANMs. Given an observational dataset, an individual's factual observations, and an intervention, CAFE approximates the corresponding posterior predictive distribution in a single forward pass. Experiments show that CAFE accurately predicts individual counterfactual outcomes in identifiable settings and approximates the posterior predictive distribution when structural uncertainty induced by observationally indistinguishable causal graphs exists. Strong performance in realistic manufacturing and viticulture settings further demonstrates its empirical robustness beyond the assumptions of the training prior.

</details>


### [962] [Unlocking Few-Step Diffusion for Faithful Previews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34406)
*Jing Jia,Sifan Liu,Guanyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过学习对初始噪声和去噪更新的校正，使少步采样器能近似全步输出，用于廉价预览筛选候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散工作流中采样延迟累积，用户需生成并丢弃大量候选。少步采样器输出质量差并非因为缺乏重建能力，而可通过优化初始噪声改善。

Method: 以端点为监督，学习对初始噪声和去噪更新的校正，使3-4步冻结采样器逼近同噪声和提示下的全步输出；输入校正可跨采样预算迁移无需重训。

Result: 参考保真度显著提升，无条件基准上重建MSE比重训LD3低53-78%；在SD1.5、SDXL、FLUX.1-dev上排序保持和候选选择均改善。

Conclusion: 少步预览可用于廉价筛选候选并保留全步生成，校正方法有效且可跨预算迁移。

Abstract: Sampling latency compounds in diffusion workflows, where users generate and discard many candidates before keeping one. Surprisingly, the poor outputs of standard few-step samplers do not reflect a lack of reconstruction capacity: by optimizing only the initial noise, frozen 3-4-step samplers can closely reproduce their corresponding full-step outputs. Building on this finding, we learn corrections to the initial noise and denoising updates using endpoint supervision, improving correspondence with full-step outputs generated from the same noise and prompt. The resulting previews allow users to screen candidates cheaply and reserve full-step generation for promising ones. Input correction also transfers across sampling budgets without retraining. Experiments show substantial improvements in reference fidelity, including 53-78% lower reconstruction MSE than retrained LD3 on unconditional benchmarks, alongside improved ranking preservation and candidate selection on SD1.5, SDXL, and FLUX.1-dev.

</details>


### [963] [Uncertainty-Aware Selection of Online Algorithms with Simulator Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32170)
*Yongyi Guo,Zifan Xu,Ziping Xu,Kelly W. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将在线强化学习中基于拟合仿真器的算法选型问题形式化，提出不确定性感知（Uncertainty-Aware）选择规则，通过仿真器集成（如bootstrap重采样）选择平均表现最好的算法，理论证明其在多臂老虎机中相比Plug-In有显著遗憾增益，并在机器人控制的深度RL实验中验证其更可靠的选择与更优在线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线RL性能高度依赖设计选择（尤其影响探索的选择）。常用做法是：将仿真器拟合到离线数据，在仿真器中评估候选算法并部署表现最佳者。最简单的Plug-In选择规则直接在拟合仿真器上选最优算法，当离线数据有限时评估不可靠。

Method: 研究不确定性感知选择：构建仿真器集成（例如通过bootstrap重采样获得），选择在集成上平均表现最好的在线算法。理论上在多臂老虎机设定下分析其对有限数据影响的缓解作用及遗憾表现；并在涉及奖励塑形超参数选择的机器人控制深度RL任务上进行实证研究。

Result: 理论证明该集成方法可缓解拟合仿真器时数据有限的影响，相比Plug-In选择在多臂老虎机中获得显著遗憾增益；深度RL机器人控制实验中，该方法带来更可靠的选择和更好的在线性能。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的集成仿真器选择优于传统Plug-In选择，在数据有限时更可靠，并已在理论与深度RL实验中验证。

Abstract: The performance of online reinforcement learning depends critically on design choices, especially those that affect exploration. These choices are often selected by fitting a simulator to offline data, evaluating candidate algorithms in that simulator, and deploying the best-performing one. The simplest Plug-In selection rule simply selects the best performing algorithm on the fitted simulator, making evaluations unreliable when the offline data used to fit the simulator are limited. We investigate Uncertainty-Aware selection, which forms an ensemble of simulators---for example, obtained by bootstrap resampling---and selects the online algorithm with the best average performance across the ensemble. While ensemble-based approaches have been used to mitigate distribution shift and facilitate sim-to-real transfer, we formally show that this approach can mitigate the effects of limited data when fitting the simulator and theoretically has significant regret gains compared to Plug-In selection in multi-armed bandits. We also empirically investigate the Uncertainty-Aware selection approach in deep RL experiments on robotic control tasks that involve selecting reward-shaping hyperparameters, and show that it leads to more reliable selection and improved online performance.

</details>


### [964] [On the Relation Between Interval Regret and Dynamic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34423)
*Yi-Han Wang,Peng Zhao,Zhi-Hua Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文否定了"最优区间遗憾蕴含最优动态遗憾"的猜想，并提出利用局部自适应性实现最优动态遗憾的归约方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳在线学习中，区间遗憾与动态遗憾是强化静态遗憾的两个代表性指标。先前工作普遍认为区间遗憾更强，猜想最优区间遗憾能自动带来最优动态遗憾，但二者关系长期不明。

Method: 先构造反例：对凸函数及弯曲函数（指数凹、强凸），存在算法具最优区间遗憾却不达最优动态遗憾。随后利用局部自适应性，将区间遗憾最小化过程作用于包含原可行域的放大欧氏球上，并使用域转换的代理损失，从而归约得到最优动态遗憾。

Result: 给出否定性结果，反驳了指标层面的蕴含直觉；该归约对凸函数和弯曲函数均适用，并首次得到指数凹函数下最优动态遗憾的真有效算法，改进先前结果并简化分析。

Conclusion: 区间遗憾与动态遗憾之间不存在必然的指标蕴含关系；通过局部自适应与域转换归约，可统一实现凸与弯曲函数的最优动态遗憾。

Abstract: Non-stationary online learning has attracted much attention in recent years, as static regret is insufficient to guide algorithm design in changing environments. To address this limitation, interval regret and dynamic regret have been introduced as two representative performance metrics that strengthen static regret in complementary directions. Interval regret requires an online algorithm to achieve competitive static regret over every local time interval, whereas dynamic regret evaluates performance against an arbitrary sequence of time-varying comparators. Despite their importance, the relation between these metrics has long remained unclear. Prior work has often regarded interval regret as the stronger notion, based on the intuition that local guarantees should naturally induce global guarantees. Consequently, it is widely conjectured that an algorithm with optimal interval regret should automatically attain optimal dynamic regret. In this paper, we first establish a negative result that refutes this intuition of a metric-level implication. Specifically, for both convex and curved functions (including exp-concave and strongly convex functions), we show that there exist instances in which an algorithm with optimal interval regret nevertheless fails to achieve optimal dynamic regret. We then show how to leverage local adaptivity to obtain optimal dynamic regret. In particular, optimal dynamic regret can be attained by invoking an interval regret minimization process over an enlarged Euclidean ball containing the original convex feasible domain and using a suitable domain-converted surrogate loss. This reduction applies to both convex and curved functions. As a byproduct, we obtain the first proper and efficient algorithm with optimal dynamic regret for exp-concave functions, improving prior results while significantly simplifying the analysis.

</details>


### [965] [Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Mobile Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32832)
*Ming Xiang,Nicolò Michelusi,Yonina C. Eldar,Lili Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedOAG，通过梯度归一化和隐式gossip自动满足能量约束并均匀混合设备更新，无需全设备传输或特定衰落模型即可收敛到无偏非凸目标的平稳点，速率达最优O(1/√T)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中计算联邦学习方法在异构衰落信道下存在问题：强制所有设备无偏更新会因最弱信道放大接收噪声；允许部分设备贡献则对衰落模型失配敏感且仅收敛到有偏目标。

Method: FedOAG利用梯度归一化自动满足能量约束，并通过隐式gossiping均匀混合各设备更新；不要求所有设备传输，也不依赖特定衰落模型或时变统计信道分布知识。

Result: 证明FedOAG收敛到无偏非凸目标的平稳点，达到任意随机一阶方法的最优速率O(1/√T)；在真实数据集和动态无线条件下的数值实验验证了分析。

Conclusion: FedOAG有效解决了异构衰落信道下空中计算联邦学习的有偏与噪声放大问题，实现无偏收敛且具备模型无关的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Over-the-air computation has emerged as a scalable and efficient solution for deploying federated learning algorithms in wireless networks by exploiting waveform superposition for simultaneous model aggregation. Most existing work struggles with heterogeneous fading channels. These approaches either enforce unbiased updates from all devices or allow partial device contributions, requiring careful tuning of the convergence bound to mitigate bias under specific fading models. However, the former significantly amplifies receiver noise due to the weakest channel, whereas the latter is sensitive to fading model mismatch and converges only to a biased objective. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedOAG, which employs algorithmic components to automatically satisfy energy constraints via gradient normalization and evenly mix devices' updates through implicit gossiping. Importantly, FedOAG does not require transmission from all devices, nor does it rely on a specific fading model or knowledge of time-varying statistical channel distributions. We show that FedOAG converges to a stationary point of an unbiased non-convex objective at the best possible rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ for any stochastic first-order method. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments over dynamic wireless conditions on real-world datasets.

</details>


### [966] [Efficient Support Recovery of Mixtures of Sparse Linear Classifiers with Less Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32176)
*Xiaxin Li,Arya Mazumdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性分类器混合模型中的支撑恢复问题，提出自适应与非自适应方案，显著减少测量次数并实现亚线性解码时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性分类器混合模型中，需从符号测量恢复l个k-稀疏向量的支撑（非零坐标）。测量随机选取一个向量并返回其与测量向量的内积符号。现有方法测量次数多、解码复杂度高（超二次），效率不足。

Method: 提出自适应测量方案和非自适应方案，用于从符号测量中恢复多个稀疏向量的支撑，兼顾测量数目与解码效率。

Result: 自适应方案大幅减少测量次数，并将解码复杂度从超二次降至与环境维度成亚线性；非自适应方案改进了此前的测量下界，同时保持高效解码。

Conclusion: 该方法在混合模型的支撑恢复中，实现了比以往更优的样本复杂度与解码时间权衡。

Abstract: The support recovery problem in mixture of linear classifiers intends to identify which features actually matter when data is generated by a mixture of several linear decision rules. In particular, the aim is to recover the support (nonzero coordinates) of $l$ unknown $k$-sparse vectors from sign measurements. Each measurement is generated by selecting one of the $l$ vectors uniformly at random, and returning the sign of its inner product with a chosen measurement vector.
  In this paper, we propose adaptive and non-adaptive schemes that significantly improve upon prior results by reducing the number of measurements and achieving sublinear decoding time simultaneously. In particular, our adaptive constructions substantially reduce measurements compared to existing approaches, while also lowering decoding complexity from super-quadratic to sublinear in the ambient dimension. We further provide a non-adaptive scheme that improves previous measurement bounds while maintaining efficient decoding.
  Overall, our approach yields a more efficient trade-off between sample complexity and decoding time for support recovery in mixture models than previously known methods.

</details>


### [967] [Clipped or Unclipped? Finite-Sample Trade-offs for Averaged SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32962)
*Alexandra Suvorikova,Egor Gladin,Darina Dvinskikh,Artem Agafonov,Mohammad Alkousa,Yuriy Dorn,Vladislav Matyukhin,Alexander Gasnikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在有限条件p阶矩下对裁剪与未裁剪的Polyak-Ruppert平均SGD做有限样本比较，说明梯度裁剪未必提升统计精度，并给出其代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度裁剪常被用于稳定训练，但在重尾噪声下它对平均SGD统计精度的作用尚无明确的有限样本理论刻画，作者希望澄清裁剪是否真正改善收敛精度。

Method: 在有限条件p阶矩（p≥2）假设下，推导裁剪与未裁剪Polyak-Ruppert平均SGD的有限样本偏差界，并通过平衡裁剪偏差与集中性得到重尾修正为对数依赖的界；用一维二次递推验证紧性，并推广到投影凸SGD。

Result: 当p>2时，给出显式精度与置信条件使高斯项主导未裁剪偏差界，故裁剪未必改善主导阶；平衡后重尾修正对逆失败概率为对数而非多项式依赖；p=2时改进主导界的置信依赖。同时证明固定有限阈值在标量高斯二次问题上增大渐近方差，整梯度裁剪在非对称噪声下可移动极限点。

Conclusion: 梯度裁剪并不必然提升平均SGD的统计精度，且在若干情形下带来额外方差或偏差代价；其作用需结合重尾程度与置信要求具体分析。

Abstract: Gradient clipping is widely used to stabilize training, but it need not improve the statistical accuracy of averaged SGD, even under heavy-tailed noise. We derive a finite-sample comparison of clipped and unclipped Polyak-Ruppert averaged SGD under finite conditional $p$-th moments, $p\ge2$. Our main result gives explicit accuracy and confidence conditions under which, for $p>2$, the Gaussian term dominates the unclipped deviation bound, so clipping need not improve its leading order. By balancing clipping bias and concentration, we obtain a bound in which the heavy-tail correction depends logarithmically rather than polynomially on the inverse failure probability. At $p=2$, this improves the confidence dependence of the leading bound. We establish sharpness of the unclipped heavy-tail term through an exact one-dimensional quadratic recursion and extend the comparison to projected convex SGD. We also prove concrete costs of clipping: every fixed finite threshold increases asymptotic variance on a scalar Gaussian quadratic, while whole-gradient clipping can shift the limiting point under asymmetric noise.

</details>


### [968] [Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings for Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32178)
*Jiaqing Xie,Yuxin Wang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AW-RoPE，将旋转变换置于边上并对所有游走路径求和，使注意力能区分节点间的连接路径；含精确（线性求解）与稀疏（有限深度截断）两变体，理论与实验均验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图旋转位置编码将每个节点的旋转由谱坐标决定，两节点间的旋转因子仅依赖端点，无法区分连接它们的不同路径，缺乏对图结构的路径感知能力。

Method: 将旋转放在边上，沿所有游走路径传输并求和特征，使不同路径的贡献可相互增强或抵消；精确变体通过可微线性求解计算完整求和，稀疏变体按有限深度截断；两者作用于投影后的 query/key，稀疏递推还可增强消息传递网络。

Result: 证明了固定输入与参数下的前向及参数导数截断界。五个合成任务上 nRMSE 相较最强基线降低 15%–58%；在超像素、肽与 OGB 真实基准上，稀疏变体配合 Performer 核在所有数据集、配合 GIN 在 13 个数据集中的 12 个取得最佳均值。

Conclusion: AW-RoPE 能区分仅由两端点连接方式决定的路径，而节点级旋转编码无法做到，验证了边级游走旋转建模对图注意力的优势。

Abstract: Rotary position encodings make attention sensitive to relative position, but extending them to graphs requires choosing how graph structure enters the rotation. Previous works assign each node a rotation from spectral coordinates, so the rotary factor between two nodes depends only on their endpoints and cannot distinguish the routes connecting them. We introduce \textit{Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings} (AW-RoPE), which place the rotations on edges and sum the transported features over all walks, so contributions along different routes can reinforce or cancel. An exact variant evaluates the complete sum by a differentiable linear solve, and a sparse variant truncates it at a finite depth. We prove forward and parameter-derivative truncation bounds at fixed inputs and parameters. Both variants act on projected queries and keys, and the sparse recurrence also augments message-passing networks. Across five synthetic tasks both variants reduce nRMSE by $15$--$58\%$ relative to the strongest baseline, and on real superpixel, peptide and OGB benchmarks the sparse recurrence attains the best mean on every dataset with Performer kernels and on twelve of thirteen datasets with GIN. Analysis shows that AW-RoPE can distinguish routes whose only cue is how two endpoints are connected, while node-wise rotary encodings cannot.

</details>


### [969] [Deep Weighted Bellman Residual Minimization for $Q^*$ Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34593)
*Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Cheng Yuan,Chen Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种加权的Bellman残差最小化框架，通过密度比加权整合专家示范与行为数据，解决离线强化学习中的分布偏移、Q值高估和样本利用率低问题，并给出收敛率理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习中的预收集数据集面临分布偏移、Q值高估和样本利用效率低等挑战，现有理论分析常依赖较强的完整性假设。

Method: 提出加权Bellman残差最小化框架，引入密度比加权，有效融合专家示范与行为数据；权重方案突破了深度强化学习理论分析中常用的完整性假设。

Result: 建立了密度比估计的紧收敛率，并推导了所得深度Q*估计器超额风险的收敛率；大量实验表明，相比现有方法在数值性能和策略泛化上有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该方法为合理利用专家示范提供了具体指导，在理论和实证上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation is a foundational component of offline reinforcement learning, aiming to assess and optimize policy performance using pre-collected datasets. However, such datasets often suffer from pronounced challenges, including distribution shift, $Q$-value overestimation, and low sample utilization efficiency. To address these issues, this paper introduces a weighted Bellman residual minimization framework that incorporates density ratio weighting by effectively integrating expert demonstrations with behavioral data. The proposed weighting scheme departs from the conventional completeness assumption commonly imposed in the theoretical analysis of deep reinforcement learning. We establish a sharp convergence rate for density ratio estimation and derive the convergence rate for the excess risk of resulting deep $Q^*$ estimator. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, our method achieves significant improvements in numerical performance and policy generalization, providing specific guidance for the rational utilization of expert demonstrations.

</details>


### [970] [ILP-BO: Integer Linear Programming-Based Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33131)
*Hyakka Nakada,Shu Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ILP-BO，一种将离散域上的核代理优化转化为整数线性规划(ILP)问题的准贝叶斯优化框架，从而获得带最优性证书的候选选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准黑箱优化（如贝叶斯优化）通过非线性优化或启发式搜索来优化采集准则，无法保证候选选择的全局最优性，缺乏透明度。

Method: 引入二元one-hot辅助变量，在有限离散距离层级上精确表示非线性核函数，将非线性代理转化为线性目标加线性约束与二元变量；为兼顾探索，引入基于汉明距离的边界以排除已观测点邻域；对多种标准核推导公式，并根据二进制搜索空间测度得出汉明距离阈值的解析上界。

Result: 所得候选选择问题可由整数规划求解器求解并给出最优性证书；在合成与离散优化基准上，ILP-BO与实用贝叶斯优化方法相比具有竞争力的优化性能。

Conclusion: ILP-BO可作为高透明度的黑箱优化框架，在保证候选选择最优性的同时保持良好优化性能。

Abstract: Black-box Optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for optimizing expensive objective functions or unknown functions with a limited number of evaluations. A central step of standard BO such as Bayesian optimization is the optimization of a surrogate-based acquisition criterion, which is commonly performed using nonlinear optimization or heuristic search. Therefore, conventional black-box optimization generally does not guarantee global optimality in candidate selection. In this study, we propose Integer Linear Programming-based Black-box Optimization (ILP-BO), a quasi-Bayesian optimization framework that transforms kernel-based surrogate optimization over discrete domains into an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem. The key idea is to represent nonlinear kernel functions exactly on finite discrete distance levels by introducing binary one-hot auxiliary variables. This transformation converts the nonlinear surrogate into a linear objective with linear constraints and binary variables. To incorporate exploration while preserving the linear structure, we further introduce a Hamming-distance margin that excludes neighborhoods around previously observed points. We derive the proposed formulation for several standard kernels and obtain an analytical upper bound on the Hamming-distance threshold based on the measure in the binary search space. The resulting candidate-selection problem can be solved by integer programming solvers with certificates of optimality. Thus, our methodology has the potential to serve as a highly transparent black-box optimization framework. Experiments on synthetic and discrete optimization benchmarks show that ILP-BO achieves competitive optimization performance compared with practical Bayesian optimization methods.

</details>


### [971] [Rethinking Cross-Channel Importance in Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32187)
*Yong-Hoon Choi,Kwang-Hyun Park,Youngjin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示多变量时间序列预测中"统计相关"、"预测有用"与"模型实际使用"的跨通道重要性并不等同（related ≠ useful ≠ used），并基于预测步长自适应选择源通道的证据提出后验支持方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨通道建模常将统计相关、预测有用和被训练模型实际使用的通道视为同一"重要性"，但作者认为这些概念未必重合，需要区分并验证。

Method: 将跨通道依赖结构按不同未来步长分解，进行步长自适应的源通道选择；在受控 Ridge 预测器与匹配的非线性预测器上测试，并将相同逻辑施加于 iTransformer；同时通过功能干预对比 iTransformer、TimesNet、TimeMixer 的源依赖排序；最后提出有界后验支持方法作用于冻结的通道独立预测器。

Result: 步长自适应源选择在32个"数据集-预测长度"条件中21个优于受控 Ridge 预测器，平均增益5.16%，并可迁移至匹配非线性预测器；但对 iTransformer 仅有20个中11个胜出、平均增益0.208%，且与受控增益对齐度低。功能干预显示强预测器确实使用跨通道信息，但源依赖排序与受控效用及彼此之间一致性都很低。有界后验支持在16个"数据集-步长"条件中12个改善冻结的通道独立预测器，提升的 bootstrap 区间为正。

Conclusion: 跨通道重要性应相对具体预测机制与所定义的问题来解释：相关、有用与实际使用三者并不等同。

Abstract: Cross-channel modeling is central to multivariate time-series forecasting, yet channels that are statistically related, predictively useful, and actually used by a trained forecaster are often treated as if they defined the same notion of importance. We show that they need not coincide. Cross-channel dependency structures change substantially across future offsets, and horizon-adaptive source selection improves a controlled Ridge predictor in 21 of 32 dataset--prediction-length conditions, with a mean gain of $5.16\%$. This selected-set signal also transfers to a matched nonlinear predictor. Yet imposing the same horizon-specific source logic on iTransformer yields only 11 of 20 wins and a mean gain of $0.208\%$, with little alignment between controlled and neural gains. Functional interventions further show that strong forecasters use cross-channel information, while their source-reliance rankings agree little with controlled utility or with one another across iTransformer, TimesNet, and a cross-channel TimeMixer. As a constructive consequence, bounded post-hoc support improves a frozen channel-independent forecaster in 12 of 16 dataset--horizon conditions, with a positive aggregate bootstrap interval. Cross-channel importance should therefore be interpreted relative to the forecasting mechanism and question that define it: related $\neq$ useful $\neq$ used.

</details>


### [972] [Uniform Race: Parameter-Free Approximate Rejection Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34639)
*Seiyun Shin,Juhyeong Pang,Kwang-Sung Jun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免参数采样算法 Uniform Race (UR)，通过将重要性权重除以独立均匀随机变量形成分数并选最大者，可事后达到最佳 RS 误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似拒绝采样 (RS) 的最优接受阈值 M 依赖于 (π, μ) 的性质，而这些通常无法从观测样本中获得。因此需要一种无需输入 M 即可取得最佳 RS 保证的方法。

Method: 基于重要性权重（目标与提议概率比）的 Uniform Race：将每个观测权重除以独立均匀随机变量得到分数，返回分数最大的候选。属于免参数算法。

Result: 对任意预算 N，其全变差误差同时满足任意固定阈值 M 的 RS 上界，达到事后最优；刻画了在以最大分数为条件的输出分布及恰为目标 π 的条件；误差不大于 Rohatgi 等 (2025) 的预算校准 RS 和 SIR，且存在误差随 N 指数级更小的实例；给出唯一性条件；LLM 数学推理测试时扩展实验验证理论并保持竞争力。

Conclusion: Uniform Race 无需阈值选择即可达到最佳 RS 保证，误差不劣于基线甚至指数级更优，且在特定条件下选择概率唯一，实验验证其有效性。

Abstract: We study approximate sampling: given $N$ independent samples from a proposal distribution $μ$, the goal is to select one whose distribution is close to a target $π$ specified only up to a normalizing constant. Block and Polyanskiy (2023) provide finite budget error bounds for approximate rejection sampling (RS) as a function of the acceptance threshold $M$. The threshold $M$ giving the smallest bound, however, depends on properties of $(π,μ)$ that are typically unavailable from the observed sample. This raises a natural question: Can one attain the best RS guarantee without taking $M$ as input? We answer affirmatively by proposing a parameter-free sampling algorithm called uniform race (UR), based on importance weights, which are ratios of target to proposal probabilities (or densities). It divides each observed weight by an independent uniform random variable to form a score and returns the candidate with the largest score. For every budget $N$, its total variation error satisfies the RS upper bound for every fixed threshold $M$ simultaneously, thereby achieving the best such bound in hindsight. We also characterize its output distribution conditional on the largest score, identifying when it is exactly the target $π$. Uniform race has no larger total variation error than a natural budget-calibrated RS derived from Rohatgi et al. (2025) and sampling importance resampling (SIR). In particular, we exhibit instances where UR's error is exponentially smaller in $N$ than that of either baseline. Furthermore, we establish conditions under which attaining this RS guarantee for every $(π,μ)$ uniquely determines the selection probabilities as those of UR. Finally, test-time scaling experiments on LLM math-reasoning tasks corroborate the theoretical comparisons and demonstrate that UR remains competitive in ground-truth accuracy without requiring threshold selection.

</details>


### [973] [Convergence of Practical Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33152)
*Haonan Wang,Yu Wu,Minghui Liwang,Xinlei Yi,Yiguang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对实用Muon优化器进行理论分析，联合考虑Newton-Schulz迭代系数与解耦权重衰减，首次给出随机非凸收敛保证，速率为O(T^{-1/4})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon在大规模神经网络训练中有望替代AdamW，但现有理论分析常简化或忽略两个关键组件：经验调参的Newton-Schulz多项式系数(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)与解耦权重衰减，因此实用Muon的理论理解仍不完整。

Method: 将实用Muon解释为对原始损失进行右预条件优化，并配以随接近平稳点而消失的动态加权ℓ2正则项，从而保证优化目标仍为原始目标；据此建立随机非凸收敛分析。

Result: 首次给出实用Muon在随机非凸设定下的收敛保证，梯度期望Frobenius范数达到O(T^{-1/4})的收敛速率，相较已知最优AdamW收敛速率的维度依赖改进了√d倍（T为迭代轮数，d为参数维度）；实验支持理论结果。

Conclusion: 该工作为实用Muon提供了优化解释与收敛保证，同时涵盖Newton-Schulz迭代与解耦权重衰减两组件，理论上优于AdamW的维度依赖，并获得实验验证。

Abstract: Muon is emerging as a promising alternative to AdamW for large-scale neural network training, yet theoretical understanding of its practical implementation remains incomplete, as existing analyses often simplify or omit two key components: (i) practical Newton--Schulz iterations with empirically tuned polynomial coefficients $(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)$; and (ii) decoupled weight decay for regularization. In this paper, we provide an optimization interpretation and establish convergence for practical Muon, jointly accounting for both components. Specifically, we interpret practical Muon as right-preconditioned optimization of the original loss with a dynamic weighted $\ell_2$ regularizer that vanishes as stationarity is approached, so that the optimization target remains the original objective. We then establish, to our best knowledge, the first convergence guarantee for practical Muon in the stochastic nonconvex setting, with an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate in terms of the expected Frobenius norm of the gradient, improving the dimension dependence of the best known AdamW's convergence rate by a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $T$ is the iteration horizon and $d$ is the parameter dimension. Experiments further support the theoretical convergence results.

</details>


### [974] [HM-ROUTER: Joint Model and Harness Routing for Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32213)
*Hao Mark Chen,Royson Lee,Yasuyuki Okoshi,Dimitris Anastasiou,Wayne Luk,Hongxiang Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HM-Router，一种联合选择模型与执行框架（harness）的路由方法，利用CP张量分解式的交互项捕捉二者针对查询的兼容性，实现未见组合的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent性能同时取决于底层模型与管理工具使用/执行的harness，选择合适组合需考虑二者兼容性；但训练样本可能只覆盖不断增长的组合空间中的一小部分子集。

Method: 学习跨路由共享的模型与harness独立表示，并引入受canonical polyadic (CP)张量分解启发的交互项来建模兼容性随查询的变化；共享机制使已观测组合的训练样本能推断未观测组合。构建了涵盖12个公开agent基准、293条路由、73个模型、25个harness的基准。

Result: 平均路由准确率超最强学习基线7.3个百分点；在六基准子集的全部七个成本预算下均领先；当90%路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观测组合相比限制于已观测路由使归一化准确率提升15.8个百分点；并展现出对新路由/组件的训练样本效率及对未见过基准的泛化能力。

Conclusion: HM-Router通过共享表示与交互项有效解决模型-harness组合路由问题，在准确率、成本效率、样本效率和泛化性上均表现优异，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Agent performance depends on both the underlying model and the harness that manages its tool use and execution. Selecting a suitable pair requires accounting for their compatibility, yet training samples may cover only a subset of the growing combination space. We introduce HM-Router, a routing method that jointly selects a model and harness for each query. It learns separate model and harness representations shared across routes, with an interaction term inspired by canonical polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition to capture how their compatibility varies with the query. This sharing allows training samples from observed pairs to inform predictions for unobserved combinations. We curate a benchmark from 12 public agent benchmarks, covering 293 routes, 73 models, and 25 harnesses. HM-Router exceeds the strongest evaluated learned baseline by 7.3 percentage points in mean routing accuracy and leads at all seven evaluated cost budgets on the six-benchmark subset. When 90% of routes have their training outcomes withheld, allowing unobserved combinations improves normalized accuracy by 15.8 points over restricting the same router to observed routes. HM-Router has also demonstrated training sample efficiency for new routes and components and generalization to unseen benchmarks. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router.

</details>


### [975] [Fast Learning Rate Transfer in Shallow Linear Networks at Growing Training Horizons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35029)
*Mana Sakai,Masaaki Imaizumi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究宽度与训练时长同时增长时的快速学习率迁移条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽度上的超参数迁移可降低大网络调参成本，但训练时长随宽度增长时迁移行为尚不清楚。基于快速超参数迁移框架，探究增长时长情形下快速迁移的条件。

Method: 研究单隐藏矩阵浅层线性网络，用全批量梯度下降训练；在额外谱假设下分析 n,T→∞ 的学习率迁移。

Result: （i）T=o(√n) 时证明快速学习率迁移；（ii）用有限宽扰动尺度、损失及其学习率导数的一阶敏感性、局部损失曲率刻画迁移率；（iii）给出最优学习率与优化损失的极限分布，由数据 Gram 矩阵极值特征值涨落支配。

Conclusion: 谱结构与局部损失敏感性共同决定增长时长下的学习率迁移。

Abstract: Hyperparameter transfer across model width can substantially reduce the cost of tuning large neural networks, but its behavior when the training horizon grows with width is not fully understood. Building on the framework of fast hyperparameter transfer (Ghosh et al., 2026), which formalizes when transfer is effective, we investigate conditions that ensure fast transfer in the growing-horizon regime. Specifically, we study learning-rate transfer in a shallow linear network with a single trainable hidden matrix, trained by full-batch gradient descent. Under additional spectral assumptions, our main results are threefold. (i) We prove fast learning-rate transfer as $n,T\to\infty$ whenever $T=o(\sqrt{n})$. (ii) We characterize the transfer rates through the finite-width perturbation scale, the first-order sensitivities of the loss and its learning-rate derivative to finite-width perturbations, and the local loss curvature. (iii) We derive limiting distributions for the optimal learning rate and optimized loss, governed by fluctuations associated with the extreme eigenvalues of the data Gram matrix. These results clarify how spectral structure and local loss sensitivities govern learning-rate transfer at growing horizons.

</details>


### [976] [The Price of Locality: Why Forward-Forward Underperforms Backpropagation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33240)
*Zhaoxian Wu,Haichuan Liu,Tianyi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文诊断了前向-前向算法(FFA)相比反向传播(BP)的性能差距来源：一是并发局部更新导致的优化误差下限，二是局部更新机制引起的层表示几何坍塌(表示相似度核随深度指数收缩至秩一)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FFA用逐层局部对比目标替代反向传播，省去反向传递和中间激活存储，但与BP存在持续性能差距且随深度加剧。论文旨在从优化与表示两方面诊断这一差距的结构性成因。

Method: 理论分析：证明FFA每层损失满足Polyak–Lojasiewicz不等式；分析同步层更新导致的层间表示分布漂移；分析层表示成对相似度核随深度的指数收缩(秩一坍塌)。

Result: 优化侧：各层损失满足PL不等式，但同步更新造成层间表示分布漂移，使每层在移动的输入分布上优化，产生误差下限；表示侧：相似度核随深度指数收缩至秩一，导致逐层误差信号多样性崩塌，使FFA有效学习容量被限制且与深度无关；而BP的链式法则信号保持逐层多样性，容量随深度增长。

Conclusion: FFA的性能瓶颈源于并发局部更新带来的优化误差下限和表示几何坍塌，二者共同限制了其有效学习容量，使其难以随深度扩展，从根本上解释了与BP的差距。

Abstract: The Forward-Forward Algorithm (FFA) replaces backpropagation (BP) with layer-wise local contrastive objectives, eliminating the backward pass and the need to retain intermediate activations, yet suffers a persistent performance gap with BP that worsens with depth. This paper diagnoses two structural failure modes: an optimization floor arising from concurrent local updates; and a geometric collapse of layer representations driven by the local update mechanism. On the optimization side, we prove that the FFA loss satisfies the Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality at each layer; however, simultaneous layer updates induce inter-layer representation-distribution drift, so each layer optimizes against a moving input distribution and incurs an error floor. On the representational side, the pairwise similarity kernel of layer representations contracts exponentially toward rank one as depth increases, collapsing the diversity of per-layer error signals. This collapse bounds FFA's effective learning capacity, which measures the diversity of gradient information across layers, independently of depth, whereas BP's chain-rule signal preserves per-layer diversity, yielding a capacity that scales with depth.

</details>


### [977] [DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32215)
*Dwipam Katariya,Thomas Caputo,Akshat Shreemali,Juan Manuel Origgi,Nikita Seleznev,Pranab Mohanty,Kalanand Mishra,Nam Nguyen,James Montgomery*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DP-Rec 提出动态潜在分块架构，用对比熵惊讶度分割序列，实现高效的推荐建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer在推荐中固定速率计算，对每个交互分配相同算力，长序列开销大且对行为噪声敏感；常用压缩/截断方法有损，限制长历史利用。

Method: 受Byte Latent Transformer启发，从item级转向patch级建模：用对比熵惊讶度分割交互序列识别信息边界，轻量patch编码器将段压缩为动态潜在行为向量，再由较大latent transformer处理并解码做下一项预测。

Result: 在受限算力下，DP-Rec能有效扩展到长序列，在效率-精度权衡上优于非压缩和固定大小压缩基线。

Conclusion: 动态潜在分块可提升长序列推荐的效率与精度平衡。

Abstract: Transformers have redefined sequential recommendation by effectively modeling dynamic user behaviors and long-range dependencies. However, they remain inherently inefficient: standard architectures operate at a fixed rate, allocating comparable computation to every item in a user's history regardless of its information content. This leads to prohibitive computational overhead on long sequences and increased sensitivity to behavioral noise. To address this, practitioners often resort to lossy sequence compression, staged modeling, or truncation. This limits the model's ability to leverage the full context of long histories during inference. Inspired by the recent success of Byte Latent Transformer, we propose DP-Rec, a dynamic latent patching architecture for recommendation. DP-Rec shifts from item-level modeling to patch-level modeling by segmenting interaction sequences using contrastive entropy surprise to identify informative behavioral boundaries. A lightweight patch encoder compresses these temporally contextualized segments into a reduced set of dynamic latent behavior vectors, which are then processed by a larger latent transformer and decoded for next-item prediction. Extensive experiments show that, under constrained computational budgets, DP-Rec scales effectively to long sequences and achieves a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off over both non-compressed and fixed-size compression baselines.

</details>


### [978] [Universality and Generalization of Causal Transformers Across Context Lengths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35055)
*Takashi Furuya,Maarten V. de Hoop,Gabriel Peyré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究单个掩码Transformer能否用长度无关参数统一逼近任意长度序列的因果token映射，跨越不同采样分辨率。用Hölder连续模刻画可逼近的因果族，并给出无穷长度平均场极限与泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer表达力结果通常针对每个固定序列长度选择不同网络，无法说明单一网络能否在任意长度（不同采样分辨率）上统一逼近因果映射。作者希望在长度无关参数下建立跨分辨率的连续性刻画与统计学习保证。

Method: 将token建模为α-Hölder序列或一般连续模，定义跨分辨率的连续性概念；构造单一掩码Transformer（参数与长度无关）在紧输入类上一致逼近因果族；推广到无穷长度平均场极限，token成为连续曲线，掩码注意力变为因果时间积分；对满足β-光滑稳定性的有界回归目标做定量逼近，分析有界权重Transformer上的经验风险最小化。

Result: 跨分辨率连续性恰刻画了可由单一长度无关Transformer统一逼近的因果族；无穷长度极限下掩码注意力等价因果时间积分；N个iid标注序列上ERM得到均方误差O((loglogN/logN)^{β/(d+2)})，以固定置信度成立，d为token维度，无最大长度因子。物理时间序列实验支持Hölder正则token模型（指数依数据集而异），文本嵌入为对照情形。

Conclusion: 单一掩码Transformer可在长度无关参数下统一逼近满足跨分辨率连续性的因果映射，并有平均场极限与无最大长度因子的泛化界；实验表明物理时间序列符合Hölder正则token模型，而文本嵌入不同，需由原生/密集采样、打乱对照和细化检查界定该经验规律适用范围。

Abstract: Long contexts are central to modern transformer systems, but most expressivity results choose a different network for each fixed sequence length. We study whether one masked transformer can approximate causal token-to-token maps uniformly over sequences of arbitrary length sampling a fixed normalized horizon. To relate sampling resolutions, we model tokens by $α$-Hölder sequences or, more generally, a common modulus of continuity. Our notion of continuity across resolutions characterizes the causal families admitting uniform approximation on these compact input classes by a single transformer with length-independent parameters. The result extends to the infinite-length mean-field limit, where tokens form continuous curves and masked attention becomes a causal time integral. For bounded regression with target maps satisfying a $β$-smooth stability condition defined using regular test functions, quantitative approximation yields a generalization bound: exact empirical risk minimization over suitably sized bounded-weight transformers gives root mean-square prediction error $O((\log\log N/\log N)^{β/(d+2)})$ from $N$ iid labeled sequences. The bound holds at fixed confidence on the same sampling distribution, with $d$ the token dimension and no maximum-length factor. Finally, experiments on physical time series support the Hölder-regular token model at observed scales, with dataset-dependent fitted exponents, whereas text input embeddings provide a contrasting case. Native and dense sampling, shuffled controls, and refinement checks delimit this empirical regularity regime.

</details>


### [979] [CompassPlay: Rewarding the Proposer for Where It Moves the Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32228)
*Sophia Xiao Pu,Ximeng Sun,Jiang Liu,Jialian Wu,Emad Barsoum,Zicheng Liu,William Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CompassPlay 自博弈方法，用梯度对齐奖励生成任务的提议者，无需额外训练求解器即可提升性能与训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自博弈中提议者奖励多基于求解器成功率（难度），但同等难度的任务训练价值不同，难度无法衡量任务对目标能力的贡献。

Method: 通过梯度对齐奖励提议者：奖励那些其求解器损失梯度与代表目标能力的参考任务梯度对齐的任务；基于学习进度的一阶近似，对每个合格任务打分，无需额外求解器训练。

Result: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 编码自博弈中，小外部参考集引导任务生成；相比 AZR 难度奖励，域内编码平均准确率提升 1.5 个百分点，域外数学提升 2.7。Lean4 定理证明中，以少 40% GPU 小时达到难度基线 150 次迭代的累计覆盖。

Conclusion: 以梯度对齐替代难度奖励，能更有效选择高训练价值任务，同时提升性能与训练效率。

Abstract: In self-play, a proposer generates verifiable tasks to train a solver. Proposer rewards often depend on the solver's success rate, but equally difficult tasks can differ in their training value. We introduce CompassPlay, a self-play method that rewards the proposer through gradient alignment. The reward favors tasks whose solver loss gradients align with those of reference tasks representing the target capabilities. It draws on a first-order approximation to learning progress and scores each eligible task without additional solver training. Our experiments show gains in performance and training efficiency. In coding self-play with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, a small external reference set guides task generation. CompassPlay improves average accuracy over AZR's difficulty reward by 1.5 percentage points on in-domain coding and 2.7 on out-of-domain mathematics. In Lean4 theorem proving, CompassPlay matches the difficulty baseline's 150-iteration cumulative coverage with 40\% fewer GPU-hours.

</details>


### [980] [Propagate, Then Sharpen: Post-Hoc Refinement of Frozen Node Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35080)
*Preben Johnsen Bentdal,Nello Blaser,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PtS方法，通过对Potts能量分解（Dirichlet+Gini），在冻结分类器上进行传播与锐化交替，无需特征/参数/梯度即可提升节点分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仅有图结构和冻结模型预测分布的情况下，无需访问节点特征、模型参数或梯度，实现事后分类精度提升。APPNP通过重启传播最小化锚定Dirichlet能量，本文寻求更优替代。

Method: 考虑Potts能量，将其分解为惩罚邻居不一致的Dirichlet项与惩罚节点内犹豫的Gini项。据此提出Propagate, Then Sharpen (PtS)，在类别概率传播与逐节点保质量锐化之间交替，仅引入一个由带标签验证节点选择的超参数。

Result: 在9个同质图上以冻结MLP为主干，PtS相对独立调优的APPNP平均测试精度提升1.71个百分点（干净输入）和3.90（严重高斯特征损坏）；在冻结GCN/GraphSAGE主干上增益减小但仍为正。锐化还大幅缓解深层传播的精度损失：无重启时2到100步精度仅降2.2点，APPNP则降33.8点。

Conclusion: PtS是一种有效的后处理精炼方法，通过Potts能量分解指导的传播-锐化交替，在多种主干和困难条件下稳定优于APPNP。

Abstract: We study post-hoc refinement of frozen node classifiers: given only the graph $G$ and class distributions $Q$ predicted by a frozen model, can we improve accuracy without access to node features, model parameters, or gradients? APPNP answers this by propagating logits with a restart towards the initial predictions, minimizing the anchored Dirichlet energy. Instead, we consider the Potts energy, and decompose it into a Dirichlet term, which penalizes disagreement between neighbouring nodes, and a Gini term, which penalizes indecision within each node. This decomposition motivates Propagate, Then Sharpen (PtS), which alternates between propagation of class probabilities and node-wise, mass-preserving sharpening, with only one additional hyperparameter selected using labelled validation nodes. Across nine homophilic graphs, with a frozen MLP backbone, PtS improves mean test accuracy over independently tuned APPNP by $1.71$ percentage points on clean inputs and $3.90$ under severe Gaussian feature corruption. Gains over APPNP become smaller, but remain positive with frozen GCN and GraphSAGE backbones. Sharpening also removes most of the accuracy loss of deep propagation: on clean inputs without restart, accuracy falls by $2.2$ points between $2$ and $100$ propagation steps under PtS, compared with $33.8$ for APPNP.

</details>


### [981] [Geometric Identification in Predict-Then-Optimize Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33472)
*Jiaxiao Xu,Changhong Mou,Keji Liu,Dinghua Xu,Yeyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了凸SPO+代理的总体风险相等集，给出在中心对称下中心均值类是唯一贝叶斯最优解的条件（每处非零有效位移使旧最优解以正概率离开移位最优面），并区分"面穿越"与"选中oracle不一致"。无对称时需选择平衡加反射穿越才能恢复商报告识别，结论为总体层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策聚焦代理（如SPO+）能在不识别商报告的情况下恢复下游决策，但其风险相等集与均值可识别性的条件尚不清晰，需要刻画何时中心均值类是唯一贝叶斯最优解。

Method: 分析凸SPO+总体风险的相等集：在中心对称假设下给出中心均值类为唯一贝叶斯最小化子的充要条件（每个非零有效位移使旧优化器以正概率离开移位最优面），提供局部强制性量化；无对称时引入选择平衡与反射穿越条件，并推广到条件版本与可测预测器；用闭式机制复现解析恒等式与速率。

Result: 条件将面穿越与选中oracle不一致分离，中心对称下均值可识别；无对称时仅严格穿越不足，需选择平衡加反射穿越。用组合、完整矩阵KuaiRec及能源/存储实验测量预测保真度、移位遗憾与拟合报告几何；已知DGP伴生实验隔离条件均值恢复与穿越。

Conclusion: 结果均为总体层面陈述，不含有限样本报告恢复或通用迁移遗憾保证；伴生DGP实验保留应用几何但未检验原始观测假设。

Abstract: Decision-focused surrogates can recover downstream decisions without identifying the quotient report. We characterize the equality set of the convex Smart Predict-then-Optimize surrogate (SPO+) population risk. Under central symmetry, the centered mean class is the unique Bayes minimizer exactly when every nonzero effective displacement makes the old optimizer leave the shifted optimal face with positive probability. This condition separates face crossing from selected-oracle disagreement and gives quantitative local coercivity. Without symmetry, strict crossing alone need not identify the mean; selection balance with reflected crossing restores quotient-report identification, and conditional versions extend the result to measurable predictors. These are population statements, without finite-sample report-recovery or generic transfer-regret guarantees. Closed-form mechanisms reproduce the analytic identities and rates. Portfolio, complete-matrix KuaiRec, and Energy/Storage studies measure predictive fidelity, shifted regret, and fitted-report geometry. A known data-generating process (DGP) companion retains their application geometries while isolating conditional-mean recovery and crossing, without testing the original observational assumptions.

</details>


### [982] ["Where Can I Trust You?": Boundary-Aware Evaluation of Surrogate Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32230)
*Jackson Eshbaugh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 替代模型的保真度不仅取决于全局一致率，还取决于一致发生的区域（尤其是教师决策边界附近）以及深度模型决策边界的稳定性。近边界一致率显著更低，且能提供超越单一全局分数的信息，但深度教师的决策边界在不同训练运行间并不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 替代模型通常仅通过在整个评测集上与教师模型的一致率来评估，而局部一致性的变化虽被公认存在，其结构与后果却尚不清楚。作者希望探究不一致是否系统性地集中在教师决策边界附近，以及保留这一结构信息是否能超越单一全局分数提供额外价值。

Method: 在多个数据集与多种替代模型类别上进行实验，采用两种识别近边界样本的方法，考察教师决策边界附近的保真度；将一致率按基于置信度定义的区域进行条件化，并在评测集组成变化时预测教师—替代模型的一致情况；同时比较全局与近边界一致率相近的替代模型在针对自身选择的变化下的不同响应；最后分析独立训练的深度教师在预测与边界识别上的一致性。

Result: 在两种近边界识别方法下，教师决策边界附近的保真度均显著低于整体水平；将一致率按置信度区域条件化后，在评测集组成变化时比仅用全局分数更能预测教师—替代模型一致率。然而，在全局和近边界一致率上都相同的替代模型，对基于替代模型自身选择的变化可能反应迥异。此外，独立训练的深度教师虽在多数预测上一致，却会把不同样本识别为近边界。

Conclusion: 替代模型保真度不仅取决于替代模型与教师一致频率，还取决于一致所发生的区域；对深度模型而言，还取决于教师决策边界在不同训练运行间的稳定性。因此，仅用全局一致率评估替代模型是不充分的，近边界结构与边界稳定性应纳入评估考量。

Abstract: Surrogate models are commonly evaluated by how often they agree with their teacher model over an evaluation set. Local variation in this agreement is well known, but its structure and consequences are less clear. We ask whether disagreement is systematically concentrated near the teacher's decision boundary and whether retaining that structure provides information beyond a single global score. Across several datasets and surrogate model classes, we find substantially lower fidelity near teacher decision boundaries under two different methods of identifying near-boundary examples. Moreover, conditioning agreement on confidence-defined regions improves prediction of teacher--surrogate agreement when evaluation-set composition changes, relative to the global score alone. Yet surrogates that agree equally well with the teacher both globally and near the decision boundary can respond very differently to changes selected using the surrogate itself. Finally, we show that independently trained deep teachers can agree on most predictions while identifying different examples as lying near their decision boundaries, complicating the use of those boundaries as stable reference regions for evaluating surrogates. Together, these results show that surrogate fidelity depends not only on how often a surrogate agrees with its teacher, but also on where that agreement holds and, for deep models, how stable the teacher's decision boundary is across training runs.

</details>


### [983] [The cost of useful natural gradient updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33499)
*Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee,Dylan Campbell,Rahul Shome*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在KL预算下如何将自然梯度方向转化为有用（finite）更新，提出信息论与计算复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然梯度方向已知并不足以决定合适的步长；步长选择本身可能承担整个更新成本，且需要的样本与计算资源可能很高。

Method: 构造四状态指数族：共享初始梯度、Fisher信息与自然梯度，但有用步集合可不相交；将问题形式化为KL预算下的有用步判定，分析最坏情况样本复杂度，并证明事件倾斜模型与逻辑族中相关任务的计算困难性；同时给出事件倾斜、阻尼Fisher解、仿射分类器的样本界与KL证书。

Result: 最坏情况样本复杂度为Θ(log(1/δ)/(pε²))；在事件倾斜模型返回有用步为NP-hard；恢复单位自然梯度至常数误差即使二参数logistic族且Fisher条件数≤3也NP-hard；实验显示冻结特征分类头在采样KL边界约一半成功，10% KL边际可使联合成功率>93%（KL预算0.01）。

Conclusion: 仅知道移动方向不够，移动多远可能决定更新的全部代价；自然梯度的有限步实现需要额外样本与计算、并可能不可行。

Abstract: What information is needed to turn a natural-gradient direction into a useful finite update? Under a population Kullback-Leibler (KL) budget, we call a step useful if it is feasible and loses at most a fraction $\varepsilon$ of the best feasible gain along the direction. We construct a four-state exponential family whose laws share their initial gradient, scalar Fisher information and natural gradient, yet two laws have disjoint useful-step sets. With these quantities supplied exactly and the law otherwise known only through draws, the family's worst-case sample complexity is $Θ(\log(1/δ)/(p\varepsilon^2))$ for small $\varepsilon$, where $p$ scales rare-state probabilities and $δ$ is the failure probability. The budget is fixed and the optimal gain stays bounded away from zero, so the step length, not the direction, carries this cost. For succinctly described event-tilt models, returning a useful step is NP-hard even with the exact natural gradient and efficient exact sampling. Recovering the unit natural gradient to constant error is also NP-hard even in a two-parameter logistic family with Fisher condition number at most 3. We also give matching sample bounds for event tilts, sample bounds for damped Fisher solves and a population-KL certificate for affine classifiers. In frozen-feature classifier heads, stopping at a sampled KL boundary succeeds in about half of the trials, and a 10% KL margin raises joint success above 93% at a KL budget of 0.01. Thus, knowing where to move is not enough: how far to move can carry an update's entire cost.

</details>


### [984] [Arithmetic Simplicity in Stochastic Gradient Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32240)
*Bin Fu,Pengfei Gu,Jose Nunez,Fabian Vazquez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将AdaGrad、Adam和AdamW转化为"算术简单"的梯度下降方法，使其仅使用加、减、乘和除以2的幂次等操作，便于芯片实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统梯度下降方法（如Adam、AdamW）包含复杂运算，不利于芯片硬件实现。作者希望设计仅用简单算术操作即可实现的优化算法，以降低硬件实现难度。

Method: 将Adam/AdamW中的分母s转化为静态形式s=S(T)（T为迭代次数，S(T)为固定函数），从而得到算术简单的静态版本；并给出静态Adam的收敛性分析。

Result: 成功将AdaGrad、Adam和AdamW转化为算术简单形式，并给出了静态Adam的收敛性分析结果。

Conclusion: 算术简单的梯度方法易于芯片设计实现；通过将自适应方法静态化（s=S(T)），可在保持收敛性的同时实现硬件友好。

Abstract: A gradient descent method is arithmetically simple if the operations are limited to $+,-, \times$, and division $x/2^t$ with integer $t$. An arthmetically simple gradient method is easy to implement in chip design. We show how to transform AdaGrad, Adam, and AdamW into arithmetically simple.
  AdamW is based on the recursion $x_{t+1}=(1-λη)x_t-\frac{η}{s}m_t$ and Adam is the special case of AdamW with $λ=0$. We transform them into a static case with $s=S(T)$, where $T$ is the number of iterations, and $S(T)$ is a fixed function. The convergence analysis is given for a static Adam, which is also arithmetically simple.

</details>


### [985] [Universal Approximation of Measure-to-Measure Operators by Pushforwards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35483)
*Takashi Furuya,Nicholas H. Nelsen,Frank Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究measure-dependent pushforward模型的普适逼近性，给出原子输入下失败的反例与绝对连续紧族上的Wasserstein逼近定理，并推广至transformer与cross-attention架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多学习任务需将输入分布映射到输出分布，pushforward模型（含measure-theoretic transformer）是自然建模方式，但其能否逼近任意连续measure-to-measure算子尚不清楚，需明确普适逼近成立的条件与边界。

Method: 先构造反例说明允许原子输入时普适逼近失败；再引入uniform level set condition（要求存在连续measure-dependent标量化，其收缩水平集邻域在输入族上质量一致趋于零），在满足该条件的紧族上证明任何有限p阶矩的连续算子可被连续measure-dependent pushforward在p-Wasserstein距离下一致逼近。

Result: 原子输入下存在分裂/重分配原子质量的连续算子无法被确定性pushforward任意逼近；在满足uniform level set condition的紧族（如绝对连续测度的紧族）上建立Wasserstein一致逼近定理；结合已有measure-dependent in-context map逼近结果，得到measure-theoretic transformer的普适逼近；并推广到连续变化源测度，得到与cross-attention密切相关的pushforward模型普适性。

Conclusion: pushforward模型的普适逼近依赖于输入族的结构条件，uniform level set condition刻画了关键充分条件；该框架统一解释了transformer类与cross-attention类模型的表达力。

Abstract: Many learning tasks map an input distribution to an output distribution.
