A natural way to model such an operator is to transform each input sample using a continuous function that may depend on the entire input distribution, and then take the distribution of the transformed samples. This defines a measure-dependent pushforward model and includes measure-theoretic formulations of transformers. We ask when such models can approximate arbitrary continuous operators between spaces of probability measures. We first show that universal approximation fails when atomic inputs are allowed: some continuous measure-to-measure operators that split or redistribute atomic mass cannot be approximated arbitrarily well by deterministic pushforward models. We then introduce the uniform level set condition, which requires a continuous measure-dependent scalarization whose shrinking level set neighborhoods carry uniformly vanishing mass over the input family. This condition is satisfied, in particular, by compact families of absolutely continuous measures. On every compact family satisfying this condition, we prove that any continuous measure-to-measure operator with outputs of finite $p$-th moment can be uniformly approximated, in the $p$-Wasserstein distance, by continuous measure-dependent pushforwards. Combining our theorem with existing approximation results for measure-dependent in-context maps yields universal approximation by measure-theoretic transformers. We also extend the framework to continuously-varying source measures, yielding a corresponding universality result for a class of pushforward models that are closely aligned with cross-attention architectures.

</details>


### [986] [dOPT: Differentiating Conic Optimization via Geometric Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33828)
*Fengyu Yang,Connor W. Magoon,Tyler Watts,Shahar Z. Kovalsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: dOPT是一个求解器无关的框架，通过将一般锥优化问题在原始-对偶解处约简为等约束二次规划，实现高效的一阶灵敏度求导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化层需要将结构化约束和决策问题嵌入学习系统，而通过一般锥规划进行反向求导非常困难。

Method: 不直接微分完整锥形式，而是在计算得到的原始-对偶解处将问题约简为等约束QP，保留参考解及其一阶灵敏度，捕捉与微分相关的局部一阶和二阶锥几何，并在奇异处仍保持良定义；求解导数只需一次对称线性求解，且独立于前向求解器。作者推导了凸NLP、QP、SOCP和SDP的显式约简。

Result: 数值实验验证了所计算的梯度，并显示反向传播的可扩展性良好，随问题规模增大相比现有可微锥优化方法有显著加速。

Conclusion: dOPT提供了一种求解器无关、高效且鲁棒的可微锥优化框架，能广泛适用于凸NLP/QP/SOCP/SDP。

Abstract: Optimization layers enable the incorporation of structured constraints and decision problems into learning systems. Training such systems requires differentiating through the embedded optimization problem, which can be challenging for general conic programs. We introduce dOPT, a solver-agnostic framework that, rather than differentiating the full conic formulation, reduces it at a computed primal-dual solution to an equality-constrained quadratic program that preserves the reference solution and its first-order sensitivity. The reduction captures the local first- and second-order conic geometry relevant to differentiation and remains well defined at singular configurations. Computing solution derivatives then requires a single symmetric linear solve, independently of the forward solver. We derive explicit reductions for convex NLPs, QPs, SOCPs, and SDPs. Numerical experiments validate the computed gradients and show favorable backward-pass scalability, with substantial speedups over existing differentiable conic optimization methods as problem size increases.

</details>


### [987] [Anytime-Valid LLM Leaderboards via Benchmark-weighted and Block-Factorized e-Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32248)
*Hongfu Gao,Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Bingyi Jing,Zhou Wang,Yiming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BB-EDGE框架，将LLM排行榜建模为有向图，用e-process对成对均值优势做任意时刻有效的FWER控制认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM排行榜按固定基准的平均性能排名，但跨运行的评估波动可能产生无依据的模型优越性结论，排行榜更新更放大此风险。

Method: 对每个方向构造经验Bernstein e-process：按协议定义的block分解证据，并以block权重分配stakes；再对多个e-process应用direct e-Holm，把方向性优势认证为边。理论上刻画异质基准均值零假设下权重成比例的线性stakes，并在任意块内及跨对依赖下证明任意时刻FWER控制。同时支持Top-k认证与同时排名区间。

Result: 在合成数据和四个真实基准上的大量实验表明，BB-EDGE在保持任意时刻FWER控制的同时具有高效率。

Conclusion: BB-EDGE为LLM排行榜提供有原则的、可随时更新且统计有效的成对优势认证框架。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) leaderboards compare model capabilities by ranking models according to their mean performance on fixed benchmarks. However, variability in evaluation outcomes across runs may produce unsupported claims of model superiority on the benchmark, a risk compounded by leaderboard updates. In this paper, we propose BB-EDGE (Benchmark-Weighted and Block-Factorized e-processes for Directed Graph Evaluation), a principled framework that represents an LLM leaderboard as a directed graph whose edges certify pairwise mean-performance advantages, with anytime-valid family-wise error rate (FWER) control. Concretely, for each direction, BB-EDGE constructs an empirical-Bernstein e-process by factorizing evidence over protocol-defined blocks and assigning stakes proportional to the corresponding block weights, then applies direct e-Holm across these $e$-processes to certify directional advantages as edges. Theoretically, we characterize weight-proportional linear stakes under heterogeneous benchmark-average nulls and prove anytime FWER control under arbitrary within-block and cross-pair dependence. BB-EDGE further supports anytime-valid Top-$k$ certification and simultaneous rank intervals. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and four real-world benchmarks demonstrate that BB-EDGE maintains anytime FWER control while achieving high efficiency.

</details>


### [988] [Simplex Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35553)
*Justin Deschenaux,Alexandre Galashov,Andrew Campbell,Li Kevin Wenliang,James Thornton,Arnaud Doucet,Valentin De Bortoli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SDM将扩散过程提升到概率单纯形以建模离散数据的类别信念，避免中间采样导致的信息坍缩，在文本与代码生成上取得有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在中间步骤通过类别采样丢弃不确定性（信息坍缩），无法像连续扩散那样逐步精化信念状态。

Method: 在概率单纯形上定义扩散过程来表示类别信念；设计具有闭式反向转移的概率路径，用简单交叉熵损失训练；引入可调随机性的DDIM式采样器。

Result: OpenWebText上64步采样达17.0 GenPPL、5.46 unigram entropy，接近真实验证数据；无SC情况下代码生成TinyGSM 49.0% vs 45.8%；蒸馏到8步解决GSM8K 32.1%，超过128步蒸馏离散扩散的21.4%。

Conclusion: 通过在单纯形上携带不确定性，SDM缓解信息坍缩，在文本和代码生成上优于掩码/均匀扩散基线，且采样步数更少。

Abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling for continuous data through the gradual refinement of a belief state. This iterative refinement has not yet carried over to discrete diffusion models, which discard uncertainty at intermediate steps through categorical sampling (information collapse). We propose Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs), a framework that lifts the diffusion process to the probability simplex to represent beliefs over categories. SDMs admit probability paths with closed-form reverse transitions and can be trained with a simple cross-entropy loss. Contrary to earlier proposals such as Dirichlet Flow Matching which requires integrating an ordinary differential equation, we introduce a DDIM-like sampler with a tunable level of stochasticity. Because SDMs operate on samples on the simplex, they can carry uncertainty across denoising steps, which mitigates information collapse. On OpenWebText, SDMs are competitive with strong Discrete Diffusion baselines, achieving $17.0$ GenPPL at $5.46$ unigram entropy in 64 sampling steps, close to real validation data. Even without Self-Conditioning (SC), SDMs outperform masked and uniform diffusion (with SC or predictor-corrector sampling) on code generation (TinyGSM, $T=0.1$; $49.0\%$ vs. $45.8\%$). Distilled down to 8 steps, SDMs solve $32.1\%$ of GSM8K problems, more than distilled Discrete Diffusion models with 128 steps ($21.4\%$).

</details>


### [989] [Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34025)
*Millend Roy,Soham Samal,Ivan Zelich,Krzysztof Marcin Choromanski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STAD-TFIs，一类近线性算法，利用树结构分解与2D FFT高效积分树上的张量场，加速Optimal Transport等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效积分定义在树上的、带距离依赖核的通用张量场是一个挑战，现有TFI方法计算效率有限，需要利用树的结构信息来提升效率。

Method: 通过围绕路径主干和单顶点分割子的分解来利用树的底层结构，并使用二维快速傅里叶变换联合计算交互。

Result: 在合成树上速度测试、真实网格上基于Sinkhorn的Optimal Transport加速松弛、以及视觉任务的Topological Attention Transformers上进行了详尽实证评估，实现了更高计算效率。

Conclusion: 首次展示可通过快速TFI方法得到高效准确的地测地Sinkhorn Optimal Transport松弛解。

Abstract: We present a new class of near-linear algorithms for efficiently integrating general tensor fields defined on trees with distance dependent kernels, the Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators (STAD-TFIs). STAD-TFIs exploit the tree's underlying structure through decompositions built around path backbones and single vertex separators, and use two-dimensional fast Fourier transforms to compute interactions jointly. By exploiting this structural information, STAD-TFIs achieve more computationally efficient integration than their regular efficient tree field integrators (TFI) counterparts. We provide a detailed theoretical analysis of our proposed approach and complement it with an exhaustive empirical evaluation, ranging from speed tests on synthetic trees, through accelerated Sinkhorn-based relaxations of the Optimal Transport algorithms on real meshes, to Topological Attention Transformers for vision tasks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide some of the first results showing that efficient to compute and accurate relaxations of the geodesic Sinkhorn-based solutions of the Optimal Transport problem can be derived by applying fast TFI methods.

</details>


### [990] [Representation Editing for Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32263)
*Longfei Huang,Xiangyu Wu,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIRE，一种基于表征工程的多模态测试时自适应方法，通过直接编辑单模态编码器的中间表征来应对分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态TTA方法主要调整融合特征来弥合源-目标差距，缺乏对中间表征错位的显式控制，而中间表征错位是分布偏移下性能下降的关键原因。

Method: FIRE在每个单模态编码器的中间层引入表征编辑器，实现逐层校准；每个编辑器通过快速傅里叶变换进行频域混合以构建结构化低秩编辑子空间，增强多样性与稳定性；并设计多级自适应目标联合优化编辑器，促进跨模态语义对齐、源-目标统计对齐和非对称预测一致性。

Result: 在两个广泛使用的多模态基准上、多种损坏类型下，FIRE均优于现有多模态TTA方法。

Conclusion: 从表征工程角度显式编辑中间表征，可为融合提供对齐的单模态表征，从而提升预测可靠性，验证了该方向的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt a pretrained multimodal model online to distribution shift across modalities using unlabeled test data, showing broad potential in real-world applications. However, existing methods primarily focus on adjusting fused features to bridge the source-target gap, lacking explicit control over intermediate representation misalignment, which is a key driver of performance drop under distribution shift. In this work, we tackle this challenge from the perspective of representation engineering. Unlike previous TTA methods that update fusion weights in place, we propose FourIer Representation Editor (FIRE), a novel multimodal TTA approach that directly edits semantically rich intermediate representations. Specifically, we first adopt representation editors into each intermediate layer of the unimodal encoders, enabling layer-wise calibration of unimodal representations. To further enhance the diversity and stability of the low-rank editing subspaces, each representation editor performs frequency domain mixing via the fast Fourier transform to construct structured bases. Moreover, we introduce multi-level adaptation objectives to optimize these editors, jointly promoting cross-modal semantic alignment, source-target statistical alignment, and asymmetric prediction consistency. In this way, FIRE yields aligned unimodal representations for fusion and further improves prediction reliability. Extensive experiments on two widely used multimodal benchmarks under various corruption types demonstrate the superiority of FIRE over existing multimodal TTA methods.

</details>


### [991] [Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35603)
*Ziang Fu,Ning Ning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CGS辅助损失，通过拉直控制几何学习利于规划的表示，提升采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型中，准确的转移预测并不保证规划目标易于优化，需要使表示对规划更友好。

Method: CGS仅用像素-动作对局部转移，令动作间余弦相似度匹配对应潜在差分的相似度；可跨架构用于端到端或预训练表示。理论分析连接时间拉直与终端代价曲率平衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境和多种规划器上，CGS以更少候选和迭代步骤提升规划，成功率较LeWM与LeWM+TS分别提升至多20和12.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 拉直控制几何使好动作序列在有限规划预算下更易找到。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.

</details>


### [992] [When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32267)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Mridul Banik,Md. Shifatul Ahsan Apurba,Md Masud Al Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在模型更新发布前，如何用廉价的LLM评委评分替代昂贵的可信标签来认证当前人群风险。核心贡献是区分"可影响有效性验证的历史"与"仅能指导标签收集的历史"，并提出portfolio vigilance顺序认证器：将受历史引导的betting expert与仅从当前标签学习的expert混合，历史仅影响下注方式，从而对任意历史保持有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发布模型更新需要认证其当前人群风险低于阈值，但可信标签昂贵，而廉价评估器（如LLM评委）可对每个样本打分。复用以往审计中的评估器错误很有吸引力，但何时这类证据能替代当前标签取决于历史状态：若错误可能不可见地变化，则无标签测试无法检测，任何有效且有用的认证器都必须持续购买标签；若假设变化有界，则可无标签认证但有显式误差代价。中间地带——历史有信息但不可信——缺乏合适方法。

Method: 提出portfolio vigilance，一种顺序认证器：将受历史引导的betting expert与仅从当前标签学习的expert混合。历史只影响下注方式而非有效性，因此对任意历史均有效。在规范模型中分析该框架，并在保留的CIFAR-10N与DICES-990数据、以及DICES-990和ToxicChat上的重复评委实验中验证。

Result: 在CIFAR-10N和DICES-990上，portfolio vigilance所需标签分别为匹配的prediction-powered monitor的0.465倍（95% CI [0.327,0.575]）和0.740倍（[0.618,0.877]），未观察到错误认证，且在全部六个外部块上标签更少。在错误建议下，其表现保持在更优组件的8.0%以内，而仅信任历史最多需1.66倍代价。在重复评委实验中，改变固定LLM评委的评分标准会使分数超出运行间波动；此时portfolio分别只需匹配monitor的0.790倍（[0.667,0.909]）和0.631倍（[0.520,0.770]）标签，且少于仅信任历史。

Conclusion: 论文的关键贡献在于分离了"可进入有效性验证的历史"与"仅能指导标签收集的历史"。准确历史可缩短决策但不会提高证据增长率，陈旧历史则会破坏之。portfolio vigilance在多种设置下显著减少标签需求且保持有效性。

Abstract: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-free certification is valid at an explicit error cost. For the middle ground, where history is informative but untrusted, we propose \emph{portfolio vigilance}, a sequential certifier mixing a betting expert guided by history with one that learns only from current labels; history affects only how it bets, so validity holds for any history. The contribution is not prior-informed betting or expert mixtures, but separating history that may enter validity from history that may only guide label collection. In a canonical model, accurate history shortens decisions but never raises the evidence growth rate; stale history can destroy it. On held-out CIFAR-10N and DICES-990 data, portfolio vigilance needs 0.465 (95\% CI $[0.327,0.575]$) and 0.740 ($[0.618,0.877]$) times the labels of a matched prediction-powered monitor, with no observed false certification, and fewer labels on all six external blocks. Under corrupted advice it stays within 8.0\% of its better component, while trusting history alone costs up to 1.66 times as much. In post-confirmatory repeated-judge experiments on DICES-990 and ToxicChat, changing a fixed LLM judge's rubric moves its scores beyond run-to-run variation; the portfolio then needs 0.790 ($[0.667,0.909]$) and 0.631 ($[0.520,0.770]$) times the labels of the matched monitor, and fewer than trusting history alone.

</details>


### [993] [Arbitrary-Accuracy Neural Approximation with Optimal Neuron Count and Near-Optimal Bit Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35628)
*Zilan Cheng,Li-Lian Wang,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多元Hölder连续函数在任意精度逼近下所需最少隐藏神经元数量及其编码复杂度，证明d+1为最少总隐藏神经元数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究多元Hölder连续函数逼近中隐藏神经元的最小数量与编码复杂度这一基本理论问题。

Method: 构造固定的显式激活函数，用两层隐藏层（宽度d和1）实现任意精度一致逼近；采用显式网格寻址与量化函数值的整数编码；另给出基于floor与指数函数的单激活构造。

Result: 证明d≥2时d+1是标准前馈网络（局部可积激活、仿射输出）的最少总隐藏神经元数；三隐藏层构造（宽度d,1,2）仅需比最小值多两个神经元，带跳跃连接时宽度d,1,1即可；有界α-Hölder类需O(ε^{-d/α}log(1/ε))比特，匹配度量熵下界至对数因子。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了多元Hölder函数逼近所需隐藏神经元的下界与近乎最优构造，并证明了编码复杂度的近最优性。

Abstract: We study the minimum number of hidden neurons required for arbitrary-accuracy approximation of multivariate Hölder-continuous functions on $[0,1]^d$ and the associated encoding complexity. For $d\geq 2$, we construct a fixed, explicitly defined activation function for which a closed-form network with two hidden layers of widths $d$ and $1$ achieves arbitrary accuracy in the uniform norm. We prove that $d+1$ is the exact minimum total number of hidden neurons among standard feedforward networks with locally integrable activations and affine outputs. We further give a simpler construction using a single elementary activation that combines the floor and exponential functions. This construction requires three hidden layers of widths $d$, $1$, and $2$, only two neurons above the minimum. If a skip connection is allowed, widths $d$, $1$, and $1$ suffice. These constructions use explicit grid addressing and integer encoding of quantized function values. For a bounded $α$-Hölder class, they require $O(\varepsilon^{-d/α}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits, matching the metric-entropy lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.

</details>


### [994] [Riemannian Difference-of-Convex Optimization for K-Means Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34310)
*Meng Xu,Bo Jiang,Hanfu Zhang,Ya-Feng Liu,Anthony Man-Cho So*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出子流形上基数约束的K-means新形式，用DC惩罚并证明全局极小点等价，提出RADA-DC算法在O(ε^-3)内求 ε- Riemannian 临界点，实验优于K-means++等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K-means在信号处理与机器学习中广泛使用，但传统方法在簇数较多时解质量有限，需在流形结构下进行更优的约束优化建模。

Method: 在紧嵌入子流形上建立基数约束K-means，用difference-of-convex（DC）惩罚替代基数约束并给出全局误差界证明等价性；将非光滑Riemannian DC问题转为minimax，提出RADA-DC（Riemannian交替下降上升，结合对偶正则与DC线性化）。

Result: 理论上证明当惩罚参数超过有限阈值时惩罚与约束公式全局极小点一致；在标准假设与合适参数下RADA-DC在O(ε^-3)次迭代内得到 ε-Riemannian临界点；在合成与真实数据集上簇数较大时解质量优于K-means++等基线，计算成本具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作为流形上带基数约束的K-means提供DC惩罚等价性与高效一阶算法，兼具理论收敛保证与实证优势。

Abstract: K-means is a widely adopted clustering approach in signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we study K-means clustering through a cardinality-constrained formulation on a compact embedded submanifold. We replace the cardinality constraint with a difference-of-convex (DC) penalty and establish a global error bound to prove that the penalized and constrained formulations share the same global minimizers whenever the penalty parameter exceeds a finite threshold. To solve the resulting nonsmooth Riemannian DC problem, we reformulate it as a minimax problem and propose RADA-DC, a Riemannian alternating descent ascent method combining dual regularization with DC linearization. Under standard assumptions and suitable parameter choices, RADA-DC finds an $ε$-Riemannian critical point within $O(ε^{-3})$ iterations. We conduct experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the tested baselines, including K-means++, in solution quality at competitive computational cost when the number of clusters is large.

</details>


### [995] [Self-Reconstruction Dynamics for Autoencoder Reconstruction Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32268)
*Hitoshi Iyatomi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD)，即冻结自编码器反复对自身重建结果编码-解码所产生的轨迹，并据此设计 SRD-RR 对潜变量做校正，从而提升重建质量，同时揭示像素保真度与感知质量之间的错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 AE 推理只用一次编码-解码，固定解码器下潜变量对每个样本未必最优；作者想探究已训练 AE 能否为改进自身重建提供信息。

Method: 重复对冻结 AE 的重建结果应用该 AE，得到图像与潜空间轨迹 SRD；用短轨迹预测潜变量校正量（SRD-RR），不进行逐样本测试时优化。引入 MSE-recov 指标衡量相对经验解码器优化参考的 MSE 恢复比例；另用 SRD 导出的伪目标训练无需原图访问的变体。

Result: 六个数据集上，SRD-RR 一次转移恢复 38.6% 可恢复 MSE 差距，两次达 45.3%；无原图访问的双转移变体恢复 40.7%，平均 PSNR 提升 1.74 dB。去除轨迹信息收益下降，跨样本错误分配轨迹严重退化；非线性 SRD 条件优于固定与训练线性校正。在 DINOv2 的 RAE 上同样有效，但像素 MSE 潜变量细化暴露像素保真度与感知质量不匹配，伪目标可缓解。

Conclusion: SRD 是有用的样本特定精修信号，而目标函数决定其如何转化为像素与感知质量。

Abstract: Standard autoencoder (AE) inference uses a single encoder-decoder pass, though the latent may not be optimal for each sample under a fixed decoder. We ask whether a trained AE can reveal information for improving its own reconstruction. Repeated application of a frozen AE to its reconstruction produces transient image- and latent-space trajectories, termed Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD). Although this degrades fidelity in the AEs studied here, SRD contains sample-specific information for correcting the reconstruction. We propose SRD-guided Reconstruction Refinement (SRD-RR), which predicts a latent correction from a short SRD with the AE frozen and no per-sample test-time optimization. We also introduce MSE-recov, an MSE recovery ratio relative to an empirical decoder-optimized reference. Across six datasets, SRD-RR recovers 38.6% of the empirically recoverable MSE gap with one transition and 45.3% with two. A two-transition variant trained without direct access to original images, using an SRD-derived pseudo-target, achieves 40.7% recovery and a 1.74 dB average PSNR gain. Removing trajectory information reduces the gain, while cross-sample trajectory assignment causes severe degradation, confirming strong sample specificity. Nonlinear SRD-conditioned refinement consistently outperforms fixed and trained linear latent correction. On a pretrained DINOv2-based representation autoencoder (RAE) with substantially different latent dynamics, SRD conditioning again improves a matched trajectory-free predictor. However, pixel-MSE latent refinement reveals a strong mismatch between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality, while the SRD-derived pseudo-target mitigates this degradation. Overall, SRD is a useful sample-specific refinement signal, while the objective determines how it translates into pixel and perceptual quality.

</details>


### [996] [Certification Frontiers for Gaussian LoRA: Independent Priors, Posterior Risk, and Prediction-Preserving Balancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32271)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画高斯LoRA后验的PAC-Bayes认证边界，区分改先验、改随机预测器与只改复杂度计数三类干预，并给出闭式KL最小化与认证下界分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后验校准本身不能带来有用的泛化认证；只有当采样预测器的损失和相对可行先验的KL散度都小时，PAC-Bayes认证才有效，因此需明确认证边界与不同干预的作用。

Method: 1) 推导各向同性KL包络，消去先验尺度并给出宽度阈值，另用零KL下界识别不可达目标；2) 在低秩因子的完整GL(r)对称性上闭式最小化KL，保持采样adapter乘积不变，并推导先验中心由独立划分训练时的非中心目标；3) 在RoBERTa小池审计、受控高斯因子任务和合成rank-4变形因子上实验，比较Chernoff与Hoeffding核算及矩阵/标量平衡。

Result: RoBERTa 567配置审计显示，即使零KL与Chernoff核算，认证下界仍为0.7298，仅降复杂度无法在记录预算下认证；受控高斯因子任务中Chernoff在20/20数据集上以1024次采样认证风险<0.1，而Hoeffding为0；合成rank-4上矩阵平衡比标量平衡平均额外降低KL 29.3%且不改变预测。

Conclusion: 复杂度降低不等于可认证性；认证取决于损失与KL的联合边界，且不同干预（先验、预测器、复杂度计数）效果需分开评估；Chernoff核算与矩阵平衡在合适条件下显著改善认证，但部分目标在任何复杂度缩减下仍不可达。

Abstract: Post-hoc Bayesian fine-tuning places Gaussians around trained low-rank adapters, yet a calibrated posterior does not by itself yield a useful generalization certificate. Such a posterior admits an informative PAC-Bayes certificate only when both the loss of its sampled predictors and its KL divergence from an admissible prior are small. In this research, we characterize this certification frontier for Gaussian LoRA posteriors and separate three interventions: changing the prior, changing the stochastic predictor, and changing only how its complexity is counted. First, an exact isotropic KL envelope eliminates the prior scale and yields a width threshold that excludes posterior widths before sampling, while a zero-KL floor identifies targets that no complexity reduction can reach at a measured risk bound. Second, we minimize KL in closed form over the full $GL(r)$ symmetry of the low-rank factors, leaving every sampled adapter product unchanged, and derive the noncentral objective required when the prior center is trained on an independent split. On a small-pool RoBERTa audit of 567 configurations, the recorded 64-draw summaries imply a certificate floor of $0.7298$ even with zero KL and Chernoff accounting, so reducing complexity alone cannot certify these posteriors at the recorded budgets. For a stable posterior in a controlled Gaussian-factor task, Chernoff accounting certifies risk below $0.1$ on 20 of 20 datasets with 1024 draws, whereas Hoeffding certifies none. On deliberately deformed synthetic rank-four factors, matrix balancing reduces KL by $29.3\%$ on average beyond scalar balancing without changing any prediction. Numerical split-prior scenarios make the remaining risk and complexity budgets explicit.

</details>


### [997] [On Parameter Symmetries and Conservation Laws in Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34549)
*Khang Nguyen,Guido Montúfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立统一的几何框架，澄清神经网络参数对称性与梯度流守恒律之间的精确关系，并提出组合可辨识性以推导多层网络中对称性与守恒律的继承原理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数空间对称性与守恒律对理解神经网络损失景观和隐式偏置很重要。先前工作受Noether定理启发，试图从参数对称性推导梯度流下的守恒律，但二者联系的范围与局限尚不清楚。

Method: 开发统一的几何框架，明确定义两种概念间的精确关系，包括对称性对应守恒律的条件；引入组合可辨识性（compositional identifiability），据此建立多层网络中对称性与守恒律完整刻画的一般继承原理。

Result: 该框架被应用于多头/分组查询注意力、多项式神经网络以及方阵深层线性网络。

Conclusion: 该统一框架明确了对称性与守恒律的联系条件，并通过继承原理为多层网络的对称性和守恒律分析提供了通用工具。

Abstract: Parameter space symmetries and conservation laws play an important role in understanding the loss landscapes and implicit biases of neural networks. Inspired by Noether's theorem in physics, prior works have sought to derive conservation laws under gradient flow from parameter symmetries, but the scope and limitations of this connection remain unclear. We develop a unified geometric framework that clarifies the precise relationship between the two notions, including the conditions under which symmetries correspond to conservation laws. We introduce a notion of compositional identifiability and use it to establish a general inheritance principle for complete characterizations of symmetries and conservation laws in multilayer networks. We apply the framework to multi-head and grouped-query attention, polynomial neural networks, and square deep linear networks.

</details>


### [998] [Learning Through Game: Skewed Transfer of Tabular Knowledge to Strengthen Image Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32272)
*Longfei Huang,Shangdong Yang,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出偏斜知识转移(SKT)，通过非对称梯度整合将表格知识迁移到图像模型，提升推理时的图像单模态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表格-图像学习存在的核心难题是测试时表格数据不可用，需在训练阶段将表格知识迁移到图像模型。但图像与表格间存在模态不平衡及跨模态迁移的非对称关系，限制了表格数据的辅助作用。

Method: 设计多模态共享头，使模型无需额外参数即可受益于跨模态结构；提出两步纳什议价策略：第一步寻找模态平衡点，第二步利用偏好感知引导组合梯度朝图像有利方向移动；并理论分析其帕累托改进与收敛性。

Result: 在广泛使用的表格-图像数据集上，SKT利用表格数据作为辅助信息，持续提升了图像单模态性能。

Conclusion: 表格知识可被显式转移以增强图像模型，SKT有效解决了模态不平衡与非对称迁移问题，且具备理论保证。

Abstract: Multimodal tabular-image learning is gaining growing attention, yet it faces challenges due to tabular data unavailable at test time. A practical solution involves transferring tabular knowledge to images during training to enhance the performance of image models at inference. However, the overlooked yet important challenges lie in the modality imbalance between images and tables, as well as their asymmetric modality relationship in cross-modal transfer, which limits the auxiliary role of tabular data. To address these issues, we propose Skewed Knowledge Transfer (SKT), which asymmetrically transfers tabular knowledge to improve the image model by adaptive integration of modality gradients in a shared parameter space. Specifically, we first introduce a multimodal shared head, which allows the model to benefit from cross-modal structure without adding additional parameters. We then design a two-step Nash Bargaining strategy to effectively leverage tabular gradients. In the first step, SKT seeks a point of modality balance and uses preference awareness in the second step to steer combined gradients toward image-beneficial directions. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the Pareto improvement and convergence of SKT. To this end, tabular knowledge is explicitly transferred to enhance image models. Empirical experiments on widely used tabular-image datasets reveal that SKT consistently improves image unimodal performance by using tabular data as auxiliary information.

</details>


### [999] [Topology-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Attention Networks Guided by the Hyperbolic Sombor Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32275)
*Haifang Cao,Boan Tao,Xiyuan Gao,Timing Li,Yu Wang,Pengfei Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO)作为轻量结构先验，并基于此构建拓扑自适应双曲图注意力网络HSO-GAT，用于层级图表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双曲图神经网络依赖共享曲率配置和特征驱动注意力，未能显式利用局部层级拓扑模式。

Method: 引入HSO刻画度分层以捕捉层级信息；HSO-GAT包含两个模块：HSO引导的局部曲率自适应（基于聚合的节点级HSO信号做节点级几何缩放）与HSO门控双曲图注意力（特征条件门控实现结构感知消息传递）。理论上证明边级HSO对度不平衡的单调敏感性，并分析节点自适应双曲映射的有效性与径向缩放性质。

Result: 在八个基准数据集上，节点分类与链接预测任务均持续达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 以拓扑先验驱动的几何自适应为双曲图学习提供有效方案，HSO-GAT在多项任务上验证其优越性。

Abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has emerged as a principled space for representing hierarchical graphs. However, existing hyperbolic graph neural networks typically rely on shared curvature configurations and feature-driven attention, failing to explicitly exploit local hierarchical topological patterns. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO) as a lightweight structural prior for capturing hierarchy-indicative degree stratification. Building on this, we propose \textbf{HSO-GAT}, a topology-adaptive hyperbolic graph attention network that unifies geometric adaptation and message propagation. Specifically, it comprises two complementary modules: HSO-Guided Local Curvature Adaptation, which performs adaptive node-wise geometric scaling from aggregated node-level HSO signals, and HSO-Gated Hyperbolic Graph Attention, which enables structure-aware message passing through feature-conditioned gating. Theoretically, we establish the monotonic sensitivity of edge-level HSO to degree imbalance and analyze the validity and radial scaling properties of node-adaptive hyperbolic mappings. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSO-GAT consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both node classification and link prediction tasks.

</details>


### [1000] [HyperLabel: Multi-Label Classification via Hypergraph-Based Label Correlation Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32276)
*Peiyu Zhang,Heng Ping,Nikos Kanakaris,Yucheng Zhao,Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Xiongye Xiao,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HyperLabel，用超图神经网络显式建模标签高阶依赖，encoder-decoder框架在七个基准上达SOTA，宏F1显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签分类的核心挑战是建模由共现模式产生的复杂标签依赖，现有方法依赖对比目标或成对注意力隐式学习，缺乏结构指导，难以捕捉高阶标签相关性。

Method: 构建标签超图，以样本定义的超边自然编码多路共现模式，提供超越成对关系的显式结构先验；采用HGNN+进行双向消息传递，融合特征信息与标签结构；共享交叉注意力解码器处理两种模态，配合互补学习目标，形成统一跨模态学习框架。

Result: 在七个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能，宏F1提升尤为显著（Delicious +10.3%，Bibtex +8.2%），验证显式超图结构能有效捕捉复杂标签关系。

Conclusion: 显式超图结构是建模高阶标签依赖的有效途径，HyperLabel框架成功统一特征与标签结构学习，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-label classification (MLC) requires predicting multiple relevant labels for each instance, where a central challenge is modeling complex label dependencies arising from co-occurrence patterns. Existing approaches are limited in capturing high-order label correlations, relying on implicit learning through contrastive objectives or pairwise attention mechanisms without structural guidance. We propose HyperLabel, an encoder-decoder framework that explicitly models label dependencies through hypergraph neural networks. Our contributions are twofold: (i) We construct a label hypergraph where sample-defined hyperedges naturally encode multi-way co-occurrence patterns, providing explicit structural prior knowledge that captures relationships beyond pairwise interactions. (ii) We propose a unified cross-modal learning approach where HGNN+ performs bidirectional message passing to integrate feature information with label structure, and a shared cross-attention decoder processes both modalities through complementary learning objectives. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that HyperLabel achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly significant improvements on macro-F1 scores (+10.3% on Delicious, +8.2% on Bibtex), validating that explicit hypergraph structure effectively captures complex label relationships. The code is available at https://github.com/iZHpy/Multi-label_hypergraph .

</details>


### [1001] [An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35466)
*Denis Zorba,Michal Valko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为SAC中目标策略来自策略镜像下降时的收敛性提供保证，并给出O(N^{-1/5})的最佳迭代有限时间收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAC广泛用于连续动作空间的熵正则强化学习，实际实现中actor仅朝不断演化的目标走几步，其收敛性缺乏理论保证，且需与经典Gibbs目标比较。

Method: 将目标策略设为策略镜像下降的结果，借助Legendre微分算子由Q函数估计的曲率刻画actor目标的强凸性与光滑性，并分析镜像下降步长λ对目标漂移的影响，与Gibbs目标对比。

Result: 给出actor目标强凸与光滑的充分条件；在actor与critic近似误差下证明O(N^{-1/5})最佳迭代有限时间收敛率；镜像下降步长λ直接控制目标漂移与actor跟踪误差，而Gibbs界含不消失的跟踪项。

Conclusion: 该工作为SAC类算法提供了收敛理论，表明镜像下降目标在跟踪误差控制上优于经典Gibbs目标。

Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $λ$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.

</details>


### [1002] [SIMANF: Sample Free Learning of Unnormalized Distributions via Simulated Annealing in Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32279)
*Vikas Kanaujia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIMANF是一个无需目标样本的框架，将模拟退火与归一化流结合，通过渐进式分布变换和分阶段训练提升多模态覆盖，并在最终阶段用反向KL与重要性加权正向KL联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从高维、多模态的未归一化分布中高效学习和采样仍是难题。归一化流虽采样高效，但基于反向KL且仅有未归一化目标密度训练时易发生模式崩塌。

Method: 提出SIMANF：将模拟退火与归一化流结合，逐步把目标分布从平滑初始形式变换到原始目标分布，并在各阶段顺序训练流；阶段间迁移学习到的表示以促进模式覆盖并渐进捕获细节；退火后进行最终精炼，将反向KL与基于流生成样本的重要性加权正向KL目标结合。训练仅需未归一化密度，无需目标样本。

Result: 在Many-Well分布和高维标量Phi4格点场论分布上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: SIMANF通过模拟退火式分阶段训练和表示迁移，缓解模式崩塌问题，能在无目标样本条件下有效学习并采样高维多模态未归一化分布。

Abstract: Efficiently learning and sampling from high dimensional, multimodal unnormalized distributions without target samples remains a challenging problem. Although normalizing flows can generate samples efficiently, training based on the reverse KL divergence using only the unnormalized target density may suffer from mode collapse. We introduce SIMANF, a sample free framework that integrates simulated annealing with normalizing flows. SIMANF progressively transforms the target distribution from a smooth initial form to the original target distribution and trains the flow sequentially across these stages. By transferring the learned representation between stages, the method promotes mode coverage while progressively capturing finer features of the target distribution. Following annealing, a final refinement stage combines the reverse KL divergence with an importance weighted forward KL objective using samples generated by the flow. SIMANF requires no target samples during training and uses only the unnormalized density. We demonstrate its effectiveness on Many-Well distributions and high dimensional Scalar Phi4 lattice field theory distribution.

</details>


### [1003] [A Solvable Theory of Pre-training Data Poisoning: Regime-Dependent Scaling Exponents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32288)
*Indranil Halder,Rastri Dey,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究预训练数据投毒率ε对模型清洁数据性能的影响，发现清洁验证困惑度增幅Δ随ε呈非整数指数幂律，并用截断岭回归理论解释了该幂律的奇异结构来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往预训练投毒研究多关注目标后门及其在安全后训练后的存活性，忽略了更基本的问题：随着投毒率ε增加，模型在清洁数据上的性能如何退化。作者通过受控预训练实验观察到Δ≈Cεᵃ的幂律，希望从理论上阐明这种非整数幂律成立的机制。

Method: 作者首先证明一个"解析性屏障"：若污染目标关于ε在非退化清洁最优解附近解析，则Δ一般应为ε的二次函数，因此非整数指数意味着存在真正奇异结构。随后在可解的截断岭回归框架中引入重尾协变量与标签偏移投毒，推导过量风险随ε的缩放指数及其极限顺序依赖性。

Result: 核心结果是过量风险缩放指数依赖取极限顺序：在高维比例渐近regime下为ε^{q⋆/(q⋆+2)}，而先取充分数据极限则得到ε^{2−2/q⋆}，两者不可交换。数值模拟验证了该预测。

Conclusion: 作者主张在局部LLM预训练中，有限训练时间相当于对曲率谱的截断，并在重尾逆曲率谱假设下推导出观察到的缩放律，将其作为建模假设提出。

Abstract: Pre-training data poisoning of large language models is usually studied using targeted backdoors and their survival through safety post-training, which leaves open a more basic question: how does a model's clean data performance degrade as the poison rate $\varepsilon$ grows? Motivated by our controlled pre-training runs of OLMo-style models, in which the relative clean data validation perplexity increase $Δ$ between poisoned and clean models matched in architecture, token budget, and optimization schedule is well fit by a power law $Δ\approx C\varepsilon^{a}$ with a non-integer exponent, we ask what such a law requires theoretically. We first prove an analyticity barrier: whenever the contaminated objective depends analytically on $\varepsilon$ around a nondegenerate clean data optimum, $Δ$ is generically quadratic in $\varepsilon$, so a generic non-integer exponent is a signature of genuinely singular structure. We then supply that structure in solvable truncated ridge regression with heavy-tailed covariates, controlled by $q_\star$, and a label-shift poisoning. Our central result is that the excess risk scaling exponent depending on the order of limits: in the higher dimensional proportional regime it is $ε^{q_\star/(q_\star+2)}$, whereas taking the ample-data limit first gives $ε^{2-2/q_\star}$, and the limits do not commute. We confirm this prediction through several numerical simulations. Finally, we argue that finite training time plays the role of truncation on the curvature spectrum in local LLM pre-training, deriving the observed scaling law under heavy tailed inverse curvature spectrum as a modeling hypothesis.

</details>


### [1004] [A Journey to the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32290)
*Jaerin Lee,Kyoung Mu Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，若按优化器的直流增益（dc gain）缩放学习率，不同一阶优化器的训练轨迹几乎完全重合；据此可划分低、中、高三个学习率区间，区分优化器、学习率与模型各自的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明深度学习常发生在"稳定边缘"（EoS），此时 Hessian 最大特征值稳定在学习率的倒数附近；但在到达 EoS 之前发生了什么、不同优化器与学习率如何共同影响训练轨迹，仍不清楚。

Method: 固定深度学习问题，对多种一阶优化方法做密集学习率扫描；追踪损失、sharpness（锐度）与相邻梯度间的对齐度等轨迹特征量，并按优化器的直流增益对学习率进行归一化后比较不同优化器的轨迹。

Result: 按 dc gain 归一化后，不同优化器在较大学习率范围内的轨迹几乎完全重叠；优化器还决定 sharpness 何时脱离该普适曲线并进入 EoS。据此划分三个区间：低 LR 区（轨迹对优化器几乎不敏感）、高 LR 区（优化器按 EoS 倒数规则支配 sharpness）、中间 LR 区（渐进锐化独立于优化器发生）。

Conclusion: 该框架厘清了优化器、学习率与模型各自对训练过程的作用，dc 归一化学习率是统一刻画训练轨迹与划分区间的关键量。

Abstract: It has recently been found that deep learning often occurs at the "edge of stability (EoS)," where the maximum Hessian eigenvalue of the model is stabilized at a value reciprocal to the learning rate. However, what happens before we reach that regime? We fix a deep learning problem and vary first order optimization methods with dense learning rate sweeps. We then track the characterizing quantities of a learning trajectory: the loss, the sharpness, and the alignment between consecutive gradients. To our surprise, if we scale the learning rate by the dc gain of the optimizer, these traces from the sweeps from different optimizers almost perfectly overlap across a large range of learning rates. The dc-normalized optimizers have another role that only becomes apparent in high learning rates: they select when the sharpness value detaches from this universal curve and enters the edge of stability. Upon this discovery, we specify three distinct regimes with respect to the dc-adjusted learning rate: the low-LR regime where the trajectory is nearly insensitive to the optimizer, the high-LR regime, where the optimizer governs the sharpness according to the EoS reciprocal rule, and the in-between mid-LR regime where so-called progressive sharpening originates independently of the optimizer. This distinguishes the role of the optimizer, the learning rate, and the model in shaping the learning progress.

</details>


### [1005] [FUND: Density Flow for Sampling Unnormalised Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32296)
*Vikas Kanaujia,Vipul Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需真实样本、基于分布轨迹匹配的 Boltzmann 分布学习算法，迭代重塑目标分布以确保模式覆盖，在多个基准上优于 MCMC 与流匹配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从 Boltzmann 分布高效采样是建模复杂物理系统的核心难题。MCMC 存在临界慢化、高自相关、模式混合差等可扩展性问题；Boltzmann Generators 等新方法虽优，但依赖昂贵的基于 MCMC 的训练、采样低效且各态历经性差。

Method: 借鉴 flow matching，但由样本-轨迹匹配转为分布-轨迹匹配，无需任何真实样本训练。算法迭代地重塑目标分布，用模型生成样本引导学习，保证全面覆盖各模式。

Result: 在 2D 高斯混合、Many-Well 分布及高维标量 φ⁴ 理论等标准基准上验证，采样性能与精度优于传统 MCMC 和基于流的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该方法为复杂物理分布的无样本学习提供了新途径，兼顾采样效率、精度与模式覆盖。

Abstract: Efficient sampling from Boltzmann distributions is central to modelling complex physical systems. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods suffer from critical slowing down, high autocorrelation, and poor mode-mixing, limiting their scalability. Recent advances, like Boltzmann Generators, offer a promising alternative but remain constrained by costly MCMC-based training, inefficient sampling, and poor ergodicity. We introduce an algorithm for learning Boltzmann distributions that does not require any true samples for training. Our approach draws inspiration from flow matching but departs fundamentally from sample-trajectory matching to distribution-trajectory matching. The algorithm iteratively reshapes the target distribution, using model generated samples to guide learning and ensure comprehensive mode coverage. We validate our method on standard benchmarks, including a 2D Gaussian mixture, Many-Well distributions, and high-dimensional scalar $φ^4$ theory. The proposed approach not only improves sampling performance and accuracy over traditional MCMC and flow-based baselines but also establishes a new method for sample-free learning of complex physical distributions.

</details>


### [1006] [Refresh or Realize? Compute Allocation in Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32298)
*Sipeng Chen,Xu Zheng,Shibo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上研究 Drifting Models 训练中计算预算的分配：深度拟合当前目标还是更频繁重算漂移场。预算自由时 k=2 降低 FID；但按实测墙钟对齐后，重算新场优于深度拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Drifting Models 每步重算有限样本漂移场并朝目标做参数步，但参数为所有样本共享，网络实际运动未必等于给定运动。因此存在基本训练问题：额外计算应投入更紧拟合当前目标，还是重算场？

Method: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，固定目标 k 个优化步并测量实际位移；比较深度拟合与重算场；在等实测墙钟预算下对比 FID；分析重抽有限支撑对场方向的影响（余弦相似度）。

Result: 深度拟合确实使网络更接近冻结目标；净进展所需步数从早期约 16 步降到后期 1 步。额外步免费时 k=2 降低 FID；按墙钟付费后结果反转，重算新场在两个种子下 FID 更低。重抽支撑使方向旋转远大于参数更新（余弦约 0.3-0.6 vs 约 0.95），场空间最优修正未必在 FID 上优于无参数修正。

Conclusion: 对 Drifting 而言，拟合好每个目标与花好计算是不同目标；等墙钟预算下应优先重算漂移场而非深度拟合。

Abstract: Drifting Models train a one-step generator by recomputing a finite-sample drift field at every iteration and taking an optimizer step toward the drifted target. The field says how generated samples should move, but the step is taken in parameters shared by all samples, so the motion the network actually makes need not match the motion it was given. This leaves a basic training question open: should extra compute go into fitting the current target more closely, or into recomputing the field? We study it on ImageNet 256x256. Holding the target fixed for k optimizer steps and measuring the realized displacement, we find that deeper fitting does bring the network closer to the frozen target, and that the number of steps needed before it makes any net progress drops from about sixteen early in training to one later on. When the extra steps come for free, k=2 also lowers FID. Once they are paid for, the result flips: at approximately matched measured wall-clock, spending the budget on fresh fields gives lower FID than deeper fitting, on both training seeds. The target itself shows why a fresh field is worth so much. Redrawing the finite support rotates its direction far more than a parameter update does (cosine ~0.3-0.6 against ~0.95), and a correction that is optimal in field space is not reliably better in FID than a parameter-free one. For Drifting, fitting each target well and spending compute well are different goals.

</details>


### [1007] [When Does Synergy Help Active Feature Acquisition? A PID-Based Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32301)
*Jie Li,Maruf A. Dhali,Hjalmar R. Bouma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SynAFA：一种状态依赖的AFA策略，结合成对联合信息与条件信息，用PID刻画信息结构。实验显示其优势高度依赖预算与数据集，仅在低预算PhysioNet等协同主导场景增益明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AFA策略很少区分交互特征贡献的信息是冗余、独特还是协同的，缺少对信息结构的刻画。

Method: 提出SynAFA，状态依赖的AFA策略，融合成对联合信息与条件信息，并用部分信息分解(PID)刻画其信息结构；辅以受控合成实验与非贪心局部搜索分析。

Result: 在五个表格数据集与MNIST-loop上表现不均：低预算PhysioNet增益最强（置换检验支持协同/冗余配对），但优势随预算增大而消失，且不依赖配对提议；MiniBooNE上显著差于几乎所有基线，MNIST-loop上差于CAE。合成实验中，预算内协同占比越高优势越大。非贪心局部搜索改善了诊断性集合目标，但预测性能未提升甚至更差，且该目标与固定分类器效用对齐较弱。

Conclusion: 刻画了成对协同何时有益于AFA，并揭示将持续的挑战：如何把局部信息转化为有效的采集目标。

Abstract: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects informative features under budget constraints. However, existing policies rarely distinguish whether information contributed by interacting features is redundant, unique, or synergistic. We introduce SynAFA, a state-dependent AFA policy that combines pairwise joint information and conditional information, with Partial Information Decomposition (PID) characterizing its information structure. Across five tabular datasets and MNIST-loop, performance is heterogeneous. SynAFA shows its strongest gains at low budgets on PhysioNet, where synergistic and redundant feature pairs are supported by permutation tests, but its advantage diminishes as budgets increase and does not depend on pair proposals. SynAFA performs significantly worse than nearly all baselines on MiniBooNE, and than CAE on MNIST-loop. Controlled synthetic experiments further show that, within budget, SynAFA's advantage rises as joint information becomes more synergy-dominated, including when total joint information is held approximately constant. Further analyses show that the budget-dependent erosion is not resolved by non-greedy local search, which improves a diagnostic set-level objective but leaves predictive performance no better, often significantly worse, and that improvements in this objective are weakly aligned with the fixed classifier's predictive utility. These findings characterize when pairwise synergy can benefit AFA while exposing a persistent challenge in translating local information into effective acquisition objectives.

</details>


### [1008] [On the Capability and Limitation of Hard Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32302)
*Lijia Yu,Shuaitong Liu,Gaojie Jin,Xinyu Li,Xiao-Shan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了"硬提示"（离散提示）的理论问题，给出计算复杂性、本质局限性与泛化性三方面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软/连续提示已有较多理论进展，但更实用的硬/离散提示的理论基本空白，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过理论分析：证明硬提示存在性的NP完全性与最优硬提示的NP困难性；分析短/长硬提示及线性硬提示的能力与局限；推导提示长度与任务规模间的紧界。

Result: 硬提示存在性判定为NP完全、寻找最优硬提示为NP困难；硬提示不完备，短提示难以显著提升能力，长提示出现"提示主导答案"现象（同长度查询给出相同答案），而线性硬提示无此局限；给出有限任务泛化到全分布的紧界及充要条件。

Conclusion: 首次为硬提示提供理论洞见，并为实际LLM使用提供可证明可靠的实践指导。

Abstract: Prompt engineering has become an indispensable tool for using large language models (LLMs), turning LLMs into task-specific experts without changing their weights. Despite notable theoretical advances in prompt engineering, the theory for the more practical hard or discrete prompts is largely open. In this paper, we try to fill this gap either by providing a complete solution or by making substantial progress on the three core theoretical questions regarding hard prompts. First, we show that determining the existence of a hard prompt for a transformer to solve a downstream task is NP-complete and that finding an optimal hard prompt is NP-hard, which is the first computational complexity result for hard prompting, as far as we know. Second, we show that, unlike soft or continuous prompts, hard prompts have essential limitations: hard prompts are not complete; short hard prompts do not significantly enhance the ability of transformers; and long hard prompts exhibit the "prompt dominating answer phenomenon," meaning that, with high probability, the same answer is given for all queries of the same length. On the other hand, linear hard prompts do not have the limitations of short or long prompts. Third, we provide a tight bound on the size of the task in terms of the prompt length for the performance of prompts on the finite task to generalize to the entire data distribution, leading to a necessary and sufficient condition for generalizability. This is the first result on generalization for prompting, as far as we know. Our findings not only offer the first theoretical insights into hard prompts but also provide provably reliable practical guidance for real-world LLM usage.

</details>


### [1009] [What Can a Leaderboard Certify? Compositional Controllability for Fair Evaluation and Training of Biomedical Literature-Review Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32318)
*Zhaowei Han,Xiang Zhang,Lingxiao Guan,Danqi Hu,Kai Liu,Kevin Chang,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"组合可控性"(compositional controllability)框架，通过比较窗口与容许性检验，解决长时程智能体排行榜因证据/输入/预算不匹配导致的不可比问题，并发布BioLitBench基准与SCRIBE模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排行榜仅按最终输出给长时程智能体打分，但高分不能说明两系统是否可比、差异来自哪个阶段。证据、输入、预算的不均等会影响分数，统计校正也无法消除这种错配。

Method: 提出组合可控性：比较窗口可覆盖单阶段、多阶段或整个智能体；核心结论用窗口外的"干扰项"(nuisance)界定观察分数差与控制分数差之间的差距，从而在查看分数前做容许性检验——不可比者被拒绝；可比者仅在分差超过采样与干扰半径时认证排序，否则判为未定，最终给每个系统一个排名区间。同时构建BioLitBench(2,042篇生物医学文献，结构化可证图)与SCRIBE(基于Qwen3.8-27B，按各阶段exit奖励训练)。

Result: 7个已发表流程的21组两两比较中，传统统计分析在14组中宣布胜者，但排名第一的系统单独获得了目标综述的参考文献。本文检验要求匹配输入与固定骨干，拒绝21组中的11组(含所有涉及排名第一系统的比较)，其中7组传统结论落在被拒对中。匹配证据下，SCRIBE获认证排名区间[1,2]，对所有已评估发表流程及Claude、OpenAI智能体均有认证优势；同池条件下与最强已发表检索器持平，并认证优于3个已发表流程。

Conclusion: 比较的可容许性与统计决策应分离：先检验证据/输入是否匹配，再认证排序，而非直接依据总分排名。该框架支持阶段级训练，并揭示常规排行榜结论可能源于不均衡的证据而非真实能力差异。

Abstract: Leaderboards rank long-horizon agents by their final outputs. Yet a higher score alone does not establish whether two systems are comparable or which stage accounts for the difference. Unequal evidence, inputs, or budgets can affect scores, and statistical corrections do not remove this mismatch. We introduce compositional controllability to address these questions. A comparison window covers one stage, several stages, or the whole agent. Our central result bounds the gap between observed and controlled score differences using only nuisance outside the window. This yields an admissibility test applied before scores are inspected. Inadmissible comparisons are refused. For admissible pairs, an ordering is certified only when the score gap exceeds the combined sampling and nuisance radii; otherwise, it remains undecided. These decisions give each system a rank interval. We introduce BioLitBench, a benchmark of 2,042 biomedical articles represented as structured claim graphs. Among seven published pipelines, a conventional statistical analysis declares a winner in 14 of 21 pairwise comparisons. Yet the top-ranked system alone received the target review's bibliography. To isolate pipeline performance, our test requires matched inputs and a fixed backbone model. It refuses 11 of the 21 comparisons, including every comparison involving the top-ranked system. Seven of the 14 conventional conclusions fall within these refused pairs. The same comparison windows support stage-level training. We train SCRIBE on Qwen3.8-27B using rewards measured at each stage's exit. Under matched evidence, SCRIBE achieves a certified rank interval of [1,2], with certified advantages over all evaluated published pipelines and the evaluated Claude and OpenAI agents. Under same pool, SCRIBE matches the strongest published retriever and is certified above three published pipelines.

</details>


### [1010] [Phase Space Attention:A Hairer Lift Circumvents the Single-Layer Induction Obstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32319)
*Kingsuk Maitra,Shagun Sood Morteza Hosseini,Suman Gunnala,Vikram Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过在post-RoPE基底上将注意力提升至辛相空间，应用辛上剪切变换绕开SHT单层归纳障碍，实现一步因果双线性设计的归纳能力，且不改变KV缓存、无新增参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单层注意力存在Sanford-Hsu-Telgarsky (SHT)归纳障碍，限制了一步骤因果双线性模型表达归纳头（induction head）的能力。作者希望在线性、一步、因果、双线性且辛一致的约束类中突破该限制。

Method: 将注意力提升到辛相空间，类比Hairer对Stormer-Verlet的辛提升。把障碍重新解释为滤波器阶数缺口：单层双线性分数实现(0,0)阶z变换，而归纳判别器需键侧阶≥1。对post-RoPE的query和key流施加辛上剪切M_γ:(q,p)→(q+γp,p)以闭合缺口。并证明该提升在因子化子类中的唯一性、算子级精确辛性及需post-RoPE放置。

Result: 在仅T₄的Gaussian约化下得到闭式双分支归纳相变，r=0.9876且零拟合参数；但该定律仅为解析可解极限，恢复T₃通道后d_k=64时γ_c从1.030降至0.569且crossover消失。91.3M参数下超临界扫描：γ=0.80时3/3种子形成归纳，平均717步；γ=0时仅2/3种子、2700步。key-only半提升达0.949，优于对称算子的0.811。

Conclusion: 辛剪切提升可在设计类内绕开SHT障碍，保持KV缓存、前缀复用与投机解码，开销仅6d FLOPs/层/Token，INT8余量至多增加log₂(1+2γ)位，内核不变、无新增参数。若以归纳精度为目标，key-only半提升是更优构造。附带41个notebook与结果文件。

Abstract: We circumvent the Sanford-Hsu-Telgarsky (SHT) single-layer induction obstruction within a linear, one-step, causal, bilinear, symplectically consistent design class on the post-RoPE substrate, by lifting attention onto a symplectic phase space, mirroring Hairer's lift of Stormer-Verlet. The lift exits the premise of the SHT counting argument rather than the bound itself. The reframing exhibits the obstruction as a filter-order gap: a one-layer bilinear score realises a $z$-transform of joint order $(0,0)$, whereas the induction discriminator requires key-side order $\geq 1$. Applying the symplectic upper shear $M_γ:(q,p)\mapsto(q+γp,p)$ to the post-RoPE query and key streams closes it. We prove this lift is unique within the factorised subclass, exactly symplectic at operator level, and requires post-RoPE placement; and in an explicit $T_4$-only Gaussian reduction we derive a closed-form two-branch induction phase transition, held out at $r=0.9876$ with zero fitted parameters. That law is an analytically solvable limit, not a robust prediction: restoring the $T_3$ channel moves $γ_c$ at $d_k=64$ from 1.030 to 0.569 and removes the crossover.
  Deployability follows by exact derivation: the KV cache is unchanged, prefix reuse and speculative decoding are preserved, overhead is $6d$ FLOPs per token per layer, INT8 headroom grows by at most $\log_2(1+2γ)$ bits, fused kernels are unmodified, and no parameters are added.
  At 91.3M parameters a supercritical sweep locates an emergence band: induction forms 3/3 seeds at $γ=0.80$ in a mean of 717 steps, against 2/3 seeds and 2700 steps at $γ=0$. Adverse results are reported as directly: a key-only half-lift reaches 0.949 against 0.811 for the symmetric operator, so if induction accuracy is the objective, the half-lift is the better construction. Forty-one notebooks and result files ship as ancillary material.

</details>


### [1011] [Superposed Inference for Hyperdimensional Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32320)
*Quanling Zhao,Nilesh Prasad Pandey,Ye Tian,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SupHDC提出一种共享编码的推理范式，将多个查询叠加后统一编码，用槽位分类器恢复各自预测，实现超维计算推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超维计算推理对每个查询独立编码，需反复进行高维投影，开销大且效率低。作者希望利用高维冗余性，不仅用于鲁棒性，也作为共享推理的容量，从而降低编码成本。

Method: SupHDC为查询分配轻量随机槽位键，将带键查询叠加后进行共享编码，再用槽位特定分类器恢复各自预测。通过随机特征核视角证明无需精确恢复每个超向量，只需保留决定预测的类别证据。

Result: 在十个数据集上，SupHDC取得1.39倍解析加速且平均精度无损，最高2.08倍加速时平均精度损失2.67个百分点；在树莓派5上实测墙钟加速2.01倍，平均预测精度损失2.26个百分点。

Conclusion: SupHDC表明高维冗余不仅可以用于鲁棒性，还能作为共享推理的容量，为高效超维计算推理提供了新思路。

Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is attractive for efficient and robust learning, but conventional inference still encodes every query independently, repeatedly paying the cost of high-dimensional projection. We introduce SupHDC, a new inference paradigm that processes multiple queries through a shared encoding computation. SupHDC assigns lightweight random slot keys, superposes the keyed queries before encoding, and uses slot-specific classifiers to recover their individual predictions. A random-feature kernel view explains why exact recovery of each hypervector is unnecessary: inference only needs to preserve the class evidence that determines the prediction. Across ten datasets, SupHDC achieves 1.39x analytical speedup with no average accuracy loss, and up to 2.08x speedup with only a 2.67 percentage-point mean accuracy loss. On a Raspberry Pi~5, it delivers 2.01x measured wall-clock speedup with a 2.26 percentage-point loss in mean prediction accuracy. SupHDC shows that high-dimensional redundancy can be used not only for robustness, but also as capacity for shared inference.

</details>


### [1012] [Not All Errors Matter: Decision-Relevant Prediction Error Predicts Planning Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32322)
*Linhao Wang,Yiyan Fan,Dongjin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 总预测误差与规划性能关系弱，提出决策相关预测误差DRPE，其与规划成功率强相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型通常以预测误差训练和评估，假设预测越准决策越好；但总误差相近的模型可能因误差分布在不同状态维度而规划性能差异巨大。

Method: 提出决策相关预测误差（DRPE），度量影响决策的状态维度上的预测误差；设计iso-error评估协议，在保持总误差固定下改变误差分配；在已知状态相关性的因子化网格世界中用标准化规划器评估55个受控与学习模型。

Result: 总预测误差与规划成功弱相关（Spearman ρ=-0.25），DRPE强相关（ρ=-0.84；受控家族内-0.98）；总误差仅差1%的模型规划成功率可差60个百分点（97% vs 37%）；相关误差依赖任务，同一总误差下模型排名可反转；更深想象放大决策相关误差，学习模型在稀有但关键事件上有系统偏差。

Conclusion: 形式化了DRPE正确排序模型而总预测误差不能的充分条件，表明评估世界模型应关注决策相关误差而非总误差。

Abstract: World models are typically trained and evaluated by prediction error, assuming that more accurate predictions lead to better decisions. We show that this assumption can fail because models with similar total error can differ substantially in planning performance when their errors occur on different state dimensions. We introduce Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE), which measures prediction error on the state dimensions that affect decisions. We also develop an iso-error evaluation protocol that varies error allocation while keeping total error fixed. In a factored gridworld with known state relevance and a standardized planner, we evaluate 55 controlled and learned models across different error levels and allocations. Total prediction error is weakly related to planning success (Spearman $ρ=-0.25$), whereas DRPE is strongly predictive ($ρ=-0.84$; $-0.98$ within the controlled family). Models with only a 1\% difference in total error can differ by 60 percentage points in planning success (97\% vs 37\%). The relevant error also depends on the task, with model rankings reversing across tasks at the same total error. Deeper imagination further amplifies decision-relevant errors, while learned models exhibit systematic bias on rare but decision-critical events. We formalize sufficient conditions under which DRPE correctly ranks models and total prediction error cannot.

</details>


### [1013] [Active Feature Acquisition With Incomplete Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32325)
*Reza Rezvan,Valter Schütz,Han Wu,Linus Aronsson,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究训练数据不完整条件下的主动特征获取（AFA-ITD）问题，分析并比较了别名、过滤和生成式恢复三种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中获取全部特征往往昂贵甚至不可能，且静态特征子集不足以应对不同实例；而现有AFA方法大多假设训练数据完整，这与实际不符。

Method: 在MCAR假设下分析AFA-ITD，证明单步获取值不变而多步获取值可能下降；理论分析别名、过滤、生成式恢复三种学习策略，并在受控实验和常见AFA数据集上实证验证。

Result: 过滤方法所需训练样本数随维度指数增长，生成式恢复则随获取预算指数增长；缺失数据主要损害依赖多步获取的方法，生成式恢复在多数实验中能挽回损失性能。

Conclusion: 训练数据缺失对AFA的影响具有结构性，生成式恢复是应对缺失数据的有效途径。

Abstract: In many prediction tasks, acquiring all features can be a prohibitively expensive or outright impossible task. Further, in many cases a static subset of features may not be enough to solve the problem sufficiently across various instances. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses these problems by formalizing the trade-off between feature cost and predictive performance during sequential feature selection. However, prior AFA work largely assumes access to complete training data, an assumption that is often violated in practice. Here we study AFA with Incomplete Training Data (AFA-ITD), showing that under missing completely at random (MCAR) data, one-step acquisition values remain unchanged, whereas multi-step values can decrease. We analyze three approaches to learning from incomplete data: aliasing, filtering, and generative restoration. We show that filtering can require a number of training instances scaling exponentially with the dimension, whereas generative restoration scales exponentially with the acquisition budget. We empirically test our theory on a controlled experiment and across common AFA datasets and find that missingness mainly damages methods that exploit multi-step acquisitions and that generative restoration is able to recover lost performance in many experiments. Code is available at https://github.com/Linusaronsson/AFA-Benchmark/tree/missing-data.

</details>


### [1014] [Continual Data Unlearning in Diffusion Models via Transition-based Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32328)
*Sunbeom Jeong,Sehwan Kim,Sangwoo Hong,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出持续数据遗忘框架，利用已完成删除的"方向性转变记录"约束后续更新，实现扩散模型中删除持久性与生成质量的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型数据遗忘需去除特定样本影响而不损害其代表概念。当删除请求按序列到达时，新请求的更新会破坏生成质量并削弱早期删除效果，现有方法难以应对累积请求。

Method: 记录每个请求在固定噪声输入上denoiser响应在遗忘前后的变化作为方向参考；对后续更新施加单侧惩罚，抑制沿记录方向相对删除后参考的"逆转"，但不惩罚正交方向变化和超出参考的进展；用固定容量bank存储代表性转变记录，基于"沿记录方向的进展对参数更新的局部敏感度"选择记录，使其在惩罚不激活时仍能保留。

Result: 在请求累积情况下，该框架在删除持久性与生成效用之间取得比现有遗忘基线更好的平衡，且仅需少量转变记忆。

Conclusion: 通过将已完成的删除转变作为方向性约束并配合固定容量记忆bank，可有效解决扩散模型持续遗忘中的灾难性遗忘问题，实现高效且存储可控的数据遗忘。

Abstract: Data unlearning in diffusion models aims to remove the influence of specific training examples without suppressing the broader concepts they represent. However, when deletion requests arrive sequentially, updates for new requests can degrade generative utility and undermine earlier deletions. We propose a continual data unlearning framework that uses completed deletion transitions as directional references to regularize future updates. For each request, we record changes in denoiser responses on the same fixed noisy inputs before and after unlearning. Rather than matching full post-deletion responses, we apply a one-sided penalty that discourages reversal along the recorded directions relative to the post-deletion references, while leaving orthogonal response changes and progress beyond these references unpenalized. To keep storage independent of the number of requests, we maintain a fixed-capacity bank of representative transition records. Records are selected based on the local sensitivity of progress along their recorded directions to parameter updates, allowing them to be retained even when their penalties are inactive. Empirical evaluations show that the proposed framework achieves a better balance between deletion persistence and generative utility than existing unlearning baselines as requests accumulate, using only a small transition memory.

</details>


### [1015] [When the Merge Coefficient Stops Mattering: Proximity Regularized Merging for Continual LoRA Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32332)
*Yixuan Liu,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song,Jin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRM（近端正则化合并），在顺序LoRA合并的训练阶段加入近端惩罚，使任务向量更"可合并"，从而在免回放的持续学习中提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免回放持续学习中的参数高效适配器可视为一系列任务向量的写入操作，但现有方法只关注"写入多少"，忽视了任务向量本身是否被训练得易于合并。

Method: 对顺序LoRA合并做最小改动，在任务向量训练时加入近端惩罚，但不改变后续写入规则。

Result: 在Base->+Prox诊断中，PRM在多种写入规则、骨干网络和类增量设置下提升AAA；固定系数变体与强基线相当。匹配前缀范数控制和近端强度扫描显示：近端训练缩小任务向量半径、降低Fisher加权干扰、拓宽系数平台并揭示稳定性-可塑性权衡。

Conclusion: 顺序LoRA合并的效果不仅取决于写入多少任务向量，还取决于任务向量本身是否被训练得可合并。

Abstract: Rehearsal-free continual learning with parameter-efficient adapters can be cast as a sequence of task-vector write-in operations: for each new task, a low-rank adapter is learned and merged into a running model. We propose Proximity Regularized Merging (PRM), a minimal modification to sequential LoRA merging that adds a proximal penalty during task-vector training without changing the subsequent write-in rule. PRM acts as a robust task-vector regularizer: in the reported Base->+Prox diagnostics, it improves AAA across multiple write-in rules, backbones, and class-incremental settings, while its fixed-coefficient variant remains competitive with strong coefficient-based baselines. Mechanistically, matched-prefix norm controls and proximal-strength sweeps show that proximal training shrinks the task-vector radius, lowers Fisher-weighted interference, broadens the coefficient plateau, and exposes a stability-plasticity trade-off. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of sequential LoRA merging depends not only on how much of a task vector is written in, but also on whether the task vector itself has been trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [1016] [A Comparative Analysis of Attention versus State-Space Models for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32341)
*Enes Arda,Semih Cayci,Atilla Eryilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"信念几何"统一分析框架，用累积贝叶斯遗憾比较注意力与状态空间模型的表示能力，提炼出证据组装、信念维护与寻址三种能力，并给出架构层面的理论结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer与SSM是两大主流序列学习架构，但二者对比多为经验性，已有理论分析往往局限于特定任务或特定架构，缺乏统一、通用的比较视角。

Method: 从广义的上下文线性回归出发，以累积贝叶斯遗憾为度量，构建belief geometry框架，抽象出证据组装、信念维护和寻址三种能力；设计三个隔离这些能力的具体案例进行分析。

Result: 信念维护上，SSM在平稳聚合核上达到最优遗憾；位置组装上，SSM具有记忆优势；内容寻址上，softmax注意力相对sigmoid选择性SSM具有指数级宽度优势。

Conclusion: 该框架统一揭示了注意力与SSM的架构性差异，且LLaMA型Transformer与Mamba-2实验表明这些结论可推广到理论可分析类别与线性回归测试床之外。

Abstract: Transformers and state-space models (SSMs) are two prominent sequential learning architectures, yet their comparison remains largely empirical and existing theoretical analyses are typically task-specific or architecturally restricted. In this paper, we develop belief geometry, a unified analytical framework for comparing the representational capabilities of broad classes of attention and SSMs. Starting from a generalized formulation of in-context linear regression and using cumulative Bayes regret as our measure, we abstract three capabilities required by many sequential learning problems in our belief geometry: evidence assembly, belief maintenance, and addressing. We then study three cases of our formulation that isolate these capabilities and yield sharp architectural lessons: For belief maintenance, SSMs attain the optimal regret over stationary aggregation kernels; for positional assembly, SSMs have a memory advantage; and for content addressing, softmax attention has an exponential width advantage over sigmoid-selective SSMs. Experiments with LLaMA-type Transformers and Mamba-2 show that these architectural insights extend beyond our analytically tractable classes and linear-regression testbed.

</details>


### [1017] [Analog-Friendly Predictive Coding without Activation Derivatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32350)
*Francesco Innocenti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 activation-matched Bregman PC，用与激活函数匹配的 Bregman 散度替代平方误差能量，去除激活导数需求，使非线性预测编码更适合模拟硬件实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码(PC)是反向传播(BP)的局部、能量式替代方案，其迭代推理动态适合模拟硬件。但标准非线性 PC 在推理和学习时都需计算激活函数导数，物理实现困难。

Method: 用与激活函数匹配的 Bregman 散度替代标准平方误差能量，并结合 mirror descent 进行推理，从而得到仅需加权和、局部预测误差、状态积分和激活函数的局部推理与学习规则。

Result: 在数字实验中，Bregman PC 在分类和生成任务上与标准 PC 和 BP 表现相当，同时保持 PC 的特征学习动态，并在稳定大模型参数化下收敛到 BP。

Conclusion: 该工作为非线性 PC 提供了更适配模拟硬件的表述，同时保留了其关键计算特性。

Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) is a local, energy-based alternative to backpropagation (BP) whose iterative inference dynamics make it attractive for implementation on analog hardware. However, standard nonlinear PC requires evaluating the derivative of the activation function during both inference and learning, which can be difficult to realise physically. Here, we introduce \textit{activation-matched Bregman PC}, replacing standard squared-error energies with Bregman divergences matched to the activation function. This formulation eliminates activation derivatives and, when combined with inference via mirror descent, yields local inference and learning rules requiring only weighted sums, local prediction errors, state integration, and the activation function. In digital experiments, Bregman PC performs comparably to standard PC and BP on classification and generative tasks, while preserving characteristic learning dynamics of PC and its convergence to BP under stable large-model parameterisations. These results provide a more analog-friendly formulation of nonlinear PC while retaining its key computational properties.

</details>


### [1018] [Black-Box Auditing of Epistemic Reliability in Multi-Agent Debate Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32361)
*Derui Wang,Zewei Shi,Rayne Holland,Ruoxi Sun,Xingliang Yuan,Jason Xue,Liming Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究辩论蒸馏中"认知可靠性退化"现象，提出两阶段黑盒审计框架ER-Audit及配套基准，检测被监控任务性能掩盖的隐藏任务退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辩论蒸馏虽提升弱验证器在监控任务上的判断，但这种增益无法保证其在相关未监控任务上的可靠性。作者关注"认知可靠性退化"：适应后监控性能不变，但对隐藏任务正确答案的支持下降。核心疑问是该退化是否只是灾难性遗忘，以及标准评估能否检测到它。

Method: 提出ER-Audit两阶段黑盒审计框架，对比适应前后的冻结验证器检查点；构建配对监控/隐藏任务提示的基准（共享语境）。先搜索非退化反例（语义有效改写），若无则用独立改写进行序贯假设检验；推导非退化概率的随时有效置信下界，支持有限预算内数据依赖停止；建立固定改写分布下的公共下界，并扩展到与混合分布总变差有界距离的分布。

Result: 实验中更高的隐藏任务准确率可与更多非退化反例、更低的非退化下界并存。这种分歧挑战了单纯用广泛灾难性遗忘解释的观点，表明审计能揭示被聚合性能提升所掩盖的选择性隐藏任务退化。代码与基准已开源。

Conclusion: 监控任务上的性能增益不能作为隐藏任务可靠性的证据；ER-Audit可有效暴露辩论蒸馏中隐藏的选择性认知退化，凸显对适应后验证器进行独立审计的必要性。

Abstract: Debate distillation adapts weaker verifiers using multi-agent debate transcripts to improve their judgement in subsequent debates, but gains on monitored tasks do not establish reliability on related unmonitored tasks. We study epistemic reliability degradation, in which adaptation preserves monitored performance while reducing support for correct responses on hidden tasks. We consider an adversarial debater that manipulates debate arguments while defending the correct monitored response, and ask whether the resulting degradation merely reflects catastrophic forgetting and whether standard evaluation can detect it. To address these questions, we propose ER-Audit, a two-stage black-box auditing framework that compares frozen verifier checkpoints before and after adaptation, and introduce two evaluation benchmarks pairing monitored and hidden task prompts grounded in shared contexts. ER-Audit searches for counterexamples to non-degradation by evaluating semantically valid paraphrases and, if none is found, uses independent paraphrases for sequential hypothesis testing. We derive anytime-valid lower confidence bounds on the non-degradation probability, allowing data-dependent stopping within a finite budget. We further establish a common lower bound across fixed paraphrase distributions and extend it to distributions within a bounded total variation distance of their mixtures. Our experiments show that higher hidden-task accuracy can coexist with more counterexamples to non-degradation and lower non-degradation bounds. This divergence challenges explanations based solely on broad catastrophic forgetting and shows that auditing can uncover selective hidden-task degradation concealed by aggregate performance gains. Our code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor.

</details>


### [1019] [DiffPTS: Rethinking Diffusion ELBO for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32363)
*Weiwei Ye,Dongyuan Li,Hangchen Liu,Haotong Jiang,Yoshihide Sekimoto,Renhe Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DiffPTS框架，通过重新审视LSNM下的ELBO，统一了概率时间序列扩散预测的训练目标，实现端到端优化并取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于DDPM的概率时间序列预测方法虽引入预训练的均值与方差估计器以应对分布漂移，但通常沿用标准DDPM框架，仅考虑ELBO的部分组件，将估计器训练视为独立于变分推断的回归任务，缺乏原则性的统一训练目标。

Method: 作者在Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM)下重新推导ELBO，发现其自然导出高斯负对数似然目标，并内在地定义了一个联合训练目标，统一了近期用于概率预测的扩散范式。基于该原则性ELBO重构，提出DiffPTS通用框架，实现ELBO内所有组件的端到端优化。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，DiffPTS持续优于近期模型，取得SOTA性能，相比现有扩散方法平均降低CRPS超过14.53%、MSE超过16.55%。

Conclusion: 通过在LSNM下重新表述ELBO，DiffPTS将扩散预测的各组件统一到端到端训练框架中，验证了原则性变分推断重构的有效性，并显著提升概率时间序列预测性能。

Abstract: Probabilistic time series forecasting requires modeling and predicting complex and time-varying distributions. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based approaches have shown promise by equipping the dif- fusion process with pretrained mean and variance estimators to accommodate distributional shift. However, these methods typically follow the standard DDPM framework and consider only partial components of the evidence lower bound (ELBO), treating the training of estimators as designed regression tasks separate from the variational inference framework. To address this, we rethink the ELBO under the Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) and find that it naturally induces a Gaussian negative log likelihood objective for the estimators and inherently defines a joint training objective that unifies recent diffusion paradigms for probabilistic forecasting. Building on this principled ELBO reformulation, we propose Diff- PTS, a general framework that enables end-to-end optimization of all components within the ELBO. Across multiple benchmarks, DiffPTS consistently outperforms recent models, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an average CRPS/MSE reduction of over 14.53%/16.55% compared to existing diffusion-based methods. The code is available at https://github.com/wwy155/DiffPTS.

</details>


### [1020] [Graph Memory: Spectral Associative Memory via Dirichlet Energy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32365)
*Zhaoyang Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出谱稠密联想记忆，将向量联想记忆扩展到图结构数据，实现图的存储与检索并保持图几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统稠密联想记忆只处理向量模式，而许多现代机器学习问题本质上是图结构的，需要关系模式、图扩散几何、社区结构和图归纳偏置的记忆机制，因此需要为图数据设计联想记忆。

Method: 基于Dirichlet能量与谱范数距离构造log-sum-exp能量进行检索，得到存储拉普拉斯矩阵的softmax加权平均，且结果仍是合法图拉普拉斯矩阵；并建立关于特征值、特征空间与扩散算子的理论保证。

Result: 证明指数级存储容量和指数衰减的检索误差，并在合成图、真实航空网络、蛋白质构象和可穿戴传感器数据上实现稳健的图检索，同时保持数据的图几何结构。

Conclusion: 该框架为图结构数据提供了新的联想记忆范式，将稠密联想记忆与现代图学习和生成式AI连接起来。

Abstract: Dense associative memories have traditionally focused on storing and retrieving vector-valued patterns. Many modern machine learning problems, however, are naturally graph-structured, requiring memory mechanisms for relational patterns, graph diffusion geometries, community structures, and graph-based inductive biases. We propose a spectral dense associative memory for storage and retrieval of graph data, extending the classical vector-valued memories. Retrieval is performed through a log-sum-exp energy induced by Dirichlet energy with spectral norm distances, producing a softmax-weighted average of the stored Laplacians that remains a valid graph Laplacian. We prove exponential storage capacity and exponentially decaying retrieval error. Beyond graph retrieval, we establish theoretical guarantees for spectral quantities central to graph learning, including eigenvalues, eigenspaces, and diffusion operators. Experiments on synthetic graph data, real-world airline network, protein conformation data and wearable sensor data demonstrate robust graph retrieval while preserving the graph geometry of the data. Our framework provides a new associative memory paradigm for graph-structured data and bridges dense associative memory with modern graph learning and generative AI.

</details>


### [1021] [STRIDE: State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32367)
*Yuchen Xiong,Siming Huang,Jianfeng Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了STRIDE框架，将连续时间序列预测重新表述为状态转移预测，通过导数指纹定义状态、学习局部转移函数，在9个基准测试族上相对14个基线取得明显优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望摆脱传统的直接连续预测范式，转而从状态转移视角刻画时间序列动力学，利用局部转移频率与增量轨迹来捕捉复杂、非平稳的动态演化。

Method: STRIDE通过导数指纹定义状态，用拖尾卷积窗口估计局部联合转移频率，其滞后差分构成高维增量轨迹；利用POD提取坐标路径，结合带记忆的稀疏动力学联合预测，再通过历史锚定反演恢复未来转移分布，采样状态路径选择局部函数生成连续预测。

Result: 在9个基准族、230个任务上与14个基线对比，系统加权的后期Energy胜率为73.6%–78.5%（190个多步对），对DLinear为77.3%（72个多步任务）；在64条Aizawa轨迹上，相对四个匹配对照的后期Energy降低约24%–56%，四个预设对比均通过Holm校正。

Conclusion: 该工作将转移统计预测与连续概率预测相联系，在匹配的Aizawa研究中展现出显著的长时程收益。

Abstract: We introduce STRIDE (State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution), which defines states through derivative fingerprints and learns local functions for state transitions (qpairs), recasting continuous forecasting as transition prediction. Trailing convolution windows estimate local joint-transition frequencies, whose lagged differences form a high-dimensional increment trajectory. Proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) gives coordinate paths, jointly forecast by sparse dynamics with memory. Recombining their forecasts and applying history-anchored inversion recovers future transition distributions; sampled state paths select local functions to generate continuous forecasts. Three-seed experiments compare STRIDE against fourteen baselines across nine benchmark families. Five independent Markov and hidden-state baselines cover all 230 evaluated tasks, with 220 complete whole-horizon pairs. Against these comparators, system-weighted late-Energy win fractions range from 73.6% to 78.5% on 190 multi-step pairs; against DLinear, the fraction is 77.3% on 72 paired multi-step tasks. Matched controls examine the intermediate representation. On 64 independently initialized Aizawa trajectories, late-Energy reductions against four matched controls range from approximately 24% to 56%, with all four prespecified contrasts passing Holm correction. These results connect transition-statistic prediction to continuous probabilistic forecasting, with substantial long-horizon gains in the matched Aizawa study.

</details>


### [1022] [Measurement Boundaries in LLM Financial Agent Evaluation: Fixed-Tape Execution and Multi-Defect Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32379)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在金融LLM agent评测中研究执行性能与审计分数的可解释边界。研究A发现执行比较混淆了执行规则与模型响应/组合反馈，条件重放显示压力执行使总收益变化-0.0170（约理想基线的10.4%），10个种子聚类无法分辨模型排名。研究B修正答案键并用0/1/2缺陷匹配任务评测，目标违规召回随缺陷增加而上升（6组中5组为正，中位数0.267，3组通过Holm校正），但包含双目标标签的审计器微精度仅0.149，在98/100零缺陷任务上仍报出发现，仅21/100准确返回双缺陷集。表明固定条件与诊断控制限定了分数能支持的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent评测中执行性能分数与审计分数常被直接解读，但缺乏对"比较究竟估计了什么"以及"目标召回究竟捕捉了什么"的控制。论文旨在识别这两类解读的边界条件。

Method: 研究A：在含24天上行阶段的三个合成设置下，比较理想与压力执行：独立运行、解析决策路径；再对每份存储响应带在两种执行目的地重放。研究B：修正不完整答案键，用匹配的0、1、2缺陷任务和显式多标签提示替换旧任务，考察审计器的目标违规召回、微精度与双缺陷集恢复。

Result: 研究A：独立运行解析决策路径仅19.8%（450对）一致；条件重放中压力执行使总收益变化-0.0170（95%区间[-0.0230,-0.0117]），为理想基线10.4%；10个种子聚类不足以分辨模型排名。研究B：1到2缺陷的目标违规召回下降在6个组合中5个为正（中位数0.267），3个通过Holm校正；但包含双目标标签的审计器微精度0.149，在98/100零缺陷任务上发出发现，仅21/100准确返回双缺陷集。

Conclusion: 两类研究处理不同限制：执行比较实际估计的内容，以及目标召回真正捕捉的内容。固定条件与诊断控制共同界定了分数可支撑的论断范围，提示评测需显式控制执行规则、模型响应与审计构造偏差。
