Abstract: What controls are needed to interpret execution performance and audit scores in LLM agent evaluations? We study two limits on these interpretations in a financial agent harness. In Study~A, comparing independent runs under idealized and stressed execution on three synthetic settings that share one 24-day upward phase mixes the execution rule with fresh model responses and portfolio feedback: the parsed decision paths agree in only $19.8\%$ of $450$ pairs. Replaying each stored response tape through both execution destinations gives a narrower result. Conditional on those responses, stressed execution changes total return by $-0.0170$ (95\% interval $[-0.0230,-0.0117]$), or $10.4\%$ of the idealized baseline, and ten seed clusters do not resolve the model ranking. Study~B corrects an incomplete answer key and replaces legacy tasks with matched zero-, one-, and two-defect tasks under an explicit multi-label prompt. The drop in target violation recall from one to two defects is positive in five of six combinations of auditor and source (median $0.267$), with three surviving Holm correction. Yet the auditor that includes both target labels most often has micro-precision $0.149$, emits findings on $98/100$ zero-defect tasks, and returns the exact dual-defect set in only $21/100$ cases. Target recall by itself therefore gives a poor account of audit quality on this construction. The studies address different limits: what an execution comparison estimates, and what target recall captures. Together, they show how fixed conditions and diagnostic controls bound the claims a score can support.

</details>


### [1023] [Attribution Without a Second Pass: Inline Per-Sample Gradient Provenance at ~1% Overhead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32380)
*Amit Nautiyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Traceprop 通过在训练反向传播中内联记录投影的逐样本梯度，避免了事后归因方法的二次遍历，将存储成本降至 60-242 倍更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据归因方法（TRAK、LoGRA、EK-FAC）是事后的：训练后需再次遍历训练集重算逐样本梯度，集成时每个检查点都需重复，开销大。

Method: Traceprop 在训练反向传播时内联记录投影的逐样本梯度；使用 Kronecker 分解草图，从单层扩展到所有层而无需物化稠密投影矩阵。

Result: 在 GPT-2 和 Pythia（至 2.8B）的 LoRA 微调上，内联记录仅占墙钟时间 0.30-1.08%（Pythia-1B 全层 <1%）。相比 LogIX，在相同存储下便宜 2.0-4.1 倍，且归因质量相当或更优。内联构造成本比单次事后遍历便宜 60-242 倍，比五检查点 TRAK 集成便宜 301-1211 倍，梯度与 autograd 完全一致。

Conclusion: Traceprop 显著降低归因成本，且因每个存储梯度带源文件溯源，同一过程还能生成 EU AI Act 第 26 条审计追踪。

Abstract: Data attribution methods used in practice (TRAK, LoGRA, EK-FAC) are post-hoc: after training they make a second pass over the training set to recompute per-sample gradients, repeated per checkpoint when ensembled. Traceprop avoids that pass by recording projected per-sample gradients inline on the training backward pass. A Kronecker-factored sketch scales from a single tracked layer to every layer without materializing a dense projection matrix. On LoRA fine-tunes of GPT-2 and Pythia models up to 2.8B on one NVIDIA L4, inline logging costs 0.30-1.08% of wall-clock time at last-block scope and stays under 1% (0.79%) even when tracking every layer of Pythia-1B. Against LogIX, the closest inline-capable competitor, the factored sketch is 2.0-4.1x cheaper at equal storage, a gap that grows with tracked scope and is significant at every scope tested, while matching or exceeding LogIX's attribution quality at matched storage. Building the attribution-ready store inline is 60-242x cheaper than one post-hoc pass and 301-1211x cheaper than a five-checkpoint TRAK ensemble, with recorded gradients matching autograd exactly. Because each stored gradient carries source-file lineage, the same pass also produces EU AI Act Article 26 audit trails.

</details>


### [1024] [TimeES: Probabilistic and Deterministic Time Series Forecasting via Evolutionary Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32384)
*Weiwei Ye,Renhe Jiang,Hangchen Liu,Dongyuan Li,Yoshihide Sekimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeES 框架，基于演化谱（ES）理论，通过可参数化的演化谱建模非平稳时间序列，实现高效、可解释的概率与确定性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实时间序列本质是非平稳的，趋势、周期性和不确定性随时间演化。现有深度学习方法未显式建模傅里叶谱的演化与随机性，难以准确预测非平稳序列的期望轨迹及其不确定性。

Method: 受演化谱理论启发，推导可参数化的演化谱公式，将非平稳随机过程建模转化为学习由随机变量调制的演化表示；利用厄米对称性和谱能量稀疏性进行频率选择，将谱估计复杂度从 O(NM) 降至 O(NK)（K << M/2）。

Result: 基于简单线性骨干，TimeES 在确定性和概率性预测任务上均达到一致的 SOTA 性能，具有高效率和可解释性。

Conclusion: TimeES 为 Non-stationary 时间序列提供了一个通用、高效且可解释的谱建模范式，兼顾确定性与概率预测。

Abstract: Real-world time series are inherently non-stationary, with trends, periodic patterns, and uncertainty evolving over time. While the Fourier domain offers a natural lens to model time series, current deep learning approaches do not explicitly model evolution and randomness in the Fourier spectra, which limits their ability to accurately predict both the expected trajectory and its uncertainty in non-stationary time series. Motivated by Evolutionary Spectra (ES) theory, we propose TimeES, a general framework that enables probabilistic and deterministic forecasting via the evolutionary spectra theory. Specifically, we derive a parameterizable evolutionary spectra formulation, recasting non-stationary random process modeling as learning an evolving representation modulated by random variables. Furthermore, we reduce the complexity of the estimated spectra from O(NM) to O(NK), where K << M/2, by exploiting Hermitian symmetry and spectral energy sparsity for frequency selection. Based on a simple linear backbone, our proposed TimeES achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across both deterministic and probabilistic forecasting tasks, with high efficiency and interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/wwy155/TimeES.

</details>


### [1025] [Using Machine Learning to Investigate Predictors of Fasting Blood Glucose: Insights into Circadian Timing and Age Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32386)
*Viktoriya Bu-Dager,Silvia Cirstea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 开发可解释机器学习框架，用NHANES数据预测空腹血糖，交互增强XGBoost表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血糖调控受损是代谢功能障碍和2型糖尿病的主要成因，需要可解释的预测工具。

Method: 基于NHANES 2017–2020（疫情前）数据，合并子数据集；采用防泄漏流程（先划分、折内插补/缩放/独热编码）；比较Elastic Net、LASSO、XGBoost，含94个候选预测变量与昼夜节律交互项；用MAE、RMSE、R²、校准和SHAP评估。

Result: 交互增强XGBoost在独立测试集表现最佳：MAE=0.0804、RMSE=0.1148、R²=0.7761，仅用10个预测变量。糖化血红蛋白为主导预测因子，其次为胰岛素、糖尿病诊断、GGT、年龄、种族、性别；睡眠中点×年龄交互项在重复随机划分中稳定保留但贡献较小。

Conclusion: 研究支持进一步探索昼夜节律-年龄交互对代谢健康的影响。

Abstract: Impaired glucose regulation is a major contributor to metabolic dysfunction and type 2 diabetes. This study developed an interpretable machine-learning framework to predict log-transformed fasting blood glucose using metabolic, hormonal, lifestyle, demographic, nutritional, and circadian variables from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017--2020 pre-pandemic dataset. After merging multiple NHANES sub-datasets, data processing used a leakage-resistant pipeline in which imputation, scaling, and one-hot encoding were performed only after dataset splitting and within training folds. Elastic Net, LASSO, and XGBoost models were evaluated using 94 candidate predictors and engineered circadian interaction terms. Performance was assessed using mean absolute error, root mean squared error, coefficient of determination, calibration, and Shapley Additive Explanations. The final interaction-augmented XGBoost model achieved strong performance on the independent test set, with a mean absolute error of 0.0804, a root mean squared error of 0.1148, and a coefficient of determination of 0.7761, using 10 predictors. Glycohemoglobin was the dominant predictor, followed by insulin, diabetes diagnosis, gamma-glutamyl transferase, age, race, and gender. Among the engineered interaction terms, sleep midpoint multiplied by age was consistently retained in repeated random-split analyses, although its contribution remained modest relative to dominant glycaemic predictors. These findings support further investigation of circadian-age interactions in metabolic health.

</details>


### [1026] [HoTS: Homophily-Aware Temperature Scaling for Graph Neural Network Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32426)
*Inwoo Tae,Yoontae Hwang,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图节点分类的后验校准，提出基于局部同配性的 Homophily-aware Temperature Scaling (HoTS)，在18个基准上取得最佳ECE（4.79%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 节点分类中的置信度排序、人工复核与风险控制需要校准的类概率。现有后验校准器或使用全局温度，或采用缺乏原则性结构形式的图感知模块，未能充分刻画局部图结构对节点级校准的影响。

Method: 作者首先证明在logits相同但局部同配性不同的节点上，仅依赖logit的温度规则不足。随后分析带高斯特征的单层线性GCN与群体集中的上下文随机块模型，在等距类均值下导出贝叶斯后验为温度缩放softmax，其逆温度由同配性相关信号强度决定；在正向同配区域，温度近似与归一化局部同配性成反比。据此提出HoTS，用熵式logit集中度与估计的局部同配性为每个节点分配正标量温度，含三个温度参数，保持预测类别，并从校准数据学习结构校正强度。

Result: 在18个节点分类基准、两种GNN骨干和八种校准基线下，HoTS获得最佳平均ECE（4.79%）、最佳平均排名，以及选择性分类中最可靠的置信度排序。

Conclusion: 局部同配性应以原则性方式进入节点级校准，HoTS以简单、保序、低参数的后验校准实现了更优校准与选择性分类性能。

Abstract: For graph node classification, calibrated class probabilities are needed when confidence scores, usually the maximum predicted class probability, are used to rank predictions, defer uncertain nodes to human review, or control risk. Existing post-hoc calibrators either apply one global temperature or use graph-aware modules without a principled structural form. We study how local graph structure should enter node-level calibration. Our first results show that a logit-only temperature rule is insufficient when nodes with identical logits but different local homophily require different optimal temperatures. We then analyze a population-concentration contextual stochastic block model with Gaussian features and a one-layer linear GCN. Under equidistant class means, the Bayes posterior over class-template scores is a temperature-scaled softmax whose inverse-temperature is governed by a homophily-dependent signal strength. In the positive-signal homophilic regime, the resulting temperature decreases approximately inversely with normalized local homophily. This law motivates Homophily-aware Temperature Scaling (HoTS), a simple post-hoc calibrator that assigns each node a positive scalar temperature from entropy-based logit concentration and estimated local homophily. HoTS has three temperature parameters, preserves the predicted class, and learns the strength of the structural correction from calibration data. Across 18 node-classification benchmarks, two GNN backbones, and eight calibration baselines, HoTS achieves the best mean Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 4.79%, the best average rank, and the most reliable confidence ranking in selective classification. Code is available at https://github.com/inu0104/HoTS.

</details>


### [1027] [Beyond the Manifold Hypothesis: Hybrid Spectral Parameterizations for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32432)
*Ségolène Martin,Anne Gagneux,Quentin Bertrand,Rémi Emonet,Mathurin Massias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究流匹配/扩散中不同预测参数化（x1、x0、v）性能差异的根源，提出信噪比与信息瓶颈两大因素，并据此设计谱混合参数化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管x1、x0、v等参数化理论上等价，但实际训练性能差异显著，其内在原因尚不清晰，需要找到决定性因素并据此改进。

Method: 分析源-数据信噪比及各数据协方差方向上的信噪比，结合神经架构引入的信息瓶颈；提出随时间和协方差方向自适应的谱混合参数化（spectral hybrid），并证明其在高斯数据下最优。

Result: 发现各协方差方向的信噪比是影响最优参数化的最主要因素；架构压缩会改变参数化可学习性，v预测比x1预测更易受被丢弃方向影响；实验表明谱参数化跨架构和源尺度稳健，能显著加速优化且几乎不增加训练成本。

Conclusion: 参数化选择由信噪比与架构瓶颈共同决定，谱混合参数化提供了稳健高效的通用方案。

Abstract: Flow matching and diffusion can be trained to predict different quantities, most commonly the data $x_1$, the source noise $x_0$, or the velocity~$v$. Although theoretically equivalent, these can lead to substantially different performances. We identify two main drivers for these differences: the source--data signal-to-noise ratio, and the information bottleneck induced by the neural architecture. We show that, beyond intrinsic data dimension, the factor affecting the optimal parametrization the most is a certain signal-to-noise ratio in each data covariance direction. From this analysis, we introduce new \emph{spectral hybrid} parameterizations that adapt across time and data covariance directions; we show that these are optimal for Gaussian data. We also show that architecture-induced compression changes which parameterization is easier to learn, with $v$-prediction being more sensitive to discarded directions than $x_1$-prediction. Experiments across architectures and source scales show that our spectral parameterizations are robust across regimes, can substantially accelerate optimization, while incurring essentially no additional training cost compared with standard parameterizations.

</details>


### [1028] [Rethinking Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning: Where It Arises and How to Correct It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32444)
*Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Porter Jenkins,Weitong Zhang,Taylor W. Killian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR中大模型训练引擎与推理引擎概率不一致问题，提出置信度感知的重要性采样方法CIS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中rollout由推理引擎采样、梯度由训练引擎计算，二者对同一token赋予不同概率，导致策略更新存在训练-推理不匹配。

Method: 基于logit位移刻画（将不匹配表示为log-odds上的加性位移ε_t，其分布对token置信度近似不变），提出置信度感知截断：大正位移用单一常数阈值截断，映射为随置信度升高而收紧的重要性比上限。

Result: 理论证明CIS将精确重要性采样误差中无界的二阶矩替换为常数有界项，代价是受截断超额控制的偏差。在3个MoE模型和5个数学推理基准上，CIS在三个模型上均取得最高五基准平均成绩；诊断显示CIS对低置信token的截断偏差小于截断重要性采样，且对小重要性权重上截会降低留出准确率。

Conclusion: CIS通过置信度感知截断有效缓解训练-推理不匹配，在理论与实验上均优于基线。

Abstract: We study training-inference mismatch in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language models, where rollouts are sampled by an inference engine while gradients are computed by a training engine, and the two engines assign different probabilities to the same tokens. To account for this discrepancy in policy updates, we introduce calibrated importance sampling (CIS). CIS is motivated by an empirically supported logit-displacement characterization that expresses the mismatch as an additive displacement $\varepsilon_t$ in log-odds, determined by the per-logit perturbation before the softmax, whose distribution is approximately invariant to token confidence. This characterization motivates a confidence-aware truncation: large positive displacements are truncated at a single constant threshold, which maps back to an importance-ratio cap that tightens as token confidence increases. Theoretically, we show that CIS replaces the unbounded second moment that governs the error of exact importance sampling with a term bounded by a constant, at the cost of a bias controlled by the truncated excess. In evaluation across three mixture-of-experts models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CIS achieves the highest five-benchmark average on all three models among the evaluated baselines. Diagnostic analyses show that CIS places less truncation bias on low-confidence tokens than truncated importance sampling, while upward clipping of small importance weights reduces held-out accuracy.

</details>


### [1029] [Length-Independent State Tracking Under a Parallel Scan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32447)
*Julien Brandoit,Arthur Fyon,Thomas Braipson,Tom Clara,Florent De Geeter,Pierre Sacré,Damien Ernst,Guillaume Drion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究有限精度下的有限状态跟踪问题，提出长度无关跟踪的形式化定义，证明仿射递归在有限精度下最多只能实现确定自动机，并提出扫描兼容的非仿射RNN模型NFSM以实现长度无关的精确跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性RNN、线性注意力与状态空间模型通过仿射递推实现可扩展并行训练，但其理论表达力保证基于理想算术，在有限精度下并不成立；而实现其并行性的parallel scan本身也是数值扰动的来源。因此需要形式化有限精度下的有限状态跟踪，并研究如何保持长序列上的正确性。

Method: 作者形式化有限精度下的有限状态跟踪，定义“长度无关”性质，即任意序列长度下保持正确且精度代价不随长度增长。指出长度无关状态跟踪需要同一映射内同时具备收缩（抑制数值扰动）与分离（保持不同状态可区分）两种竞争动态。证明仿射递推每步只有一个速率，无法兼顾两者，因此有限精度下最多实现确定自动机。进而将scan兼容性重新解释为计算预算，提出NFSM：一种非仿射、scan兼容的RNN，专为长度无关有限状态跟踪设计。

Result: 在涵盖阿贝尔群、非阿贝尔群、不可逆幺半群以及文本状态跟踪任务的合成基准上，仿射基线在所有非确定任务上均失败，多数在几百步内崩溃；单个NFSM层能够学习所有代数任务的精确转移表，从而保证超出测试长度的正确性；多层NFSM在文本任务的所有测试长度上保持完美准确率。

Conclusion: 有限精度下的长度无关有限状态跟踪本质上需要收缩与分离的竞争动态，仿射递归因单速率限制无法胜任；将scan兼容性视为计算预算可指导设计非仿射架构，NFSM实证上实现了对多样的非确定代数与文本任务的精确、长度无关跟踪。

Abstract: Learning robust and scalable finite-state tracking is fundamental to sequence processing. While linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs), linear attention, and state space models enable scalable parallel training through affine recurrences, their theoretical expressivity guarantees assume idealized arithmetic and do not extend to finite precision, where the parallel scan that makes them fast is itself a source of perturbation. We formalize finite-state tracking at finite precision and characterize length independence: tracking that stays correct at every sequence length, at a precision cost that does not grow with the length. We show that length-independent state tracking requires two competing dynamics within a single map: contraction to suppress numerical perturbations and separation to keep distinct states apart. We prove that affine recurrences, which offer a single rate at each step to serve both roles, realize at most definite automata at finite precision. Instead of treating scan compatibility as a restriction on the update map, we reinterpret it as a computational budget and introduce the Neural Finite-State Machine (NFSM): a nonaffine, scan-compatible RNN built for length-independent finite-state tracking. On synthetic benchmarks spanning abelian and nonabelian groups, noninvertible monoids, and textual state-tracking tasks, affine baselines fail on every nondefinite task, most of them within a few hundred steps. A single NFSM layer instead learns the exact transition tables of every algebraic task, which certifies correctness beyond the tested lengths, and a stack of NFSMs keeps perfect accuracy on the textual tasks at every tested length.

</details>


### [1030] [Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32457)
*Wencheng Ye,Anning Hu,Xiangdong Zhang,Tianyi Wang,Yikang Li,Hengyu Jin,Bing Li,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReFlux提出一种可学习的反馈图，通过在层间复用"深度增量Δ"作为反馈信号，实现推理时高效反馈，在不增加主干FLOPs的情况下提升语言建模和推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer推理严格前向，深层计算无法回访和精炼早期表示；现有方法要么重执行深度增加计算，要么用预定义方向修改残差流，缺乏实例级自适应；已有推理时反馈机制中"反馈什么"尚不明确。

Method: 论文主张层间的深度增量Δ（新累积的计算量）比完整状态更适合作为反馈信号，更具可组合性和可扩展性。基于此提出ReFlux——一个可学习的反馈图，动态选择并组合携带增量的反馈路径，支持对同一token的同步反馈和对后续token的流式反馈。

Result: 在多种模型、语料和基准上，同步ReFlux在十个语言建模语料上一致降低困惑度，准确率提升2.1-2.3点，多跳推理提升达4.7点；流式ReFlux保留大部分增益，同时保持基座模型1x的理论主干FLOPs。

Conclusion: ReFlux确立了释放LLM潜在计算潜力的高效范式，让模型能够以新的表示重新审视同一批token。代码已开源。

Abstract: Transformers process information strictly forward through depth, preventing deeper computation from revisiting and refining earlier representations. To augment the standard forward pass, existing approaches either re-execute depth, incurring additional computation, or modify the residual stream using predefined directions, limiting their instance-level adaptation. Recently, inference-time feedback offers a direct mechanism for recycling endogenously produced computation by writing deeper residual states back to earlier layers, yet what should be fed back remains unclear. We argue that the depth increment Delta, capturing newly accumulated computation between two layers, provides a more effective, composable, and scalable feedback signal than the full state. Building on this observation, we introduce ReFlux, a learnable feedback graph that dynamically selects and composes increment-carrying routes. ReFlux supports synchronous feedback to the same token and streaming feedback to subsequent tokens. Extensive experiments across various models, corpora, and benchmarks show that synchronous ReFlux consistently reduces perplexity across ten language-modeling corpora, and improves accuracy by 2.1-2.3 points, with gains reaching 4.7 points on multi-hop reasoning. Streaming ReFlux further retains most of these gains while preserving the base model's 1x theoretical backbone FLOPs. These results establish ReFlux as an efficient paradigm for unlocking the latent computational potential of LLMs, allowing them to revisit the same tokens with fresh representations. Code implementation can be found at https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux.

</details>


### [1031] [Adapting Nonstationary Multi-output Gaussian Processes to Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32464)
*Zikai Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MOLRN-BO，通过共享谱代理、Pareto局部qLogEHVI与校准机制，解决非平稳多输出GP在MOBO中训练拟合强但决策不可靠的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOBO常用独立平稳核GP，难以表达非平稳结构且无法在目标间共享信息；但表达力强的非平稳GP不一定带来可靠BO决策。作者研究MO-LRN GP中强训练拟合与较大off-design误差、乐观采集预测共存的不匹配问题。

Method: MOLRN-BO组合：正则化共享谱代理+目标特定残差；prequential均值校正与温化协方差缩放；Pareto局部qLogEHVI优化并周期性全局搜索。

Result: 在12个确定性双目标基准上，MOLRN-BO显著优于原MO-LRN，在9个算法中取得最终归一化超体积和归一化IGD最佳平均排名；具备最强逆境尾部表现，随时优化具竞争力。消融表明共享谱改善off-design预测，局部-全局策略提升优化，分层校准减少候选偏差。

Conclusion: 非平稳多输出代理在结构和使用显式适配序贯优化需求时，可提供强且鲁棒的MOBO性能。

Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) commonly relies on independent Gaussian processes (GPs) with stationary kernels, limiting its ability to represent nonstationary structure and share information between objectives. However, expressive nonstationary GPs do not necessarily make reliable BO decisions. We study this mismatch for the multi-output low-rank nonstationary (MO-LRN) GP: strong training fit can coexist with large off-design errors and optimistic acquisition predictions. We introduce MOLRN-BO, which combines a regularized shared-spectral surrogate with objective-specific residuals, prequential mean correction and tempered covariance scaling, and Pareto-local qLogEHVI optimization with periodic global search. Experiments on 12 deterministic bi-objective benchmarks show that MOLRN-BO substantially improves upon the original MO-LRN and achieves the best average problem ranks for final normalized hypervolume and normalized inverted generational distance among nine evaluated algorithms. It also achieves the strongest adverse-tail performance while remaining competitive with the leading baselines in anytime optimization. Ablation studies further show that the shared spectral construction improves off-design prediction, the local--global decision policy improves optimization performance, and hierarchical calibration reduces systematic candidate bias. These results demonstrate that nonstationary multi-output surrogates can deliver strong and robust MOBO performance when their structure and use are explicitly adapted to the demands of sequential optimization.

</details>


### [1032] [PolyStepOR: Learning to Decide Without Optimal Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32465)
*Viet The Nguyen,Gunther Gust,An Thai Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyStepOR 提出一种无需最优参考决策和梯度的决策聚焦学习方法，通过扰动参数、评估决策并利用最优传输选择低成本方向，从实际决策成本直接训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策聚焦学习（DFL）通常依赖昂贵的最优参考决策，且分段常数损失导致无法直接求导，限制了其应用。

Method: PolyStepOR 直接用实际决策成本训练，无需预计算最优解；通过参数扰动评估决策，并利用最优传输偏向低成本方向；扩展到约束内预测，采用修复或不可行惩罚机制；无需导数计算。

Result: 无需任务特定调参，在经典优化基准上表现强，在预测约束及真实问题上具有竞争力；理论上刻画了决策保持扰动与边界检测，给出成本误差敏感性界及平滑目标的稳定性保证。

Conclusion: PolyStepOR 用前向评估替代最优参考决策与导数，为决策聚焦学习提供了更实用的训练范式。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors for downstream decision quality, but often relies on optimal reference decisions that are expensive to obtain. We present PolyStepOR, which trains directly from realized decision costs without pre-computed optima and extends to in-constraint predictions through repair or infeasibility penalties. To handle piecewise-constant losses, PolyStepOR perturbs predictor parameters, evaluates the resulting decisions, and uses optimal transport to favor lower-cost directions, requiring no derivatives. Without task-specific tuning, PolyStepOR performs strongly on classical optimization benchmarks and competitively on predicted-constraint and real-world problems. Theoretically, we characterize decision-preserving perturbations and boundary detection, bound sensitivity to cost errors, and establish stationarity guarantees for a smoothed objective. PolyStepOR thus replaces optimal reference decisions and derivatives with forward evaluations.

</details>


### [1033] [Bison: Cross-Dataset Learning for Unseen-Compound Perturbation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32467)
*Yunfan Liu,Kasra Ghorbani,Yufei Huang,Zicheng Liu,Jiangbin Zheng,Jingbo Zhou,Shaorong Chen,Chang Yu,Stan Z. Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Bison框架，通过共享基因表征与离散扩散模型整合八个数据集，实现未见过化合物的转录响应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测未见过化合物的转录响应受限于化学覆盖碎片化、实验平台与基因面板异质性问题。

Method: 基于Chem-PerturBridge构建基准（8个数据集、16,771化合物，测试化合物完全隔离）；Bison用共享基因表征连接原生面板，结合两个离散扩散模型与匹配药物对比监督。

Result: 单个联合训练Bison模型在整体响应与药物对比皮尔逊相关上超越11种按数据集独立训练方法；相比同架构数据集专属训练，药物对比相关性平均提升27.4%。

Conclusion: 匹配药物对比可将互补筛选数据转化为共享分子监督，在保留原生基因测量的同时提升未见药物响应预测。

Abstract: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen compounds is limited by fragmented chemical coverage and heterogeneous experimental platforms and gene panels. To assess molecular generalization across these settings, we build on Chem-PerturBridge to benchmark eight datasets with 16,771 compounds, withholding test compounds from every training dataset. This comparison reveals that high overall response agreement can coexist with weak prediction of drug-specific differences, despite reproducible signals across repeated measurements. To exploit complementary chemical supervision while targeting these differences, we introduce Bison: a shared gene representation connects native panels, while two discrete diffusion models compose context-dependent responses with molecular deviations learned through matched drug-contrast supervision. A single Bison model jointly trained across all eight datasets achieves the highest mean overall-response and drug-contrast Pearson correlations on the full benchmark in comparison with 11 methods trained independently per dataset. Compared with dataset-specific training of the same architecture, joint training increases mean drug-contrast correlation by 27.4\%, with gains across all eight datasets and improvements in overall response prediction. These results demonstrate how matched drug contrasts turn complementary screens into shared molecular supervision for unseen-drug response prediction while preserving native gene measurements.

</details>


### [1034] [On the Pitfalls of Verbalized Confidence Priors for Calibrating Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32470)
*Shuoyuan Wang,Beier Luo,Hao Zeng,Chengyao Yu,Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Bingyi Jing,Hongxin Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大型推理模型(LRM)表达不确定性时普遍过度自信。基于置信度的强化学习(RL)可优化校准，但依赖on-policy rollout，受限于RL前的"置信先验"。作者发现LRM的置信先验高度集中在少数高值上，并从理论上证明这抑制了稀有置信值的策略梯度更新、抬高了Brier风险下界。为此提出CalibSFT：一个即插即用的SFT阶段，在RL前塑造广泛支撑的校准置信先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 置信感知RL受模型RL前置信分布(置信先验)制约，导致探索瓶颈：低置信/稀有置信值难以被采样优化，校准效果受限。

Method: 提出CalibSFT：1) 为每道题构造结合成功率与响应级正确性的置信目标，可证明保持proper-scoring最优性；2) 在置信谱上平衡训练响应，促进RL中的多样置信探索；3) 引入正确性条件监督——对所有响应监督置信，仅对正确响应监督推理，避免模仿错误推理。

Result: 在16个数学与通用推理基准、5种代表性RL算法上，CalibSFT降低校准误差、提升区分度，同时保持相当准确率，并对下游选择性预测与模型路由有实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过SFT阶段塑造广泛支撑的校准置信先验，可突破置信感知RL的探索瓶颈，改善LRM校准且不损失精度，兼具理论保证与实用价值。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often suffer from overconfidence when expressing their uncertainty. Confidence-aware reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising way to optimize calibration. However, it relies on on-policy rollouts and is thus constrained by the model's pre-RL confidence distribution, which we term confidence prior. In this work, we reveal that off-the-shelf LRMs exhibit a confidence prior heavily concentrated on a few high values, which persists throughout RL. Theoretically, we prove that this concentration suppresses policy gradient updates for rarely sampled confidence values and inflates the lower bound on expected Brier risk. To overcome this exploration bottleneck, we propose CalibSFT, a plug-and-play supervised fine-tuning stage that shapes a calibrated confidence prior with broad support before RL. For each question, CalibSFT constructs confidence targets combining its success rate with response-level correctness, which provably preserves proper-scoring optimality, and then balances training responses across the confidence spectrum to enable diverse confidence exploration during RL. To learn from incorrect responses without imitating their reasoning, CalibSFT introduces correctness-conditional supervision, guiding confidence across all responses while supervising reasoning only on correct ones. Across 16 mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks, incorporating CalibSFT reduces calibration errors and improves discrimination across five representative RL algorithms while preserving comparable accuracy. Furthermore, CalibSFT delivers practical benefits for downstream selective prediction and model routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/ml-stat-Sustech/verbalized-confidence-training.

</details>


### [1035] [Fast and Precise Learned Charged-Particle Trajectory Regression at the Large Hadron Collider](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32479)
*Jonathan Renusch,Benjamin Huth,Daniel Murnane,Eleni Xochelli,Doğa Elitez,Paul Gessinger-Befurt,Andreas Stefl,Jeremy Couthures,Andreas Salzburger,Lukas Heinrich,Michael Kagan,Markus Elsing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将高能物理探测器中的带电粒子轨迹参数回归视为序列建模任务，用双向门控线性RNN编码器达到经典轨迹拟合的完整精度，并在GPU推理上实现显著吞吐提升，有望降低LHC模式识别计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典方法（卡尔曼滤波、线性化最小二乘）是该任务的公认最优估计器，但依赖精细的探测器几何、材料、探测效应建模与磁场中运动方程的精确数值积分，计算成本高。作者希望用可端到端学习的模型在保持精度同时降低计算开销。

Method: 提出一种训练配方，把轨迹参数回归当作序列建模任务；采用双向门控线性循环编码器（bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder），并实现自定义kernel以提升GPU推理吞吐。

Result: 模型复现了经典轨迹拟合技术的完整精度（经典方法精度达10^-5量级）；借助自定义kernel，GPU推理吞吐显著高于运行在同等价位多核CPU服务器上的经典拟合软件，从而可大幅节省LHC模式识别的计算成本。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个端到端学习的轨迹拟合在达到完整精度的同时还能降低计算成本的工作。

Abstract: We propose a training recipe that treats charged-particle trajectory parameter regression on high-energy physics detector data as a sequence-modeling task. Kalman filters and linearized least-squares fits have been the classical standard approach for this task: they are optimal estimators for sparsely sampled linear-Gaussian data and are commonly used for trajectory parameter regression (fitting). The classical fitting techniques implemented for this domain reach a final precision of one part in $10^5$ through detailed modeling of detector geometry, material, detection effects and precise numerical integration of the equations of motion through the detector's inhomogeneous magnetic field. With this study, we demonstrate that using a bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder, one is able to reproduce the full precision of classical track fitting techniques. Using a custom kernel, we also achieve significantly higher throughput during GPU inference, compared to classical fitting software running on similarly priced multi-core CPU servers representing typically employed hardware. Such a speedup would lead to considerable cost savings for the pattern recognition at the Large Hadron Collider. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end learned track fit to reach the full precision and, at the same time, offer the opportunity to reduce the computing costs.

</details>


### [1036] [What Should Federated LoRA Share? FedSAIL via Input-aware Subspace Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32485)
*Junye Du,Shuaida He,Long Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FedSAIL，通过引入输入感知的 action matrix 发现跨异构客户端稳定的共享子空间结构，并以此正则化本地训练，在提升预测性能的同时降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有联邦 LoRA 方法依赖跨客户端的参数相似性来寻找共享更新结构，但这种相似性可能主要由共同初始化导致，在独立初始化下会退化为随机重叠；同时仅依赖参数相似性忽略了本地输入分布的影响。

Method: 作者提出输入感知的 action matrix，用本地层输入的二阶统计量对 adapter 更新进行加权。实验发现尽管参数相似性消失，该 action matrix 的领先右奇异方向在各客户端间仍高度对齐。基于此提出 FedSAIL：不直接平均权重，而是估计共享的 action 子空间来正则化本地训练，同时保留客户端特定的系数。

Result: 该共享几何结构保留了任务条件的差异，并随网络深度自然变化。在多个基准测试上，FedSAIL 相比竞争性联邦 LoRA 方法持续提升预测性能，并显著降低通信成本。

Conclusion: 联邦 LoRA 的稳健共享结构应建立在输入感知的 action 子空间而非参数相似性之上，FedSAIL 验证了该思路在性能与通信效率上的优势。

Abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) requires identifying an update structure that is shared across heterogeneous clients. Prior work reports strong similarity among trained LoRA projection matrices across clients; however, such agreement may be largely induced by common initialization and collapses toward random overlap under independent initialization. More crucially, relying solely on parameter similarity inherently ignores the influence of local input regime. To uncover a more robust shared structure, we introduce an input-aware action matrix that weights the adapter update by the second-moment statistics of local layer inputs. Empirically, while parameter similarity vanishes, the leading right singular directions of this action matrix remain strongly aligned across clients. This shared geometry preserves task-conditioned differences and naturally varies across network depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Federated Subspace-Guided Action-Informed Learning (FedSAIL). Instead of averaging weights, FedSAIL estimates a shared action subspace to regularize local training while preserving client-specific coefficients. Across several benchmarks, our approach consistently improves predictive performance over competing federated LoRA methods while reducing communication cost significantly.

</details>


### [1037] [Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrids for Train-Once, Export-Many Budgeted Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32486)
*Dachuan Song,Chuchu Chen,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ESSH，将 Hankel 谱通道实现为独立循环单元并引入选择性门控，实现可弹性截断的谱-注意力混合模型，在保持质量的同时获得平滑质量-成本权衡与显著解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同算力与延迟预算下需要不同质量-成本权衡的紧凑模型。弹性谱状态空间模型虽可截断通道，但其线性时不变滤波器无法随上下文选择性保留或遗忘信息。

Method: ESSH 将每个 Hankel 谱通道用拟合的阻尼旋转模式作为独立循环单元，加入输入相关的衰减与写/读门控，使保留和状态更新变为输入相关，同时保持通道截断与结构化循环；再与滑窗注意力组合，通过双速率容量映射（不同速率削减谱通道数与前馈宽度）配合全模型蒸馏联合训练多容量模型，支持分块并行训练与融合循环解码。

Result: 满容量下质量与同规模独立训练模型相当，小容量导出呈现平滑权衡；在语言理解、检索、跨域文本和 DNA 任务上验证了质量保留与权衡优势。1.53B 配置下批一融合解码在 B300 上为 1.37 ms/token，比 Mamba-2/3 快 2.14-2.80x，比同参数量 Transformer++ 快 3.03x。

Conclusion: ESSH 通过选择性谱循环与注意力混合实现可弹性、可截断且高效的语言模型，在质量、权衡灵活性与解码效率上均优于现有弹性及循环基线。

Abstract: Deploying a language model under different computing and latency budgets calls for compact models with different quality-cost trade-offs. Towards this end, elastic spectral state space models provide ordered and temporally decomposed channels that can be truncated, but they are associated with linear time-invariant filters that cannot selectively preserve relevant past information or forget irrelevant information as the context evolves. To address this, we introduce the Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH), which realizes each Hankel spectral channel as an independent recurrent unit using fitted damped rotation modes. It also features an input-dependent decay and write/read gates that make temporal retention and state update input-dependent while preserving channel-wise truncation and a structured recurrence for efficient execution. ESSH combines these selective spectral mixers with sliding-window attention and jointly trains multiple capacities by reducing spectral-channel count and feed-forward width at different rates through a two-rate capacity map with full-model distillation. The resulting models support chunked parallel training and fused recurrent decoding while avoiding computation for discarded channels. At full capacity, ESSH achieves language-modeling quality comparable to similarly sized independently trained models, while smaller exports exhibit a smooth quality-cost trade-off. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework using language understanding, retrieval, cross-domain text, and DNA experiments, by assessing quality retention and the trade-off against independently trained and elastic baselines. At the 1.53B model configuration, fused batch-one decoding takes 1.37 ms per token on a B300, providing a 2.14-2.80x speedup over the tested Mamba-2 and Mamba-3 implementations and 3.03x over Transformer++ at matched parameter counts.

</details>


### [1038] [Neural Dynamics as the Composition of Quantized Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32487)
*Jacopo Minniti,Aravinth Kulanthaivelu,Richard Sproat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"量子(quanta)"这一中间抽象——训练被描述为可复用计算按序列突然获得、二值激活以降低损失——通过逼近群体梯度更新推导其获取动力学，并在布尔组合任务与Transformer数字转英文任务中验证该抽象可连接微观电路与宏观缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习常在两个层面被解读：宏观层面通过损失聚合趋势（缩放律）描述，微观层面通过神经元、特征与电路描述。核心挑战在于连接这两个层面，从而解释基本计算如何组合并集体塑造宏观行为。作者希望找到一种中间抽象来桥接二者。

Method: 将训练描述为"量子"（可复用计算）的有序获取过程：这些计算被突然获得、并在样本间二值激活以降低损失。通过逼近群体梯度更新，推导出量子的获取动力学，得出获取优先级取决于"需求"（该计算在样本中被需要的频率）与"条件复杂度"（在已有计算基础上获取该计算的难度）。在布尔组合任务中推导获取顺序的预测；随后训练一个Transformer完成数字到英文数名的映射，并从其检查点轨迹中恢复候选量子，构建一个能保留Transformer大部分行为、同时暴露可解释潜在计算与获取动力学的模型；此外还将量子结构用作训练目标以提升泛化。

Result: 在布尔组合任务中，推导出了获取顺序的预测，并展示错开的离散获取可产生平滑的聚合损失，且在特定量子组合几何下产生缩放律。在Transformer数字转英文任务中，从检查点轨迹恢复出候选量子，构建的模型保留了原Transformer的大部分行为，同时暴露可解释的潜在计算与符合理论的获取动力学。此外，量子结构可用作训练目标以改进Transformer泛化。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明，量子抽象可为研究多种宏观现象提供有用的计算原子，有效连接微观计算与宏观行为。

Abstract: Deep learning is commonly interpreted at two levels: the macroscopic, through aggregate trends in loss summarized by scaling laws, and the microscopic, through neurons, features, and circuits. A central challenge is understanding how these levels connect, so that we can explain how elementary computations compose and collectively shape macroscopic behavior. To this end, we study an intermediate abstraction in which training is described as the ordered acquisition of quanta: reusable computations acquired suddenly and binary-activated across examples to reduce loss. By approximating population-gradient updates, we derive quanta's acquisition dynamics. This yields an acquisition priority governed by demand, how frequently a computation is required across examples, and conditional complexity, how difficult that computation is to acquire given those already available. In a Boolean compositional task, we derive predictions for acquisition order and show how staggered discrete acquisitions can produce smooth aggregate loss and, under certain geometries of quanta composition, give rise to scaling laws. We then train a Transformer to map numerals to English number names and recover candidate quanta from its checkpoint trajectory. From these units, we construct a model that preserves much of the Transformer's behavior while exposing interpretable latent computations and acquisition dynamics consistent with the theory. Separately, the quanta structure can serve as training targets to improve transformer generalization. Together, these results suggest the quanta abstraction can provide useful computational atoms for studying a variety of macroscopic phenomena.

</details>


### [1039] [SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32493)
*Huihao Jing,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Zhongwei Xie,Guijia Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Haoyu Huang,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SoFT方法，在多教师多领域蒸馏的SFT场景下平衡分布内学习与分布外泛化，取得最优综合表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将多教师、多领域的知识整合进单一学生模型仍具挑战；学生需习得多样能力同时保持对训练任务之外的泛化能力，而现有SFT方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化间存在不同权衡，需要更显式的平衡控制。

Method: 提出soft-target fine-tuning（SoFT）：为每个示范token设定最小目标概率，同时以最小的KL变化偏离Base分布；该目标将示范学习与对Base模型的自适应加权正则耦合。进一步用领域特定的梯度预算控制平衡，并为每条轨迹确定概率阈值。

Result: 在混合领域推理与智能体任务上，SoFT在对比方法中取得最佳综合性能，分布内能力获取和分布外泛化均有提升。

Conclusion: SoFT通过耦合示范学习与自适应正则、并以梯度预算显式控制平衡，有效兼顾多领域能力的习得与泛化保持。

Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over this balance. To this end, we propose soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT) to balance learning from teacher demonstrations with retaining the Base model's existing capabilities. SoFT sets a minimum target probability for each demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the Base distribution. The resulting objective couples learning from demonstrations with adaptively weighted regularization toward the Base model. We further use domain-specific gradient budgets to control this balance and determine a probability threshold for each trajectory. Experiments on mixed-domain reasoning and agentic tasks show that SoFT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, with improvements in both in-distribution capability acquisition and out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [1040] [Rondo: Unsupervised Discovery of Recurring Temporal Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32500)
*Yingtian Shi,Ankith Chandra,Thomas Plötz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无监督方法Rondo，通过构建可复用单元及其组合的词汇表，在连续时间流中发现多尺度的层级化重复结构，在有限数据和持续流场景优势明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实时间序列具有多尺度结构性质（短小重复单元及其复杂组合），但现有方法忽视层级结构，将不同尺度的重复模式视为独立结构；且多假设可获取完整数据、把发现视为静态过程，无法随新观测演化。无监督发现这些成分与结构可减少昂贵的标注需求。

Method: Rondo 是一种无监督方法，用于在连续时间流中建模重复的层级结构。它显式构建可复用单元的词汇表及其重复组合，从而捕捉跨复杂时间模式共享的结构，并随数据流的演化不断精化与扩展其发现。

Result: 跨多个领域和数据模态的时间序列评测显示，Rondo 优于现有的无监督重复发现基线，在有限数据和持续流场景下优势尤为显著。

Conclusion: Rondo 为重复模式发现、可扩展的行为理解以及在长时无标注时间流上运行的自适应智能系统提供了更强的基础。

Abstract: Many real-world time series data exhibit structural properties at multiple scales, from short, recurring units to complex sequences composed of these units. Unsupervised discovery of both these components and structure enables the design of intelligent systems that help interpret temporal data, thereby limiting the amount of costly human annotations required. Existing modeling approaches typically overlook the hierarchical structure inherent to many time series, treating recurring patterns at different temporal scales as independent structures. Moreover, most assume access to the complete data sequence and treat discovery as a static process, limiting their ability to evolve as new observations arrive. We introduce Rondo, an unsupervised approach for modeling recurring hierarchical structure in continuous temporal streams. By explicitly constructing vocabularies of reusable units and their recurring compositions, Rondo captures structure shared across complex temporal patterns while refining and expanding its discoveries as the stream evolves. Evaluations on temporal sequences spanning diverse domains and data modalities show that Rondo outperforms existing unsupervised recurrence-discovery baselines, with particularly pronounced advantages in limited-data and continual-stream settings. These capabilities provide a stronger foundation for recurring-pattern discovery, scalable behavior understanding, and adaptive intelligent systems operating on long, unlabeled temporal streams.

</details>


### [1041] [Fisher Simplicity in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multilayer Perceptrons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32503)
*Ami Tavory,Meir Feder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究KAN的架构简化（小/零系数）与Fisher零化（扰动不可见）是否一致，结论是否定的：系数大小本身不能作为KAN的Fisher剪枝标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN被认为可解释，固定基KAN中小或零基系数常被视为简化的证明，类比MLP中的死ReLU。但缺乏严格的统计判据来验证这种架构简化是否真对应"扰动在任务分布下不可见"的Fisher意义。

Method: 作者定义Fisher-simple：参数方向扰动在任务分布下不可见即为Fisher零方向。然后对比死ReLU与固定基KAN，在单层高斯情形推导系数Fisher矩阵（等于输入分布下的基Gram矩阵，与拟合系数无关），并在多层KAN中给出基于图路径的Fisher简单性刻画，用有效边测度编码两个条件（数据到达基原子、扰动向下游传播）。

Result: 死ReLU中两种概念一致（闭合激活区使score方向消失）；固定基KAN中不一致（Fisher矩阵与系数无关）。在局部字典独立与有效测度非退化条件下，零有效暴露恰好标识边内的Fisher零方向。诊断实验证实零系数可保持秩，而有效路径断开则移除预测方向。

Conclusion: 系数大小单独不足以作为KAN的Fisher剪枝准则；Fisher简单性由有效路径连通性决定，而非系数本身。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are motivated in part by interpretability: their learned edge functions can be inspected, pruned, and reduced to symbolic structure. In a fixed-basis KAN, this makes a small or zero basis coefficient look like a certificate of simplicity, much as a dead rectified linear unit (ReLU) marks unused computation in a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Fisher nullity gives a precise statistical notion: a parameter direction is Fisher-simple exactly when perturbing it is invisible under the task distribution. We study when these architectural and Fisher notions agree.
  For a dead ReLU unit, they agree: the closed activation region makes the associated score directions vanish. For a fixed-basis KAN, they do not. In the single-layer Gaussian case, the coefficient Fisher matrix is a basis Gram matrix under the input distribution and is independent of the fitted coefficients. In a multilayer KAN, Fisher simplicity is graph-path based: the data must reach a basis atom and its perturbation must propagate through the downstream network. We encode these two conditions in an effective edge measure and, under local dictionary independence and effective-measure nondegeneracy, show that zero effective exposure exactly identifies Fisher-null directions within an edge. Controlled diagnostics confirm that zero coefficients can preserve rank while effective path disconnections remove the predicted directions. Coefficient magnitude alone is therefore not a Fisher-based pruning criterion for KANs.

</details>


### [1042] [Does Transolver really need a Transformer?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32525)
*Shizheng Wen,Siddhartha Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Transolver的注意力机制实为冗余，仅需切片/反切片+逐点MLP即可通用逼近连续算子；作者还提出高效的flashslice内核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transolver族神经算子虽广泛使用，但其性能来源的机理尚不清晰，需要系统的实证与理论分析来厘清哪些组件真正起作用。

Method: 在9个三维流体动力学基准上做消融实验；用平均神经算子理论解释发现；并设计FlashAttention风格的flashslice高效实现。

Result: 将token注意力替换为常数线性映射不影响精度；移除全局混合（切片/反切片）或只做一次会导致性能崩溃。理论证明仅切片/反切片加逐点MLP即可通用逼近连续算子。flashslice在浮点误差内复现最佳实现，并显著节省内存与计算。

Conclusion: Transolver不需要Transformer，注意力在该上下文中冗余；全局切片/反切片混合才是关键。flashslice可在大切片数下大幅降低内存与计算开销。

Abstract: The widely used Transolver family of neural operators is based on physics-attention, which softly assigns the points of an unstructured mesh to a small number of slices, applies self-attention among the resulting tokens, and broadcasts the result back to the points. We provide a comprehensive empirical and theoretical analysis to elucidate the mechanisms which are responsible for model performance. To this end, we perform careful ablations on a challenging suite of nine 3D fluid dynamics benchmarks to find that replacing token attention with a constant linear map does not affect the accuracy. Thus, Transolver does not need a Transformer at all. However, removing the global mixing (slicing/deslicing) or doing it only once leads to performance collapse. We leverage the theory of averaging neural operators to explain and corroborate our findings by showing that just slicing/deslicing, in conjunction with pointwise MLPs, already suffices for universal approximation of continuous operators and attention is redundant in this context. Finally, we provide a novel FlashAttention-style efficient implementation of the key slicing/deslicing module of Transolver. This flashslice kernel streams slice and deslice over the points without materializing the heavy slice-weight tensor, while reproducing the best available implementation to floating point error. At the same time, it leads to very significant memory and compute savings, particularly at large slice counts.

</details>


### [1043] [Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32530)
*Hong Kiat Tan,Linh Le,David Williams-King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ActFlow 无需微调，仅用 k 个正确标签制造激活，通过 ODE 求解残差流向量 x，解锁 sandbagging 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差异均值引导需要模型表现目标行为时的激活，而 sandbagging 模型故意隐藏行为、无法提供这些激活。

Method: ActFlow 设定使每个标签项正确答案排首位的目标 logits，通过在所有 k 个残差流的某一层加入向量 x 逼近目标；将 x 建模为 ODE 族，每条规则对应一种从所需 logit 变化到速度的映射。最小范数规则精确命中目标，其它规则仅保留 Jacobian 的顶部奇异方向。

Result: 在三个指令微调模型（sandbagging 提示和密码锁定 LoRA 各一）上测试：k=40 时，保留 5 个奇异方向的 ActFlow 将六个锁定模型的 ARC-Easy 平均留出准确率从 0.05 提升到 0.85（微调 0.88，诚实模型 0.92）；在 18 种锁定模型与 k 组合中的 16 种优于最小范数规则，且转向方向与诚实差异均值方向近乎正交；并解锁了两个诚实方向失败的 LoRA 锁。

Conclusion: ActFlow 提供了一种无需微调、仅需少量正确标签即可恢复 sandbagging 模型性能的引导方法，效果接近微调并优于最小范数规则。

Abstract: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for fine-tuning and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails.

</details>


### [1044] [What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? Action Rules, Convergence, and the Missing Random Floor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32532)
*Abhisek Keshari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"随机下界"（均匀随机策略在同一关卡/框架下的回报）作为强化学习泛化差距的参照，并以ProcGen为例说明该下界会改变多个标准结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统泛化差距（训练关卡回报减留出关卡回报）通常缺少参照点，导致对模型泛化与否的判断缺乏基准。

Method: 在ProcGen八个环境的相同checkpoint与关卡上，比较采样动作与贪心（argmax）动作的留出回报；分析原始策略熵与合并等效动作后的熵；审计十二个已有ProcGen代码库的留出评估协议。

Result: 贪心评估在三个环境跌至或低于随机下界（miner中采样策略为下界的4.9倍而argmax低于下界）；原始熵显示七/八环境未收敛，合并等效动作后仅一至三个未收敛，且仅heist未能迁移；十二个代码库中十一个有留出评估，均采样测试动作（九个默认而非显式选择），六个报告在循环平均而非固定checkpoint；相同检验下调了一个显著编码器效应并排除了一个within-encoder的train-vs-test CKA统计量。

Conclusion: 建议每次报告泛化差距时说明动作规则、采用匹配且带种子的协议，并在两个关卡集上报告随机下界。

Abstract: A generalization gap in reinforcement learning (return on training levels minus return on held-out levels) is usually reported without a reference point. We argue that the missing reference is a measured random floor: the return of a uniform-random policy on the same levels under the same harness. On ProcGen, the floor changes what several standard numbers mean. On identical checkpoints and levels across eight environments, switching between sampled and greedy (argmax) test-time actions moves held-out return in both directions, and greedy evaluation takes three environments to or below the floor: in miner, the sampled policy scores 4.9x the floor on held-out levels while its argmax scores below it. Raw policy entropy places seven of eight environments short of convergence, but 35-65% of that entropy is spread across actions with identical effects; after merging them, one to three remain short, and against the floor only heist has learned nothing that transfers. An audit of twelve prior ProcGen codebases finds that all eleven with held-out evaluation sample test-time actions for their policy-gradient agents, nine by default rather than explicit choice, and six report running in-loop averages rather than evaluating a fixed checkpoint. Applied to our own case study, the same checks grade down a statistically significant encoder effect and rule out a within-encoder train-vs-test CKA statistic. We recommend that every reported gap state its action rule, use a matched and seeded protocol, and report the random floor on both level sets.

</details>


### [1045] [Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32546)
*Thomas S. Robinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，在单次自回归生成中批量产出多条记录（shared-completion batching）会扭曲合成数据中变量间的关系，且这种扭曲难以通过简单的边际分布校正消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可在一次自回归补全中生成多条记录，使先前答案成为后续记录的上下文。作者关注这种做法是否会让合成数据中变量之间的关系（相关性）被系统性扭曲，从而影响合成数据的效度。

Method: 在合成调查受访者上做受控实验，使用2000份欧洲社会调查（ESS）profile，在固定profile、示例、问题与解码参数的前提下，比较每请求生成10条与1条记录。并进行受控干预：重新配对相同的前置答案值（在固定profile与边际分布下），以及隐藏前置答案，以检验答案历史是否为因果通道。

Result: 每请求生成10条而非1条时，国内相关系数的平均绝对误差增加48-58%（Qwen3.8-27B）和114-127%（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct），跨三个随机种子一致。扭曲主要体现为关系强度被夸大，但仍与人类相关系数排序有较高一致性。重新配对前置值会改变后续答案的相关性，证明答案历史是因果通道。隐藏前置答案可降低相关性误差，但会恶化边际准确性。

Conclusion: 请求构造本身就是数据生成过程的一部分，因此合成数据的效度必须针对其预期支持的后续分析来评估；降低相关性误差可能与更差的边际分布和回归估计共存。

Abstract: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.

</details>


### [1046] [Prioritizing Repeated LLM Evaluation for Hidden Failure Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32547)
*Keita Broadwater,Akin Broadwater*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM可靠性评估建模为预算约束下的失败发现问题，提出先用浅层评估、再用学习到的特征排序优先深评估零失败提示的方法，在AIRBench/StrongREJECT上实现隐藏失败发现提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规评估对每个prompt只采样少量随机响应，受推理预算限制，难以观察到低概率但重要的失败；浅层零失败的prompt可能仍有潜在失败概率，造成可靠性误判。

Method: 将评估形式化为预算约束发现问题，每个prompt有未知的每次生成失败概率；框架先做浅层评估，再利用trial级失败结果和prompt表示学习基于特征的失败倾向排序，用分数优先深评估零浅失败的prompt。

Result: 在AIRBench和StrongREJECT及多模型/系统提示条件下测试；AIRBench上最高排名10%未解决prompt的隐藏失败提升为Qwen 2.5 7B 2.54x、Gemma 3n E4B 1.87x，分别恢复25.4%和18.7%后续隐藏失败，随机分配仅10%；语义邻域与特征消融显示该信号可从多种prompt内容/关系表示中恢复。

Conclusion: 无需深评估结果训练的模型即可排序零浅失败prompt的潜在失败倾向，从而更有效地分配深评估预算并发现隐藏失败。

Abstract: Large language models are commonly evaluated by generating a small number of stochastic responses for each prompt in a benchmark. Because inference budgets are limited, this shallow evaluation may fail to observe low-probability but operationally important failures. A prompt that produces no failures in a small sample may therefore appear reliable despite having a nonzero latent probability of failure under repeated inference.
  We formulate LLM reliability evaluation as a budget-constrained discovery problem in which each prompt is associated with an unknown per-generation failure probability. We propose a budgeted discovery framework that first performs shallow evaluation across the prompt set and then uses trial-level failure outcomes together with prompt-derived representations to learn a feature-based ranking of failure propensity. The resulting scores prioritize prompts with zero observed shallow failures for deeper evaluation, concentrating the deep-evaluation budget where hidden failures are more likely to be discovered.
  We evaluate this approach on AIRBench and StrongREJECT across multiple model and system-prompt conditions. The central empirical test asks whether models fit without access to deep-evaluation outcomes can rank prompts with zero observed shallow failures according to their likelihood of producing failures under deeper evaluation. On AIRBench, the highest-ranked 10\% of unresolved prompts achieves 2.54x hidden-failure lift for Qwen 2.5 7B and 1.87x for Gemma 3n E4B, recovering 25.4\% and 18.7\% of subsequently observed hidden failures, respectively, compared with 10\% expected under random allocation. Semantic-neighborhood and feature-ablation analyses further show that this predictive signal can be recovered from multiple representations of prompt content and relationships.

</details>


### [1047] [Compositional Objectives: Learning Structure in Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32566)
*Pranavchandra Vivekananda,Sumukh Bettadapura,Ajan Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究epiplexity（可学习结构度量）的谱近似计算，发现其偏好均匀谱分布，但谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用是不同属性，观察者所见内容比添加关系/交互tokens更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能可定义为对可学习新颖性的追求，而可学习新颖性基于epiplexity。但仅铺开谱信息不足以形成对特定任务有用的特征，且缺乏高效计算epiplexity的方法。

Method: 提出epiplexity的闭式谱近似（固定迹约束）；并设计一个组合目标，令观察者度量图像各部分间的关系与交互，与仅有掩码部分的原始谱目标对比；在ImageNet及多个图像基准上训练评估。

Result: 掩码部分的谱目标产生近乎最大铺开的表示，并在多数评估中取得最强的冻结特征分类性能，线性探测精度超过整图基线两倍以上；改变观察者所见内容比添加关系与交互tokens影响更大；预测导向的组合目标留出观察者预测更好但分类较弱。

Conclusion: 谱铺开的效用不仅取决于保留了多少结构，还取决于观察者向目标提供了哪些关系；谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用是相互独立的属性。

Abstract: Intelligence is defined in many ways. One of these definitions defines intelligence as the pursuit of learnable novelty. However, learnable novelty can be meaningless without the ability to compose the learned structures to take action and achieve goals. Learnable novelty builds on epiplexity, which is a way to measure learnable structure in data through a bounded observer. In this paper, we investigate a closed-form spectral approximation to compute epiplexity. We use a fixed-trace constraint and find that the epiplexity objective prefers a more uniform distribution of spectral mass rather than concentrating it in a small number of directions. However, a representation may spread information across many directions without organizing that information into features useful for a particular task. To address this gap, we propose a compositional objective whose observer measures the relationships between the parts and interactions of an image. We compare it with the original spectral objective given only the masked parts. In our ImageNet training runs, the spectral objective with masked parts produces an almost maximally spread representation while achieving the strongest frozen-feature classification performance on most evaluations, more than doubling the linear-probe accuracy of the whole-image baseline. Across multiple image benchmarks, changing what the observer sees matters more than adding relation and interaction tokens. At the same time, our prediction-oriented compositional objective produces substantially better held-out observer prediction but relatively weaker classification, revealing that spectral diversity, predictability, and downstream utility are distinct properties. These results suggest that the usefulness of spectral spreading depends not only on how much structure is preserved, but on which relationships the observer makes available to the objective.

</details>


### [1048] [CAESAR: Clustering via Autonomous Embedding-Space Agglomerative Reorganization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32570)
*Ilan Bacry,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAESAR，通过重组织预训练嵌入空间并自动推断聚类数K来提升最近邻图聚类效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于最近邻图的聚类算法（如FINCH）高度依赖嵌入空间质量，但预训练视觉与语言模型的嵌入并非为聚类优化；同时现实中簇数K通常未知，而多数强聚类方法却将其作为输入。

Method: 训练一个重组织网络，将互近邻拉近、非近邻推远，得到更适合聚类的嵌入空间；整个CAESAR流程设计为推断K而非假设已知。

Result: 在文本和图像数据集上重组织嵌入均稳定提升聚类效果；在文本上超越所有对比方法，在最难图像基准上取得最佳，其余也保持竞争力——即使对比的深度聚类方法拥有真实K的“oracle优势”。

Conclusion: 重组织预训练嵌入是应对真实数据（类别重叠、K未知）聚类的简单而强大的途径。

Abstract: Clustering algorithms that operate on nearest-neighbor graphs, such as FINCH (First Integer Neighbor Clustering Hierarchy), depend heavily on the quality of the embedding space they are given. However, pretrained vision and language model embeddings are not optimized for this purpose. We propose CAESAR, a method that reorganizes a pretrained embedding space: a reorganization network is trained to pull mutual nearest neighbors together and push non-neighbors apart, yielding a reorganized embedding space substantially better suited to clustering. CAESAR offers a second major advantage: it never requires the number of clusters $K$. This matters because in realistic unsupervised settings, $K$ is typically unknown and discovering it is often part of the problem, yet most strong clustering methods take it as an input. We therefore design the entire CAESAR pipeline to infer $K$ rather than assume it is known. Empirically, reorganizing the embeddings consistently improves clustering over the raw space on both text and image datasets. Since the few deep clustering methods that also infer $K$ do not release their code, we complement controlled comparisons with methods that infer $K$ on the same embedding space by comparisons with strong deep clustering methods that are given the true $K$, giving them a substantial oracle advantage. Even so, CAESAR outperforms all of them on text, achieves the best results on the most challenging image benchmark and remains competitive on the others. Reorganizing pretrained embeddings thus emerges as a simple and powerful route to clustering realistic data, where classes overlap and the number of clusters is unknown.

</details>


### [1049] [Trapped by Their Own Rollouts: Understanding Aggregation--Rollout Feedback in Federated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32573)
*Jinqian Chen,Jihua Zhu,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦在线策略蒸馏（Federated OPD）中发现其协作收益会被学习率敏感性掩盖，并提出 FedTOPS 方法通过自适应放大 FedAvg 更新幅度来恢复协作增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦 OPD 中客户端协作收益可被学习率敏感性掩盖：小学习率下 FedAvg 不如独立本地训练，大学习率下才显现优势。作者希望解释这一现象并加以利用。

Method: 从学生模型兼具"学习者"与"未来训练数据生成者"的双重角色出发，建立聚合- rollout 反馈理论，识别学习率的两个耦合作用；据此提出 FedTOPS，利用当前轨迹上的教师反馈，在客户端预测变化约束下自适应调整 FedAvg 更新幅度。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，FedTOPS 相比 FedAvg 将 macro Avg@8 提升 4.56–14.57 个百分点（覆盖多个学生模型和本地学习率）。

Conclusion: 联邦 OPD 的协作增益需通过合适的学习率调节才能释放，FedTOPS 通过教师引导的更新缩放有效实现这一点。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach to language-model adaptation, aligning teacher supervision with the student's own generated trajectories. When adaptation prompts are distributed across clients, can this process benefit from federated collaboration? We study federated OPD and find that substantial collaboration gains can be obscured by learning-rate sensitivity: FedAvg can perform no better than independent local training at a small learning rate, yet recover a clear advantage at a larger rate. We explain this phenomenon through the student's dual role as learner and generator of future training data. An aggregation-induced optimization lag can delay access to useful teacher supervision, which in turn slows subsequent learning. Our theory establishes this aggregation--rollout feedback in a solvable model with a common optimum and stable updates, and identifies two coupled roles of learning rate: learning from current supervision and reaching future supervision. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedTOPS (Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling), which reuses teacher feedback on current trajectories to adapt the FedAvg update magnitude under clientwise predictive-change constraints. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FedTOPS improves macro Avg@8 over FedAvg by 4.56--14.57 percentage points across the evaluated student models and local learning rates.

</details>


### [1050] [DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32579)
*Vojtěch Lanz,Yufei Cui,Prasanna Parthasarathi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何在冻结预训练模型的前提下，通过为query/key学习线性投影来降低维度，并提出DimPO方法：结合列表式偏好优化与top-k交叉熵，比KL匹配全注意力分布更能保持任务性能，尤其是在高比例投影和长上下文场景下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性投影可在不更新预训练模型的情况下降低query/key维度，但何种训练目标最能保持模型行为尚不清楚。本文探究：对key的偏好排序及最高权重key上的注意力质量，是否比用KL散度匹配完整注意力分布提供更好的信号，特别是在长上下文场景。

Method: 提出DimPO，将列表式偏好优化与轻量级top-k交叉熵项（用于head保真）结合。离线训练：从冻结语言模型的注意力模式中学习，每层一个映射，query与key共享该映射，各层独立训练。在LLaMA3.2-3B、LLaMA3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B与Qwen3-4B Instruct上进行评估。

Result: 成对偏好目标优于三元组基线，在末40%层投影至半维时，短上下文任务保留98%原始分数。更多投影层或长上下文RULER上性能迅速下降。KL与DimPO在训练中使用全部key，在8B模型投影至50%层时仍保留约95%的RULER 4k分数。KL投影更接近原注意力分布与注意力输出，但DimPO下游性能更好；超过50%投影层后，DimPO在SQuAD、常见词/高频词抽取与变量追踪等任务上明显优于KL。

Conclusion: 在降维条件下，保持任务相关注意力的排序与集中度，可能比复现完整注意力分布更重要。

Abstract: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.

</details>


### [1051] [Age of Learning: Temporal Persistence of Prediction Errors as a Learning Signal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32593)
*Chenyang Wang,Stefan Forsström,Roger Olsson,Di Yuan,Qing He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Age of Learning (AoL)学习状态变量，衡量预测误差随时间的持续性，并用于离线与流式长尾分类的自适应训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ML算法依赖loss、margin、置信度等瞬时信号，只反映当前优化步的预测难度，无法刻画模型"错误持续了多久"，难以区分持续性欠学习与短暂性错误。

Method: 定义AoL：误差未解决时递增，预测正确时重置。离线设置下累积样本级AoL并聚合为类级状态，指导自适应重加权与重采样；流式设置下用当前与缓冲观测维护轻量类级AoL状态。

Result: 在长尾分类中AoL优于或匹配标准基线，学习难度持续时收益更大；多种子流式实验在时间稳定不平衡下显示可复现增益；AoL与常规难度度量相关但额外捕捉误差持续时间信息。

Conclusion: 时间持续性为刻画和控制不平衡及非平稳环境下的学习动态提供了有用的互补信号。

Abstract: Current machine learning algorithms primarily rely on instantaneous signals such as loss, margin, and prediction confidence to characterize model behavior. These signals indicate how difficult a prediction is at the current optimization step, but they do not capture how long the model has remained incorrect. We study this temporal dimension of learning and introduce Age of Learning (AoL), a learning-state variable that measures the persistence of prediction errors over time. AoL increases while an error remains unresolved and resets when a correct prediction is achieved, thereby distinguishing persistent under-learning from transient mistakes. We develop AoL-based training strategies for both offline and streaming settings. In offline learning, sample-level AoL is accumulated over training and aggregated into class-level states that guide adaptive reweighting and resampling. In streaming learning, where full historical access is unavailable, we maintain lightweight class-level AoL states using current and buffered observations. Across long-tailed classification settings, AoL improves or matches standard training baselines, with larger benefits when learning difficulty persists over time. Multi-seed streaming experiments further show reproducible gains under temporally stable imbalance. Analysis of class frequency, loss, and margin shows that AoL is related to conventional difficulty measures but captures additional information about error duration. These results suggest that temporal persistence provides a useful complementary signal for characterizing and controlling learning dynamics in imbalanced and non-stationary environments.

</details>


### [1052] [Not Every Term Adds New Structure: Sobolev Novelty for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32597)
*Boxiao Wang,Kai Li,Yuheng Jing,Tianyi Liu,Chen Li,Yifan Zhang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出项级结构新颖性度量 Sobolev Novelty，用经验 Sobolev 签名判别符号回归中各项是否真正带来新结构，可作为即插即用模块提升多种 SR 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法多以整体表达式级目标（如拟合误差）引导搜索，无法判断单个项是否贡献真正的新结构，还是与其他项冗余，导致搜索效率低、解缺乏科学方程般的结构紧凑性。

Method: 为每个项构造经验 Sobolev 签名（基于其在观测输入上的函数值与精确导数），量化该行为有多少无法由剩余项重构；并推导理论校准阈值，得到无需调参、有原则的项级结构新颖性判据。

Result: 基准真值方程中 92.6% 的项达到充分结构新颖性，而 15 种 SR 方法生成的表达式平均仅 38.3%，揭示科学方程与现有 SR 解之间的显著差距。作为轻量插件可用于项剪枝、搜索引导、LLM 反馈与数据选择，在多种 SR 范式中取得一致性能提升。

Conclusion: 项级结构独立性度量能有效刻画符号方程的结构质量，Sobolev Novelty 作为通用插件广泛适用于多种 SR 范式并稳定提升性能。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover compact and meaningful mathematical equations from data, but searching the vast combinatorial space of symbolic structures remains challenging. Existing methods typically guide this process using expression-level objectives, such as fitting error, which assess a candidate equation as a whole but provide little information about whether an individual term contributes genuinely new structure or is largely redundant with the rest of the expression. We introduce \textbf{Sobolev Novelty}, a term-level measure of structural independence for symbolic equations. For each term, we construct an empirical Sobolev signature from its function values and exact derivatives over the observed inputs, and quantify how much of this behavior cannot be reconstructed by the remaining terms. We further derive a theory-calibrated threshold, yielding a principled and tuning-free criterion for identifying structurally novel terms. Using this threshold, 92.6\% of terms in benchmark ground-truth equations exhibit sufficient structural novelty, compared with only 38.3\% on average for expressions produced by 15 SR methods, revealing a substantial gap between scientific equations and current SR solutions. As a lightweight plug-in, Sobolev Novelty can be incorporated into diverse SR paradigms to support term pruning, search guidance, LLM feedback, and data selection, yielding consistent performance gains and demonstrating broad applicability.

</details>


### [1053] [AnchorRep: Defending LLMs Against Cross-Model Adversarial Transfer via Representation Repulsion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32602)
*Gal Wertheizer,Rom Himelstein,Tomer Peretz,Avi Mendelson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AnchorRep，通过对齐内部表征几何来防御跨模型对抗攻击迁移，用轻量 LoRA 将有害提示的表征推离冻结锚模型，跨模型攻击成功率降至 ≤1.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一开放权重 LLM 上优化的对抗攻击可迁移并越狱架构不同的模型，形成共享漏洞；现有防御并非针对这种跨模型威胁设计。

Method: 发现跨模型迁移与共享内部表征几何相关；用轻量 LoRA 适配器直接把被防御模型对有害提示的内部表征推离冻结锚模型的对应表征，仅用少量有害提示、无需对抗样本训练。另提出 Benign Garble Rate 量化退化良性输出。

Result: 在 5 个模型、4 个架构家族上，对 2,000 个迁移攻击将成功率降至 ≤1.1%（其中 2 个为 0%），Mistral 降幅最大（36%→1.1%）。现有防御虽能降低迁移，但代价高：最高 77% 退化良性输出或最高 18% 过度拒答。

Conclusion: 跨模型鲁棒性可通过塑造表征几何实现，无需攻击专用训练。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks optimized on a single open-weight LLM can transfer to and jailbreak architecturally different models, allowing an attacker with white-box access to one model to compromise independently deployed systems. This creates a shared vulnerability across models, yet existing defenses are not designed for this cross-model threat. We find that cross-model transfer aligns with shared internal representation geometry, making it a natural defense target. AnchorRep targets this geometry directly with a lightweight LoRA adapter that pushes the defended model's internal representations of harmful prompts away from those of a frozen anchor model on the same prompts. Training uses a small set of harmful prompts and no adversarial examples. Across five models and four architectural families, AnchorRep reduces cross-model attack success rate to <=1.1% on 2,000 transferred attacks (0% on two), including the largest drop on Mistral (36% -> 1.1%). Existing defenses can reduce transfer, but only at high cost either inducing up to 77% degenerate benign output or increasing over-refusal by up to 18%. Because such degenerate benign outputs are not captured by standard refusal-based metrics, we introduce the Benign Garble Rate to quantify them. Our results suggest that cross-model robustness can be achieved by shaping representation geometry, without requiring attack-specific training

</details>


### [1054] [Learning the Graph and the Embedding Together: Classifier-Independent Rewiring for Heterophilic Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32613)
*Harshit Kumar,Sujan Chakraborty,Priyanka Saha,Pritam Kar,Saptarshi Bej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种亲和力引导的图重连方法，同时估计图结构与节点表示，产出与分类器无关的重连图和节点嵌入，在异质图基准上显著提升精度并降低分类器间差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在异质图上优势减弱，因为相连节点常带不同标签。图重连是常用补救手段，但现有重连方法通常只用一个分类器评估，难以判断收益来自新拓扑还是特定分类器配对。

Method: 提出亲和力引导重连方法，联合估计图与节点表示，以类似EM思想交替进行：在当前图上训练轻量GNN，并在带伪标签同质性项的模块度目标下重新加权候选边。候选边来自一个紧凑池，由对比学习得到的节点相似度和邻域分布亲和力打分。

Result: 在六个异质图基准和五个下游分类器上，重连图加嵌入在30个分类器-数据集组合中的23个提升了精度（相对原始图加归一化特征），平均提升5.8个点，并将分类器间精度差距缩小约四倍。消融显示嵌入贡献主要精度增益，重连图促进分类器一致。无监督变体保留大部分提升，重连图更具同质性，并改善标签传播与社区检测。

Conclusion: 该方法的两个输出互补：嵌入提升精度，重连图提升分类器一致性；且无需标签的变体同样有效，重连图在同质性、标签传播和社区检测上均有改善。

Abstract: Graph neural networks lose much of their advantage on heterophilic graphs, where connected nodes often carry different labels. Graph rewiring is a popular remedy, but rewiring methods are usually evaluated with a single classifier, which makes it hard to tell whether the gains come from the new topology or from that particular pairing. We propose an affinity-guided rewiring method that estimates the graph and the node representation together. It alternates, in the spirit of expectation maximisation, between training a lightweight graph neural network on the current graph and re-weighting candidate edges under a modularity objective with a pseudo-label homophily term. Candidate edges come from a compact pool scored by a contrastively learned node similarity and a neighbourhood-distribution affinity. The method returns two classifier-independent outputs: a rewired graph and a node embedding learned on it. Across six heterophilic benchmarks and five downstream classifiers, it improves accuracy over the original graph with normalised features in 23 of 30 classifier-dataset combinations, with a mean gain of 5.8 points, and reduces the accuracy spread between classifiers about fourfold. A controlled ablation shows that the two outputs are each useful and play complementary roles: the embedding contributes most of the accuracy gain, while the rewired graph makes different classifiers agree. A fully unsupervised variant, which uses no labels during rewiring, retains most of the improvement. The rewired graphs are also more homophilic and improve label propagation and community detection.

</details>


### [1055] [Stabilizing the Dynamic Low-Rank Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32615)
*Zhonghan Xu,Ling Wang,Junhao Chen,Jianwei Zhao,Jinwei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDLRT，通过补偿缓冲与负反馈修正DLRT在激进压缩下的不稳定问题，成功在高压缩率下找到可训练子网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态低秩训练(DLRT)可在训练中在线识别高效子网络，但在高压缩率下无法找到可训练网络。作者指出其根源在于DLRT忽略了最优秩-r近似的梯度流中一个曲率耦合项，该偏移在激进压缩下很大，不可忽略。

Method: 推导最优秩-r近似的梯度流，定位DLRT的偏差来源；提出SDLRT：(1)维护轻量补偿缓冲，重新注入被丢弃的顶端奇异方向；(2)对截断容差引入负反馈，稳定每层秩。

Result: SDLRT在DLRT崩溃的场景下可靠找到可训练子网络；作为DeBERTa-v3上的PEFT适配器，在SuperGLUE上取得最佳平均分，仅比LoRA多2.8%参数开销。

Conclusion: 通过理论分析曲率耦合项并引入补偿缓冲与负反馈，SDLRT解决了动态低秩训练在高压缩下的失效问题，兼顾训练与推理的效率与性能。

Abstract: Training neural networks directly in a low-rank parameterization is an appealing route to reducing memory, compute, and storage simultaneously during both training and inference. Dynamic low-rank training (DLRT), which confines weights to a rank-$r$ manifold via the Galerkin projection of the gradient flow, is particularly attractive because it identifies efficient subnetworks on the fly without specialized initialization or post-factorization. However, DLRT fails to find trainable networks under high compression. In this paper, we derive the gradient flow of the best rank-$r$ approximation and point out that the offset of DLRT comes from a curvature-coupling term which is large and thus non-negligible under aggressive compression. Guided by this analysis, we propose a stable dynamic low-rank training method, named SDLRT, which maintains a lightweight compensation buffer that reinjects the top neglected singular directions. Additionally, we introduce a negative feedback on the truncation tolerance to stabilize each layer's rank. Experimentally, SDLRT reliably finds trainable subnetworks where DLRT collapses and as a PEFT adapter on DeBERTa-v3, it achieves the best average score on SuperGLUE at only $2.8\%$ parameter overhead over LoRA.

</details>


### [1056] [Intuition vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32619)
*Shahar Haim,Daniel C. McNamee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 冻结的大规模自监督视觉模型（DINOv3、MAE）的隐空间几何无需微调即可支持隐式规则推理：通过"直觉向量"（演示输入-输出差向量）进行潜在向量运算，在Bongard、ARC-AGI及ARC-GEN上取得接近任务专用基线的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自监督视觉模型的表征几何是否能直接迁移到视觉推理任务，验证"关系表征"能否通过编码相似性与变换，以潜在向量运算的形式桥接感知与抽象推理，从而无需任务专用微调。

Method: 考察DINOv3、MAE及随机像素投影；在Bongard（抽象与自然）问题上用冻结嵌入的简单最近质心读出；在ARC-AGI-1/2及ARC-GEN上用"直觉向量"（总结演示输入-输出变换的潜在差向量）与测试向量对齐，并沿该向量迁移查询以检索精确输出。

Result: Bongard两基准上冻结嵌入的最近质心读出与任务专用基线差距在4个百分点内；ARC中同任务直觉向量与测试向量对齐更强，异任务近乎正交；沿直觉向量迁移持续提升精确输出检索，ARC-AGI-2达70.7；在794个任务、397,000个ARC-GEN实例上，单对直觉向量以约87%留一准确率识别生成任务。

Conclusion: 冻结视觉表征上的潜在向量运算可在多领域支持隐式规则推断，无需生成模型组件；这表明"推断抽象变换"与"生成其特定实例结果"可能是两种可分离的能力。

Abstract: Large self-supervised vision models learn representations that support scene segmentation and the semantic decomposition of physical objects. We ask whether their representational geometry supports transfer to visual reasoning problems without any task-specific fine-tuning. We hypothesized that relational representations may bridge perception and abstract reasoning by encoding similarities and transformations among visual inputs such that an intuitive, implicit form of reasoning may be performed via latent vector arithmetic. Specifically, we examine DINOv3, MAE, and random pixel projections on abstract and naturalistic Bongard problems, ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, and novel ARC-GEN instances. On both Bongard benchmarks, the accuracy of a simple nearest-centroid readout of frozen visual embeddings is within four percentage points of the task-specific baselines reported with the original benchmarks. In ARC, latent difference vectors summarizing demonstration input-output transformations, which we refer to as intuition vectors, show greater alignment with test vectors from the same task, whereas those from unrelated tasks are near orthogonal. This latent geometry is operational: transporting a query along its intuition vector consistently improves exact-output retrieval, reaching 70.7 on ARC-AGI-2 evaluation. Across 397,000 ARC-GEN instances from 794 tasks, single-pair intuition vectors identify the generating task with approximately 87\% leave-one-out accuracy.
