Across three selection seeds, two model families, two candidate pools, and two target tasks, features cached at a post-warmup checkpoint and paired with fresh validation gradients preserve the ranking 40 optimizer steps later with Spearman correlation from 0.952 to 0.991, while the top-10% subset they induce misses 10 to 22% of the examples that full recomputation selects. We therefore propose Cached Diverse Influence Selection (CDIS), which recomputes gradient features for the top-ranked fraction $p$ of candidates under the stale scores, fits an affine calibration on the recomputed examples, and selects the final subset under source and length quotas. A refresh fraction at or above the selection fraction recovers the exact top-$k$ subset whenever the calibrated stale scores have bounded error, and the budget curves follow this rule: at $p=0.3$ the recovered top-$k$ subset coincides with full recomputation in every setting, allocating the same budget per stratum recovers the stratified subset at 0.92 to 1.00, and gradient-stage wall-clock drops 3.5 to 3.6 times. Iterating the cache over four checkpoints keeps top-$k$ overlap at 0.98 or higher at 1.9 gradient features per example against 4 for full recomputation, and stale-to-recomputed agreement on the refreshed examples provides a free check for unsafe reuse. Downstream, unconstrained top-$k$ selection collapses to a single data source and scores 13 points below random selection on GSM8K. CDIS scores 12 points above random selection with paired confidence intervals that exclude zero and trails full recomputation by 4.3 points, one training-run standard deviation, at 3.4 times lower selection cost.

</details>


### [1093] [Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation for Frozen EEG Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32889)
*Anuar Aimoldin,Yankai Chen,Ayana Mussabayeva,Nurdaulet Akhanov,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MGPA方法：以测量证据决定校正作用方向、以保留信息决定校正目标，在不依赖源身份或编码器重训练的情况下，将EEG表征中的采集痕迹（设备/电极差异）源分数移动到保留坐标预测值，从而在保持任务性能的同时降低源可预测性，效果优于LEACE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的EEG表征同时包含采集特征（设备、电极等）与神经活动。仅凭"源可预测性"无法判断应删除什么：源分数高可能反映测量效应，也可能是真实生物或人群差异，后者不应被抹除。因此需要区分"可移除的测量效应"与"应保留的真实信息"。

Method: 测量门控溯源衰减（MGPA），基于一原则：测量证据决定校正可在何处生效，保留信息决定校正目标。用配对测量对比定义门控，门外不做任何改变；门内将源分数移动到保留坐标已预测的值（固定仿射分数下，保持与那些坐标设定的任意目标相同的信息，且期望平方移动最小）。提供闭式与critic引导的迭代构造，无需源身份或编码器重训练。

Result: 三项研究逐步远离假设检验该原则：(1)受控参考变化下，MGPA将源降至接近随机而任务性能不变；LEACE删除源预测因子却使冻结任务AUROC从0.753降至0.656且几乎不影响源；消融显示衰减源于门控方向，条件目标移动量减少2.7倍。(2)跨不同设备与电极记录，迭代校正降低源可访问性同时保持或提升任务性能。(3)一个任务上选定并原样复用到现有头部的迭代映射，在另两个任务上将其最差关联AUROC（设备-标签偏移下最低值）分别比LEACE提高0.057和0.019。

Conclusion: 可复用的校正在采集线索不再可靠时，其价值体现在现有预测器的行为上，而不仅在于探针能读出什么。MGPA原则在偏离假设的不同场景下均有效，优于仅删除源预测因子的方法。

Abstract: Frozen EEG representations retain acquisition signatures as well as neural activity. Source predictability alone does not identify what should be removed: it can reflect measurement effects or genuine biological and population differences, which should not be erased. We propose Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation (MGPA), built on one principle: measurement evidence determines where correction may act, and preserved information determines what it should aim for. Paired measurement contrasts define a gate outside which nothing changes; inside it, the source score is moved to the value the preserved coordinates already predict: for a fixed affine score, this keeps the same information as any target set by those coordinates and needs the least expected squared movement. Closed-form and critic-guided iterative constructions apply it without source identity or encoder retraining. Three studies test the principle at increasing distance from its assumptions. Under controlled reference changes, where the source-task association is known, MGPA brings source to near chance with task performance unchanged, whereas erasing what predicts source (LEACE) lowers frozen-task AUROC from .753 to .656 while barely touching source; ablations attribute the attenuation to the gate's directions and 2.7x less movement to the conditional target. Across recordings from different devices and electrodes, iterative correction lowers source accessibility while preserving or improving task performance. Finally, one iterative map selected on one task and reused unchanged on existing heads for two others raises their worst-association AUROC (lowest over device-label shifts) by .057 and .019 over LEACE, at a cost to those heads while the training association holds. A reusable correction shows its value in how an existing predictor behaves once acquisition cues stop being reliable, not only in what a probe can read.

</details>


### [1094] [A Function-Level Vulnerability Score Measures Flag Rate More Than the Model: Protocol Effects on Paired Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32890)
*Maciej Cichoń,Bartłomiej Dmitruk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用统一协议在配对基准上评估模型作为漏洞检测器的表现，发现评分差异主要来自模型而非评估协议，且函数级分数更多反映"标记率"而非真实判断能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相似模型在不同论文中报告的漏洞检测分数差异很大，作者想量化其中有多少来自评估协议，从而厘清分数差异的来源。

Method: 在固定模型输出的情况下，逐一改变三个评估选择：指标、判定提取、输出预算。对7个前沿/大型开源模型、5个已发布配对基准及汇总集进行评估，并对61个1.5B–36B模型在汇总集上评估，另用线性探针分析激活、tf-idf基线及长度对照。

Result: 函数级F1与"同时标记一对中两个函数"的频率高度相关（Spearman +0.86），而与配对级正确性几乎无关（+0.16）。提取在配对分数上中位数仅改变+0.001，预算+0.02（置信区间穿过零），而模型改变基准分数达0.18、基准改变模型分数达0.16。68个模型中37个正确与反转配对的差异落在零的95%区间内。长度匹配对上线性探针达0.78，tf-idf 0.64，长度为0.5；生成判定对多数模型接近随机。

Conclusion: 函数级评分更多衡量标记率而非模型能力，判定主要由两个函数共有的文本决定。评估协议对分数的解释力有限，应谨慎看待当前漏洞检测评估的结论。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly evaluated as vulnerability detectors, and scores reported for similar models differ widely between papers. We measured how much of that difference evaluation protocol accounts for, with model outputs held fixed. In a paired test, a model must flag a vulnerable function and clear its version after a fixing commit. Three choices that published evaluations make differently were varied one at a time: metric, verdict extraction and output budget. Seven frontier and large open models were evaluated on five released pair benchmarks and a set pooled for this work under one protocol, and 61 open models of 1.5B to 36B parameters on the pooled set. Function-level F1 follows how often a model flags both functions of a pair (Spearman $+0.86$ over 42 combinations) and is nearly unrelated to pair-level correctness ($+0.16$). On the pair score, extraction changes a model's number by $+0.001$ at the median and budget by $+0.02$ with an interval through zero, whereas the model changes a benchmark's number by up to 0.18 and the benchmark a model's by up to 0.16; a function-level score therefore measures flag rate more than model. For 37 of 68 models the difference between correct and reversed pairs is within its 95% interval of zero, the value for a null model that flags each function at a fixed rate, while both-flagged and both-cleared rates exceed that null by 0.055 on median, and for 64 of 68 both functions of a pair receive one answer more often than independence predicts: verdicts are determined by the text common to both functions. On length-matched pairs a linear probe on activations separates 0.78 by within-pair ranking, against 0.64 for a tf-idf baseline and 0.5 for length; the generated verdict is near chance for three of six models and at 0.55 to 0.57 for the other three, and a prompted logit is at chance for all six.

</details>


### [1095] [Optimizing H-Graph Hybridization for Diffusion-Guided RRT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32897)
*Omer Talmi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出两种推理时多样化策略（因子多样性与仅精修多样性），通过H-Graph混合方法应用于预训练的DiTree扩散规划器，在AntMaze机器人上验证其能生成更短、更优的轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散模型的采样运动规划器单次运行即可产生高质量轨迹，但推理时的随机多样性尚未被充分利用，存在提升轨迹质量的潜在空间。

Method: 针对固定的预训练DiTree模型，提出两种推理时多样化策略：(1)因子多样性，扫描随机种子与扩散目标偏置(DGB)参数；(2)仅精修多样性，扫描控制RRT轨迹编辑程度的扩散精修强度(RS)。两者通过H-Graph混合方法结合，并与单次运行基线和基于池的统计进行比较。

Result: 在15个迷宫场景的完整AntMaze机器人上评估。H-Graph将因子与仅精修多样性的平均池长度分别提升18.8%和14.5%，最佳个体候选长度分别提升9.7%和6.8%，相比成功基线轨迹长度分别提升18.2%和19.9%。

Conclusion: 推理时参数变化是一种可靠、免训练的路径多样性来源，H-Graph混合方法能可靠地将这种多样性转化为更短、更高质量的轨迹。

Abstract: Sampling-based motion planners guided by diffusion models produce high-quality trajectories in a single run, yet the stochastic diversity available at inference time is left largely unexploited. We present two inference-time diversification strategies for a fixed, pretrained DiTree model, combined via H-Graph hybridization, and evaluate them on a holonomic AntMaze robot across 15 maze scenarios. The first, factorial diversity, sweeps the random seed and Diffusion Goal Bias (DGB) parameter, the second, refinement-only diversity, sweeps the diffusion refinement strength (RS) that controls how much an RRT-generated trajectory is edited. Because a single-run baseline only partially succeeds, we additionally compare H-Graph results with pool-based statistics. H-Graph improves the mean pool length of the factorial and refinement-only diversities by 18.8% and 14.5%, respectively. In addition, it also improves the best individual candidate's lengths by 9.7% and 6.8%, respectively. And last, compared with the successful baseline's trajectory length, it improves the results by 18.2% and 19.9%, respectively. These results show that inference-time parameter variation is a reliable, training-free source of path diversity, and that H-Graph hybridization reliably converts this diversity into shorter, higher quality trajectories.

</details>


### [1096] [When Less Compute Is More: Adaptive Early Exit Improves Pretrained Outlier Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32898)
*Tianyang Zhou,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个针对预训练离群检测模型的深度自适应早退研究：最优中间层退出不仅能提效，还能平均提升检测性能4.7-7.3%，并提出即插即用路由器选择退出层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表格基础模型对所有数据集固定深度处理，推理成本随数据规模增长；早退通常为提效，但作者发现最优中间层退出还能提升检测性能。

Method: 研究深度自适应早退机制，识别"上下文污染"（in-context样本中混有离群点）这一关键驱动因素；基于检索视角分析近邻样本随深度增加的影响；预训练即插即用路由器（用查询离群标签作为特权信息）选择数据集特定的退出层，不改变基础模型参数与预测头。

Result: 退出最优中间层在三个基础模型上平均提升检测性能4.7-7.3%；当上下文污染匹配自然离群率时增益达13-21%；路由器在三个基准上恢复高达45%的oracle增益，最高1.8倍加速，污染越多增益越大。

Conclusion: 早退不仅提效还能提升检测性能，上下文污染是关键机制；提出的后处理路由器能有效选择退出层，实现性能与效率双赢。

Abstract: Pretrained tabular foundation models process every dataset at a fixed depth, with inference costs growing with dataset size. To address this, we present the first study of depth-adaptive early-exit for pretrained outlier detection models. While early-exit is typically motivated by efficiency, we uncover a surprising benefit: exiting at the optimal intermediate layer can also improve detection performance on diverse real-world benchmarks by 4.7-7.3% on average, consistent across three distinct foundation models. First, we investigate the factors driving these gains, and identify a key mechanism: context pollution, i.e., the presence of outliers among in-context samples. Our analysis reveals that nearby in-context samples exert increasing influence on query predictions at greater depths, consistent with a retrieval-based view of these models. In effect, early-exit alleviates the adverse effects of retrieving accurate-yet-polluted neighbors, with gains of 13-21% when context pollution matches the natural outlier rate. Motivated by these findings, we pretrain a plug-in router to select a dataset-specific exit layer, using query outlier labels as privileged information available only during router training. The router operates post hoc, leaving the base model parameters and prediction head unchanged. Experiments on three large real-world benchmarks show that, on clean context, the router recovers up to 45% of the oracle gain with up to 1.8x speedup across three pretrained backbones, with larger gains as context pollution increases.

</details>


### [1097] [Predicting the Next State Is Not Enough: JEPA Representations for Lean Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32908)
*Aarnav Choudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究用JEPA式模型做Lean证明搜索的branch ordering，虽然单步排序准确率更高，但不能转化为长时程搜索收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明器需要同时提出tactic并决定探索哪些有效后继状态；作者想验证一步Lean转移能否提供自监督信号用于分支排序。

Method: JEPA式模型预测潜在后继表示，仅对固定预训练ByT5提议器生成的、经kernel验证的非终止后继进行打分，并与InfoNCE对照。

Result: 在同定理排序诊断中JEPA Top-1为50.18%，高于InfoNCE的31.55%；但三seed平均解出987题中的282.3题，低于proposer ordering的308题，且需要更多tactic检查。

Conclusion: 在此设定下，准确的一步转移排序不足以作为长时程搜索价值；受控评估将表示质量与提议质量分离，并以kernel检验的证明完成为主要终点。

Abstract: Neural theorem provers must both propose tactics and decide which valid successor states to explore. We study whether one-step Lean transitions provide a self-supervised signal for branch ordering. A JEPA-style model predicts latent successor representations and scores only kernel-validated, nonterminal successors generated by a fixed pretrained ByT5 proposer. JEPA achieves higher Top-1 than matched InfoNCE on a same-theorem ranking diagnostic(50.18% versus 31.55%), but averages 282.3 of 987 solved theorems across three seeds versus 308 for proposer ordering, while requiring more tactic checks. In this setting, accurate one-step transition ranking is therefore insufficient as a long-horizon search value. The controlled evaluation separates representation from proposal quality and treats kernel-checked proof completion as the primary endpoint.

</details>


### [1098] [Allspark: Weak to Strong Transfer via Alternating Chain of Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32913)
*Kaizhao Liang,Junxiong Wang,Chen Liang,Zhendong Wang,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Allspark 框架，通过弱模型教师与大模型的思维链交替推理，实现无需强模型 rollout 的弱到强迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型 rollout 成本高昂，使大规模强化学习难以验证；希望弱模型学到的推理能力能迁移到强模型，从而节省训练成本。

Method: 训练一个弱教师模型与自身冻结副本交替进行推理片段，由冻结模型给出最终答案；推理时用更强的学生模型替换冻结伙伴，两模型保持固定，通过文本通信实现跨模型家族、跨分词器迁移。在 Qwen 上进行数学与推理的受控实验，并在 ARC-AGI-2 上进行更大规模的 Inkling 实验。

Result: Inkling 实验显示同家族与跨家族（Kimi、Nemotron）设置下均有准确率提升，收益随推理设置而变化。

Conclusion: 训练好的弱教师可复用于多个强学生，并值得进一步研究准确率与 token 消耗之间的权衡。

Abstract: Recent progress in frontier models has renewed interest in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL), but the cost of generating large-model rollouts makes even testing RL recipes expensive. We ask whether reasoning improvements learned by a small, weak model can benefit a larger, stronger model without using the strong model's rollouts during training. We introduce Allspark, a training and inference framework for weak-to-strong transfer through alternating chains of thought. A weak teacher is trained alongside a frozen copy of the same model; the two alternate reasoning segments, and the frozen model produces the final answer. At inference time, a stronger student replaces the frozen training partner, while both models remain fixed. Because they communicate through text, the teacher can steer students from different model families and with different tokenizers. We study Allspark at two scales: controlled Qwen experiments across math and reasoning, and larger-scale Inkling experiments on ARC-AGI-2. The Inkling experiments show accuracy gains in within-family and cross-family settings, including transfer to Kimi and Nemotron, with benefits that vary across inference settings. These findings motivate reusing a trained weak teacher across strong students and examining the resulting accuracy--token tradeoff.

</details>


### [1099] [Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32921)
*Idan Achituve,Lior Dikstein,Idit Diamant,Arnon Netzer,Hai Victor Habi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ALeWM 是一种基于 JEPA 的世界模型，通过将预测信息集中到隐表示的紧凑前缀中，并引入 MixSIGReg 正则化，实现更高效的自适应宽度规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准抗坍缩目标只鼓励隐坐标间的多样性，而不按预测重要性组织坐标，导致预测信息分散，规划效率低。

Method: ALeWM 学习前缀长度的序列条件分布，训练预测器从采样前缀估计完整下一嵌入；提出 MixSIGReg，对掩码嵌入按高斯活跃前缀与零坐标的混合先验加权正则化。

Result: 理论分析表明 MixSIGReg 给早期坐标块更高方差；在特定假设下，将最有用于预测的信息放在早期块可最小化预测误差。实验在已知状态变量的受控动力系统和目标条件视觉控制中，ALeWM 平均成功率一致高于调优的固定宽度 LeWM，且平均规划容量更低。

Conclusion: 按预测重要性组织隐表示前缀能提升世界模型的预测与规划效率，ALeWM 在成功率和规划容量上均优于固定宽度基线。

Abstract: We introduce Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a world model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns to concentrate predictive information in compact prefixes of a wide latent representation. To encourage this ordering, ALeWM learns a sequence-conditioned distribution over prefix lengths and trains the predictor to estimate the full next embedding from a sampled input prefix. As standard anti-collapse objectives encourage variation across latent coordinates and do not organize them by predictive importance, we also introduce MixSIGReg. MixSIGReg regularizes the masked embeddings against a prior-weighted mixture with Gaussian active prefixes and zeros in the remaining coordinates. As a result, the ALeWM objective encourages early coordinates to retain information useful for prediction and recursive planning. Our analysis shows that the mixture distribution used by MixSIGReg assigns higher variance to earlier coordinate blocks and lower variance to later ones. In addition, we show that, under specified assumptions, prediction error is minimized by placing the information most useful for prediction in earlier blocks. Empirically, we study the behavior of ALeWM in a controlled dynamical system with known state variables and in goal-conditioned visual control. We show that ALeWM consistently achieves higher mean success rates than tuned fixed-width LeWM, with lower planning capacity on average.

</details>


### [1100] [The Geometry of Logic: Stratification Induces Semantic Structure and Robust Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32927)
*Cristina V. Lopes,Yuangang Li,Justin Tian Jin Chen,Alberto Krone-Martins,Iris Ma,Md Rakib Hossain Misu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出STRAT架构，将残差流划分为Data和Type两个正交子空间，用类型驱动注意力与门控，提升逻辑机制的可学习性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在符号任务上表现好，但不清楚是学到了通用规则还是依赖统计捷径。作者假设稳健推理需要将“值”与“控制其操作的类型”分离。

Method: 提出STRAT，将残差流划分为正交的Data子空间和Type子空间，并基于Type进行注意力和门控来控制Data变换。

Result: 算术实验识别出三种失败模式：Linear Trap、Gradient Wall、Open Gate Trap。算术任务中STRAT将OOD误差中位数相比Transformer降低35倍。在10个任务11个数据集上平均准确率高26个百分点；分布偏移下准确率仅下降2.39个百分点，而Transformer下降11.75个百分点。

Conclusion: 将值与类型的分离作为架构原语可显著提升逻辑机制的可学习性与泛化能力，并带来更可解释的内部逻辑结构。

Abstract: Transformer-based language models perform well on symbolic tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they learn generalizable rules or rely on statistical shortcuts. Mechanistic studies link algorithmic behavior to structured internal representations, motivating the hypothesis that robust reasoning benefits from separating values from the types that control their manipulation. Can making this separation an architectural primitive improve the learnability and generalization of logical mechanisms? We introduce \textbf{STRAT} (\textbf{ST}ratified \textbf{R}egisters \textbf{A}nd \textbf{T}ypes), which partitions the residual stream into orthogonal Data and Type subspaces and uses Type-based attention and gating to govern Data transformations. Controlled arithmetic ablations identify three failure modes associated with data-control interference: the Linear Trap, Gradient Wall, and Open Gate Trap. Mechanistic analysis reveals interpretable logical structure, and in arithmetic, STRAT reduces median OOD error 35-fold relative to a Transformer baseline. On each of 11 datasets spanning 10 tasks, STRAT outperforms the Transformer baseline in mean accuracy, by 26 percentage points on average, with both models trained from 10 base examples per dataset using identical task-specific augmentation where applicable. Under distribution shift, STRAT's mean accuracy drops by only 2.39 percentage points, compared with 11.75 for the Transformer.

</details>


### [1101] [Phenomenon-Graph JEPA: Label-Efficient Representation Learning for Contactless Cardiorespiratory Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32928)
*Constantino Álvarez Casado,Nhi Nguyen,Mohammad Rakibur Rahman,Le Nguyen,Manuel Lage Cañellas,Sasan Sharifipour,Miguel Bordallo López*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Phenomenon-Graph JEPA，一种无负样本、无合成增强的联合嵌入预测架构，从四路一维信号中学习心肺波形表示；在 OMuSense-23 上提升标签效率，但生理先验（typed edges）的增益未被对照组证实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波雷达与 RGB-D 相机可无接触连续记录心肺波形，但监督标签需专门采集会话，标注数据稀缺。自监督预训练可利用无标注信号，然而对比学习依赖信号变换与负样本对，而这两者对心肺数据的有效性存疑：时间扭曲会改变呼吸频率，且相隔较远的窗口可能处于相同生理状态。

Method: Phenomenon-Graph JEPA 在 base 配置下不使用负样本对与合成增强。四路处理后的一维流各由时序卷积分支与带限谱分支编码；预训练时预测被停止梯度的目标嵌入，沿类型化边连接——同生理现象的流之间，以及同一状态片段内的时间前向边。将该"生理类型化"视为可检验假设，与错误边图、全对图对照。另有可选 Takens 式延迟坐标。

Result: 在 OMuSense-23 上，预训练相比匹配的监督训练在标签效率面积上提升 3.91 个百分点（95% 区间 2.08–5.80，Holm 校正 p=0.006），第二配置在同批测试受试者上提升 3.74 点；但错误边与全对对照未表明生理类型化带来增益。Takens 延迟坐标在验证比较中优于学习历史，两项仅手腕的 WESAD 协议未显示预训练优势。

Conclusion: 研究区分了预测性表示所带来的实测收益与用于组织训练的生理先验；即表示学习本身有效，但生理类型化边的额外价值尚未被证实。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar and RGB-D cameras can record cardiac and respiratory waveforms continuously and without contact, but labeled recordings remain scarce because every label requires a supervised acquisition session. Self-supervised pretraining can exploit the unlabeled signals, yet contrastive methods depend on signal transformations and negative pairs whose validity is uncertain for cardiorespiratory data, where time warping changes breathing rate and distant windows can share the same physiological state. We present Phenomenon-Graph JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns from four processed one-dimensional streams without negative pairs or synthetic augmentation in its base configuration. Each stream is encoded by a temporal convolutional branch and a band-limited spectral branch. During pretraining, the model predicts stopped target embeddings along typed edges, which connect streams assigned to the same physiological phenomenon, and forward in time within a state episode. We treat this physiological typing as a testable hypothesis and compare it with wrong-edge and all-pairs prediction graphs. In the OMuSense-23 dataset, pretraining improves label-efficiency area over matched supervised training by 3.91 percentage points (95% interval 2.08 to 5.80, Holm-adjusted p = 0.006), and by 3.74 points under a second configuration evaluated on the same test participants. However, the wrong-edge and all-pairs controls do not establish a benefit from physiological typing. Optional Takens-inspired delay coordinates improve a validation comparison with learned history, whereas two wrist-only WESAD protocols do not establish a pretraining advantage. The study therefore separates the measured benefit of predictive representations from the physiological prior used to organize their training.

</details>


### [1102] [Efficient Dynamic Algorithms for Graph Neural Networks with Non-Linear Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32929)
*Kiarash Banihashem,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Silvio Lattanzi,Danny Mittal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非线性的GNN传播在动态图（边插入/删除）下的高效节点表示维护问题，提出基于残差的动态算法，可选择性传播局部误差，在度归一化误差保证下实现每次更新摊还O(1/ε)时间，线性情形另给精确算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数GNN假设静态拓扑，在边随时间变化的网络上网低效；现有动态方法要么仅关注时序GNN架构而忽略高效动态维护，要么局限于基于Personalized PageRank的线性传播模型。作者希望在无学习参数的非线性传播下，支持边插入删除的高效维护。

Method: 传播无学习参数、仅后接分类器训练。对一大类标准激活函数，提出基于残差的动态算法：通过push操作选择性传播局部误差，维护演化不动点的近似而无需完全重算。采用度缩放范数下的势能分析；线性特例另用低秩矩阵求逆更新给出精确动态算法。

Result: 在度归一化误差保证下，证明每次图变化摊还O(1/ε)更新时间；方法无需对更新序列或输入向量作随机性假设（区别于线性情形先前工作）。基准数据集实验表明引入非线性提升了精度，同时保持高效更新性能。

Conclusion: 该工作给出可扩展且有理论依据的动态图上非线性GNN传播维护方法，兼顾精度与更新效率，并覆盖线性特例的精确动态算法。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used for representation learning on graphs, but most methods assume static topologies, making them inefficient on evolving networks where edges change over time. Existing dynamic approaches either model graph evolution through temporal GNN architectures without focusing on efficient dynamic maintenance, or are restricted to linear propagation models based on Personalized PageRank.
  In this work, we study how to efficiently maintain node representations for non-linear GNN propagation under edge insertions and deletions. The propagation has no learned parameters, and only a classifier applied afterward is trained. For a broad class of standard activation functions, we develop a residual-based dynamic algorithm that selectively propagates local errors via push operations, maintaining an approximation to the evolving fixed point without full recomputation. We prove that our method achieves amortized $O(1/ε)$ update time per graph change under a degree-normalized error guarantee. Our approach uses a potential-based analysis in a degree-scaled norm and, in contrast to prior work on the linear case, requires no randomness assumptions on either the update sequence or the input vector. For the linear special case, we additionally provide an exact dynamic algorithm via low-rank matrix inverse updates. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that incorporating non-linearity improves accuracy while preserving efficient update performance, yielding a scalable and theoretically grounded method for maintaining this propagation on dynamic graphs.

</details>


### [1103] [Counting on Thinking: Tracing Evidence Integration in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32932)
*Jingming Xue,Robert C. Wilson,Huadong Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探究LLM为何连计数这类基础操作都需System 2思考。证据整合任务显示：直接回答的证据权重不均、近因效应强、难度提升时准确率下降；思考使权重趋于均匀并重建累计计数，但注意力仍集中于序列两端。反馈学习无法将计算内化为直接能力，性能反而恶化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类与动物能自动（System 1）完成计数等基本操作，而LLM面对简单计数也需耗费推理（System 2）。作者想弄清：为何这类操作在LLM中仍需"思考"，思考究竟补足了什么。

Method: 借用心理学/神经科学的证据整合范式：每轮对话呈现一个字母，最后问两个目标字母哪个出现更多。最优策略是维持"计数差"并等权更新。对比直接回答与思考模式，分析证据整合权重、注意力分布、推理轨迹与token成本；并用上下文强化学习（ICRL）测试反馈能否将计算内化。

Result: 直接回答权重不均、近因效应强、难度升高时正确答案概率下降。思考提升表现并使权重近乎均匀，但最终查询注意力在两种模式下都集中于序列两端。推理轨迹显示模型反复回看输入、重数、核验中间计数。推理token成本主要随字母数量增长而非连贯性。ICRL下性能随重复博弈下降、近因效应增强，但模型更自信。

Conclusion: 思考是在"构造"直接回答所缺失的累计计数，而非读出已形成的计数。人类与动物能将此类计算摊销为自动过程，而当前LLM每次都要付出思考代价。哪些操作可通过学习直接可用，是未来模型计算分配的核心问题。

Abstract: Finite computational resources force a tradeoff between automatic System 1 processes and costly System 2 thinking. Large language models (LLMs) can spend extra computation on hard problems, yet direct answers struggle even with counting, an elementary operation humans and animals perform automatically. We ask why this requires thinking in LLMs. Evidence integration has long been used in psychology and neuroscience to probe decision-making. Our evidence-integration task presents one letter per conversational turn and asks which of two target letters appeared more often. A running count difference solves the task optimally by weighting every letter equally; tokens at each turn could represent and update this difference. Direct responses instead weighted evidence unevenly, with strong recency effects, and assigned less probability to the correct answer as difficulty increased. Thinking improved performance and made integration weights nearly uniform, yet final-query attention remained concentrated on the sequence ends in both modes. Reasoning trajectories showed models revisiting input, recounting letters, and checking intermediate counts that informed the answer, suggesting that thinking constructs the accumulated count that direct responses lack rather than reading out one already formed. Reasoning-token costs grew with the number of letters far more than with coherence. Outcome feedback did not bring this computation into direct responses: under in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL), performance deteriorated over repeated games and recency effects strengthened, yet models grew more confident. Humans and animals amortize such computations into automatic processes, whereas current LLMs still pay for them with thinking on every trial. Which operations learning can make directly available remains central to how future models allocate computation.

</details>


### [1104] [Last-Iterate Guarantees for Online Reinforcement Learning in Structured Constrained MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32933)
*Nam Phuong Tran,Trinh Ha Mai Huynh,Tuyen Pham Le,Van-Truong Nguyen,Quan Nguyen,Long Tran-Thanh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用的、统计高效的框架，用于结构化约束MDP（CMDP）中的末次迭代收敛保证，支持无模型在线/离线学习与结构化函数逼近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键应用中只部署单一策略，需要末次迭代（而非平均或混合策略）的性能与约束满足保证；现有结果仅限于精确梯度或表格在线场景，缺乏面向大规模结构化问题的可扩展方法。

Method: 将正则化原始-对偶动力学的收缩性与在线探索下策略评估的演员逼近和统计误差分离分析；采用乐观策略评估避免显式转移模型构建，用紧凑参数化演员避免维护历史策略混合。针对线性CMDP和一般函数逼近进行实例化。

Result: 得到依赖表示复杂度的界，并相比先前的乐观正则化原始-对偶分析改进了对目标精度的依赖；合成线性CMDP实验验证正则化方法末次迭代稳定，非正则化版本振荡更大。

Conclusion: 该框架为结构化CMDP的末次迭代收敛提供了可扩展且统计高效的理论保证，并得到实验支持。

Abstract: In safety-critical applications, deployment uses a single policy, whose performance and constraint satisfaction should hold directly rather than only for an average or mixture of training policies. This motivates last-iterate guarantees in constrained reinforcement learning. Recent progress has established such guarantees in exact-gradient or tabular online settings, yet scalable results for structured large-state problems remain open. We develop a general, statistically efficient framework for last-iterate convergence in structured Constrained MDPs (CMDPs). Our analysis separates contraction of the regularised primal-dual dynamics from actor approximation and statistical errors in policy evaluation under online exploration. This enables model-free on- and off-policy learning with structured function approximation: optimistic policy evaluation avoids explicit transition-model construction, while a compact parametric actor avoids maintaining mixtures or histories of past policies. We instantiate the framework for linear CMDPs and general function approximation, obtaining representation-dependent complexity and improved target-accuracy dependence over prior optimistic regularised primal-dual analyses. We further validate the stabilising effect predicted by our theory on a synthetic linear CMDP: the regularised method exhibits stable last-iterate behaviour, whereas its unregularised counterpart shows larger oscillations.

</details>


### [1105] [The Impact of Stochasticity on the Rashomon Effect in Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32934)
*Andrea Apicella,Francesco Isgrò,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文实证研究神经网络训练中三种随机性来源（权重初始化、小批量数据顺序、dropout）如何分别影响Rashomon效应的三个维度：解空间多重性、预测多重性和决策依据多重性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络训练的随机性（如权重初始化）会导致模型各异但性能相近，这通常被归为Rashomon效应。然而，不同训练随机性来源是否以相似或不同方式贡献于Rashomon效应的各种表现尚不清楚。

Method: 沿三个互补维度（解空间多重性、预测多重性、决策依据多重性）量化Rashomon现象，分别用经验Rashomon集大小、预测模糊度、XAI归因图一致性度量。独立控制三种标准随机性来源（权重初始化、小批量数据顺序、dropout），隔离其对各维度的贡献。在表格和图像分类基准上实验。

Result: 不同随机性来源以不同方式影响三个维度。较大的经验Rashomon集不一定对应更大的预测分歧或更低的解释一致性，表明三种多重性捕捉的是互补而非可互换的Rashomon效应方面。

Conclusion: 训练随机性不仅影响预测性能，还影响预测与解释的稳定性。在评估神经网络模型的可靠性、可复现性和可解释性时，需识别造成Rashomon现象不同表现的具体随机性来源。

Abstract: Neural network training is inherently stochastic, with factors such as weight initialization leading to distinct models despite comparable predictive performance. This phenomenon is commonly associated with the Rashomon effect, which describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models for the same task. Although the Rashomon effect has received increasing attention, it remains unclear whether different sources of training stochasticity contribute similarly or differently to its manifestations. In this work, we present an empirical study of the Rashomon phenomenon along three complementary dimensions: solution-space multiplicity, predictive multiplicity, and decision-basis multiplicity. These dimensions are quantified through the size of the empirical Rashomon set, predictive ambiguity, and agreement between XAI attribution maps, respectively. By independently controlling three standard sources of stochasticity, namely weight initialization, mini-batch data ordering, and dropout, we isolate their respective contributions to each dimension of the Rashomon phenomenon. Experiments on tabular and image classification benchmarks reveal that these sources affect the three dimensions in different ways. In particular, larger empirical Rashomon sets do not necessarily correspond to greater predictive disagreement or lower explanation agreement, indicating that solution-space, predictive, and decision-basis multiplicity capture complementary rather than interchangeable aspects of the Rashomon effect. Overall, our results show that training stochasticity influences not only predictive performance but also the stability of predictions and explanations, highlighting the importance of identifying the specific sources of stochasticity responsible for different manifestations of the Rashomon phenomenon when assessing the reliability, reproducibility, and interpretability of neural network models.

</details>


### [1106] [Theory of Scene: Breaking the Symmetry Trap in Multi-Agent LLM Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32939)
*Liangqi Yuan,Wenzhi Fang,Shiqiang Wang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Theory of Scene (ToS)，一种免训练推理模式，通过让同构LLM智能体读取各自的公开角色和任务情境来协调无通信下的并发行动，将同构性从失败根源转化为解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统高度同构，智能体行为趋同。在无通信并发行动时，它们会在需分割的目标上碰撞、在需共同占领的目标上分散，形成"对称陷阱"(symmetry trap)。常用的心智理论(ToM)无法逃脱该陷阱，因为同构智能体会形成相同预测并作出相同反应。

Method: 提出ToS免训练推理模式：每个智能体读取其公开角色（智能体间唯一的差异）和共同观察的任务情境。通过角色门控(role gating)判断所有权是重叠还是已划分；通过任务耦合(task coupling)推断团队对每个目标是需收敛、分割还是轮流执行阶段。同构智能体由此推导出统一分工，各取角色所定部分。

Result: 在自建DivvyBench（含Tabletop、Airspace、Household场景，目标类型分Competitive/Cooperative/Mixed）及GovSim、Overcooked两个基准上，ToS全面超越全部六个基线。相同输入下相比ToM，DivvyBench成功率从71.1%提升至99.6%，GovSim总收益从207提升至400，Overcooked关卡归一吞吐量从1.41提升至1.67。

Conclusion: ToS利用公开角色作为唯一差异化信息，将同构性由对称陷阱的成因转化为治愈手段，实现无通信的多智能体协调，并在多个基准上取得一致且显著的领先。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are largely homogeneous, as their agents behave alike even across distinct LLMs. We show that when such agents act concurrently without communication, they collide on targets they must split and diverge on targets they must take together, a double failure we term the symmetry trap. Theory of Mind (ToM), widely used for coordination without communication, cannot escape this trap, since homogeneous agents form the same prediction of one another and respond to it in the same way. We propose Theory of Scene (ToS), a training-free reasoning schema in which each agent reads its public role, the only difference between the agents, and the task context they all observe. Homogeneous agents thereby derive one division of labor, each taking the part its role fixes, which turns homogeneity from the cause of the trap into the cure. ToS reads the role together with the scene through role gating, which determines whether ownership overlaps or is already divided, and the task context through task coupling, which infers whether the team must converge on each target, divide it, or take its stages in turn. We evaluate on DivvyBench, a controlled environment we introduce, whose target types make an episode Competitive, Cooperative, or Mixed across Tabletop, Airspace, and Household scenarios, and on two established agentic benchmarks, GovSim and Overcooked. ToS outperforms all six baselines on every benchmark, and each baseline falls far behind it in at least one setting. Against ToM given the same inputs, ToS raises the DivvyBench success rate from 71.1% to 99.6%, the GovSim total gain from 207 to 400, and the Overcooked level-normalized throughput from 1.41 to 1.67.

</details>


### [1107] [TwinS-GCN: Spectral conjugate for Spectral Graph Convolutional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32940)
*Chun Hei Michael Chan,Flavia Petruso,Dimitri Van De Ville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对图卷积网络中深度带来的过平滑与长程依赖矛盾，提出利用谱共轭分解移位算子为耗散与非耗散两部分，构造sum与ratio两类非全纯核滤波器，并实现TwinS-GCN，在降低深度的情况下解决图迁移任务并取得竞争性节点分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图卷积通过重复局部聚合传播信息，K层网络覆盖K跳邻域：一方面会导致过平滑，另一方面长程依赖又需要深度。远距离传输且不衰减的信息要求移位算子是定向的，而对称算子无法区分流向，只有有向算子可以。直接取笛卡尔分解的斜对称部分虽能提取方向性，但一般不与移位算子对易，导致滤波器非移位不变，因此需要新方法。

Method: 作者采用谱共轭，即算子τ: z↦\bar{z}下的像，它与移位算子对易且将其分为耗散与非耗散部分。由此得到两类滤波器：sum滤波器，其非耗散分量无能量损耗地传输信号；ratio滤波器，按分量对的比值定义而非移位的多项式。两者均源自非全纯核，超出经典谱卷积所依赖的全纯类。在有向环上，ratio滤波器变为具有全局冲激响应的IIR滤波器，并证明其相对任意度-K多项式滤波器存在长程可达差距。通过Chebyshev重参数化得到顶点域稳定层，实系数，形成TwinS-GCN。

Result: 在有向环上证明ratio滤波器具有全局冲激响应，且相对任意度-K多项式滤波器存在长程可达差距。TwinS-GCN在图迁移任务中以更小的深度完成求解，并在节点分类基准上与最先进的图卷积网络具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 利用谱共轭分解移位算子得到的非全纯sum与ratio滤波器，突破了经典全纯谱卷积的限制，能够在低深度下实现长程、无衰减的方向性信息传输。TwinS-GCN在保持稳定顶点域层的同时，实现了竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Graph convolutional networks propagate information by repeated local aggregation through a graph shift operator; i.e., a $K$-layer network reaches $K$ hops neighborhood. On the one hand, such spreading can lead to oversmoothing. On the other hand, long-range dependencies demand the depth. Transporting information on long distances and without attenuation requires the shift to distinguish a direction of flow, which a symmetric operator cannot perform but a directed one can fulfill. A natural way to extract pure-directionality is to take the skew-symmetric part of the shift operator through the Cartesian split, which, however, generally does not commute with the shift itself, meaning that the filters built on it are not shift-invariant. We instead use the spectral conjugate; i.e., the image of the operator under $τ:z\mapsto \bar{z}$, which commutes with the shift and splits it into a dissipative and a non-dissipative part. Two filter families follow: a sum filter, whose non-dissipative component transports signal without energy loss, and a ratio filter, ratio in the pair of components rather than polynomial in the shift. Both arise from non-holomorphic kernels, placing them outside the holomorphic class underlying classical spectral convolution. On the directed cycle, the ratio filter becomes an IIR filter with global impulse response, for which we prove a long-range reach gap against every degree-$K$ polynomial filter. Chebyshev reparameterization gives stable vertex-domain layers with real coefficients, yielding TwinS-GCN, which solves graph transfer tasks at reduced depth and is competitive with state-of-the-art graph convolutional networks on node classification benchmarks.

</details>


### [1108] [Optimal Nonparametric Dynamic Pricing with Censored Demand and Adversarial Inventory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32949)
*Mengxiao Zhang,Yingfei Wang,Haipeng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带删失需求的在线动态定价，在一般非参数设定下提出Double-Grid-UCB和Threshold-UCB算法，后者达到近最优的Õ(T^{2/3})遗憾并证明其极小极大最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作（Xu et al. 2026）虽达到Õ(√T)遗憾，但依赖线性需求、价格无关加性噪声及库存-噪声支撑条件等强结构假设，适用性受限。作者希望将框架推广到更一般、统计上更难的非参数设定：仅假设期望销量随价格非增，允许非线性需求曲线和价格相关噪声。

Method: 针对库存水平在定价前任意揭示且可适应历史观测、需求服从未知平稳价格相关分布的情形：首先提出基线算法Double-Grid-UCB，对价格与库存均离散化，并为每个价格-库存网格对单独估计收益，获得Õ(T^{3/4})遗憾；进而提出Threshold-UCB，通过共享的需求尾部概率估计在多个库存水平间复用销量观测，使同一数据可为多个库存提供收益上界，将遗憾改进至Õ(T^{2/3})。

Result: Double-Grid-UCB达到Õ(T^{3/4})期望遗憾；Threshold-UCB达到Õ(T^{2/3})期望遗憾，并通过从随机标价定价的归约给出Ω(T^{2/3})下界，证明其极小极大最优性。实验覆盖多种库存过程、需求函数和噪声模型，Threshold-UCB持续优于基准算法。

Conclusion: 该工作将删失需求在线定价从受限参数化设定推广到一般非参数设定，Threshold-UCB以跨库存共享尾部信息的方式达到Õ(T^{2/3})遗憾并具有极小极大最优性，实验验证其优越性能。

Abstract: We study online dynamic pricing with censored demand, where an arbitrary inventory level is revealed before pricing and may adapt to past observations, while demand follows an unknown, price-dependent distribution that is stationary over time. For a horizon of $T$ rounds, Xu et al. [2026] achieved $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under restrictive structural assumptions including linear demand, price-independent additive noise, and conditions relating inventory levels to the noise support. Our first contribution is to extend this framework to a substantially more general and statistically harder nonparametric setting, requiring only the natural assumption that expected sales are nonincreasing in price and allowing nonlinear demand curves and price-dependent noise. For this model, we first propose a simple baseline, Double-Grid-UCB, which discretizes both price and inventory and achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret using separate revenue estimates for each price-inventory grid pair. Then, we develop Threshold-UCB, which improves the expected regret to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{2/3})$. Unlike Double-Grid-UCB, Threshold-UCB reuses sales observations across inventory levels through shared estimates of demand-tail probabilities, allowing the same data to support revenue upper bounds for multiple inventories rather than a single inventory bin. We also complement this upper bound with an $Ω(T^{2/3})$ lower bound via a reduction from stochastic posted pricing, establishing its minimax optimality. Finally, extensive experiments across inventory processes, demand functions, and noise models demonstrate consistently superior performance of Threshold-UCB over benchmark algorithms.

</details>


### [1109] [Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32952)
*Boyang Li,Matthew Kim,Sylvia Herbert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAFALE：一种离策略 actor-critic 安全强化学习方法，用 flow 策略直接对增强拉格朗日目标求导，无需估计 score，并用动能正则替代熵正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有原始-对偶方法受多模态动作分布困扰：高斯 actor 会塌缩到单一次优模态，非凸拉格朗日优化不稳定。扩散/流策略能表达多模态分布，但已有扩散 actor 需估计并匹配增强拉格朗日目标策略的 score，增加复杂度。

Method: 直接通过 flow 策略的生成路径对增强目标求导，避免 score 估计。因 flow 策略缺少可用的动作对数密度，采用 FLAC 的无密度动能正则器。将更新形式化为受限单端广义薛定谔桥，证明每个源采样下路径空间问题等价于动作空间的熵正则问题。

Result: 正噪声时，解仅在估计代价超过拉格朗日乘子阈值处对纯奖励分布重新加权；噪声趋零时最优值收敛到流策略直接优化的最小能量映射目标。在七个 Safety-Gymnasium 任务上，RAFALE 均取得有竞争力的奖励且平均最终代价在预算内，而强基线需在两者间权衡；消融验证增强目标与 flow actor 均必要。

Conclusion: RAFALE 通过直接微分增强目标与 flow 策略结合，兼顾奖励与安全约束，克服了多模态与优化不稳定问题，在安全 RL 基准上表现稳健。

Abstract: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. Reward and safety can induce multimodal action distributions, challenging the prevailing primal-dual methods: Gaussian actors may collapse onto a single suboptimal mode, and optimization over the nonconvex Lagrangian landscape can be unstable. Diffusion and flow policies can represent such distributions, but recent work with a diffusion actor relies on estimating and matching the score of an augmented-Lagrangian target policy. Instead, we differentiate the augmented objective directly through the generation path of a flow policy, so no score needs to be estimated. Because a flow policy lacks a readily available action log-density for entropy regularization, we build on the density-free kinetic-energy regularizer of FLAC, a recent reward-only method, and propose Reparameterized Augmented-Lagrangian Flow Actor with Least Energy (RAFALE), an off-policy actor-critic method for safe RL. We formulate its update as a constrained one-ended generalized Schrödinger bridge and show that, for each source draw, this path-space problem is exactly an entropy-regularized problem in action space. At positive noise, its solution reweights the reward-only action distribution only where the estimated cost exceeds a threshold set by the Lagrange multiplier. As the noise vanishes, the optimal value converges to that of a least-energy map objective that the flow policy optimizes directly. Across seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks, RAFALE achieves competitive reward with mean final cost within budget on every task, whereas strong baselines trade one for the other; ablations support the necessity of both its augmented objective and its flow actor.

</details>


### [1110] [Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32961)
*Ritul Satish,Prasoon Sinha,Akiho Kawada,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 系统研究LLM agent历史压缩策略，在3个开源模型和2个基准上运行约3.5万次，发现token更少不等于更快更省，相同成功率可解不同任务，需按任务/模型/负载定制压缩策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent任务变长，需压缩推理、动作与工具输出历史以省token，但压缩会改变后续决策可用信息。现有框架将"压缩什么、何时压缩、压缩多少"捆绑为固定策略，缺乏系统性拆解与分析。

Method: 在SWE-bench Verified与Terminal-Bench 1.0上，对3个开源权重模型系统性变化压缩决策的各个维度，共进行近35,000次agent运行。

Result: 测量任务成功率、token用量、端到端延迟与估计成本。发现token更少不一定更快或更便宜：Qwen在Terminal-Bench上，约用1/3 token的策略可能比未压缩agent慢20-80%。成功率相近的策略可解决不同任务，同一策略跨模型表现差异大。

Conclusion: 应以压缩对agent执行的影响来评估压缩，并针对任务、模型与工作负载定制策略。

Abstract: As LLM agents tackle longer tasks, they increasingly compress growing histories of reasoning, actions, and tool outputs. Compression can reduce token use, but it also changes the information available for later decisions. Existing agentic harnesses bundle decisions about what to compress, when to compress, and how much to remove into fixed policies. A systematic characterization is needed to disentangle these decisions and reveal how each affects task success and execution cost. We systematically vary these decisions across three open-weight models on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 1.0. Across nearly 35,000 agent runs, we measure task success, token use, end-to-end latency, and estimated cost. We find that fewer tokens need not mean faster or cheaper execution: on Terminal-Bench with Qwen, policies using roughly one-third as many tokens can take 20-80% longer than the uncompressed agent. Policies with similar overall success can solve different tasks, while the same policy can perform quite differently across models. Our results motivate evaluating compression by its effects on agent execution and tailoring policies to the task, model, and workload.

</details>


### [1111] [Self-Confirming Superposition Traps in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32966)
*Dai Shi,Andi Han,Feng Chen,Yiqun Duan,Junbin Gao,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文揭示强化学习中表示学习与策略反馈可能形成"自确认叠加陷阱"，使次优策略被自我强化，并提出理论分析与缓解方法（如保留被忽视状态、调整回放权重、保护性拟合）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL中策略选择数据、数据训练表示、回报再指导策略，这一闭环可能导致即使表示拟合全局最优，依然维持低回报策略。作者想解释并刻画这种失效机制。

Method: 在关联两步模型中刻画可产生陷阱的特征维度；分析特征频率、持续访问、独立控制器学习的影响；在有限动作模型中界定回报扭曲程度并推导回放条件；用PPO神经网络实验观察反馈演化；测试保留被忽视状态、调整回放权重、降低特征重叠等干预。

Result: 理论表明被回避动作可因访问权重偏差而失去回报优势；回放条件可保留最优动作排序。PPO实验中，不同初始化的智能体形成不同干扰模式、相反回报排序和不同最终策略。保留被忽视状态降低干扰、改善序贯回报；冻结编码器也有收益；干预在MiniGrid、DMControl上提升控制；保护性拟合提升DreamerV3-Crafter训练累计分数。

Conclusion: RL中的表示-策略反馈可造成自我确认的次优循环，但通过保护被忽视状态、调节回放权重和减少特征重叠等干预，可以在相同容量下改善控制与训练表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains representations on data selected by the agent's policy, which then uses the resulting returns to guide its next choices. We show that this loop can sustain a lower-return policy even when representation fitting is globally optimal on those data. In a self-confirming superposition trap, every optimal code assigns overlapping directions to features that rarely occur together under the current policy. An alternative action brings them together, causing interference that lowers its return and reinforces avoidance, although refitting to that action would yield more return at the same capacity. We characterize the dimensions admitting a trap in a tied two-step model and show separately that equal feature frequencies, continued visitation, and independent controller learning need not prevent it. Because fitting weights errors by visitation, an avoided action can lose its return advantage at little cost to the objective. In a finite-action model, we bound this distortion and derive a replay condition: sufficient training weight on the best separately adapted action preserves its ranking despite residual error. Neural PPO experiments show how the feedback develops during learning: agents initialized toward different actions develop different interference patterns, opposite mean return rankings, and different final policies at the same capacity. We therefore test whether retaining access to neglected states can improve control. Keeping these states in training reduces measured interference and improves sequential return, with gains even when the encoder is frozen. Related interventions on state access, replay weights, and feature overlap improve control on MiniGrid and DMControl. For agents that learn through a world model, protected fitting improves DreamerV3--Crafter's cumulative training scores at unchanged capacity.

</details>


### [1112] [Adaptive Ensemble Selection for Noisy Labels on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32976)
*Faizaan Ali,Inwon Kang,Oshani Seneviratne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向AI数据科学的数据中心推理模块，用元模型对多种标签噪声检测器动态加权，实现自动诊断数据集质量并选择清洗策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据集中的错误或损坏标签会严重损害监督学习性能，尤其是特征空间中难以察觉的隐蔽误标。在自动化/AI增强的数据科学流程中，鲁棒地检测此类标签噪声对构建可靠模型至关重要。

Method: 给定数据集，由元模型预测一组多样检测器的权重，检测器涵盖置信度类、邻域类和分布类方法，从而自动诊断数据质量并选择清洗策略。方法强调基于描述符的、以数据为中心的集成。

Result: 在受控噪声的基准数据集上，平均性能与Confident Learning基线相当，但在异构情形下存在依赖数据集的正负差异；并显示检测器有效性与数据集属性之间存在系统性关联。

Conclusion: 描述符驱动、以数据为中心的集成可作为AI辅助数据科学流程中的组件，用于鲁棒的数据集评估与模型可靠性提升。

Abstract: Incorrect or corrupted labels in tabular datasets can significantly degrade supervised learning performance, particularly when mislabeling is subtle and not easily detectable from feature space alone. In the context of automated or AI-augmented data science workflows, robust detection of such label noise is critical for building reliable models. We propose a data-centric reasoning module for AI data science systems that automatically diagnoses dataset quality and selects appropriate cleaning strategies. Given a dataset, a meta-model predicts weights over a diverse set of detectors, including confidence-based, neighborhood-based, and distributional methods. Across benchmark datasets with controlled noise, our approach achieves performance comparable to a Confident Learning baseline on average, with dataset-dependent gains and losses, particularly in heterogeneous regimes. We further show that detector effectiveness is systematically linked to dataset properties. These results demonstrate the value of descriptor-driven, data-centric ensembling as a component of AI-assisted data-science pipelines for robust dataset assessment and model reliability.

</details>


### [1113] [Feasible Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction via Within-Sampling Primal-Dual Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32980)
*Haoming Chen,Nicolas Zilberstein,Santiago Paternain,Santiago Segarra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出约束原始-对偶PIFM（CPD-PIFM），通过沿轨迹演化的拉格朗日乘子将结构侧信息（度约束、三角形计数、边密度带等）引入图重建采样，无需重训即可提高可行性并保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图重建常带有结构侧信息（度界、三角形数、边密度带），但Prior-Informed Flow Matching（PIFM）虽能从局部先验运输到图分布，却缺乏引入这些约束的机制。

Method: CPD-PIFM在采样器中加入沿每条轨迹演化的拉格朗日乘子；乘子根据预测终点的约束违反情况响应，并指导后续采样步骤，无需重新训练。理论上证明了采样器继承PIFM的置换等变性，并将期望终端违反量上界为随步数平方根倒数衰减的项加两个近似项。

Result: 在三个链接预测基准、九种数据集与约束组合上，CPD-PIFM将可行性提高11-26个百分点，并与固定引导方法保持竞争力，且无需为每个约束单独选择乘子。

Conclusion: CPD-PIFM有效将结构约束融入PIFM采样，提升图重建可行性，同时保持理论性质并避免逐约束调参。

Abstract: Graph reconstruction from partial observations often comes with structural side information, such as degree bounds, triangle counts, or an edge-density band. Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM) reconstructs graphs by transporting a local prior toward the graph distribution, but it provides no mechanism to incorporate this side information. We put forth Constrained Primal-Dual PIFM (CPD-PIFM), which augments the sampler with Lagrange multipliers that evolve along each trajectory. The multipliers respond to constraint violations at a predicted endpoint and guide subsequent sampling steps without retraining. We prove that the sampler inherits PIFM's permutation equivariance and bound its expected terminal slack by a term that decays as the inverse square root of the number of steps, plus two approximation terms. On three link-prediction benchmarks and nine combinations of datasets and constraints, CPD-PIFM raises feasibility by 11-26 percentage points and remains competitive with fixed guidance without selecting a separate multiplier for each constraint.

</details>


### [1114] [What Should Data Teach? Moving Bottlenecks Across Circuit, Store, and Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32991)
*Yixiao Chen,Ke Cheng,Jiangtao Guan,Shuo Huang,Yue Liu,Jun Zhang,Yuhong Liu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 从电路视角揭示语言模型训练的三种瓶颈（形成计算、内容可用、路径选择），并提出"诊断到数据"原则指导监督数据的调整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究数据在训练的不同阶段应教给语言模型什么，识别训练受限的关键操作。

Method: 以电路视角定位缺失操作，保留其因果联系，变化含捷径的上下文并审计残差；通过形成敏感的选择与前置排序、可用性反事实、配对监督与上下文机会排序等方法进行干预。

Result: 在350M模型上，早期电路训练改善后续学习，完整干预序列在特定事实上优于阶段替换控制；早期前缀在100B token内保持验证优势。

Conclusion: 限制操作的变化要求调整监督方式，而非仅重新排列困难样本，条件性仲裁是剩余的前沿问题。

Abstract: What should data teach a language model at a particular point in training? A circuit view reveals three distinct bottlenecks: forming a computation, making its required content available, and selecting among available routes. A shared diagnosis-to-data principle connects them: localize the missing operation, preserve its causal relation, vary shortcut-bearing context, and re-audit the residual. Formation-sensitive selection and prerequisite ordering accelerate a binding-matching-transport path; a brief early prefix from the same training multiset retains a validation advantage through 100B tokens. Availability counterfactuals then distinguish writing content from invoking available memory, while paired supervision and context-opportunity ranking improve matched route decisions and long-context answer likelihood. A continuous 350M-model experiment connects the three interventions on the same facts: early circuit training improves subsequent learning, and the complete sequence outperforms stage-replacement controls on facts withheld from Use teaching. Independent query surfaces and opposed-source decisions expose conditional arbitration as the remaining frontier. Together, these results show why a change in the limiting operation calls for a change in supervision, not merely a new ranking of difficult examples.

</details>


### [1115] [Saturation-Insensitive Dueling Bandits with General Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33011)
*Chenggong Zhang,Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Weitong Zhang,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究BTL偏好模型下的一般函数逼近上下文对决赌博机，提出SI-CDB算法通过启发式对手臂选择实现饱和不敏感的奖励学习，并建立局部Eluder维度框架，消除了不利的1/σ'因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对决赌博机中偏好模型的饱和问题：当奖励模型已能高置信区分两个动作时，偏好反馈信息量变弱，导致奖励估计难以改进。现有样本复杂度分析依赖反导数因子1/σ'[Δr*]，当链接函数σ在大奖励差处饱和时该因子极其巨大。

Method: 提出SI-CDB算法，采用精心设计的启发式对手臂选择策略，实现饱和不敏感的奖励学习；核心分析工具为针对一般函数逼近对决赌博机定制的局部Eluder维度框架。

Result: SI-CDB恢复了线性奖励类的近最优依赖，消除了不利的1/σ'(·)因子；理论结果还解释了为何双臂遗憾分析对提升单臂性能至关重要。

Conclusion: 通过饱和不敏感的算法设计与局部Eluder维度分析，解决了对决赌博机偏好饱和带来的样本复杂度问题，并揭示了双臂与单臂遗憾分析的内在联系。

Abstract: We study contextual dueling bandits with general function approximation under the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) preference model. A key challenge in this setting is the saturation of the preference model: when the current reward model can already distinguish two actions with high confidence, the resulting preference feedback becomes weakly informative, making it difficult to further improve reward estimation. Consequently, existing sample-complexity analyses often depend on the inverse-derivative factor $1 / σ'[Δ_{r^\ast}]$ which can be prohibitively large when the link function $σ$ saturates for large reward gaps $Δ_{r^\ast}$. To address this issue, we introduce `SI-CDB`, an algorithm that selects opponent arms using a carefully designed heuristic for arm selection. This design enables saturation-insensitive reward learning and recovers the near-optimal dependence for linear reward classes, eliminating the unfavorable $1/σ'(\cdot)$ factor. The core of our analysis is a localized Eluder dimension framework tailored to dueling bandits with general function approximation. Our theoretical results also explain why two-arm regret analysis is crucial for improving single-arm performance in dueling bandits.

</details>


### [1116] [Relative Generalization Invariance of LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33016)
*Fengzhuo Zhang,Shuche Wang,Shenggui Li,Tianyu Ruan,Jianliang He,Ivor Tsang,Tianyu Pang,Chao Du,Tianwei Zhang,Zhuoran Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"相对泛化不变性"(RGI)现象，用于区分LLM预训练中优化器/架构与数据流的不同影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练性能受优化器、模型架构和训练数据流三部分共同影响，但各组分如何以不同方式影响性能尚不清楚，作者希望隔离并区分它们各自的作用。

Method: 引入相对泛化不变性(RGI)，即任意两个token之间验证损失差在跨模型时保持不变；在多种优化器和适度架构变化下检验RGI是否成立，并对比训练数据流变化的影响；进一步分析其与NTK、平均场机制的关系，并在过参数化二次模型中证明RGI可以出现。

Result: RGI在广泛的优化器和适度架构变化下近似成立，说明这些选择对token级损失造成近似均匀的偏移；而改变训练数据流会显著改变相对泛化。RGI无法仅用NTK或平均场机制解释，但在过参数化二次模型中可被证明出现。

Conclusion: RGI是LLM预训练中的一个新现象，有助于将优化器和架构的影响与训练数据的影响区分开来。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining performance is jointly shaped by three components of the training triplet: the optimizer, model architecture, and training data stream. However, how these components influence performance in distinct ways remains unclear. We take a first step toward isolating their effects by studying relative generalization. We introduce Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI), the invariance of the validation-loss difference between any two tokens across models. We show that RGI approximately holds across a wide range of optimizers and moderate architectural variations, suggesting that these choices induce an approximately uniform shift in token-wise losses. In contrast, changing the training data stream can substantially alter relative generalization. We further show that RGI cannot be explained by the neural tangent kernel or mean-field regimes alone and prove that it can emerge in an overparameterized quadratic model. Overall, our work identifies RGI as a new phenomenon in LLM pretraining that helps distinguish the effects of optimizers and architectures from those of training data.

</details>


### [1117] [Łukasiewicz Neural Networks Extended: Residual Architectures and Crystallization Strategies for Interpretable Rule Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33028)
*Carlos Leandro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将ResNet残差连接引入Łukasiewicz神经网络，证明其在任意深度下保持符号对应关系，并分析三种权重整数化（crystallization）策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Łukasiewicz神经网络通过整数权重和截断恒等激活实现神经-逻辑对应，可进行符号知识提取，但原方法受限于浅层架构、小数据集：整数化（crystallization）仅概率成功，且深度增加时理论保证失效。

Method: 第一，证明残差连接（ResNet式跳跃连接）可将Łukasiewicz网络扩展到任意深度，同时按构造在merge neurons处保持符号对应；第二，分析三种crystallization策略：修正的Levenberg-Marquardt、直通估计（STE）和近端正则化。

Result: merge neurons在Łukasiewicz残差块中自动满足神经元分类命题，与内层权重无关；内层神经元通过crystallization策略训练向可表示性靠拢。三种crystallization策略的理论保证、失败模式和可解释性权衡得到表征。

Conclusion: 残差连接解决了深度扩展问题，三种整数化策略各有理论保证与失败模式权衡，为可提取符号逻辑的深层网络提供理论基础。

Abstract: A feed-forward neural network whose weights are integers and whose activation is the truncated identity implements, neuron by neuron, the connectives of Łukasiewicz many-valued logic. This exact correspondence --- established theoretically by Castro and Trillas and developed into a training algorithm by Leandro --- enables \emph{symbolic knowledge extraction}: training produces not a black-box model but a logical formula. Two obstacles have limited the approach to shallow architectures and small datasets: crystallization (forcing weights to integers) succeeds only probabilistically under the original Levenberg--Marquardt training scheme, and the theoretical guarantees break down as networks grow deeper.
  This paper addresses both obstacles. First, we prove that \emph{residual connections} (skip connections of the kind used in ResNets) extend Łukasiewicz neural networks to arbitrary depth while preserving the symbolic correspondence \emph{at merge neurons} by construction: merge neurons in a Łukasiewicz residual block automatically satisfy the neuron-classification proposition, regardless of the inner layer weights; inner-layer neurons are trained toward representability by the crystallization strategy. Second, we analyse three crystallization strategies --- Levenberg--Marquardt (corrected), straight-through estimation (STE), and proximal regularization --- characterizing their theoretical guarantees, failure modes, and interpretability trade-offs.

</details>


### [1118] [What Must a World Model Distinguish for Planning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33030)
*Rongzhe Wei,Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Peizhi Niu,Yifan Li,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型在规划中究竟需要保留哪些物理信息，提出“机制充分性/响应充分性/决策充分性”的层级框架，指出所需信息取决于查询、候选集与规划器，并据此提出查询决定“看哪里”、动作条件模型预测“会发生什么”的模块化设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型用于模拟动作候选的后果，但良好规划并不需要保留精确预测所需的全部物理区分。现有世界模型往往预设固定的信息保真度，忽略了规划查询、候选集构造方式以及规划器对信息需求的影响，因此需要厘清“世界模型到底该保留什么”。

Method: 作者将规划对信息的需求形式化为三个层级：机制充分性、响应充分性与决策充分性；分析给定候选集时，规划查询如何决定哪些物理变化重要、需要多高的精度。并在碰撞系统、非线性动力学和机器人规划任务中研究这些效应，同时比较“以查询为条件联合生成动作与结果”的模型与“动作条件世界模型”的表现，进而提出模块化设计：查询决定去哪里搜索，动作条件模型预测会发生什么。

Result: 粗粒度决策可以丢弃预测所需的大量信息，而细粒度决策可能需要几乎相同的分辨率；规划器为构造候选而自适应搜索时，最终选择不需要的信息仍可能对发现好候选有用。实验上，联合生成动作与结果的模型在已见目标上遗憾低于动作条件世界模型，但这一优势在泛化到未见目标时大幅消失。

Conclusion: 世界模型需要保留的信息取决于查询、候选集与规划器，而非固定不变。相比把查询信息直接耦合进结果生成，模块化设计让查询负责决定搜索位置、动作条件模型负责预测结果，可使同一套预测在多个目标间复用，是更可取的规划系统设计方向。

Abstract: World models simulate the consequences of action candidates, but good planning need not preserve every physical distinction required for accurate prediction. We formalize this gap through a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency. Given a candidate set, the planning query determines which physical variations matter and how precisely they must be preserved: coarse decisions can discard much of the information needed for prediction, whereas fine decisions may require nearly the same resolution. In practice, planners often adaptively search to construct candidates, and information unnecessary for final selection may still be needed to discover good candidates. What a world model must preserve therefore depends on the query, the candidate set, and the planner. We study these effects in a collision system, nonlinear dynamics, and robotic planning. These varying requirements raise a design question: where should query information enter the planning system? A model that jointly generates actions and outcomes conditioned on the query achieves lower regret than an action-conditioned world model on seen objectives, but this advantage largely disappears when generalizing to unseen objectives. Motivated by this, we propose a modular design in which the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts what will happen, allowing the same predictions to be reused across objectives.

</details>


### [1119] [Balancing Early Performance Sacrifices with Long-Term Gains: Scaling Learning-Rate Warmup Duration Across Training Horizons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33041)
*Kristi Topollai,Anna Choromanska*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文通过一个二次模型研究学习率warmup时长应固定还是随训练时长增长的问题，提出一个简洁的时长缩放律，能覆盖从几乎无warmup到随时长增长的多种机制，并可解释峰值学习率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型训练中warmup时长长期依赖经验启发（固定步数或固定比例），两者在训练更长时缩放行为差异巨大，缺乏理论指导来判断何时应固定、何时应随训练时长增长。

Method: 构建一个二次模型，其中不同模式对峰值学习率响应不同：warmup会减慢在峰值速率下已良好收缩方向的进度，但能消除接近稳定边界的持续误差；峰值学习率越高越倾向更长warmup。由此推导出时长缩放律。

Result: 得到一个紧凑的时长缩放律，涵盖几乎无warmup、固定时长、随时长增长三种机制，并能刻画峰值学习率如何改变偏好机制。该律可用较短训练拟合，预测更长训练时长的warmup。

Conclusion: warmup的多种熟悉性质可由单一权衡解释；建议将warmup时长视为依赖训练时长的超参数，而非固定的训练启发式。

Abstract: Learning-rate warmup is a standard technique in language-model training, yet its duration remains largely heuristic. Common approaches use either a fixed number of updates or a fixed fraction of the training horizon, two choices that imply very different scaling as training gets longer. When should warmup stay fixed, and when should it grow with the horizon? We address this question with a quadratic model whose modes respond differently to the peak learning rate. Warmup slows progress in directions that already contract well at the peak rate, but can remove persistent error in directions near the stability edge, with higher peak rates shifting the balance toward longer warmup durations. This yields a compact horizon scaling law that captures regimes ranging from essentially no warmup, through fixed-duration warmup, to durations that grow with the training horizon, and explains how the preferred regime changes with peak learning rate. Because the law captures the tradeoff between giving up early progress and improving the trajectory that follows, it can be fit using shorter runs and used to predict warmup at substantially longer horizons. Together, our results explain several familiar properties of warmup through a single tradeoff and suggest treating warmup duration as a horizon-dependent hyperparameter rather than a fixed training heuristic.

</details>


### [1120] [Cost-free Spectral Estimation for Adaptive Newton--Schulz in Matrix Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33047)
*Kristi Topollai,Anna Choromanska*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出谱自适应Newton-Schulz正交化方法，利用迭代中Gram矩阵的标量约简估计奇异值分布，按当前矩阵选择专用多项式例程，降低正交化误差与预训练损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵优化器（如Muon）用固定多项式例程近似正交化，对所有层与训练全程一视同仁。但近似质量与代价强依赖输入奇异值谱，统一处理既非必要也不最优，需要更自适应的方式。

Method: 在Newton-Schulz迭代内部，Gram矩阵通过廉价的标量约简即可得到谱矩，无需额外矩阵乘法；由这些矩恢复经验奇异值分布估计，并据此选择针对当前矩阵的多项式例程，使正交化成为随层和时间自适应调整的过程。

Result: 在保存的动量矩阵上，固定迭代预算下显著降低正交化误差，或减少迭代次数达到同等精度；在最多1B参数的GPT预训练中，降低了两种矩阵优化器的验证损失。

Conclusion: 优化器内部的矩阵函数操作无需按最坏情况谱保守设计，可低成本测量正在处理的谱并据此特化计算，实现更高效的优化。

Abstract: Matrix optimizers such as Muon transform each momentum matrix through an approximate orthogonalization, typically implemented by a small number of Newton-Schulz matrix multiplications. The quality and cost of this approximation depend strongly on the singular-value spectrum of its input, yet existing implementations use the same fixed polynomial routine for every layer and throughout training. We show that this uniform treatment is unnecessary: the computations in the Newton-Schulz method already reveal enough information to make the method adaptive. The Gram matrices formed inside Newton-Schulz iterations yield spectral moments through inexpensive scalar reductions, requiring no additional matrix multiplications. From these moments, we recover an estimate of the empirical singular-value distribution and use it to select a polynomial routine specialized to the current matrix. This turns Newton--Schulz orthogonalization into a spectrum-adaptive procedure that responds to differences across both layers and training time. On saved momentum matrices, spectral estimation substantially reduces orthogonalization error at a fixed iteration budget or reaches the same accuracy with fewer iterations, and in GPT pretraining up to 1B parameters it lowers the validation loss of two matrix optimizers. Our results suggest that matrix-function operations inside optimizers need not be designed for a conservative worst-case spectrum: they can cheaply measure the spectrum they are already processing and specialize computations accordingly.

</details>


### [1121] [DevelopmentODE: Structured Neural ODEs for Early Brain Development Dynamics Across a Decade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33048)
*Kaiqiao Han,Haitao Chen,Bryan Quah,Xiaoda Wang,Janelle Liu,John H Gilmore,Wei Gao,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DevelopmentODE，一个结构化连续时间框架，用"发育管道"几何组织群体与个体变异，并按年龄有序变形向量场，实现稀疏儿童纵向fMRI的长期发育预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童脑发育预测需从稀疏、间隔不规则的纵向观测中建模轨迹。个体差异大且发育动力学随年龄变化，而通用连续时间模型把群体进展、个体变异、发育年龄都混入单一柔性转移函数，缺乏结构，难以做长期预测。

Method: 围绕表示群体轨迹的"发育管道"，以其局部方向为参考约束个体偏差速度；用共享非线性偏差场刻画个体发育运动而不破坏群体进展；通过有序的年龄依赖变形逐步调整共享向量场以建模非平稳性，流逝时间决定积分范围。

Result: 在纵向fMRI上，用早期观测预测同一儿童未来功能连接，DevelopmentODE在短期与长期预测上均稳定优于对比基线。

Conclusion: 以群体发育结构引导稀疏个体的学习、同时让动力学随年龄平滑演化，是改善长期神经发育预测的有效途径。

Abstract: Understanding how individual brain development unfolds over childhood requires modeling developmental trajectories from sparse longitudinal observations. Long-term neurodevelopmental forecasting is challenging because each child is typically observed at only a few irregularly spaced visits, while developmental dynamics vary across individuals and age. Generic continuous-time models accommodate irregular timing but often absorb these factors into a single flexible transition function, providing little structure for how population progression, individual variability, and developmental age shape the dynamics. We propose DevelopmentODE, a structured continuous-time framework that organizes population- and subject-specific variation within a shared developmental geometry while allowing the governing dynamics to evolve with age. The model builds this geometry around a developmental canal representing the population trajectory, whose local direction provides a reference for organizing subject-specific variation. Subject deviation velocities are constrained relative to this direction, while a shared nonlinear deviation field captures individual developmental motion without disrupting population-level progression. DevelopmentODE further models developmental non-stationarity through ordered age-dependent deformations of the shared vector field, progressively adapting a common dynamical structure as age changes, while elapsed time determines the integration horizon. This formulation uses population-level developmental structure to guide learning from sparse individual trajectories while allowing dynamics to evolve smoothly with age. We evaluate DevelopmentODE on longitudinal fMRI by predicting future functional connectivity of the same child from earlier observations. DevelopmentODE consistently outperforms competing baselines across short- and long-horizon predictions.

</details>


### [1122] [SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33051)
*Omin Kwon,JoongWon Shin,Minseo Kim,Kurt Keutzer,Sehoon Kim,Jae W. Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SketchSSM 通过低秩基向量离线近似查询，仅在状态更新时读取全状态，从而大幅降低线性注意力解码的状态访问开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合注意力模型用线性注意力减少 KV-cache 增长，但解码时循环状态访问成为主要瓶颈；ReplaySSM 虽缓存 K/V 摊销状态更新，每个新查询仍需全状态读取，即使状态在两次更新间并未改变。

Method: 观察到低秩状态加权查询近似能准确保持状态读取输出，且近似基向量可离线固定。SketchSSM 在每次状态更新时读取一次全状态，为这些基向量预计算输出并存入紧凑 sketch；后续解码步用查询相关系数组合 sketch 向量重建输出，无需全状态读取。保留全状态更新，仅近似读取。

Result: 在四类 Mamba-2、GDN、KDA 模型上，状态访问流量约减少 10 倍，四个解码基准平均精度基本保持，四个 RULER 检索任务召回率也基本保留。单张 NVIDIA B300 上，相较标准 vLLM 基线，Mamba-2、GDN、KDA 的线性注意力 kernel 加速分别达 7.78x、5.22x、5.20x；Nemotron 3 Super 上解码吞吐提升最高 2.64x。

Conclusion: 通过将全状态读取转化为离线基向量预计算与在线系数组合，SketchSSM 有效缓解线性注意力解码的状态访问瓶颈，在保持精度的同时显著提升速度与吞吐。

Abstract: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10x while largely preserving average accuracy across four decode benchmarks and recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. On one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the standard vLLM baseline reach 7.78x, 5.22x, and 5.20x for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.64x higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.

</details>


### [1123] [Deep Learning Techniques for Phoneme Recognition in Italian Children' s Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33060)
*Nicola Barbaro,Cristina Gena,Francesco Petriglia,Andrea Meirone,Alessandro Mazzei,Arianna Viotti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Broca是一个基于Conformer的语音转IPA系统，用少量意大利儿童语音数据微调后，达到13.36%的音素错误率，助力语言治疗诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言治疗师缺乏将语音转写为国际音标（IPA）的高效工具，导致诊断儿童语音障碍困难。

Method: Broca基于Conformer，先在8天成人语音上预训练，后在165分钟意大利儿童语音数据（3.5-6.5岁，标准化诊断测试采集）上微调，针对儿童语音的音调、口音和发音错误等变异性进行优化。

Result: 在意大利语上取得13.36%的加权音素错误率（SOTA），且仅用不到3小时儿童特定数据。

Conclusion: 以极少数据即可实现准确、与词汇无关的语音转IPA转写，为更易获取、数据高效的语言评估与诊断工具开辟道路。

Abstract: Speech therapists often face difficulties diagnosing impairments due to the lack of efficient tools for transcribing speech into the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). This work addresses this challenge with Broca, a Conformer-based deep learning system pretrained on 8 days of adult speech and fine-tuned on a 165-minute dataset of Italian child speech collected through a range of standardized diagnostic tests for children aged 3.5-6.5. Broca was optimized to handle phonetic variability in children's speech, including tone, accent, and speech errors, and achieved a state-of-the-art weighted Phoneme Error Rate of 13.36% on Italian speech. Remarkably, this performance was obtained using less than three hours of child-specific data, underscoring the model's efficiency and robustness in low-resource clinical settings. This work demonstrates that accurate, vocabulary-independent speech-to-IPA transcription can be achieved with minimal data, paving the way for more accessible, data-efficient tools to support speech assessment and diagnosis.

</details>


### [1124] [Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33066)
*Volkan Dağlı,Zerrin Dağlı,Dağhan Dağlı*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非张量决策范式WERR与Phase III OED，用24字节坐标种子沿Mandelbrot集边界程序化合成非线性决策边界，用Lean 4机器验证10条定理并在CPU上实现零VRAM、15.15倍加速的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经推理依赖高带宽内存中的稠密浮点权重矩阵，存在严重内存墙瓶颈，且无法在EVM等确定性虚拟机中原生执行；连续域递归动力系统的终止性与算术不变量验证在BSS模型下通常不可判定。

Method: 将递归z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c投影到模剩余环Z/9Z与定点域Q_{16.16}，构造沿Mandelbrot边界的24字节坐标种子Θ=(c_x,c_y,zoom)按需合成非线性决策边界；在Lean 4(v4.34.1)+Mathlib4中机器验证10条定理（无sorry），包括理想闭包、燃料有界停机、无平方溢出、边界逃逸敏感性与EVM gas上界；并用40核双路Xeon服务器上的向量化36次迭代CPU核进行实测。

Result: 验证了I_3={0,3,6}理想闭包、通用燃料有界停机（≤9与≤12步）、Q_{16.16}在2^{63}-1以下无平方溢出、非恒定边界逃逸敏感性、EVM gas上界≤22,557≤24,000；CPU核10万次决策6.49秒（15,397次/秒，0字节VRAM，15.15倍加速），S型离群门抑制100.00%对抗尖峰并保留89.60%干净基线信号。

Conclusion: WERR与Phase III OED作为非张量决策范式，兼具形式化可验证性（Lean 4零sorry）与裸机高效性（零VRAM、低gas），为确定性虚拟机内可原生验证的神经推理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed $Θ= (c_x, c_y, \text{zoom})$ along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set ($\partial\mathcal{M}$). By projecting the recurrence $z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c$ onto the modular residue ring $\mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ and the fixed-point domain $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving $\mathcal{I}_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting ($\le 9$ and $\le 12$ steps), absence of $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$ square overflow below $2^{63}-1$, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound ($\le 22,557 \le 24,000$ gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.

</details>


### [1125] [Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33073)
*Christine Herlihy,Xumei Xi,Shloka Desai,Kevin Bannerman Hutchful,Pedro Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对生成模型引入推荐系统带来的算法危害，扩展了危害分类法与威胁模型，提出涵盖新型因果驱动因素和内源性危害的分类，并进行因果分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型被整合进机器学习平台后，现有危害分类法与威胁模型不足以应对：(1) 已被研究的表征危害和服务质量危害出现了新的因果驱动因素；(2) 当系统输入与设计者目标或生成模型归纳先验不一致时，可能产生如“消毒”(sanitization)等内源性危害。

Method: 提出一个扩展的算法危害分类法，聚焦于非对话式推荐系统中生成模型的使用；并对(input, output)联合分布中有问题子集的产生方式进行因果分析。

Result: 给出了扩展的危害分类体系，并通过因果分析揭示了问题子集如何从联合分布中产生，为危害检测与缓解提供依据。

Conclusion: 现有危害分类与威胁模型需扩展；通过新分类法和因果分析，可更好地指导生成模型推荐系统中算法危害的检测与缓解。

Abstract: In this work, we consider algorithmic harms that may arise as generative models are incorporated into machine learning platforms. We argue that existing harm taxonomies and threat models require extension to (1) address novel causal drivers of well-studied representational and quality-of-service harms; and (2) anticipate and mitigate endogenous harms, such as sanitization, which may arise when system inputs are misaligned with the system designer's objectives, or the generative model's inductive priors. To this end, we introduce an expanded taxonomy of algorithmic harms associated with the use of generative models in non-conversational recommendation systems. In addition, we offer a causal analysis of how problematic subsets of the (input, output) joint distribution can arise, in an effort to inform harms detection and mitigation efforts.

</details>


### [1126] [KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33074)
*Changxin Ke,Rui Zhang,Zixiang Fang,Zhenghong Li,Yuanbo Wen,Jiashuo Shen,Shuo Wang,Jiaming Guo,Ling Li,Qi Guo,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KernelZero是一个协同演化框架，通过Proposer和Coder双模型交替优化，自动生成能力对齐的训练数据，并采用CA-GRPO策略在正确性可靠后优化性能，显著提升GPU内核生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的GPU内核生成方法面临两大挑战：缺乏与模型当前能力匹配的高质量训练数据，以及内核正确性与性能之间的固有权衡。

Method: 提出KernelZero协同演化框架，包含Proposer（从API集生成Torch模块）和Coder（翻译为CUDA/Triton内核）。采用前沿驱动的模块生成机制持续产生能力对齐的训练模块，并引入正确性感知组相对策略优化（CA-GRPO），在正确性足够可靠后才优化性能，通过交替优化形成自动课程。

Result: KernelZero-7B在CUDA上超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet，在Triton上超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro。在KernelBench Level 1和2上，CUDA pass@1达75.8%和69.6%，pass@10达100%和97%；Triton pass@1达77.2%和72.5%。

Conclusion: KernelZero通过协同演化与自动课程机制，有效解决了数据稀缺和正确性-性能权衡问题，实现了高效且有针对性的GPU内核生成能力提升。

Abstract: High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model's current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero, a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder's current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8% and 69.6%, respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100% and 97%. On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2% and 72.5%, respectively.

</details>
