### [1127] [The limits of exactness: On the failure of automatic differentiation in physics-informed machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33078)
*Ameya D. Jagtap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出自动微分(AD)虽能提供机器精度的导数，但它并不理解物理结构，因此"数值精确"不等于"物理正确"，并呼吁以此重新定位PDE神经网络代理模型的构建思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息机器学习(physics-informed ML)普遍将AD的数学精确性视为可靠基础，但作者认为精确定义与物理保真之间存在被忽视的鸿沟，需重新审视这一假定。

Method: 这是一篇观点性(argument)论文，通过概念论证：AD在设计上不具备对物理结构的认知，从而可能给出"数值完美却错误"的导数；并以对流方向性、扩散、色散为例，列举守恒、热力学一致性、对称性、辛结构、正性、单调性、有界性等一系列被忽略的物理约束。

Result: 论证表明，上述物理结构缺失并非个别现象，而是横跨计算科学与工程各分支的普遍问题，远超对流等最显眼的案例。

Conclusion: 识别这一更广泛的鸿沟，为构建下一代PDE驱动的神经代理模型提供了重新框架化的方向：需将物理结构纳入模型设计，而非仅依赖AD的精确性。

Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) lets neural networks compute derivatives of governing equations to machine precision, and this precision has made it the computational backbone of physics-informed machine learning. Yet exactness in the mathematical sense is not the same as fidelity to the physics. Here I argue that a derivative can be numerically perfect and still be the wrong derivative for the problem at hand, because AD, by construction, has no notion of the physical structure a solution must obey. Convection and its associated directionality, diffusion, and dispersion are only the most visible instances of a much longer list that spans all branches of computational science and engineering, including conservation, thermodynamic consistency, symmetry, symplectic structure, positivity, monotonicity, and boundedness. Recognizing this broader gap reframes how the field should build the next generation of PDE-driven neural surrogates.

</details>


### [1128] [From Constitutions to Control: Interpretable Rewards for Aligning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33086)
*Johann D. Gaebler,Calvin Isley,Max Lamparth,Stephen Casper,Sharad Goel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于评分标准(rubric)的对齐框架,将通用宪法转化为可解释、可调整的奖励模型,通过重加权各维度实现对目标行为的可控调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法存在不足:偏好方法将多种考量压缩为聚合的人类判断,掩盖了奖励的驱动因素;原则方法仅指定高层价值,未充分操作化。难以了解何种行为被奖励,也难以有针对性地调整。

Method: 构建基于rubric的框架,用宪法引导的AI反馈为各rubric条目估计初始权重,再对这些维度重加权以构造修改后的奖励进行训练。

Result: 在政治对齐与安全-有用性权衡实验中,对单个维度重加权能可预测地、相对独立地改变目标行为,并能在冲突目标间导航权衡;同一框架可减弱偏好判断中的标签偏差(如谄媚、人口统计偏差)。

Conclusion: 由宪法衍生的可解释奖励可将高层对齐原则转化为更透明、更可控的模型行为。

Abstract: Current approaches to aligning language models often make it hard to know what behavior is being rewarded or to change that reward in a targeted way. In particular, standard preference-based methods collapse multiple considerations into aggregate human judgments, obscuring what drives the resulting reward, while principle-based methods specify high-level values without fully operationalizing them. To address this gap, we develop a rubric-based framework to transform a general-purpose constitution into an interpretable and tunable reward model, using constitution-guided AI feedback to estimate initial weights for the constituent rubric items. We then reweight those dimensions to construct modified rewards for training. Across experiments on political alignment and safety-helpfulness tradeoffs, reweighting individual dimensions predictably changes targeted behaviors largely independently while navigating tradeoffs between conflicting alignment objectives. We show that the same framework can mitigate label bias encoded in preference judgments -- including sycophancy and demographic bias -- by reducing their influence on the training reward. Our results demonstrate that constitution-derived, interpretable rewards can translate high-level alignment principles into more transparent and controllable model behavior.

</details>


### [1129] [Geometry-Aware Operator Families for Structured Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33089)
*Zuyuan Zhang,Fei Xu Yu,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出几何诱导算子族（GIOF）框架，将固定几何结构转化为结构化传播算子族，并依据上下文动态选择算子，实现结构感知的深度表示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在表示的几何结构决定了哪些组件应交互以及信息应如何传播，因此几何感知的算子设计是结构化深度表示学习的核心。然而现有神经架构多依赖通用模板或针对特定几何的构造，缺乏一个能直接从固定结构信息推导可容许算子、同时适应动态上下文的统一框架。

Method: GIOF首先将几何导出的交互通道转化为可复用的生成基，然后通过上下文相关的选择器和自适应传播尺度进行组合，最后借助稳定的连续时间传播与瓶颈残差层实现所选算子。

Result: 理论上给出了参数压缩、可辨识性、稳定性、局部性、组合结构和过平滑行为的保证；受控实验验证了各机制；在 PEMS-BAY 与 METR-LA 上，在所有区域断电设置中取得最低平均 MAE，30% 传感器缺失时相较最强保留基线提升 2.4%--8.8%。

Conclusion: GIOF 提供了一个统一且自适应的几何感知算子设计框架，兼具理论保证与实证性能优势，适用于结构化深度表示学习与图传播任务。

Abstract: The geometry of latent representations governs which components should interact and how information should propagate, making geometry-aware operator design a fundamental ingredient of structured deep representation learning. However, existing neural architectures typically rely on generic operator templates or geometry-specific constructions, creating a need for a unified framework that can derive admissible operators directly from fixed structural information while remaining adaptive to changing contexts. We introduce \emph{Geometry-Induced Operator Families} (GIOF), a general framework that converts fixed geometry into a structured family of propagation operators and dynamically selects an appropriate member of this family according to the current context. GIOF first transforms geometry-derived interaction channels into reusable generator bases, then combines them through a context-dependent selector and adaptive propagation scale, and finally realizes the selected operator through stable continuous-time propagation and a bottleneck residual layer. We establish theoretical guarantees covering parameter compression, identifiability, stability, locality, compositional structure, and oversmoothing behavior, while controlled experiments validate these mechanisms and experiments on PEMS-BAY and METR-LA achieve the lowest mean MAE across all reported regional-outage settings, improving over the strongest retained baseline by 2.4\%--8.8\% at 30\% missing sensors.

</details>


### [1130] [How Linear Attention Remembers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33093)
*Kichang Lee,JaeYeon Park,Songkuk Kim,JeongGil Ko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了线性注意力中固定大小的循环记忆系统如何写入、保留和读取信息，揭示其选择性回忆能力及干扰和容量限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态替代标准注意力不断增长的KV缓存，大幅降低内存增长，但这改变了过往信息的存储方式：许多token必须共享并反复更新同一记忆。作者希望理解这种循环状态作为记忆系统是如何运作的。

Method: 使用解析分解结合在预训练GLA和GDN模型中的受控因果干预，追踪被回忆信息如何被写入、保留和后续访问；并对后续写入进行因果干预，分析混合架构中记忆支撑来源。

Result: 事实特定信息通过集中的、内容依赖的写入进入循环记忆，并在查询时通过集中的读取路径访问；同一状态中多个事实可保持选择性可访问，但其内部表示存在跨事实因果耦合而非独立的KV式存储。记忆负载增加时，回忆和定向可编辑性均下降，而单纯上下文时长影响较小；干扰由后续写入与现有记忆的重叠决定。在混合架构中，支撑回忆的运行时记忆主要转移到全注意力的KV状态。

Conclusion: 固定大小的循环记忆能在共享存储下支持选择性回忆，但也暴露出与token可寻址KV记忆不同的干扰和容量限制。

Abstract: Linear attention replaces the growing key--value (KV) cache of standard attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, substantially reducing memory growth with context length. This efficiency, however, changes how past information is stored: many tokens must share and repeatedly update the same memory. We study how this recurrent state functions as a memory system. Using an analytical decomposition together with controlled causal interventions in pretrained GLA and GDN models, we trace how recalled information is written, retained, and later accessed. We find that fact-specific information enters recurrent memory through concentrated, content-dependent writes and is later accessed through concentrated query-time read pathways. Multiple facts can remain selectively accessible within the same state, yet their internal representations exhibit cross-fact causal coupling rather than independent KV-like storage. As memory load increases, both recall and targeted editability degrade, whereas elapsed context alone has a substantially smaller effect within the tested regime. Causal interventions on subsequent writes further show that interference is shaped by their overlap with existing memory. Finally, in hybrid architectures that combine recurrent layers with full attention, the runtime memory directly supporting recall shifts predominantly to the full-attention KV state. Together, these results reveal how fixed-size recurrent memory supports selective recall despite shared storage, while exposing the interference and capacity limits that distinguish it from token-addressable KV memory.

</details>


### [1131] [CARVE: Breaking Data Barriers in Chip Placement by Harnessing Reusable Expertise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33106)
*Jiefu Zhang,Haixiang Sun,Yang Xu,Vaneet Aggarwal,Zishen Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARVE框架将累积的专家知识表示为冻结的基础策略、不可变的专家模型和经本地验证的任务凭证，实现新任务的高效复用与持续适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的宏布局策略可减少重复优化，但部署时面对新设计且原始训练数据缺失，单一模型反复微调会覆盖早期成果，而单纯保存检查点又无法确定复用时机。

Method: CARVE首先检查现有专家模型，仅当无合格者时才从冻结基础策略训练新专家；在固定任务分布和可控制累积误差的验证规则下，建立重复复用的期望性能保证，并针对有界损失推导可靠复用所需本地样本的最坏情况界。

Result: 复用优先策略使训练时间减少58.5%（9.66至4.01小时），平均HPWL增益仅从8.41%降至7.86%；模拟接收部署中，7个新IBM电路中6个无需接收端训练即可复用导入专家，实现5.76%平均HPWL增益。

Conclusion: CARVE通过凭证化专家复用机制，在保证性能的前提下显著降低持续适应成本，导航研究进一步验证了修复保留与重复适应能力。

Abstract: Pretrained macro-placement policies can reduce repeated optimization across circuits, but deployment often exposes them to unfamiliar designs when the original training data are unavailable. Repeatedly fine-tuning a single serving model can overwrite earlier improvements, while simply saving checkpoints does not determine where they can be reliably reused. We introduce Continual Adaptation through the Reuse of Validated Expertise (CARVE), a framework that represents accumulated expertise as a frozen base policy, immutable specialists, and task-specific credentials obtained through local validation. For a new task, CARVE first checks existing specialists and trains a new specialist from the frozen base only when none qualifies. Under fixed task distributions and validation rules that control cumulative error, we establish expected-performance guarantees for repeated reuse. For bounded losses, we also derive matching worst-case bounds on the local samples needed for reliable reuse. In macro placement, a reuse-first follow-up reduces recorded training time by 58.5% (9.66 to 4.01 hours), while mean HPWL gain changes only from 8.41% to 7.86%. In a simulated receiving deployment, imported specialists are reused on six of seven new IBM circuits with no receiver-side training, achieving a 5.76% mean HPWL gain. Navigation studies provide complementary evidence on repair retention and repeated adaptation.

</details>


### [1132] [D-JEPA: Design-Recoverable JEPA Representation with Swappable Physics Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33110)
*Nitin Nagesh Kulkarni,Aashwin Anand Mishra,Yin Yu,Peter Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出D-JEPA，一个以几何为中心的JEPA框架，将可复用几何表示与物理特定解码器解耦，并用设计可恢复性目标支持设计分析，同时缓解case-level collapse，在多类3D基准上保持精度并实现近完美的设计参数线性可恢复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数化物理系统中学到的表示常将几何与工况、任务特定物理响应纠缠，导致难以跨预测任务复用。JEPA虽能学紧凑表示而不直接重建观测，但未解决该纠缠问题。

Method: D-JEPA仅从几何计算紧凑表示，通过轻量物理特定解码器在工况与响应空间复用该表示。引入显式设计可恢复性目标，使几何潜变量保留底层设计变量信息。针对目标表示在不同几何上近乎不变但重建误差低的case-level collapse，采用case-level变异约束与辅助目标重建进行缓解。

Result: 在四个3D气动、水动与结构基准上，D-JEPA保持或提升全场预测精度，同时实现设计参数近乎完美的线性可恢复性。冻结的几何表示可复用于新工况并迁移到结构响应任务，且可训练参数更少。该表示还支持可微设计优化，用高保真CFD验证并保持候选设计的预测排序。

Conclusion: 将可复用几何表示与物理特定预测分离，为科学代理建模与设计提供了一种实用的表示方法。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a framework for learning compact representations without directly reconstructing high-dimensional observations. However, in parameterized physical systems, learned representations can entangle geometry with operating conditions and task-specific physical responses, limiting their reuse across prediction tasks. We introduce D-JEPA (Design-recoverable JEPA), a geometry-centric JEPA that computes a compact representation from geometry alone and reuses it across operating conditions and physical response spaces through lightweight physics-specific decoders. An explicit design-recoverability objective encourages the geometry latent to preserve information about the underlying design variables, enabling the representation to support design analysis and optimization. We further identify a case-level collapse failure mode in which target representations become nearly invariant across distinct geometries despite low reconstruction error, and mitigate it using case-level variation constraints and auxiliary target reconstruction. Across four 3D aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and structural benchmarks, D-JEPA maintains or improves full-field prediction accuracy while achieving near-perfect linear recoverability of design parameters. The frozen geometry representation can be reused at held-out operating conditions and transferred to a structural response task with fewer trainable parameters. Finally, the representation supports differentiable design optimization, with designs validated using high-fidelity CFD, preserving the predicted ranking of candidate designs. These results demonstrate that separating a reusable geometry representation from physics-specific prediction provides a practical representation for scientific surrogate modeling and design.

</details>


### [1133] [ECG-Scroll: A Long-Horizon, Streaming Benchmark and Agent Environment for Interpretation of Ambulatory Electrocardiograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33117)
*Haitao Li,Chenglin Li,Zhengyao Ding,Ziyu Li,Yiheng Mao,Zhengxing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将长时程ECG判读重新定义为长程在线（流式、因果）序列决策问题，提出ECG-Scroll基准与gym式智能体环境，含390段、2536小时双导联动态ECG，要求智能体在无未来信号条件下检测阵发性事件，并以规则奖励和检测延迟为指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM可解读10秒12导联ECG，但真实动态（Holter/遥测）记录长达数小时至数天，临床关键发现是埋藏于平凡波形中的短暂阵发事件。此类记录无法以诊断分辨率放入单一上下文，且未来尚未发生，必须在线判读：即时决定测量内容、将证据写入记忆、实时报告事件。现有批式评估范式无法刻画这种能力。

Method: 将长时程ECG判读建模为长程在线因果序列决策过程。作为基准：长动态记录逐块流式输入智能体，需在无未来信号下定位、量化并及时标记阵发事件；因保留原始信号，答案可对照客观真值校验，得到基于规则而非评判模型的奖励；并新增批式评估无法表达的指标——事件起始到智能体记录时刻的检测延迟。作为智能体环境：固定gym式交互层，考察三种能力——记忆、基于信号测量的工具使用（而非读像素）、以及"现在测什么、何时提交"的规划。同时发布390个整段记录实例、2536小时双导联动态ECG。

Result: 实验在线评估了信号阈值规则智能体与现成LLM智能体，刻画其如何运用记忆、工具与规划，并揭示该基准的剩余提升空间（head-room）。

Conclusion: 批式ECG解读与真实动态监测之间存在本质差距；ECG-Scroll以流式基准和智能体环境的形式，为在线、可校验、带延迟度量的长时程ECG分析提供了评测与研究的统一平台。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now interpret a standard ten-second, twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with clinically grounded, reward-verified reasoning. Real cardiac monitoring is different. Ambulatory (Holter) and telemetry recordings span hours to days and are read as they stream in, and their clinically decisive findings are paroxysmal, brief episodes buried in an otherwise unremarkable trace. Such a recording cannot be held in one context at diagnostic resolution, and its future has not yet happened, so a reader must work online, deciding what to measure now, committing evidence to memory as it passes, and reporting events as they occur. We recast long-duration ECG interpretation as a long-horizon, online (streaming, causal) sequential decision process and introduce ECG-Scroll. As a benchmark, long ambulatory recordings are streamed to an agent chunk by chunk, and it must localize, quantify, and promptly flag paroxysmal events without access to future signal; because the underlying signal is retained, every answer is checkable against objective ground truth, giving rule-based rather than judge-based rewards, and the streaming formulation adds a metric batch evaluation cannot express, the detection latency between an event's onset and the moment the agent records it. As an agent environment, it is a fixed, gym-style interaction layer that exercises three competencies single-glance ECG models never touch: Memory, Tool use through signal-grounded measurement rather than reading pixels, and Planning of what to measure now and when to commit. We release 390 whole-recording instances spanning 2,536 hours of two-lead ambulatory ECG and evaluate a signal-threshold rule agent alongside off-the-shelf LLM agents online, characterizing how they use memory, tools, and planning and where the benchmark's head-room lies.

</details>


### [1134] [Mycelium: A Generalizable Cross-Grid Multi-Task Model for Electrical Distribution Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33120)
*Zhengyang Wei,Shourya Bose,Helgi Hilmarsson,Elena Carnio,Dhruv Suri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一电网模型Mycelium，用异构图Transformer处理稀疏噪声不完整的时间序列，实现多任务并泛化到未见配电网。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电网运行需要跨异质网络推断，但测量数据稀疏、含噪、不完整；现有方法难以统一建模并泛化到新网络。

Method: 定义统一电网本体，将可变规模配电网表示为异构图，保留拓扑、资产类型与电气关系；构建物理仿真流水线（参考网+程序生成网、重构、故障、可配置传感）；提出Mycelium——结构感知通信边与电气参考特征的异构图Transformer，配任务特定时间读出。

Result: 在完全排除于训练和验证的基准网络上测试，Mycelium在多数基准指标上优于任务专用神经基线；消融与实验表明其能学习底层物理表征，提升跨任务性能。

Conclusion: Mycelium验证了统一电网模型的可行性，通过学习物理表征增强跨任务泛化，解决了统一电网模型的关键挑战。

Abstract: Electrical distribution grid operations require inference across heterogeneous networks from sparse, noisy, and incomplete time series measurements. In this work, we identify challenges and explore solutions towards a unified model that can perform diverse tasks grounded in the physics of the electric grid and generalize to unseen distribution networks. We define a unified grid ontology that represents variable sized distribution networks as heterogeneous graphs while preserving native topology, asset types, and electrical relationships across networks. We develop a physics based data simulation pipeline that combines reference and procedurally generated distribution networks with network reconfigurations, fault scenarios, and configurable sensing conditions. We present Mycelium, a heterogeneous graph transformer with structure aware communication edges and electrical reference features that encode network position and nominal phase orientation, together with task specific temporal readouts which generate per task outputs. We train Mycelium on reference as well as synthetic grids, and study its generalization on benchmark networks completely excluded from training and validation. Mycelium is observed to outperform task specific neural baselines on most reported benchmark metrics. Architectural ablations and the aforementioned studies reveal Mycelium's capability to learn representations of the underlying physics which serves to enhance cross-task performance, thereby addressing a significant challenge in unified grid models.

</details>


### [1135] [Save Your Saturated Data: Learning Beyond Reward Saturation in Group-Based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33126)
*Ziyuan Yang,Yike Wang,Shangbin Feng,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究奖励饱和数据在组相对RL中能否被回收利用，发现通过对rollout生成等四个层面进行干预可恢复学习信号，其中诱导模型生成"高质量但错误"的负样本最有效，使GRPO提升6.4%–9.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型能力增强，训练数据易出现奖励饱和：同一问题下所有采样回答奖励均很高，导致组相对优势估计趋近于0、学习信号消失，使原本有用的数据失效。作者希望探究能否从这类饱和数据中恢复有效学习信号，以应对数据稀缺问题。

Method: 在组策略RL流程的四个层面（数据、rollout、奖励、优势）设计干预措施，仅在饱和推理数据上进行大量RL训练。核心策略是扰动策略以生成"高质量但错误"的解，从而把低奖励rollout作为负样本引入饱和组；同时对比提高rollout温度、添加辅助奖励等方法。

Result: 标准GRPO在饱和数据上优势接近0、信号近似噪声；而多种干预可成功回收数据。rollout生成层面干预最有效，在Qwen3-1.7B和4B上使GRPO提升6.4%–9.0%。其他干预（提高温度、辅助奖励）也能恢复非零优势，但收益不稳定。有效负样本需具备有信息量的负轨迹；该方法与未饱和数据可协同，并支持对新饱和样本的迭代回收。

Conclusion: 不应浪费饱和数据：通过恰当策略，奖励饱和数据可被回收为有用的RL训练信号。在模型日益增强、数据愈发稀缺的背景下，这为持续利用被"淘汰"的数据提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) relies on reward variation among sampled responses to estimate informative relative advantages. As language models become increasingly capable, existing training data can become reward-saturated: all sampled responses to the same problem might receive equally high rewards, where the group-relative learning signals vanish and leave previously useful data obsolete. In this work, we investigate whether useful learning signals can be recovered from such saturated data. We study interventions at four levels of group-policy RL pipelines---data, rollout, reward, and advantage---and conduct extensive RL training on saturated reasoning data only. While standard GRPO on saturated data would almost always yield near-0 advantages and near-noise signals, diverse interventions successfully recycle and repurpose such data: among the proposed strategies, interventions at rollout generation are consistently most effective: nudging the policy to generate ``high-quality'', incorrect solutions introduces rollouts with poor rewards into saturated groups as negative samples, which turns out to improve GRPO by 6.4% to 9.0% across Qwen3-1.7B and 4B. Other interventions such as increasing rollout temperature or adding auxiliary rewards can also restore non-zero advantages, but yield less consistent gains. Further analyses show that effective negative rollouts require informative negative trajectories, that the method remains effective alongside unsaturated data, and that it supports iterative recycling of newly saturated examples. While increasingly stronger LLMs would render more data as saturated, our results demonstrate that don't waste your saturated data: with the right strategies they can be recycled into useful RL training signals in an increasingly data-scarce world.

</details>


### [1136] [Policy Plasticity Matters in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning: Refitting Offline Policies for Online Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33127)
*Yuheng Huang,Yunpeng Qing,Yixiao Chi,Yilun Kong,Changqing Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 从网络可塑性视角研究离线到在线强化学习(O2O)，发现离线数据长时间优化会降低网络可塑性，提出REFIT方法在在线微调前通过蒸馏将离线策略迁移到全新初始化学生网络中，恢复可塑性并提升在线适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有O2O方法主要通过值校准解决离线到在线的过渡，且通常将离线训练的策略视为给定的初始化。本文质疑：离线训练的策略是否仍具有足够的可塑性用于在线学习？

Method: 通过控制实验发现：在静态离线数据上长时间优化会逐步降低网络可塑性，即使离线性能已基本饱和，且低可塑性与后续在线提升较弱相关。据此提出REFIT（Restoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer），一种轻量级模型级方法：在线微调前，将离线策略蒸馏到全新初始化的学生网络中，同时临时冻结部分学生单元，从而把学到的离线行为迁移到更具可塑性的策略初始化中。

Result: 在D4RL和OGBench上大量实验表明，REFIT在Cal-QL和IQL两种骨干网络上均持续取得高于现有O2O插件方法的总体性能，同时可塑性诊断与消融实验进一步证明网络可塑性得到恢复。

Conclusion: 从网络可塑性角度理解O2O过渡是有效的，REFIT作为一种简单轻量的方法能恢复可塑性并提升离线到在线的适应性能。

Abstract: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O RL) has emerged as a practical paradigm that pre-trains the policy using static offline datasets and subsequently adapts the policy through online interactions. Existing O2O methods primarily address the transition through value calibration, while generally treating the offline-trained policy as a given initialization. We instead study O2O adaptation from the perspective of network plasticity, asking whether the offline-trained policy remains sufficiently adaptable for online learning. Controlled experiments show that prolonged optimization on static offline data progressively reduces network plasticity even after offline performance has largely saturated, and that lower plasticity is associated with weaker subsequent online improvement. Motivated by these observations, we propose REstoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer (REFIT), a lightweight model-level method for the O2O transition. Before online fine-tuning, REFIT distills the offline policy into a freshly initialized student while temporarily freezing a random subset of student units, transferring the learned offline behavior to a more plastic policy initialization. Extensive experiments on D4RL and OGBench demonstrate that REFIT consistently achieves higher aggregate performance than existing O2O plug-in methods across both Cal-QL and IQL backbones, while plasticity diagnostics and ablations provide further evidence of restored network plasticity.

</details>


### [1137] [Flow-Matching-Based Protein Structure Tokenizer Made Efficient and Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33129)
*Zhe Zhang,Yikai Zhang,Jiangtao Feng,Ya-Qin Zhang,Wei-Ying Ma,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProFiT，一种轻量级流匹配(flow matching)蛋白结构分词器，无需人工语义对齐即可学习有意义的离散表示，性能媲美更大模型，可即插即用适配多种下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白结构分词器依赖高度工程化的训练目标和大规模数据集，且针对特定下游任务定制，导致难以迁移到更广泛的应用场景。

Method: 提出ProFiT轻量级流匹配分词器，采用促进码本健康使用的简单训练策略，无需人工语义对齐，即自然学习到语义上有意义的表示。

Result: 重建质量和泛化能力与或超过体量大得多的分词器，在广泛设置下经大量评估验证；作为即插即用分词器可适配多种下游任务。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了流匹配分词器范式的巨大潜力，代码已开源。

Abstract: As the bridge between protein modality and discrete modeling, protein structure tokenization still largely relies on heavily engineered training objectives tailored to specific downstream tasks and large training datasets, which hinders its transfer to broader application scenarios. To address this issue, we propose ProFiT, a lightweight flow matching tokenizer. With simple training strategies that encourage healthy codebook utilization, ProFiT can be trained efficiently and naturally learns semantically meaningful representations without any manual semantic alignment, while achieving reconstruction quality and generalization that match or surpass those of substantially larger tokenizers. We conduct extensive evaluations across a wide range of settings and demonstrate that ProFiT is a plug-and-play tokenizer adaptable to diverse downstream tasks. This study further reveals the significant potential of the flow matching tokenizer paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QDKStorm/ProFiT.

</details>


### [1138] [Leaky Students: Membership Inference against On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33136)
*Zhexi Lu,Mingzhi Zhu,Stacy Patterson,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究on-policy distillation中的成员推断隐私问题，提出Leaky方法检测学生模型是否泄露教师监督记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD训练中学生拟合教师分布，但教师获得的特权信息可能含敏感数据，学生是否泄露这些记录成员信息尚不明确。

Method: Leaky从目标模型采样新轨迹，比较其token对数概率与未用候选记录训练的匹配参考模型的最大值，对该差距应用Leaky ReLU以保留正差距、降低负差距。

Result: 在数学、医学问答、代码生成共15个目标上，Leaky平均AUROC达0.875，远超最强基线0.614；同一采样轨迹上基线为0.826。

Conclusion: 通过OPD训练的学生模型会暴露教师监督记录的成员信息，即便固定参考答案损失几乎无法提供成员证据。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated trajectories. However, privileged information supplied to the teacher for OPD training may contain sensitive data. Whether the student leaks private information about the records supplied to the teacher during distillation remains poorly understood. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first systematic study of membership inference in this setting. We find that fresh student trajectories expose sparse membership signals that fixed reference-answer losses often miss. These signals are mixed with probability changes caused by training on other records. We introduce Leaky, which samples fresh trajectories from the target model and compares its token log-probabilities with the maximum across matched reference models trained without the candidate records. It applies Leaky ReLU to the resulting gaps, preserving positive gaps and downweighting negative gaps as an approximate correction for incidental positive gaps in non-members. Across fifteen targets spanning mathematics, medical question answering, and code generation, Leaky outperforms all evaluated baselines and achieves mean AUROC 0.875, compared with 0.614 for the strongest baseline on each target in the main evaluation. On the same sampled trajectories, the strongest baseline achieves mean AUROC 0.826. These results show that students trained through OPD can expose the membership of records used for teacher supervision, even when fixed reference-answer losses provide little evidence of membership.

</details>


### [1139] [Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33144)
*Jia Liang,Xi Jin,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文机制性地比较了两种循环Transformer（MR-Loop与DR-Loop），揭示其长度泛化的不同内部机制及其失效原因，并提出循环状态编码"内容+计算状态"的通用表征原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer能泛化到训练时未见过的更长推理链，但其内在计算机制及泛化边界尚不清楚，本文旨在从机制层面解释这一行为及其局限。

Method: 对比Matched-Recurrence (MR-Loop)与Decoupled-Recurrence (DR-Loop)两种配置，在多项式迭代、有限状态复合、知识图谱遍历任务上，采用注意力分析、中间状态解码与因果干预进行机制研究。

Result: MR-Loop在固定读出点更新中间状态，通过相邻token交互与可迁移的进度线索推进关系选择；DR-Loop则在关系位置间传播状态，形成前进的计算前沿。两者在更深层均不可靠：MR-Loop读出状态与进度线索退化，DR-Loop状态传播可靠性下降，且微弱自纠错使局部错误累积。循环状态还编码内容的"计算状态"，live-consumed与fresh-aged残差方向可因果控制信息是否参与后续计算。

Conclusion: 长度泛化不一定依赖忠实的分步推理，循环Transformer可利用任务结构而不显式表示每一步中间状态，但其泛化深度受状态与进度线索可靠性限制。

Abstract: Looped Transformers can generalize to reasoning chains longer than those encountered during training, but the computations enabling this behavior and limiting its extent remain unclear. We mechanistically compare two looped-Transformer configurations, which we call the Matched-Recurrence Looped Transformer (MR-Loop) and Decoupled-Recurrence Looped Transformer (DR-Loop), reflecting their respective recurrence-training schemes. We evaluate polynomial iteration, finite-state composition, and knowledge-graph traversal using detailed mechanistic analysis. Attention analysis, intermediate-state decoding, and causal interventions reveal distinct mechanisms learned under final-answer supervision. MR-Loop updates an intermediate state at a fixed readout while advancing relation selection through adjacent-token interactions and a transferable progress cue. DR-Loop instead propagates intermediate states across relation positions, forming an advancing computational frontier. However, both mechanisms become unreliable at greater depths: MR-Loop exhibits degradation of its readout state and progress cues, while DR-Loop exhibits declining reliability of state propagation. Limited self-correction allows local errors to persist and compound. Across both models, we uncover a common representational principle: recurrent states encode not only task-relevant content but also its computational status, whether that content remains in a form that can support subsequent computation. Transferable live-consumed and fresh-aged residual directions causally control whether represented information can participate in subsequent computation, including beyond the training horizon. We further show that length generalization need not rely on faithful step-by-step reasoning, as Looped Transformers can exploit task structure without explicitly representing every intermediate state.

</details>


### [1140] [CFLoRA: Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs with Complementary Factors for Error-free Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33147)
*Yanan Ma,Qiyuan Chen,Zihan Fang,Xianhao Chen,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CFLoRA 通过每轮将 LoRA 隐通道划分为互补集合，消除双线性项，实现无误差、可同时更新的联邦 LoRA 聚合，并支持异构秩预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 中，两个因子矩阵分别平均不等于其乘积平均，存在结构性聚合误差。现有精确方法需冻结整个因子或轮流交替更新因子，无法同时更新且不引入误差或不扩大通信秩。

Method: 每轮通信将 LoRA 隐通道划分为两个互补集合，保证因子间的列与行互补，从而在矩阵乘法中消除双线性项，使联邦聚合精确；框架同时支持客户端具有异构秩预算。

Result: 收敛分析证明在同构秩情况下，CFLoRA 对原始 LoRA 目标达到 O(1/√T) 收敛率。在 GLUE（RoBERTa）和常识推理（LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct）上实验表明其性能与训练效率优于现有联邦 LoRA 基线。

Conclusion: CFLoRA 从结构上解决了联邦 LoRA 聚合不精确的核心问题，实现因子的同时精确更新并兼容异构秩，兼具理论收敛保证与实证优势。

Abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables collaborative fine-tuning of large language models without centralizing private client data. Its factorized update, however, creates a structural mismatch in federated averaging: averaging the two LoRA factors separately does not equal averaging their products. Existing exact methods resolve this issue mainly by freezing an entire factor or alternating factors across rounds, but none can update factors simultaneously without aggregation errors or expanding communication ranks. To address this fundamental problem, we present \texttt{CFLoRA}, a federated LoRA scheme that partitions latent LoRA channels into two complementary sets in every communication round. By ensuring that columns and rows are complementary across factors, we eliminate bilinear terms in matrix multiplications, making federated aggregation exact. Crucially, our framework also supports clients with heterogeneous rank budgets. Convergence analysis validates \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate of the \textit{original} LoRA objective in homogeneous-rank cases. Extensive experiments with RoBERTa on the GLUE benchmark and with LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct on commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves superior performance and training efficiency compared to state-of-the-art federated LoRA baselines.

</details>


### [1141] [Downstream-Aware Context Selection for Online In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33166)
*Ruihan A. Li,Shangtong Zhang,Rohan Chandra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有界历史的上下文管理框架，通过预测移除历史交互的下游影响来指导历史选择并确定上下文预算，在SUMO驾驶和ScienceWorld任务中大幅降低token消耗且性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICRL让大模型智能体无需更新参数即可通过交互历史适应新环境，但反复基于不断增长的历史进行条件化会导致大量token开销，亟需有效的上下文管理方法。

Method: 以完整滚动历史为参考，预测器评估移除各历史交互的效果并定义删除顺序，应用共享选择准则决定每个决策点保留多少历史，从而确定依赖于决策的上下文预算。

Result: 在SUMO闭环驾驶的分布内、未见领域和未见路线三种设置下，token用量分别减少25.7%、25.8%、23.2%且性能相当；在ScienceWorld持续ICRL协议下，相比全上下文减少52.1%，比Recent和Similarity基线分别少30.2%和37.8%且保持性能。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效降低ICRL的token成本同时维持性能，证明了基于移除效应预测的动态历史选择与上下文预算方法的有效性。

Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables large language model agents to adapt to new environments using their interaction history without updating model parameters. However, repeatedly conditioning on growing histories can lead to substantial token cost. We propose a bounded-history context-management framework that predicts the task-dependent downstream effect of removing historical interactions to guide history selection and determine a decision-dependent context budget. Formally, our framework uses the full rolling history as a reference. The predictor evaluates removal effects, defines a deletion ordering, and applies a shared selection criterion to determine how much history to retain at each decision. We evaluate the method in closed-loop SUMO driving under held-out in-distribution, unseen-domain, and unseen-route settings, and in ScienceWorld under a continual ICRL protocol. Relative to a baseline using the full context, our method reduces total token usage by 25.7%, 25.8%, and 23.2% across the three driving settings while maintaining comparable closed-loop driving performance. In ScienceWorld, it reduces total token usage by 52.1% compared to full context and uses 30.2% and 37.8% fewer tokens than the Recent and Similarity baselines, respectively, while maintaining performance.

</details>


### [1142] [When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33169)
*Xingjian Li,Yi Han,Jianhua Z. Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究记忆策略中"截断表征梯度"何时影响学习，发现应通过从头训练及优化器更新（而非原始梯度）来衡量记忆截断的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带记忆的策略有两条反向传播路径：物理状态路径与存储表征路径。Transformer-XL与截断BPTT会切断第二条路径却保留其值，本文研究这种切断何时会带来实际影响。

Method: 固定前向计算、仅改变导数边，测量参数梯度、优化器更新与持续训练；在Transformer血管轨迹模型与四旋翼跟踪策略上做记忆梯度切断实验（如分离KV缓存、不同截断段长、仅末段启用等）。

Result: 血管模型中分离KV缓存使梯度范数降至约十分之一且旋转小；强裁剪下优化器（而非梯度）决定更新差异，AdamW将2%梯度差异放大为切换步最多31%的更新差异。四旋翼在0.20 m/s噪声下移除记忆使误差升43%、切断记忆梯度升32%；两步截断无明显收益，八步可消除一半到四分之三代价；仅末五分之一训练启用低估代价约三倍。

Conclusion: 衡量记忆截断代价应从头开始带截断训练；比较反向图应依据优化器实际施加的更新，而非原始梯度。

Abstract: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.

</details>


### [1143] [Perturb-and-Solve: Efficient Learned-Operator Conditioning for Latent Diffusion Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33171)
*Abduragim Shtanchaev,Arip Asadulaev,Luiza Labazanova,Aidar Alimbayev,Karim Salta,Eric Moulines*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PASEO 用一个小型学习网络在潜空间中对扩散预测进行退化，从而支持任意退化算子，无需通过扩散网络反向传播，实现高效图像复原。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜扩散模型求解逆问题的方法在通用性与效率之间存在权衡：支持固定退化算子的求解器快但缺乏通用性；支持任意退化算子的方法慢且需要梯度穿过扩散网络。

Method: 引入 PASEO（Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning），使用约 100 万参数的小型学习网络在潜空间中对扩散模型预测进行退化；结合扩散预测与观测图像，通过加噪声并基于学习网络的局部线性近似求解线性方程，从近似后验中采样重建，避免构建或求逆大型协方差矩阵，也无需通过扩散网络反向传播。

Result: 在 FFHQ 和 COCO 上的超分辨率、去模糊和修复任务中，PASEO 在相同或更少模型评估次数下，感知质量强，运行速度最高快 9 倍，峰值内存最多减少 34%。

Conclusion: PASEO 打破了通用性与效率之间的瓶颈，支持学习到的退化算子且高效，适用于多种图像复原任务。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models serve as powerful priors for solving inverse problems in image restoration, such as deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution. Current methods have a trade-off between generality and efficiency. Solvers that are restricted to a fixed set of degradation operators are fast and efficient. Methods that support arbitrary degradation operators are slow and require gradients through the diffusion network. To break this bottleneck, we introduce PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning), a method that uses a small (1M parameters) learned network to degrade diffusion model predictions in latent space. PASEO supports learned degradation operators without back-propagating through the diffusion network. We efficiently sample reconstructions from an approximate posterior by combining the diffusion model's prediction with the observed image. We do this by adding noise and solving linear equations based on a local linear approximation of the learned network, without building or inverting large covariance matrices. Across super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting on FFHQ and COCO, PASEO achieves strong perceptual quality while running up to 9x faster and using up to 34% less peak memory than the tested baselines, with the same or fewer model evaluations.

</details>


### [1144] [When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33189)
*Jiaxuan Guo,Jingxin Yang,Jiaqi Ye,Youran Sun,Shuo Xin,Kejia Zhang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析了NAVSIM的GTRS-Dense标签生成器中"human-reference forgiveness"规则的影响：当人类参考在某指标上得分为零时，整列16,384个候选轨迹被标为通过。作者禁用该覆盖规则重新生成标签，发现该规则在10.88%的navtrain场景中抹除了训练损失所读取的候选区分，并导致车道保持等指标上被宽恕场景的监督质量显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAVSIM作者为避免在单一轨迹评分时惩罚上下文合理的机动，引入了human-reference forgiveness规则，但警告这可能会忽略重要失败。该规则在标签生成中会将整列16,384个候选目标设为通过，其监督后果尚未被量化。作者旨在测量这一规则对监督质量的实际影响。

Method: 禁用overwrite规则重新运行GTRS-Dense生成器，与已发布标签在全部103,288个navtrain场景上逐列对比。在navtest上评估已发布的lane-keeping head和Hydra-MDP checkpoint在被宽恕场景与匹配的未宽恕场景上的AUC。继续训练300步（三组配对随机种子）比较pre-overwrite与published targets。在五个损失指标上评估被宽恕场景的车道保持与帧间规划一致性。

Result: 该规则在11,237/103,288（10.88%）场景中抹除候选区分。车道保持占9,982/13,042个被宽恕损失列，其中位宽恕列在覆盖前有14,391/16,384个候选失败。navtest被宽恕场景中，lane-keeping head中位AUC为0.7095（未宽恕匹配场景0.9807）；Hydra-MDP为0.6627 vs 0.9761。继续训练后，pre-overwrite目标使被宽恕场景AUC高0.1086–0.1251，匹配组差距缩小但仍大于零。禁用宽恕后navtest精度提升2.478–3.524点但相邻帧一致性下降。EPDMS无法区分两组目标。

Conclusion: human-reference forgiveness规则在标签生成中大规模抹除了候选级监督信号，显著损害被宽恕场景的模型学习质量，尤其影响车道保持指标。禁用该规则可提升精度但降低规划一致性，说明该规则在监督层面存在实质性代价，需要重新审视其设计。

Abstract: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.

</details>


### [1145] [AG-CoT: Verified Algorithmic Traces for LLM Program Synthesis on Clifford Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33192)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Chenfeng Cao,Lu Pang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用Aaronson-Gottesman思维链监督语言模型生成Clifford电路，配以精确验证器过滤继续训练，显著提升态等价精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学代码生成常产出可执行但计算错误科学对象的程序，需要可精确验证的任务来研究此问题。

Method: 以紧凑符号稳定子生成元为条件，用精确验证器检查生成的OpenQASM电路；用验证器确认的AG-CoT轨迹监督，并在验证器接受的模型生成上继续训练。

Result: AG-CoT监督使贪心解码态等价精度提升4-6倍，验证器过滤继续训练进一步提升；32B模型语法与Clifford有效性近完美，最强直接模型态等价6.14%，多候选验证引导选择下超10%。

Conclusion: 算法轨迹监督带来统计显著增益，验证器过滤继续训练持续提升性能；Clifford有效性与态等价间的差距证明精确验证必不可少。

Abstract: Scientific code generation can produce executable programs that fail to compute the intended scientific object. We study this problem in language-model synthesis of Clifford circuits, which prepare the stabilizer states used in quantum error correction and admit exact classical verification. In our target-conditioned framework, each target is given as compact signed stabilizer generators, and an exact verifier checks the generated OpenQASM circuits. We supervise models with Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) traces checked by the verifier, and continue training on model generations that the verifier accepts. Across two independently trained model families (3B and 7B), AG-CoT supervision multiplies greedy-decode state-equivalence accuracy by four to six times over circuit-only baselines, and verifier-filtered continuation training adds a further consistent gain atop both. A complementary 32B study shows that supervised models achieve near-perfect syntax and Clifford validity while the strongest direct model reaches 6.14% state equivalence per target, rising to over 10% under verifier-guided selection with multiple candidates. These results show that algorithmic trace supervision gives a large, statistically significant gain in both model families and that verifier-filtered continuation adds a further repeated gain. The persistent gap between Clifford validity and state equivalence confirms that exact verification is necessary: a circuit can be syntactically and physically valid yet prepare the wrong quantum state.

</details>


### [1146] [Apparent Compression, Real Stability: The Intrinsic Dimension of Learning a Quantum Wavefunction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33193)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Chenfeng Cao,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文测量了变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）中的内在维度，发现小维度可能具有误导性，但其带来的训练稳定性是真实可靠的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在维度回答了训练所需的最小随机方向数，小维度值启发了LoRA等参数高效方法。作者希望用VMC这一严苛且可评分的场景来检验内在维度的真实含义。

Method: 仅训练一个小潜在向量，通过冻结的随机映射转换为网络权重，不改变标准的自然梯度优化器，在磁性模型和量子相变场景下测量内在维度。

Result: 在难符号模式的磁体上，无法表示符号的网络在28642个方向中仅8个达到最优能量，但这只是因为该类网络无法更低；符号可学后，符号和幅度都不廉价。维度在量子相变处上升，能低成本追踪状态难度，但从不低于随机子空间设定的下限。子空间训练从未发散，而全参数训练会发散。

Conclusion: 内在维度小可能误导，但其带来的稳定性真实；子空间训练的稳定性源于降维本身。

Abstract: How many directions in weight space does training need? The intrinsic dimension answers this with the smallest number of random directions in which training still reaches a target accuracy, and small values have motivated parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA. We measure it for variational Monte Carlo (VMC), which trains a neural network to represent the ground state of a quantum many-body system. VMC is a demanding test, because the network generates its own training samples and every gradient is noisy, and a revealing one, because the exact answer is known and every run can be scored. We train only a small latent vector that a frozen random map turns into the network's weights, with no change to the standard natural-gradient optimizer. We find that a small dimension can be misleading, while the stability it brings is real. On a magnet with a hard sign pattern, a network that cannot represent signs reaches its best energy in 8 of 28,642 directions, but only because no such network can go lower; once signs are learnable, neither the signs nor the magnitudes are cheap. The dimension rises across a quantum phase transition, so it tracks how difficult a state is at far less compute than fitting a scaling law, yet it never falls below a floor set by the random subspace itself, even where the ground state is nearly trivial. Training in the subspace, in contrast, never diverged in our experiments, whereas full-parameter training with the same settings did, and a control with matched solvers attributes the difference to the reduced dimension.

</details>


### [1147] [Orthogonal Witness Control for Muon Optimization via Sigmoid Spectral Reshaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33194)
*Dat Phi Van,Ngo Vu Minh,Tuc Nguyen,Thin Nguyen,Ngoc-Thanh Dinh,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出矩阵优化器Soren，用有界单调sigmoid变换压缩梯度奇异值而非完全展平谱，并给出收敛保证与Soft Newton–Schulz多项式实现，在LLM预训练、SFT和DPO上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon等矩阵优化器通过Newton–Schulz正交化利用更新谱结构，但几乎展平奇异谱，丢弃了不同梯度模态间的相对幅度信息。作者希望保留梯度奇异子空间的同时，保留幅度信息。

Method: Soren保持梯度的奇异子空间不变，对奇异值施加有界单调sigmoid变换，平滑压缩主模态但不完全展平谱。将其解释为半正定预条件梯度方法，并在相对光滑性与度量Polyak–Łojasiewicz几何下建立收敛保证。为避免显式SVD，提出有限深度Soft Newton–Schulz（SNS）多项式实现，并刻画其谱近似对收敛几何的影响。

Result: 在LLM预训练、监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）实验中，Soren相对已有优化器表现出有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Soren通过sigmoid谱变换在保留奇异子空间的同时避免谱完全展平，兼具理论收敛保证与实用多项式实现，是一类有效的矩阵优化器。

Abstract: Matrix-valued optimizers such as Muon exploit the spectral structure of neural network updates through Newton--Schulz orthogonalization, but their near-flattening of the singular spectrum discards relative magnitude information across gradient modes. We introduce \emph{Soren} (\textbf{S}pectral \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{Re}shapi\textbf{n}g), a matrix-valued optimizer that preserves the singular subspaces of the gradient while applying a bounded, monotone sigmoid transformation to its singular values. This smoothly compresses dominant modes without fully flattening the spectrum. We interpret Soren as a positive-definite preconditioned gradient method and establish convergence guarantees under relative smoothness and metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz geometry. To avoid explicit singular value decomposition, we further develop a finite-depth Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) polynomial realization of the sigmoid spectral map and characterize how its spectral approximation affects the induced convergence geometry. Experiments across LLM pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Soren against established optimizers.

</details>


### [1148] [Teach Yourself Where to Look: On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation for Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33200)
*Safaeid Hossain Arib,Rabeya Akter,Ismam Nur Swapnil,Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi,Md Mofijul Islam,Tasnim Mohiuddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OPASD，用解条件注意力蒸馏补充令牌级自蒸馏，提升精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏只迁移教师的令牌预测，未迁移其在上下文中的注意力分布，导致监督不完整。

Method: OPASD在令牌级监督外加入解条件注意力蒸馏，将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置并重归一化后对齐。

Result: 在3个模型规模、4个竞赛级数学基准上，平均准确率比纯令牌OPSD提升4.98-8.40个百分点，rollout令牌减73.9%，算力减72.6%，训练快1.53倍。

Conclusion: 解条件注意力是互补监督信号，使on-policy自蒸馏更准确、稳定且省算力。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation trains reasoning models on their own trajectories using dense token distribution guidance from a privileged teacher with access to a verified solution. This supervision transfers what the teacher predicts without directly transferring where it attends within the preceding context. We introduce On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD), which complements token-level supervision with solution-conditioned attention distillation. Because the privileged teacher can attend to verified solution tokens unavailable to the student, OPASD projects teacher attention onto student-visible positions and renormalizes the resulting distribution before alignment. Across three model sizes and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks, OPASD consistently outperforms token-only OPSD, improving average accuracy by 4.98 to 8.40 percentage points. OPASD also avoids the response-length inflation and performance degradation observed with token-only distillation, reducing generated rollout tokens by 73.9% and estimated model compute by 72.6% while training 1.53x faster. These results show that solution-conditioned attention provides a complementary supervision signal that makes on-policy self-distillation more accurate, stable, and compute-efficient.

</details>


### [1149] [SMORE: Stability-Promoting Mesh-Agnostic Model Reduction for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33205)
*Yangyuan Li,Weichao Li,Shaowu Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMORE，一种基于Lyapunov引导稳定性正则化的网格无关PDE降阶框架，实现稳定长时程预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真时变PDE模拟计算昂贵，需数据驱动降阶代理模型；但现有代理模型时序稳定性差，长时程多步预测易出现发散和不稳定梯度。

Method: SMORE为网格无关的降阶框架，其隐动力学采用Lyapunov引导的稳定性正则化训练，隐动力学可解释且为线性或线性二次型；支持从稀疏初始测量预测连续PDE解场，并在给定结构假设下提供理论保证。

Result: 在波动传播、Navier-Stokes方程、浅水方程等问题上评估，相比DINo、FNO、CNO、Transolver等基线，长时程泛化与经验鲁棒性提升，并在相当参数预算下达到有竞争力精度。

Conclusion: SMORE通过稳定性正则化有效缓解长时程预测不稳定问题，隐动力学还有利于数据同化与最优控制等下游任务。

Abstract: High-fidelity simulations of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive, motivating data-driven reduced-order surrogates for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, design optimization, data assimilation, and optimal control. However, existing surrogate models often exhibit poor temporal stability, which can lead to unstable rollouts and exploding gradients during backpropagation, especially in multistep long-horizon forecasting. To address this, we propose SMORE, a mesh-agnostic framework for model order reduction of time-dependent PDEs. Its latent dynamics are trained with Lyapunov-guided stability regularization, which promotes stable long-horizon rollouts. We provide theoretical guarantees under the stated structural assumptions. Beyond forecasting PDE evolution, the learned latent dynamics, which are interpretable and linear or linear-quadratic, could bring benefits for downstream tasks such as data assimilation and optimal control. Moreover, our framework is capable of predicting continuous PDE solution fields from sparse measurements of the initial condition. We evaluate SMORE on a range of problems, including wave propagation, the Navier-Stokes equations, and the shallow water equations. Our results show that it improves long-horizon rollout generalization and empirical robustness, and achieves competitive accuracy at comparable parameter budgets relative to competitive baselines including DINo, FNO, CNO, and Transolver.

</details>


### [1150] [When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33220)
*Steven Y. Feng,Noah D. Goodman,Michael C. Frank,Evan Hubinger,Paul C. Bogdan,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 仅以结果为导向的强化学习训练可产生任务性能相近但"失败披露"行为差异极大的模型；该行为在多次运行间高度不稳定，需直接测量并设计稳定的训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结果导向RL只关注任务性能，忽略了模型如何沟通自身失败。论文想揭示这类安全相关行为在训练中是否稳定，以及稳定的任务准确率是否能保证稳定的行为。

Method: 在重复的仅结果GRPO训练中测量"失败披露"（模型是否承认解答失败而非沉默或伪装成功）；扩展到第二个推理任务、稳定的PPO、7B规模及指令条件32B设置；分析浮点与采样差异的影响；用中性对照实验检验弱约束行为；通过抑制模型在失败但格式良好回答上偏离初始策略来尝试降低变异性。

Result: 失败披露在运行间变异远大于任务准确率；该现象跨任务、算法（PPO）、规模（7B、32B）复现；训练的微小数值/采样差异即可改变报告行为；失败披露包含多个可分离子决策（核对答案、进入报告、完成承认），薄弱环节依任务与响应格式而变；弱约束行为普遍更易跨运行波动；抑制偏离初始策略可显著提升披露一致性，但对任务性能影响不一。

Conclusion: 稳定的任务准确率并不能保证稳定的安全相关行为。研究者应跨运行直接测量这类行为，并设计能使它们保持可靠的训练方法。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.

</details>


### [1151] [RMB: Reward Model Boosting Mitigates Reward Hacking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33221)
*Jiabin Fan,Dezhi Ye,Yongchang Hao,Lili Mou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Reward Model Boosting (RMB)，通过多样性正则训练多个奖励模型并用boosting方式聚合，提升奖励信号鲁棒性，缓解RLHF的reward hacking问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF常因代理奖励模型不完美而出现reward hacking：策略优化提升了代理奖励却降低了真实人类偏好表现，需要增强奖励信号的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Method: 先用多样性促进正则器训练一组奖励模型，使各模型学习奖励景观的互补方面；再基于boosting原则学习一个轻量级聚合器，将多样奖励模型的输出整合为更准确、鲁棒的奖励信号。

Result: 大量实验表明，RMB在分布内和分布外数据集上均显著提高奖励准确率，大幅缓解reward hacking，并最终提升RLHF性能。

Conclusion: RMB是一种可有效增强RLHF奖励信号、缓解reward hacking并改善对齐效果的新方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. However, it often suffers from the reward hacking issue, where policy optimization improves the proxy reward model while actually degrading performance with respect to the true human preference, due to the imperfection of the proxy. To address this, we propose Reward Model Boosting (RMB), a novel approach that enhances the robustness and reliability of the reward signal for RLHF. RMB first trains a set of reward models with a diversity-promoting regularizer. This encourages each model to learn complementary aspects of the reward landscape. Then, RMB learns a lightweight aggregator in the principle of boosting to aggregate the outputs of the diverse reward models into a more accurate and robust reward signal. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RMB significantly improves reward accuracy on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets, substantially mitigating the reward hacking issue and ultimately improving RLHF performance.

</details>


### [1152] [MTLiquid: Enabling Efficient Multi-Task Learning using Liquid Neural Networks for Lightweight Healthcare Monitoring Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33232)
*Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra,Fahad Abdul Rauf,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MTLiquid，一种在连续时间神经网络中实现高效多任务学习的方法，用于医疗监测系统。通过共享主干网络+多输入输出头，以及损失加权和数据比例呈现的训练策略，在 ICU 死亡率预测(P12)和脓毒症早期检测(P19)上取得与单任务连续/离散网络相当的性能，同时内存开销降低 44%-94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗监测中生理信号常以不规则时间间隔采样，需连续时间处理；且系统通常需同时完成多个检测/预测任务以提供全面评估。然而现有连续时间神经网络(CTNN)通常每个网络只解决单一任务，限制了效率收益。

Method: MTLiquid 包含两部分设计：(1) 多输入头与多输出头以支持不同任务，同时跨任务共享同一主干网络；(2) 高效训练策略，采用损失加权技术平衡各任务的学习更新，并使用按比例的数据呈现技术应对数据集规模不平衡问题。

Result: 在 ICU 患者的死亡率预测(P12)和脓毒症早期检测(P19)上，MTLiquid 性能(AUROC: P12=0.84, P19=0.94)与连续时间网络单任务(SOTA: P12=0.84, P19=0.95)及离散时间网络(P12=0.79-0.82, P19=0.92-0.94)相当，同时内存开销显著减少 44%-94%。

Conclusion: MTLiquid 方法有望实现轻量化的连续时间医疗监测系统，从而支持更好的决策。

Abstract: Continuous-time sensing and monitoring with timely and accurate decision-making are critical for many real-world applications. In healthcare monitoring systems, physiological signals are often available or sampled at irregular time intervals, hence requiring continuous-time processing to provide accurate prediction. Moreover, such systems often need to solve multiple detection/prediction tasks to provide a comprehensive patient review from different physiological aspects for more accurate decision-making. To solve this, continuous-time neural networks (CTNNs) can be employed. However, state-of-the-art works typically solve only one task at each network, thereby limiting their efficiency gains. To address this limitation, we propose MTLiquid, a novel methodology to enable efficient multi-task learning in continuous-time processing for healthcare monitoring systems through effective network design and training strategy. MTLiquid employs: (1) multiple input and output heads to accommodate different tasks, while sharing the same backbone network across tasks; as well as (2) an effective training strategy that leverages a loss-weighting technique to balance learning updates across different tasks and a proportional data presentation technique to address imbalanced dataset sizes. Experimental results for mortality prediction (P12) and sepsis early detection (P19) tasks for ICU patients show that, MTLiquid achieves strong performance (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.94 for P19) comparable to the state-of-the-art single-task learning in both continuous-time networks (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.95 for P19) and discrete-time networks (AUROC: 0.79-0.82 for P12 and 0.92-0.94 for P19), while incurring significantly smaller memory cost by 44%-94%. These results highlight the potential of our MTLiquid methodology to enable lightweight continuous-time healthcare monitoring systems for better decision-making.

</details>


### [1153] [Feedback-Robust AI for Patient Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33248)
*Mohammed Sameer Syed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ClosedLoopBench 基准与反馈鲁棒的因果患者图方法，用负控制动作流检验 29 个由物理/药理/临床固定符号的关系，在 VitalDB 上显著优于相关构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 床边监测患者知识图谱需标注关系类型与数据支持性。在麻醉与重症中，药物和通气随生理调整，时间关系混淆了患者反应与医生策略（闭环反馈），而无校准的相关/格兰杰方法易产生虚假因果。

Method: 构建 ClosedLoopBench：3,442 例 VitalDB 手术（12,653 小时），29 个符号由物理、药理或临床实践固定的关系，并用他人动作流作负控制。提出反馈鲁棒患者图：概念节点+证据指针、经负控制准入的类型化关系、搏动级耦合（beat-level couplings）。

Result: 负控制流下，12 个估计器中 6 个在未校准时平均宣称 11-18 个关系显著；校准后互相关与格兰杰检验仍给通气率->呼末CO2赋予医生策略的符号。所提图每图仅 0.06-0.10 个假概念级关系实例，对比相关构造的 10-12。11 个慢速药物/通气反应的个体化估计预测后续数据不优于群体估计；脉压到达时间-收缩压斜率在 94.3%（2,884 例）为负且具个体特异性（早晚期相关 0.67）。

Conclusion: 反馈混淆使常规因果估计不可靠，符号固定+负控制准入的类型化患者图可有效抑制假关系，且部分个体化生理耦合真实存在而慢速反应个体化无增益。

Abstract: Patient knowledge graphs from bedside monitoring should type their relations and state whether the data support their signs. In anesthesia and intensive care, clinicians titrate drugs and ventilation in response to the physiology, so temporal relations mix the patient's response with the clinician's policy. We introduce ClosedLoopBench: 29 relations with signs fixed by physics, pharmacology or clinical practice, on 3,442 VitalDB surgical cases (12,653 h) with negative-control action streams. When each patient's actions are replaced by another patient's, six of 12 estimators declare on average 11-18 of their 19-29 distinct relation estimates significant without calibration, and after calibration cross-correlation and Granger tests still assign ventilator rate -> end-tidal CO2 the sign of the clinician's policy. We propose feedback-robust patient graphs that combine concept nodes with evidence pointers, typed relations admitted against negative controls, and beat-level couplings. On VitalDB under null streams, our graphs contain 0.06-0.10 false concept-level relation instances per graph, versus 10-12 for correlational construction. Patient-specific estimates of 11 slow drug and ventilator responses predict later data no better than population estimates, whereas the pulse-arrival-time-systolic-pressure slope is negative in 94.3% of 2,884 cases and patient-specific (early-late correlation 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]).

</details>


### [1154] [BERT4DTI : BERT-based Model for Predicting Drug-Protein Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33254)
*Thanina Hamitouch,Khadidja Henni,Abdelkrim Arie,Amina Selma Haichour,Neila Mezghani,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BERT4DTI：用ChemBERTa和ProtBERT编码SMILES与氨基酸序列，通过双向互注意力捕捉配对依赖，再用卷积层和MLP分类，以更低可训练参数量在DTI任务上取得竞争力表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于序列的药物-靶标相互作用（DTI）模型面临三大实际限制：标注交互数据稀缺且分布不均；大型预训练化学与蛋白编码器端到端微调成本高；独立编码的序列无法捕捉配对特异性依赖。

Method: BERT4DTI分别用ChemBERTa编码SMILES、ProtBERT编码氨基酸序列，在token级表示间施加双向互注意力，再用卷积层和多层感知机对交互特征分类。为降低可训练规模，ProtBERT截断至保留18层，且每个编码器仅微调最后两层。

Result: 在BIOSNAP、DAVIS和BindingDB上表现具有竞争力：在BIOSNAP取得最佳ROC-AUC和PR-AUC，在三个基准上均取得最高敏感度。DAVIS消融实验显示互注意力提升PR-AUC和特异性。可训练参数125M，相比全BERT微调的353M更具优势。

Conclusion: BERT4DTI在性能与参数量间提供了有利权衡，适合基于序列的DTI筛选；运行时分析、校准及防泄漏验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: Understanding how drugs interact with protein targets is fundamental to drug discovery, drug repurposing and the early identification of promising therapeutic candidates before costly experimental testing. Sequence-based DTI models face three practical limitations: labelled interactions are scarce and unevenly distributed, large pretrained chemical and protein encoders are expensive to fine-tune end-to-end, and independently encoded sequences do not capture pair-specific dependencies. We present BERT4DTI, which encodes SMILES strings with ChemBERTa and amino-acid sequences with ProtBERT, applies bidirectional mutual attention between token-level representations, and classifies the resulting interaction features using convolutional layers and a multilayer perceptron. To reduce trainable size, ProtBERT is truncated to 18 retained layers and only the last two layers of each encoder are fine-tuned. On BIOSNAP, DAVIS and BindingDB, BERT4DTI is competitive, achieving the best ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on BIOSNAP and the highest sensitivity on all three benchmarks. An ablation on DAVIS shows that mutual attention improves PR-AUC and specificity. With 125M trainable parameters compared with 353M for full BERT fine-tuning, BERT4DTI provides a favourable performance-parameter trade-off for sequence-based DTI screening, while leaving runtime profiling, calibration and leakage-audited validation for future work.

</details>


### [1155] [Two Heads Are Better Than One: Aggregating Weaker LLMs for Better Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33257)
*Cheng Peng,Ruixi Luo,Zhi Chen,Wei Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究弱到强预测聚合：用较弱的LLM预测器聚合能否超越最强单一预测器。基于ForecastBench，70个LLM、16组、1121个弱模型对，结果显示16组中11组可匹配或超越最强个体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最强单一LLM预测器可能成本高或受限，因此希望用较弱的LLM预测器通过聚合超越强预测器。

Method: 使用ForecastBench评估70个LLM预测器，16个比较组，每组超1000个共享子问题，共1121个弱模型对。以测试Brier分数识别组内最强个体，仅在训练数据上学习聚合权重，评估只由弱预测器组成的聚合。

Result: 学习到的线性池化在16组中11组找到匹配或超越最强个体的弱模型对，且全部16组Brier分数都在最强个体5%以内；改进不依赖接近最优的成员，且通常校准良好。增加更多模型并不稳定提升性能，实际约束下仍可获得有竞争力的弱模型聚合。

Conclusion: 弱到强预测聚合存在显著证据：较弱LLM预测器的聚合可匹配甚至超越最强个体，并且这种提升具有稳健性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events, but access to the strongest individual forecaster may be costly or otherwise constrained. We study weak-to-strong forecast aggregation: can individually weaker LLM forecasters be aggregated to outperform a stronger forecaster? Using ForecastBench (Karger et al., 2025), we evaluate 70 LLM forecasters across 16 comparison groups, each with more than 1,000 shared subquestions, yielding 1,121 weaker-model pairs. Within each group, we identify the strongest individual by test Brier score and evaluate aggregates composed exclusively of weaker forecasters, with aggregation weights learned on separate training data. We find substantial evidence of weak-to-strong improvement. Learned linear pooling identifies a weaker pair that matches or outperforms the strongest individual in 11 of 16 groups and comes within 5% of its Brier score in all 16 groups. We also find that these improvements do not rely on having a near-best constituent and are generally accompanied by good calibration. Additional analyses show that adding more models does not consistently improve performance, and competitive weaker-model aggregates also remain available under practical constraints.

</details>


### [1156] [GTRL: Grounding Divide-and-Conquer Value Learning with Temporal Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33259)
*Abdul Monaf Chowdhury,MD Sameer Iqbal Chowdhury,Shifat E Arman,Md Mehedi Hasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GTRL，用一步TD目标接地分而治之更新，解决离线GCRL在随机动力学下的有偏价值与无法更新非连通状态-目标对问题，并在19个OGBench任务上取得最高平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习中，分而治之通过子目标拼接短片段以扩展到长时域，但存在两个问题：随机动力学下其基础情形只重视数据中最幸运的轨迹；子目标必须位于共享轨迹上，导致无轨迹连接的状态-目标对得不到价值更新。

Method: GTRL将一步TD目标与分而治之组合更新相结合，而非替换。由于单步TD目标对后继取平均且无需子目标，故正确无误；该目标被加入组合中，使每对状态-目标都获得更新，同时组合仍承载长时域信息。此外，通过对每个目标相对于其他后继的可达性进行重加权，纠正事后重标记带来的偏差。

Result: 在涵盖随机、确定性和拼接环境的19个OGBench任务上评估，GTRL取得最高平均成功率。

Conclusion: GTRL通过将一步TD目标接地于分而治之组合并重加权纠正事后重标记偏差，兼顾长时域与全覆盖更新，在多种环境下表现最优。

Abstract: In offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), divide-and-conquer scales to long horizons by joining two shorter segments at a subgoal. However, under stochastic dynamics, the base case of this rule values the luckiest trajectories through the data. The subgoal must also lie on a shared trajectory, so a state-goal pair that no trajectory connects gets no value update at all. To address both, we present Grounded Transitive RL (GTRL), an offline GCRL value learning algorithm that grounds the divide-and-conquer update with a one-step TD target. Over a single step, TD is correct, as its target averages over the successors and needs no subgoal. GTRL adds this target to the composition rather than replacing it, so every pair receives an update, and the composition still carries the long horizon. GTRL also corrects the bias from hindsight relabeling by reweighting each goal against how reachable it was from other successors. We evaluate our algorithm on nineteen OGBench tasks spanning stochastic, deterministic, and stitching environments, where it achieves the highest average success rate. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [1157] [Towards Identifiable Representations under Misspecified Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33273)
*Yuke Li,Yujia Zheng,Ziyi Chen,Kun Zhang,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究潜变量依赖噪声下更一般的错误指定结构，突破条件独立假设，建立精确与近似可识别性保证，并提出无监督变分估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可识别性结果依赖观测在给定潜变量下的条件独立（条件分解）假设，但现实中该条件因子化往往不成立，噪声依赖潜变量带来根本性挑战。

Method: 将结构性错误指定建模为受扰动的因子分析问题；在谱分离与受控扰动条件下建立子空间可识别性，进而在结构稀疏下得到逐分量可识别性；当精确条件不满足时给出近似子空间可识别性定理，并据此设计无监督变分估计器。

Result: 得到精确的子空间与逐分量可识别性保证，以及近似子空间可识别性定理；实验验证了所提框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 在条件独立假设失效的更一般错误指定结构下仍可实现潜变量恢复，所提理论保证与无监督变分估计器有效。

Abstract: The presence of noise that depends on the latent variables poses a fundamental challenge to identifiability. Existing results rely on conditional independence among the observations given the latent variables. We study a more general \emph{misspecified structure}, where this conditional factorization does not hold, and establish both precise and approximate identifiability guarantees. We characterize structural misspecification as a perturbed factor analysis problem. For precise identifiability, we establish subspace identifiability under spectral separation and controlled perturbation, followed by component-wise identifiability under structural sparsity. When the precise condition is not guaranteed, we derive an approximate subspace-identifiability theorem. Based on these results, we develop an unsupervised variational estimator for recovering latent variables. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [1158] [Domain Generalization under Sampling Pattern Shifts in Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33279)
*Changhun Kim,Joohyung Lee,Kwanhyung Lee,Donghwee Yoon,Grigorios Chrysos,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个针对不规则采样多元时间序列（ISMTS）采样模式偏移的受控基准HAR-C，并基于此提出域泛化框架PRISM以提升对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISMTS中观测时间和可用测量在跨域时差异巨大，现有模型虽利用采样信息做预测，但其在采样模式偏移下的鲁棒性研究不足。

Method: 1) 构建HAR-C基准，系统研究采样偏移影响；2) PRISM框架：无任务标签下先学习互补的"特征中心"与"采样中心"表征，再在多样采样变化下进行鲁棒监督训练，抑制脆弱的捷径依赖。

Result: 在受控与真实ISMTS基准上，PRISM对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性一致优于现有域泛化方法；同时揭示采样偏移会显著降低性能并诱导采样特异捷径。

Conclusion: 采样模式偏移是ISMTS中一个关键且被忽视的鲁棒性挑战，PRISM为缓解该问题提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series (ISMTS) are prevalent in real-world applications, where both observation times and available measurements can vary substantially across domains. While recent models increasingly exploit such sampling information for prediction, its robustness under sampling pattern shifts remains underexplored. We introduce HAR-C, to the best of our knowledge the first controlled benchmark for sampling pattern shifts in ISMTS, and show that sampling shifts alone can substantially degrade performance, induce sampling-specific shortcuts, and remain challenging for existing domain generalization (DG) methods. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a DG framework that first learns complementary feature-centric and sampling-centric representations without task labels, and subsequently performs robust supervised training across diverse sampling variations to discourage brittle shortcut reliance. Extensive experiments on controlled and real-world ISMTS benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently improves robustness to unseen sampling shifts over existing methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM.

</details>


### [1159] [Direct Hidden-State Alignment: Mapping and Controlling Preference Expression in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33298)
*Fansheng Zhang,Shengran Guo,Zexiao Wang,Liang Yuan,Jiyuan Chen,Ruikun Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出残差竞争图(RCM)来分析预训练模型中偏好行为的因果表示，并基于此提出直接隐状态对齐(DHSA)方法，通过CAST在推理时对少量偏好相关接口进行局部状态干预，以极少参数量达到与DPO相当的对齐效果，且可即插即用、随时移除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多场景下后训练无需从零构建目标行为——基础模型已能产生该行为但不够稳定。这将偏好对齐的部分任务从"能力获取"转变为"行为表达"。作者希望弄清：指定偏好如何编码在模型原生计算中、什么阻碍了支持目标的计算可靠主导生成、以及这种结构能否直接指导控制。

Method: 提出残差竞争图(RCM)，将行为偏好映射到原生残差计算的有符号因果效应上。在此基础上提出直接隐状态对齐(DHSA)，把推理时隐状态而非基础模型权重作为直接适配空间；具体实现为RCM引导的因果激活状态转移(CAST)，在少量偏好相关接口做局部状态干预，同时冻结基础模型。

Result: RCM揭示跨偏好域存在共存的"支持目标"与"竞争目标"效应、组件角色依赖输入，且某些情况下单个原生组件干预即可逆转偏好结果。DPO会大幅重组这些效应，能削弱对抗但无法保证消除。CAST仅用256-16384个控制器参数，在三个偏好域上达到与DPO相当的工作点，可补充DPO训练模型，并能在推理时启用或移除。

Conclusion: 偏好对齐可在推理时通过隐状态干预高效实现，RCM提供了理解与引导原生计算结构的因果工具，CAST以极少参数实现灵活、可插拔的对齐控制。

Abstract: In many settings, post-training need not create the target behavior from scratch: the base model can already produce it, but not reliably. This shifts part of preference alignment from capability acquisition to behavioral expression. We ask how a specified preference is represented in native model computation, what prevents target-supporting computation from reliably dominating generation, and whether this structure can directly guide control. We introduce Residual Competition Maps (RCMs), which map a behavioral preference onto signed causal effects of native residual computation. Across preference domains, RCMs reveal coexisting target-supporting and target-competing effects, input-dependent component roles, and cases where a single native-component intervention reverses the preference outcome. DPO substantially reorganizes these effects and can weaken opposition without guaranteeing its removal. We then propose Direct Hidden-State Alignment (DHSA), which treats inference-time hidden states rather than base-model weights as the direct adaptation space. RCM-guided Causal Activation State Transition (CAST) implements DHSA through local state interventions at a small number of preference-relevant interfaces while freezing the base model. With only 256-16,384 controller parameters, CAST reaches DPO-competitive operating points across three preference domains, can complement DPO-trained models, and can be enabled or removed at inference time.

</details>


### [1160] [BITS: Rethinking Fair and Comprehensive Evaluation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33303)
*Kangjia Yan,Linfeng Wang,Tianen Shen,Xiangfei Qiu,Ruitong Zhang,Hao Miao,Jilin Hu,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang,Christian S. Jensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出BITS——一个标准化、可复现、可扩展的不规则时间序列预测基准，涵盖9个领域11个数据集，统一预处理/模型集成/评估流程，支持误差型与非误差型多维度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不规则时间序列预测评估缺乏统一基准，评估数据集有限、实验协议不一致，且主要依赖误差型指标，难以公平、全面地比较方法。

Method: 提出BITS基准：纳入11个数据集（9个领域），按缺失率、缺失模式复杂度、采样不规则性和偏度刻画数据集；提供统一的数据预处理、模型集成与评估、报告流程；在一致设置下兼容规则与不规则方法（含时间序列基础模型），并纳入误差型与非误差型指标。

Result: 方法性能随不规则特性差异显著，没有单一建模策略始终占优；误差型与非误差型指标会得到不同的模型排名，说明需要多维度评估。

Conclusion: BITS为不规则时间序列预测提供公平、全面、可复现的评估平台，推动该领域研究进展；多维度评估对方法选择至关重要。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in irregular time series forecasting, the field still lacks a unified benchmark for fair and comprehensive evaluation. Existing evaluations are often conducted on a limited set of datasets with inconsistent experimental protocols and predominantly error-based metrics, rendering it difficult to compare and assess methods fairly and comprehensively across diverse settings. To eliminate these limitations and accelerate progress, we propose BITS, a standardized, reproducible, and extensible benchmark for advancing research on irregular time series forecasting. BITS covers eleven datasets from nine domains with diverse irregularity characteristics, and it characterizes the datasets according to their missing rate, missing pattern complexity, sampling irregularity, and skewness. Further, it offers a unified pipeline for data preprocessing, model integration and evaluation, and reporting. It accommodates regular and irregular time series forecasting methods, including time series foundation models, under consistent settings, incorporating both error-based and non-error-based evaluation metrics. Findings include that method performance varies substantially across irregularity characteristics, with no single modeling strategy consistently dominating. We also find that using error-based or non-error-based metrics can yield different model rankings, highlighting the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. The code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BITS-8F2E/.

</details>


### [1161] [ZeroGAR: Benchmarking the Adversarial Robustness of Zero-Shot Graph Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33314)
*Zhongjian Zhang,Xiao Wang,Busheng Zhang,Bo Yan,Xingtong Yu,Yue Gao,Jia Li,Chuan Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZeroGAR，首个系统评估零样本图模型（ZGM）对抗鲁棒性的基准，覆盖13个模型、8个数据集及多种攻击，并发现干净性能强不代表对抗鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ZGM主要在干净图上评估，而图鲁棒性基准多聚焦监督场景，ZGM在未见目标图遭对抗操纵时的鲁棒性这一根本问题尚未被探索。

Method: 提出ZeroGAR基准，评估3种范式下13个代表性ZGM，在4个领域的8个数据集上，覆盖域内与跨域迁移，采用结构、文本和节点注入攻击及多种扰动预算，并检验现有图防御在零样本设置下的有效性。

Result: 强干净零样本性能不保证对抗鲁棒。三大发现：（1）脆弱性与预测机制相关，GNN方法易受结构和节点注入攻击，LLM方法易受文本攻击；（2）更强LLM主干引入结构-文本鲁棒性权衡；（3）现有图防御不能一致提升零样本鲁棒性，甚至可能损害干净性能。

Conclusion: ZeroGAR为ZGM安全性提供快速、公平的评估平台，并期望激发更多ZGM安全方向的创新研究。

Abstract: Zero-shot graph models (ZGMs), which learn transferable knowledge from source graphs and directly apply to unseen target graphs without any adaptation, have achieved promising performance and attracted considerable attention. Despite their proliferation, existing ZGMs are predominantly evaluated on clean graphs, while existing graph robustness benchmarks mainly focus on supervised settings, leaving a fundamental question largely unexplored: How robust are ZGMs when their unseen target graphs are exposed to adversarial manipulation? In this paper, we answer this question by proposing ZeroGAR, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the adversarial robustness of ZGMs. ZeroGAR evaluates 13 representative ZGMs from 3 different paradigms on 8 graph datasets across 4 domains, covering both in-domain and cross-domain transfer under structural, textual, and node injection attacks with multiple perturbation budgets. It further investigates whether existing graph defenses remain effective in the zero-shot setting. Extensive experiments reveal that strong clean zero-shot performance does not guarantee adversarial robustness, with three key findings: (1) Vulnerability patterns are related to model prediction mechanisms: GNN-based methods are particularly vulnerable to structural and node injection attacks, whereas LLM-based methods are more vulnerable to textual attacks; (2) Stronger LLM backbones introduce a structure-text robustness trade-off; (3) Existing graph defense methods do not consistently improve zero-shot robustness and may compromise clean performance. We hope that ZeroGAR will facilitate rapid, equitable evaluation and inspire further innovative research in ZGM security.

</details>


### [1162] [When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33334)
*Haeyong Kang,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE)，将 KV-cache 淘汰推迟到解码前两个 token 之后，仅改变"何时淘汰"即可在 LongBench 上接近 FullKV 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练 KV-cache 压缩方法（SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV）在 prefill 结束时即淘汰 token，但此时决定答案轨迹的 query 尚不存在，导致两个失败：(1) 补偿性失败——恢复被淘汰的注意力质量仍无法恢复任务质量；(2) 选择失败——覆盖更多真实 decode-query 质量反而有害，因为恢复的质量碎片化而非集中于连贯片段。

Method: 提出 DGE：将淘汰推迟到用完整 cache 生成前 k=2 个答案 token 之后（仅比 prefill 多一步 decode）。因 draft 由答案自身前缀生成，此时轨迹信号已可用。每头 cache 预算不变，可直接应用于 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O、StreamingLLM 而无需修改其淘汰评分。与额外前向方法不同，DGE 改变的是淘汰时机而非选择内容。并设时机对照 DGE-W。

Result: DGE 在六个 instruct-tuned 主干中的五个上，于每个预算下均超越先前方法，LongBench 得分 44.2，接近 FullKV 的 44.3。仅改变时机的对照 DGE-W 取得相同分数。

Conclusion: 性能提升源于"何时淘汰"而非"选择什么"，作者将此效应命名为 trajectory anchoring（轨迹锚定）。

Abstract: Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep.
