We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.

</details>


### [1163] [Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33336)
*Xuanlin Chen,Ziyue Wang,Xunlan Zhou,Yuan-yih Shang,Qiang Wu,Shenghua Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECON提出将保守策略学习与主动数据采集分离：主策略负责任务执行，探索器基于"可恢复性条件化的认知不确定性"采集真实交互数据，聚焦于主策略仍能回归专家行为的不确定状态，从而提升模仿学习效率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的模仿学习（MBIL）虽能提升真实交互效率，但模型与真实环境的占有分布差异使策略学习对模型误差敏感。保守MBIL会抑制模型利用，却因用同一保守策略采集数据，导致专家分布周围的不确定区域采样不足；而通用不确定性探索又会把交互浪费在与任务无关的新颖动态上。

Method: RECON将保守策略学习与主动数据采集解耦：维护一个主策略用于任务执行、一个探索器用于真实环境交互。探索器优化基于认知不确定性，且该不确定性以"可恢复性"为条件——可恢复性由主策略的多步想象（multi-step imagination）估计，从而将数据采集集中在主策略仍能返回专家行为的未知状态上。

Result: 在运动控制、导航和操作任务的实验中，RECON在交互效率、模仿性能和鲁棒性上均取得一致提升，表明其能将真实交互导向专家分布周围、以往方法探索不足的"可恢复区域"，进而学到更适合模仿的世界模型。

Conclusion: RECON通过可恢复性条件化的探索，针对性采集专家分布周边的可恢复未知区域数据，缓解了保守MBIL采样不足与通用探索任务无关的问题，学到更适合模仿的世界模型，验证了主动数据采集与保守策略学习分离的有效性。

Abstract: Model-based imitation learning (MBIL) improves real-environment interaction efficiency by optimizing policies on imagined rollouts from a learned world model. However, the gap between model-induced and real-environment occupancies makes policy learning sensitive to model error. Conservative MBIL mitigates model exploitation during policy optimization, but when real-environment interactions are collected by the same conservative policy, uncertain regions around the expert distribution remain insufficiently sampled. Generic uncertainty-driven exploration, on the other hand, may allocate interaction to novel but task-irrelevant dynamics. We propose REcoverability-CONditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning (RECON). RECON separates conservative policy learning from active data collection by maintaining a main policy for task execution and an explorer for real-environment interaction. The explorer is optimized based on epistemic uncertainty conditioned on recoverability estimated from multi-step main-policy imagination, focusing data collection on unknown states from which the main policy can still return toward expert behavior. Experiments on locomotion, navigation and manipulation show consistent gains in interaction efficiency, imitation performance, and robustness, indicating that RECON directs real-environment interaction toward recovery regions around the expert distribution that are underexplored by prior methods, and thereby learns a world model better suited for imitation.

</details>


### [1164] [Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33337)
*Boyang Li,Matthew Kim,Sylvia Lee Herbert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Safe Score Matching (SSM)，将Q-score matching扩展到硬约束安全RL，用HJ可达性对双分支score目标进行门控，在可行域内做Q-score matching、不可行域内做恢复，解决多模态目标动作分布的坍缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软期望成本约束只保证平均安全，硬状态约束需通过HJ可达性实现，但其可行域与不可行域目标不同，导致目标动作分布多模态，现有高斯或确定性actor易坍缩到次优模式。

Method: 提出SSM，一种off-policy actor-critic方法；用HJ可达性门控两分支score目标：可行集内去噪过程退化为对HJ critic判定为可行动作的Q-score matching，可行集外用恢复分支将去噪偏向最坏情况违反更低的区域。

Result: 在四旋翼和固定翼轨迹跟踪及stabilize-and-avoid基准上取得最佳或接近最佳性能且false-safe率低；primal-dual基线不安全行为更多，可达性基线更保守；在Safety-Gymnasium速度任务上获得最低成本且有竞争力的奖励。

Conclusion: SSM通过扩散策略与HJ门控的score matching，有效建模多模态安全动作分布，兼顾任务性能与硬约束安全。

Abstract: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. A popular line of research in safe RL relaxes safety to a soft expected-cost constraint and solves the resulting Constrained Markov Decision Process via primal-dual Lagrangian updates that only enforce safety on average. To address this limitation, hard, state-wise constraints are introduced and often imposed through Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. Yet such constraints require solving different objectives in the feasible and infeasible regions: reward maximization in the former, recovery toward the feasible regions in the latter. The resulting target action distributions are inherently multimodal, and this structure poses a fundamental challenge for the Gaussian or deterministic actors used in existing HJ-based safe RL, which often collapse onto suboptimal modes. Diffusion policies provide the expressiveness needed to represent such distributions, and recent work on Q-score matching offers a route to training them for online RL by score regression -- but has been applied only to reward maximization. We propose Safe Score Matching (SSM), an off-policy actor-critic method that adapts Q-score matching to hard-constrained safe RL by gating a two-branch score target with HJ reachability: inside the feasible set, the denoising process degenerates to Q-score matching on actions classified as viable by the HJ critic; outside, a recovery branch biases denoising toward regions with lower worst-case violation. On quadrotor and fixed-wing trajectory-tracking and stabilize-and-avoid benchmarks, SSM attains the best or near-best task performance with low false-safe rates, whereas the primal-dual baseline admits more unsafe behavior and reachability-based baselines tend to be more conservative; on Safety-Gymnasium velocity tasks, SSM attains the lowest cost with competitive reward.

</details>


### [1165] [RAEGL: Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning for Selective Contextual Routing under Temporal Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33340)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RAEGL 框架，通过风险感知的证据门控机制决定是否启用上下文残差预测，避免时间分布漂移下的有害部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文特化能提升预测精度，但在时间分布漂移下，某一历史区间选出的校正可能变得不可靠，导致部署风险。

Method: RAEGL 默认保留经全局验证的预测器，仅当部署前证据支持时才激活上下文残差。框架将候选选择与门控校准分离，并联合评估随机化显著性、实际增益意义和时间稳定性；扩展版本加入稳定性与支持度感知。

Result: 在 Our World in Data 审计中，精确回退避免了 0.0960 和 0.0239 的 RMSE 退化；在世界发展指标评估中，区域校正虽通过随机化检验，但因增益仅 0.000092、95% 置信区间跨零而被保留不用。受控面板中，强稳定情境激活率 97.2%，高漂移设置全部拒绝。

Conclusion: RAEGL 是一种可审计、基于证据的上下文部署风险管理机制，可作为验证驱动上下文选择的保守替代方案。

Abstract: Contextual specialization can improve forecasting accuracy, but a correction selected on one historical interval may become unreliable under temporal distribution shift. To address this issue, we propose RAEGL, a Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning framework for selective contextual forecasting. RAEGL retains a validated global predictor by default and activates a contextual residual only when pre-deployment evidence supports its use. The framework separates candidate selection from gate calibration and jointly evaluates randomization significance, practically meaningful gain, and temporal stability. Experiments on real-world audits and controlled panels show how RAEGL can prevent harmful contextual deployment while making conservative opportunity costs explicit. In a reconstructed Our World in Data audit, exact fallback avoids RMSE degradations of 0.0960 and 0.0239 caused by two validation-selected corrections. In a sealed World Development Indicators evaluation, a region-based correction passes the randomization test but is withheld because its gain is only 0.000092, its country-clustered 95% confidence interval crosses zero, and only 0.02% of bootstrap replicates reach the practical threshold. In controlled panels, the stability- and support-aware extension activates in 97.2% of strong, stable-context runs while rejecting all high-drift settings. These results support RAEGL as an auditable, evidence-based mechanism for managing contextual deployment risk and as a conservative alternative to validation-driven contextual selection.

</details>


### [1166] [CalibHyper: Chance-Corrected Relational Hypergraphs for Few-Shot Molecular Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33342)
*Linyu Li,Zhi Jin,Yuanpeng He,Dongming Jin,Huanyu Liu,Huanyao Zhang,Haoran Duan,Heng Tian,Gadeng Luosang,Nyima Tashi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CalibHyper，一种基于联合标签分布的chance-corrected关系超图方法，用于小样本分子性质预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测中实验成本高、标注数据稀缺，现有方法用辅助测定标签和标签一致性监督性质关系，但标签一致性对类别边缘分布敏感，且无法直接刻画性质间的依赖关系。

Method: 基于联合标签分布构建chance-corrected关系超图：从有序四态标签分布中减去独立基线，并按联合观测数量收缩残差；用swap-equivariant关系头估计残差，为每个分子选择辅助性质并确定超边消息的符号与权重。

Result: 在5个基准的13个数据集上，1-shot和10-shot设定下，CalibHyper及其消融设置取得与最强已报告结果相当的ROC-AUC。

Conclusion: CalibHyper通过联合标签分布的chance-corrected关系建模，克服标签一致性的局限，在小样本分子性质预测中达到具竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Molecular property prediction is central to drug development and materials discovery, but experiments are costly and labeled data are scarce. Context-aware methods use auxiliary assay labels to support few-shot prediction, and recent work supervises property relations with label agreement. However, label agreement is sensitive to class marginals and does not directly capture dependence between properties. We propose CalibHyper, a chance-corrected relational hypergraph method based on the joint label distribution. CalibHyper subtracts an independence baseline from the ordered four-state label distribution and shrinks the residual according to the number of joint observations. A swap-equivariant relation head estimates these residuals, which choose the auxiliary properties for each molecule and set the sign and weight of their hyperedge messages. On thirteen datasets from five benchmarks, in both 1-shot and 10-shot settings, CalibHyper and its ablation settings achieve ROC-AUC competitive with the strongest reported results.

</details>


### [1167] [MultiEcho: An Experimental Science of Learned Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33347)
*Meng Zhu,Airui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MultiEcho框架，通过受控反事实干预研究世界模型的响应规律，并独立测试其物理对应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可被视为具有自身响应规律的实验系统，但缺乏系统估计这些规律、界定其适用范围及检验物理对应性的框架。

Method: 在九个模拟物理系统和七个冻结模型配置上，采用三参考估计器，基于发现数据选择估计器，用验证与确认情境评估冻结拟合；通过事件窗口、可见性、相机干预、幅度扫描、精确重置材料实验及有限尺度恒等式等方法进行研究。

Result: 估计器可预测完整干预响应并恢复干预参数；响应可局部描述但物理效果匹配差；发现条件适用性、场景提示下可读性降低、小图像误差伴随大相对效果误差，以及可见响应成功与固定读出失败的分离；精确恒等式解决奇偶响应误差，一阶余项界规定精化校准的收敛条件。

Conclusion: MultiEcho为独立于物理定律并与之关联地研究学习世界规律提供了实验基础。

Abstract: World models can be studied as experimental systems with response laws of their own. We introduce MultiEcho, a framework for estimating these laws through controlled counterfactual interventions, delimiting their applicability, and separately testing their physical correspondence. Across nine simulated physical systems and seven frozen model configurations, three-reference estimators predict complete intervention responses and recover intervention parameters. Estimator selection uses discovery data only; frozen fits are evaluated on validation and confirmation contexts. The experiments distinguish response predictability, intervention readability and physical accuracy. Responses can be locally describable yet poorly match physical effects in the same target coordinates. Event-window, visibility and camera interventions reveal conditional applicability, and paired generator configurations show reduced readability under a scene prompt with stronger guidance. Magnitude sweeps expose small image errors alongside large relative effect errors. An exact-reset material experiment separates registered visible-response success from fixed-readout failure on material-dependent futures at matched positions and velocities. Exact finite-scale identities resolve odd and even response errors; first-order remainder bounds specify when refined calibration converges. MultiEcho provides an experimental basis for studying learned-world laws independently of, and in relation to, physical laws.

</details>


### [1168] [KoopCell: Koopman-Based Generative Model for Learning Single-Cell Dynamics from Distribution Snapshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33350)
*Wanfeng Lu,Yutong Zhang,Keyi Zhou,Chenxin Ge,Wei Lin,Qunxi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 KoopCell，基于 Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig 理论的生成框架，联合学习表示与线性隐动力学，用于从稀疏无配对分布快照建模群体动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从时间稀疏、无配对的分布快照学习群体动态是发育生物学核心难题；现有神经微分方程和流匹配方法难以外推训练范围，且缺乏显式建模发育分支的机制。

Method: 基于 Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig 理论统一学习表示与预测性线性隐动力学；利用弱连续性方程推导 Koopman 生成元的闭式最小二乘估计并给出收敛保证；提出 KoopCell-M，通过 Markovian embedding 将非马尔可夫记忆引入隐 Koopman 动力学以建模分支。

Result: 在合成系统和三个 scRNA-seq 数据集上，能够恢复 Koopman 谱、通过记忆建模分支，并扩展到预测高维基因表达分布，在所评估方法中达到最优性能。

Conclusion: KoopCell 为从稀疏无配对快照学习群体动态提供了有理论保证的统一生成框架，可有效外推并建模发育分支。

Abstract: Learning population dynamics from temporally sparse, unpaired distribution snapshots is a fundamental challenge in developmental biology. Recent approaches based on neural differential equations and flow matching can interpolate between observed population snapshots, but may struggle to extrapolate beyond the training horizon and often lack an explicit mechanism for modeling developmental branching. We propose KoopCell, a unified generative framework based on Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig theory that jointly learns representations and predictive linear latent dynamics. Theoretically, using the weak continuity equation, we derive a closed-form least-squares estimator for the Koopman generator from distribution snapshots and establish convergence guarantees under suitable assumptions. To model branching dynamics, we further develop KoopCell-M, which incorporates non-Markovian memory into the latent Koopman dynamics through a Markovian embedding. Experiments on synthetic systems and three scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate the ability of our framework to recover Koopman spectra, model branching through memory, and scale to predicting high-dimensional gene expression distributions, achieving state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods.

</details>


### [1169] [How Much Imprecision is Enough Imprecision in my Classifier? A Practical Elicitation Procedure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33352)
*Victor F. Lopes de Souza,Sébastien Destercke,Abdelhak Imoussaten*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出实用且可操作的引导(elicitation)程序，用于量化用户对集合值预测(即容忍不精确)的接受程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合值分类器（来自精确概率+代价函数、凸集+鲁棒推断、或conformal方法）能提供更鲁棒可信的预测，但缺少操作工具来衡量用户愿意以多少精度换取更高准确度。

Method: 提出迭代式引导程序来测量用户对集合值预测的倾向参数，在表格和图像数据集上验证其收敛性。

Result: 迭代引导程序能收敛到目标参数值，且只需向用户呈现少量样本实例。

Conclusion: 该方法实用性强，适用于识别决策者在面对不精确时的最优行为。

Abstract: Set-valued classifiers, whether derived from precise probabilities and an adapted cost function, from convex sets with a robust inference mechanism, or from conformal methods, are routine options to obtain more robust, trustworthy predictions. However, there is a lack of operational tools to measure how robust or imprecise a given user is ready to be when receiving predictions, that is how much precision he/she is ready to let go in exchange of more accuracy. This is why we propose, in this paper, practical and operational elicitation procedures to measure the user proneness to set-valued predictions. The effectiveness of the iterative elicitation procedure in converging to the target parameter value is demonstrated on both tabular and image datasets drawn from standard machine learning benchmarks. The results show that the procedure also presents the user with a small number of instances, highlighting the practicality of the approach for real-world applications aimed at identifying the decision maker's optimal behavior when faced with imprecision.

</details>


### [1170] [The Selection Rule Decides the Winner: A Pre-Registered Audit of Open-Set Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33370)
*Farhan Shahriyar Hossain,Taufikur Rahman Fuad,Md Abrar Jahin,Md Rizwan Parvez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过统一协议重跑DEMO、NSReg与自建OUTPOST，检验开集图异常检测中三条报告惯例对排名的影响，并注册40条预测，其中12条被证伪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开集图异常检测结果依赖三条惯例：用测试集最佳epoch读数、基线数字直接沿用旧论文、多数异常是把少数类重新标注为异常。作者想知道这些惯例在多大程度上决定了报告出的排名。

Method: 在八张图（基线七张，ogbn-mag上基线无法运行）上以相同seed与划分重跑DEMO、NSReg及小型一阶检测器OUTPOST，每个方法十个seed，每个run同时按best-epoch规则与可部署的validation规则打分；在测试这些惯例的run之前预先注册40条预测。

Result: 第一，规则改变领先者：best-epoch下OUTPOST与NSReg各在七张图中领先三张，validation下NSReg领先五张。第二，best-epoch带来的收益取决于benchmark构造方式：三张小的重标类图上为0.045–0.080 AUC-ROC，三张真实欺诈图上仅0.002–0.014。第三，OUTPOST中的伪标签在同样三张图上值0.038–0.065 AUC-ROC，但在任何真实欺诈图上无收益。此外，用于超参选择的0.002平局带在全部六张测试图上都低于配对标准误，即使十个seed也是如此。40条预测中12条被证伪。

Conclusion: 报告出的排名很大程度上由评测惯例决定，而非方法本身的稳健优势；best-epoch与人工构造benchmark会夸大收益，常用平局带也不可靠。作者给出简短的报告清单，并公开被证伪的预测。

Abstract: Open-set graph anomaly detection trains on a few labeled anomalies from one class and must also find anomaly classes that were never labeled. Published results share three conventions: the test score is read at the best epoch on the test set, baseline numbers are copied from earlier papers, and most anomalies are minority classes relabeled as anomalous. We ask how much of the reported ranking these conventions decide. We re-run two recent methods, DEMO and NSReg, together with OUTPOST, a small first-order detector built for this study. All three use one protocol with identical seeds and splits on eight graphs (seven for the baselines, which cannot run on ogbn-mag), ten seeds each, and every run is scored under both the best-epoch rule and a deployable validation rule. Before the runs that test them, we registered 40 predictions. Three findings hold. First, the rule changes the leader: under the best-epoch rule, OUTPOST and NSReg each lead three of seven graphs, while under the validation rule, NSReg leads five. Second, the best-epoch bonus depends on how the benchmark was built: 0.045--0.080 AUC-ROC on the three small relabeled-class graphs and 0.002--0.014 on the three real fraud graphs. Third, pseudo-labeling in OUTPOST is worth 0.038--0.065 AUC-ROC on the same three graphs but gives no benefit on any real fraud graph. We also show that a 0.002 tie band for hyperparameter selection lies below the paired standard error on all six graphs tested, even at ten seeds. Twelve of our 40 predictions were falsified, and we report them. We close with a short reporting checklist.

</details>


### [1171] [TNF based Spectral Embedding for Effective Application of Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33376)
*Rohan Yashraj Gupta,Lalith Srikanth Chintalapati,Satya Sai Mudigonda,Pallav Kumar Baruah,Raghunatha Sarma Rachakonda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文面向汽车保险欺诈检测，系统比较了多种分类、数据不平衡处理与降维嵌入方法的组合，提出三阶段最优方案(MWMOTE + TNFSE2 + Random Forest)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保险欺诈带来严重财务损失，欺诈检测模型需在高准确率之外兼顾Sensitivity、Specificity、Precision、F1、FPR、FDR、AUC等指标，因此需寻找合适分类模型并解决数据不平衡与高维表示问题。

Method: 使用汽车保险数据集，分类器包括DT、RF、XGBoost、LightGBM、GBM；不平衡处理采用MWMOTE与TGAN；降维嵌入采用基于拓扑节点特征(TNF)的谱嵌入及MDS、Isomap、t-SNE。共研究65种组合，形成三阶段框架：不平衡处理(Phase I)→数据嵌入(Phase II)→分类(Phase III)。

Result: 在所有65种组合中，MWMOTE(Phase I) + TNFSE2(Phase II) + Random Forest(Phase III)取得最佳结果；同时验证了TNF谱嵌入在汽车保险数据集上的有效性。

Conclusion: 该三阶段组合方法能有效提升汽车保险欺诈检测性能，TNF谱嵌入在此类数据中具有实用价值，为欺诈检测提供了一种创新方案。

Abstract: Fraud detection is an important area of research in the insurance business due to its financial implications. The primary aim of a fraud detection model is to identify fraud and non-fraud cases with high accuracy along with other important metrics such as Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1-score, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate, AUC etc. To achieve this, we need to explore a suitable classification model to identify fraud and non-fraud cases. In this work, we have used auto insurance data set and explored classification models such as Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). To overcome the problem of data imbalance, we have employed MWMOTE and TGAN techniques. We have used Topological Node Feature(TNF) based spectral embedding for low dimensional data representation along with some popular embedding methods like MDS, Isomaps and t-SNE. After studying all the 65 possible combinations of these models, we have proposed an innovative method for effective automobile insurance fraud detection. For the given dataset, our results show that using a combination of MWMOTE as a data imbalance handling technique (Phase I), TNFSE2 as data embedding (Phase II) and Random Forest as classification (Phase III) provides the best result in comparison to all other combinations. This work also highlights the efficacy of TNF based spectral embedding in automobile insurance dataset

</details>


### [1172] [Optimal Transport Dropout for Structured Predictive Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33377)
*Giacomo Lorenzon,Francesco Regazzoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OTD通过可学习的最优传输流联合学习潜空间扰动分布与预测映射，用Energy Score训练并以动能项正则化，生成结构化预测不确定性，优于MC dropout等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性神经网络与神经算子只给出点预测，缺乏可靠性度量。预测不确定性可能来自不可约的结果变异性、有限数据或模型类局限。Monte Carlo dropout虽计算方便，但其扰动律是预设的先验且通常在潜坐标间因子化，不够灵活。

Method: 提出Optimal Transport Dropout (OTD)，联合学习预测映射与潜扰动律。从简单的独立参考分布出发，通过可学习流将潜扰动传输并经由预测网络传播，从而诱导结构化预测律。训练采用严格proper的Energy Score，并用kinetic-action项对传输做几何正则化。

Result: 合成基准上OTD能捕获多峰预测分布、在模型误设时给出有意义的离散度，并随数据增多或模型容量增大而收缩离散度。在场值PDE代理任务中，预测离散度与预测误差的空间模式强对齐；相比MC dropout更准确，区间校准更好且显著更窄。真实回归基准上也有竞争性精度和更好的概率预测。

Conclusion: OTD提供了一种无需显式后验推断或独立训练集成即可学习结构化预测不确定性的方法。

Abstract: Deterministic neural networks and neural operators provide point predictions with no intrinsic measure of reliability. Yet, predictive uncertainty may stem from irreducible outcome variability, finite data, or limitations of the chosen model class. Monte Carlo dropout offers a computationally convenient way to construct a predictive distribution through stochastic feature masking, without training multiple independent networks or explicitly inferring a posterior over model parameters. However, its perturbation law is largely prescribed a priori and typically factorised across latent coordinates. We introduce Optimal Transport Dropout (OTD), which instead learns the predictive mapping and the law of its latent perturbations jointly. Starting from a simple independent reference distribution, OTD transports latent perturbations through a learnable flow and propagates them through the predictive neural network, thereby inducing a structured predictive law. Training uses the strictly proper Energy Score, while a kinetic-action term geometrically regularises the transport. Synthetic benchmarks show that OTD captures multimodal predictive distributions, generates meaningful dispersion when the model is misspecified, and exhibits contracting dispersion as more training data or greater model capacity are provided. For a field-valued partial differential equation surrogate, predictive dispersion strongly aligns with the spatial pattern of prediction errors. On this task, compared with Monte Carlo dropout, OTD yields more accurate predictions and better-calibrated, substantially narrower intervals. On real-world regression benchmarks, it further shows competitive accuracy and better probabilistic predictions compared to established baselines. OTD therefore offers a way to learn structured predictive uncertainty without explicit posterior inference or ensembles of independently trained predictors.

</details>


### [1173] [From Grey-Box to Green-Box: When can Physics-Informed Machine Learning Reduce Carbon Footprints in Structural Health Monitoring?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33387)
*Daisy R. Bradley,Nathan A. Hinchliffe,Daniel J. Pitchforth,Matthew R. Jones,Elizabeth J. Cross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨物理信息（灰盒）机器学习在结构健康监测中是否能降低环境影响，通过对比四种方法训练数据量与训练时间、碳排放的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在工程中应用日益重要，但计算时间的增加带来环境成本。物理信息/灰盒模型利用工程先验克服黑盒学习器的局限，本文探究其能否额外带来减少环境影响的好处。

Method: 在结构健康监测背景下，评估四种物理信息机器学习方法：残差建模、输入增强、混合建模、约束学习，涵盖高斯过程与神经网络。比较各模型达到给定误差阈值时的训练碳排放。

Result: 多数示例中，物理信息模型训练排放更低（输入增强模型例外）。训练排放的减少还与收集、存储更少数据带来的环境节省相叠加。

Conclusion: 结果虽有前景但并非万灵药：案例研究表明，引入物理知识带来的复杂性增加与训练数据需求减少的收益之间需要权衡。

Abstract: Machine learning plays an increasingly vital role in engineering, but the corresponding increase in compute time is not without environmental cost. Physics-informed machine learning or "grey-box" models have been developed to overcome some of the limitations of traditional black-box learners, utilising the physical insight that an engineer would have about the structure they are modelling and have shown promising results in the structural engineering field among many others. This work explores whether an additional advantage could be a reduced environmental impact, considering the relationship between training data quantity and training time, linking this duration to carbon emissions from computing.
  In a structural health monitoring context, four physics-informed machine learning approaches - spanning Gaussian processes and neural networks - are evaluated: residual modelling, input augmentation, hybrid modelling, and constrained learning. The emissions for training each of the models to reach a given error threshold is compared, and in most examples, shown to be lower for the physics-informed models (with input augmented models being an exception). This reduction in training emissions further compounds the environmental savings achieved by collecting and storing less data. Although promising results, we cannot expect a silver bullet and the case studies demonstrate that a trade-off is needed between the increased complexity that comes from introducing physics into a machine learner, against the gain from reduced training data requirements.

</details>


### [1174] [Beyond Timestamps: Decision-Aligned On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33391)
*Mingju Chen,Can Lv,Jinrong Liu,Huan Zhang,Heng Chang,Shiji Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AlignOPSD 解决 OPSD 中的决策-时间戳不匹配问题，通过决策对齐监督矫正与半马尔可夫分层信用分配，在多个 agent 任务上超越 GRPO 与 StepOPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 依赖稀疏的结果奖励，对长时程智能体监督过粗；OPSD 的高密度特权反馈存在"决策-时间戳不匹配"：特权指导对应的时间步与学生实际功能决策不一致，且学生决策可能跨越多个时间步，导致基于单时间戳的局部监督在上下文与信用时间范围上都产生错配。

Method: AlignOPSD 遵循"先对齐监督、再分配信用"的原则，包含两阶段：(1) 决策对齐监督矫正，在同一学生采样响应、跨兄弟 rollout 的功能匹配上下文中重打分，以校准局部教师证据；(2) 半马尔可夫分层信用分配，从对应关系变化中推导变时长的决策片段，并用矫正后的证据将结果奖励分配至各片段及其组成轮次。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 上以 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 评估：AlignOPSD 在全部八组 backbone–聚合指标对比中均优于 GRPO 和 StepOPSD，较 GRPO 提升 5.5–8.7%，六项排名第一；消融分析了两个对齐阶段及跨任务的超参敏感性。

Conclusion: AlignOPSD 通过先对齐监督再分配信用，有效缓解决策-时间戳不匹配，提升长时程智能体在可验证奖励下的强化学习表现，稳定优于 GRPO 与 StepOPSD。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often relies on sparse outcome rewards, providing coarse supervision for long-horizon agents. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this signal with dense privileged feedback. However, we identify \emph{Decision--Timestamp Mismatch}: privileged guidance may be misaligned with the student's functional decision because the corresponding decision can occur at a different timestep, while the student's decision itself may span multiple timesteps rather than being tied to a single timestamp. Thus, timestamp-local supervision can misalign both the context and the temporal scope of credit. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textsc{AlignOPSD}, following the principle of aligning supervision before assigning credit. Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification re-scores the same student-sampled response in functionally matched contexts across sibling rollouts to calibrate local teacher evidence. Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment then derives variable-duration decision spans from correspondence changes and uses rectified evidence to allocate outcome-grounded credit across spans and their constituent turns. We evaluate \textsc{AlignOPSD} with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA against representative baselines. \textsc{AlignOPSD} outperforms both GRPO and StepOPSD across all eight backbone--aggregate-metric comparisons, improving on GRPO by 5.5--8.7 \% and ranking first in six. Additional analyzes examine the two alignment stages and hyperparameter sensitivity between tasks. Our code is avaliable at https://github.com/mingju-c/Align-OPSD

</details>


### [1175] [AutoHGNN: Robust and Efficient Neural Architecture Search for Hypergraph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33392)
*Sirui Li,Pietro Liò b,Xinsheng Li,Baisong Liu,Chengbin Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AutoHGNN，一种为超图神经网络量身定制的神经架构搜索框架，通过 Hyper-Interaction Module 与 HyperSTD 准则自动发现高效架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图神经网络虽成功，但人工设计架构费时费力，且难以捕捉复杂高阶关系；传统 GNN 设计与超图数据存在不匹配，因此需要自动化、可适配的超图架构设计。

Method: 1) 在搜索空间引入 Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM)，解决传统 GNN 设计与超图数据不匹配的问题；2) 提出 Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) 作为结构选择准则，在可微搜索中识别最能保留原始超图内在结构亲和性的架构。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，AutoHGNN 在分类准确率和时间效率上均持续优于人工设计与自动搜索的基线方法。

Conclusion: AutoHGNN 能自动发现显著更有效的超图神经网络架构，验证了自动化超图结构设计的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Hypergraph neural networks have achieved significant success in recent years. However, manual architecture crafting is labor-intensive and often fails to capture complex, higher-order relations, making the automation of hypergraph neural network structure design crucial. To improve the automation and adaptability of hypergraph learning, this paper proposes AutoHGNN, a neural architecture search framework tailored for hypergraph neural networks. First, we introduce a Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM) into the search space to address the mismatch between conventional graph neural network designs and hypergraph data. Second, we propose Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) as a structural selection criterion to identify architectures that best preserve the intrinsic structural affinities of the original hypergraph during differentiable search. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets demonstrate that AutoHGNN consistently outperforms manually designed and automatically searched baselines in classification accuracy and time efficiency, proving that the discovered architectures are significantly more effective.

</details>


### [1176] [Decoupling Token Roles in Autoregressive Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33405)
*Suqin Yuan,Runqi Lin,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Junchi Yu,Lei Feng,Chris Russell,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示token在自回归预训练中的双重角色：作为预测目标与作为后续上下文。通过控制性破坏实验发现二者存在反转关系，并解释了语言模型生成文本时的类似机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归预训练越来越依赖异构数据，因此理解模型如何从单个token学习变得重要。以往将token贡献等同于其自身预测损失，但token不仅是预测目标，也是后续内容的上下文，这种双重角色未被区分。

Method: 使用控制性破坏（controlled corruption）方法，将token的"预测目标"角色与"作为上下文"角色解耦，分别考察两种角色对模型学习的影响。

Result: 发现反转现象：让含噪token更容易预测会减少其作为目标的损害，却增加其作为上下文的损害。该解耦还解释了语言模型生成文本的机制：生成时每个token依据与前缀的契合度被选出，而其作为上下文的作用从未针对独立确定的后续内容被检验，因为后续内容是为契合它而生成的。在已知破坏位置上，通过上下文起作用可以减少去除token自身损失所无法消除的损害。

Conclusion: 理解和控制模型从token中学到什么，需要解耦其作为预测目标和作为上下文两种角色。

Abstract: Autoregressive pretraining increasingly draws on heterogeneous data, making it important to understand how a model learns from an individual token. The next-token prediction objective naturally identifies a token's contribution with its own loss. However, each token is not only a prediction target but also context for what follows. Using controlled corruption, we decouple these two roles and find a reversal: making a noisy token easier to predict reduces its damage as a target but increases it as context. The same decoupling helps explain text generated by language models: generation selects each token by its fit to the prefix, while its role as context is never tested against an independently determined continuation, because that continuation is generated to fit it. At known corrupted positions, acting through the context can reduce damage that removing the token's own loss does not. Understanding and controlling what a model learns from a token therefore requires decoupling its roles.

</details>


### [1177] [StarBOA: Real-Time Mamba State-Space Unrolling for Sparse Radar Micro-Doppler in ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33408)
*Mustafa Bora Çelik,Ceren Çelik,Orhan Gazi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 StarBOA，用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替代注意力机制，在 ISAC 极端 chirp 子采样下实现高效因果雷达重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC 中雷达感知需在高达 90% 缺失数据的 chirp 子采样下工作。基于注意力的基线受限于 52ms 缓冲区，随稀疏度上升其熵趋于最大均匀熵（H=2.584 bits），无法捕捉长程步态周期上下文。

Method: StarBOA 用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替换注意力机制，以逐窗口方式增量更新，无需重新扫描历史重建结果。通过维护持久状态，在不增加每步计算成本的前提下整合超过 100 倍的时间历史。

Result: 在所有稀疏度水平上均优于基线已发表结果，SSIM 增益从 50% 缺失时的 +0.0379 增至 90% 缺失时的 +0.2472。每个窗口处理耗时 1.53ms，零前瞻（zero lookahead）。

Conclusion: StarBOA 在极端 chirp 子采样下实现了高效、因果的雷达重建，证明持久状态的 Mamba 架构可在长时序建模上超越注意力基线。

Abstract: In Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC), radar sensing must operate under chirp subsampling with up to 90\% missing data. An attention-based baseline, limited to a 52~ms buffer, collapses toward maximum uniform entropy ($H=2.584$ bits) as sparsity increases, failing to capture long-range gait-cycle context. We propose StarBOA, which replaces attention with a causal Mamba state-space model that updates incrementally on a per-window basis without re-scanning past reconstructions. By maintaining a persistent state, StarBOA integrates over $100\times$ more temporal history at no additional per-step computational cost. StarBOA outperforms the baseline's published results across all sparsity levels, with SSIM gains increasing from $+0.0379$ at 50\% missing data to $+0.2472$ at 90\%. Each window is processed in 1.53~ms with zero lookahead, demonstrating efficient causal reconstruction under extreme chirp subsampling.

</details>


### [1178] [FoldAttention: Declared-Reference Softmax for Fast Decode and Deterministic Backward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33410)
*Sriman Achanta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FoldAttention 提出一种固定参考值 Z_i 的加法式 softmax 注意力，避免在线 softmax 的临时归一化与重缩放，从而加速长上下文解码并实现确定性反向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归解码中 KV cache 不断增长，注意力成为长上下文主要开销；现有高性能 kernel 用 online softmax，需边扫描边发现归一化参考，导致早期结果暂定并可能重缩放。

Method: 利用 softmax 对共同平移不变的性质，在扫描 KV 前固定有限参考 Z_i，使权重 2^{s_ij - Z_i} 计算即确定，可在不同 key 区间直接相加；据此设计两类 Hopper decode 技术：最终权重先门控 KV 读取并用深度 T 截断小于 2^{-T} 的键但保留其质量；加法式 partial 无需重缩放的 split KV 与共享前缀级联。

Result: H100 T=16 下，对七个真实模型生成解码比最快 BF16 baseline 快 1.36-2.30×，跨 MHA/GQA 形状最高 3.09×；七个中六个误差在最低 BF16 误差 1.5% 内；读取全部 key 时匹配误差下快 1.14-1.30×。Qwen3-8B 上整个 decode step 最高快 1.46×，似然与长上下文准确率匹配 BF16。确定性反向比确定性 FlashAttention-3/4 快最高 1.84×，比最快非确定性 kernel 快 1.05×。

Conclusion: FoldAttention 通过固定参考的加法式 softmax 消除在线归一化与重缩放需求，同时提升长上下文解码速度并实现高效确定性反向，移除确定性的性能代价。

Abstract: Autoregressive decode repeatedly streams a growing KV cache, making attention a major cost at long context. Existing high-performance kernels use online softmax, which discovers a row's normalization reference as it scans keys. Earlier contributions therefore remain provisional and may require rescaling. We argue that the reference need not be discovered: softmax is invariant to a common shift, so the reference only has to keep the weights in range. We present FoldAttention, an additive formulation of softmax attention that fixes a finite reference $Z_i$ before scanning the KV cache. Each weight $2^{s_{ij}-Z_i}$ is then final when computed, so contributions add across disjoint key ranges and their quotient equals softmax attention in real arithmetic. We use this property to develop two techniques for Hopper decode: (1) final weights gate key and value reads before the bytes are fetched, and a per-call depth $T$ cuts keys below $2^{-T}$ while keeping their mass, and (2) additive partials compose split KV and shared-prefix cascades without rescaling. On H100 at $T=16$, FoldAttention decodes seven real-model generations 1.36-2.30$\times$ faster than the fastest BF16 baseline, and up to 3.09$\times$ faster across MHA and GQA shapes, at an error within 1.5% of the lowest BF16 error on six of the seven; reading every key, it is 1.14-1.30$\times$ faster at matched error. We validate on Qwen3-8B that a whole decode step is up to 1.46$\times$ faster while likelihood and long-context accuracy match those under BF16 kernels. The same principle makes the backward deterministic: CTAs round bounded partial gradients onto an integer grid declared before the reduction and add them in any order. FoldAttention thereby removes the determinism tax: its deterministic backward is up to 1.84$\times$ faster than deterministic FlashAttention-3/4 and 1.05$\times$ faster than the fastest nondeterministic kernel.

</details>


### [1179] [Investigating the Effect of k-NN Preprocessing on Developing Graph Neural Networks: A Fairness-Based Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33416)
*Nikolaos Zafeiropoulos,Emmanouil Mavrikos,George E. Tsekouras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于k-NN图构建与公平性约束的图卷积网络设计方法，在三个真实数据集上验证了k值对分类性能与公平性的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图卷积网络在多个应用中广泛使用，但其公平性问题（尤其是不同受保护群体间错误率差异）尚未被充分研究，且图构建过程与公平性目标之间缺乏系统性联合考量。

Method: 用k近邻预处理构建输入图；以均等赔率（equalized odds）为公平性准则，将其作为额外损失项直接嵌入模型优化目标；系统变化k-NN的邻域大小k，考察其对分类性能与公平性的影响。

Result: 在三个含已知偏差的真实表格数据集上实验：k值的选取显著影响性能趋势（随数据特性表现为稳步提升或在中值处达到峰值）；公平性约束显著降低了受保护变量各群体间假阳性率与假阴性率差异，且未造成整体精度的重大损失。

Conclusion: 联合优化图构建过程与公平性目标对基于GCN的学习至关重要，为构建更公平、更有效的图模型提供了系统化方法。

Abstract: In this paper, a methodology to design fair graph convolutional neural networks (GCNs) is developed and tested over several application data sets. The graphs that are used as inputs to the network are constructed by a k-nearest neighbor-based preprocessing procedure, while fairness issues are considered in terms of the equalized odds criterion. To effectively incorporate the above heterogenous information, the equalized odds criterion is directly embedded into the model's optimization objective through an additional fairness-driven loss functional term. The proposed methodology investigates how varying the neighborhood size in the k-NN algorithm during graph construction influences both the classification performance and the fairness of the resulting models. Extensive experimentation is conducted on three real-world tabular datasets with known biases, evaluating the interplay between graph structure and fairness enforcement. The results demonstrate that the choice of the value of the parameter k critically impacts the performance trends, either steadily improving or peaking at intermediate values depending on dataset characteristics, while the application of fairness constraints significantly mitigates disparities in false positive and false negative rates across groups defined by the protected variable at hand, without incurring major sacrifices in overall accuracy. This study highlights the importance of jointly optimizing the graph construction process and fairness objectives in GCN-based learning, providing a systematic approach toward building more equitable and effective graph-based models.

</details>


### [1180] [A Light Bilevel Refinement Aligns Self-Supervised Representations for Stronger Task-Specific Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33424)
*Gustav Wagner Zakarias,Zheng-Hua Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BiSSLight 通过 M-FAC 隐式梯度近似与 LoRA 参数高效微调，改进 BiSSL 双层优化框架，大幅提升效率与可扩展性，在下游任务上稳定提升性能，ViT-H 上计算时间减少十倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练表征迁移性好，但直接微调可能因子监督与下游目标不对齐而次优，甚至破坏有用的预训练特征。BiSSL 用双层优化引入过渡训练阶段缓解该问题，但其依赖传统双层优化求解，隐式超梯度近似开销大，难以适用于现代模型架构。

Method: 提出 BiSSLight，将 M-FAC 的隐式梯度近似与 LoRA 参数高效微调结合，替代 BiSSL 中昂贵的传统双层优化求解，实现高效且可扩展的过渡训练。

Result: 在多个下游任务和现代模型架构上验证，BiSSLight 持续提升下游性能；随模型规模增大，增益更明显（即便基线更强）。效率上，ViT-H 骨干上计算时间比前作减少十倍以上。

Conclusion: BiSSLight 使原本因开销过大而不可行的大规模 BiSSL 式训练变得可行，兼顾性能提升与计算效率，具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining learns representations that are broadly transferable across downstream tasks, yet direct fine-tuning can be suboptimal due to misalignment between self-supervised and downstream task objectives, potentially degrading pretrained features beneficial to the downstream task. The BiSSL framework addressed this by introducing a transitional training stage formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the downstream task objective guides the self-supervised learning process in refining pretrained representations to better facilitate subsequent fine-tuning. However, BiSSL relies on conventional bilevel optimization solving techniques whose costly implicit hypergradient approximations render the method increasingly impractical for contemporary model architectures. To make it efficient and scalable, we introduce BiSSLight, which combines M-FAC-based implicit gradient approximation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA, enabling efficient application at larger scales that were previously impractical. Evaluation across multiple downstream tasks and contemporary model architectures shows that BiSSLight consistently improves downstream performance, with gains becoming more pronounced as model size increases despite stronger baselines. The method is highly computationally efficient, reducing computation time by more than a factor of ten compared to its predecessor on a ViT-H backbone.

</details>


### [1181] [MoGround: Measuring and Mitigating Modality Distraction in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33431)
*Luca Zhou,Bo Zhao,Rose Yu,Emanuele Rodolà,Roberto Dessì*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MоГround数据集，在四个视觉域中保证每个问题的答案只从单一模态可得，从而量化"模态干扰"现象，并提出了基于权重空间鲁棒向量的缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探针很少保证单模态可答性，难以隔离多模态模型中因无关内容导致的答案翻转（模态干扰）现象。

Method: 构建MоГround数据集，跨越四个视觉域，保证每个问题可由唯一模态回答；在七个开源VLM上测量模态干扰；并在其中一个划分上训练权重空间鲁棒向量用于缓解干扰。

Result: 模态干扰并非普遍存在而是依赖模型；较弱的基础模态更易受干扰（r=+0.86），干扰随基础能力增强而减弱（r=-0.90）；鲁棒向量在七个模型上减少9%至51%的干扰，标准多模态任务准确率仅损失0.1分。

Conclusion: 单模态可答性保证有效隔离并度量模态干扰，所提缓解方法可在几乎不影响通用性能的前提下显著降低干扰，提示模态干扰是可预测且可缓解的。

Abstract: We release MoGround, a vision-language dataset spanning four visual domains in which the answer to every question is guaranteed to be available from exactly one modality. This guarantee enables us to measure modality distraction, the failure in which a model answers a question correctly from one modality alone and then flips to a wrong answer once irrelevant content from the other modality is added. Existing probes rarely establish single-modality answerability this way, making it hard to isolate distraction in the first place. Across seven open-source VLMs, we find that modality distraction is not universal but model-dependent. The weaker-grounded modality is the more distracted one (r = +0.86), and distraction scales inversely with grounding strength (r = -0.90). The single-modality guarantee also enables a mitigation method that needs to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant context. Trained on one split of MoGround alone, a weight-space robustness vector reduces distraction on all seven models by 9% to 51%, at a cost of only 0.1 average points of accuracy on standard multimodal tasks.

</details>


### [1182] [SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33437)
*Yanggan Gu,Yuanyi Wang,Zhen Li,Shuo Cai,Yuhang Liu,Junzhuo Li,Zihao Wang,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMAT，一种简单高效的merge-aware训练方法，通过仿真合并操作联合优化专家损失与期望损失，在语言和视觉语言模型上提升合并性能且训练开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准专家训练仅优化任务损失，无法保证合并后性能；现有merge-aware训练方法未充分覆盖常见合并操作且增加训练成本。

Method: 从专家视角将常见合并方法归纳为三种操作：Scale（缩放自身更新）、Mask（移除坐标）、Perturb（加入其他专家更新）。SMAT通过采样缩放系数、掩码和加性噪声，联合优化专家损失与模拟合并参数下的期望损失，并引入周期性调度、算子融合和参数存储切换以保证效率，每步仅一次前向和一次反向。

Result: 在四个语言和视觉语言主干模型上，SMAT在五种合并方法上的平均得分较各主干最强基线提升1.07-2.16分，训练时间开销相比标准微调低于2%。

Conclusion: SMAT统一建模三种合并操作，实现高效的merge-aware训练，显著提升合并后性能且开销可忽略，为模型合并训练提供简单有效方案。

Abstract: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1183] [SchemaMem: Schema-Indexed Recurrent Memory for Delayed State Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33436)
*Sungwoo Goo,Hwi-yeol Yun,Sangkeun Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SchemaMem——一种结合块内注意力与持久化schema索引相位状态的注意力循环记忆架构，在长延迟保持任务上优于Mamba-3和Gated DeltaNet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制可直接访问历史表示但保留全部历史代价高昂；循环模型能限制持久状态，但须在处理后续输入时保留关键信息，二者难以兼顾。

Method: SchemaMem采用块局部注意力与持久化、schema索引的相位状态：学习schema嵌入作为读写共享参考，读取用当前状态，写入使用层输入与静态schema嵌入（不含该层自身状态反馈）；块边界提交通过前向计算聚合有界相位增量；同一参数同时支持全历史注意力训练与循环训练。

Result: 在受控address-value任务（九种设置×三个种子）中，SchemaMem在四倍最大训练延迟处的写入值保持均值高于两个基线；更新值恢复在九个设置中均优于Mamba-3、七个优于Gated DeltaNet；但在该延迟下默认配置Gated DeltaNet更优，且SchemaMem需更多优化步数。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了schema索引循环中保持能力与优化代价之间的权衡。

Abstract: Attention provides direct access to past representations, but retaining an ever-growing history is costly. Recurrent models bound persistent state, yet must preserve selected information while processing subsequent inputs. We introduce SchemaMem, an attention-based recurrent memory architecture combining chunk-local attention with a persistent, schema-indexed phase state. Learned schema embeddings provide a shared representational reference for reading and writing. Reads use the current state, whereas writes use the layer input and static schema embeddings, excluding direct feedback from that layer's own state. Chunk-boundary commits aggregate bounded phase increments through forward computation. The same parameters also support full-history attention training before and during recurrent training. We studied selective updates, preservation, and delayed retrieval in a controlled address--value task, comparing three-layer models with approximately matched parameter counts and persistent-state dimensions. Across nine address/value settings and three training seeds, SchemaMem has higher mean written-value retention at four times the maximum training delay than both baselines, which are trained toward a higher in-range accuracy target. Updated-value recovery favors SchemaMem in all nine settings against Mamba-3 and seven against Gated DeltaNet. Defaults consistently favor Gated DeltaNet over SchemaMem at that delay, and SchemaMem requires substantially more optimization steps. These results identify a promising retention--optimization trade-off in schema-indexed recurrence.

</details>


### [1184] [A Cheap Verifier is Good Enough: LLM Post-training is Robust to Erroneous Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33467)
*Andreas Plesner,Curtis Northcutt,Francisco Guzmán,Anish Athalye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探究验证器一致性能否预测半可验证奖励任务上的后训练性能，发现高一致性并不稳定对应最佳训练验证器，且低成本验证器可大幅降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中需权衡训练步数、模型规模、验证器准确性等因素来最大化模型性能，但验证器一致性与后训练性能的关系尚不明确，尤其缺乏跨领域、跨模型规模的系统验证。

Method: 在HealthBench与PRBench（医学、法律、金融）任务上开展超过11k H100 GPU小时实验，覆盖Qwen3不同规模（HealthBench 1.7B-8B；PRBench 8B）、不同评估划分及前沿LLM golden verifier，比较验证器一致性与训练表现，并回顾性对比两种低成本验证器选择。

Result: 更高的验证器一致性并不能稳定识别最佳训练验证器；昂贵验证器未必优于廉价验证器，开源权重Gemma验证器表现强劲。两种低成本方案相对golden协议降低评分成本约98.8%-99.7%，平均比最佳训练验证器低1-3分，个别场景损失更大。

Conclusion: 验证器一致性不足以作为训练验证器选择的可靠指标；低成本验证器具备实用价值，但不能视为可互换，需结合具体场景谨慎选择。

Abstract: When post-training large language models on tasks with semi-verifiable rewards, there are many factors (training steps, base model size, training order, data quality, verifier accuracy, etc.) that practitioners must contend with to maximize model performance. Yet, it remains unclear how well verifier agreement predicts post-training performance on such tasks. In this paper, we explore this question with over 11k H100 GPU-hours, across HealthBench and PRBench tasks in medical, legal, and finance domains. Across the tested domains, Qwen3 trainees (1.7B-8B on HealthBench; 8B on PRBench), evaluation splits, and frontier LLM reference judges (which we call golden verifiers), higher verifier agreement does not consistently identify the best training verifier. Expensive verifiers need not outperform inexpensive ones, and open-weight Gemma verifiers produce strong training outcomes. We compare two low-cost choices retrospectively -- a cost-reducing choice and a balanced choice -- with estimated grading cost reductions of 98.8%-99.7% relative to the golden grading protocols and average post-training score gaps of 1-3 points from the best evaluated training verifier. These averages include larger losses in individual settings; they do not establish that verifier choices are interchangeable.

</details>


### [1185] [Elucidating the Design Space of Regression-based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33444)
*Toyota Li,David Zhao,Alan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文统一了DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM等无需策略梯度的扩散/流模型强化学习方法，指出它们都是同一散度约束奖励最大化问题的解，仅由定义约束的凸生成器不同，并据此提出更快更稳的DiffusionRFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型中放弃策略梯度、改用重加权监督回归的方法逐渐兴起，但DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM等代表性方案动机各异，学界对其共同本质尚不清楚，缺乏统一理论理解。

Method: 将各方法建模为同一个散度约束的奖励最大化问题，用凸生成器刻画约束差异；分析既有方法在构建优势嵌入回归目标时的近似（对DiffusionNFT线性tilt与FlowAWR指数tilt分别近似KKT条件和后验归一化），并保留线性tilt下对概率单纯形的精确sparsemax投影；结合实验探索回归式扩散RL的设计空间与训练配方。

Result: 统一框架揭示了各方法的放松与近似来源，并提出新的更优模型类型（精确sparsemax投影）；实验揭示回归式扩散RL的训练配方，最终提出DiffusionRFT，收敛更快、训练更稳定且性能最优。

Conclusion: 回归式扩散RL方法可被统一为散度约束奖励最大化，其差异仅在于凸生成器；基于此洞察与实验探索得到的DiffusionRFT在速度、稳定性和性能上均达到领先。

Abstract: A nascent family of methods that forgoes the policy gradient and reweights a supervised regression instead has garnered momentum in reinforcement learning for diffusion and flow models. DiffusionNFT, FlowAWR, and RAM are representative regimes with contrasting motivations. It is yet opaque what, if anything, they share. We substantiate that each is the solution of one divergence-constrained reward-maximization problem, and they are differentiated only by the convex generator that defines the constraint. Under the unified modeling framework, we unravel the relaxations that prior art made during building the advantage-embedded regression target: approximating the KKT condition and posterior normalizer for the linear and exponential tilt shapes DiffusionNFT and FlowAWR respectively, while preserving the exact sparsemax projection onto the probability simplex for linear tilt leads to another superior model type in this work. Beyond the theoretical underpinnings, we further empirically investigate the design space and shed light on the training recipe for regression-style diffusion RL. Retaining the merits discovered during our exploration gives rise to DiffusionRFT, our paradigm that converges faster, trains more stably, and attains the top performance.

</details>


### [1186] [TGRL: Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Exploration in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33589)
*Zihan Lin,Xiaohan Wang,Jie Cao,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Ran He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TGRL将温度诱导的多样性转化为显式训练信号，通过奖励对比估计探索增益并分配为token级信用，在不增加采样预算的情况下加速RLVR并提升多领域性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中的高效探索仍是核心瓶颈；温度控制和测试时扩展虽能增加LLM采样多样性，但要么扩大采样预算，要么未量化探索收益。

Method: 对每个prompt，将其rollout组划分为低温与高温子集，通过两组奖励对比估计探索增益，并利用同一logits下温度缩放后next-token分布的JS散度，将该组级信号作为token级信用进行分配。

Result: 相比强RLVR基线，达到同等精度最快提速36%且不扩大rollout预算；11个基准测试普遍提升：32B数学六项平均+1.6%，CodeForces评分+196.7分，LiveCodeBench Pass@16 +4.4%，ALFWorld/WebShop成功率+6.3%/+4.9%。

Conclusion: TGRL有效将温度多样性转化为训练信号，提升探索效率与准确率；消融实验和wall-clock分析验证各组件有效性。

Abstract: Efficient exploration often remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Although temperature control and test-time scaling strategies can increase rollout diversity of large language models (LLMs), they either expand the sample budget at rollout time or leave the benefit of exploration unquantified. To this end, we propose Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which turns temperature-induced diversity into an explicit training signal. For each prompt, TGRL partitions its rollout group into low- and high-temperature subsets, estimates exploration gain through their reward contrast, and allocates this group-level signal as token-level credit using Jensen--Shannon (JS) divergence between the corresponding temperature-scaled next-token distributions induced by the same logits. Notably, TGRL reaches equivalent accuracy up to 36% faster than strong RLVR baselines without expanding the rollout budget. Across 11 benchmarks from diverse domains, TGRL broadly improves over strong RLVR baselines: it improves the six-benchmark math average by 1.6% at 32B, raises CodeForces rating by 196.7 points and LiveCodeBench Pass@16 by 4.4%, and improves ALFWorld/WebShop success rates by 6.3%/4.9%. Comprehensive ablations and wall-clock analysis confirm the efficacy of all proposed components. Code is available at https://github.com/1229095296/TGRL/tree/main.

</details>


### [1187] [A Free Knob: Decoupling Calibration and Predictive Skill in Threshold-Based Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33457)
*Md Tanveer Hossain Munim,Bijoy Ahmed Saiem,Al-Amin Sany,Tanzima Hashem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，在稀有事件密集预测基准中，空间分块池化加阈值得到的CSI会混淆空间辨别能力与振幅校准；作者提出用单调校准作为对称审计，证明许多系统间CSI对比在校准后大幅缩小甚至反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀有事件密集预测评测通常先空间池化再阈值化，计算CSI。固定操作点下，max-pooled CSI会把空间辨别力和振幅校准混在一起：观测锐利使许多块超阈值，而平方误差回归得到的衰减预测使同样这些块不超阈值，导致对比失真。作者希望区分这两种因素。

Method: 将经典单调校准重新用作对称审计：在留出数据上拟合后置单调变换，分别应用于各系统。该变换不能改变像素排序，因此若能复现对比，不能说明空间排序改善。在SEVIR及多个任务上，对系统两两对比校准前后CSI变化，并分析池化频率偏差与CSI对比变化的关系。

Result: SEVIR上同架构两个检查点极端阈值CSI先差-29.5%，校准后+5.3%；450个两两对比中，池化频率偏差差异与CSI对比变化相关r=+0.796，51个对比变号。CasCast极端事件操作点下，cascade对backbone的CSI差距从0.1601降至0.0339，减少78.8%，剩余差距仍为正。测试前窗口拟合仍成立；静止红外影像上事件越稀有相对增益越大，人群计数在patch-sum池化下重现偏差-增益关系，语义分割因频率偏差近1变化不大。

Conclusion: 该混淆需要同时满足固定操作点和训练导致输出在该点失准。建议在稀有事件pool-and-threshold分数之外，报告池化频率偏差和对称的held-out FreeKnob审计。

Abstract: Many dense-prediction benchmarks evaluate rare events by pooling prediction and target over spatial blocks, thresholding each, and scoring the contingency table. At a fixed rare operating point, the max-pooled Critical Success Index (CSI) confounds spatial discrimination with amplitude calibration: sharp observations promote many blocks above threshold, while attenuated predictions from squared-error regression leave the same blocks below it. We repurpose classical monotone calibration as a symmetric audit: a post-hoc transform fitted on held-out data and applied separately to each system. The transform cannot reverse pixel ordering, so any contrast it reproduces cannot establish improved spatial ranking. On SEVIR, two released checkpoints of one architecture differ by -29.5% in extreme-threshold CSI before the control and by +5.3% after it. Across 450 pairwise contrasts among 6 systems, the difference in pooled frequency-bias deviation is associated with how far the CSI contrast moves under the control (r = +0.796), and 51 contrasts reverse sign. At CasCast's published extreme-event operating point, the cascade-over-backbone CSI gap falls from 0.1601 to 0.0339, a 78.8% reduction; the remaining gap stays positive. The effect persists when the transform is fitted on a window before the test period, and calibration also reveals advantages hidden by a better-calibrated baseline. On geostationary infrared imagery the relative gain grows as events become rarer, crowd counting reproduces the bias-gain relationship under patch-sum pooling, and semantic segmentation, where frequency bias is already near one, shows little average change. The confound therefore requires both a fixed operating point and a training regime that leaves the output miscalibrated there. We recommend reporting pooled frequency bias and a symmetric held-out FreeKnob Audit alongside rare-event pool-and-threshold scores.

</details>


### [1188] [How Synthetic Labels Improve Conformal Prediction: A Perspective on Conditional Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33482)
*Qianyi Chen,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在仅有少量可信标注数据、但存在大量廉价合成标注（来自领域模型或LLM）时，能否提升共形预测的条件覆盖。提出prediction-powered quantile learning，结合合成池估计pinball风险、用配对可信-合成结果纠偏、并以独立可信集完成最终共形化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测仅保证边际覆盖，而事后校准数据往往太少，难以学习不确定性在不同输入上的变化（条件覆盖）。同时，大量协变量可通过领域模型或通用语言模型廉价标注，作者探究这些合成标签能否在小规模可信样本下改善条件覆盖。

Method: 基于score-quantile regression，提出prediction-powered quantile learning：合成标注池估计pinball风险；配对的可信与合成结果用于纠偏；独立可信划分进行最终共形化。对pinball风险关于标量修正做剖面分析，发现总体条件覆盖误差是其函数梯度，对应Hessian可去除全局偏移并按边界密度加权剩余形状误差。将该几何与prediction-powered学习结合，得到三资源扩展及合成数据收益-成本规则。

Result: 在8个回归基准上，合成驱动的分位数学习显著改善下游条件覆盖，同时保持边际有效性，并产生更紧凑的预测集。人类评分研究显示外部LLM标签能带来类似增益，并揭示质量-数量-成本的权衡。

Conclusion: 合成标签可有效弥补可信校准数据不足，在保持共形预测边际有效性的同时提升条件覆盖与预测集紧凑度；但合成标签的价值取决于质量、数量与成本的权衡。

Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free finite-sample marginal coverage, but post-hoc calibration data may be too scarce to learn how uncertainty varies across inputs. Meanwhile, abundant covariates can often be labeled cheaply by domain models or general-purpose language models. We study whether these synthetic labels can improve conditional coverage when only a small trusted sample is available. Building on score-quantile regression, we introduce prediction-powered quantile learning: a synthetic-labeled pool estimates pinball risk, paired trusted and synthetic outcomes correct its bias, and an independent trusted split performs final conformalization. Profiling pinball risk over scalar corrections reveals that population conditional-coverage error is its functional gradient; the corresponding Hessian removes global shifts and weights remaining shape error by boundary density. Composing this geometry with prediction-powered learning yields a three-resource expansion and a benefit--cost rule for synthetic power. Across eight regression benchmarks, synthetic-powered quantile learning substantially improves downstream conditional coverage while preserving marginal validity and producing more compact prediction sets. A human-rating study finds similar gains from external LLM labels and exposes a quality--quantity--cost tradeoff.

</details>


### [1189] [What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487)
*Pierre Guetschel,Bruno Aristimunha,Yassine El Ouahidi,Arnaud Delorme,Thomas Moreau,Michael Tangermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地隔离研究了EEG基础模型中的掩码策略，在统一流水线下对比MAE与JEPA框架并评估58个预训练模型，找到最优掩码配置并揭示新的失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型的预训练流水线缺乏深入理解，掩码策略至关重要却从未被单独消融，因为每个新模型都把掩码策略与骨干网络、目标函数绑定在一起。

Method: 形式化时空掩码策略的设计选择，在单一流水线下用不同掩码配置训练MAE和JEPA两类SSL框架的模型，并在OpenEEGBench的12个数据集上以线性探针系统评估58个预训练模型。

Result: 两个框架一致确定最优掩码配置及共享失败模式；除此之外性能稳健（11个MAE和9个JEPA配置与最佳无统计差异）；发现JEPA特有的新失败模式“偏置膨胀坍缩”，标准检测器无法察觉；选好掩码后以远低于REVE的预训练成本达到其下游性能。

Conclusion: 掩码策略是EEG基础模型预训练的关键设计选择，妥善选择掩码可在低计算成本下达到先进性能，并为未来EEG SSL设计提供指导。

Abstract: EEG foundation models hold promise for scalable brain-signal decoding across clinical and cognitive neuroscience applications, yet their pre-training pipelines remain poorly understood. Among design choices, the masking strategy is particularly critical: it determines what the network must predict and from which context. Yet it has never been ablated in isolation, as each new model bundles a new masking strategy with a new backbone and objective. In this paper, we formalize the design choices for spatio-temporal masking strategies and train various models with a single pipeline under varying masking configurations across two SSL frameworks (MAE and JEPA). We then systematically evaluate the resulting 58 pre-trained models on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench under a linear probe. Both frameworks agree on an optimal masking configuration and on shared failure modes. Outside these, performance is robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. We further identify a novel JEPA-specific failure mode, tagged bias-inflation collapse, invisible to standard detectors. With a well-chosen mask, our pipeline reaches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.

</details>


### [1190] [Predicting Block-Coordinate Performance via Cross-Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33489)
*Shengkun Zhu,Jinshan Zeng,Zhiqiang Kou,Yongxin Tong,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一理论比较Jacobi、Gauss-Seidel及部分顺序块梯度更新的优劣，通过跨块曲率表达一步损失差，并给出了迭代K步后的符号损失比较及误差界，在神经网络、联邦学习和LoRA上验证了理论预测的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同时块更新与顺序块更新是机器学习中两种基本优化策略，但其相对优势取决于目标几何和迭代次数，如何选择十分困难，缺乏统一的理论指导。

Method: 建立统一理论比较Jacobi(JC)、Gauss-Seidel(GS)及部分顺序确定性块梯度更新；用跨块曲率加O(η³)余项表达一步损失差；在正则条件下及ηK≤T时，推导K步后的符号损失比较，误差为O(Kη³)。

Result: 在500次迭代中，理论正确识别低损失方法的比例为：神经网络98.0%、联邦学习83.4%、LoRA 97.6%；若每步用实测参数差应用损失递归，比例提升至100.0%、93.2%、99.6%。

Conclusion: 理论能够有效预测并识别更低损失的更新方法，用实测参数差逐步应用损失递归可进一步提升预测准确率。表明跨块曲率是决定顺序与同时更新相对优势的关键因素。

Abstract: Simultaneous and sequential block updates are two basic optimization strategies used across machine learning, such as neural-network training, federated learning, and low-rank adaptation. Choosing between them is difficult because their relative advantage depends on both the objective geometry and the number of iterations. We develop a unified theory for comparing Jacobi (JC), Gauss--Seidel (GS), and partially sequential deterministic block-gradient updates. Our analysis expresses the one-step loss difference through cross-block curvature, with an $O(η^3)$ remainder, where $η$ is the learning rate. We derive a signed loss comparison after $K$ iterations with $O(Kη^3)$ error under regularity conditions and $ηK\le T$ for fixed $T$, identifying the better method when the predicted difference exceeds this error. We evaluate these formulas along observed training trajectories across different machine learning settings. Over 500 iterations, our theory correctly identifies the lower-loss method in 98.0\% of iterations for the neural network, 83.4\% for federated learning, and 97.6\% for LoRA. Applying the loss recursion at each step using the measured parameter difference raises these rates to 100.0\%, 93.2\%, and 99.6\%, respectively.

</details>


### [1191] [BOReFT: Manifold Steering of Language Models for Black-box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33722)
*Dhruv Agarwal,Rico Angell,Kavitha Srinivas,Tahira Naseem,Horst Samulowitz,Willie Neiswanger,Andrew McCallum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BOReFT 在冻结语言模型的隐藏状态干预空间中学习紧凑低维表示，并将其作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，桥接 LLM 离散提议空间与连续黑盒优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语言模型的提议方法通过迭代提示或参数更新改进提议，对搜索空间的探索程度和效率控制有限；而贝叶斯优化等连续方法虽更principle但对搜索域有要求。作者希望构建一个适合连续优化的域，以提升黑盒搜索的覆盖与效率。

Method: 提出 BOReFT：在冻结语言模型的隐藏状态上学习一个紧凑、低维的干预空间，将该空间作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，并使用外部评分函数进行优化。理论上分析语义覆盖与插值如何决定该空间中的最优分数，并证明从该空间解码可得到用于自适应搜索的标准随机臂老虎机观测模型。

Result: 学习到的域覆盖多个语义区域且具有利于搜索的平滑性。在可解释词搜索任务 Semantle 上，BOReFT 找到比强 LLM 基线更多的隐藏目标；在三个真实分子性质优化任务中，有两个达到更高的性质分数。

Conclusion: BOReFT 为基于 LLM 的离散提议空间与连续黑盒优化之间提供了有原则的新桥梁，兼顾探索控制与优化效率。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used as proposal models for black-box search, from program optimization to molecular design. Existing approaches typically improve proposals through iterative prompting or parameter updates, offering limited control over how completely and efficiently the model's search space is explored. Continuous optimization methods, such as Bayesian optimization, provide a principled way to search but require a suitable domain to operate over. To address this, we introduce BOReFT, which learns a compact, low-dimensional space of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model, and uses this space as the search domain for Bayesian optimization with an external scoring function. Empirically, we find that the learned domain spans semantic regions and exhibits smoothness properties that support search. Theoretically, we show that semantic coverage and interpolation control the best score available in the learned space, and that decoding from this space yields a standard stochastic-bandit observation model for adaptive search. We evaluate BOReFT on the interpretable word search task "Semantle" and on three more real-world discovery tasks in de novo molecule property optimization. Compared to strong LLM baselines, BOReFT finds in Semantle a higher number of hidden targets and, on two out of three molecular objectives, achieves higher property scores. Consequently, our method provides a principled new bridge between discrete proposal spaces of LLM-based search and continuous black-box optimization.

</details>


### [1192] [Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33496)
*Arnab Sanyal,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Chameleon，一种固定比特宽度、把数值格式本身当作离散变量进行逐通道、逐(层,时间步)选择的扩散模型训练后量化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型PTQ都预先固定数值格式，只调scale、zero point或逐层位宽；固定位宽下最优格式依赖被编码的分布，而该分布随权重通道、层以及扩散时间步变化（激活从重尾噪声主导到紧凑结构化）。

Method: 固定位宽，将格式作为离散变量。激活格式从{INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}中按(层,时间步桶)选择，依据峰度和扩散SNR两个廉价统计预选并存查表；权重格式按通道离线由重构误差在8位{INT8,MXINT8}或4位{INT4,NF4,FP4 E2M1,MXINT4,MXFP4}中选择；用架构分叉适配多步UNet、单步蒸馏模型和DiT。

Result: 在COCO-2014上跨SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、PixArt-α，六种骨干×位宽设置中FID均最优，CLIP与FP16参考差距在0.24以内，W4A8下为所有量化方法中最优。

Conclusion: 将格式视为可变离散变量而非固定选择，可在不增加位宽的前提下显著提升扩散模型PTQ效果。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per (layer, timestep bucket) activation tensor. Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$α$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$.

</details>


### [1193] [Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33781)
*Woongyeong Yeo,Minki Kang,Chanuk Lee,Sangwoo Park,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EAPO是一种熵引导的信用分配方法，通过不对称处理成功与失败信号来改进LLM推理强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR的细粒度信用分配需辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息；而策略熵虽易得，但在强化与惩罚下同等优先处理不确定位置，会把惩罚集中在仍有恢复潜力的失败响应处，抑制探索。

Method: 提出EAPO：将归一化策略熵与响应优势的符号耦合。对成功响应中的高熵决策给予更强强化，对失败响应中的低熵决策给予更强惩罚，同时衰减不确定位置的惩罚以保留恢复机会。通过在各token间重新分配响应优势，从现有rollout信号直接推导token级信用，无需额外监督。

Result: 在多种推理任务、base与reasoning骨干模型上验证，EAPO取得最佳整体性能，并促进更有效的探索，扩大问题覆盖范围、生成更多样化的候选答案。

Conclusion: EAPO通过非对称的熵引导信用分配，有效利用现有rollout信号改进推理能力与探索质量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. Specifically, motivated by the observation that success under uncertainty is less repeatable while confident failures tend to recur, EAPO couples normalized policy entropy with the sign of the response advantage to reinforce surprising success and correct repeated failure. It assigns stronger reinforcement to high-entropy decisions in successful responses and stronger penalties to low-entropy decisions in failed responses, while attenuating penalties at uncertain positions to preserve opportunities for recovery. By redistributing the response advantage across tokens, EAPO derives token-level credit directly from existing rollout signals without additional supervision. We validate EAPO on a range of reasoning tasks across both base and reasoning backbones, demonstrating that it achieves the best overall performance. We further show that EAPO promotes more effective exploration, broadening problem coverage and generating more diverse candidate answers.

</details>


### [1194] [Hamiltonian JEPA: Action-Conditioned World Models with an Inherited Control State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33497)
*Tamim Zoabi,Ameen Ali,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: H-JEPA 将感知与控制状态解耦，用宽感知编码中固定的正交切片作为控制状态，配合结构化耗散 Hamilton 动力学和端口逆一致性，在多个像素控制基准上超越无重建基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件 JEPA 让单一嵌入同时承担感知与控制，导致规划器评分的状态未被动作如何驱动系统的信息组织起来，限制了基于像素的规划效果。

Method: H-JEPA 分离感知与控制：宽感知编码通过 Bures-Wasserstein 先验正则化为各向同性几何，控制状态取其中固定的正交切片并继承协方差；状态按相位条件耗散 port-Hamiltonian 动力学演化，输入端口列正交；PIC 通过端口转置读取已执行动作，等价于把 rollout 误差投影到端口方向上的无参数误差重加权，而非辅助动作解码器。

Result: 在四个像素控制基准上，H-JEPA 至多训练 10 个 epoch 即匹配或超过无重建基线（含动作解码的 Delta-JEPA）；OGB-Cube 增益最大，91.9% 对 79.3%；若让读出与端口解绑，该恒等式被破坏并损失约一半增益；PushT 与 OGB-Cube 消融分析了结构化预测器、PIC、预测时域、状态秩和抗坍缩先验的贡献。

Conclusion: 将控制状态从感知编码中正交切出、并让动作读出与 Hamiltonian 输入端口严格绑定，可在无需像素重建和辅助动作解码的情况下显著提升基于像素的规划性能。

Abstract: Planning from pixels needs more than a latent space that is stable and predictable. The state the planner scores must also be organized by how actions move the system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid pixel reconstruction by predicting future representations, but existing action-conditioned JEPAs ask one embedding to serve both perception and control. We introduce H-JEPA, which separates the two. A wide perceptual code is regularized toward a well-scaled isotropic geometry with a Bures-Wasserstein prior, and a fixed orthonormal slice of that code is the control state, which inherits the code's covariance without any objective of its own. The state evolves under phase-conditioned dissipative port-Hamiltonian dynamics whose input port has orthonormal columns. Port-inverse consistency (PIC) reads the executed action back through the transpose of that port. We show that this readout is exactly the rollout error projected onto the port directions, so PIC is a parameter-free reweighting of prediction error and not an auxiliary action decoder. Untying the readout from the port breaks this identity and loses half of the gain. H-JEPA matches or exceeds reconstruction-free baselines, including the action-decoding Delta-JEPA, on four pixel-based control benchmarks after at most $10$ training epochs, and its largest gain is on OGB-Cube ($91.9$ against $79.3$ percent). Ablations on PushT and OGB-Cube separate the contributions of the structured predictor, PIC, the prediction horizon, the state rank, and the anti-collapse prior.

</details>


### [1195] [ChemOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33838)
*Yaoyao Xu,Xinjian Zhao,Xiaozhuang Song,Xuemin Chen,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ChemOPD框架，用SFT梯度估计任务亲和性并通过MIP构造部分重叠的专家分组，同时在蒸馏中保留通才教师并采用锚点残差目标，以整合化学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM需在统一模型内支持多样化学推理能力。分而治之再通过多教师在策略蒸馏整合是常见思路，但存在两个问题：如何组织专门化、如何整合专家指导。

Method: 从SFT梯度估计任务亲和性，求解约束混合整数规划（MIP）构建部分重叠的专家分组；蒸馏时保留覆盖全任务的通才教师，专家指导作为补充而非替代；锚点残差目标逐步提升被路由专家在学生生成响应上的贡献。

Result: 在ChemCoTBench上，亲和性引导的专门化相比通才教师带来任务相关增益，并优于语义分组；教师侧性能更强不必然带来更强学生，相同专家与路由下，锚点残差OPD在多数指标上优于纯专家蒸馏，获更大比例的教师增益。

Conclusion: 专门化与能力整合是化学推理中相互关联但不同的设计问题。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly expected to support diverse chemical reasoning capabilities within a unified model. One approach is to develop specialized capabilities separately and consolidate them through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, but this raises two questions: how should specialization be organized, and how should specialist guidance be integrated? We introduce ChemOPD, which addresses both. We estimate task affinities from supervised fine-tuning gradients and solve a constrained mixed-integer program(MIP) to construct partially overlapping specialist groups. During distillation, we retain a generalist teacher trained on all tasks so that specialist guidance supplements rather than replaces its supervision. Our anchor-residual objective gradually increases the routed specialist's contribution on student-generated responses. On ChemCoTBench, affinity-guided specialization produces task-dependent gains over the generalist teacher and improves several capabilities beyond semantic task grouping. Yet stronger teacher-side performance does not automatically yield stronger students: with the same specialists and routes, anchor-residual OPD improves most reported metrics over specialist-only distillation and realizes a larger share of the available teacher gains. These results highlight specialization and capability integration as connected but distinct design problems in chemical reasoning.

</details>


### [1196] [Pulseflow: PPG Counterfactual Generation Via Latent Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33501)
*Hung Manh Pham,Dong Ma,Bin Zhu,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PulseFlow提出一种源条件反事实生成框架，通过条件表示学习与可逆潜变量传输编辑心律，缓解AF标注稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPG连续心血管监测中AF检测受限于标注数据稀缺，现有生成方法仅生成符合目标条件的样本，未显式建模源记录如何变换，难以利用丰富的源人群数据做定向增强。

Method: 提出PulseFlow，源条件反事实生成框架，结合条件表示学习与可逆潜变量传输，在保留源信息的同时编辑心律。

Result: 在两个临床队列上验证了有效的心律变换、可度量的源对应关系，以及在有限标签下AF分类性能的提升。

Conclusion: 源条件反事实生成可有效利用源记录进行针对性增强，缓解目标域标注稀缺，提升AF检测表现。

Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) has become an important modality for continuous cardiovascular monitoring, including atrial fibrillation (AF) detection. However, labeled AF recordings remain limited in many clinical settings, making model adaptation difficult when only limited target data are available. Generative modeling offers a natural way to alleviate this scarcity by synthesizing additional AF signals. Existing approaches, however, mainly generate samples that match the target condition without explicitly modeling how an observed source recording should be transformed, making it difficult to leverage abundant source recordings from a specific population or cohort for targeted augmentation. We introduce PulseFlow, a source-conditioned counterfactual generation framework that combines conditional representation learning with invertible latent transport to edit cardiac rhythm while retaining information from the source. Experiments across two clinical cohorts demonstrate effective rhythm transformation, measurable source correspondence, and improved AF classification under limited labels.

</details>


### [1197] [Rethinking Contextualization by Reinterpreting Attention Head Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33851)
*Hakaze Cho,Haolin Yang,Zhun Sun,Naoya Inoue,Benjamin Heinzerling,Kentaro Inui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出关于语言模型上下文处理的全局性原理：不同词携带的信息量不同，低信息词倾向吸收更多上下文信息，且这种吸收具有细粒度选择性。作者将注意力头重解释为由其奇异向量门控的通道，揭示了信息源/汇机制，并实现对注意力头的自动化、连续空间解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文化研究多聚焦单个词和注意力头，将其视为不断增长的离散字典，缺乏对整体行为的全局视角。

Method: 提出“信息量—上下文吸收”的全局原则，并估计每个词携带的信息量与其吸收的上下文信息；将注意力头重新解释为受其奇异向量门控的通道进行分析。

Result: 发现低信息词吸收更多上下文信息且非均匀吸收，细粒度选择性实现更精确的路由以促进匹配词间信息传递；奇异向量指向高信息词的隐藏状态，使其作为信息源更强地写入他词，反之亦然。

Conclusion: 奇异向量也可视为隐藏状态特征，从而实现对注意力头的自动化解释（超越此前的启发式头发现），并将头嵌入连续空间，而非离散独立的字典条目。

Abstract: Contextualization, the core operation of language modeling, transmits information across words to build sentence-specific word representations. Prior works mainly study contextualization, focusing on individual words and attention heads as a growing discrete dictionary, lacking a global view of their general behavior. Therefore, we propose a general principle: Globally, we find and estimate that different words carry different amounts of information, and less-informative words tend to absorb more contextual information. Specifically, these low-information words do not absorb contextual words uniformly, and finer-grained selectivity enables more precise routing to promote information transmission between matched words. Moreover, to find what mechanism causes such processing, we reinterpret attention heads as channels gated by their singular vectors and find that: (1) these singular vectors point to the hidden states of more informative words, allowing such words to write their information to others more strongly to act as information sources, and vice versa; and (2) these singular vectors can be viewed equally as hidden state features, enabling automated interpretation of attention heads beyond prior heuristic head discovery, also embedding heads into a continuous space rather than treating them as discrete, independent dictionary entries.

</details>


### [1198] [Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency in Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33510)
*Giulia Romoli,Filippo Ruffini,Paolo Soda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAPC方法，通过在生成前将物理约束编码进源噪声分布，解决投影式流匹配方法产生偏离目标分布样本的问题，在五个PDE系统的六个任务上取得最优分布匹配效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成模型用于求解偏微分方程和建模物理系统状态分布时，如何保证生成样本满足物理定律仍是难题。现有基于投影的流匹配方法通过修正无约束噪声分布产生的流来施加物理约束，但这些修正会使样本偏离目标解分布，尤其在高噪声区域。因此需要一种从源头出发的方法。

Method: 提出Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency (SAPC)，一种Functional Flow Matching方法，在生成开始前即将物理约束编码进源噪声分布，从而减少生成过程中所需的大幅修正。核心设计是源投影(source projection)配合与之匹配的、回归到投影源的训练目标。

Result: 在五个PDE系统、六个任务（含线性与非线性动力学）上评估，对比五种基线和无约束主干。SAPC在每个任务上最准确地重现目标分布，同时达到最佳投影式基线的约束精度。消融实验表明性能提升源于源投影与匹配训练目标的结合。
