IV-EWC alleviates this issue, reducing forgetting by 162% on average relative to vanilla curriculum learning and yielding positive backward transfer, as evidenced by improved performance on easier tasks after subsequent training on challenging tasks.

</details>


### [1234] [DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34838)
*Hanyang Wang,Zeyuan Liu,Zhengyu Chen,Jingqing Ruan,Chaoxu Pang,Zhongda Su,Wulin Xie,Zhizhao Zeng,Ke Zeng,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DivOPD：一种learner-side批次选择方法，通过将固定turn预算分散到更多rollout并优先训练教师-学生分歧大的turn，解决异步多轮on-policy蒸馏中的rollout浪费与陈旧问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步多轮on-policy蒸馏中，按到达顺序分批会让少量早期或长rollout主导学习更新，其他有效rollout在可用前已陈旧，浪费已生成经验。

Method: DivOPD将固定turn预算分散到更多rollout，在每个rollout内优先选择累计教师-学生分歧大的turn，排除无可用教师反馈的turn；per-turn loss与优化器不变，仅改变训练权重分配。可选扩展：对无进展rollout暂时交由教师控制再交还学生。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop六个师生设置（1.5B-7B学生）上，cross-setting平均峰值成功率从77.4提升至84.4，最后五次评估平均成功率从71.5提升至78.6；几何平均加速1.84x训练token、1.87x learner GPU时间。教师干预后last-five均值进一步升至82.4，保持约1.7x GPU加速。

Conclusion: DivOPD通过简单的批次选择策略显著提升异步多轮on-policy蒸馏的效率与成功率，教师干预可进一步提升性能，代码将开源。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD.

</details>


### [1235] [Scalable Attribution and Control of Model Behavior During Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33667)
*Sleem Abdelghafar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用互信息量化训练批次中每个样本的行为贡献，证明该互信息是行为梯度唯一性(BGU)的对数函数，并提出BS-Ghost算法在训练循环中高效计算这些分数，实现行为归因与干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一批次内的样本会产生相似的行为变化，导致难以区分各自的贡献，而快速识别每个样本的贡献对于在下次更新前采取行动至关重要。

Method: 通过互信息处理批次内干扰，量化联合行为变化对每个样本贡献的揭示程度；证明该互信息是行为梯度唯一性(BGU)的对数函数；提出BS-Ghost算法，利用批次空间的共享计算，无需存储模型规模的样本梯度即可在训练循环内高效计算分数。

Result: 在1000样本的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct完整工作负载上，BS-Ghost仅使5.5分钟训练增加27秒(8.0%)；移除与重训练实验表明BGU能识别因果塑造最终行为的数据；带符号信息可识别哪些样本增强或削弱目标行为，并能预测改变样本权重对下次更新的影响，进而选择权重引导行为。

Conclusion: 该框架为可扩展的监督与训练流程验证提供了实用基础，帮助评估者评估模型对齐、理解其训练过程并指导干预。

Abstract: Attributing and controlling model behavior during training requires identifying each example's contribution quickly enough to act before the next update. However, examples in the same training batch can produce similar behavioral changes, making their individual contributions difficult to distinguish. We address this ambiguity through mutual information, accounting for interference within the batch by quantifying how much the combined behavioral change reveals about each example's contribution. We show that this mutual information is a logarithmic function of Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU). BGU gives the information measure its geometric interpretation. Our Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost) algorithm makes these scores practical inside the training loop through shared computation in batch space, without storing model-sized example gradients. On a complete 1,000-example Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct workload, our BS-Ghost implementation adds 27 seconds (8.0%) to 5.5 minutes of ordinary training. Removal and retraining demonstrate that BGU identifies data that causally shapes final behavior. At each training step, signed information identifies which examples strengthen or weaken the target behavior, explaining how behavior develops during training. Signed information also enables cheap intervention during training: it predicts how changing example weights will affect behavior in the next update. We then use these predictions to choose weights that steer behavior toward a desired target. This makes our framework a practical foundation for scalable oversight and verification of training pipelines and processes, helping evaluators assess model alignment, understand how it develops during training, and guide interventions that shape ongoing learning.

</details>


### [1236] [Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34857)
*Chenxiao Fan,Chongming Gao,Gangyi Zhang,Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Jiamin Wang,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CREDO 用确定性读出的置信度替代文本采样，通过可微回归在 RLVR 中联合训练准确率与校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 训练的推理模型虽能给出正确答案，但置信度系统性过度自信且未校准。已有在 RLVR 循环中训练校准的方法都通过采样文本获得置信度，导致方差大、取值坍缩为少数离散值，且不可微，只能借助标量奖励传递校准损失。

Method: 提出 CREDO（Confidence REaDOut），从模型输出分布中一个专用 token 对确定性读出置信度，并用可微回归训练；同时将训练后的置信度作为准确率信号，按置信度与结果的不一致程度对 rollout 加权。

Result: 在数学与代码推理任务上，CREDO 取得最佳准确率与校准表现，优势还扩展到弃答（abstention）和选择性预测（selective prediction）。

Conclusion: 用确定性、可微的置信度读出头替代文本采样，可同时提升准确率与校准，并可迁移到弃答和选择性预测等下游场景。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.

</details>


### [1237] [Reachability is not enough: Diagnosing long-range behavior in GNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33674)
*Filippo Maria Bianchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，衡量图神经网络输入在不同图距离上对预测的影响，并区分架构、有限近似、训练与数值执行四类限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN常被视为具备长程能力，因为架构能连接远距离节点，但这并不能证明它们能正确利用远距离信息。

Method: 提出一个可测量各图距离输入对预测影响强度的框架，并将长程能力的限制来源分解为架构、有限近似、训练和数值执行四个方面。

Result: 局部消息传递可能传播影响缓慢，有限实现可能主要依赖近邻输入；数学等价的滤波器在学习难度和运行可靠性上存在差异；架构触达相似的模型对远距离信息利用差异大，且低平均误差会掩盖远距离交互失败。

Conclusion: 长程能力取决于能否学会利用任务所需距离的信息，并在计算过程中保持这种利用。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are often called long-range because their architecture can connect distant nodes, but this does not show whether they use distant information correctly. We introduce a framework that measures how strongly inputs at each graph distance affect predictions and separates limitations due to architecture, finite approximation, training, and numerical execution. Our analysis shows that local message-passing can spread influence slowly, so a finite implementation may rely mainly on nearby inputs even when the ideal computation uses the whole graph. We also explain why mathematically equivalent filters can differ in how easily they are learned and how reliably they run. Across controlled tasks, models with similar architectural reach use distant information very differently, while low average error can hide failures on distant interactions. Together, these results show that long-range capability depends on learning to use information at the distances required by the task and preserving that use during computation.

</details>


### [1238] [Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34929)
*Kasra Arabi,Virginia Smith,Chhavi Yadav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对指令微调模型无法从目标分布采样的问题，提出基于最大均值差异（MMD）的witness advantage，为GRPO中每个rollout分配差异化奖励，训练模型匹配目标分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常用于从指定分布采样（如模拟调查对象、生成合成数据），但指令微调模型虽能正确陈述分布却无法真正从该分布采样。提示和修改解码只能部分缓解，因此需要用策略优化训练。GRPO天然适合（每组rollout的经验分布可与目标比较），但整组打分使所有rollout奖励相同，组相对中心化后优势全为零，模型无学习信号。

Method: 提出witness advantage：基于MMD，为每个rollout计算单独优势。模型分布与目标分布间的MMD有witness函数，衡量每个结果的过度或不足产生。每个rollout的优势估计其所在结果处的负witness值——对组内欠产出的结果给予奖励，对过度产出的结果给予惩罚。该优势可由组内结果计数闭式算出，并作为GRPO中的奖励。

Result: 在未见过的目标分布上，用witness advantage训练显著降低了与目标分布的总变差距离（total variation distance），同时基本保留了模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: witness advantage为分布匹配问题提供了有效的逐rollout学习信号，通过MMD闭式解与GRPO结合，实现更好的目标分布采样，且不损害通用能力。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

</details>


### [1239] [T-MoXAI: A Hierarchical Explainability Framework for Temporal Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33685)
*Ali Inha,Mo Vali,Saaliha Vali,Pietro Liò,Meen-Yau Thum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: T-MoXAI:一个分层可解释AI框架，为时序多模态数据提供时间、模态、特征三个层级的解释，在IVF结局预测与小麦产量预测上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗与农业中的时序多模态AI模型存在"黑箱"问题，不透明性限制了信任与实际部署，亟需可解释性支撑。

Method: 提出T-MoXAI分层框架：用时序Shapley值解释"何时"影响预测，用注意力分析解释"哪些模态"在那些时刻起作用，用基于梯度的归因解释"哪些特征或图像区域"驱动决策；底层为Transformer架构，可处理不规则时序与异构数据，并在一秒内生成三层解释。

Result: 在两个真实任务上评估：IVF治疗结局预测AUC 0.660（类别显著不平衡）；小麦产量预测R² 0.265（环境变异大）。消融显示时序建模在两个领域都至关重要，去除后性能降至随机猜测水平；时序ROAR实验表明解释反映模型推理过程。

Conclusion: 凭借统一、领域无关的架构与开源实现，T-MoXAI为时序多模态XAI提供基线，缓解领域碎片化问题，适用于理解决策与预测精度同等重要的应用场景。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models for temporal multimodal data have potential in healthcare and agriculture, but their opacity can limit trust and adoption. We introduce T-MoXAI (Temporal Multimodal eXplainable AI), a hierarchical framework explaining (1) when timepoints influence predictions, using temporal Shapley values; (2) which modalities contribute at those moments, using attention analysis; and (3) what features or image regions drive decisions, using gradient based attribution. A transformer based architecture handles irregular temporal sequences and heterogeneous data, generating all three explanation levels in under one second for interactive decision support. We evaluate the framework on two real world tasks: predicting IVF treatment outcomes from ultrasound sequences and clinical measurements (AUC 0.660 despite significant class imbalance), and forecasting wheat yield from temporal RGB imagery and phenotypic traits ($R^2$ 0.265 amid substantial environmental variability). Ablation studies indicate that temporal modelling is critical in both domains: removing it reduces performance to the equivalent of random guessing. Temporal ROAR experiments provide evidence that the explanations reflect the model's reasoning process. With a unified, domain agnostic architecture and open source implementation, T-MoXAI provides a baseline for temporal multimodal XAI, addressing fragmentation in the field and supporting applications where understanding decisions is as important as predictive accuracy.

</details>


### [1240] [Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34933)
*Florian Eichin,Philipp Mondorf,Andrei Mircea,Yupei Du,Barbara Plank,Michael A. Hedderich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过分解记忆序列的损失轨迹，研究语言模型记忆的训练动态，发现记忆由序列级梯度对齐驱动，下层参数最关键，并可用于预测和干预记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆被认为是语言模型拟合训练分布尾部的一种机制，但其训练动态尚不清楚。作者希望细粒度理解记忆如何随训练和模型参数发展。

Method: 在Pythia模型族上，将记忆序列的损失轨迹分解到训练过程和模型参数中，研究对象包括重复序列（recitation）和稀有序列（recollection），并分析梯度对齐、层贡献以及干预高影响参数。

Result: 两类记忆都表现为序列级梯度对齐；recitation因与其他训练影响错位而遗忘，需要更高重复次数。下层最参与记忆与遗忘。该分解在预测记忆上优于交叉熵基线，尤其在更大模型和训练早期；干预少量高影响参数可消融最终模型中的记忆。

Conclusion: 研究推进了对记忆在训练中如何发展的理解，并为预测和干预记忆提供了思路。

Abstract: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.

</details>


### [1241] [Dynamic Kuramoto-Hodge Operators for PDEs on Complex Geometries and Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33693)
*Xiang Li,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DKHO算子，结合拓扑约束（Hodge/Dirac边界与余边界）与Kuramoto式自适应动态，在复杂几何上实现高精度、参数高效的PDE算子学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂域上的PDE场在顶点、边、面上存在相互作用，并受拓扑影响的全局响应。现有神经算子支持不规则几何，但忽视这些不同场支撑及其条件依赖的耦合。

Method: DKHO：在原始余链支撑上编码条件，用组成Dirac算子的边界与余边界算子演化Kuramoto式关系状态，并在正交Hodge子空间解码非调和与调和响应；拓扑决定信息流向，学习动态按PDE实例调整交换方式。

Result: 在多孔介质Darcy流、环面输运-扩散、腔体静磁任务中，DKHO-large平均降低约61%预测误差；DKHO-small仅用11.5–24.3%参数量仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 将拓扑结构与自适应动态耦合，为复杂几何与拓扑上的精确、参数高效PDE算子学习提供了有效归纳偏置。

Abstract: Learning PDE operators on complex domains requires capturing interactions among fields on vertices, edges, and faces, alongside global responses shaped by topology. Existing neural operators accommodate irregular geometries but often overlook these distinct field supports or their condition-dependent coupling. We introduce the Dynamic Kuramoto--Hodge Operator (DKHO), which combines topology-constrained interactions with learned coordination. DKHO encodes conditions on their native cochain supports, evolves Kuramoto-inspired relation states through the boundary and coboundary operators that compose the Dirac operator, and decodes non-harmonic and harmonic responses in orthogonal Hodge subspaces. Topology thus determines where information can flow, while learned dynamics adapts how it is exchanged to each PDE instance. Across porous-medium Darcy flow, torus transport--diffusion, and cavity magnetostatics, DKHO-large reduces prediction error by approximately 61% on average over leading baselines, while DKHO-small remains competitive using only 11.5--24.3% as many parameters. These results suggest that coupling topological structure with adaptive dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for accurate and parameter-efficient PDE operator learning on complex geometries and topologies.

</details>


### [1242] [See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34970)
*Weiqiao Que,Ruizhe Li,Chengyu Wang,Dakan Wang,Emine Yilmaz,Xiaofeng He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对涌现性对齐失效(EM)进行动态二阶几何分析，提出参数级几何缓解框架，在多个开放权重模型上抑制EM并揭示行为安全的假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的LLM存在涌现性失配(EM)：狭窄领域适配会意外触发跨领域的灾难性安全失效。已有静态分析无法刻画训练动态，现有防御依赖启发式方法且损害效用。

Method: 动态二阶几何研究EM：追踪训练轨迹发现方向性Hessian曲率集中于语义枢轴token；Grassmannian投影显示有害-安全差距扩大主要源于安全梯度重叠下降。基于此提出参数级几何缓解框架，将经验有害梯度子空间正交投影出参数更新。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-14B-IT上，防御将自由生成EM抑制最高达80.0%；在四类开放权重指令模型家族（3B-20B）中的另外三类（单层行为EM已接近零）上，teacher-forced评估显示同一有害子空间控制冻结EM响应的条件支持。

Conclusion: 这些诊断揭示了行为安全的假象：即使在行为EM接近零的模型中，同一子空间仍可测量且可操控。代码已开源。

Abstract: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.

</details>


### [1243] [Geometric Inductive Biases for Semi-Supervised Equalization: The Constellation-Aware Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33695)
*Avi Caciularu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出星層感知Transformer（CAT），通过注入几何归纳偏置改进信道均衡，在少导频下优于VAE和标准Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代通信中，在未知信道上以最小导频开销解码信号是关键挑战。现有深度学习方案依赖通用编码器，难以建模长程时序依赖，也难以从稀缺数据中有效捕捉信道物理特性；标准架构存在"不可知估计鸿沟"，需隐式学习本已已知的星座几何。

Method: 提出CAT，将几何归纳偏置显式注入均衡过程。CAT由一系列定制TransFIRmer块堆叠，采用"早期交互"范式联合处理接收信号与理想星座符号。每块含分裂式前馈网络：一支做FIR启发式滤波实现解卷积，另一并行MLP做几何精修。

Result: 证明该设计与最优线性（MIMO Wiener）接收机结构对齐：注意力可视为匹配滤波器组，双向FIR支路提供块MMSE均衡所需的非因果滤波。在半监督设置下，CAT所需导频少于VAE和标准Transformer：在三个ISI信道中的两个上，用64个导频达到的SER低于基线用128个导频的结果。

Conclusion: 显式注入星座几何先验可显著降低导频需求并提升均衡性能，为低导频未知信道解码提供有效架构。

Abstract: Decoding signals over unknown channels with minimal pilot overhead is a critical challenge in next-generation communications. Existing deep learning approaches typically rely on generic encoders that struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies or efficiently capture the channel's physical properties from scarce data. We argue that standard architectures suffer from agnostic estimation gaps, as they must implicitly learn the constellation geometry that is already known. We introduce the Constellation-Aware Transformer (CAT), a novel architecture that explicitly injects geometric inductive biases into the equalization process. CAT is composed of a stack of custom TransFIRmer blocks, which use an "early interaction" paradigm to co-process received signals and ideal constellation symbols. Each block features a split Feed-Forward Network that applies a Finite Impulse Response (FIR)-inspired filter for deconvolution and a parallel MLP for geometric refinement. We show that this design is structurally aligned with the optimal linear (MIMO Wiener) receiver: its attention can implement a matched-filter bank, and its bidirectional FIR branch provides the non-causal filtering that block MMSE equalization requires. In the semi-supervised setting, CAT needs fewer pilots than VAE and standard Transformer baselines: on two of our three ISI channels, it reaches a lower SER with 64 pilots than they do with 128.

</details>


### [1244] [ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34985)
*Shicheng Fang,Yiwen Zhao,Wenbo Tian,Jiahao Lu,Yining Zheng,Yuxin Wang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG)，通过为每个奖励构造独立的裁剪策略目标并将梯度协调为单次更新，实现多奖励策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励策略优化需要能同时反映各学习信号及目标间预期关系的联合更新，而简单加权难以兼顾兼容与冲突梯度。

Method: ORPG 为每个奖励构建梯度，兼容梯度时用余弦相关插值并通过部分归一化参考协调贡献，保持和的范数，刻画为球面方向折衷的唯一解；冲突梯度时按任务优先级投影。

Result: 在 helpfulness–safety 对齐与正确性–成本数学推理优化中，ORPG 显著提升 Useful 与 Harmless 平均分；数学任务上取得最高全预算准确率与三预算超体积，回答更准确更简洁。

Conclusion: 梯度协调适用于地位平等的目标及具有显式优先级的目标；兼容协调贡献更大，冲突处理提供补充增益。

Abstract: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.

</details>


### [1245] [A Spectral Theory of Compositional Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33708)
*Hugo Rydel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过数学分析深度线性网络的学习动力学，研究组合推理如何在经验学习中涌现，建立了经验结构与组合学习之间的理论联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想回答"组合推理如何在学习中涌现"这一核心问题，并解释人类认知中的若干现象。

Method: 在结构化合成环境中训练深度线性网络，推导将经验结构与组合学习相联系的理论，分析组合推理何时涌现、是否可从证据中识别、以及新链接证据如何快速解锁推理。

Result: 理论预测了组合推理的涌现时机、可识别性及新证据解锁旧推理的机制，定性解释了已知前提却组合失败、相似组合不同时间出现、单一链接事实激活大量新推理等现象。

Conclusion: 研究在经验统计结构与组合推理发展之间建立了数学联系。

Abstract: How does compositional reasoning emerge during learning? We address this question by mathematically analyzing the learning dynamics of deep linear networks. We train these networks in structured synthetic environments and derive a theory linking the structure of experience to compositional learning. Our theory predicts when compositional inferences emerge, whether they are identifiable from the available evidence, and how new linking evidence can rapidly unlock previously unavailable inferences. These results provide a qualitative explanation for several phenomena observed in human cognition. They account for why a composition can fail despite knowing its premises, why similar compositions can emerge at different times, and how a single linking fact can suddenly enable many new inferences. Taken together, these findings establish a mathematical link between the statistical structure of experience and the development of compositional reasoning.

</details>


### [1246] [DuoOPD: Learning from Joint Teacher-Student Outcomes for Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33711)
*Ao Yu,Weibo Gao,Heng Zhou,Linan Yue,Rui Li,Suyi Liu,Yu Yan,Yizhong Zhang,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DuoOPD，利用师生联合结果共同决定蒸馏反馈的方向与强度，在多个任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统on-policy蒸馏(OPD)忽略师生各自的对错结果，平均会压低学生本已正确的回答；单纯按学生正确性门控只修正方向，却未区分教师是否成功。

Method: 学生结果决定反馈方向，师生联合结果决定教师如何支持：仅教师成功时，用其答案作为上下文为学生失败回答评分；仅学生成功时，以任务内共享权重强化整段回答。单一规则覆盖四种结果组合，无需任务特定设置。

Result: 在Qwen3与Llama上，DuoOPD平均宏准确率超过全部五个基线，较OPD提升2.58和5.98个百分点；在涵盖科学计算、指令遵循与代码生成的另两种任务混合上同样领先。消融显示仅结果方向接近门控基线，联合结果设计贡献主要增益。

Conclusion: 联合师生结果的蒸馏反馈设计能有效提升on-policy蒸馏性能，且具有跨模型与跨任务的通用性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses with token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, yet the teacher can fail on questions the student already answers correctly, and how often each model succeeds varies across tasks. OPD ignores these outcomes and, on average, pushes down even the student's correct responses; gating feedback by student correctness fixes the direction but uses the teacher in the same way whether or not it succeeded. We introduce DuoOPD, in which the student's outcome sets the direction of feedback and the joint teacher-student outcome decides how the teacher supports it: when only the teacher succeeds, its verified answer becomes context for scoring the student's failed response, and when only the student succeeds, a weight shared within the task reinforces the whole response. A single rule covers all four outcome combinations without task-specific settings. Across Qwen3 and Llama, DuoOPD outperforms all five baselines in mean macro accuracy, improving over OPD by 2.58 and 5.98 percentage points, and it also leads on two further task mixtures spanning scientific calculation, instruction following, and code generation. Ablations show that outcome-based direction alone stays near the gated baseline, while the joint-outcome designs supply most of the gain.

</details>


### [1247] [Theory Guided and Interpretable Neural Operator Design for Partial Differential Equation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33715)
*Zeyuan Song,Zheyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFDONet，首次将自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论与神经算子学习结合并嵌入VAE结构，用于求解光滑流形上的一般非线性PDE，具有可解释性和理论支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确求解PDE在科学与工程中至关重要，但现有神经算子设计缺乏数学框架指导，多为"艺术"而非"科学"，且缺乏可解释性。

Method: AFDONet将神经算子学习与自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论首次融合进专门设计的变分自编码器(VAE)结构中，用于求解光滑流形上的非线性PDE；其架构与组件设计完全由AFD数学框架指导。

Result: 在多个基准问题上取得优异求解精度和具竞争力的计算效率；尤其在任意(Riemannian)流形上的PDE以及含尖锐梯度数据集上表现突出。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一种可解释神经算子框架设计的新范式，将神经算子设计从"艺术"转变为"科学"，兼具数学可解释性与理论根基。

Abstract: Accurate numerical solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) are crucial in numerous science and engineering applications. In this work, we introduce a novel neural PDE solver named AFDONet, which incorporates neural operator learning and adaptive Fourier decomposition (AFD) theory for the first time into a specifically designed variational autoencoder (VAE) structure, to solve a general class of nonlinear PDEs on smooth manifolds. AFDONet is the first neural PDE solver whose architectural and component design is fully guided by an established mathematical framework (in this case, AFD theory), turning neural operator design from an art to a science. Thus, AFDONet also exhibits exceptional mathematical explainability and groundness, and enjoys several desired properties. Furthermore, AFDONet achieves outstanding solution accuracy and competitive computational efficiency in several benchmark problems. In particular, thanks to its deep connections with AFD theory, AFDONet shows superior performance in solving PDEs on i) arbitrary (Riemannian) manifolds, and ii) datasets with sharp gradients. Overall, this work presents a new paradigm for designing explainable neural operator frameworks.

</details>


### [1248] [TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35224)
*Kasra Arabi,Nir Weinberger,Micah Goldblum,Niv Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TANGO，一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的水印方法，通过将新token与邻近已解锁token绑定以抵御频率攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数文本水印假设从左到右生成，按前序token编码，但扩散模型中这些token可能仍被掩码。固定绿色列表无需上下文，却在每个位置偏好相同token，导致水印文本中这些token出现过于频繁，攻击者可对比频率恢复列表并伪造可通过检测的文本。

Method: TANGO将每个新token的key设为一个邻近的已解锁token。用秘密密钥将词表划分为颜色类，并依据密钥与该邻近token的颜色，将新token偏向某一颜色，使水印嵌入token对中。因偏好颜色随位置变化，token频率更接近未加水印文本。检测仅需文本与密钥，不依赖任何解锁顺序。

Result: 在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO几乎能检测出所有未编辑的水印文本，并能检测大部分经过编辑的文本；针对固定绿色列表的频率攻击对其无效。

Conclusion: TANGO通过token对颜色绑定，解决了掩码扩散模型水印受固定绿色列表频率偏差影响的问题，在保持检测能力的同时有效抵御频率攻击。

Abstract: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.

</details>


### [1249] [ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33728)
*Teng Cao,Yu Deng,Quentin Delfosse,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ALDER通过主动设计实验、验证与修订参数化方程，实现可测试的显式世界模型，并用于目标导向控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定轨迹数据难以区分同样表现良好的竞争假设，固定候选集搜索又无法发现假设空间外的方程；因此需要能主动提出实验来检验和修订模型的方法。

Method: ALDER提出参数化方程，用数值优化器拟合系数，独立验证器在留出数据上测试候选；再用成本与安全感知的选择器查询干预，提出新实验以获得反例，更新证据账本并指导结构修订，同时淘汰不兼容定律。验证后的世界模型可通过求解逆问题选择控制动作。

Result: 在内部基准、ODE方程发现任务和机器人实验中，ALDER能发现初始公式集之外的定律，修复失败模型提案，用更少交互区分固定候选模型，并提升分布外预测；还能根据当前状态和目标选择控制动作。

Conclusion: 显式方程世界模型可通过交互进行测试和修订，并能自然用于指导目标导向控制。

Abstract: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.

</details>


### [1250] [PQ-HSA: Reusing Product-Quantized Scores for Hybrid Sparse-Approximate Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33746)
*Kunming Shao,Jierun Chen,Yanli Wang,Ruoyu Wang,Haoli Bai,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Chi Ying Tsui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PQ-HSA用IVF-PQ索引对KV缓存做近似打分，将未选token以背景项形式纳入softmax，在低预算稀疏注意力下提升精度并加速解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文解码时注意力受内存带宽限制；稀疏注意力只读少量key且给未读token零权重，导致输出仅依赖小部分KV缓存，小预算下精度明显下降，尤其影响需跨上下文聚合信息的任务。

Method: 用IVF-PQ索引对缓存key计算近似分数以排序；选中token用原始key/value参与注意力，未选token（背景）通过其分数经每倒排列表求和并乘以列表均值value进入同一softmax；以vLLM插件形式实现。

Result: 128K、1-2%检索预算下，PQ-HSA在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B上优于Quest和SnapKV，接近全注意力macro accuracy；相同选择器下背景项将8B模型macro accuracy从0.71提升至0.83；单张H20的vLLM中解码注意力比FlashAttention-3快1.6倍，加速随上下文增长，并给出启动上下文长度的成本模型。

Conclusion: PQ-HSA在低预算下兼顾精度与效率，背景项有效恢复未选token信息，vLLM插件无需改动引擎源码即可运行，代码已开源。

Abstract: At each decoding step a language model attends over the key-value (KV) cache of every earlier token, so at long context the attention call is bounded by memory bandwidth. Sparse attention reads only a subset of keys chosen by a cheap score estimate, and most methods give the unread tokens zero weight. The output then draws on only a small fraction of the KV cache, and accuracy drops at small budgets, most on tasks that aggregate information across the context. An inverted-file product-quantization (IVF-PQ) index over the cached keys computes an approximate score for every indexed token in order to rank them; after ranking, those scores approximate the attention logits of the tokens left out. PQ-HSA (hybrid sparse-approximate attention) attends the selected tokens with their original keys and values, and the unselected tokens, the background, enter the same softmax through those scores, summed per inverted list and multiplied by the list's mean value. At 128K and a 1-2% retrieval budget, PQ-HSA is more accurate than Quest and SnapKV on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B and stays close to full attention in macro accuracy; with the same selector, the background term raises macro accuracy on the 8B model from 0.71 to 0.83. In the same 128K setting, inside vLLM on one NVIDIA H20, the decode attention call runs 1.6x faster than the FlashAttention-3 kernel; the speedup grows with context length, and a cost model fitted on 8B to 30B models gives the context length at which it begins. A vLLM plugin runs PQ-HSA on two engine versions without changes to the engine source; code is available at https://github.com/KunmingSHAO/pqhsa_release.

</details>


### [1251] [Task-Aware Discretization of Differentiable Logic Gate Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33747)
*Thore Gerlach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究可微逻辑门网络(DLGN)的离散化问题，指出常见的局部离散化（基于argmax和置信度准则）可能是任务次优的，并提出用下游任务一阶信息指导渐进式离散化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准DLGN离散化方法在局部做决策（如argmax选择、基于置信度或熵的收敛准则）。作者指出即使松弛解全局最优，局部离散化也可能对任务次优，且高门置信度并无普遍保证。因此需要理解任务感知的门选择与可处理干预之间的关系。

Method: 作者推导了任务感知门选择与松弛网络中可处理干预之间的界限；研究渐进式离散化中的一阶下游任务信息，并分析该局部近似何时可靠；在卷积DLGN上进行实验验证。

Result: 实验揭示强烈的局部性依赖：当直接在非局部干预上优化时，一阶分数变得不可靠；但在渐进冻结中评估局部argmax决策时，一阶分数是准确的。

Conclusion: 局部离散化准则并不总是任务最优，高置信度也不保证正确选择。一阶任务信息适用于评估局部渐进冻结决策，但不适用于非局部干预优化，需区分应用场景。

Abstract: Differentiable logic gate networks (DLGNs) enable gradient-based training of highly efficient Boolean networks by relaxing discrete logic gates during training and discretizing them for inference. Standard approaches make this discretization decision locally, typically through argmax selection and confidence- or entropy-based convergence criteria. We show that local discretization can be task-suboptimal even for globally optimal relaxed solutions, with high gate confidence providing no general guarantee, and derive bounds relating task-aware gate selection to tractable interventions in the relaxed network. Motivated by these results, we study first-order downstream task information for progressive discretization and characterize when this local approximation is reliable. Experiments on convolutional DLGNs reveal a strong locality dependence: first-order scores become unreliable when directly optimized over nonlocal interventions, but accurately assess local argmax decisions for progressive freezing.

</details>


### [1252] [ResDiffFRG: Residual Diffusion for Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33749)
*Shizhe Liu,Jiayan Gu,Xiangyu Kong,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ResDiffFRG，将扩散目标定义为说话人行为锚与目标面部反应之间的残差，解决随机高斯初始化导致的去噪轨迹偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的MAFRG方法从随机高斯噪声直接去噪生成多个合理面部反应，但这些初始化与目标听众反应对齐差，需要复杂的去噪轨迹，容易偏离产生合理反应的轨迹范围。而人类听众与说话人面部行为存在天然模仿性，可作为强先验利用。

Method: 受听众-说话人模仿性启发，提出ResDiffFRG扩散框架：将扩散目标定义为说话人行为锚与合理面部反应之间的残差，显式地将扩散过程锚定到说话人行为上。去噪器只需建模将这个锚转换为AFR所需的相对较小的、反应特定的残差，而非从无结构状态重建完整反应。

Result: 在基于相关性的合适度指标上，相比现有方法取得大幅提升。去噪轨迹分析显示，ResDiffFRG在去噪轨迹起点即达到的面部反应相关性得分，已高于高斯扩散基线完成60%去噪轨迹后的得分。

Conclusion: 利用说话人-听众模仿先验锚定扩散过程，可有效缓解去噪轨迹偏差问题，显著提升多合理面部反应生成的性能。

Abstract: In dyadic human speaker-listener conversations, the listener's facial reactions allows the speaker to accurately perceive the listener's emotional states. Since human facial reactions are non-deterministic, the ability to generate multiple appropriate human-like facial reactions is crucial for realistic human-agent interactions. Although diffusion models are naturally suited to such one-to-many generation, existing diffusion-based Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation (MAFRG) methods attempt to denoise random Gaussian initialisations directly into multiple appropriate facial reactions (AFRs). These random initialisations are usually not well-aligned with the target listener facial reaction, which requires complex denoising trajectories from these initialisations, and subsequently creates substantial opportunities for deviations away from the range of trajectories leading to appropriate AFRs. Given the inherent mimicry between the human listener's and speaker's facial behaviours, we address the above denoising trajectory issue by leveraging this strong prior. Specifically, we propose ResDiffFRG, a novel diffusion-based MAFRG framework that explicitly anchors the diffusion process to the speaker behaviour by defining its diffusion target as the residual between the speaker anchor and an AFR. The denoiser only needs to model the comparatively small, reaction-specific residual needed to transform this anchor into an AFR, rather than reconstructing the complete reaction from an unstructured state. Extensive experiments show that ResDiffFRG achieves large improvements in correlation-based appropriateness over existing methods. Our denoising trajectory analysis showed that even at the start of the denoising trajectory, ResDiffFRG already achieves a higher facial-reaction correlation score than the Gaussian Diffusion baseline does after completing 60% of its denoising trajectory.

</details>


### [1253] [Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35426)
*Robin Faro,Shyam Sundhar Ramesh,Ilija Bogunovic,Aurelien Lucchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 "frontier learning"，一种开放式后训练方法，利用程序化生成器在线持续生成训练问题，并通过遗憾信号探索模型能力前沿的难度水平，从而取得比固定问题池基线更高的相对增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习（GRPO）的LLM后训练依赖训练前指定的固定问题池，学习信号仅在策略rollout中同时出现成功与失败时产生，因此当模型改进后，固定池中有用的部分会迅速失效，成为根本性限制。

Method: 提出frontier learning：用程序化生成器在线持续生成有信息量的问题；将生成器的任务特定参数视为搜索空间，并利用regret信号优先探索与逼近模型当前能力边缘的"前沿"难度水平，将训练集中在模型能力边界处。

Result: 在多项推理任务和多个模型家族上，该方法相比固定问题池基线持续取得更高的相对增益。

Conclusion: 有效的后训练不仅需要"选择"有用问题，还需要在模型能力边缘"持续生成"问题，说明开放式问题生成是提升推理能力的关键。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.

</details>


### [1254] [Collaborative Synthetic Data for Privacy-Preserving Financial Fraud Detection Across Organizational Silos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33754)
*Simeon Allmendinger,Domenique Zipperling,Burhanettin Bahadir Kibar,Niklas K{ü}hl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CollaFuse是一种基于扩散模型的协作式替代方案，用于跨组织欺诈检测。它不追求最高的本地保真度，但能在多数数据集上更稳定地提升下游欺诈检测性能，表明合成数据的价值主要来自可迁移的跨组织结构而非本地真实感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织希望从AI中获取分析价值，但数据常分散于不同组织且受隐私限制。金融欺诈检测尤为突出：欺诈案例稀少且本地数据集不平衡，限制了决策相关分析。联邦学习可实现协作但无法解决少数类稀缺问题；合成数据虽能帮助，但轻量方法受插值限制，生成模型需大量数据和算力，现有协作式生成方法多依赖联邦学习，给组织端带来沉重训练负担。

Method: 提出并考察CollaFuse——一种基于扩散模型的协作式替代方案，用于欺诈检测，并在五个欺诈数据集上进行评估。

Result: 与经典过采样、本地生成基线及集中式扩散基准相比，CollaFuse未达到最高的本地保真度，但在大多数数据集上更一致地提升了下游欺诈检测性能。

Conclusion: 这些发现表明，合成数据的分析价值较少来源于本地真实感，而更多来源于可迁移的跨组织结构。

Abstract: Organizations seek analytical value from AI, yet relevant data are often fragmented across organizations and constrained by privacy. This is acute in financial fraud detection, where rare fraud cases and imbalanced local datasets limit decision-relevant analytics. Federated learning enables collaboration without direct data sharing but does not resolve minority-class scarcity. Synthetic data generation can help, yet lightweight methods are interpolation-bound, while generative models require substantial data and computation. Existing collaborative generative approaches often rely on federated learning, imposing considerable organization-side training burdens. In this paper, we examine CollaFuse as a collaborative diffusion-based alternative for fraud detection and evaluate it across five fraud datasets. Compared with classical oversampling, local generative baselines, and centralized diffusion benchmarks, CollaFuse does not achieve the highest local fidelity but improves downstream fraud detection more consistently across most datasets. These findings suggest that synthetic data create analytical value less through local realism than through transferable cross-organizational structure.

</details>


### [1255] [LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35427)
*George Yakushev,Denis Mazur,Vladimir Bartenev,Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy,Timofey Byzov,Vladimir Kaurkin,Vadim Pastushenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通用的异步LLM智能体框架，用可重叠记忆状态的推理协程实现并发处理，Qwen 3.x无需任务特定训练即可应对流式视频、游戏与监控等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体遵循"读取-思考-回复/调用工具"的串行循环，但语音助手、具身智能和监控等真实场景需要在思考或执行任务的同时接收新输入。当前方案(语音交互架构、VLA、异步工具调用等)都是针对特定任务定制的，缺乏通用性。

Method: 提出异步LLM框架，允许用户或智能体自身定义带有重叠记忆状态的推理协程(inference coroutines)，从而泛化到不同类型的并发任务。

Result: 展示Qwen 3.x模型在流式视频理解、电子游戏和监控任务上具备异步操作能力，且无需任务特定训练。

Conclusion: 该工作从各类异步任务泛化为通用异步智能体，为处理并发输入提供了统一的框架方案。

Abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.

</details>


### [1256] [CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35462)
*Yusuf Kesmen,Aniruddha Mukherjee,Yena Chang,David Sasu,Trevor Brokowski,Alexandra V. Kulinkina,Kristina Keitel,Akhil Arora,Lars Henning Klein,Mary-Anne Hartley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CLIMB基准，用多轮问诊交互评估模型对共病（多标签诊断）的临床推理能力，发现前沿模型在交互场景中几乎无法准确恢复完整共病集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实患者常同时患有多种疾病，诊断线索在问诊过程中逐步显现，因此评估临床推理需要同时具备多轮交互与多标签诊断能力，而现有评估难以覆盖这一设定。

Method: 构建CLIMB基准：医生模型与模拟患者进行多轮问诊，目标恢复一组真实的共病诊断。病例由临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成，使共病表现扎根于结构化临床知识；并在六个前沿及开源模型上测试，同时开展控制实验，提出单假设追踪的理论参考模型。

Result: 六个模型中无一在超过10%的交互病例里恢复出准确诊断集合；当疾病共现时诊断性能下降，即使给出完整病历和真实疾病数量仍下降；交互进一步降低性能。模型表现为单假设追踪者：开局线索锚定首个诊断，围绕其提问，仅在当前线索指向时才补获第二个病，继续提问只会增加错误诊断。

Conclusion: 现有模型在多轮、多标签临床推理上存在根本缺陷，倾向于单假设追踪；CLIMB为评估与改进此类能力提供了基准、生成器和评测代码。

Abstract: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.

</details>


### [1257] [StatD2GAN: When Calibration Masks Generator Quality in Held-Out Evaluation of Synthetic Weather Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33761)
*Mustafa Ozaytac,Ozge Karadag Atas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出多元天气序列生成模型常用的"边缘校准后汇总分布指标"评估方式会误导架构结论，并基于严格留出协议重建了 StatD2GAN 的评估，提出三项最低评估要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多在校准后计算汇总分布指标，可能使架构优劣判断失效；作者希望通过一个无泄漏的留出协议，重新检验 StatD2GAN 各组件与校准流程的真实贡献。

Method: 采用留出协议：每个数据集最后两个日历年留出并设168小时禁令期，校准仅在训练块拟合，指标全部在留出块计算；25组匹配（地点,种子）对，覆盖5种Koppen-Geiger气候，用Wilcoxon符号秩检验并做Holm校正；对比含弱RCGAN基线及秩变换变体。

Result: 一，等渗校准将所有架构（含弱RCGAN）的KS距离压到逐地点噪声-位移下限2%内，校准后边缘指标无法区分类架构。二，排序表示判别器是唯一显著影响跨变量依赖的组件（Kendall tau MAE +0.080，Holm p=0.009），效应随气候区变化（安卡拉近零，迪拜和雅库茨克>115%）；秩变换变体表明机制是边缘的分位数监督而非copula匹配。三，物理约束违反由校准引入而非生成器，投影可近乎零代价消除（deltaKS<=0.003）。四，汇总指标掩盖了TimeGAN在序列间周均值变异性（季节与regime多样性代理）上的坍缩，仅序列级统计能揭示。

Conclusion: 建议将下限参照的边缘评估、匹配对检验和序列级方差分解作为校准生成式流程的最低评估要求。

Abstract: Generative models for multivariate weather series are routinely evaluated with pooled distributional metrics computed after marginal calibration. We show this practice can invalidate architectural conclusions, and rebuild the evaluation of StatD2GAN, a three-discriminator GAN with evolutionary weight adaptation, around a held-out protocol: the final two calendar years of each dataset are held out behind a 168 hour embargo, calibration is fitted on the training block only, and all metrics are computed on the held-out block. Evidence comes from 25 matched (location, seed) pairs across five Koppen-Geiger climates, tested with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests under Holm correction. Four results follow. First, isotonic calibration drives the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance to within 2% of a per-location noise-and-shift floor for every architecture tested, including a deliberately weak RCGAN baseline, so calibrated marginal metrics cannot discriminate between architectures. Second, the sorted-representation discriminator is the only component whose removal significantly degrades cross-variable dependence (Kendall tau MAE +0.080, Holm p = 0.009), with a regime-dependent effect: near zero in Ankara, above 115% in Dubai and Yakutsk. A rank-transformed variant isolates the mechanism as quantile supervision of the marginals rather than copula matching. Third, physical constraint violations are injected by calibration, not the generator; projection removes them at negligible cost (deltaKS <= 0.003). Fourth, pooled metrics conceal a collapse of between-sequence weekly-mean variability, a proxy for seasonal and regime diversity, in TimeGAN that only sequence-level statistics expose. We recommend floor-referenced marginal evaluation, matched-pair testing, and sequence-level variance decomposition as minimum requirements for calibrated generative pipelines.

</details>


### [1258] [Beyond Fixed Features: Architecture-Dependent Sensitivity to Node Representations under Heterophily](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33764)
*Priyanath Maji,Sidharth Gaur,Rajavinoth Paul Durai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究节点特征表示如何影响异质图（heterophilic）上GNN架构的性能评价，发现表示变化对性能的影响因架构而异，但架构排序保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异质图GNN评测通常在固定节点特征表示下比较架构，无法判断关于异质鲁棒性的结论是否随输入表示变化而稳定。

Method: 为Roman-Empire和Amazon-Ratings两个大规模异质基准构建并行特征变体，将图与从静态fastText到上下文Transformer嵌入的多种表示配对，并在这些表示上评测七种GNN架构，辅以秩相关分析。

Result: 表示效应因架构而异：Roman-Empire上上下文增益从GCN-sep的2.38到GAT的13.67个百分点（H2GCN增益8.77）；Amazon-Ratings上GAT从fastText到MPNet提升6.78个百分点，而GCN-sep仅变化0.20。秩相关分析显示跨表示的架构相对排序高度稳定。

Conclusion: 架构性能依赖于节点表示，架构与表示不能视为独立评测因素；主要效应是架构对表示的差异化敏感度，而非排序不稳定。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) perform well on homophilic graphs but struggle in heterophilic settings, where connected nodes often carry dissimilar labels. Existing evaluations typically compare architectures under a fixed node-feature representation, leaving unclear whether conclusions about heterophily robustness remain stable as the input representation changes. We address this question by constructing parallel feature variants of two large-scale heterophilic benchmarks, Roman-Empire and Amazon-Ratings, pairing each graph with representations ranging from static fastText vectors to contextual Transformer embeddings and evaluating seven GNN architectures across these representations. We find that the effect of representation varies across architectures: on Roman-Empire, the contextual gain ranges from 2.38 percentage points for GCN-sep to 13.67 points for GAT, with H2GCN gaining 8.77 points. On Amazon-Ratings, where node text is limited to short product titles, GAT improves by 6.78 points from fastText to MPNet, while GCN-sep changes by only 0.20 points. These results show that architectural performance is conditional on node representation: the same representation change can produce different magnitudes of performance gain across architectures, so architecture and representation cannot be treated as independent evaluation factors. A rank-correlation analysis on these two benchmarks further shows that the relative ordering of architectures remains highly stable across representations, isolating differential sensitivity, rather than ranking instability, as the primary effect.

</details>


### [1259] [DEALS: Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving for Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33768)
*Jingjuan Huang,Wenbin Wang,Yanchuan Yin,Alvaro Velasquez,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DEALS，一个去中心化、低复杂度的多智能体框架，使智能体能够自组织并动态路由并发任务，无需中央控制器或训练专用路由器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统常处理异构复杂任务流，需智能体分解任务并自适应演化、共享资源。但现有集中式或固定协调模式限制扩展性与适应性，而已有去中心化动态MAS需训练路由器或调用LLM选智能体，计算与协调开销大。

Method: DEALS中每个智能体维护本地任务队列，其路由器根据积压量和成功率的差异决定本地处理还是转发给邻居；执行器在智能体内和跨智能体并发处理独立任务，部分完成的任务可被其他智能体继续处理。

Result: 在同构与异构智能体池中，DEALS在答案准确率、任务吞吐量等多维度上提升性能，并以自组织方式平衡智能体专长与工作负载。

Conclusion: DEALS实现了有效的去中心化协调，支持任务级与负载级的自组织和自演化，且复杂度低。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have recently emerged as an effective approach for coordinating large language model (LLM)-based agents to solve complex tasks through structured interactions. In practice, MASs often handle a stream of heterogeneous and complex tasks, requiring agents to decompose each task and then self-organize and self-evolve to adapt to incoming tasks while sharing execution resources. However, most early approaches to MASs rely on centralized controllers or fixed coordination patterns, which can limit scalability or adaptability. In contrast, existing decentralized and dynamic MASs often require training dedicated routers or invoking LLMs for agent selection, resulting in substantial computational costs and coordination overhead. To address these challenges and enable efficient task-level self-organization and self-evolution for task- and workload-level collaboration, we propose Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving (DEALS), a decentralized and low-complexity framework that enables agents to self-organize and dynamically route concurrent tasks for processing. Specifically, each agent maintains local queues of incoming tasks, and its router decides whether to process a task locally or forward it to a neighbor based on differences in backlog and success rate. Meanwhile, executors process independent tasks concurrently within and across agents, and partially solved tasks can be resumed by other agents. Experiments show that DEALS not only improves performance along multiple dimensions (e.g., answer accuracy and task throughput) in both homogeneous and heterogeneous agent pools, but also balances agent expertise and workload in a self-organized manner, enabling effective decentralized coordination.

</details>


### [1260] [Selecting Diverse SFT Traces Improves Post-RL Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33780)
*Dylan Zhang,Mingyuan Wu,Jinning Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究SFT数据中的"推理路线多样性"，提出一种轻量级、基于规则的指纹方法来筛选多样化数据，实验证明路线多样的SFT能更好为强化学习做准备，提升后RL问题覆盖率和pass@8表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已验证的解答对准备推理模型的强化学习（RL）并不等效用。现有SFT数据选择可能忽视了推理步骤序列的多样性，需要研究路线多样性对RL准备的实际价值。

Method: 全面研究"路线多样性"（SFT数据中推理步骤序列的变化），提出一种轻量级、基于规则的指纹（fingerprint）来选择多样化路线；用相同预算、相同训练配方和checkpoint进行对照实验；并做合成实验与预RL诊断。

Result: 在同一预算下选择多样路线比相似路线提升后RL问题覆盖率（含更难问题）；合成实验中OLMo3-7B在SFT未见过环境上pass@8提升16.9分；单模型条件下10个数学基准平均pass@8最高提升6.2分；在3个开源语料上，仅用CPU、无模型调用的选择器在每次平均后RL性能对比中都优于更昂贵的替代方案。

Conclusion: 推理路线多样性是选择SFT数据的实用标准，能更好地为模型准备强化学习；预RL诊断表明多样SFT虽平均准确率略低，但能在更多问题上同时产生成功与失败尝试，为group-relative RL提供更多有学习信号的prompt。

Abstract: Verified solutions are not equally useful for preparing reasoning models for reinforcement learning (RL). We present a comprehensive study of route diversity, the variation in the sequences of reasoning steps in supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data, and propose a lightweight, rule-based fingerprint to select for it. From one pool at one budget, with matched training recipes and checkpoints, selecting diverse rather than similar routes improves post-RL problem coverage across puzzles and mathematics, including on problems harder than those seen in either training stage. In synthetic experiments, route-diverse SFT improves OLMo3-7B's pass@8 by 16.9 points on environments held out from SFT. In a single-model condition, where one model writes every candidate, diverse selection gains up to 6.2 points of mean pass@8 across 10 mathematics benchmarks. Pre-RL diagnostics suggest why: diverse SFT can produce both successful and failed attempts on more prompts despite slightly lower mean accuracy, giving group-relative RL more prompts with a learning signal. On 3 open-source corpora, our CPU-only selector, without model calls, outperforms more expensive alternatives in every comparison of mean post-RL performance. These results identify reasoning-route diversity as a practical criterion for selecting SFT data that better prepares models for RL.

</details>


### [1261] [Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35609)
*Aditya Thimmaiah,Lara Marinov,Jayanth Srinivasa,Haris Vikalo,Junyi Jessy Li,Milos Gligoric*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了掩码扩散语言模型约束解码中的轨迹偏差问题，并提出TWISTER——首个自动机扭曲的序贯蒙特卡洛解码器来纠正该偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有约束解码方法虽然每步采样精确且满足约束，但将其复合后会偏离模型在有效轨迹上的相对概率，产生轨迹偏差。作者希望刻画并消除这一偏差。

Method: 先证明偏差的存在并推导其精确表达式（有效续段质量比值的乘积），刻画偏差消失的条件；然后提出TWISTER，用步骤精确解码器作为提议分布，采用自动机扭曲的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）进行Feynman-Kac纠正。

Result: 对正则语言约束，Feynman-Kac纠正可精确计算，扭曲量可由步骤精确采样预先计算的量高效获得；理论证明所得Feynman-Kac模型以无偏的Doob h-变换路径律（条件于约束满足）为目标。

Conclusion: TWISTER为MDLM约束解码提供了首个无轨迹偏差的自动机扭曲SMC解码器，兼顾约束满足与模型相对概率的正确性。

Abstract: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.

</details>


### [1262] [SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35629)
*Kyle Lee,Christian Z. Pratt,Ruoyu Fang,Heekyung Lee,Avinash Lohitsa,Ryan Modafe,Kerem Y. Camsari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SANTA++是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，通过将KV缓存键分组并用代表键打分，来选择团队采样，实现内存高效的选择；在保持高精度的同时大幅减少KV读取并加速注意力计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力通常集中在上下文中的一小部分token上，但这部分token随查询不同而变化。为利用这种变化的稀疏结构，需要一种无需训练、能避免扫描整个KV缓存的内存高效方法。

Method: 将缓存的键组织成团队（teams），查询只对每团队的代表键打分以决定采样哪些团队；在采样团队内计算精确注意力分数，并按团队被包含概率的倒数对贡献重新加权（重要性采样校正），以估计全缓存的注意力，采样预算可在内存读取与精度间权衡。

Result: 采样32或64个团队时，SANTA++仅使用稠密注意力16%–22%的KV读取；在LongBench v2和HELMET的RAG子集上保留稠密基线94%–99%的分数，在RULER上保留85%–91%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，32K上下文）。31个团队时，GPU实现在32K上下文下比稠密FlashAttention基线快1.69倍。

Conclusion: SANTA++通过减少需读取的缓存条目，可在保持高精度的同时降低内存读取并加速，原则上可与压缩KV表示架构（如多头潜在注意力）互补。

Abstract: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.git.

</details>


### [1263] [Do We Really Need KL Divergence for On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33791)
*Wenze Lin,Jiyuan Long,Jiale Zhao,Shenzhi Wang,Xitai Jiang,Ce Luo,Rui Lan,Qianli Ma,Fukang Wen,Hui Wu,Liyuan Chen,Shuoling Liu,Jiangpeng Yan,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现on-policy蒸馏（OPD）不必依赖KL散度，只需保证更新方向朝向教师即可，尤其只需让小部分教师-学生分歧大的token朝教师更新。基于此提出C-MOPD多教师蒸馏方法，效果优于MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KL散度自知识蒸馏以来一直是标准损失，OPD也沿用KL。作者质疑KL散度对OPD是否必要，探索更本质的机制。

Method: 1）用奖惩信号（教师概率更高给+1，更低给-1）代替KL，仅鼓励朝教师方向更新；2）分析只有教师-学生分歧大的小部分token的更新方向关键；3）提出C-MOPD，让每个样本被所有教师监督而非路由给单个教师。

Result: 奖惩式更新几乎复现reverse KL的OPD训练模式；只有高分歧token的方向关键。C-MOPD在数学和代码基准上一致优于MOPD。

Conclusion: KL散度对OPD并非必要，保持朝教师的更新方向即可，且只需关注少数高分歧token。C-MOPD作为应用有效缓解多教师蒸馏的能力冲突问题。

Abstract: Since the advent of knowledge distillation, KL divergence has been the standard loss in distillation. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for LLMs. As a distillation method, OPD naturally inherits KL divergence as its standard loss. However, in this work, we find that KL divergence may not be necessary for OPD. We show that simply preserving the update direction is sufficient for effective OPD. As long as the update direction is toward the teacher, OPD works. More precisely, it is not the direction of every token, but the direction of a small subset of tokens where the teacher and student disagree strongly. We first show that simply assigning a reward of (+1) to tokens where the teacher probability is higher than the student probability and (-1) where it is lower, which merely encourages updates toward the teacher, reproduces almost the same training mode as OPD with reverse KL. We further show that only the direction of a small subset of tokens with large teacher-student disagreement is critical, and training works as long as their update direction is toward the teacher, even if other tokens are pulled away from the teacher. And as an application of these findings, we introduce Consensus Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (C-MOPD) to improve Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Unlike MOPD, which routes each sample to a single teacher and may cause capability conflicts across domains, C-MOPD lets every sample be supervised by all teachers. Experiments show that C-MOPD consistently outperforms MOPD on both math and code benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/KL-Free-OPD.

</details>


### [1264] [Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35695)
*Qiyao Ma,Junshan Zhang,Zhe Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种百万参数级MLP个性化排序模型，通过复用基础生成器内部嵌入，在测试时对齐中高效利用个性化生成的性能空间，以极少参数和极低延迟超越十亿参数通用奖励模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准对齐范式针对单一用户优化，无法满足多样化用户偏好；作者通过实证研究发现在测试时对齐中存在大量未被利用的个性化生成性能空间，且个性化生成更像候选匹配问题而非生成器能力瓶颈。通用奖励模型校准不佳且参数规模巨大，评分成本过高。

Method: 提出参数高效框架，采用百万参数规模的多层感知机（MLP）排序模型，直接复用基础生成器的内部嵌入，以最小开销实现个性化偏好评分；通过扩展训练数据提供细粒度个性化偏好，使该模型能准确评分大规模候选池，并可无缝引导生成以降低材料化N个候选的成本。

Result: 在涵盖三种个性化生成设置的九个数据集上实验表明，该个性化排序模型有效利用了发现的性能空间，在每个数据集上均超越十亿参数通用奖励模型，参数量不足其0.4%，评分延迟低四个数量级。

Conclusion: 个性化生成可通过参数高效的轻量排序模型结合测试时缩放（如BoN）显著提升，百万参数MLP排序模型能高效替代庞大通用奖励模型，为个性化对齐提供低成本高性能方案。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.

</details>


### [1265] [Binding Multiple Modalities via Multimodal Wasserstein Barycenter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33800)
*Xiaole Tang,Jiayi Xu,Xiang Gu,Yan Yang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BaryBind，通过将特定模态向 Wasserstein 重心迁移并构建重心单纯形进行体积对齐，实现 n 模态平衡语义空间，在多任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态学习常依赖某一特定模态（如文本）来绑定其他模态，难以构建平衡且逼近共享语义、同时尊重 n 模态数据整体几何的表示空间。

Method: 将特定模态投影到跨所有模态优化的 Wasserstein 重心（WB），使其最小化到多模态分布的平均 Wasserstein 距离并作为对齐锚点；随后构建重心单纯形，以其体积作为相似度度量，围绕 WB 嵌入进行全局对齐。

Result: 在文本-视频-音频检索、分类、VideoQA 与跨模态生成任务上取得有竞争力的性能，且在模态缺失下保持鲁棒、可扩展到三种以上模态。

Conclusion: BaryBind 通过 Wasserstein 重心与体积对齐构建统一语义空间，为 n 模态平衡表示学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Multimodal learning beyond two modalities commonly leverages a specific modality (e.g., text) to bind other modalities. However, how to establish a more balanced representation space that approximates shared semantics while respecting the holistic geometry of $n$-modal data remains challenging. In this work, we present BaryBind, which aims to transport the specific modality towards the Wasserstein barycenter (WB) optimized across all modalities and introduces a volumetric alignment objective to establish a unified semantic space around the WB embedding. Specifically, we project specific modalities to the WB, which minimizes the average Wasserstein distances to multimodal distributions and serves as the anchor for subsequent alignment. We then construct a barycenter simplex, whose volume is taken as a similarity metric for global alignment centered at the WB. Experiments show that BaryBind achieves competitive performance in text-video-audio retrieval, classification, videoQA, and cross-modal generation tasks, along with robustness under modality absence and scalability to more than three modalities. Code is released at https://github.com/xl-tang3/BaryBind.

</details>


### [1266] [Diffusion Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33803)
*Xiangyang Wang,Bingxiang He,Zeyuan Liu,Jiaze WangZiqing Qiao,Yuxin Zuo,Huan-ang Gao,Cheng Qian,Wenbin Zhang,Ran Li,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Yuanchun Shi,Zhiyuan Liu,Chaojun Xiao,Chun Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DRM，将奖励建模重构为条件密度估计（扩散模型），以刻画人类偏好的多模态结构，并在多个基准和RLHF实验中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流奖励模型将prompt-response对压缩为点估计或固定参数族分布，无法反映人类偏好的多模态本质：同一回复可有多种合理评判方式，且单一参数族难以覆盖全部情形。

Method: DRM为Diffusion Reward Model，用冻结LLM编码器作条件，轻量Diffusion Transformer将高斯噪声去噪为奖励向量，对输出分布不做参数假设，从而自然表达多模态。单一架构可同时处理多属性回归与成对偏好数据；推理时N个样本构成经验奖励分布，可聚合为标量、方差或分位数。

Result: 在五个基准上，数据与backbone匹配时匹配或超越基线；尽管训练规模有限，仍与更大的判别式、分布式和生成式RM竞争力相当；能恢复被传统head坍缩为单点的多模态奖励结构。不确定性感知拒绝与LCB聚合表明可利用分布信息改进去噪决策；下游RLHF实验显示以DRM作为训练期奖励可提升策略性能。

Conclusion: 基于扩散的奖励建模能更好拟合人类偏好的多模态性，并提供标量之外的不确定性信息，直接验证了其对RLHF训练的实际价值。

Abstract: Reward models underpin the alignment of large language models, yet the dominant designs reduce each prompt--response pair to a point estimate or to a distribution from a fixed parametric family. This is at odds with human preference, which is inherently multimodal: the same response can be reasonably judged in many ways, and no single family covers all of them. To better fit this structure, we introduce DRM, a Diffusion Reward Model that recasts reward modeling as conditional density estimation over $p(\mathbf{r}\mid x,y)$. Conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder, a lightweight Diffusion Transformer denoises Gaussian noise into a reward vector, placing no parametric assumption on the output distribution and naturally representing its multimodal structure. A single architecture handles both multi-attribute regression and pairwise preference data, and at inference $N$ samples form an empirical reward distribution that can be aggregated into a scalar, a variance, or quantiles. Across five benchmarks, DRM matches or surpasses baselines under matched data and backbone, stays competitive with much larger discriminative, distributional, and generative RMs despite its modest training scale, and recovers multimodal reward structure where conventional heads collapse to a point. Uncertainty-aware rejection and lower-confidence-bound (LCB) aggregation further demonstrate that DRM can exploit distributional information beyond a scalar reward to improve reward-model decisions. Downstream RLHF experiments additionally show that using DRM as the training-time reward leads to improved policy performance, directly validating the practical benefit of diffusion-based reward modeling for RLHF training.

</details>


### [1267] [MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33804)
*Yuhao Li,Louie Hong Yao,Tianyi Shi,Hanqun Cao,Hongxia Hao,Zhen Zhao,Shengchao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，用联合时空坐标参数化作用在 query/key 上的 Lorentz 变换，实现显式几何偏置与灵活学习的结合，在分子动力学与视频预测任务上均取得最佳效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨尺度建模时空耦合是构建物理智能的关键挑战。现有方法分为两类：物理启发的动力学建模先验更强但灵活性受限；学习启发的架构更灵活但时空耦合关系隐式、不明确。作者希望兼具灵活学习能力与显式时空几何偏置。

Method: 提出 MinkowskiPE，利用联合的时空坐标来参数化作用在 query 和 key 特征上的 Lorentz 变换。由此，query-key 注意力分数仅通过两个 token 间的相对时空位移依赖位置，从而对全局坐标平移保持不变（平移不变性）。该方法保留标准点积注意力接口，兼容高效注意力实现。

Result: 在微观分子动力学与宏观视频预测任务上评估：在全部九项多轨迹分子评测中取得最佳结果；KTH 视频预测 MSE 相对最强基线降低 9.9%，且参数量约为其十分之一。

Conclusion: MinkowskiPE 通过将 Lorentz 变换引入注意力机制，为时空耦合建模提供了显式几何偏置，同时保持灵活性与效率，在跨尺度任务上验证了有效性与参数高效性。

Abstract: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.

</details>


### [1268] [How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35751)
*Shouren Wang,Chuang Ma,Mohsen Hariri,Debargha Ganguly,Wang Yang,Xiaoqing Tong,Qianying Liu,Xiaotian Han,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Foil：固定专家参数与每 token 计算量，将 MoE 专家层"扁平化"（减半层数、倍增每层专家数与循环次数）并解绑各次循环的注意力参数，从而在循环 MoE 中显著降低预训练损失并改善路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复使用同一层块提升固定规模模型的参数利用率，稀疏 MoE 则每 token 只激活少量专家。将两者结合（循环 MoE）有望改善专家使用，但"如何循环 MoE"尚不明确。本文旨在回答这一问题并给出设计指导。

Method: Foil 在保持专家参数与每 token 专家计算量固定的前提下：(1) 扁平化专家——专家层数减半、每层专家数翻倍、循环次数翻倍，使每次路由从更大专家池中选择；(2) 解绑注意力——每次循环使用独立注意力参数，而专家与路由器保持共享。并进行了消融分析以解释其有效性。

Result: 20B tokens 时每个 Foil 模型预训练损失均低于未扁平化的循环基线；100B tokens 时损失随扁平化程度单调改善，最扁平的 Foil 在等参数等计算下损失低 0.012 nat，下游准确率持平或更优；解绑注意力在同形状下带来更均衡、更自信的路由。

Conclusion: 循环与加宽专家层的收益相互放大；路由置信度比负载均衡更能反映健康的专家使用；因此稀疏循环 MoE 应采用更多每层专家数与更多循环次数。代码与配置已开源。

Abstract: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe.

</details>


### [1269] [QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33848)
*Weiqi Wang,Yuxin Zhou,Mouxiang Chen,Siyuan Zhang,Yi Zhang,Yuyan Luo,Zhiyu Yin,Chencan Wu,Jiemin Jiang,Wentao Yao,Chujie Zheng,JianWei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QwenGyre 是一个面向超长时程（xlong-horizon）在线强化学习的端到端框架，通过弹性 GPU 调度和轨迹处理解决 GPU 空转与轨迹冗余问题，在 NL2RepoBench 上取得 6.0% 绝对提升，并实现最高 1.85×/1.78× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体执行的超长时程任务（单次可达数小时、上百次交互、单 rollout 近 1M token）给在线 RL 带来两大挑战：执行方差大、rollout 延迟长导致 GPU 大量空转；复杂非线性分支产生海量轨迹冗余，严重拖累训练效率。

Method: QwenGyre 在 rollout 与训练之间弹性重分配 GPU，且不中断正在进行的执行；其轨迹处理器重构分支历史、对部分进度打分，并对冗余路径去重，从而约束训练开销。

Result: 在旗舰模型 Qwen 3.8 2.4T、每次 rollout 700K token 规模下，48 步内 NL2RepoBench 从 52.5% 提升到 58.5%（绝对增益 6.0%）。在多个领域训练集上，相比 Colocate 和 Async 分别取得最高 1.85× 和 1.78× 加速。

Conclusion: QwenGyre 有效支撑超长时程在线 RL，在提升任务性能的同时显著改善训练效率，验证了弹性调度与轨迹去重设计的有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% $\to$ 58.5%) in 48 steps. Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to $1.85\times$ and $1.78\times$ speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.

</details>


### [1270] [PI-NOMT: Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport for Brain Fluid Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33857)
*Mehmet Emin Acar,Vahit Bugra Yesilkaynak,Helene Benveniste,Gozde Unal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将脑示踪剂成像中隐藏运输机制的恢复建模为物理信息潜在状态推断，提出PI-NOMT框架，用连续神经场表示密度、速度和源，在合成基准与9只大鼠DCE-MRI数据上成功恢复速度场和源机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏时空观测中恢复隐藏运输机制是科学机器学习的核心逆问题。在脑示踪剂DCE-MRI中，虽有时序示踪剂浓度测量，但驱动其传播的速度场和源机制不可观测。现有方法多将运输场作为辅助变量仅用于重建密度，而非推断目标本身。

Method: 提出PI-NOMT（物理信息神经最优质量传输）。将密度、速度、源均表示为连续神经场；结合连续神经密度教师、递归可微的平流-扩散-源展开、非平衡最优传输正则化，以及控制方程监督。物理定律作为结构先验约束可行运输机制空间，观测动力学提供估计潜在运输状态的证据。
