Result: 在已知真实运输的合成基准上，PI-NOMT准确恢复预设速度场（幅值、方向和积分轨迹），而非仅重建端点密度。在9只大鼠DCE-MRI数据上，实现亚百分点的局部端点误差、合理的物理速度尺度和较低的训练后PDE及不可压缩性残差。

Conclusion: 结果支持物理信息潜在状态推断可作为从观测动态标量场恢复隐藏运输机制的通用框架。

Abstract: Recovering hidden transport mechanisms from sparse spatiotemporal observations is a fundamental inverse problem in scientific machine learning. In brain tracer imaging, dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI) provides time-resolved measurements of tracer concentration, while the underlying velocity and source mechanisms governing tracer propagation remain unobserved. We formulate this problem as physics-informed latent-state inference, in which the transport field itself is the primary object of inference rather than an auxiliary variable used only to reconstruct observed densities. We propose Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport (PI-NOMT), a framework that represents density, velocity, and source as continuous neural fields and combines a continuous neural density teacher, recursive differentiable advection--diffusion--source rollout, unbalanced optimal-transport regularization, and governing-equation supervision. Physical laws act as structural priors that constrain the space of admissible transport mechanisms, while observed tracer dynamics provide evidence for estimating the latent transport state. We evaluate PI-NOMT on a synthetic benchmark with known ground-truth transport and on DCE-MRI sequences from nine control rats. On the synthetic benchmark, PI-NOMT accurately recovers the prescribed velocity field, including its magnitude, direction, and integrated trajectories, rather than merely reconstructing endpoint densities. Across the nine rat datasets, the framework yields sub-percent local endpoint error, consistent physical speed scales, and low post-training PDE and incompressibility residuals. These results support physics-informed latent-state inference as a general framework for recovering hidden transport mechanisms from observed dynamic scalar fields.

</details>


### [1271] [JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33874)
*Shenghao Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JET 利用预训练语言与视觉语言模型，在无需额外训练的情况下从有限答案集中选择答案，直接评估候选似然并共享计算，在本地设备上实现准确且高效的决策推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索无需额外训练的本地决策推理：直接从现有预训练模型获取答案，兼顾决策准确性与执行成本，验证在消费级硬件上部署的可行性。

Method: 通过预训练语言及视觉语言模型直接评估候选答案的似然，并在候选之间共享计算；在桌面 CPU 与消费级 GPU 上测试决策准确率和执行开销，采用前缀复用、缓存管理、输入准备优化等手段加速，并对比模型、硬件与推理选择的权衡（以 Jev 作为外部参照）。

Result: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在完整 MMLU 测试集达 87.48% 准确率，单独计时子集上达 3.69 请求/秒；前缀复用和缓存管理带来 2.18–2.23 倍加速，输入准备优化减少 30.8% 进程时间且输出不变；可选推理存在任务相关的准确率-吞吐量权衡。

Conclusion: 结果支持基于现有模型进行本地决策推理，无需额外训练即可在消费级硬件上获得较高的准确率与吞吐量。

Abstract: JET uses pretrained language and vision-language models to select among a finite set of answers without additional training. It evaluates candidate likelihoods directly and shares computation across candidates. Experiments on desktop CPUs and consumer GPUs assess decision accuracy and execution cost. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B achieves 87.48% accuracy on the full MMLU test set and 3.69 requests per second on a separately timed MMLU subset. The accuracy-throughput comparison covers model, hardware, and reasoning choices, with Jev as an external reference. Controlled execution experiments show 2.18-2.23-fold speedups from prefix reuse and cache management, and a 30.8% reduction in process time from input preparation optimizations, with unchanged outputs. Optional reasoning has a task-dependent accuracy-throughput trade-off. These results support local decision inference from existing models.

</details>


### [1272] [Vanilla Policy Optimization Is Both Optimal and Differentially Private for Stochastic Contextual Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33888)
*Idan Attias,Orin Levy,Alexander Ryabchenko,Yishay Mansour,Uri Stemmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明vanilla策略优化（PO）在随机上下文bandit中无需探索奖励或重要性加权即可达到近最优regret，并揭示其隐式探索机制，进一步给出批处理与差分隐私版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨标准指数策略更新（vanilla PO）能否在随机上下文bandit中仅靠离线回归实现足够探索、达到近最优regret，避免额外的探索奖励与重要性加权。

Method: 采用由离线回归驱动的标准指数策略更新；分析其隐式探索机制（渐进式策略更新防止动作概率过快衰减，使回归oracle能学习各动作期望损失）；并开发仅需O(log T)次回归调用与策略切换的批处理版本，结合私有回归oracle实现DP算法。

Result: 对A个动作、T轮、有限预测类F，vanilla PO以高概率达到Õ(√(AT log|F|)) regret；有限类下批处理私有版本给出纯ε_priv-DP及Õ(√(AT log(|F|/δ))(1+ε_priv^{-1/2})) regret；实验验证其有效性。

Conclusion: vanilla策略优化本身具备足够隐式探索能力，可在无需显式探索机制下实现近最优regret，并自然扩展到批处理与差分隐私设定，实验显示在更强隐私约束下显式探索仍有价值。

Abstract: Can vanilla policy optimization explore enough to achieve near-optimal regret in stochastic contextual bandits? We show that standard exponential policy updates driven by offline regression do so under realizability, without exploration bonuses or importance weighting. For $A$ actions, $T$ rounds, and a finite prediction class $F$, vanilla PO achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$ regret with high probability. Our analysis reveals an implicit exploration mechanism of independent interest: gradual policy updates prevent actions from losing probability too quickly, allowing the regression oracle to learn their expected losses. We further develop a batched version using only $O(\log T)$ regression calls and policy switches, and show how private regression oracles yield differentially private contextual bandit algorithms without composition across batches. For a finite class, this gives pure $\varepsilon_{\rm priv}$-DP and regret $\widetilde O\left( \sqrt{AT \log(|F|/δ)}(1+\varepsilon_{\rm priv}^{-1/2}) \right)$. Finally, experiments across oracle-based contextual bandit algorithms, with and without privacy, demonstrate the practical effectiveness of policy optimization and the value of explicit exploration under stronger privacy constraints.

</details>


### [1273] [Augmented Feature Boosting for Multicalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33891)
*Ira Globus-Harris,Inbal Livni Navon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析一种无需离散化的提升范式：每轮在增广假设类（接收上一轮预测作为额外特征）上调用平方损失oracle，仅对最终预测取整，通过增广假设类的表达能力导出多层次校准保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准分布式场景下的multicalibration提升方法需要反复对预测值域离散化并审计修复水平集，导致实际保证对取整参数敏感。作者希望探索一种在提升过程内部避免取整、无需离散化的提升方法。

Method: 受Tax et al. (2026)启发的特征增广提升范式：每轮在接收到上一轮预测作为额外特征的假设上调用平方损失oracle，仅对最终预测进行取整。作者通过增广假设类的表达能力对该过程进行理论分析。

Result: 增广假设类的表达能力产生了一个保证层级，涵盖multiaccuracy、multicalibration以及更强的level-set multicalibration。

Conclusion: 该无离散化提升范式可避免提升过程中的取整敏感性，并借助增广假设类的表达能力统一导出从multiaccuracy到level-set multicalibration的多层次保证，为multicalibration提供了一种新的理论框架。

Abstract: Multicalibration requires a predictor's residuals to be unbiased not only globally, but also after conditioning on the predictor's own level sets and reweighting by a rich class of test functions. Standard boosting approaches in the distributional setting achieve this by repeatedly discretizing the predictor's range then auditing and repairing the resulting level sets. One consequence is that in practice, the algorithm's guarantees are sensitive to this parametrization of the rounding parameter. A natural theoretical question, then, is how to do discretization-free boosting which avoids this rounding within the boosting process itself. Here, we analyze an alternative feature-augmentation boosting paradigm inspired by Tax et al. (2026): at each round, a squared-loss oracle is called on hypotheses that receive the previous predictor's output as an additional feature, and only the final predictor is rounded to have a finite set of level sets to provide the multicalibration guarantee with respect to. We give a theoretical analysis of this procedure through the expressivity of the augmented hypothesis class, and show how the expressivity of this class yields a hierarchy of guarantees, including multiaccuracy, multicalibration, and the stronger notion of level-set multicalibration.

</details>


### [1274] [MISHAP-Bench: A Hallucination Benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33893)
*Zhi Wen Soi,Giulio Segalini,Jian-Jia Chen,Lydia Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MISHAP-Bench基准，将音频语言模型的幻觉分为"语境幻觉"和"知识幻觉"两类，用12,000个开放式问答对和基于评分标准的评判流程评估10个先进模型，发现幻觉仍严峻（如Gemini 3.7 Flash达36.5%），有效缓解仍是开放难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频幻觉基准主要衡量回答正确性，无法区分模型是"幻觉"还是"未理解音频"，导致评估混浊。

Method: 定义两类幻觉：语境（主张无音频依据）与知识（音频相关主张缺乏外部可验证事实支持）；构建MISHAP-Bench，含12,000个挑战性开放式问答对及覆盖两类的评估流程；提出基于参考评分标准和人工标注引导提示的"有据性评判器"。

Result: 评测10个先进LALM，幻觉普遍严重，Gemini 3.7 Flash幻觉率仍达36.5%；适配并测试4种来自多领域的缓解方法，虽有改善但效果有限。

Conclusion: 有效缓解音频幻觉仍是开放挑战，呼吁社区用MISHAP-Bench评估幻觉并基准测试缓解方法。

Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) produce fluent responses about audio but often hallucinate by making plausible yet ungrounded claims. Existing audio hallucination benchmarks mainly measure response correctness, leaving it unclear whether an LALM hallucinates or simply fails to understand the audio. We challenge correctness-based evaluation by defining two hallucination categories: (i) context, where claims are not grounded in the audio; and (ii) knowledge, where claims about audio-related topics lack support from externally verifiable facts. We introduce MISHAP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with 12,000 challenging open-ended question-audio pairs and a rigorous evaluation pipeline covering both categories. To evaluate open-ended responses, we propose a groundedness judge that uses reference rubrics and judge prompts guided by human annotations. We extensively evaluate ten state-of-the-art LALMs and show that hallucination remains substantial. Even a frontier model such as Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches a hallucination rate of 36.5%. We further adapt and benchmark four mitigation methods from multiple domains for LALMs. Despite some improvements, effective hallucination mitigation remains an open challenge. Finally, we call on the community to evaluate hallucination and benchmark mitigation methods with MISHAP-Bench.

</details>


### [1275] [No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33898)
*Yiyong Liu,Jun Sakuma,Michael Backes,Rui Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次系统性地跨领域研究了"训练效率"与"模型脆弱性"之间的权衡关系，发现在视觉和语言模型中，追求效率的训练策略会提升对抗攻击与隐私攻击的易感性，并揭示其内部几何与表征结构的系统性变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模基础模型训练带来巨大的算力与数据需求，研究者广泛采用选择性数据采样、高效预训练、简化强化学习等策略来降低开销。然而这些效率策略是否以牺牲模型的鲁棒性与安全性为代价，这一问题尚未被系统研究，因此作者提出探究效率与脆弱性之间的权衡。

Method: 作者进行首个跨领域（视觉与语言模型）的系统性实证研究，对比高效训练变体与常规训练模型对对抗攻击和隐私攻击的易感性；并通过分析模型的内部几何与函数表征，考察损失曲面锐度与表征结构的变化；同时将分析扩展到"zero RL training"，比较简化RL流程与传统对齐流程在灾难性遗忘和过度自信方面的差异。

Result: 效率导向训练虽显著降低开销，但增加了模型对对抗攻击和隐私攻击的脆弱性；高效变体一致性地表现出更锐利的损失几何以及表征结构的系统性变化；基于简化RL流程训练的模型在灾难性遗忘和过度自信方面明显比传统对齐流程更严重。

Conclusion: 训练效率很少是"免费的午餐"——最小化计算量的机制可能无意中损害安全性。作者呼吁向多目标训练范式转变，同时优化性能、成本与安全性。

Abstract: Training efficiency has become the central driver of recent progress in foundation models. To overcome the massive computational and data requirements of large-scale training, researchers increasingly adopt strategies such as selective data sampling, efficient pre-training, and simplified reinforcement learning pipelines. While these strategies drastically reduce overhead, they prompt a critical, yet neglected question: Is efficiency achieved at the expense of model robustness and security? To our knowledge, we present the first systematic cross-domain investigation of the efficiency-vulnerability trade-off. Across vision and language models, we show that efficiency-oriented training increases susceptibility to adversarial and privacy attacks. We characterize this vulnerability by analyzing the models' internal geometry and functional representations, demonstrating that the evaluated efficient variants consistently exhibit sharper loss geometry together with systematic changes in representational structure. We further extend our analysis to "zero RL training", finding that models trained using simplified RL recipes exhibit substantially greater susceptibility to catastrophic forgetting and more pronounced overconfidence than those trained through conventional alignment pipelines. Our findings suggest that training efficiency is rarely a "free lunch"; rather, the mechanisms that minimize computation can inadvertently compromise safety. We conclude by calling for a paradigm shift toward multi-objective training that jointly optimizes for performance, cost, and security.

</details>


### [1276] [Finite Probes Suffice: Identifiability and Universality for Weight-Space Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33901)
*Soutrik Sarangi,Yonatan Sverdlov,Adir Dayan,Haggai Maron,Nadav Dym*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于探针的神经泛函学习，建立辨识性与通用性理论，并提出HIDDENPROBE，利用中间隐层表示的探针响应，在MLP与Transformer基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习神经网络的性质日益受关注，已有方法或直接作用于网络参数，或通过基于探针的网络行为表示。探针法经验表现强，但理论基础有限，尤其不清楚有限探针表示何时足以学习神经泛函。

Method: 理论上给出探针的一般辨识性与通用性结果，证明使用中间隐层表示比仅用最终输出提供更具信息量的表示；据此提出简单架构HIDDENPROBE，从隐藏层探针响应中学习。

Result: 在包括MLP和Transformer的多种神经泛函基准上，HIDDENPROBE持续优于现有探针方法，达到最先进性能。代码已在GitHub公开。

Conclusion: 有限探针表示足以学习神经泛函，且隐层探针优于输出探针；HIDDENPROBE验证了理论并成为新的强基线。

Abstract: Learning properties of neural networks has recently attracted growing interest, with existing approaches operating either directly on network parameters or through probe-based representations of network behavior. While probing methods have shown strong empirical performance, their theoretical foundations remain limited. In this work, we study when finite probe-based representations are sufficient for learning neural functionals. We establish general identification and universality results for probing, and show that using intermediate hidden representations can provide significantly more informative representations than relying only on final outputs. Motivated by these results, we introduce HIDDENPROBE, a simple architecture for learning from hidden probe responses. Across a range of neural functional benchmarks, including both MLPs and Transformers, HIDDENPROBE consistently improves over existing probing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [1277] [On the Two Faces of Adam in Separable Linear Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33904)
*Chen Fan,Csaba Szepesvári*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文定量刻画了可分离线性分类下带偏置修正的确定性全批量Adam（稳定性常数ε>0）的行为：先接近max-norm最优边界，随后才转向梯度式更新并达到固定的欧氏边界目标，两个时间尺度相差极大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有结果只知道ε=0时Adam趋于max-norm最优、ε>0时趋于欧氏边界最优，但缺乏对"小正ε"这一实际情形的定量描述，即何时、以何种顺序实现这两种最优性尚不清楚。

Method: 在softmax参数化、log-loss、可分离线性分类设定下，分析确定性全批量bias-corrected Adam的动力学，给出充分条件并利用步长多项式衰减（指数a∈(1/3,1)）与逆线性衰减（a=1）分别推导迭代复杂度。

Result: 当1/3<a<1时，更新在Θ(log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})步后近似等于负梯度方向，而此时分类器仍几乎最大化max-norm边界；要达到高于所有max-norm最优分类器但低于最优的固定欧氏边界目标，需ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}步。a=1时，更新转变需多项式步数，而达到目标边界需指数步数。实验验证了预测。

Conclusion: Adam在小正ε下呈现两个分离的时间尺度：早期表现为max-norm最优，晚期才转向欧氏边界优化；这种后期变化可在训练误差归零后改善或恶化泛化，从而将分析联系到grokking及其反向现象。

Abstract: We consider the behavior of deterministic, full-batch, bias-corrected Adam in separable linear classification with softmax parametrization under log-loss. In this setting, under a wide range of conditions Adam is known to approach max-norm-margin optimality when its stability constant $ε$ is zero, while with a positive $ε$, it is known to approach Euclidean-margin optimality. Our main contribution is the quantitative description of Adam's behavior for small fixed positive $ε$. We give sufficient conditions under which an Adam-trained classifier nearly maximizes the max-norm margin before the updates become gradient-like. We also show that the classifier reaches a fixed target Euclidean margin only much later. Specifically, we show that for polynomially decreasing stepsizes with exponent \(a\), where \(1/3<a<1\), the updates become approximately proportional to the negative gradient after $Θ(\log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})$ iterations. At that time, the classifier still nearly maximizes the max-norm margin. Reaching a fixed target Euclidean margin above that of every max-norm-optimal classifier, but below the optimum,
  is shown to require $ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}$ iterations. Under inverse-linear stepsize decay (\(a=1\)), the update
  transition takes polynomially many iterations, whereas reaching the target margin takes
  exponentially many. Experiments support these predictions. The later change in the classifier
  can improve or worsen generalization after training error reaches zero, connecting the
  analysis to grokking and its reverse.

</details>


### [1278] [JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33906)
*Guangxun Zhang,Brian Cai,Boxuan Zhang,Chao Chen,Ruixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JIVE是一个免训练框架，通过向生成器端点雅可比的主导右奇异子空间注入速度扰动，可证明地最大化端点多样性并保持样本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型常面临模式崩塌和样本多样性受限的问题。已有方法通过联合生成一批样本并排斥其轨迹来缓解，但这些启发式方法并未显式最大化最终端点的多样性。

Method: JIVE通过分析生成器端点的雅可比矩阵，将速度扰动对齐到其主导右奇异子空间，利用局部几何结构注入扰动；为保持效率，采用基于经典数值线性代数的免矩阵迭代来计算扰动方向，计算开销很小。该框架为免训练方法。

Result: 在多个基准上，JIVE提升了少步和单步生成中的像素级与特征级多样性，同时保持样本质量。

Conclusion: JIVE提供了一种理论上有保证、计算高效且免训练的生成多样性增强方案，适用于少步与单步生成场景。

Abstract: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.

</details>


### [1279] [Training Witnesses: Trusting the Training without Trusting the Trainer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33915)
*Houjun Liu,Pratyusha Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Witnesses方法，将神经网络训练验证的责任从读者转移到训练者，通过快速行为指纹和偶然回放挑战以极低开销认证训练、数据使用与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML论文激增，科学声明依赖对训练者的信任，导致评估与基线不一致、阻碍可靠进展；传统验证需读者复现昂贵训练，无法应对方法与算力的爆发。

Method: 核心洞见：快速行为指纹配合偶尔的回放挑战足以审计神经网络训练，从而可验证训练、数据使用和评估。

Result: 在100M至2B规模语言模型训练（DDP与FSDP）上测试，验证开销极小；可以可放大概率拒绝坏训练，并支持对数据包含与排除的精确查询。

Conclusion: 提出自监管的"自动认证"训练排行榜以共享基线与推进进展，并邀请社区参与以提升ML可复现性。

Abstract: Progress in machine learning cannot outpace our ability to verify it. With an explosion in papers today, every scientific claim rests initially on trust in the trainer, leading to uneven evaluation, baselines, and forestalling of reliable progress. Traditionally, the burden of verification falls on the reader, who must reproduce expensive training runs. This strategy is impractical due to an explosion in slop contributions, diversity of methods, and the sheer compute required. We put the burden of proof where it belongs, on the trainer, and in the process also cut the overall cost of verification significantly. We introduce Witnesses, a method for certifying training, data usage and evaluation in a neural network training run. Our key insight is that fast behavioral fingerprints with occasional replay challenges are sufficient for auditing neural network training. Our method is applicable at scale with minimal overhead to the trainer, is cheap for the verifier, rejects bad training runs with amplifiable probability, and allows for exact queries of both data inclusion and exclusion. We test our method on language model training runs from 100M to 2B scales, across DDP and FSDP, and demonstrate this minimal overhead. We also introduce a self-regulating leaderboard of "auto-certified" training runs that enables shared baselines and progress. We invite the community to participate in the leaderboard to improve reproducibility in machine learning.

</details>


### [1280] [Optimizing the Phi-2 Small Language Model for Real-time Chatbot Applications Using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with QLoRA Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33927)
*PhanTan Khanh Nguyen,Ashfaq Ali Shafin,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过PEFT与QLoRA（4-bit量化+LoRA）优化Phi-2小型语言模型，以适配实时聊天机器人在移动/边缘环境中的应用，并使用ROUGE指标验证了摘要任务性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型语言模型（SLM）虽具低计算开销优势，但在移动和边缘计算等资源受限环境部署时仍面临内存与效率约束，需要进一步优化以满足实时聊天机器人的需求。

Method: 将参数高效微调（PEFT）与LoRA结合4-bit量化的QLoRA方法应用于Phi-2模型，以显著降低内存占用，同时保持或提升实时交互中的响应准确性，并采用ROUGE指标进行评估。

Result: ROUGE评估显示模型在摘要任务上取得明显性能提升，验证了在资源受限环境中使用SLM的可行性。

Conclusion: 该研究为在实时场景中部署高效、可扩展且易获取的AI技术开辟了新途径，对多行业广泛应用具有重要启示。

Abstract: This study explores the optimization of the Phi-2 Small Language Models (SLMs) for real-time chatbot applications through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). QLoRA specifically refers to the integration of PEFT with LoRA alongside a 4-bit quantization process, aimed at enhancing computational efficiency. These models, initially designed for high performance with minimal computational overhead, are further refined to address the constraints of mobile and edge computing environments. By integrating PEFT with QLoRA, the research aims to reduce memory usage significantly while maintaining, or potentially improving, the accuracy of model responses in real-time interactions. The effectiveness of these techniques was evaluated using the ROUGE metric system, which showed notable improvements in the summarization tasks performed by the models. This approach not only confirms the feasibility of using SLMs in resource-restricted environments but also opens up new avenues for deploying advanced AI-driven applications in real-time settings. The study's findings have significant implications for the development of efficient, scalable, and accessible AI technologies, paving the way for broader adoption in various industries.

</details>


### [1281] [Diffusion-Based Rollouts as a Stabilization Mechanism for Long-Horizon Environmental Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33930)
*Marina Vicens-Miquel,Amy McGovern,Aaron J. Hill,Efi Foufoula-Georgiou,Samuel S. P. Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于扩散模型的滚动预测作为递归预测稳定机制，发现扩散能抑制递归误差增长，但预报保真度还取决于可用的预测信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展预报提前期同时保持预测技巧是环境预报的重大挑战，递归预测中的误差累积问题亟待解决。

Method: 以低维水位时间序列和高维降水场为对象，采用基于扩散的rollout作为递归预测的稳定机制，并与确定性rollout对比。

Result: 两种模态下扩散均抑制递归误差增长，在确定性rollout最不稳定处稳定效果最显著。水位实验中预报逐步丧失事件级保真度，轨迹趋于中心值、变异性降低；降水实验因全程保留数值天气预报条件，扩散更好保持空间结构与事件检测能力。

Conclusion: 扩散可控制递归误差放大，但其实际收益还取决于约束未来演变所需的预测信息是否可用。

Abstract: Extending forecast lead times while maintaining predictive skill remains a major challenge in environmental forecasting. We investigate diffusion-based rollouts as a stabilization mechanism for recursive forecasting using low-dimensional water-level time series and high-dimensional precipitation fields. Across both modalities, diffusion suppresses recursive error growth, with the largest stabilization occurring where deterministic rollouts are most unstable. However, stabilization does not guarantee forecast fidelity. In the water-level experiments, forecasts progressively lose event-level fidelity as the rollout loses access to external predictive information, and trajectory-level comparisons show that diffusion can remain numerically stable while contracting toward central values and exhibiting reduced variability. In the precipitation experiments, which retain conditioning from numerical weather prediction throughout the rollout, diffusion better preserves spatial organization and event-detection skill. Together, these contrasting experiments indicate that diffusion can control recursive error amplification, while its practical benefit also depends on the predictive information available to constrain future evolution.

</details>


### [1282] [How Strong Is the Evidence for the Artificial Hivemind? Reevaluating Evidence for the Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33936)
*Rylan Schaeffer,Brando Miranda,Joshua Kazdan,Jessica Chudnovsky,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新检验"人工蜂巢思维"论文的三项核心结论，发现旗舰隐喻例子不成立、同质性度量缺乏严格基线、以及推论干预不足的结论缺乏依据；因此该论文未能证明人工蜂巢思维存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究主张语言模型在开放式生成中高度同质，构成威胁人类创造力的"人工蜂巢思维"，本文质疑其证据是否足以支撑这一结论。

Method: 重新分析该论文的三项中心结果：(1) 检验"写一个关于时间的隐喻"这一旗舰案例的聚类与标签；(2) 用更严格的原假设（同一提示但表达真正不同想法）替代其宽松基线；(3) 重审其关于推理期干预无效的结论，并测试提示干预的效果。

Result: 可视化、谱分析、聚类与标签均不支持两簇塌缩的说法，实际为一主类加长尾；在更严格基线下一部分同质性消失；提示干预能可靠提升多样性；且其度量为无人类基线、无原假设。

Conclusion: 本文不判定人工蜂巢思维是否真实，但证明已发表证据不足以确立它，且其训练级别解决方案的结论缺乏支持。

Abstract: Recent research argues that language models exhibit pronounced homogeneity in open-ended generation, framing such behavior as an Artificial Hivemind that poses a long-term threat to human creativity. We examine three of its central results. First, the flagship example is that model responses to "Write a metaphor involving time" collapse into two clusters. Visualization, spectral analysis, clustering, and language model labels all contradict this description. The labels record each response's vehicle, what it compares time to. Our responses and the original authors' own show one dominant vehicle plus a heavy tail of distinct minority vehicles. "Time" is one of our least diverse topics, so the example is a favorable case, not a representative one. Second, the paper measures homogeneity against an undemanding null: responses to unrelated prompts. Under a more demanding null (same-prompt responses expressing genuinely different ideas), 20%-32% of such pairs already exceed the paper's 0.8 convergence threshold. A residual effect survives this null. The paper's same-prompt pairs exceed 0.8 roughly two to three times as often as our different-idea pairs. Much of what the paper calls homogeneity is the shared geometry of answering the same prompt. The remaining measurements lack any null: no human baseline is collected, and the model-indistinguishability statistic has no null. Third, the paper concludes that inference-time interventions are inadequate for combating the Artificial Hivemind, writing that "more generalizable solutions are needed at the model training level." We show that this conclusion is unsupported in three ways, and that an inference-time intervention (prompting) reliably raises measured response diversity. We do not resolve whether the Artificial Hivemind is real. We show that the published evidence does not establish it.

</details>


### [1283] [Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33940)
*Thomas Walker,Randall Balestriero,Richard Baraniuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"质心"(子组件雅可比行和)来识别世界模型的行为特性,为WM规划提供行为监控工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测基于世界模型(WM)的规划失败,需要监控模型是否与当前任务行为对齐,而这需要研究其内部表示。

Method: 利用质心(子组件雅可比行和),通过雅可比向量积高效计算,刻画模型如何组织输入空间几何,生成任务相关的显著性图。在连续控制任务上用JEPA世界模型评估。

Result: 揭示结构性解离:编码器正确表示目标,但预测器行为无响应。该失败模式能在动作执行前预测规划失败,支持目标重采样以恢复分布外成功。质心方法作为分布偏移检测器优于基线。

Conclusion: 这些工具构成一个在分布偏移下可操作且有意义的行为监控栈。

Abstract: Detecting failures in World Model (WM)-based planning requires monitoring whether the model is behaviorally aligned with the current task, which in turn requires studying its internal representations. Here, we show that centroids---sub-component Jacobian row-sums---effectively identify the behavioral properties of WMs, complementing traditional activation-based knowledge signals. The centroids of a model are easily computed through Jacobian vector products and characterize how the model organizes the geometry of its input space, yielding an efficient perspective on internal representations, including the generation of task-relevant saliency maps. Evaluated on continuous control tasks using JEPA WMs, this behavioral view reveals a structural dissociation, where the encoder correctly represents the goal while the predictor remains behaviorally unresponsive. This failure mode directly predicts planning failure before any action is taken, allowing for goal resampling to recapture out-of-distribution success. Moreover, centroid-based methods outperform baseline methods as distribution-shift detectors. Together, these tools yield a behavioral monitoring stack that is operational and consequential under distribution shifts.

</details>


### [1284] [GroupMask: Layer-Adaptive Group-wise Sparsity for Semi-Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33977)
*Zhengao Li,Shuoqiu Li,Xiaofang Zhang,Yukai Jin,Gokcen Kestor,Yanfu Zhang,Yiming Zeng,Bin Ren,Chuxu Zhang,Shangqian Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GroupMask，用超网络学习组级稀疏度自适应分配，在冻结权重下实现半结构化剪枝，显著优于固定N:M模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有N:M半结构化剪枝固定每层局部稀疏比例，虽层自适应分配对非结构化剪枝有效，但在N:M下被报道效果有限，需探究其在半结构化剪枝中的普适价值。

Method: 采用组级稀疏：将权重矩阵划分为规则组，整组保留或剪除，允许各层稀疏比在全局预算下变化。GroupMask用轻量超网络生成各层组选择器，经Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛与直通估计器，结合稀疏预算正则和自蒸馏学习，保持预训练权重冻结。

Result: LLaMA-2-7B在50%稀疏、1×256组大小下，WikiText-2困惑度从10.02降至8.30，零样本平均准确率从0.455升至0.496；在五个LLaMA和Qwen模型上取得最低WikiText-2困惑度，Alpaca校准时平均零样本准确率最高。

Conclusion: 层自适应分配在半结构化剪枝中同样有效，组级稀疏比固定N:M更具优势，GroupMask验证了自适应分配的价值。

Abstract: Semi-structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) while keeping a regular sparse structure, but the prevailing N:M pattern fixes the same local sparsity ratio in every layer. Layer-adaptive sparsity allocation improves unstructured pruning, yet it has been reported to be less effective under N:M sparsity, leaving open whether adaptive allocation is of limited value for semi-structured pruning in general or only under the fine-grained N:M pattern. We examine this question with group-level sparsity, which partitions each weight matrix into regular groups, retains or prunes each group as a whole, and allows each layer's sparsity ratio to vary under a global budget. We propose GroupMask, which generates the group selectors of all layers with a lightweight hypernetwork, relaxes them with a Gumbel-Sigmoid parameterization and a straight-through estimator, and learns them through sparsity-budget regularization and self-distillation while keeping the pretrained weights frozen. On LLaMA-2-7B at 50% sparsity with the same $1\times256$ group size, learned layer-adaptive allocation reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 10.02 to 8.30 and raises the average zero-shot accuracy from 0.455 to 0.496 relative to a uniform per-layer ratio. GroupMask obtains the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity on LLaMA-2-7B and the highest average zero-shot accuracy with Alpaca calibration among the evaluated baselines on five LLaMA and Qwen models. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhengaoLi/GroupMask.

</details>


### [1285] [DynGraphAgentBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Lifecycle Control in Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33980)
*Yuwei Han,Lingwei Wei,Wooseong Yang,Liangjie Huang,Liancheng Fang,Huanhuan Ma,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DynGraphAgentBench，一个在延迟反馈下评估智能体生命周期控制的动态图异常检测可执行基准，让控制器在无当窗信息时选择检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图异常检测需随图结构与类别分布漂移反复决策，但现有基准通常在已知当前标签后评估固定流水线，无法反映真实部署中的延迟反馈与因果约束。

Method: 构建含7个时序图数据集、节点/边级任务、11个可选检测器、每数据集8个时间部署窗口的基准；每窗口控制器仅见时间因果聚合上下文、模型卡与自身成熟历史，须在当窗训练或候选分数产生前选择检测器；沙箱执行器用成熟数据训练、对隐藏窗口打分并延迟一窗释放结果；确定性验证器检查决策时序、泄漏防护、合法动作、训练范围与持久化产物。

Result: 以平均精度和固定审查深度捕获率衡量检测效用，用模型切换与计算量刻画适应；呈现两主控制器与无记忆参考在4数据集上的完整8窗轨迹，及3个额外控制器在3数据集上的结果，揭示对延迟证据的有用、高代价与无效反应。

Conclusion: 该基准在不提供当窗完备预言者的情况下，支持对延迟反馈下智能体生命周期控制进行可复现、防泄漏的评估。

Abstract: Dynamic graph anomaly detection requires repeated decisions as graph structure and class prevalence drift, yet detector benchmarks usually score a fixed pipeline after current labels are known. We introduce DynGraphAgentBench, an executable benchmark for agentic lifecycle control under delayed feedback. It comprises seven temporal graph datasets with node- and edge-level anomaly tasks, eleven selectable detectors, and eight chronological deployment windows per dataset. In each window, a controller sees only time-causal aggregate context, registered model cards, and its own matured history. It must choose a detector before current-window training or candidate scores exist. A sandboxed executor trains the chosen architecture on mature data, scores a hidden deployment window, and releases the outcome after a one-window delay. A deterministic verifier checks decision timing, leakage guards, legal actions, training scope, and persisted artifacts. We measure detection utility with average precision and capture at fixed review depth, and characterize adaptation through model switches and compute. Complete eight-window trajectories from two primary controllers and a no-memory reference on four datasets, together with three additional controllers on three datasets, expose useful, costly, and ineffective reactions to delayed evidence without granting an exhaustive current-window oracle.

</details>


### [1286] [Future Information-Directed Sampling for Bayesian Nonstationary Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33981)
*Yichen Song,Alessio Russo,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出未来信息导向采样（FIDS）算法，在贝叶斯非平稳bandit中显式探索未来最优臂的信息，并给出可学习的近似框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典算法（UCB、Thompson Sampling）的探索主要减少关于当前最优臂的不确定性，但在非平稳环境中，未来最优臂可能与当前显著不同，因而探索不足。

Method: 提出FIDS算法，显式探索以获取未来最优臂的信息；并针对后验推断困难，提出基于监督学习的近似框架，从离线数据中学习FIDS策略。

Result: FIDS达到与Thompson Sampling相当的遗憾（至多差一个小的常数因子），同时能利用传统探索目标无法捕捉的预测性信息结构；在合成基准上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: FIDS在贝叶斯非平稳bandit中兼顾理论遗憾保证与预测信息利用能力，其监督学习近似为实际应用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Exploration--exploitation is a central trade-off in bandit learning. While classical algorithms such as upper confidence bound methods and Thompson Sampling effectively balance this trade-off in stationary environments, their exploration strategies mainly reduce uncertainty about the current optimal arm, which can be insufficient in nonstationary settings where future optimal arms may differ substantially from current ones. In this paper, we propose Future Information-Directed Sampling (FIDS), a new algorithm for Bayesian nonstationary bandits that explicitly explores to gather information about future optimal arms. We show that FIDS achieves regret comparable to Thompson Sampling up to a small constant factor, while being able to exploit predictive information structures that conventional exploration objectives fail to capture. To address the practical difficulty of posterior inference, we further propose a supervised-learning-based approximation framework that learns the FIDS policy from offline data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on synthetic benchmarks.

</details>


### [1287] [From HL to H+L-1 Parameters: A Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33984)
*Chaoqi Zhang,Yu Wang,Haixu Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF)，利用经典平稳预测理论指导线性预测器的参数共享，实现更紧凑的长期时间序列预测模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性预测器在长期时间序列预测中已能与Transformer类模型竞争，但其参数效率与理论基础仍有提升空间，本文试图用经典平稳预测理论来指导参数共享设计。

Method: 对中心化二阶平稳过程，最小MSE有限窗口线性预测器可分解为Hankel互协方差矩阵与逆Toeplitz协方差矩阵。基于新息表示，HTF学习一个脉冲响应，同时定义逆滤波器和预测映射，仅用H+L-1个可训练系数，同时允许满秩预测矩阵。

Result: 在L=336的七个基准数据集上，HTF的horizon平均MSE与Dense Linear相差不超过1.2%，而可训练参数少75-229倍。

Conclusion: HTF表明经典平稳预测理论可有效指导线性预测器的参数共享，在保持高精度的同时大幅减少参数量。

Abstract: Linear forecasters have shown competitive accuracy against Transformer-based models in long-term time series forecasting. We study how classical stationary prediction theory can guide parameter sharing for more compact linear forecasters. For centered second-order stationary processes with nonsingular history covariance, the minimum-MSE finite-window linear predictor factors into a Hankel cross-covariance matrix and an inverse Toeplitz covariance matrix. Shared lags and scale cancellation specify this predictor using $H+L-1$ autocorrelations for lookback $L$ and horizon $H$. Building on the innovations representation, our Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF) learns one impulse response that defines both an inverse filter and a forecast map. We characterize the finite-history correction and, under summability assumptions, bound the excess risk of truncating the true filters. HTF uses $H+L-1$ trainable coefficients while allowing a full-rank forecasting matrix. Across seven benchmarks at $L=336$, its horizon-averaged MSE is within 1.2% of Dense Linear on each dataset with 75-229 times fewer trainable parameters.

</details>


### [1288] [ICMAPE: In-Context Multiagent Pure Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33986)
*Xinyi Hu,Alessio Russo,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ICMAPE是一个基于贝叶斯学习的去中心化多智能体纯探索框架，将固定置信度识别目标转化为推理置信度奖励，从而可用标准强化学习求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动序贯假设检验（ASHT）研究多聚焦于有限、单智能体且模型明确的问题，缺少可用于实际多智能体的主动序贯测试方法，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: ICMAPE将固定置信度识别目标转化为基于推理置信度的奖励，使标准强化学习机制适用于去中心化纯探索。它联合学习一个集中式神经推理网络（从全局轨迹估计假设的后验分布）和去中心化策略（依据局部观测历史选动作，并在达到目标置信度时学会停止采集数据）。

Result: 在两个合成基准及基于真实数据的马里兰硝酸盐浓度监测任务上，ICMAPE-TD3以更少的探索步数达到目标精度。

Conclusion: ICMAPE为去中心化多智能体主动序贯假设检验提供了实用方法，在真实任务中提升了探索效率。

Abstract: In some multi-agent systems, the quantity to be optimized is not an externally specified reward but the information acquired about unknown properties of the environment as done in active sequential hypothesis testing (ASHT) problems. However, the ASHT literature tends to focus on finite single-agent problems with well-specified models, while there is currently a gap for practical multi-agent methods that can perform active sequential testing. We fill this gap with ICMAPE, a Bayesian learning-based framework for decentralized multi-agent pure-exploration driven by inference objectives. ICMAPE converts the fixed-confidence identification objective into a reward derived from inference confidence, so that standard reinforcement learning machinery can be applied to decentralized pure exploration. It jointly learns a centralized neural inference network that estimates a posterior distribution over hypotheses from global trajectory data, and decentralized policies that select actions from local observation histories and learn when to stop collecting data once the target confidence is reached. On two synthetic benchmarks and a Maryland nitrate concentration monitoring task based on real-world data, ICMAPE-TD3 achieves target accuracy with fewer exploration steps.

</details>


### [1289] [ASTRA: ADMM-Accelerated Topology Reconfiguration for Dynamic Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33993)
*João Norberto,Ricardo Ferreira,Cláudia Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ASTRA是一个基于在线学习与ADMM的动态卫星拓扑重构框架，在理论保证下兼顾效率，并在真实Starlink数据（部分部署、非均匀间距）下验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有卫星星座拓扑重构方法依赖理想化假设，如完整星座部署或均匀轨道间距，导致在现实LEO网络中失效。

Method: 构建在线学习形式的ASTRA框架，结合ADMM离线求解器与在线梯度下降、在线条件梯度的在线更新，实现低成本的约束更新；理论分析其在entry-wise非零效用矩阵下的强凸性及静态/动态遗憾界。

Result: 对一类效用矩阵证明目标强凸，在线梯度下降获得对数静态遗憾；在ADMM不精确内循环下给出动态遗憾保证；在合成星座上拓扑质量与计算时间取得良好折中，在真实Starlink数据部分部署与非均匀间距场景下依然有效。

Conclusion: ASTRA是面向现实LEO网络的高效且具理论基础的拓扑重构方法。

Abstract: Dynamic topology reconfiguration is central to the reliability and efficiency of large satellite constellations, yet many existing approaches rely on idealized assumptions such as full constellation deployment or uniform orbital spacing. We present Adaptive Satellite Topology via Regret-Aware learning (ASTRA), a theoretically-grounded framework for dynamic satellite topology reconfiguration that builds on an online learning formulation and makes it computationally practical. ASTRA combines an ADMM-based offline solver with efficient online updates for both online gradient descent and online conditional gradient, yielding markedly cheaper constrained updates than generic optimization pipelines. On the theory side, we show that for a relevant class of entry-wise nonzero utility matrices, the objective is strongly convex, which yields logarithmic static regret for online gradient descent, and we further instantiate known dynamic-regret guarantees under inexact ADMM inner loops. Empirically, ASTRA matches or improves topology quality, presenting a good trade-off with computational time on synthetic constellations, and it remains effective on real Starlink data under partial deployment and non-uniform spacing, where idealized structural assumptions break down. These results position ASTRA as an efficient and theoretically grounded approach to topology reconfiguration in realistic Low Earth Orbit networks.

</details>


### [1290] [T-SNN: Temporal Simplicial Neural Network for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34002)
*Nikita Malik,Shubhajit Roy,Mohit Kataria,Isuru Herath,Suraj Yadav,Inés García-Redondo,Dhananjay Bhaskar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出时序单纯复形神经网络(T-SNN)，将EEG建模为演化的单纯复形序列，联合学习高阶交互与时间演化，在SEED-VII情绪识别任务上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG方法多将记录视为多元时间序列或用成对图表示功能连接，忽略了动态的高阶交互作用。

Method: T-SNN 将EEG表示为演化的单纯复形(sequence of evolving simplicial complexes)，结合单纯复形卷积(simplicial convolutions)与循环更新(recurrent updates)，联合学习高阶交互及其时间演化。

Result: 在七分类SEED-VII情绪识别任务上，T-SNN在trial-wise与跨被试(cross-subject)评估中均优于卷积、循环、图及Transformer方法；融合眼动特征可进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: 该框架展现了多模态脑状态解码的潜力。

Abstract: Decoding brain states requires models that capture both the evolution of neural activity and interactions among groups of brain regions. Existing EEG methods often treat recordings as multivariate time series or represent functional connectivity with pairwise graphs, leaving dynamic higher-order interactions largely unmodeled. We introduce the Temporal Simplicial Neural Network (T-SNN), which represents EEG recordings as sequences of evolving simplicial complexes. By combining simplicial convolutions with recurrent updates, T-SNN jointly learns higher-order interactions and their temporal evolution. On the seven-class SEED-VII emotion recognition task, T-SNN outperforms convolutional, recurrent, graph-based, and Transformer methods in both trial-wise and cross-subject evaluations. Incorporating eye-movement features further improves performance, demonstrating the framework's potential for multimodal brain-state decoding.

</details>


### [1291] [RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34004)
*Tong Liu,Lanmiao Liu,Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RICE-Alpha，一种point-in-time股票评分框架，通过事件图与可靠性校准的残差修正，将历史事件延续信息引入LLM金融预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM金融agent在point-in-time约束下难以保留发行人专属的时间序列信息，也难判断历史转移是否对当前预测提供额外增量信息。

Method: 分离history-aware多视图Base Alpha与基于历史事件延续的可靠性校准残差修正；用Multi-Tier Memory Layer确保时间合规的发行人历史，Typed Event Agent构建事件状态并在发行人内部及有效局部配对后跨公司池化，校准成熟转移后得到图信号，再对Base Alpha和技术视图做残差化得到RICE Delta。

Result: 2024–2026年Nasdaq-100与恒生指数日度面板上，四项预测指标和四项组合指标均优于评估的LLM agent与动量baseline；ICIR翻倍以上，美/港净Sharpe达1.656和1.725，美国消融显示移除主要组件后IC与RankIC显著下降（Holm校正）。

Conclusion: 当历史事件延续具备时间落地、可靠性校准并以残差修正形式引入多视图预测时，能提供额外增量信息。

Abstract: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuers and pooled across firms only after valid local pairing. Matured transitions are calibrated by their empirical reliability, and the resulting graph signal is residualized against the Base Alpha and technical view to obtain the RICE Delta. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, RICE-Alpha achieves the strongest results among the evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio-level metrics. Its ICIR more than doubles that of the strongest baseline, while net Sharpe ratios reach 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong, respectively. U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed. These results indicate that historical event continuation adds incremental information when it is temporally grounded, reliability-calibrated, and introduced as a residual correction to a multi-view forecast.

</details>


### [1292] [Fisher-Informed Recalibration for Feedback-Based On-Policy Self-Distillation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34009)
*Seohyun Lee,Dong-Jun Han,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIRE：一种双分支框架，通过Fisher信息校准反馈监督，稳定LLM基于反馈的on-policy自蒸馏训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于反馈的on-policy自蒸馏让LLM在外部反馈下从自身输出学习（单模型兼任师生），但优化不稳定，易导致训练中性能崩溃。

Method: 提出FIRE双分支框架，重新校准正确/错误on-policy输出的监督：正确响应用重加权的on-policy SFT替代自蒸馏；错误响应则识别对教师更新影响过大的反馈成分并校准目标；两分支均受由softmax Fisher迹导出的token级半径调控，分离“朝哪移动”与“移动多远”，对良好监督保持不变。

Result: 实验表明FIRE显著提升自蒸馏稳定性，同时保持较强的下游性能，尤其在标准反馈条件蒸馏不稳定的场景下。

Conclusion: FIRE通过Fisher信息校准反馈监督，有效缓解自蒸馏崩溃，兼得训练稳定性与下游性能。

Abstract: Feedback-based on-policy self-distillation has emerged as a promising approach for enabling foundation models, more specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), to learn from their own outputs under external feedback, with a single model serving as both teacher and student. However, such methods can exhibit unstable optimization, conducive to performance collapse during training. To address this limitation, we propose FIRE (Fisher-Informed REcalibration), a dual-branch framework that recalibrates the supervision applied to correct and incorrect on-policy outputs during fine-tuning. For correct responses, FIRE replaces self-distillation with re-weighted on-policy SFT, while for incorrect ones FIRE identifies feedback components that disproportionately influence the teacher-induced update and recalibrates the feedback-conditioned target accordingly. Both branches are influenced by a token-level radius derived in part from a softmax Fisher trace. FIRE separates which direction feedback should move the model from how far the model should move in that direction, while leaving well-behaved feedback supervision unchanged. Our experiments demonstrate that FIRE provides substantially more stable self-distillation while maintaining strong downstream performance, particularly in settings where standard feedback-conditioned distillation becomes unstable.

</details>


### [1293] [When Known Physics Helps Neural PDE Models: Residual Constraints Out-Regularize Generic Priors for Nonlinear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34012)
*Zahra Farazpay,Aniruddha Bora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在统一协议下评估神经PDE代理模型中的结构先验，核心发现是已知方程残差的收益特定于非线性算子，且在网格欠分辨时反而有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE代理模型常引入结构先验（如物理残差），但其收益究竟来自物理特定信息还是仅来自正则化和训练选择尚不清楚，需要区分二者的真实来源。

Method: 在统一协议下，将多种先验与匹配的从零训练神经算子基线对比，控制调参预算与模型容量，并进行容量扫描、数据稀疏性预注册假设检验及网格欠分辨实验。

Result: 在相同调参预算下，已知方程残差始终优于最佳通用正则器；固定容量下对线性和非线性PDE均有收益，但容量扫描显示：Burgers、KdV、Allen-Cahn收益持续且增大，线性热方程与对流扩散则趋于持平或更低。数据稀疏假设被证伪，全监督下残差仍有效。网格欠分辨时非线性粗场不满足朴素控制方程残差，强制施加反而有害；跨族预训练与上下文条件化未能超越强基线。

Conclusion: 已知物理信息对神经PDE模型的价值是非冗余的，但仅对非线性算子持久有效；当粗网格使残差假设失效时，强制物理约束会引入偏差。研究界定了物理先验何时有益、何时无益以及何时有害。

Abstract: Neural PDE surrogates increasingly incorporate structural priors, yet it is often unclear whether their gains arise from physics-specific information or simply from regularization and training choices. We evaluate several such priors under a common protocol against a matched from-scratch neural operator baseline. Our central result is that a known-equation residual consistently outperforms the best generic regularizer at equal tuning budget. At fixed capacity this benefit appears across linear and nonlinear PDEs, but a capacity sweep reveals a sharp distinction: the advantage persists and grows for Burgers, KdV, and Allen-Cahn, while collapsing toward or below parity for linear heat and advection-diffusion. Thus, the durable value of the residual is specific to nonlinear operators. We further falsify a pre-registered hypothesis that the benefit is activated only by data sparsity: the residual remains advantageous even under full supervision. Its usefulness does, however, have a clear boundary. Under grid under-resolution, nonlinear coarse fields no longer satisfy the naive governing-equation residual, and enforcing it becomes actively harmful. In contrast, cross-family pretraining and in-context conditioning fail to outperform the strong from-scratch baseline in the regime studied. Together, these results identify when known physics provides non-redundant information to neural PDE models, when it does not, and when enforcing it introduces bias.

</details>


### [1294] [LTV-CTDNet: Compositional Turning Decomposition for Short-Term Turning-Movement Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34014)
*Md Atiqur Rahman Mallick,Kamrul Hasan,Robert T. White*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出LTV-CTDNet框架，通过分解式预测转向流量，在保持竞争性精度的同时保证输出结构合理（非负、分量之和等于总需求）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短期转向流量预测可支持信号控制和走廊运营，但无约束神经网络可能产生物理上不可能的负流量，或输出未明确与进口道需求总量挂钩。

Method: 提出线性时序变量组合式转向分解网络（LTV-CTDNet）。使用轻量编码器融合近期转向历史、每周时段嵌入和位置嵌入；组合式转向分解框架分别预测非负进口道总量和进口道内转向比例，再重构各转向流量。

Result: 基于Nashville八个监测点七个月15分钟LiDAR数据评估。转向级MAE为1.8189，RMSE为3.8072。相比最强序列模型精度提升有限，但未产生负预测；无约束学习模型约10.6%–29.2%的原始预测单元出现负值。

Conclusion: 该框架通过构造保证非负输出，并使模型预测的进口道总量精确等于其分量转向之和，无需截断或一致性修正即可提供直接可解释的预测。

Abstract: Short-term turning-movement forecasts can support signal control and corridor operations, but unconstrained neural networks may produce physically impossible negative counts or outputs that are not explicitly tied to an approach-demand total. This study introduces the Linear Temporal-Variable Compositional Turning Decomposition Network (LTV-CTDNet), a forecasting framework designed to combine competitive accuracy with structurally admissible outputs. LTV-CTDNet was evaluated using seven months of 15-minute LiDAR observations from eight monitored corridor locations in Nashville, Tennessee. Its lightweight encoder combines recent turning-movement history, weekly time-slot embeddings, and location embeddings. The Compositional Turning Decomposition framework separately predicts nonnegative approach totals and within-approach turning proportions, then reconstructs movement forecasts from these components. Among the evaluated predefined configurations, LTV-CTDNet achieved a movement-level MAE of 1.8189 and RMSE of 3.8072. Its accuracy gains over the strongest sequence models were modest, but it produced no negative forecasts, while unconstrained learned models generated negative values in approximately 10.6% to 29.2% of raw forecast cells. The framework enforces nonnegative outputs and exact agreement between each model-predicted approach total and the sum of its component movements by construction, providing directly interpretable forecasts without clipping or coherence correction.

</details>


### [1295] [SR4-Fit: A Unified Interpretable Rule-Based Machine Learning Framework for Informative and Trustworthy Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34019)
*Shyam Sundar Murali Krishnan,Dean Frederick Hougen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SR4-Fit，一种本质上可解释的规则拟合算法，在分类与回归任务上生成紧凑稳定规则集，兼顾性能与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险应用中机器学习多为黑盒模型，需事后解释，但这类解释往往不可靠、无法反映模型真实计算过程，损害问责与信任。虽然本就可解释的规则模型是自然替代方案，但现有方法（如RuleFit、决策树）透明却缺乏稳定性与预测能力，强化了"性能与可理解性相互权衡"的固有印象。

Method: 提出Sparse Relaxed Regularized Regression Rule-Fit (SR4-Fit)，一种同时适用于分类和回归的固有可解释算法，通过稀疏放松正则化机制生成紧凑且稳定的规则集。在美国人口普查局ACS人口数据上预测众议院选举结果，并在14个基准数据集（6分类、8回归）上与RuleFit、决策树及黑盒模型对比。

Result: SR4-Fit在选举预测中兼具高准确性与可解释性，并发现黑盒模型遗漏的人口统计交互作用；在14个基准数据集上，其在准确性、稳定性和紧凑性方面超越RuleFit和决策树等规则方法，预测性能与黑盒模型相当。

Conclusion: 可解释性与预测可靠性并非互斥，SR4-Fit为高风险决策提供了实用且透明的替代方案。

Abstract: In many high-stakes applications, machine learning is dominated by black-box models that require post hoc explanations to justify their predictions. These explanations are often unreliable because they do not reflect the model's actual computations, limiting accountability and trust. A natural alternative is to use models that are interpretable by design. However, existing rule-based approaches, such as RuleFit and decision trees, while transparent, often lack stability and predictive strength, reinforcing a perceived trade-off between traditional performance measures and model understandability. To address this, we propose Sparse Relaxed Regularized Regression Rule-Fit (SR4-Fit), an intrinsically interpretable algorithm for both classification and regression that produces compact and stable rule sets without sacrificing performance. Using demographic data from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey, SR4-Fit predicts U.S. House election outcomes with high accuracy and interpretability while uncovering demographic interactions missed by black-box models. We further validate SR4-Fit across fourteen benchmark datasets (six classification and eight regression), where it outperforms existing rule-based methods, including RuleFit and decision trees in terms of accuracy, stability, and compactness while remaining competitive with black-box models in predictivity. These results demonstrate that interpretability and predictive reliability need not be mutually exclusive, offering a practical and transparent alternative for high-stakes decision-making.

</details>


### [1296] [UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34036)
*Wenbo Zhang,Pengcheng Xu,Weizhi Du,Jing Zhang,Hengrui Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UOPD 提出一种不确定性感知的干预方法用于在线策略蒸馏，在低置信度步骤用教师动作纠正学生，提升多轮智能体任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中，学生在多轮环境里的关键决策失误会导致后续轨迹偏离，产生不良结果，需要选择性干预。

Method: 利用教师对学生动作的低置信度来识别高不确定性步骤。低不确定性时执行学生动作并应用标准 OPD 损失；高不确定性时采样并执行教师动作，用监督微调让学生模仿，从而在期望上最小化前向 KL 散度。采用自适应不确定性阈值以匹配预设的干预率。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search 等任务上评估，UOPD 优于标准 OPD 及其变体；WebShop 分数相比标准 OPD 最高提升 15.8%。

Conclusion: 选择性、基于不确定性的教师干预能有效改善在线策略蒸馏在多轮智能体任务中的性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using dense supervision from a teacher. In multi-turn environments, a mistake at a critical decision step can redirect the subsequent rollout toward poor outcomes. We use low teacher confidence on student actions to select high-uncertainty steps for correction. In a controlled ALFWorld study, a single teacher correction at a low-confidence step improves subsequent student behavior and task success, motivating selective intervention during distillation. We propose UOPD, an uncertainty-aware intervention method for on-policy distillation. At low-uncertainty turns, UOPD executes student actions and applies the standard OPD loss. At high-uncertainty turns, it samples and executes teacher actions and trains the student to imitate them through supervised fine-tuning, which minimizes forward Kullback-Leibler divergence in expectation. UOPD utilizes adaptive uncertainty thresholds to target a scheduled intervention rate. Empirically, we evaluate UOPD across a broad range of agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search, demonstrating its superior performance over OPD methods and their variants. UOPD improves WebShop score by up to $15.8\%$ relative to standard OPD.

</details>


### [1297] [Vision--Language Signals in Constrained RL: Safety Gains Without Anticipation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34041)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出VLM-Safe-RL框架，将冻结CLIP信号通过奖励塑形和增强乘子更新整合进PPO-Lagrangian。在MetaDrive Hard上灾变率从31.6%降至19.4%，但分析显示CLIP信号并不能预测碰撞，VLM项对拉格朗日乘子影响可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在驾驶基准中，碰撞代价通常只在碰撞发生时出现，无法提前预警危险；冻结视觉语言模型虽可提供密集语义反馈，但其分数能否预测碰撞、以及哪个组件驱动了安全性提升仍不明确。同时，回合制代价可能偏好进展很少的策略。

Method: 提出VLM-Safe-RL框架，将冻结的CLIP信号整合进PPO-Lagrangian，通过奖励塑形（reward shaping）和增强的乘子更新（augmented multiplier update）实现。

Result: 在交通最密集、地图最大的MetaDrive Hard上，灾变率从31.6%降至19.4%。FormulaOne-L2分析未发现CLIP信号能预测碰撞的证据，且VLM项对拉格朗日乘子的影响可忽略。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，观测到的灾变率降低是有条件的，且没有证据表明存在碰撞预测能力。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximise task performance while satisfying safety constraints. In driving benchmarks, however, collision costs typically appear only at the time of collision, providing no advance warning of an approaching hazard. Frozen vision--language models can provide dense semantic feedback, yet it remains unclear whether their scores anticipate collisions and which component drives an observed safety improvement. Episodic cost can also favour policies that make little task progress. To address these gaps, we propose VLM-Safe-RL, a framework that integrates frozen CLIP signals into PPO-Lagrangian through reward shaping and an augmented multiplier update. On MetaDrive Hard, which combines the densest traffic with the largest map, the catastrophe rate falls from 31.6\% to 19.4\%. FormulaOne-L2 analysis finds no evidence that the CLIP signals anticipate collisions and shows that the VLM term has a negligible effect on the Lagrange multiplier. These findings show a conditional reduction in observed catastrophe rate without evidence of collision anticipation.

</details>


### [1298] [PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34054)
*Hyesung Jeon,Hyeongju Ha,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PReCache，一个免训练的 KV cache 共享框架（含 PreLRShared 与 ReBaseShared），解决多 LoRA 智能体系统中重复 prefill 与角色特异性弱化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多 LoRA 智能体共享骨干模型，但每个智能体重复处理增长的共享轨迹并构建各自 KV cache，造成长任务中内存与计算冗余；现有共享方法需额外训练或架构约束，或仍保留大量计算，且直接复用会引入前一智能体 adapter 的缓存状态，削弱当前角色特异性。

Method: 免训练 KV cache 共享框架，共享基于预训练权重计算的 base cache，并预计算紧凑的智能体专属低秩(LR) cache。PreLRShared 在首次处理共享上下文时预计算各智能体 LR cache，避免重复 prefill；ReBaseShared 从无 adapter 的隐状态重建共享 base cache，减少前序 adapter 表示带来的误差，并提供面向单流推理与并发服务的两种重建方案。

Result: 在多个模型与智能体基准上，PreLRShared 相较无 KV cache 共享推理实现最高 3.1x TTFT 加速和 2.3x 单请求吞吐提升；ReBaseShared 在评估的缓存共享方法中整体保真度最佳，相对无共享推理平均仅下降 1.1 分。

Conclusion: PReCache 无需训练即实现高效且高保真的 KV cache 共享，兼顾速度与角色特异性精度。

Abstract: Multi-LoRA agent systems enable efficient role specialization by sharing a common backbone model. However, each agent repeatedly processes the growing shared trajectory and constructs its own KV cache, introducing substantial memory and computation redundancy in long-horizon tasks. Existing KV cache sharing methods reduce this repeated prefill, but they either require additional training or architectural constraints or retain substantial model computation. Moreover, direct cache reuse causes the current agent to rely on cache states generated by the previous agent's adapter, weakening the role-specific behavior encoded by its own LoRA. We present PReCache, a training-free KV cache sharing framework with two designs, namely PreLRShared and ReBaseShared, that share the base cache computed using the pretrained weights and precompute a compact agent-specific low-rank (LR) cache. To remove repeated prefill, PreLRShared precomputes each agent's LR cache when the shared context is first processed, allowing the current agent to use its own LR cache without reprocessing context processed by previous agents. To improve sharing accuracy, ReBaseShared reconstructs the shared base cache from adapter-free hidden states, reducing the remaining error caused by the previous agent's adapted representation. To minimize its reconstruction cost, we propose two inference schemes tailored to single-stream inference and concurrent serving, performing the same reconstruction after each agent's turn or alongside its execution, respectively. Across multiple models and agent benchmarks, PreLRShared achieves up to a 3.1x TTFT speedup and a 2.3x improvement in per-request throughput over inference without KV cache sharing. ReBaseShared best preserves accuracy overall among the evaluated cache-sharing methods, with an average drop of only 1.1 points relative to inference without cache sharing.

</details>


### [1299] [Do World Models Learn Global Understanding?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34058)
*Alexander Detkov,Matt Thomson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将"理解"形式化为学习约束并传播其后果，在幺半群世界任务上测试模型泛化能力，发现组合式训练能显著促进约束传播与信息整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统表现脆弱、碎片化：LLM能解释概念却无法应用，或在某些语境下遵守安全指令而在其他语境下失败，反映出从局部信息提升到全局理解的普遍失败。

Method: 构建"幺半群世界"学习任务（由动作转移连接的状态集合），训练转移与未见约束共同决定留出转移；考察逆、交换、组合、周期性四类约束；对比注意力、循环、状态空间等架构，比较next-state训练与组合式训练（相同路径但隐藏中间状态）；定义证明深度d衡量推理轮数。

Result: next-state训练能拟合数据但无法传播非平凡约束；组合式训练在逆、交换、组合约束上达96%准确率，并在具身环境世界模型几何泛化和Wikidata微调LLM关系泛化上均有提升；泛化能力随证明深度d急剧下降，增大组合路径长度T可改善泛化。

Conclusion: 提供了研究语言与世界模型中全局理解的形式化方法，证明组合式训练能促进信息传播与整合。

Abstract: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences. We construct learning tasks on monoid worlds, sets of states connected by action transitions, where observed training transitions and an unseen constraint jointly determine held-out transitions. Measuring generalization tests whether models can learn global constraints from local transitions and propagate their consequences. We consider inverse, commutativity, composition, and periodicity constraints relevant to spatial and semantic structure. Across attention, recurrent, and state-space architectures, next-state training fits the data but fails to propagate non-trivial constraints. Compositional training, which uses identical paths but hides intermediate states from the input, achieves 96% accuracy on inverse, commutativity, and composition constraints across architectures, yields corresponding improvements in geometric generalization of world models trained on embodied environments and relational generalization in Wikidata-finetuned LLMs. How far do models propagate constraints when inferring an unseen fact may depend on first inferring others? We define proof depth d of a held-out transition, measuring the minimum number of inference rounds to infer the transition, and find that model generalization decreases sharply with proof depth. Increasing compositional path length T improves generalization. These results provide a formal way to investigate global understanding in language and world models and demonstrate that compositional training promotes information propagation and integration.

</details>


### [1300] [KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34060)
*Hyesung Jeon,Hyeongju Ha,Seoyoung Lee,Beomseok Kang,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KVCMAS：一种在线KV缓存修正框架，用低秩状态表示跨智能体缓存偏差，沿工作流无缝修正，支持动态共享上下文且保持首智能体缓存精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示特化的多智能体系统共享同一模型但角色不同，智能体前缀导致同一共享上下文生成不同KV缓存，各智能体需重复预填充并构建独立缓存，计算与内存开销大。选择性重计算仍保留大量执行，现有delta修正方法仅支持固定上下文关系或需内存密集的在线修正状态，且首次出现的共享上下文需在工作流外构建参考缓存，首智能体的近似修正还会影响后续智能体输出。

Method: 用紧凑低秩状态表示跨智能体缓存偏差；沿智能体工作流无缝链式修正，无需额外参考预填充；支持动态变化的共享上下文并保持首智能体缓存精确。

Result: 在多种语言与视觉-语言负载上，准确率匹配或优于现有KV缓存共享方法，并在高并发服务下达到最低TTFT；受控服务轨迹下相比无共享推理实现2.0倍TTFT加速，峰值GPU内存较先前KV缓存修正方法降低达3.7倍。

Conclusion: KVCMAS是一种准确且可扩展的KV缓存共享方法，适用于提示特化多智能体服务。

Abstract: Prompt-specialized multi-agent systems enable multiple agents to share a model while performing complementary roles to solve complex tasks. However, agent-specific prefixes change the KV cache generated for the same shared context, causing each agent to repeatedly prefill the growing context and construct a separate cache with high computation and memory overhead. Selective recomputation reduces this redundancy but still retains substantial model execution, while existing delta correction methods either support only recurring context relations or maintain memory-intensive online correction states for dynamically changing context. For first seen shared context, these methods also construct a reference cache outside the agent workflow, and an approximate correction at the first agent affects the outputs passed to subsequent agents. We present KVCMAS, an online KV cache correction framework that represents cross-agent cache deviations using compact low-rank states and seamlessly chains corrections along the agent workflow without an additional reference prefill. This design supports dynamically changing shared context while preserving an exact first-agent cache. Across multiple language and vision-language workloads, KVCMAS matches or improves the accuracy of prior KV cache sharing methods while achieving the lowest TTFT under highly concurrent serving. Under controlled serving traces, it provides a 2.0x TTFT speedup over inference without KV cache sharing and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 3.7x relative to a prior KV cache correction method. These results establish KVCMAS as an accurate and scalable KV cache sharing approach for prompt-specialized multi-agent serving.

</details>


### [1301] [Learning Perturbation Robust Policies for LLM Agents with Stable Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34064)
*Pengxin Wang,Yuanzhe LI,Yuxin Ren,Huanrui Yang,Jingdi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究长程LLM智能体在强化学习后训练中的策略鲁棒性问题，提出SPrPO方法，通过自适应、敏感性感知的扰动来提升策略对扰动的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习已成为长程LLM智能体的有效后训练范式，但所得策略对隐藏状态噪声、剪枝、量化等扰动较为敏感，因此需要改进策略优化过程中的扰动鲁棒性。

Method: 作者首先引入"扰动鲁棒策略"的概念，分析扰动策略更新保持稳定单调改进的条件；据此提出Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO)，在RL训练中施加自适应且敏感性感知的扰动。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上进行评估，并对多种扰动类型和规模开展系统性实验，结果显示SPrPO在保持稳定策略优化的同时提升了扰动鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SPrPO能够有效提升长程LLM智能体策略对扰动的鲁棒性，同时维持稳定的策略优化过程。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective post-training paradigm for long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents. However, we find that the resulting policies can be sensitive to various policy perturbations, such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization. In this work, we study how to improve perturbation robustness during policy optimization. We first introduce the notion of a perturbation robust policy and analyze conditions under which perturbed policy updates preserve stable monotonic improvement. Based on this analysis, we introduce Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO), which applies adaptive and sensitivity-aware perturbations during RL training. We evaluate SPrPO on ALFWorld and WebShop and conduct systematic experiments across multiple perturbation types and scales, showing improved perturbation robustness while maintaining stable policy optimization.

</details>


### [1302] [FLARE: Flow Matching with Local Axis-Angle Representations for Stochastic Micromagnetic Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34070)
*Pengyu Li,Renjie Tong,Xuanlue Jiang,Jianmin Li,Yuanyuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FLARE——一种基于流匹配的框架，将随机有限时间磁化预测重构为锚点相对局部轴角旋转的条件传输，直接生成全场随机终点，避免逐步积分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程微磁模拟因传统与学习型求解器逐步传播LLG动力学而极为昂贵；现有学习方法多保留逐步积分或仅建模确定性演化，全场、直接预测的随机建模尚未探索。

Method: 将随机有限时间磁化预测重构为锚点相对局部轴角旋转上的条件传输；旋转空间公式符合磁化动力学内在几何，并按构造保持逐点单位范数；以物理预测时程为条件，直接生成多目标时刻的全场随机终点，无需逐步积分。

Result: 相比各指标最强单检查点外部基线，角能量距离降低29.9%（15.30°），公平能量分数降低37.3%（0.393）；在代表性的5纳秒两段协议上，单GPU实现相对MuMax³最高批次3062倍加速。

Conclusion: FLARE通过旋转空间流匹配实现直接、随机的全场时程预测，在精度与速度上均显著优于现有方法与主流GPU求解器。

Abstract: Long-horizon micromagnetic simulation remains expensive because conventional and learned solvers typically propagate Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) dynamics step by step. Existing learned approaches generally retain stepwise integration or model deterministic evolution, leaving full-field, direct-horizon stochastic prediction largely unexplored. We propose FLARE, a flow-matching framework that recasts stochastic finite-time magnetization prediction as conditional transport over anchor-relative local axis-angle rotations. This rotation-space formulation respects the intrinsic geometry of magnetization dynamics and preserves pointwise unit norm by construction. By explicitly conditioning on the physical prediction horizon, FLARE directly generates full-field stochastic endpoints across multiple target times without stepwise integration. Against the strongest single-checkpoint external baseline on each metric, FLARE achieves 29.9% lower angular energy distance ($15.30^\circ$), and a 37.3% lower fair energy score (0.393). On a representative composed 5-ns two-segment protocol, FLARE achieves a $3{,}062\times$ best-batch speedup over the widely used GPU micromagnetic solver MuMax$^3$ on a single GPU.

</details>


### [1303] [MaskCoFT: Masked Co-Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34077)
*Junfeng Wu,Zehao Fan,Hadjer Benmeziane,Kaoutar El Maghraoui,Liu Liu,Yinan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MaskCoFT，一种掩码协同自适应微调方法，同时训练MoE路由器和专家，以减少专家卸载场景下的加载开销并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE语言模型常超出单GPU显存，专家卸载需按需加载，解码速度取决于每token获取的专家数量；缓存与预取受路由限制。仅微调路由器可复用专家但专家被冻结，无法适应新路由带来的token。

Method: MaskCoFT用可学习二值掩码在微调时将每层Top-K路由限制到部分专家，使路由器与专家协同自适应；仅用交叉熵损失训练。推理时，学到的掩码作为软先验对专家重排序，保证所有专家仍可选。

Result: 在Mixtral-8x7B上模拟每层4专家GPU缓存，DeepSeek-V2-Lite为12。每token专家获取量相对基线分别降低23.7%和10.1%；真实卸载系统服务中，每输出token时间最多降低16.4%和5.5%；九个基准平均精度仍高于基线0.92和0.53分。

Conclusion: MaskCoFT通过协同微调路由与专家，在保持甚至提升精度的同时显著减少专家获取、降低推理延迟，适合专家卸载场景。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models often exceed the memory of a single GPU. Expert offloading keeps most experts in host memory and loads them on demand, so decoding speed depends on how many experts each token must fetch. Caching and prefetching reduce this cost only as far as the routing allows. Router-only fine-tuning can reshape the routing to reuse experts, but it keeps the experts frozen, so they cannot adapt to the tokens the new routing sends them. We propose MaskCoFT, a masked co-adaptive fine-tuning method that trains routers and experts together with the cross-entropy loss alone. During fine-tuning, a learnable binary mask restricts the Top-K routing of each layer to a subset of experts, and the experts adapt to the tokens redirected to them. At inference, the learned mask becomes a soft prior that re-ranks experts, so every expert remains selectable. We simulate a GPU cache of 4 experts per layer for Mixtral-8x7B and 12 for DeepSeek-V2-Lite. MaskCoFT cuts expert fetches per token by 23.7% and 10.1% relative to the base model. In real offloading system serving, it lowers the time per output token by up to 16.4% and 5.5%, respectively. Its average accuracy over nine benchmarks stays above the base model by 0.92 and 0.53 points.

</details>


### [1304] [Beyond One Epoch: Uncertainty-Weighted Sensitivity Regularization for Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34083)
*Richard Lettich,Shagun Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 推荐模型在稀疏嵌入与共享消费者结构下存在"一个epoch现象"：第二个epoch降低训练损失却损害泛化。作者从"预序原则违背"角度解释，提出"自影响不对称"概念，并设计UWSR正则化方法缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐模型（稀疏嵌入+共享消费者）常出现"一个epoch现象"：第二epoch训练损失下降但泛化急剧恶化。作者认为其根源在于违背了预序原则（prequential principle）——第一epoch时样本标签未影响用于打分的嵌入行，而后续epoch中这些行已包含先前标签更新造成的位移，导致共享消费者有动机去利用这种位移，从而无法泛化。

Method: 提出"自影响不对称"（self-influence asymmetry）概念。用精确标量模型和局部影响分析，将标签更新引发的嵌入位移与嵌入不确定性及消费者利用该不确定性的动机相联系。通过嵌入-消费者-更新干预实验在深度推荐模型中验证假设，并提出"不确定性加权敏感度正则化"（UWSR），在损失函数中惩罚消费者依赖不确定嵌入的行为。

Result: 在三个基准上，四epoch的UWSR相比单epoch训练将测试交叉熵降低1.38%–6.78%，AUC提升0.0058–0.0231。且UWSR与现有补救方法不同，能保留已学到的嵌入。

Conclusion: "一个epoch现象"可由自影响不对称导致消费者利用不确定嵌入位移来解释；UWSR通过惩罚消费者依赖不确定嵌入有效缓解该问题，在多个基准上优于单epoch训练，同时保留学到的嵌入。

Abstract: Recommendation models with sparse embeddings and a shared consumer often exhibit the one-epoch phenomenon: a second epoch lowers training loss while sharply degrading generalization. We present a view based on the violation of the prequential principle. On the first epoch, an example's label has not affected the embedding rows used to score it. On later epochs, those rows contain a displacement induced by the labels earlier update. This creates an incentive for the shared consumer to exploit this displacement in subsequent epochs, which fails to generalize. We call this self-influence asymmetry. Using an exact scalar model and local influence analysis, we connect this mismatch to the uncertainty in the embeddings and the consumers incentive to exploit it in subsequent epochs. We verify this hypothesis using an embedding-consumer-update interventions in deep recommendation models and propose uncertainty-weighted sensitivity regularization (UWSR) which counteracts this mismatch by augmenting the loss function to penalize the consumer for relying on uncertain embeddings. Unlike existing remedies, UWSR preserves the learned embeddings and across three benchmarks, four-epoch UWSR reduces test cross-entropy by 1.38%-6.78% and improves AUC by 0.0058-0.0231 relative to one-epoch training.

</details>


### [1305] [TRACE: Expert-Aligned ECG Representation Learning with Rigorous Benchmarking and Real-World Validation in Acute Cardiac Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34088)
*Lovely Yeswanth Panchumarthi,Andrew Lu,Saurabh Kataria,Delgersuren Bold,Minxiao Wang,Runze Yan,Patricia Dykes,Brian J. Gow,Tom J. Pollard,Jessica K. Zègre-Hemsey,Dillon J. Dzikowicz,Lekshmi Kumar,Xiao Hu,Ran Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE是一种多模态ECG表示模型，通过不确定性加权多任务学习联合训练单模态与跨模态表示，并借助LLM提取高保真报告发现，在心律失常、结构异常及急性冠脉闭塞诊断上均优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP式训练难以处理含噪临床文本，且未能充分利用单模态（ECG内）与跨模态（ECG与配对心脏科报告间）学习的互补优势。

Method: 提出TRACE混合架构，通过不确定性加权多任务学习联合学习单模态与跨模态表示，并使用基于LLM的流水线从心脏科报告中提取高保真临床发现。

Result: 在心律失常分类和结构异常的公开基准上优于现有单模态与多模态ECG模型；在大型私有ACO数据集上显著超越真实临床实践，相对临床基线灵敏度提升19.0%，或将假阳性率降低62.6%。

Conclusion: TRACE兼具基准任务的强性能与在高危急性心脏场景中的实际临床价值，验证了其现实应用潜力。

Abstract: TRACE (Text-Reinforced Analysis of Cardio ECGs) is a multimodal electrocardiogram (ECG) representation model that learns clinically grounded signal embeddings for downstream cardiac classification. It is designed to address the limitations of existing CLIP-style training, which often struggles with noisy clinical text and fails to leverage the complementary strengths of unimodal (from ECG) and cross-modal (between ECG and matched cardiologist reports) learning. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid architecture that jointly learns unimodal and cross-modal representations via uncertainty-weighted multi-task learning while utilizing an LLM-based pipeline to extract high-fidelity findings from cardiologist reports. We evaluate TRACE across a spectrum of clinical urgency, establishing robust performance on public benchmarks for arrhythmia classification and structural abnormalities relative to existing unimodal and multimodal ECG models. To demonstrate real-world utility, we further validate the model on acute coronary occlusion (ACO), where the prevailing ST-elevation criteria miss 25-34% of true occlusions. Utilizing a large private ACO dataset with expert-annotated ground truth, TRACE significantly outperforms real-world clinical practice, yielding a 19.0% increase in sensitivity or a 62.6% reduction in false positive rates at the clinical baseline. This extensive evaluation confirms that TRACE delivers both strong performance on benchmark tasks and tangible clinical impact in the most acute, high-risk cardiac scenarios.

</details>


### [1306] [When Is an SAE Feature Interpretable? A Validation Ladder for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34091)
*Yucong Cao,Chenqi Li,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAE潜变量的扰动敏感性不能证明其语义含义，需经"验证阶梯"逐级检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在EEG基础模型中，SAE潜变量易于解释也易被误读。常见做法是：若移除alpha频段活动强烈改变某潜变量激活，就断定该潜变量表征alpha活动。作者怀疑这种推断存在混淆。

Method: 在3个骨干、3个EEG数据集、3种网络深度共27种设置下，对比alpha移除与等宽sham notch对潜变量激活的影响；再用移除的频谱能量归一化，并在干净数据上计算潜变量与相对alpha功率的相关性。基于此失败案例提出"验证阶梯"框架。

Result: 未归一化时，alpha移除对潜变量激活的改变是sham的7.3倍（95% CI [6.2,8.7]）；但经移除能量归一化后比值降至0.28（95% CI [0.22,0.36]），27种设置无一超过1。被选中的潜变量在干净EEG上与相对alpha功率呈弱负相关（平均r=-0.073）。

Conclusion: 仅凭扰动敏感性无法确立SAE潜变量的语义表征。作者提出验证阶梯：依次检验是否响应、是否在控制移除信号量后仍成立、是否具有特异性而非广泛脆弱、以及所提属性是否在未扰动数据上可见，并单独检验潜变量对任务分类器是否重要。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense model activations into discrete latents, making individual features easy to interpret--and easy to misinterpret. In EEG foundation models, this creates a tempting inference: if removing alpha-band activity strongly changes a latent's activation, one might conclude that the latent represents alpha activity. Across 27 settings spanning three backbones, three EEG datasets, and three network depths, this interpretation initially appears compelling: alpha removal changes latent firing 7.3 times more than an equal-width sham notch (95% CI [6.2, 8.7], bootstrapped over settings). However, the alpha filter also deletes far more signal than the sham. After normalizing by removed spectral energy, the ratio falls to 0.28 (95% CI [0.22, 0.36]) and exceeds one in none of the 27 settings. Latents selected for their response to alpha removal are, on clean EEG, slightly anti-correlated with relative alpha power (mean r = -0.073), giving no support for a simple alpha-detector reading. Motivated by this failure case, we propose a validation ladder for semantic interpretations of SAE latents: it asks in turn whether a latent responds, whether that response survives controlling for how much signal the intervention removes, whether it is specific rather than broadly fragile, and whether the proposed property is visible on unperturbed data--while separately testing the stronger claim that the latent matters to a task classifier. Perturbation sensitivity alone does not establish what an SAE latent represents.

</details>


### [1307] [Beyond Correctness: Evaluating Semantic Knowledge in Cross-Table Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34098)
*Seokyong Sheem,Hochang Lee,Suyeong Lee,Daekyum Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 语义消融实验常被用来证明语义知识提升预测，但本文指出这会导致误导性结论，并提出区分"内容敏感性"与"预测效用"两种评估量及相应的评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格学习中常用语义消融（修改或抑制语义知识）来论证语义知识对预测的贡献。但当模型本身从该语义知识中获益甚微时，改变语义内容仍可能造成大幅性能波动，从而被误读为"原语义知识有益"。因此需要厘清消融实验究竟在测量什么。

Method: 提出区分两个概念：内容敏感性（改变语义内容时性能的变化）与预测效用（意图语义知识相对于合理无知识参考的增益）。据此构建评估框架：按研究问题选择对照——改变内容的对照测敏感性，主张预测增益则需合适的参考基线。并对25项语义消融比较（来自9项研究）进行有界审计。

Result: 发现语义内容的改变即使模型未真正获益也能造成大性能差异；预测效用随参考基线不同而变化，当基线更易从其他输入或标注样本中恢复该知识时会下降。审计中18项明确的"预测效用"主张里，仅1项配有能清晰隔离所测语义贡献的对照。

Conclusion: 语义消融的对照选择与解释应依据其想要回答的问题；声称语义知识提升预测需使用能隔离语义贡献的合适参考，否则结论可能失效。

Abstract: Semantic knowledge is increasingly used to bridge heterogeneous schemas in tabular learning, but how much does that knowledge actually improve prediction? Studies in tabular learning commonly answer this question through semantic ablations that modify or suppress the supplied semantic knowledge. We show that these ablations can lead to misleading conclusions about predictive benefit: poor performance under altered semantics may be taken as evidence that the intended knowledge is beneficial. Across real and controlled experiments, altering semantic content can produce large performance differences even when the model gains little predictive benefit from having that semantic knowledge in the first place. To separate these effects, we distinguish two quantities: content sensitivity and predictive utility.
