Data and code are available at: https://github.com/yyddou/CoReTTA

</details>


### [1381] [Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34642)
*Sergei Kholkin,Evgeny Burnaev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM)，一种后训练方法，将预训练的Schrödinger bridge微调至奖励倾斜目标 p1^r∝p1e^r，同时保持源分布 p0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Schrödinger bridges为无配对域翻译提供熵正则化的原则性方案。但实践中预训练bridge常需按人类偏好或物理约束（即奖励）进行调整，这类似于扩散模型中的reward tilting，但在Schrödinger bridge中尚未充分探索。

Method: 将适应问题形式化为从预训练bridge P出发的交替优化，提供理论依据，并基于Adjoint Matching推导出实用算法。

Result: 在无配对图像到图像翻译任务上评估TSBM，针对MNIST的数字属性与CelebA的面部属性。

Conclusion: TSBM为Schrödinger bridge的奖励倾斜微调提供了原则性框架与可行算法，在受控属性翻译任务上得到验证。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridges provide an entropy-regularized framework and a principled solution for unpaired domain translation. In practice, a pretrained bridge may need to be adapted to human preferences or physical constraints through a reward a problem closely related to reward tilting in diffusion models but underexplored for Schrödinger bridges. We introduce Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM), a post-training method for fine-tuning a learned bridge $P$ between source $p_0$ and target $p_1$ toward a reward-tilted target $p_1^r\propto p_1e^r$, while preserving source $p_0$. We formulate this adaptation as alternating optimization initialized from $P$, provide theoretical justification, and derive a practical algorithm based on Adjoint Matching. We evaluate TSBM on unpaired image-to-image translation targeting digit properties in MNIST and facial attributes in CelebA.

</details>


### [1382] [Universal Dynamic Portfolios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34643)
*Yu-Jie Zhang,Yu-Xiang Wang,Peng Zhao,Kevin Jamieson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Cover的通用投资组合框架推广到与任意比较器序列竞争，揭示了log损失在动态遗憾下exp-concavity优势消失，提出结构感知度量与参数自由算法Universal Dynamic Portfolio，实现更快速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cover的通用投资组合仅能与最佳固定再平衡投资组合竞争。作者希望推广到与任意时变比较器序列竞争，但已有的动态遗憾方法因log损失的潜在无界梯度而失效。log损失是exp-concave的，传统上能带来静态遗憾的快速率，但本文发现该优势在动态设定中一般会消失，需要新的度量和算法来刻画和利用比较器序列的结构。

Method: 作者首先证明线性损失型√(TP_T)依赖不可避免（P_T为路径长度，度量粗糙）。为此引入两种结构感知度量：Jensen-Shannon距离刻画空间结构，JS^q-path length刻画时间结构。为同时对两种度量取得紧界，提出Universal Dynamic Portfolio——一种参数自由方法，结合新的Dirichlet Hedge算法与fixed-share更新，并在最坏情况下保持近最优P_T保证。此外在额外有界梯度假设下，提出可处理的proper算法达到T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}率，并可泛化到任意紧凸域上的在线exp-concave优化。

Result: 证明线性损失型√(TP_T)下界不可避免；在JS距离与JS^q-path length度量下，当比较器序列具有良好结构时可达更快速率；Universal Dynamic Portfolio同时对两种度量取得紧界并保持最坏情况近最优P_T；有界梯度下达到T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}动态遗憾率，且算法适用于一般在线exp-concave优化。

Conclusion: exp-concavity的快速率优势在动态遗憾中一般不成立，路径长度P_T掩盖了比较器序列的细粒度结构；通过引入空间与时间结构感知度量并设计参数自由算法，可恢复快速率并同时保持最坏情况保证，成果可推广到一般在线exp-concave优化。

Abstract: Cover's Universal Portfolio (Cover, 1991) matches the performance of the best constant rebalanced portfolio in hindsight. We generalize this framework to compete with an arbitrary comparator sequence $\mathbf{u}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{u}_T$, leading to a dynamic regret minimization problem for the log loss where existing methods break down due to potentially unbounded gradients. The log loss is exp-concave, a curvature property that classically yields fast rates for static regret, yet we show that this advantage generally disappears in the dynamic setting. In particular, a linear-loss-type $\sqrt{TP_T}$ dependence is unavoidable, where $P_T=\sum_{t=2}^T\lVert\mathbf{u}_t-\mathbf{u}_{t-1}\rVert_1$ is the standard path length. This limitation stems from the coarse nature of $P_T$, which obscures finer spatial and temporal structure of the comparator sequence. We therefore introduce two structure-aware measures---the Jensen-Shannon distance for spatial structure and the JS$^q$-path length for temporal structure---under which faster rates are attainable when the comparator sequence has favorable structure. To achieve sharp bounds for both measures simultaneously, we develop Universal Dynamic Portfolio, a parameter-free method that combines a new Dirichlet Hedge algorithm with a fixed-share update, while retaining a near-optimal $P_T$ guarantee in the worst case. Finally, under an additional bounded-gradient assumption, we show that OPS admits the faster $T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}$ dynamic regret rate over all comparator sequences. We attain this rate with a tractable proper algorithm that applies more broadly to general online exp-concave optimization over arbitrary compact convex domains.

</details>


### [1383] [Minimax Last-Iterate Convergence in Matrix Games with Observed Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34656)
*Yuheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究带赌博机反馈与观测对手动作的未知双人零和矩阵博弈的末迭代收敛，提出达到最优维度依赖的高效算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知博弈中，现有算法对动作数d的依赖过强（最优保证多出d^{3/2}因子），需要降低维度依赖并实现末迭代（每一轮t）收敛保证。

Method: 结合自适应平均与修正指数权重（corrected exponential weights）的联合设计以吸收估计方差，并用势函数（potential）论证界定各阶段时长；算法每轮仅需O(d)时间与内存。

Result: 对每玩家d个动作的博弈，算法以高概率在每一轮t同时达到\tilde{O}(√(d/t))的对偶间隙，比最优已知保证改善d^{3/2}因子，且匹配标准赌博机下界，在动作数与轮数上均为极小极大最优（至对数因子）。

Conclusion: 该算法在带赌博机反馈的零和矩阵博弈中实现了维度依赖最优、计算高效的末迭代收敛保证，理论上下界匹配。

Abstract: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum matrix games with bandit payoff feedback and observed opponent actions. For games with $d$ actions per player, we develop an algorithm achieving a duality gap of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{d/t})$ with high probability, simultaneously at every round $t$. This improves the dimension dependence of the best previously known guarantee by a factor of $d^{3/2}$. The rate matches a standard bandit lower bound, establishing minimax optimality in both the number of actions and the number of rounds, up to logarithmic factors. The algorithm is computationally efficient, requiring only $\mathcal{O}(d)$ time and memory per round. Our technical contribution is a joint design of adaptive averaging and corrected exponential weights that absorbs estimation variance, together with a potential argument that bounds phase durations.

</details>


### [1384] [FestDPO: Few-step Generator Alignment with Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34673)
*Jaewoo Lee,Kyuil Sim,Hyeongyu Kang,Kanghoon Lee,Woocheol Shin,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FestDPO将DPO扩展到少步生成模型，用非参数似然估计来自经验样本，实现无需可解似然的偏好优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步生成模型高效但样本属性难控制；DPO可基于成对偏好对齐，但少步模型是隐式的，似然不可解，导致DPO难以直接应用。

Method: 提出FestDPO，利用少步模型的快速采样能力，通过经验样本进行非参数似然估计，从而可行地近似DPO损失；该样本化公式化方法对模型族和采样过程无关。

Result: 玩具实验表明FestDPO在四种少步生成器上匹配奖励倾斜目标分布；在文本到图像生成中，胜率与人工评分优于基线；在蛋白质骨架生成中，获得更高β-折叠比例和更好结构可设计性。

Conclusion: FestDPO有效解决了少步生成模型难以直接应用DPO的问题，并在图像和蛋白质任务中验证了其有效性和通用性。

Abstract: Few-step generative models can generate high-fidelity samples within a few function evaluations. Despite this efficiency, generated samples may not exhibit desirable properties. When these properties are difficult to encode as an explicit reward function, direct preference optimization (DPO) can align generative models using pairwise preference feedback without training a separate reward model. However, extending DPO to few-step generative models is challenging because few-step generative models are generally implicit, making the likelihood evaluation required by DPO intractable. To address this challenge, we introduce Few-step DPO (FestDPO), an extension of DPO for few-step generative models that leverages nonparametric likelihood estimation from empirical samples. By exploiting the fast sampling capabilities of few-step generative models, our approach makes sample-based approximation of DPO loss computationally feasible. Furthermore, the sample-based formulation makes FestDPO agnostic to the model family and sampling procedure. Our toy experiment demonstrates that FestDPO matches the reward-tilted target distribution across four few-step generators. For real-world tasks, we evaluate FestDPO in two domains: text-to-image generation and protein backbone generation. In text-to-image generation, FestDPO outperforms preference optimization baselines in both win rates against the base models and human evaluation scores. In protein backbone generation, it achieves a higher $β$-sheet fraction and better structural designability than the baselines.

</details>


### [1385] [Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34677)
*Beomsu Kim,Chieh-Hsin Lai,Bac Nguyen,Amir Bar,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FAR框架，通过未来感知的预测监督和自适应多线索评分，学习世界模型中的情节记忆召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型预测依赖过去观测，但记忆累积后难以判断哪些记忆有用、哪些检索线索可信。基于时间、位姿或视觉相似度的固定准则在不同环境和查询下不可靠。

Method: FAR用条件对数似然衡量预测效用（用负扩散预测损失近似），训练一个推理时未来盲的检索器；检索器学习线索特定相关性，自动决定时间、位姿、视觉、音频等线索的信任度。

Result: 在三种互补设置下，FAR即使使用相同检索线索也优于手工设计召回，能自动适应信任哪些线索，并在环境变化时召回正确历史。

Conclusion: FAR为世界模型中的情节记忆访问提供了灵活且有原则的方法。

Abstract: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

</details>


### [1386] [From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34679)
*Wangxuan Fan,Xiaoyu Nie,Zhoutian Shi,Xiangcheng Meng,Shipei Zeng,Pin Gao,Yan Hu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结合LLM智能体与上下文赌博机的动态双边匹配框架，在模拟中国婚姻市场中实现优于Gale-Shapley的互惠福利与更低性别排名差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典匹配理论（如Gale-Shapley）假设偏好完整且集中计算，但现实匹配过程常是去中心化、异步、信息有限的序贯互动，需要新的建模范式。

Method: 构建动态双边匹配框架：LLM智能体基于经济逻辑评估本地接触的候选人（"我喜欢谁"），每个智能体配一个Logistic-UCB模型从真实提案结果中学习互惠接受概率（"谁可能喜欢我"），将两类决策分离，无需事先的市场整体偏好排序。

Result: LLM诱导的择偶偏好在多种LLM骨干上与经验条件logit参照一致；在50×50实验中，Bandit-UCB互惠福利最高（56.01 vs Gale-Shapley 54.87），性别排名差距更小，且LLM-ABM策略中阻塞对最少；接受模型呈现可解释的性别差异化关联，反事实实验未发现先验搜索知识带来系统性单边优势。

Conclusion: 结果表明，去中心化匹配结合LLM行为建模与在线学习（信息不完全条件下）对经济仿真与计算社会科学研究具有优势。

Abstract: Bipartite matching is a fundamental problem in game theory and market design. Classical approaches such as Gale--Shapley assume complete preferences and centralized computation, whereas many real-world matching processes are decentralized, asynchronous, and shaped by sequential interaction under limited information. We propose a dynamic bipartite matching framework that combines large language model (LLM) agents with contextual bandits. In a simulated Chinese marriage market, economically grounded LLM agents evaluate locally encountered candidates, while agent-specific Logistic-UCB models learn reciprocal acceptance from realized proposal outcomes. The mechanism therefore separates two decisions---\emph{whom do I like?} and \emph{who is likely to like me back?}---without requiring ex ante market-wide preference rankings. We first validate LLM-induced mate preferences against the empirical conditional-logit reference across multiple LLM backbones. In the $50\times50$ matching experiment, Bandit-UCB achieves the highest mean mutual welfare (56.01 versus 54.87 for Gale--Shapley), a smaller gender rank gap than the classical baselines, and the fewest blocking pairs among the LLM-ABM policies. Learned acceptance models show economically interpretable gender-differentiated associations, while counterfactual setups reveal no systematic unilateral advantage from prior search knowledge. Overall, these results support the advantages of decentralized matching with LLM-based behavioral modeling and online learning under incomplete information for economic simulation and computational social science research.

</details>


### [1387] [QuantForge: Discovering Residual Decompositions for MXFP4 Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34680)
*Qiulin Shang,Zhoutong Wu,Jie Hu,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QuantForge是一个PTQ发现系统，通过记录竞争解释、选择区分性控制实验并验证后继代码来引导LLM程序演化，发现了MXFP4量化器HiRes。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四比特后训练量化（严格MXFP4 W4A4）需协调多种设计选择，坐标变换会改变块编码误差并影响网络残差传播，因此有用的算法分解在搜索前并不完全可知，仅靠性能分数无法说明下一步应改进什么。

Method: 提出QuantForge，记录竞争性解释、选择能区分它们的控制实验、并检查后继代码是否实现所得结论；通过残差编译指导程序修订，即使原解释被否定也保留有用程序，重新测量后揭示下一个待解决误差。

Result: 发现固定MXFP4量化器HiRes（坐标整形、合法码分配细化、沿注意力与MLP路径恢复误差，各阶段作用于前阶段执行后的残差）。在七个任务上取得最低七模型Robust Fit（0.09300）和32B最低量化Fit-7；240次评估器调用的匹配预算对比中，QuantForge在8次运行中6次达到留出迁移目标，而文本记忆和反思记忆各3次，仅分数演化1次。

Conclusion: 将受控证据转化为后续程序修改，QuantForge提升了可迁移PTQ算法的发现能力。

Abstract: Four-bit post-training quantization can reduce the memory demands of large language models, but preserving accuracy under strict MXFP4 W4A4 requires coordinating several design choices. Coordinate transforms change block-encoding errors, which in turn affect the residuals propagated through the network. The useful algorithmic decomposition is therefore not fully known before search. LLM-driven program evolution offers a way to explore these choices, but performance scores alone do not explain which design should change next. We introduce QuantForge, a PTQ discovery system that records competing explanations, selects controls that distinguish them, and checks that successor code implements the resulting conclusions. This residual compilation guides program revisions while retaining useful programs even when their original explanations are rejected. Remeasuring the revised program reveals the next error to address. This process discovers HiRes, a fixed MXFP4 quantizer that shapes coordinates, refines legal code assignments, and recovers errors along attention and MLP paths. Each stage acts on residuals measured after the preceding stage has executed. Across seven tasks, HiRes achieves the lowest seven-model Robust Fit (0.09300) and the lowest quantized Fit-7 at 32B. In matched-budget comparisons of LLM-driven program evolution, each with 240 evaluator calls, QuantForge reaches a held-out transfer target in six of eight runs, compared with three each for textual memory and reflection memory, and one for score-only evolution, despite evaluating fewer new programs. These results show that QuantForge improves the discovery of transferable PTQ algorithms by turning controlled evidence into subsequent program changes.

</details>


### [1388] [SOLAR: A State-Driven Online Learning Rate Scheduler for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34681)
*Qiulin Shang,Binyu Wang,Yongqi Qiao,Songde Rao,Zhoutong Wu,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLAR：一种稳定的在线学习率调度框架，通过基础调度锚定的有界残差修正实现LLM预训练的自适应学习率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM预训练学习率调度依赖Warmup-Cosine-Decay等固定手工启发式，无法适应优化动态变化；而L2O在线学习在大规模下因噪声、延迟反馈和发散风险而不稳定。

Method: SOLAR以基础调度为参考，为各参数组学习有界的、状态相关的残差修正，每步重新锚定到基础调度；采用轻量状态表示和进度感知奖励，并用Circuit-Breaker在罕见不安全动作后恢复训练。

Result: 在60M-1B密集模型、AdamW与Muon及高达3B的两种MoE设置中，SOLAR的最终困惑度优于调优静态调度和自动LR调优器；130M对照显示基础锚定+动作边界将全局PPO控制器从27.09改善至23.74 PPL，组级控制达22.87；60M代理训练的残差策略可冻结复用至更大规模，跨4倍基础LR范围仍有效。

Conclusion: SOLAR是一种可用于LLM预训练的实用学习率控制器，兼顾在线自适应与训练稳定性。

Abstract: Learning-rate (LR) scheduling plays a central role in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet current practice still relies heavily on hand-crafted heuristics such as Warmup-Cosine-Decay and Warmup-Stable-Decay. Because these schedules are fixed in advance, they cannot adapt to evolving optimization dynamics. Online learned scheduling within the Learning to Optimize (L2O) framework offers a dynamic alternative, but remains brittle at LLM scale due to noisy signals, delayed feedback, and the risk of catastrophic divergence. We propose SOLAR (State-driven Online Learning rAte scheduleR), a stabilized framework for reliable online LR adaptation. SOLAR uses a base schedule as a reference and learns bounded, state-dependent residual corrections for individual parameter groups. Each correction re-anchors to the base at every step, allowing the policy to adapt the LR without relearning the warmup-decay profile. A lightweight state representation and progress-aware reward guide online learning, while a Circuit-Breaker restores training after rare unsafe actions. Across autoregressive language-model pretraining, SOLAR improves final perplexity over tuned static schedules and automatic LR tuners for dense models from 60M to 1B, AdamW and Muon, and two MoE settings up to 3B. Matched 130M controls show that adding base anchoring and action bounds improves a global PPO controller from 27.09 to 23.74 final PPL, while group-wise control reaches 22.87 on the same two seeds. A residual policy trained on a 60M proxy can also be frozen and reused at larger dense scales without target PPO updates, remaining effective across a fourfold base-LR range. These results establish SOLAR as a practical learned LR controller for LLM pretraining.

</details>


### [1389] [AgentPerfBench: A Benchmarking and Evaluation Suite for Inference Performance of Agentic LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34683)
*Cheuk Hang Lau,Zeyu Cao,Kevin Wong Cheuk Yin,Yao Lai,Haoran Wu,Nicholas D. Lane,Robert D. Mullins,Ilia Shumailov,Yiren Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 AgentPerfBench，一个面向 agentic 推理的基准测试套件，用真实 agent 轨迹构建多轮、工具调用、上下文增长的工作负载，揭示现有基准与实际硬件性能的差距，并通过 NCU 轨迹构建多维 roofline 模型进行瓶颈分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务引擎（如 vLLM、SGLang）优化高度依赖基准测试，但现有基准主要针对单轮聊天场景。进入 agentic 时代后，编码 agent、终端执行、工具调用等应用呈现多轮请求、上下文持续增长的特征，基准与实际工作负载产生显著不匹配；同时现有基准未考虑真实上下文增长，也未在硬件饱和状态下测量，导致无法反映真实硬件性能。

Method: 1) 基于 SWE-Bench、TerminalBench 等真实 agentic 轨迹，结合标准聊天基线，构建 AgentPerfBench；2) 从真实轨迹中采样输入长度、输出长度、轮次数的经验分布，生成可低成本、准确测量的合成负载画像；3) 采集 kernel 级 Nsight Compute (NCU) 轨迹，构建覆盖内存带宽与内存容量足迹的多维 roofline 模型；4) 提供自动化脚本，在新硬件上识别潜在瓶颈。

Result: 发现现有基准无法准确反映真实硬件性能，原因有二：未考虑现实上下文长度增长；未在硬件饱和状态下测量推理性能。通过 NCU 轨迹与多维 roofline 分析，量化了当前推理基准中的 chat-to-agentic 差距，并刻画了每个 kernel 的 GPU 资源利用率。

Conclusion: AgentPerfBench 量化了聊天与 agentic 负载之间的基准差距，并通过 roofline 分析刻画 kernel 级 GPU 资源利用，为面向 agentic 场景的 LLM 服务引擎优化与新硬件评估提供更真实、可复现的基准工具。

Abstract: The optimization of LLM serving engines, such as vLLM and SGLang, is largely benchmark-driven: optimizations, scheduling policies, hardware and system designs are all selected based on representative workloads. However, a significant mismatch has emerged in the agentic era. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on simple single-turn chatbot workloads. LLM applications are increasingly agentic: coding agents, terminal execution systems, and tool-use agents issue multi-turn requests with growing context lengths. We introduce AgentPerfBench, a benchmark suite for agentic inference. It uses real traces from agentic benchmarks, such as SWE-Bench and TerminalBench, alongside standard chat baselines. This enables benchmarking of models on multi-turn tasks involving tool calling, skill utilization, and increasing context lengths. AgentPerfBench also samples from empirical distributions of input length, output length, and turn count derived from the real traces, generating representative synthetic profiles for cheap and accurate measurements on new hardware. In addition, we further find that several existing benchmarks fail to accurately reflect real hardware performance for two key reasons: 1) they do not account for realistic context-length growth, and 2) they measure inference performance without operating at hardware saturation. We discuss these issues in detail and provide rich kernel-level Nsight Compute (NCU) traces to construct a new multi-dimensional roofline model that captures hardware-system limitations in both memory bandwidth and memory capacity footprint. The benchmarking suite then includes automated scripts to identify potential bottleneck conditions on emerging hardware when evaluated with diverse agentic traces. Together, these contributions quantify the chat-to-agentic gap in current inference benchmarks and characterise per-kernel GPU resource utilisation via roofline analysis.

</details>


### [1390] [Predicting Delayed Train Trajectories on the Dutch Railway Network: Explainable AI Evaluation of Topological, Operational and Weather Features with Tree Based Ensemble Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34692)
*Jia Long Bao,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对荷兰铁路网络延误预测进行可解释的时间稳健性分析，发现丰富特征的可解释树模型仅能提升同期预测，跨月预测会系统性退化，根源在于环境特征波动与目标定义不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多追求用不透明的深度学习模型最大化绝对精度，却忽视了驱动纵向预测能力衰减的数据机制，因此需要可解释的时间稳健性研究。

Method: 以荷兰铁路网为对象，使用可解释的树集成模型，整合拓扑、环境与运营等多粒度特征，并结合多时间跨度的SHAP分析与离散度分析。

Result: 特征丰富的树模型能改善同期（月内）预测，但在非同期（未来月份）评估时性能系统性下降；该退化与环境特征的波动性及统计目标定义的不稳定性直接相关。

Conclusion: 仅靠更丰富的特征集无法解决长期预测约束，需转向以绝对运营边界为锚点的动态、季节感知架构。

Abstract: The reliable prediction of passenger train delays is a critical component of railway management. While contemporary research frequently attempts to maximize absolute accuracy by deploying opaque deep learning architectures, the underlying data mechanics driving longitudinal predictive decay remain underexplored. Consequently, this study provides an explainable temporal robustness analysis of network-wide railway delay prediction. Focusing on the Dutch railway network, this research utilizes interpretable tree-based ensembles to integrate granular topological, environmental, and operational features. The overarching finding establishes that while feature-rich tree-based models improve simultaneous (within-month) prediction, predictive performance systematically degrades when evaluated across non-simultaneous (future) months. Furthermore, multi-horizon SHAP and dispersion analyses explicitly link this degradation to environmental feature volatility and instability within the statistical target definition. Ultimately, this thesis demonstrates that richer feature sets alone are insufficient to resolve long-term forecasting constraints, underscoring the necessity to transition toward dynamic, season-aware architectures anchored by absolute operational boundaries.

</details>


### [1391] [Learning Propagation Geometry from Message-Passing Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34711)
*Yingxu Wang,Kunyu Zhang,Xinwang Liu,Mengzhu Wang,Siyang Gao,Chang Tang,Nan Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoF是一个循环框架，通过消息传递反馈联合演化节点特征与传播几何，学习局部对称正定几何以改进邻域权重的自适应计算，在节点分类、链接预测和图分类任务上超越现有GNN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统GNN从聚合表示中估计几何，容易忽略单个消息之间的差异以及特征维度间的依赖关系，导致邻域信息的比较与整合不够精细。

Method: 每个节点维护一个局部对称正定几何，由结构感知原型图集初始化并以块对数三角坐标参数化。每步中几何决定邻域权重，三角标架传输将变换后的源消息映射到目标节点局部坐标后再聚合。对齐消息与变换目标状态残差的加权二阶统计量捕捉方向变化和块内依赖，生成几何更新目标；共享控制器通过任务监督学习补充修正，有界对数三角更新融合修正、目标与上一几何状态并保持正定性，形成闭环反馈。

Result: 在基准数据集上，GeoF持续优于最先进的GNN基线；参数在循环步骤间共享，任务特定读出支持节点分类、链接预测和图分类。

Conclusion: 通过循环联合演化节点特征与传播几何，GeoF有效利用了消息级差异和特征维度依赖，提升了GNN的几何自适应能力，并在多种图任务上取得一致优势。

Abstract: Learning local geometry enables graph neural networks (GNNs) to adapt how they compare and integrate neighborhood information. However, estimating geometry from aggregated representations can overlook variation among individual messages and dependencies across feature dimensions. We propose GeoF, a recurrent framework that jointly evolves node features and propagation geometry through message-passing feedback. Each node maintains a local symmetric positive-definite geometry, initialized from a structure-aware prototype atlas and parameterized in block log-triangular coordinates. At each step, the geometry determines neighborhood weights, while triangular frame transport maps transformed source messages into the target node's local coordinates before aggregation. Weighted second-order statistics of residuals between aligned messages and the transformed target state capture directional variation and within-block dependencies, yielding a geometric update target. A shared controller learns complementary corrections through task supervision. A bounded log-triangular update combines these corrections, the target, and the previous geometric state while preserving positive definiteness. The geometry governs subsequent propagation, closing the feedback loop. With parameters shared across recurrent steps, task-specific readouts support node classification, link prediction, and graph classification. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that GeoF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GNN baselines.

</details>


### [1392] [Edge-Level Automorphism in GNNs: A Quantitative Framework and Effective Designs For Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34729)
*Chen Shao,Donald Loveland,Tobias Käfer,Danai Koutra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出边自同构比(EAR)量化GNN链接预测表达能力，并设计EO-GNN架构解决自同构塌缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GNN会将自同构节点（结构角色相同的节点）塌缩为不可区分表示，限制表达能力并降低链接预测性能。现有基于Weisfeiler-Lehman的分析多为定性方法，常与实验结果不符。

Method: 首先通过边轨道形式化边级自同构，引入边自同构比(EAR)这一标量指标量化GNN区分链接的能力。基于此设计EO-GNN，通过(1)自同构感知dropout和(2)子图轨道偏置聚合，结合WL节点哈希，在保持等变性的同时以最小计算开销解决自同构塌缩。

Result: EAR与性能强相关；在合成图和真实图高自同构场景下，链接预测性能分别提升高达42.36%和28.44%。

Conclusion: EAR为GNN链接预测表达能力提供了定量评估工具，EO-GNN有效缓解自同构塌缩问题，兼顾等变性与计算效率。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for learning node and link embeddings through permutation-equivariant aggregation. However, standard GNNs collapse automorphic nodes, i.e., those with identical structural roles (or orbits) into indistinguishable representations, leading to the node automorphism problem. This collapse limits their expressive power and degrades link prediction performance. Existing approaches to characterize GNN expressiveness rely primarily on Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) analyses, but these methods are typically qualitative and often misaligned with empirical results. To address this gap, we begin by introducing a novel quantitative framework to assess GNN expressiveness for link prediction. We first formalize edge-level automorphism through edge orbits, which capture the set of structural role pairs for nodes that share a link. Then, we introduce the edge automorphism ratio (EAR), a scalar metric that quantifies a GNN's ability to distinguish links in a given graph. We empirically demonstrate that EAR correlates strongly with performance, validating its practical benefit. Building on this insight, we design EDGE-ORBIT EQUIVARIANT GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK (EO-GNN), a GNN architecture that addresses automorphism collapse while preserving equivariance and incurring minimal computational overhead. EO-GNN accomplishes this through two core designs combined with WL-based node hashes: (i) automorphism-aware dropouts and (ii) subgraph orbit-biased aggregation. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real graphs show improvements of up to 42.36% and 28.44%, respectively, in predicting links in scenarios with high automorphism.

</details>


### [1393] [Predictive Dual Smoothing for Column Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34740)
*Senne Berden,Noah Schutte,Andrea Lodi,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预测式对偶平滑(predictive dual smoothing),用学习到的未来对偶预测引导列生成定价子问题,大幅减少生成列数与运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模线性规划的列生成中,对偶解的震荡会显著拖慢收敛。现有对偶稳定化方法(如对偶平滑)用历史对偶来稳定轨迹,但历史对偶未必能引导定价找到对未来迭代真正有用的新变量。

Method: 提出预测式对偶平滑:将当前对偶解与对偶的未来预测相结合来引导定价。预测器离线训练,监督信号来自标准列生成轨迹。预测仅用于修改定价子问题的目标函数,同时用精确的reduced-cost检查与基于未平滑对偶的回退定价保证正确性。

Result: 在cutting stock与广义分配问题上,相比标准列生成及已有经典和学习的稳定化方法,显著减少了生成列数与wall-clock时间;增益可扩展到分布外的实例规模,且与强经典稳定化方法结合时进一步提升。

Conclusion: 面向未来对偶的预测式平滑优于面向历史对偶的传统平滑,能有效加速列生成,并可与经典方法互补使用。

Abstract: Solving large-scale linear programs efficiently is an important challenge in many optimization settings. A key technique is column generation, which alternates between solving the master problem over a restricted subset of the variables, and using a pricing subproblem to identify new variables to add. The pricing subproblem is guided by the dual solution of the current restricted master problem, but oscillations in these dual solutions can substantially slow convergence. Dual stabilization methods address this issue. Dual smoothing is a common stabilization method, which guides the pricing subproblem using a combination of the current dual solution and duals from previous iterations. However, while past dual solutions can stabilize the dual trajectory, they do not necessarily guide pricing towards useful new variables. We therefore introduce predictive dual smoothing, which instead combines the current dual solution with a learned prediction of future duals to steer pricing towards variables that are more useful in subsequent iterations. The predictor is trained offline using supervision extracted from standard column generation trajectories and is used only to modify the pricing subproblem's objective function, while exact reduced-cost checks and fallback pricing with the unsmoothed duals preserve correctness. Experiments on cutting stock and generalized assignment problems show that predictive dual smoothing substantially reduces generated columns and wall-clock time relative to standard column generation and existing classical and learned stabilization methods. These gains extend to out-of-distribution instance sizes, and predictive smoothing provides further improvements when combined with strong classical stabilization.

</details>


### [1394] [No Pain, More Gain: Iterative Merging for Effective Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34745)
*Seonghyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Noah Lee,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究多教师在线蒸馏(MOPD)中初始化对蒸馏效果的影响，并提出迭代合并方法IM-MOPD，在蒸馏过程中逐步调整教师贡献以提升恢复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD将多个共享参考模型但经过不同后训练的领域教师蒸馏到单个学生中，但研究发现学生初始化会显著影响教师能力的恢复，且初始基准性能并不能可靠预测好的MOPD初始化；有效合并既依赖相对教师贡献又依赖整体合并尺度，难以通过一次性系数搜索找到。

Method: 提出Iterative Merging for MOPD (IM-MOPD)：从均匀合并初始化出发，在蒸馏过程中针对恢复不足的领域逐步加入任务向量增量(task-vector increments)，从而在训练中动态determine有效的教师贡献。

Result: 在5领域设置中，IM-MOPD相比使用均匀合并初始化或SFT warm-up的MOPD取得了更高的平均归一化恢复率。

Conclusion: 有效的教师贡献可以在训练过程中逐步确定，因此选择合并初始化时不仅要评估其即时性能，还要考虑其在MOPD下所促成的学习能力。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) combines independently developed domain teachers into a single student by distilling their predictions on student-generated samples. We study a setting where teachers share a reference model but undergo different post-training procedures, and find that MOPD can struggle to recover some teacher capabilities. Because distillation occurs on student-generated prefixes, the student initialization can strongly affect subsequent recovery. However, initial benchmark performance is not a reliable predictor of a good MOPD initialization. For example, merge initialization can start below SFT warm-up yet finish higher after MOPD. We further find that effective merging depends on both the relative teacher contributions and the overall merge scale, with some strong configurations lying outside the simplex of convex parameter averaging. Thus, selecting a good merge initialization requires evaluating not only its immediate performance but also the learning it enables under MOPD, making one-shot coefficient search difficult. We propose Iterative Merging for MOPD (IM-MOPD), which starts from a uniform merge and progressively adds task-vector increments for under-recovered domains during distillation. In a 5-domain setting, IM-MOPD achieves higher average normalized recovery than MOPD with either uniform merge initialization or SFT warm-up, showing that effective teacher contributions can be determined progressively during training.

</details>


### [1395] [A Unifying Framework of Concept-based Explainable AI with Completeness Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34750)
*Vojtěch Kůr,Adam Kukučka,Tomáš Brázdil,Vít Musil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一理论框架，用概念自编码器视角分析基于概念的解释方法，并给出模型完整性与归因完整性的界限保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于概念的解释方法在概念定义、表示及与预测连接方式上各不相同，缺乏统一的数学语言，难以对其性质进行共同分析。

Method: 引入统一理论框架：对潜在空间中的概念发现问题采用概念自编码器视角，编码器从模型潜在空间提取概念表示，解码器据此重构原始潜在表示，并以重构误差度量准确性。

Result: 证明概念导致的模型不完整性可由自编码器重构误差界定；该视角还统一了单个概念归因的定义，明确了归因何时与模型预测求和一致，并在不一致时给出差异界限，从而提供归因完整性的保证。

Conclusion: 该框架为概念解释方法提供统一数学语言，并通过重构误差建立模型完整性与归因完整性的理论界限。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations describe neural network predictions through human-understandable properties of inputs called concepts. The field encompasses approaches that differ in how they define and represent concepts and connect them to model predictions. We introduce a theoretical framework that describes these approaches in a common mathematical language and supports a shared analysis of their properties. For concept discovery, which identifies concepts automatically within a latent space of a trained model, we employ a concept autoencoder view. An encoder extracts concept representations from the model's latent space, and a decoder uses them to reconstruct the original latent representation. The autoencoder's reconstruction error measures how accurately its decoder recovers the original latent representation. We revisit model completeness: how well the concepts can reproduce the model's outputs. We show that model incompleteness of the concepts can be bounded by the autoencoder's reconstruction error. The autoencoder view also provides a common way to define individual concept attributions, which measure each concept's contribution to a prediction. We establish when these attributions sum to the model's prediction, and bound the discrepancy otherwise, thus providing attribution completeness guarantees.

</details>


### [1396] [Instance-Adaptive Prompts as Context for Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34786)
*Zehao Xiao,Shifeng Xie,Lei Zan,Jianfeng Zhang,Lujia Pan,Ievgen Redko,Malik Tiomoko,Keli Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PaCTS，用少量实例自适应潜在提示token替代长历史上下文，为冻结的时序基础模型高效提供上下文信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更长历史能提升时序基础模型（TSFM）性能，但推理成本大幅增加。作者探索能否用一组紧凑的学习型token嵌入更高效地提供上下文信息。

Method: PaCTS基于可见上下文生成少量实例自适应的连续嵌入token作为潜在提示，充当冻结TSFM的紧凑上下文替代。提示由实例级全局统计构造，并用分段级时序信息细化，兼顾全局特性与局部时序变化。提示模块与冻结骨干在异构时序上联合训练部署。

Result: 实验证明提示作为上下文有效，在不同上下文长度和模型架构下持续提升预测性能。更短输入上下文下PaCTS可超越使用双倍上下文的同一冻结骨干，且推理计算大幅减少。相比权重空间适配方法，PaCTS提升更强、分布外泛化更好。

Conclusion: 紧凑的实例自适应潜在提示可作为长历史的有效替代，为冻结TSFM高效提供上下文，在性能、推理成本与泛化性上均具优势。

Abstract: Longer histories can improve time-series foundation models (TSFMs), but require substantially higher inference cost. We therefore ask whether contextual information can be provided more efficiently through a compact set of learned token embeddings. We introduce PaCTS, which generates a small set of instance-adaptive latent prompts in the form of continuous embedding tokens conditioned on the visible context. These prompts serve as compact context surrogates for frozen TSFMs. PaCTS constructs them from instance-specific global statistics and further refines them with segment-level temporal information, capturing both global characteristics and local temporal variations. The prompt module is jointly trained and deployed across heterogeneous time series with the frozen backbone. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of prompts as context, consistently improving forecasting across context lengths and model architectures. With a shorter input context, PaCTS can outperform the same frozen backbone using double context while requiring substantially less inference computation. Compared with weight-space adaptation methods, PaCTS achieves stronger improvements and better out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [1397] [Separating personal from population gains when calibrating EEG foundation models for new users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34801)
*Xilin Tao,Kani Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三个冻结EEG基础模型（CBraMod、REVE、LaBraM）在235名受试者上的个性化适配效果，发现个性化增益真实存在（1.5–5.4个百分点），但随群体训练预算增加而缩小，且廉价校准方式并不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型日益针对个体用户适配，但表面上的"个性化增益"可能仅仅反映了一个更强的群体模型。在脑机接口场景中，每个新用户都需校准，因此必须厘清个性化增益是真正来自个体适配，还是群体模型本身的能力提升。

Method: 评估三个冻结EEG基础模型（CBraMod、REVE、LaBraM）在三个运动想象数据集的235名留出受试者上的个性化适配。将每个受试者的适配器与群体模型、以及其他受试者拟合的适配器（交换适配器）进行对比；使用全部前半段会话标签；并考察群体训练预算（4倍预算）与廉价校准方式（少标签校准、无标签上下文、元学习初始化）的影响。

Result: 使用全部前半段标签时，个人适配器在全部九种模型-数据集组合中均优于群体模型（平均平衡准确率提升1.5–5.4个百分点），并优于交换适配器（2.3–7.3个百分点）。当群体训练预算增至4倍时，各模型中位增益仍为正（1.0–2.0个百分点）但均变小，且无群体模型达到确认的平台期。廉价获取增益不可靠：少标签校准仅在一个数据集上持续非负；CBraMod中无标签上下文与元学习初始化均未优于匹配对照。

Conclusion: 个性化应同时对照群体参考和交换参数两种基线，并在多种群体训练预算下进行评估，才能确认增益的可靠性。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly adapted to individual users, but an apparent personalization gain can simply reflect a stronger population model. This distinction matters for brain-computer interfaces, where every new user must be calibrated. We evaluated personal adaptation of three frozen EEG foundation models (CBraMod, REVE and LaBraM) in 235 held-out subjects from three motor-imagery datasets, comparing each subject's adapter with the population model and with adapters fitted to other subjects. Using all first-half session labels, personal adapters improved mean balanced accuracy over the population model by 1.5-5.4 percentage points and outperformed exchanged adapters by 2.3-7.3 points in all nine model-dataset combinations. The size of this benefit depended on population training: with four times the original budget, median gains remained positive (1.0-2.0 points) but were smaller for every model, and no population model reached a confirmed plateau. Acquiring the benefit cheaply was unreliable: few-label calibration was consistently non-negative on only one dataset, and in CBraMod neither unlabeled context nor meta-learned initialization outperformed matched controls. Personalization should therefore be evaluated against both a population reference and exchanged parameters, across population-training budgets.

</details>


### [1398] [Polylogarithmic Nash Regret in Matrix Games with Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34812)
*Yuheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带bandit反馈和可观测对手动作的未知有限矩阵博弈中的Nash regret最小化，提出OPB算法实现实例依赖的O(log²T) Nash regret，解决了Maiti等人（2025）的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Maiti等人（2025）仅在2×2博弈中给出bandit反馈下的polylogarithmic Nash regret保证，如何将其扩展到任意有限维度、并处理非唯一均衡，是待解决的开放问题。

Method: 提出Optimistic Payoff Balancing (OPB)算法：构造一个为局部调整留出空间的参考策略；将独立的收益差按估计精度排序，并用不确定性缩放调整幅度，使学习器利用对手的不平衡来抵消估计成本。

Result: OPB对任意自适应对手（包括非唯一均衡的博弈）实现实例依赖的O(log²T) Nash regret，将polylogarithmic保证从2×2博弈扩展到任意有限维度。

Conclusion: 在一般有限矩阵博弈中，仅观测对手动作即可实现polylogarithmic Nash regret。

Abstract: We study Nash regret minimization in unknown finite matrix games with bandit payoff feedback and observed opponent actions. We develop Optimistic Payoff Balancing (OPB), which achieves instance-dependent $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 T)$ Nash regret against arbitrary adaptive opponents, including games with nonunique equilibria. This resolves the open problem posed by Maiti et al. (2025), extending their polylogarithmic guarantee under bandit feedback from $2\times2$ games to arbitrary finite dimensions. To handle nonunique equilibria, we construct a reference strategy that leaves room for local adjustments. We order independent payoff differences by estimation accuracy and scale these adjustments by uncertainty, allowing the learner to exploit the opponent's imbalance to offset estimation costs. Our result thus shows that observing opponent actions suffices for polylogarithmic Nash regret in general finite matrix games.

</details>


### [1399] [Gaussian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34825)
*Peter Kuhn,Victoria Heusinger-Heß*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高斯神经网络(GaNN)，通过在激活空间施加高斯先验实现新型正则化，提升分类与回归性能并具备不确定性量化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统正则化多从贝叶斯角度视为对权重空间施加先验，而对激活空间施加先验的可能性基本未被探索。作者希望填补这一空白。

Method: GaNN将前层激活视为含高斯噪声的信号，通过额外无监督损失预测噪声分布性质。训练时该损失对"意外"激活施加惩罚，从而允许权重在非意外方向上进行更大更新。

Result: 在多种分类与回归任务上，GaNN优于标准神经网络；同时具备量化不确定性的能力。

Conclusion: 激活空间先验是一种有效的正则化机制，GaNN可作为标准网络的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Gaussian neural networks (GaNNs) are proposed as a novel regularization mechanism for neural networks. From a Bayesian perspective standard regularization techniques can be viewed as imposing priors over weight-space. Assuming priors over activation-space remains a largely unexplored possibility. GaNNs assume such priors. They do this by treating activities from earlier layers like signals with Gaussian noise and predicting the properties of the noise distribution using an additional unsupervised loss. While training, the unsupervised loss acts as a penalty on unexpected activities, allowing greater weight updates in less surprising directions. The paper demonstrates the superiority of Gaussian neural networks over standard neural networks on a variety of classification and regression tasks. We also investigate the ability of GaNNs to quantify uncertainty.

</details>


### [1400] [Structured Neural SDEs for Functional Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34831)
*Francesco Piatti,Andrea Iannucci,Thomas Cass*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SLiSDE 系列神经 SDE 模型，用结构化线性随机层实现层级别的时间并行模拟，通过门控流场堆叠恢复表达能力，并引入 Girsanov 倾斜做重要性采样，兼顾效率、稳定性与理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用神经 SDE 的漂移与扩散网络在长时段模拟上代价高，且当训练信号为路径泛函而非逐点观测时梯度不稳定。作者希望在保留连续时间生成建模能力的同时，提升模拟效率与训练稳定性。

Method: 构建由结构化线性随机层组成的 SLiSDE 模型：层级别可时间并行模拟；通过门控流场堆叠（用前层路径调制下一层隐流）恢复表达力。针对稀有路径主导损失的功能性校准任务，加入可选的 Girsanov 倾斜，作为带精确似然比修正的学习式重要性采样器。

Result: 理论层面证明了适定性、离散化误差界、测度变换有效性，以及门控堆叠终端分布可在平方可积分布空间中稠密的普适性结果。实验上，在功能校准基准中结构化模型优于全神经 SDE 基线，并保持时间并行模拟与稳定的重要性权重。

Conclusion: SLiSDE 在效率、表达能力与理论保证之间取得平衡，验证了结构化线性层加门控堆叠与 Girsanov 倾斜组合的有效性，为长时段路径泛函校准任务提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Neural Stochastic Differential Equations (Neural SDEs) provide flexible continuous-time generative models, but generic neural drift and diffusion networks are costly to simulate on long horizons and can give unstable gradients when the training signal is a path functional rather than a pointwise observation. We introduce SLiSDE, a family of Neural SDE models built from structured linear stochastic layers. Parallel-in-time simulation is obtained at the layer level, while expressivity is recovered by gated in-flow stacking: previous-layer paths modulate the next layer's latent flow through learned gates. For functional calibration tasks in which rare paths dominate the loss, we add an optional Girsanov tilt that acts as a learned importance sampler with an exact likelihood-ratio correction. We prove well-posedness, a discretisation error bound, validity of the change of measure, and a universality result: the terminal laws of the gated stack are dense in the space of square-integrable laws. Experiments on functional calibration benchmarks show that the structured model outperforms fully neural SDE baselines while retaining parallel-time simulation and stable importance weights.

</details>


### [1401] [QiYao-M: Multimodal Time Series Foundation Model with Role-Aware Modeling of Endogenous and Exogenous Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34842)
*Hanyin Cheng,Linfeng Wang,Zhengbo Qu,Yang Shu,Zhongwen Rao,Meng Wang,Yijie Li,Xin Jiang,Bin Yang,Chenjuan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QiYao-M，一种角色感知的多模态时间序列基础模型，区分内生与外生模态分别建模，在多模态与单模态基准上取得强预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态时间序列基础模型通常用共享机制建模异构模态，忽视了内生模态与外生模态在预测中的不同角色。

Method: 对内生模态，引入Endo-Multimodal Predictor与Endo-Multimodal Supervision，从历史到未来显式学习其演化；对外生模态，提出Exo-Multimodal Retrieval Enhancer，实现无需更新TSFM参数的快速下游适配；并提出Endo-Modality Proxy Training，在无外生多模态预训练数据下训练检索模块。

Result: 在单模态与多模态基准的大量实验中，在有/无外生模态两类场景下均展现强预测性能。

Conclusion: 角色感知地分离建模内外生模态，是提升多模态时间序列基础模型预测能力的有效途径。

Abstract: Existing multimodal time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically model heterogeneous modalities through largely shared mechanisms, overlooking the distinct forecasting roles of endogenous and exogenous modalities. In this work, we propose QiYao-M, a role-aware multimodal TSFM that models the two types of modalities separately. For endogenous modalities, to capture how they evolve along with the underlying temporal dynamics, we introduce an Endo-Multimodal Predictor and Endo-Multimodal Supervision to explicitly learn their evolution from history to the future. For exogenous modalities, to generalize across domains and across various modality types and numbers under the scarcity of exo-multimodal pretraining data, we propose an Exo-Multimodal Retrieval Enhancer that enables rapid downstream adaptation without updating the TSFM parameters. We further introduce Endo-Modality Proxy Training to train this retrieval module without exogenous multimodal pretraining data. Extensive experiments across unimodal and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate strong forecasting performance in scenarios both with and without exogenous modalities.

</details>


### [1402] [Context-dependent time-series prediction via HyperReservoirs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34847)
*Kohei Tsuchiyama,Takatomo Mihana,Ryoichi Horisaki,André Röhm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出HyperReservoir模型，通过主储层与小上下文储层结合，提升多动力学机制时间序列预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当训练与测试时间序列包含多个动力学机制（如底层参数变化或多个不同系统）时，传统储层计算预测误差较高。

Method: HyperReservoir结合主储层与较小的上下文储层，后者调节前者的输出权重，类似超网络但保留线性回归的简单训练。对比ESN和full-matrix Conceptor。

Result: 在Lorenz和Rössler系统的时间序列预测任务（包括不同分岔参数和时间采样尺度）中，HyperReservoir取得最低平均测试误差，尤其在相同吸引子但不同时间尺度数据上优于Conceptor。

Conclusion: HyperReservoir是处理多动力学机制时间序列预测的有效扩展，兼具高性能与简单训练优势。

Abstract: Time series prediction is a common application of reservoir computing. When the training and testing time series data contains multiple dynamical regimes, because an underlying parameter is changing, or the data in fact consists of multiple distinct systems, simple application of the reservoir computing principle produces high prediction errors. Here, we propose a HyperReservoir as an extended model of reservoir computing especially designed for such cases. The HyperReservoir combines a main reservoir with a smaller context reservoir, where the latter modulates the output weights of the former. This structure resembles the hypernetworks from deep neural network literature. However, in contrast, HyperReservoirs retain the simple training via linear regression of standard reservoir computing. We compare the proposed architecture with a conventional ESN, in which context acts at the input, and a full-matrix Conceptor, in which context modulates the reservoir state space. We evaluate all three models on time-series prediction tasks based on Lorenz and Rössler systems, including for varying bifurcation parameters and time sampling scales. We find that the HyperReservoir achieves the lowest mean test error in all three tasks, and particularly outperforms conceptors on data that is sampled from the same attractor but at different time scales.

</details>


### [1403] [When Sparse Reward Meets Dense Distillation: Training Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34849)
*Xinke Jiang,Tao Feng,Zhibang Yang,Zhixin Zhang,Weixuan Xu,Haoyu Zhang,Xu Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过NTK分析揭示混合奖励-蒸馏训练的不稳定性，提出交叉信号NTK指标K_DR(n)识别"幅度淹没"与"局部方向冲突"两种失效模式，并提出M3方法族(幅度归一化+三种策略)缓解训练崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习+可验证奖励仅提供稀疏的二值序列级信号，所有token共享相同优势；加入带标量权重的教师KL项虽提供密集token级指导，但两信号交互可能在联合优化中导致训练不稳定，其内在机理尚不清楚。

Method: 将混合奖励-蒸馏训练的学习动态用神经正切核(NTK)分析；引入交叉信号NTK K_DR(n)，度量位置n处奖励梯度与蒸馏梯度的对齐程度；分析优化区间对失效严重度的影响(梯度范数比κ)。

Result: 识别两种失效模式：1)幅度淹没，奖励梯度量级远超蒸馏梯度，即使弱方向冲突也致蒸馏损失上升；2)局部方向冲突，序列级优势与教师位置分布在同一token上产生相反更新(K_DR(n)<0)。κ在不同任务间变化约一个数量级，实验发现超过某阈值后朴素混合会持续训练崩溃。

Conclusion: 基于以上发现提出M3方法族，结合幅度归一化与三种策略来缓解联合训练的不稳定性(具体策略在摘要中被截断)。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides a sparse post-training signal: a single binary outcome evaluates the entire rollout, and every token receives the same sequence-level advantage regardless of its individual contribution. To complement this sparse supervision, a growing family of methods adds a scalar-weighted teacher KL term to the policy-gradient objective, providing dense token-level guidance that may be unreliable at some positions. Despite the benefits of combining these signals, their interaction during optimization can destabilize joint training. To understand how this instability develops, we study the learning dynamics of hybrid reward--distillation training through a neural tangent kernel (NTK) analysis. We introduce the cross-signal NTK $K_{DR}(n)$, a token-level statistic that measures the alignment between reward and distillation gradients at position n. Through this analysis, we identify two failure modes: 1 Magnitude drowning, where the reward gradient exceeds the distillation gradient by orders of magnitude, so that even weak directional conflict can cause the distillation loss to rise despite its explicit inclusion in the training objective; and 2 Localized directional conflict, where the sequence-level advantage and the teacher's position-specific distribution induce opposing updates at the same token ($K_{DR}(n)\!<\!0$). The severity of these effects depends on the optimization regime: the gradient-norm ratio $κ\!=\!\|\nabla\mathcal{L}_R\|/\|\nabla\mathcal{L}_D\|$ varies by roughly an order of magnitude across tasks, and our experiments reveal an empirical threshold beyond which naive mixing can lead to persistent training collapse. Motivated by these findings, we introduce the M3 family, which combines magnitude normalization with three strategies...

</details>


### [1404] [Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34851)
*Nam Hee Kim,Markus Kirjonen,Perttu Hämäläinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SCOOT算法，针对高风险高精度运动控制（以台球为例），在AWR基础上用精英采样、混合专家策略和距离正则化+课程学习三项改进，学习高精度击球并发现多种策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRL通常用于动作可被后续修正的序列决策任务，允许噪声动作仍获高回报。但高风险高精度控制中动作结果不可逆，奖励景观存在尖锐峰值和山脊，现有方法研究不足。

Method: 基于advantage-weighted regression (AWR)，做三点改进：1) 仅用精英样本进行策略优化，捕捉稀有高奖励动作样本；2) 采用混合专家(MoE)策略，随状态在奖励景观模式间切换；3) 加入距离正则化项和学习课程，先探索多样策略再适应最优样本。

Result: 在物理仿真台球击球任务中有效学习到高动作精度，并能针对给定球型发现多种击球策略。

Conclusion: SCOOT适用于不可逆、高精度运动控制问题，三项改进能提升对稀疏高奖励样本的学习与多策略发现能力。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.

</details>


### [1405] [Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34860)
*Lukas Koch Vindbjerg,Qi Zhang,Yury Brodskiy,Lukas Esterle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AH-VIB，一种结合变分信息瓶颈与自回归消息生成的注意力通信模型，在消息前缀截断场景下提升多智能体通信的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带宽受限下的多智能体通信不仅需决定"通信什么"，还需组织消息结构，使部分传输（如前缀）仍有用；此前方法未充分应对前缀截断导致的性能骤降。

Method: AH-VIB：注意力机制 + 自回归变分通信模型，融合变分信息瓶颈（VIB）、顺序消息生成与分层鲁棒性损失，使早期消息片段包含关键信息。

Result: 在自定义协同物体巡检与占据栅格建图任务（有限视域传感器、变/固定带宽）中，与MADDPG、CommNet、扁平VIB基线及自回归MLP消融对比，AH-VIB取得具竞争力的平均回报，并在最受限带宽下显著提升性能可靠性。

Conclusion: AH-VIB提升了带宽约束下学习型通信的可靠性与优雅退化能力（graceful degradation）。

Abstract: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB on a custom cooperative object-inspection and occupancy-mapping task, where agents equipped with a limited field-of-view sensor coordinate to scan inspection objects in an occupancy-grid world, under variable and fixed bandwidth conditions, and compare it against MADDPG, CommNet, a flat VIB baseline, and an autoregressive MLP ablation. AH-VIB achieves competitive mean return while improving performance reliability under the most constrained bandwidth conditions.
  These results indicate that AH-VIB improves the reliability and graceful degradation of learned communication under bandwidth constraints.

</details>


### [1406] [From Attention Sensitivity to Layer Role: Revisiting Mixed-Precision Quantization of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34866)
*Nafiseh HosseinpourFardi,Negar Alihadi,Mahmoudreza Babaei,Milad Hosseini,Adrian Weller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出JAB：用注意力块整体Q/K/V的联合损失替代逐矩阵拟合，先在Mistral-7B注意力量化上验证有效，但MLP进入分配后失效；进而发现角色感知的偏移规则更优，且块级重建并非端到端困惑度的可靠代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练量化逐矩阵拟合预训练权重，这一代理是否反映注意力块的真实计算、以及Q/K/V误差在softmax中的累积，鲜有检验。作者希望直接在注意力输出上定义目标，并覆盖三个投影。

Method: JAB在块的联合Q/K/V权重上定义单一标量损失，针对真实因果掩码注意力输出，用于两处：拟合量化权重（GPTQ热启动，随后STE与可学习scale），以及为多选背包分配打分。另提出无需敏感度估计的角色感知偏移规则。

Result: Mistral-7B纯注意力量化：3比特下JAB恢复均匀GPTQ与全精度间77-90%的差距，敏感度估计与73次前向的oracle误差不到一个点。加入MLP后失效：角色感知偏移规则在GPT-2 MLP和完整Mistral-7B上均优于JAB，3比特下限时96.4%权重为4.5比特/参数，困惑度6.933，压缩3.56倍，距全精度(6.643)4.4%，同预算JAB为7.158。

Conclusion: 权重所在矩阵的角色比任何敏感度估计更重要；块级重建与端到端困惑度脱节（某次块目标改善4.6倍而困惑度涨32倍），故所有分配均需端到端验证；后训练量化似乎恢复的是注意力行为而非权重。

Abstract: Most post-training quantization pipelines fit each weight matrix to its pretrained counterpart, one matrix at a time. Whether that proxy tracks what an attention block actually computes, or how errors in the Q, K and V projections compound inside the softmax, is rarely checked. We write the objective on the attention output instead, over all three projections at once, and reuse it throughout the pipeline. JAB defines one scalar loss over the joint Q, K, V weights of a block, evaluated against the block's real causally-masked attention output, and uses it twice: to fit the quantized weights (GPTQ warm start, then STE with learnable scales), and to score the block for a multiple-choice knapsack allocation.
  On attention-only quantization of Mistral-7B this works. At 3 bits JAB recovers 77-90% of the gap between uniform GPTQ and full precision, and its sensitivity estimate tracks an oracle costing 73 forward passes to within a fraction of a point. It stops working once MLP layers enter the allocation. A role-aware offset rule needing no sensitivity estimate at all beats JAB on GPT-2's MLP and on the full Mistral-7B model: with a 3-bit floor it quantizes 96.4% of the weights to 4.5 bits per parameter at 6.933 perplexity, within 4.4% of full precision (6.643) at 3.56x compression, against 7.158 for JAB at the same budget. Which matrix a weight sits in matters more than any sensitivity estimate we computed.
  Two things came out sideways. Block-local reconstruction is an unreliable proxy for end-to-end perplexity: one run improved a block's own objective 4.6x while perplexity rose 32x, which is why every allocation here is validated end-to-end. And on attention-only quantization, fine-tuning moved weights farther from their pretrained values while pulling attention outputs closer, with net gains. Post-training seems to recover attention behavior, not weights.

</details>


### [1407] [Reference-Tail Trust:Certified Probability Floors for Learned Updates Inside a Deployed Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34904)
*Abdolvahab Khalili Sadaghiani,Jose Nunez-Yanez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Reference-Tail Trust (RTT) 框架，在冻结的 GNN 内部进行受约束的学习式更新，并认证实际服务的预测。RTT 通过约束内部优化器、轨迹验证管和独立检查器，保证逐节点的概率下界和调用级预算；失败则回退到原模型。理论上推导了概率下界前沿及效率条件，实验在 ogbn-arxiv 等多个图任务上实现了可认证的性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN 部署中已有被信任的预测，需要在不放弃对已信任预测控制权的前提下改进消息传递。现有适配/校正方法往往是无条件的模型替换，缺乏对实际服务预测的认证与回归控制。

Method: RTT 将基于图的候选状态与受约束内部优化器耦合：每次位移根据现任模型剩余消息传递层的最坏情况终端交叉熵增量计费。通过轨迹验证管和独立检查器强制逐节点概率下界 p^s_ic ≥ e^{-H_row} p^r_ic 及调用级预算 Σ w_i D∞(p^r||p^s) ≤ H+，对所有标签一致成立。通过认证的调用无需完整现任模型重跑，失败则整调用回退。使用注水法推导精确的概率下界前沿。

Result: 在 ogbn-arxiv 审计中，RTT 每次调用平均增益 6.5×10^-3 nats，单侧 95% 回归率上界 0.95%，负翻转上界 0.51%。平均增益为交叉拟合后验前沿估计的 61%，比最强匹配单次校正器高 0.9×10^-3 nats。实验涵盖八种候选、六类图现任模型、结构与时间图偏移、分子预测，以及图像和表格评估。

Conclusion: RTT 将 GNN 适配转变为有预算、可认证的推理决策，而非无条件的模型替换，在保证回归控制的同时利用内部传播证据实现可靠的性能增益。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) need to exploit improved message passing without surrendering control over predictions already trusted in deployment. We introduce Reference-Tail Trust (RTT), a framework that admits learned updates inside a frozen GNN and certifies the prediction actually served. RTT couples graph-based proposal states with a constrained internal optimizer: each displacement is charged for its worst-case terminal cross-entropy increase through the incumbent's remaining message-passing layers. A trajectory-validated tube and an independent checker enforce per-node probability floors, $p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$, and a call-level budget, $\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$, uniformly over labels. Calls whose adapted outputs pass certification require no separate full incumbent rollout; failed certificates trigger whole-call fallback. We derive the exact probability-floor frontier by water-filling, characterize architecture-constrained efficiency, and establish conditions under which internal propagation exploits evidence unavailable to restricted output correctors. In the reported ogbn-arxiv audit, RTT achieves $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats of mean gain per call, with a one-sided 95% regression-rate upper bound of 0.95% and a 95% negative-flip upper bound of 0.51% on the uninspected part of the reserved node population. Its mean gain is 61% of a cross-fitted posterior-based frontier estimate and exceeds the strongest matched one-pass corrector by $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats. Reported experiments span eight proposals, six graph-incumbent families, structural and temporal graph shifts, and molecular prediction, with additional image and tabular evaluations. RTT makes GNN adaptation a budgeted, certifiable inference decision rather than an unconditional model replacement.

</details>


### [1408] [Muon Sublates the Edge of Stability in LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34915)
*Yanzhe Chen,Qifang Zhao,Xiaoxiao Xu,Fanghui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Muon在LLM预训练中突破了经典GD的"稳定边缘"(EoS)图景，损失中性、更新反转与边际稳定性不再耦合，呈现"分裂的EoS"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon日益用于语言模型预训练，但其大步长动力学无法用经典GD的EoS理论解释，需重新刻画其稳定性机制。

Method: 针对随机无动量Muon，推导相干性修正的条件损失中性边界2ρ_b/η；通过控制实验分别考察损失平衡与时间对齐对学习率和批大小的响应；在130M与1B Llama类LLM上进行验证。

Result: 损失平衡与时间对齐对学习率、批大小的响应不同；130M模型呈损失边界跟踪但弱负对齐，1B模型出现更强的部分抵消；两种设置下方向均远离相干反转但训练持续改善。

Conclusion: Muon存在分裂的EoS：随机损失中性边界仍成立，但不再伴随普适的时间方向特征。代码已开源。

Abstract: Muon is increasingly used for language-model pretraining, yet its large-step dynamics are not captured by the classical edge-of-stability (EoS) picture of gradient descent (GD). In GD, loss neutrality, equal-magnitude update reversal, and marginal stability meet at a single learning-rate-dependent edge. We show that Muon breaks this coupling. For stochastic no-momentum Muon, we derive a coherence-corrected conditional loss-neutral boundary $2ρ_b/η$, while temporal alignment follows a separate geometry. Controlled experiments show that loss balance and temporal alignment respond differently to learning rate and batch size. Across our language model experiments, the 130M Llama-like LLM runs exhibit loss-boundary tracking with weak negative alignment, whereas the studied 1B LLM configuration shows stronger partial cancellation; in both settings, directions remain far from coherent reversal while training continues to improve. These results support a split EoS picture for Muon: a stochastic loss-neutral edge survives, but it is not accompanied by a universal temporal-direction signature. The source code for reproducing the experiments can be found in https://github.com/cyzebra/Muon-Sublates-the-Edge-of-Stability-in-LLM-Pretraining

</details>


### [1409] [Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via Hierarchical Sequential Cross-Attention over Chemical and Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34921)
*Khadidja Henni,Hamza Abdelali,Abdelkrim Aries,Neila Mezghani,Brigitte Vannier,Sara Magdouli,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出仅用序列的DTI预测架构，结合ChemBERTa与ESM-2预训练语言模型及层次化交互模块，在多个数据集上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多基于序列的DTI模型独立处理药物和蛋白，仅在后期预测阶段融合表示，无法显式建模化学子结构与蛋白序列区域间的跨分子依赖。

Method: 用ChemBERTa编码药物SMILES、ESM-2编码蛋白序列，提取上下文表示；再用1D卷积压缩局部序列模式，接着采用受诱导契合启发的顺序双向交叉注意力机制，最后用注意力池化构建固定大小的交互感知向量做二分类预测。

Result: 在BIOSNAP上达到最佳性能，Davis上匹配最佳AUROC，BindingDB上保持竞争力，仅用2520万可训练参数；消融验证CNN与交叉注意力模块贡献，冷启动实验显示对未见蛋白和药物具有良好泛化性。

Conclusion: 该序列级架构有效建模跨分子依赖，参数量适中且泛化性良好，说明显式交互建模与预训练语言模型结合对DTI预测有重要价值。

Abstract: Predicting Drug-Target Interactions~(DTIs) is a central task in computational drug discovery, with direct applications in virtual screening, drug repurposing, and therapeutic candidate prioritization. Although recent deep learning methods have improved DTI prediction, many sequence-based models still process drugs and proteins independently and only combine their representations at a late prediction stage. This limits their ability to explicitly model cross-molecular dependencies between chemical substructures and protein sequence regions. In this paper, we propose a sequence-only DTI prediction architecture that combines two pre-trained language models, ChemBERTa for drug SMILES strings and ESM-2 for protein amino acid sequences, with a hierarchical interaction module. The proposed model first extracts contextual representations using pre-trained encoders, then applies 1D convolutional layers to condense local sequence patterns, followed by a sequential bidirectional cross-attention mechanism inspired by the induced-fit view of molecular recognition. Finally, attention-based pooling constructs fixed-size interaction-aware vectors for binary prediction. Experiments on BIOSNAP, Davis, and BindingDB show that the proposed model achieves the best performance on BIOSNAP, matches the best AUROC on Davis, and remains competitive on BindingDB while using only 25.2 million trainable parameters. Ablation results confirm the contribution of both the CNN and cross-attention modules, and cold-start experiments indicate promising generalization to unseen proteins and drugs.

</details>


### [1410] [Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34924)
*Sebastian Bobadilla-Suarez,Bob Suh,Ryan Fortin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"平稳性二分法"(stationarity dichotomy)：只要智能体可达的编辑集合固定，迭代自我修改必然遇到严格递减回报；只有该集合扩张才能突破。重写脚手架（工具、验证器、分解）能扩张可达集而不改权重，因此冻结权重只保证最终上限、不保证平稳。该准则区分三种常被混淆的机制，并把同一上限判定推广到横向扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计者常只检查权重是否冻结，但这检查错了对象。作者希望找到一个能统一解释迭代自我修改收益递减、以及宽度扩展（best-of-k、多智能体投票）为何无法突破天花板的理论准则。

Method: 把"精炼"读作对草稿与目标之间残差的梯度提升（以补丁/git diff 为单位），再测量该读法在哪里失效：补丁是可组合的而非可并列投票的，且失败会重叠。以"饱和"为测量对象，在 SWE-bench 上观察每轮改进衰减，在 401 个生产会话上观察改动量几何衰减，并与前 AI 人类基线对比。

Result: 每轮改进趋于零，改动量几何衰减；30 个同族worker的失败重叠达到最大，多数投票在 23/55 (42%) 任务上失败，表明加权投票所需的多样性在真实worker中不存在。宽度只买速率、不买预算；固定池的再咨询有一个可预先计算的地平线。

Conclusion: 审计脚手架，而非检查点。两个失效点都是工程选择而非关于代码的定律，因此它们共同指向一个值得构建的 harness。

Abstract: An auditor who checks whether a system's weights are frozen is checking the wrong thing. Our stationarity dichotomy says that iterative self-modification hits strict diminishing returns whenever the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, and can escape only if that set expands. Rewriting scaffolding (tools, verifiers, decomposition) expands what an agent reaches without touching a weight, so frozen weights buy an eventual ceiling but no stationarity along the way. The criterion also separates three regimes usually merged: search within a fixed class, test-time training that raises the ceiling itself, and scaffold rewriting between them. Audit the scaffold, not the checkpoint.
  The same ceiling binds sideways. Best-of-$k$ orchestration realizes the best worker's ceiling exactly: width buys rate, not budget. Re-consulting a fixed pool has a horizon computable in advance, decided by the pool alone, and the one arrangement that would beat it, a weighted vote, needs diversity real workers lack: on 30 same-family workers the failure overlap sits at its maximum, and a majority fails 23/55 (42%) of tasks.
  We obtain the criterion by reading refinement as gradient boosting on the residual error between draft and target, a patch or git diff, and then measuring where that reading breaks: patches compose instead of standing beside each other to be voted on, and failures overlap. What we measure is saturation. Per-round improvement decays toward zero on SWE-bench, and churn decays geometrically across 401 production sessions, a shape shared with a pre-AI human baseline that establishes the regime without identifying its cause. Both breaks are engineering choices rather than laws about code, so together they specify a harness worth building.

</details>


### [1411] [XMatch: Enhancing Covariate-Aware Time Series Forecasting through Tree-Structured Exogenous Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34939)
*Ziyang Zhang,Hanyin Cheng,Xiangfei Qiu,Yang Shu,Bin Yang,Chenjuan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出XMatch，一种协变量感知的预测模型，通过树状匹配过程匹配未来与历史外生模式，自适应选择匹配所用外生变量数量，利用历史内生模式增强预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协变量感知方法主要学习外生变量对内生变量的直接影响，但这类影响复杂且随外生模式变化而改变，难以捕捉。观察发现特定外生模式往往只与少数内生响应模式共现，可据此通过模式匹配增强预测。但多外生变量场景下存在精确匹配与历史支撑之间的两难。

Method: XMatch包含两个组件：1）ProtoTree Creator，将历史外生-内生模式对应关系组织成ProtoTree，树深层引入更多外生变量参与匹配；2）ProtoTree Matcher，用未来外生变量查询ProtoTree，基于外生模式相似度与历史支撑自适应决定使用多少外生变量匹配，匹配到的内生模式作为显式历史证据增强预测。

Result: 在12个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，XMatch优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过树状结构自适应匹配外生模式并利用对应内生模式作为历史证据，可有效解决精确匹配与历史支撑的矛盾，提升协变量感知预测性能。

Abstract: Future exogenous variables provide valuable information for forecasting endogenous time series. Existing covariate-aware methods primarily learn the direct influence of exogenous variables on endogenous variables. However, these effects can be complex and change with the pattern of the exogenous variables, making them difficult to capture. Beyond this perspective, we observe that a given exogenous pattern often co-occurs with only a small set of endogenous response patterns. These associations motivate a strategy that matches future and historical exogenous patterns and uses the corresponding endogenous patterns to enhance forecasting. However, in real-world forecasting scenarios with multiple exogenous variables, each exogenous variable provides a distinct dimension for matching, creating a dilemma for this strategy between precise matching and sufficient historical support. To bridge this gap, we propose XMatch (EXogenous MATCHing), a covariate-aware forecasting model that realizes the aforementioned strategy through a tree-structured matching process that adaptively adjusts the number of exogenous variables used as matching conditions. Specifically, we first introduce the ProtoTree Creator, which organizes historical correspondences between exogenous and endogenous patterns into a ProtoTree, whose deeper levels incorporate additional exogenous variables for matching. For forecasting, we then design the ProtoTree Matcher, which uses future exogenous variables to query the ProtoTree and adaptively determines how many exogenous variables to use for matching based on exogenous pattern similarity and historical support. Finally, the matched endogenous patterns are used as explicit historical evidence to enhance forecasting. Extensive experiments on 12 real-world datasets demonstrate that XMatch outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [1412] [Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34944)
*Jeongsol Kim,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Kwanyoung Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF)，将轨迹感知的critic引导摊销到轻量引导网络中，在保持预训练VLA和critic冻结的同时实现高效的长时间任务优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于flow的VLA策略通过行为克隆训练，不显式优化长期任务回报；现有critic引导方法需在每个flow步骤反传critic集成，代价高。

Method: 将critic引导的flow生成建模为确定性最优控制问题，其最优引导为costate（携带终端critic梯度回传），并让引导网络回归该costate，冻结VLA与critic。

Result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa、LIBERO-Pro上一致提升预训练VLA，与critic引导及策略微调基线相当；单引导强度跨任务最鲁棒。相比QGF，每步快3.6倍、参数少7.0倍，性能相当甚至更好。

Conclusion: critic引导可以同时做到轨迹感知且轻量化。

Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.

</details>


### [1413] [ALICE: In-context, Zero-shot, Mutual Information Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34962)
*Giulio Franzese,Simone Rossi,Pietro Michiardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ALICE 基础模型，通过上下文学习估计互信息，无需针对每个分布重新训练，跨领域零样本可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络互信息估计器在大数据下准确，但数据稀缺时表现差，且每个分布需重新训练、仅绑定特定数据类型，限制了实际应用。

Method: ALICE 仅在广泛的合成分布族上训练，作为整流流速度场的上下文估计器：给定未见分布的样本，无需显式训练即估计其速度场，再通过固定恒等式对联合与条件速度场的平方差积分得到互信息。

Result: 在标准困难基准上验证，并应用于模型未见过的生物学、遗传学和神经科学三个领域，首次证明单一模型可接近为每个分布单独训练的神经估计器的精度。

Conclusion: ALICE 原生支持不同数据维度和样本量，实现跨科学领域的零样本互信息分析。

Abstract: Estimating mutual information (MI) from samples is a central objective in a variety of scientific fields. Modern neural estimators are accurate in the large-data regime, but they fall short when data is scarce, and each must be fit anew for every distribution under study. Current estimators are moreover tied to specific data types. These constraints limit their adoption in many applications where per-distribution training is impractical and sample sizes are small.
  We present ALICE, a foundation model that removes per-distribution training, while achieving competitive estimation accuracy. Trained exclusively on a broad family of synthetic distributions, ALICE acts as an in-context estimator of rectified-flow velocity fields: conditioned on samples of an unseen distribution, it estimates that distribution's velocity field without any explicit training. MI is then obtained through a fixed identity that integrates the squared difference between the joint and conditional fields. We validate ALICE on a standard, challenging benchmark and apply it in three domains, biology, genetics, and neuroscience, whose data the model has never seen. For the first time, we show that a single model closes the gap with neural estimators trained separately for each distribution, while natively supporting different data dimensionality and sample cardinality, enabling zero-shot MI analysis across scientific domains.

</details>


### [1414] [Cyclostationary Phase Conditioning for Medical Time Series Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34965)
*Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Michele Copetti,Jorge da Silva Goncalves,Sonia Laguna,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对生理时间序列的循环平稳性，提出移位协变小波表示与逐样本相位条件两个归纳偏置，并引入循环平稳指数和反演轨迹对偶耦合来提升扩散模型恢复效果与采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生理时间序列（心电、脑电等）具有循环平稳性：统计量随周期相位周期性变化。运动、接触不良和生理干扰会破坏诊断所需的形态，因此需要信号恢复。现有扩散方法仅以损坏观测为条件，必须隐式学习周期结构，未能显式利用这一可测的循环结构。

Method: 提出两个编码循环平稳性的归纳偏置：（1）移位协变小波表示；（2）从损坏输入推断的逐样本密集相位条件。此外引入无需训练的循环平稳指数，量化相位结构并预测相位条件何时有效；并提出反演轨迹的对偶耦合，降低采样方差，在性能相当的情况下将网络评估次数减少五倍。

Result: 跨多种模态的实验表明，显式编码可测量的循环结构能改善生理时间序列恢复效果；对偶耦合在保持相当性能的同时将网络评估减少五倍。

Conclusion: 显式编码循环平稳性有助于生理时间序列恢复，且循环平稳指数可用于预测相位条件的收益，对偶耦合可提升采样效率。

Abstract: Many physiological time series, such as cardiac and brain recordings, exhibit cyclostationarity: their statistics vary periodically with an underlying cycle phase. Corruption from motion, poor contact, and physiological interference obscures morphology needed for diagnosis, making signal restoration essential. Existing diffusion approaches condition on corrupted observations alone and must learn cyclic structure implicitly. We instead propose two inductive biases which encode cyclostationarity: a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning inferred from the corrupted input. We further introduce a training-free cyclostationarity index that quantifies phase structure and predicts when phase conditioning will help. Finally, we propose antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories to reduce sampling variance while achieving comparable performance with fivefold fewer network evaluations. Across modalities, our results show that explicitly encoding measurable cyclic structure improves physiological time-series restoration.

</details>


### [1415] [Teach to Learn: Hint Annealing for Self-improving LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34975)
*Zile Wang,Zijian Li,Haodong Wang,Jian Liu,Qianli Liu,Lucas Muli,Blaze Chen,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HATCH 框架，通过让策略自生成并使用提示来提升推理能力，并缓解 hint reward shift 问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 在困难查询上仅有错误 rollout 会缺乏奖励对比和学习信号；现有提示方法虽能恢复信号，但忽略提示轨迹在评估时不可用，产生奖励偏移与改进受限问题。

Method: HATCH 为在线单策略框架，学习生成和使用自身提示；引入在线权重退火提示轨迹贡献，并用梯度投影去除提示生成更新中与解题目标冲突的分量。

Result: 在数学推理基准上优于 SOTA，Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 提升 1.02 pp，Qwen3-1.7B 提升 2.84 pp，Qwen3-8B 提升 4.32 pp。

Conclusion: HATCH 能让策略为自身创造学习机会，并在无提示条件下转化为更强推理能力。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves language-model reasoning by comparing verified rewards among multiple solution rollouts for each query. However, difficult training queries can yield only incorrect rollouts, leaving GRPO with no reward contrast or learning signal. Prior hint-based methods construct auxiliary hints from solution evidence and use them to re-solve failed queries, recovering learning signal. Yet the resulting trajectories are typically treated as ordinary solution trajectories despite being generated under an assisted condition unavailable at evaluation. We discover hinted reward shift: recovered reward contrast can concentrate policy updates on hinted trajectories, limiting improvement without hints. This also creates a trade-off: increasing hinted trajectories can accelerate early learning but intensify reward shift later. To address this problem, we propose HATCH (Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching), an online single-policy framework that learns from both generating and using its own hints to improve reasoning without assistance. To mitigate hinted reward shift, we introduce online weighting to anneal the contribution of hinted trajectories. However, learning to generate hints can conflict with improving query solving. We therefore use gradient projection to remove the opposing component of hint-generation updates. Together, these designs support self-improvement by enabling the policy to create learning opportunities for itself and turn them into stronger reasoning without hints. We evaluate our method on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and outperform state-of-the-art methods by 1.02 pp on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, 2.84 pp on Qwen3-1.7B, and 4.32 pp on Qwen3-8B.

</details>


### [1416] [Inspector: Conversational and Lightweight Analyzer of Analog Circuit Layouts Using LLM and CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34976)
*Abril Cano Castro,Giuseppe Chiari,Michele Piccoli,Federico Viola,Davide Zoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结合微调LLM与CNN的框架，分析模拟电路GDSII文件，实现设计者与工具间的对话式交互，在四类任务上大幅超越通用大型VLM（最高81%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI融入CAD推动模拟IC设计从手动、算法方案转向自动化智能范式；GDSII是模拟电路最精确的行业标准数据库，包含决定流片性能的物理几何与寄生信息，但缺乏轻量高效的自动化分析手段。

Method: 将微调后的大语言模型（LLM）与卷积神经网络（CNN）相结合，构建能解析模拟电路GDSII文件并支持对话式交互的框架。

Result: 在数千个模拟设计、四个真实任务上进行实验，性能显著优于当前最先进的通用大型视觉语言模型（VLM），提升幅度最高达81%。

Conclusion: 该方案为GDSII分析问题提供了轻量级解决路径，并通过对话式界面增强了工具与设计者的交互。

Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines fine-tuned LLMs and CNNs to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling a conversational interface between the tool and the designers. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across four realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose massive VLMs by a significant margin (up to 81%), thus providing a lightweight solution to the problem of GDSII analysis.

</details>


### [1417] [MaPP: A Unified Marginalized Posterior-Predictive Framework for Data-Efficient RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34990)
*Yangyang Ren,Haodong Zhu,Sheng Xu,Yanjing Li,Nikolai Yu. Zolotykh,Wentao Zhang,Baochang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG
