However, this overlap relies on spikes firing on incomplete inputs, and a spike once generated cannot be withdrawn, so its error persists and reduces accuracy. Waiting for more input before firing would seem to improve accuracy at the cost of reduced overlap. Yet we find and prove that this intuition fails at some layers, where even a small increase in waiting can change spike timing and downstream computation, making the network both slower and less accurate. We therefore propose a Pipeline Delay Search method which selects each layer's delay by balancing task-level accuracy gains against added network latency. We then adapt the selected configurations through spike-based quantization-aware training and bounded tuning of firing thresholds and initial membrane potentials. Together, these steps form Falcon, a framework for Fine-grained Analysis of Latency and Controlled firing which systematically analyzes and optimizes SNN latency under a spatial analog compute-in-memory mapping with shared digital engines. We evaluate Falcon on GSCV2 and SSC, achieving competitive accuracies of 96.31 and 83.02 at modeled network-core latencies of 119.64 and 124.00us, respectively. Together, our analysis and results show that SNNs can compute more yet finish faster, and wait longer yet predict worse, highlighting why Falcon matters for both latency and accuracy.

</details>


### [1453] [SpikeCredit: Temporal Credit Carrier for Reinforcement Learning with Sparse Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35268)
*Yingchao Yu,Pengfei Sun,Wenxuan Pan,Wei Chen,Yitian Hong,Kuangrong Hao,Yaochu Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SpikeCredit，一个基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的稀疏奖励强化学习框架，通过"时间信用载体（TCC）"概念利用SNN的膜电位痕迹与事件驱动脉冲进行信用分配，在MuJoCo稀疏奖励任务上大幅超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏奖励RL中延迟结果难以为中间计算提供指导，信用分配困难。作者认为可靠信用分配需要能在时间上保留并暴露信用相关信息的策略动力学，而SNN的渐变膜痕迹与事件驱动脉冲天然满足这一需求。

Method: 提出SpikeCredit框架：先进行任务自适应的TCC选择，再闭合两条通路的循环——快速的TCC读取通路（用自运动反馈约束，以局部行为接地线索约束转移级信用恢复）和慢速的TCC写入通路（信用目标的痕迹对齐，将恢复的信用反馈给actor，使未来TCC动力学更易读信用）。

Result: 在稀疏奖励MuJoCo任务上，Last10回报相比稀疏SNN基线提升：Ant +1169%、Hopper +953%、Swimmer +723%、Walker2d +1781%；在Swimmer上比稠密奖励基线还高+113%。机制分析显示其与稠密奖励的对齐显著强于稀疏SNN基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明脉冲动力学可作为稀疏奖励RL中保留信用的基础机制。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse rewards is challenging because delayed outcomes provide little guidance about which intermediate computations caused success or failure. We argue that reliable credit assignment requires policy dynamics that preserve and expose credit-relevant information over time, a role we formalize as Temporal Credit Carriers (TCCs) and that spiking neural networks (SNNs) naturally fulfill through graded membrane traces and event-driven spikes. Based on this hypothesis, we propose SpikeCredit, an SNN-based framework for RL with sparse rewards that first performs task-adaptive TCC selection and then closes the loop between a fast TCC-reading pathway, where self-motion feedback constraint uses local behavior-grounded cues to constrain transition-level credit recovery, and a slow TCC-writing pathway, where credit-targeted trace alignment feeds recovered credit back into the actor to make future TCC dynamics more credit-readable. Across sparse-reward MuJoCo tasks, SpikeCredit improves Last10 return over sparse SNN baselines by +1169% on Ant, +953% on Hopper, +723% on Swimmer, and +1781% on Walker2d, and exceeds the dense-reward baseline on Swimmer by +113%. Mechanistic analyses further show substantially stronger alignment with dense rewards than the sparse SNN baseline. These results position spiking dynamics as credit-preserving substrates for sparse-reward RL.

</details>


### [1454] [eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35269)
*Mansi,Nikhil Raghavan,Zixia Huang,Kai Sheng Ong,Ji Shen Lim,Brandon Siao Xiang Ling,Francesco Leofante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 eval-unlearn，一个面向 T2I 扩散模型概念遗忘的开源统一可复现基准测试框架，集成 12 种遗忘技术与 9 项评估指标，并提供排行榜与交互式工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念遗忘技术激增导致评估环境异质、碎片化，难以进行原则性的跨方法比较。

Method: 构建 eval-unlearn Python 库：集成微调、闭式模型编辑、推理时干预三类共 12 种遗忘技术，以及覆盖擦除有效性、对抗鲁棒性、生成质量、概念保留的 9 项指标；采用插件架构支持第三方自注册，流式批处理管道支持 NSFW 与任意通用概念评估。

Result: 发布 HuggingFace 公共排行榜与实时评估交互工具，对全部 12 种技术的裸体概念擦除案例比较，揭示出异构评估所掩盖的显著准确性-质量权衡。

Conclusion: eval-unlearn 以 MIT 许可开源，包、代码、排行榜与文档均在 https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io，为概念遗忘提供统一可复现的评估基准。

Abstract: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io.

</details>


### [1455] [Multi-Attractor GNNs: Set-Valued Expressivity Beyond Unique Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35274)
*Jialin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种权重共享的消息传递GNN，通过多重平衡态（不同初始化收敛到不同解）表示集合值等变映射，无需指定唯一目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多组合与科学问题存在多个有效解且无偏好，而现有递归/平衡GNN强制唯一不动点或单一训练目标，会隐含任意选择规则；对节点重标号不变任务中，对称图可能有对称解集却无对称解。

Method: 构造全局Lipschitz、置换等变的动力学，几乎必然收敛到有效解且以正概率到达每个解分支；再用连续分量图的递归消息传递近似实现，误差和更新误差任意小、概率任意高。利用演化状态在有限步保持节点可区分（无需辅助节点标识符），并结合问题特定能量进行无解标签学习。

Result: 在Ising基态、蛋白质图结构模块检测、化学反应稳态任务上，学到的更新产生多个高质量预测且数值收敛率高，平均解质量优于唯一平衡、单目标和前馈基线，并与更大的扩散求解器相当。

Conclusion: 多重平衡态使单一权重共享消息传递GNN能表示集合值等变映射，突破标准通用性论证，为多解问题提供无需解标签的学习框架。

Abstract: Recurrent and equilibrium graph neural networks (GNNs) often enforce a unique fixed point or use one training target per graph. Yet many combinatorial and scientific problems admit multiple valid solutions, with no preferred one. A designated target can then impose an arbitrary selection rule. For tasks invariant to node relabeling, a symmetric graph may have a symmetric solution set but no symmetric solution.
  We show that multiple equilibria enable one weight-tied message-passing GNN to represent set-valued equivariant maps: different initializations approach different valid solutions. Under stated regularity assumptions, we first construct globally Lipschitz, permutation-equivariant dynamics that converge almost surely to valid solutions and reach every solution branch with positive probability. We then establish approximate realization by recurrent message passing with continuous component maps, with arbitrarily small update and limiting errors and arbitrarily high probability. This goes beyond standard universality arguments: although message passing alone cannot distinguish symmetric nodes, the evolving state keeps nodes distinguishable at every finite step without auxiliary node identifiers. Such dynamics can be learned without solution labels using problem-specific energies. On Ising ground states, structural module detection in protein graphs, and chemical reaction steady states, the learned updates produce multiple high-quality predictions with high numerical convergence rates. They achieve better average solution quality than the tested unique-equilibrium, single-target, and feedforward baselines, while remaining competitive with much larger diffusion-based solvers.

</details>


### [1456] [$λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35288)
*Berker Demirel,Clémentine Dominé,Valentino Maiorca,Marco Fumero,Marco Mondelli,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SACReg，一种基于λ-平衡分析的光谱反坍缩正则化器，用于解决联合嵌入自监督学习中骨干表示维度坍缩的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习常结合增强视图不变性目标与防坍缩机制，但这些目标通常作用于投影头之后，而下游任务使用投影器之前的骨干表示。这种不匹配可能导致骨干仍发生维度坍缩，保持低有效秩，限制下游迁移能力。

Method: 作者基于λ-平衡（刻画各层权重矩阵相对尺度）分析，提出SACReg光谱反坍缩正则化器。在两层线性网络中证明λ-平衡可防止坍缩，且施加于骨干的正则化能诱导λ-平衡；非线性情形下同样实现反坍缩。将SACReg应用于JEPA，提出λ-JEPA。

Result: 在ImageNet100真实架构上经验性地提升了表示秩；在ImageNet-1k分类及八个下游图像数据集的平均线性探测迁移性能上优于LeJEPA和VISReg；在视频自监督中于Something-Something-v2和Kinetics-400上优于LeVJEPA和V-JEPA 2。

Conclusion: SACReg通过诱导λ-平衡有效缓解骨干维度坍缩，提升表示秩与下游迁移性能，在图像和视频自监督任务中均取得优于现有方法的成果。

Abstract: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $λ$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $λ$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $λ$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $λ$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $λ$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa.

</details>


### [1457] [Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35291)
*Shunchang Liu,Lukas Fluri,Xin Chen,Francesco Croce*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次定义并研究视觉语言模型中的涌现性错位(EM),发现窄域多模态微调可诱发广泛有害行为并跨任务迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EM研究几乎局限于纯文本任务,多模态模型中的错位表现尚不明确,需要填补这一空白。

Method: 通过在脆弱代码、粗心使用家用物品、阴谋论式解读普通场景等窄域多模态任务上微调,测试15个商用与开源模型;考察训练数据危害性、模态对齐、SFT与偏好优化、推理传播及多种缓解策略。

Result: 窄域多模态微调可诱发连贯且广泛的错位行为,迁移至无关任务(错位观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、视觉越狱、风险智能体行为);EM不依赖训练数据表面危害性,而敏感于训练-评估模态对齐,可经中间推理传播;提示接种、良性续训、激活引导可部分缓解。

Conclusion: 多模态EM反映的是一种行为转变而非通用能力丧失,且从文本扩展到了视觉模态。

Abstract: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.

</details>


### [1458] [LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35297)
*Arman Bolatov,Artem Riabinin,Nikita Kornilov,Andrey Veprikov,Samuel Horváth,Martin Takáč,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LionMuon 优化器：每 P 步执行一次 Muon 谱步，其余步用 Lion，共享一个双 EMA 动量缓冲，在降低 Muon 计算/通信开销的同时保持或超越其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 的谱步方向比 sign step 更强，但代价高：每步都要在全矩阵上做 Newton-Schulz 迭代，分布式训练还需额外 all-reduce。Lion、Signum 的 sign step 便宜且设备本地，但方向较弱。希望兼得两者优势，降低预训练算力开销。

Method: LionMuon 每隔 P 次迭代执行一次 Muon 步，中间迭代使用 Lion 步，二者共享一个双 EMA 动量缓冲；另有单 EMA 变体 SignMuon。Muon 的计算与通信每 P 步仅支付一次，优化器状态为 AdamW 的一半。并在重尾噪声下给出复杂度界。

Result: 理论上证明周期 P 在 Muon 与 Lion 的平滑性与噪声常数之间插值，并给出 LionMuon 快于两者的条件。在 FineWeb 上训练 124M 和 355M 模型，P=2 与 P=5 的 LionMuon 在相同 token 数下损失低于 Muon、AdamW、Lion、Signum；4-GPU 数据并行下以 PCIe 上少三分之一墙钟时间达到 Muon 最终损失，并在不增加暴露通信的情况下损失优于 Dion 和 MuonBP，且保持精确梯度。

Conclusion: LionMuon 通过周期性混合 Muon 与 Lion/sign 步，在精度、计算、通信和内存上取得更优权衡，是一种高效且实用的预训练优化器。

Abstract: Pretraining a language model takes enormous compute, and the right optimizer can save a good part of it. Muon's spectral step gives a stronger direction than a sign step, but it is expensive. Every step runs Newton-Schulz iterations on the full matrix and, in distributed training, an extra all-reduce. Sign steps, as in Lion and Signum, are cheap and stay local to each device. We propose LionMuon, which takes one Muon step every $P$ iterations and Lion steps in between, with a single dual-EMA momentum buffer shared by both. Muon's compute and communication are paid once per $P$ steps, and the optimizer state is half of AdamW's. A single-EMA variant, SignMuon, already improves on Muon. We prove complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise in which the period sets an interpolation between Muon's and Lion's smoothness and noise constants, and which say when LionMuon is faster than both. On 124M and 355M models trained on FineWeb, LionMuon with $P=2$ and $P=5$ reaches a lower loss than Muon, AdamW, Lion and Signum at the same number of tokens. Under 4-GPU data-parallel training it reaches Muon's final loss with a third less wall-clock on PCIe, and it beats the communication-efficient Muon variants Dion and MuonBP on loss at no more exposed communication, while keeping the exact gradient. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon

</details>


### [1459] [When Should a Satellite Estimate Be Changed? Stress-Testing Neural Corrections for Evapotranspiration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35314)
*Marco Trotta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文评估了带选择性门控（selector）的神经残差模型在卫星蒸散发（ET）估计中的可靠性，重点检验其能否在输入无效时拒绝校正。结果显示，普通Gain在物理无效记录上仍接受校正并大幅增加误差，而SupportGain能显著降低错误接受率并改善空间留出误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经残差可改善卫星ET估计，但selector必须判断何时校正有益、何时应拒绝不支持的输入。作者希望检验selector在分布外/物理无效输入下的稳健性与故障模式。

Method: 在151个站点、16,366条涡度相关通量塔观测与OpenET配对数据上，评估十成员模型，采用九个滚动年份和五个空间折。比较Gain与SupportGain在物理无效记录、空间留出误差（如wind x3.6扰动）、干净输入及作物训练下的接受率与MAE，并进行预注册的时序与农田对比检验（Holm校正）。

Result: 单站点中，Gain对全部32条物理无效记录接受校正，预测平均收益0.83 mm/day，但MAE较OpenET增加21.6 mm/day。空间留出误差下，SupportGain在wind x3.6时较Gain降低站点宏观MAE 0.148 mm/day（95%区间0.070–0.226），接受率9.3% vs 51.8%；干净输入下优势0.006 mm/day且区间含零。40项预计划时序比较均未通过Holm校正；预声明农田对比显示仅作物训练站点宏观MAE低0.041 mm/day（95%区间0.009–0.079）。

Conclusion: 选择性校正机制能显著减少对无效输入的误接受并提升扰动下的空间留出性能，但干净输入与多数时序比较无稳健优势；故障分析为探索性，需谨慎解释。

Abstract: Neural residuals can improve satellite evapotranspiration (ET) estimates, but selectors must predict when a correction helps and reject unsupported inputs. We evaluate ten-member models on 16,366 flux-tower observations from 151 stations paired with OpenET, across nine rolling years and five spatial folds. At one held-out station, Gain accepted corrections on all 32 physically invalid records: it predicted a mean benefit of 0.83 mm/day, but the corrections increased mean absolute error by 21.6 mm/day versus OpenET. On spatially held-out unit errors, SupportGain reduced station-macro MAE versus Gain by 0.148 mm/day under wind x3.6 (simultaneous 95% interval, 0.070 to 0.226), with 9.3% acceptance versus Gain's 51.8%; on clean inputs, its 0.006 mm/day advantage had an interval that includes zero. These fault analyses are exploratory; none of 40 preplanned temporal comparisons passed Holm correction, while a separate predeclared cropland contrast found 0.041 mm/day lower station-macro MAE with crop-only training (95% interval, 0.009 to 0.079).

</details>


### [1460] [Collaborative Principle Evolution via Evidence Transfer for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35315)
*Yingming Pu,Hongyu Chen,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出COEVOLVE框架，将协作式科学发现建模为并行原则演化分支间的证据迁移，通过信息价值门控路由与上下文折扣似然注入实现分支协作，在6项任务上平均解质量66.5%（单分支57.0%），墙钟时间加速1.80倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体有望自动化科学发现，但假设空间巨大、探索成本高昂。现有原则演化方法虽加速了发现循环，却是串行执行，限制了探索广度，并在困难问题上浪费墙钟时间。

Method: 将协作式科学发现表述为并行原则演化分支之间的证据迁移问题；提出COEVOLVE，通过一个协调核心管理并行分支，结合基于信息价值（VoI）的门控路由与上下文折扣的似然注入，使各分支能通过共享测量结果协作，同时保持各自原则后验的独立性。

Result: 在6项科学发现任务、匹配评估预算下，COEVOLVE平均解质量66.5%，优于单分支原则演化的57.0%，在GPT-5.6-Terra骨干上平均墙钟加速1.80倍；在交由自主研究框架执行的5项自动研究任务中，是唯一在所有任务上平均表现均高于已发表SOTA锚点的方案。

Conclusion: 结果表明了证据共享在何时能加速并行发现，以及在何种情况下需要迁移保护机制来限制负向或无效迁移。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents promise to automate scientific discovery, yet exploring the vast hypothesis space remains costly. Existing principle-evolution methods accelerate this loop, but operate sequentially, which caps exploration breadth and wastes wall-clock time on challenging problems. To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under a matched evaluation budget, COEVOLVE attains a mean solution quality of 66.5% versus 57.0% for single-branch principle evolution, with a 1.80x mean wall-clock speedup on the GPT-5.6-Terra backbone; on five auto-research tasks delegated to an autonomous research harness, it is the only arm whose mean stays above the published SOTA anchor on every task. These results establish when evidence sharing accelerates parallel discovery and when transfer safeguards are necessary to limit negative or inert transfers

</details>


### [1461] [Teacher-Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35319)
*Tong Zhang,Zhou Liu,Yihao Liu,Jiahua Bao,Xuchen Li,Honglin Lin,Tao Cheng,Zhihan Yu,Kai Tang,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出多轮智能体在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中teacher-student的token分布差距与监督收益存在错配，提出OG-OPD，用轨迹相对权重和基于最终任务结果的校准来选择性加强有效监督，在三个基准上显著提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPD工作将大的teacher-student分布差距视为需要纠正的关键点，但实证发现大差距可能是良性的，小差距反而对结果关键。局部差距只反映当前轮差异，无法判断教师指导是否真正有益。

Method: 提出Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD)：对教师监督应用轨迹相对权重，并利用成对学生续写产生的最终任务结果来校准这些权重，选择性地在学生原始轨迹中教师指导真正有益的轮次上加强监督。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop上，OG-OPD在多种设定下均优于基线，任务成功率比vanilla OPD提升3.6-17.7个百分点，比最强基线最高提升7.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 有效的监督应聚焦于学生能转化为更好最终任务结果的指导，而非仅依据局部teacher-student差距；OG-OPD通过结果校准实现了这一目标并取得一致提升。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense teacher supervision. Recent work on OPD for multi-turn autonomous agents often treats large teacher-student token-level distributional gaps as promising intervention points, linking larger gaps to a greater need for correction. Yet, our empirical analysis reveals a supervision-benefit mismatch: large gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical. Teacher-student gaps capture differences at the current turn, whereas the benefit of teacher guidance depends on how the current student interacts with the environment afterward. The student may still succeed despite choosing an action that differs from the teacher's, while a teacher-preferred action may lead to a state from which the student cannot complete the task. Local gaps alone are therefore not enough to determine whether teacher guidance benefits the current student. Effective supervision should instead emphasize guidance that the current student can translate into better final task outcomes. Accordingly, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD), which applies trajectory-relative weighting to teacher supervision and calibrates these weights using final task outcomes from paired student continuations. This calibration selectively strengthens supervision on the student's original trajectories at turns where teacher guidance benefits the current student. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, OG-OPD consistently outperforms baselines under diverse settings. It improves task success rates by 3.6-17.7 percentage points over vanilla OPD and by up to 7.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [1462] [Weighting Schedules Govern What and When Score-Based Generative Models Learn from Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35322)
*Jérémie Klinger,Raphaël Urfin,Giulio Biroli,Marylou Gabrié*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过高维精确分析，揭示扩散模型训练中被时间积分损失掩盖的模态学习时间尺度层次，指出信噪比Λ(t)决定多模态目标各特征（方向与权重）的学习速率，且只有在物种形成时间附近（Λ(t)~1）所有特征才可学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有得分生成模型用时间积分损失与加权schedule w(t)训练，但积分损失掩盖了训练动力学，尤其对多模态分布，轨迹在狭窄的"物种形成时间"窗口内锁定模态，其机制与w(t)设计缺乏理论理解。

Method: 聚焦高维数据，将积分损失分解为各固定信噪比Λ(t)下的单时间贡献；对非平衡与分层高斯混合模型进行精确高维训练动力学分析，研究各特征（模态方向及相对权重）的获得速率。

Result: 高Λ(t)时所有模态方向在同一时间尺度上一起获得且不依赖其幅度，而相对权重完全未学；只有在物种形成时间附近当Λ(t)~1时，所有特征才变得可学，各具独立时间尺度：权重与方向联合获得，方向学习速率由相对幅度决定。图像与人类基因组单倍型生成实验验证了预测的层次。

Conclusion: 时间积分目标的训练动力学取决于加权有多大比例落在物种形成时间附近，为w(t)的设计选择提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Score-based generative models generate new samples by integrating a time-dependent drift that carries Gaussian noise onto the target distribution. In practice this drift is modeled by a neural network, trained on a loss integrated over time $t$ with a weighting schedule $w(t)$. Along the backward dynamics, and for multi-modal distributions, trajectories commit to modes of the target within a narrow time window, the \textit{speciation time}. In this work, focusing on high-dimensional data, we decompose the integrated loss into its single-time contributions and analyze each at fixed signal-to-noise ratio $Λ(t)$: we show that $Λ(t)$ sets the rate at which each feature of a multimodal target - the mode directions and their relative weights - is acquired during training. Crucially, at high $Λ(t)$ all mode directions are acquired together, on a single timescale insensitive to their amplitudes, while the relative weights are not learned at all. Only near the speciation time, where $Λ(t)$ becomes of order one, do all features become learnable, each on its own timescale: the weights are acquired jointly with the directions, and the directions at rates set by their relative amplitudes. For models trained on time-integrated objectives, the learning dynamics is then governed by how much of the weighting effectively sits near the speciation time, which provides insights on $w(t)$ design choices. These results follow from an exact high-dimensional analysis of the training dynamics of unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures. Numerical experiments on image and human genome haplotype generation recover the predicted hierarchy of learning timescales in more complex settings.

</details>


### [1463] [Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Algorithm Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35333)
*Yuanqing Ma,Zhenrui Zheng,Chenjun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出循环算法蒸馏RAD，用压缩Transformer将长交互历史蒸馏为紧凑隐token，配合AD Transformer生成动作，在固定大小隐缓冲下解耦历史长度与计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法蒸馏(AD)虽能让Transformer无需权重更新实现上下文强化学习，但捕捉长期学习进展需要极长上下文窗口，带来高昂内存成本并限制其在复杂长时任务上的扩展性。

Method: RAD采用双组件架构：(1)压缩Transformer将扩展的交互历史蒸馏为紧凑的隐token；(2)AD Transformer以压缩记忆与近期transition组成的混合上下文自回归生成动作。通过维持固定大小的隐缓冲，将有效历史长度与计算复杂度解耦，为模型提供长时记忆能力。

Result: 在多种环境中评估，RAD在显著减小上下文窗口的情况下达到标准AD的渐近性能。

Conclusion: RAD为高效上下文决策提供了一种可扩展方案，可缓解AD的上下文瓶颈。

Abstract: Algorithm Distillation (AD) has demonstrated the remarkable ability of Transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning without explicit weight updates. However, capturing long-term learning progress necessitates expansive context windows, which incur prohibitive memory costs and limit scalability in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address this bottleneck, we propose Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD). RAD employs a dual-component architecture: a Compression Transformer that distills extended interaction histories into compact latent tokens, and an AD Transformer that auto-regressively generates actions using a hybrid context of these compressed memories and recent transitions. By maintaining a fixed-size latent buffer, RAD decouples the effective history length from computational complexity, functionally providing the model with a long-horizon memory. Empirical evaluations across diverse environments demonstrate that RAD matches the asymptotic performance of standard AD with significantly reduced context window sizes, offering a scalable solution for efficient in-context decision-making.

</details>


### [1464] [Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35335)
*Petros Tsialis,Steffen Limmer,Tobias Rodemann,Martin Heckmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM能否仅凭数据集层面信息和用户指定的目标特征，自动推断数据领域与下游预测任务类型，并发布625个数据集的标注基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML任务类型识别对构建有效流水线至关重要，但实践中通常需人工指定，缺乏自动化手段。

Method: 提出基于LLM的系统，从数据集层面信息推断数据领域与预测任务；发布含625个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准；在三种场景评估：与AutoML启发式对比、跨域评估、以及小模型本地部署。

Result: LLM方法在表格场景优于AutoGluon（0.98 vs 0.93 F1 macro）；跨域最佳达0.90 F1 macro；本地小模型达0.75，体现部署可行性与精度的权衡。

Conclusion: LLM在任务类型识别上具一致性优势，但在异构与资源受限场景下难度增加，存在精度与部署可行性的权衡。

Abstract: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular datasets in comparison with established AutoML heuristics, (ii) cross-domain evaluation across tabular and time series datasets, and (iii) a practical deployment scenario using smaller local models. The results show consistent advantages for LLM-based task type identification, with increasing difficulty in heterogeneous and resource-constrained settings. LLM-based approaches outperform AutoGluon in the tabular setting, reaching 0.98 F1 macro compared to 0.93. In the cross-domain setting, the best model achieves 0.90 F1 macro, while smaller locally deployable models reach 0.75, indicating a trade-off between deployment feasibility and accuracy.

</details>


### [1465] [NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35338)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeuronDiscover框架，通过"双胞胎混淆"理论形式化机制发现与模型误差难以区分的难题，用Agent-in-Twin联合机制-差异信念设计实验，在模拟脑液示踪世界和真实皮质神经元记录上取得优于基线的关系发现效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元微环境机制发现需要能区分"真实机制变化"与"计算孪生体误差"的干预和测量。由于稀疏观测下两者留下相同特征，预测精度无法解决该问题，因此需要形式化这种"孪生混淆"并设计能分离二者的实验。

Method: 提出NeuronDiscover——Agent-in-Twin框架。其共享的、机制驱动的World Action Model (WAM)耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计；经独立裁决的结果修订带作用域的Mechanism-Intervention-Observation-Outcome (MIOY)图，支持的关系编译为可执行程序，携带差异调整的接受界限。

Result: 在模拟脑液示踪世界（由独立冻结细网格求解器裁决）和供体不重叠的公开电流钳皮质神经元记录上评估。在16实验/32源单元固定预算下，NeuronDiscover每世界解决4.0个关系，最强基线3.4，无图修订3.2，假支持率5%、作用域准确率82%。联合机制-差异获取解决3.8 vs 插件期望信息增益2.9；差异调整验证将接受程序失败率从15%降至9%（60%接受覆盖）；迁移到记录为1.94 vs 1.53。

Conclusion: NeuronDiscover通过联合推理机制与差异信念有效分离真实机制与模型误差，在模拟与真实数据上均优于基线；正确性在声明的模型世界与存档记录内裁决。

Abstract: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

</details>


### [1466] [Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35347)
*Xin Li,Hao Jiang,Xin Gao,Annan Wang,Yuchen Xie,Jinghao Guo,Xingwei Qu,Yichi Zhang,Chau Yuen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 多教师在线蒸馏(MOPD)把多个专才模型合并成一个学生模型，但不同领域反馈强度不均等导致学生无法超越最强单一专才。作者提出领域归一化MOPD(DN-MOPD)，按各领域反馈的离散度进行重缩放，在三个规模、六个基准上均优于MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习可把单一语言模型训练成数学、编码、指令遵循等各有所长的专才，但用户需要一个兼具所有技能的模型。MOPD通过让对应领域专才对学生每个token给出反馈来合并技能，然而路由只决定"谁教"，未决定"反馈影响多强"。作者发现MOPD学生打不过最强单一专才，且几乎学不到数学专才的优势。

Method: 作者诊断出反馈不平衡问题：指令遵循反馈的离散度是数学反馈的数倍，从而主导了学生更新。据此提出DN-MOPD，保留原有路由策略，但按每个领域测得反馈的离散度对各领域反馈进行重缩放。

Result: 在Qwen3.5三个规模上，DN-MOPD在六个公开基准上平均分均高于MOPD，覆盖三个随机种子和两种答案长度上限，并恢复了大部分丢失的数学增益。固定领域权重的对照实验显示，增益主要来自调低指令遵循反馈而非单纯调高数学反馈，且接近DN-MOPD所测权重的固定权重效果相当。

Conclusion: 合并专才不仅需要决定由哪个专才来教，还需要决定其反馈的权重强度。领域归一化是解决多教师蒸馏中反馈不平衡的有效手段。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its feedback moves the shared student. In Qwen3.5 models at three sizes, we find that MOPD's student does not beat one taught by the best single specialist and gains little of the mathematics specialist's advantage. The feedback is unbalanced: instruction-following feedback is several times more spread out than mathematics feedback and dominates the student's updates. We propose Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD), which keeps the routing and rescales each domain's feedback by its measured spread. On six public benchmarks, DN-MOPD improves the average score over MOPD at every size, across three random seeds and under two answer-length limits, and recovers most of the lost mathematics gain. Controls with fixed domain weights show that the gain comes mainly from turning down instruction-following feedback rather than turning up mathematics alone, and that fixed weights close to those DN-MOPD measures perform comparably. Combining specialists therefore requires deciding not only which one teaches, but also how strongly its feedback counts.

</details>


### [1467] [From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348)
*Simon Klüttermann,Xueying Ding,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRODiGI 是一个预训练的数据到程序模型，可在单次前向传播中推断出显式、可执行的生成程序，实现快速且可解释的表格生成建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限样本估计概率密度通常需要针对特定数据集进行模型拟合，过程耗时且模型难以重用。作者希望用一种可预训练、无需逐数据集拟合的方式，直接从数据推断可执行的生成程序。

Method: 提出 PRODiGI：在合成数据集及其真值程序上预训练；通过模板预测和非自回归程序参数解码，适应多种生成族与数据维度；推断出的程序可独立支持采样、密度与分数评估及检查；并引入程序空间微调，在保持模型参数不变的情况下通过匹配生成样本与经验样本细化可微程序参数。

Result: PRODiGI 在平均密度和分数 MAE 上优于现有预训练模型，且相较最接近的竞品有数倍加速；程序空间微调进一步将生成 MMD 降低 84%。

Conclusion: 通过将经验数据转化为显式、可复用的程序，PRODiGI 为快速、可解释的表格生成建模开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by matching generated and empirical samples while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI achieves lower average density and score MAE than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 84%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.

</details>


### [1468] [Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35349)
*Nicolaj Rux,Johannes Hertrich,Sebastian Neumayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文引入"kernel capacity"度量注意力核的表达能力，证明softmax等核具无限容量但常见准线性核容量有限，提出基于样条和多项式指数核的可加核，可保持无限容量并实现准线性计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Softmax注意力的评估成本随序列长度二次增长。核注意力用更一般的核函数替代softmax以降低成本，但现有准线性核（如有限维特征映射导出的核）牺牲了表达能力。因此需要找到既保持注意力表达性又能准线性计算的核。

Method: 提出"容量"(capacity)指标：衡量注意力矩阵近似单位阵的最大序列长度，容量越高表达性越强。分析各类核的容量，并设计由单变量样条核和多项式指数核构造的可加核(additive kernels)，证明其具无限容量且可通过排序实现准线性计算。

Result: Softmax、Gauss、Laplace等表达性核具无限容量；有限维特征映射导出的准线性核容量有限；所提可加样条/多项式指数核保持无限容量并支持准线性计算。实现可加排序核并与现代softmax后端对比，在长序列上表现优势。

Conclusion: 可加核在保持注意力表达性的同时实现准线性计算，长序列场景下优于softmax后端，为解决长序列注意力效率与表达的权衡提供新方案。

Abstract: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity. A higher capacity thus indicates greater expressivity. We show that expressive kernels like softmax, Gauss, and Laplace have infinite capacity. In contrast, common quasi linear kernels, such as those derived from finite dimensional feature maps, exhibit finite capacity. As a solution, we propose additive kernels constructed from univariate spline and polynomial exponential kernels. We prove that these maintain infinite capacity while allowing quasi linear computation via sorting. Finally, we implement additive sorting kernels efficiently and benchmark them against modern softmax backends, demonstrating advantages for long sequences.

</details>


### [1469] [Interference Beyond Geometry in Concept Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35351)
*Valérie Costa,Bahareh Tolooshams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"有效干扰"概念，结合特征几何与编码统计刻画真实交互，并在稀疏自编码器上验证架构约束如何通过四种机制塑造干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上干扰被简单视为学习特征之间的几何重叠，但这一视角无法区分建设性与破坏性干扰，也无法区分频繁弱交互与罕见强交互，因此需要更贴合实际的度量方式。

Method: 引入"有效干扰"概念，融合特征几何与编码统计数据以捕捉实际发生的交互；在局部固定支撑假设下，分析架构约束影响干扰的四种机制：特征正交化、偏置补偿、增益自适应、编码器-解码器分离；并通过稀疏自编码器实验进行验证。

Result: 实验表明，受约束的架构会选择性地降低共同激活特征之间的重叠，而偏置、增益和编码器自由度则允许建设性的交叉贡献得以保留。

Conclusion: 学习表示中的干扰不仅取决于特征几何，还取决于特征如何被使用以及产生其编码的架构。

Abstract: Interference is commonly treated as geometric overlap between learned features. We introduce effective interference, which combines feature geometry and code statistics to capture realized interactions, distinguishing constructive from destructive interference and frequent weak interactions from rare strong ones. Under local fixed-support assumptions, we characterize how architectural constraints shape interference through four mechanisms: feature orthogonalization, bias compensation, gain adaptation, and encoder-decoder separation. Experiments with sparse autoencoders show that constrained architectures selectively reduce overlap among co-active features, while bias, gain, and encoder freedom allow constructive cross-contributions to remain. Together, these results show that interference in learned representations depends not only on feature geometry, but also on how features are used and on the architecture that produces their codes.

</details>


### [1470] [Fiona: Accelerating FHE Inference with Packing-Aware Ternary Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35352)
*Yiteng Peng,Zhibo Liu,Dongwei Xiao,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIONA是一个离线优化器，通过在同态加密神经网络中有选择地对权重进行三值量化，显著减少明文-密文乘法并加速加密推理，同时保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全同态加密(FHE)可直接在加密输入上进行神经网络推理，但比明文推理慢几个数量级。其中将服务器明文权重应用于加密激活值的明文-密文乘法(PMult)占推理时间的一半以上。三值量化虽可用加减替代乘法，但在打包执行下难以实现节省，且全组三值化会大幅降低精度。

Method: FIONA基于三值转换对模型性能的估计影响，在给定打包布局内有选择地对权重进行三值化：鼓励每个权重组共享同一三值，保留敏感组的全精度权重，使层内三值与全精度路径共存；精确编译这些混合算子，对累积输入统一应用缩放因子并跨输出复用求和；利用权重三值化缩小下游多项式输入范围，在累积精度预算下拟合低阶替代多项式，降低乘法深度和自举次数。

Result: 在VGG11、ViT和BERT上，FIONA将PMult操作减少53.4-79.5%，端到端加密推理分别加速2.38倍、1.68倍和1.84倍，且三个模型精度损失均小于1%。

Conclusion: FIONA通过有选择的三值量化与混合算子编译，有效减少了FHE神经网络推理中的乘法开销和计算深度，实现了显著的加速并保持精度。

Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables neural network inference directly on encrypted inputs, but it remains orders of magnitude slower than plaintext in- ference. Applying the server's plaintext weights to encrypted activations involves plaintext-ciphertext multiplications (PMult) and accounts for more than half of inference time in recent systems. Ternary quantization can replace these multipli- cations with additions and subtractions, but the savings rarely materialize under packed execution. A single PMult applies a weight group fixed by the packing layout and can be avoided only when all its weights share the same ternary value. Ternarizing all groups, however, largely degrades accuracy.
  We present FIONA, an offline optimizer that selectively ternarizes weights within a given packing layout based on the estimated effect of ternary conversion on the model's performance. FIONA encourages a shared ternary value within each weight group and retains full-precision weights for sensitive groups, so ternar- ized and full-precision paths coexist within a layer. It then compiles these hybrid operators exactly, applying common scaling factors once to accumulated inputs and reusing sums across outputs. Weight ternarization can also narrow the input ranges of downstream polynomials. FIONA fits lower-degree replacements under a cumulative accuracy budget, reducing multiplicative depth and bootstrapping. On VGG11, ViT, and BERT, FIONA reduces PMult operations by 53.4-79.5% and accelerates end-to-end encrypted inference by 2.38x, 1.68x, and 1.84x, re- spectively, with less than 1% accuracy loss across all three models.

</details>


### [1471] [d-OPD: Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35362)
*Ruitao Liu,Qinghao Hu,Song Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 d-OPD，一种面向未来信息的在线策略蒸馏方法，用于将 AR 预训练模型转换为块扩散模型，对齐教师与学生可见状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 AR 模型蒸馏为块扩散 LLM 时，学生从整个部分去噪块（含可见未来信息）预测，而标准 AR 教师仅基于因果前缀，导致监督信息不匹配。

Method: d-OPD（future-aware OPD）：修正 AR 教师分布，将块内可见未来信息纳入，使教师监督与学生可见状态对齐。

Result: 在 Qwen3 0.6B-8B 上，相比 OPDLM，六基准平均提升最多 4.0 分，训练时间减少 1.35-1.58 倍。

Conclusion: 通过对齐教师与学生的信息条件，d-OPD 有效提升块扩散模型蒸馏效果并加速训练。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) typically generate text autoregressively (AR), predicting one token at a time. Block diffusion language models (dLLMs) instead generate blocks sequentially while denoising multiple tokens in parallel within each block, offering a promising way to accelerate generation. Rather than training such models from scratch, recent work adapts strong pretrained AR models into block dLLMs through distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely used for LLM training because it supervises the student on states generated by its current policy, rather than only on fixed offline trajectories. By training on the states the student actually visits, it reduces the mismatch between training and generation and can provide more relevant supervision as the student evolves. Recent work has extended this idea to AR-to-block-diffusion conversion. However, this setting introduces a fundamental mismatch in supervision: the block-diffusion student and the causal AR teacher condition on different information at the same training state. The student predicts from the entire partially denoised block, including visible future context, whereas the standard AR teacher target is defined only from the causal prefix. As a result, the teacher distribution used for distillation is not fully aligned with the information available to the student. We therefore introduce d-OPD, a future-aware on-policy distillation method that corrects the AR teacher distribution to better align with the student-visible state by incorporating visible future information within each block, providing supervision that better matches the information used by the student. Across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, d-OPD improves the six-benchmark average by up to $4.0$ points over OPDLM and reduces training time by $1.35$-$1.58\times$. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/d-OPD.

</details>


### [1472] [Do Temporal Link Predictors Need Learned Memory? A Smoothed-Count Baseline with a Handful of Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35364)
*Lisi Qarkaxhija,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于统计语言建模的时序链路预测器，通过聚合跨源的转移与共现计数并做平滑处理，无需节点嵌入即可实现有竞争力的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序链路预测器多依赖学习到的节点表示来总结历史交互，本文探究：简单的重复交互模式计数能否在不学习这些表示的情况下取得有竞争力的预测效果。

Method: 基于统计语言建模构建时序链路预测器：跨源聚合转移与共现计数以预测源从未形成的链路；用目的地频率或Kneser-Ney延续计数平滑稀疏估计；用共享对数线性规则将这些估计与流行度、源历史、近因性结合，不使用节点嵌入。

Result: 在TGB与TGB-Seq共16个数据集的主评估中，模型在7个数据集上取得最高的MRR；在全部16个数据集上超过EdgeBank和Base3，在14个上超过启发式方法族；优势也延伸到旨在限制重复边的数据集。

Conclusion: 仅需9--13个学习参数，该模型为评估未来的神经时序链路预测器提供了一个简单且有竞争力的基线。

Abstract: Many temporal link predictors summarize past interactions through learned node representations. We examine whether simple counts of recurring interaction patterns can provide competitive predictions without learning these representations. We propose a temporal link predictor based on statistical language modelling. It pools transition and co-occurrence counts across sources to predict links that a source has never formed. We smooth sparse estimates using destination frequencies or Kneser-Ney continuation counts. A shared log-linear rule combines these estimates with popularity, source history, and recency, without node embeddings. In our main evaluation, the model achieves the highest MRR among the compared methods on 7 out of 16 datasets from TGB and TGB-Seq. It also outperforms EdgeBank and Base3 on all 16 datasets and the heuristic family on 14. These gains extend to datasets designed to limit repeated edges. With only 9--13 learned parameters, our model provides a simple and competitive baseline for evaluating future neural temporal link predictors.

</details>


### [1473] [First Learn, Then Memorize: The Spectral Bias of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35377)
*Raphaël Urfin,Tony Bonnaire,Giulio Biroli,Marc Mézard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 扩散模型先泛化后记忆的时间尺度分离由NTK Gram矩阵谱的双峰结构决定：大特征值部分刻画泛化，重复加噪产生的极小特征值部分对齐样本噪声方向，决定参数化更大的记忆时间尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在有限数据上先学会生成新样本、之后才坍缩到训练集，这一时间尺度分离的机制此前不明；作者希望找出控制泛化与记忆时间尺度的结构。

Method: 将score function训练动力学精确地（任意宽度）归约为噪声训练数据上NTK Gram矩阵；通过对每个样本使用m个同噪声水平加噪副本，分析Gram矩阵谱结构；在惰性高维极限下（线性n≍d与多项式n≍d^k样本复杂度）解析求解谱，并用偏差-方差分解论证；同时在CelebA上的卷积NTK及超越惰性区的有限宽度U-Net上做实证，并通过截断Gram矩阵秩和L2惩罚做因果验证。

Result: 发现Gram矩阵谱分为两簇：大特征值簇（m=1即存在）承载目标分布的全局特征、最小化近似误差；重复加噪产生的极小特征值簇支撑在对齐样本特定噪声方向的特征向量上、驱动记忆相关误差，其记忆时间尺度随训练集规模n多项式级增大。该双簇结构在卷积NTK与特征学习U-Net中均得到验证；截断Gram矩阵秩r可调控泛化-记忆转变，针对第二簇的L2惩罚可抑制U-Net记忆。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的泛化-记忆分离由score-matching损失中多次加噪导致的Gram矩阵谱双峰结构决定，第一簇控制泛化、第二簇控制记忆，且可通过秩截断或针对性正则实现对记忆的因果调控。

Abstract: Diffusion models trained on a finite dataset first learn to generate novel, high-quality samples and only much later collapse onto their training set. We identify the mechanism behind this separation of timescales and the object that probes it. The training dynamics of the score function are governed---exactly, and at any width---by the Gram matrix of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluated on the noisy training data, so the timescales of generalization and of memorization must be encoded in its spectrum. We show that they are, and that the structure responsible has no analogue in standard kernel settings. The use of multiple noise realizations per sample ($m$ noised copies at a fixed noise level) in the score-matching loss is what restructures the Gram matrix spectrum into two distinct parts. The first, of large eigenvalues, carries the global features of the target distribution and is present already for $m=1$. The second, which the repeated noising creates, consists of the smallest eigenvalues and is supported on eigenvectors aligned with the sample-specific noise directions; it sets a memorization timescale parametrically larger in the training set size $n$. We establish this picture on two fronts. Analytically, we solve the spectrum in the lazy high-dimensional limit for both linear ($n \asymp d$) and polynomial ($n \asymp d^k$) sample complexities, and prove through a bias--variance decomposition that the first bulk minimizes the approximation error while the second drives the error associated with memorization. Empirically, we show the same two-bulk structure in Convolutional NTKs on CelebA and in finite-width U-Nets trained well beyond the lazy regime, and we make the link causal: truncating the Gram matrix at rank $r$ tunes the generalization--memorization transition, and an $L_2$ penalty targeting the second bulk suppresses memorization in feature-learning U-Nets.

</details>


### [1474] [Identifying Neural Source Dynamics from Unknown Local Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35379)
*Ayana Mussabayeva,Jiaqi Sun,Anuar Aimoldin,Olivier Oullier,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：在EEG源动态不可辨识时，未知的局部机制变化可提供缺失信息。变化在后续EEG中留下秩一、源特异的签名，结合前向模型与初始化响应可恢复源间交互，并给出充分恢复条件、直接估计器和噪声敏感度界；仿真验证其优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG记录的是脑源活动的混合。即使已知解剖前向模型，仅激发部分源状态空间的实验仍无法辨识动力学，重复实验也无法消除模糊性。因此需要新的信息来源来解决源动态不可辨识问题。

Method: 考虑固定解剖源间的线性动力学，源状态初始化模式已知。改变某一源在单次转移中的更新规则，会在后续EEG中产生秩一、源特异的签名；通过减去匹配的基线响应将其分离，用前向模型识别源并校准其响应历史。将响应历史与初始化响应结合，无需基线可达性、也无需先识别干预系数即可恢复源间交互。理论部分建立充分恢复条件、直接估计器及依赖正确源标签的噪声敏感度界；并在基于MRI解剖的仿真EEG上验证。

Result: 仿真中，基线激发仅限12个源坐标中的4个时，8个未知变化在32/32个系统中恢复了全部动力学；而基线实现、经可逆前向模型的基线回归、以及未暴露被测状态的变化均失败，且显式构造的替代动力学可重现所有基线均值。在基线信息充分时，直接重建也比匹配信息的谱估计器更可靠。非局部变化和前向模型误差即便在源标签正确时仍限制精度。

Conclusion: 未知局部机制变化能为EEG源动态辨识提供额外信息，实现源交互恢复。方法在仿真中有效，但受非局部变化和前向模型误差限制，精度依赖正确源标签。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) records mixtures of brain-source activity. Even with a known anatomical forward model, experiments that excite only part of the source-state space leave the dynamics unidentified, and repetition cannot resolve the ambiguity. We show that unknown local mechanism changes can supply the missing information. We consider linear dynamics among fixed anatomical sources with known source-state initialization patterns. Changing one source's update rule for one transition leaves a rank-one, source-specific signature in subsequent EEG: subtracting matched baseline responses isolates it, and the forward model identifies the source and calibrates its response history. Combining these histories with initialization responses recovers source interactions without baseline reachability and without first identifying the intervention coefficients. We establish sufficient recovery conditions, a direct estimator, and a noise-sensitivity bound conditional on correct source labels. Simulated EEG on anatomy derived from magnetic resonance imaging confirms the information gain: with baseline excitation confined to four of twelve source coordinates, eight unknown changes recover all dynamics in 32/32 systems, whereas baseline realization, baseline regression through an invertible forward model, and changes that leave the tested states unexposed all fail, and explicitly constructed alternative dynamics reproduce every baseline mean. Where baseline information suffices, direct reconstruction is also more reliable than a matched-information spectral estimator. Nonlocal changes and forward-model error limit accuracy even when source labels are correct.

</details>


### [1475] [Inductive Feedback for Mixed-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35390)
*Amir Moeini,Huaijiang Zhu,Daniel Havir,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出改进的on-policy蒸馏方法，通过概率确认框架隔离反馈信息并构造信任域内的目标分布，并推导共享rollout的对称散度估计器以充分利用反馈指导，在知识与智能体基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有利用言语反馈的on-policy蒸馏会转移反馈未激发的教师偏好，同时大量反馈指导未被利用。作者认为这两个问题均源于标准on-policy蒸馏目标：其最小化的散度及其作为目标的分布。

Method: 1) 将言语反馈视为关于“某token在某前缀下是否为下一个”的假设证据，采用概率确认框架，依据教师接受反馈前后预测唯一确定词表排序，并用符合该排序的确认分数在学生信任域内构造目标分布；2) 推导学生与目标分布之间对称散度的简单共享rollout估计器，通过重要性加权双向复用学生与反馈条件教师rollout。

Result: 实证评估表明，该方法在知识类与智能体（agentic）基准上均优于常见的on-policy蒸馏配方以及近期的一种对比式变体。

Conclusion: 通过改进散度选择与目标分布构造，可有效隔离反馈信息并充分利用反馈指导，提升基于言语反馈的语言模型后训练效果。

Abstract: Verbal feedback can identify errors and prescribe corrections, providing rich supervision for language-model post-training even when reliable programmatic verifiers are unavailable. Such feedback, often generated by a capable model, can be used to condition the teacher in on-policy distillation, which trains the student to match the teacher's predictions on student-generated rollouts. However, this approach can transfer teacher preferences that the feedback did not motivate, while leaving much of the feedback's guidance unused. We find that both problems come from the standard on-policy distillation objective, specifically the divergence it minimizes and the distribution it uses as its target. Our proposed method addresses both limitations. First, to isolate the information conveyed by the feedback from the teacher's inherent preferences, we treat verbal feedback as evidence for or against the hypothesis that a particular token comes next at a given prefix. We then adopt a probabilistic confirmation framework which uniquely determines an ordering over the vocabulary based on the teacher's predictions before and after it receives feedback. Using a confirmation score consistent with this ordering, we construct a target distribution within a trust region of the student. Second, to learn from guidance that student rollouts can leave unused, we derive a simple shared-rollout estimator of a symmetric divergence between the student and target distributions over rollouts, reusing student and feedback-conditioned teacher rollouts in both directions through importance weighting. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms the common on-policy distillation recipe and a recent contrastive variant on knowledge-based and agentic benchmarks.

</details>


### [1476] [The Hidden Ratio in Adam: Stable Structure, Compression, and Sign Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35392)
*Yihe Zhou,Tongtian Zhu,Yingxiao Huo,Satya Prakash Dash,Can Wang,Samuel Kaski,Mingfei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究 tied-β 情形下的 Adam 优化器，发现其自适应动态可由一个近似尺度稳定的变换比率表示，该比率具有稳定的重尾分布，可用于 4-bit 压缩存储与联系 Signum 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam 是现代深度神经网络训练的默认优化器，但其一阶与二阶矩 EMA 之间的复杂交互使自适应行为难以理解，本文旨在揭示其内在结构的简单规律。

Method: 在 tied-β 机制下将 Adam 的自适应动态表达为变换比率，并推导该比率的递推关系，从而得到用可压缩状态替代二阶矩的重参数化；同时对比特率量化与符号方法（Signum）进行分析。

Result: 变换比率在不同任务、模型规模和训练阶段呈现稳定重尾分布，而原始矩幅值变化大；基于该稳定性，固定 4-bit 码本能存储该状态且无需辅助缩放，性能与全精度 Adam 相当；Adam 可视为由变换比率调制的符号动量，比率取常数时退化为 Signum，并给出两者学习率迁移规则。

Conclusion: tied-β Adam 的自适应行为由简单且近似稳定的比率结构支撑，这一视角既有助于理论分析，也支持高效实现。

Abstract: Adam is the default optimizer for training modern deep neural networks, yet its adaptive behavior remains poorly understood due to the complex interaction between its first- and second-moment exponential moving averages (EMAs). We study Adam in the tied-$β$ regime, where the two EMA decay rates are equal, and show that its adaptive dynamics can be expressed through a transformed ratio with approximately scale-stable behavior. Empirically, this transformed ratio exhibits a stable, heavy-tailed distribution across tasks, model scales, and training stages, in contrast to the variability of raw moment magnitudes. This empirical stability has both practical and conceptual consequences. First, we derive a recurrence for the transformed ratio, yielding a reparameterization of Adam that replaces the second moment with a compressible state. Leveraging its stable distribution, we show that a fixed 4-bit codebook is sufficient in our experiments to store this state without auxiliary scaling, achieving performance competitive with full-precision Adam. Second, the transformed ratio view clarifies Adam's connection to sign-based methods: Adam reduces to sign-based momentum modulated by the transformed ratio, and replacing it with a constant recovers Signum as a limiting case. This perspective further provides a simple rule for transferring learning rates between the two methods. Together, these results suggest that tied-$β$ Adam admits a simple and approximately stable ratio structure underlying its adaptive behavior and demonstrate its utility for both analysis and efficient implementation.

</details>


### [1477] [Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35402)
*Paul-Peter Arslan,Yubin Kim,Xiao Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在Calvano等算力平台的重复Bertrand双寡头中,预注册随机实验发现:固定交易伙伴会显著提高学习到的价格与利润,即使对手价格被隐藏(无法"惩罚")也如此;纯表格Q学习可复现该效应,大模型结果不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平台可决定重复博弈中谁与谁配对，这一"配对选择"是否会改变智能体学习到的价格、以及价格上升是否伴随"学到的惩罚"行为，尚不清楚。作者通过预注册实验检验配对稳定性对算法定价合谋的影响。

Method: 在Calvano等Bertrand双寡头中，每个智能体的价格由表格Q学习模块设定(语言模型仅附属于其旁)，随机化三项:是否保持同一伙伴、是否可见对手价格、能否发送消息。通过强制偏离探针测量"惩罚",并与静态最优反应对照;另做纯表格学习者重复块实验，以及Qwen2.5 7B/14B等大模型探索性扩展。

Result: 固定同一伙伴使训练平均利润提高竞争-垄断差距的0.27(95%CI 0.20–0.35,20对全为正,主结果),静态价格提高Nash-垄断区间的0.17(事后)。纯表格学习者在全部25个额外块中复现该效应,且单个永久伙伴比约三个伙伴提升更多(+0.23 vs +0.05,探索性)。隐藏对手价格时无法看到降价故无法惩罚,但静态价格同样上升且持续到训练结束;对手可见时该上升随训练变长而缩小(事后)。静态最优反应可解释强制偏离探针所测"惩罚"的三分之一到一半,净除后预注册的"学习惩罚"检验不确定。大模型中,隐藏对手价格时7B/14B均呈现效应,显示时不一致,7B在新鲜块上可复现,另两族模型无效应。

Conclusion: 价格上升不一定来自学到的惩罚:仅检测惩罚会漏掉对手隐藏时的价格上升,而检测"有利偏离"则能标记多数此类价格。平台配对设计本身即可推高算法定价,该结论在多模型上部分成立。

Abstract: When pricing agents meet repeatedly on a platform, the platform decides who faces whom. We ask whether that choice moves the prices the agents learn, and whether a rise comes with learned punishment. In a pre-registered randomised experiment in the Bertrand duopoly of Calvano et al., each agent's price is set by a tabular Q-learning module, not by the small language model attached to it, and we randomise whether each agent keeps its partner, sees its rival's prices and can send messages. Keeping the same partner raises the level of profits, averaged over training, by 0.27 of the gap between competitive and monopoly profit (95% CI 0.20 to 0.35, all twenty paired runs positive), our registered primary result, and the resting price by 0.17 of the Nash-to-monopoly range (post hoc). A plain tabular learner reproduces the effect in all 25 further blocks, and there one permanent partner raises the level more than about three do (+0.23 against +0.05, exploratory). Where rival prices are hidden, the price-setting module cannot see a cut, so cannot punish it, yet the resting price rises as much and the rise lasts to the end of training, while with visible rivals it shrinks with longer training (post hoc). Where the rival is visible, a static best responder accounts for a third to a half of what a forced-deviation probe reads as punishment, on the starts where the rival can see the cut, and net of it the registered test of learned punishment is inconclusive. A test that looks only for punishment would thus miss the rise where the rival is hidden, while a check for profitable deviations flags most of those prices (post hoc). In an exploratory extension, untrained Qwen2.5 7B and 14B models under one prompt show the effect when the rival's price is left out of the prompt and inconsistently when it is shown, the 7B result replicating on fresh blocks, while two other model families show none.

</details>


### [1478] [ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35433)
*Yihang Chen,Yuanhao Ban,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对RLVR中重用rollout导致的策略漂移问题，提出ReSPO方法，用平滑的双分支序列级核替代裁剪操作，缓解梯度饥饿，提升训练与基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR常跨多次策略更新重用rollout，加剧当前策略与数据生成策略的错配。裁剪式策略优化存在符号相关的梯度饥饿：低重要性权重尾部中欠生成的正样本被抑制，而高权重尾部中严重过生成的负样本却主导梯度。

Method: 提出ReSPO（Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization），用平滑的两分支序列级核替代裁剪，该核由α散度变分目标与指数方差控制倾斜推导而来。正分支为欠生成的正样本保留非零梯度权重，负分支抑制严重过生成的负样本。

Result: ReSPO能在训练早期有效从长正推理轨迹中学习，即便累积策略漂移将其推至低重要性权重尾部。在dense和MoE的Qwen3模型上，ReSPO加快早期优化、提升最终训练分数，并在rollout重用下取得更高的留出基准性能。

Conclusion: 验证了在off-policy学习中控制重要性权重尾部的重要性，ReSPO为该问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy. We identify a sign-dependent gradient starvation problem in clipped policy optimization: clipping suppresses under-generated positive responses at the low-importance-weight tail while permitting severely over-generated negative responses to dominate the high-weight tail. To address this, we propose ReSPO (Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization), which replaces clipping with a smooth, two-branch sequence-level kernel derived from an $α$-divergence variational objective and an exponential variance-control tilt. The positive branch preserves a nonzero gradient weight for under-generated positive responses, while the negative branch suppresses heavily over-generated negative responses. We demonstrate that ReSPO effectively learns from long positive reasoning trajectories during early training, even when accumulated policy drift relegates them to the low-importance-weight tail. On dense and MoE Qwen3 models, ReSPO accelerates early optimization, improves final training scores, and achieves higher held-out benchmark performance under a rollout reuse, validating our approach on importance-weight tail control in off-policy learning.

</details>


### [1479] [SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35440)
*Bojian Yin,Shurong Wang,Yuqi Pan,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SOLO方法，用共享只读的末层读出替代私有读出，实现无需更新锁定的局部学习，在十亿参数级预训练中接近反向传播性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向传播需全局梯度协调所有层，但迫使每层保存激活并等待梯度回传，造成更新锁定。传统局部学习虽有局部读出，但无法扩展到十亿参数预训练，其私有读出缺乏来自更深层模块的信息。

Method: SOLO用最终模块读出的共享只读副本替代私有读出，该副本取自上一时刻，仅由全网络输出训练，从而在不传递梯度、不重新引入更新锁定的情况下传递深层信息。

Result: 在340M至2B参数、15B token预训练的Transformer上接近反向传播，平均零样本精度差距在1点内，困惑度差距随规模缩小；无更新锁定时每阶段只需O(1)微批激活内存，吞吐量最高达分区流水线反向传播的1.44倍。

Conclusion: SOLO是首个在十亿参数语言模型预训练中展现内存与吞吐收益的局部学习方法，使局部学习成为大规模预训练的实用替代方案。

Abstract: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning (SOLO), which replaces them with a shared, read-only copy of the final module's readout, the only one trained on the output of the whole network. Taken from the previous step, the copy transmits information from the final module without passing gradients between modules or reintroducing update locking. SOLO approaches backpropagation on Transformers of 340M to 2B parameters pretrained on 15B tokens, staying within one point in average zero-shot accuracy with a perplexity gap that narrows with scale. Readout ablations attribute SOLO's improvement over private readouts to sharing. Without update locking, each of p pipeline stages holds activations for O(1) micro-batches instead of O(p). The freed memory permits larger micro-batches, which reach up to 1.44x the best measured throughput of pipeline backpropagation on the same partition. To our knowledge, SOLO is the first local learning method to show such memory and throughput gains in billion-parameter language-model pretraining. Local learning thus becomes a practical alternative to backpropagation for large-scale pretraining.

</details>


### [1480] [Riccati State Space Models: Non-iterative Parallelization for Nonlinear Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35441)
*Mónika Farsang,Ramin Hasani,Daniela Rus,Radu Grosu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RiccatiSSM，一种基于Riccati微分方程的非线性状态空间模型，其每步流为Möbius变换，可通过单次并行扫描精确计算，兼顾非线性动态与高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSM因仿射状态更新可组合、可用并行扫描高效求解，但缺乏丰富的状态依赖动态；非线性循环模型动态更丰富却丧失可组合性，需迭代线性化，效率低。作者希望设计既状态依赖又精确可组合的非线性动态。

Method: 每个状态维度遵循输入条件化的Riccati微分方程；其二次状态依赖使局部Jacobian显式依赖状态，而在分段常数输入下每步流恰为Möbius变换。由于Möbius映射对复合封闭且可用2×2矩阵乘法复合，整个非线性轨迹可用单次并行扫描精确求解，无需迭代线性化。并提出约束参数化以保证有界、收缩动态并避免极点。

Result: 在长序列分类、回归和预测任务上，RiccatiSSM取得有竞争力的预测性能，相较于非线性LrcSSM（同架构）运行时间减少22%–33%。

Conclusion: 状态依赖非线性动态可以保持精确可组合性，并在单次并行扫描内高效评估，为非线性SSM提供了可行的新方向。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) achieve efficient sequence processing because their affine state updates are closed under composition and can therefore be evaluated with an associative parallel scan. Nonlinear recurrent models can provide richer, state-dependent dynamics, but generally lose this compositional structure: parallel evaluation then requires iterative methods that repeatedly linearize and scan the recurrence. We ask, what state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can be designed to remain exactly composable? We answer by introducing RiccatiSSM, a nonlinear SSM, in which each state dimension follows an input-conditioned Riccati differential equation. Its quadratic state dependence makes the local Jacobian explicitly state-dependent, while its exact per-step flow under piecewise-constant inputs is a Möbius transformation. Since Möbius maps are closed under composition and compose through $2\times 2$ matrix multiplication, the complete nonlinear state trajectory can be evaluated exactly with a single associative parallel scan, without iterative linearization. We further derive a constrained parameterization that ensures bounded, contractive dynamics, and avoids poles in the fractional-linear state update. Across long-sequence classification, regression, and forecasting tasks, RiccatiSSM achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing runtime by $22{-}33\%$ compared to the nonlinear LrcSSM under matched architectures. These results demonstrate that state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can retain exact composability and be evaluated efficiently within a single parallel scan.

</details>


### [1481] [NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35445)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 NeuronSifter，把干预决策质量归因于干预接口；通过状态条件靶点占据场与扩散动力学建模，并按期望干预损失减少选测量，在合成 AD 评测中优于标量暴露/点状态接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNS 干预需预测剂量、途径、方案如何作用于部分观测微环境，并选择能改变决策的测量。现有动作条件预测器把方案压缩为身份 token 或标量暴露，丢失靶点被作用的位置与时间；将点估计交给独立规划器又丢弃了测量值得执行的联合不确定性。因此作者将决策质量视为干预接口属性。

Method: NeuronSifter 将方案编译为带支持掩码的状态条件靶点占据场，用占据条件扩散算子通过微环境动力学传播，并利用期望减少干预损失来选择测量，同时把类型化结局同化到同一后验。

Result: 在 64 个配对情景块的合成 AD 评测中，占据条件将轨迹 CRPS 从 0.165 降至 0.110，干预排序准确率从 0.760 提至 0.880，Holm 校正后配对对比仍分离。决策导向采集终末风险 0.160，匹配数值贝叶斯实验设计规划器为 0.166；其成本比早期设计控制为 0.796 [0.732,0.873]，与匹配规划器比为 0.963 [0.907,1.025]，未与相等分离。点状态和依赖消融接口风险升至 0.220 和 0.199；全后验外部控制器完全持平。公开 AD 试验提供回顾性终点桥接。

Conclusion: 决策质量来自干预接口而非控制器位置；保留状态条件靶点占据与联合不确定性可改善轨迹预测、干预排序和风险效率。与全后验外部控制器持平表明接口更关键，但仍需公开发表 AD 试验的回顾性终点桥接支持外部有效性。

Abstract: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. In a declared synthetic Alzheimer's disease (AD) evaluation over 64 paired scenario blocks, occupancy conditioning lowers trajectory continuous ranked probability score from 0.165 to 0.110 and raises intervention ordering accuracy from 0.760 to 0.880, and every paired benchmark contrast remains separated after Holm correction. Decision-directed acquisition attains terminal risk 0.160 against 0.166 for a matched numerical Bayesian experimental design planner, and reaches the target risk at 0.796 $[0.732,0.873]$ of an earlier design control's cost, while the corresponding ratio against the matched planner, 0.963 $[0.907,1.025]$, is not separated from equality; point-state and dependence-ablated interfaces instead raise risk to 0.220 and 0.199, and a full-posterior external controller ties exactly. Published AD trials supply a separate retrospective endpoint bridge.

</details>


### [1482] [Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35465)
*Pier-Jean Malandrino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tetra 提出一种新型 Leech 格码本与 GPU 内核，将大语言模型量化到约 2.7 bits/参数仍保持较好精度与推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Leech 格量化在 2 bits/权重下质量好，但码本超 10^14 个点无法用查找表；此前内核需在加载时展开并每权重读取 4.804 bits。

Method: 采用同一格的 Tetra 码本，24 权重块用 48 bits，主要索引 Golay 码的 64 状态 trellis 与一个共享 16 KiB 表；内核在矩阵向量积中用六次表加载和两次小查找解码；全模型每行重训一个 scale，对损失最大的矩阵用 4-bit 整数存储并以 4-bit 嵌入表补偿。

Result: 每权重仅读 2.148 bits；Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 全模型为 2.73/2.70/2.73 bits/参数，MMLU 得分 63.37/69.58/75.66（比 4-bit AWQ 低 4.76/4.21/2.46 分），生成速度 113.8/95.0/57.2 tokens/s；GSM8K 上比 FP16 低 9.63/4.62/3.26 分；4B 模型比 llama.cpp IQ2_XXS（2.48 bits/参数）高 23.6 分。

Conclusion: Tetra 在约 2.7 bits/参数下实现了优于同类低比特方案的质量与可用推理速度，所有结果在单张 NVIDIA L40S 上测得，主实验已预注册。

Abstract: Leech-lattice quantization gives good quality at two bits per weight, but its codebooks hold more than 10^14 points, too many for a lookup table. Our earlier kernel expanded the codes at load time and read 4.804 bits per weight from GPU memory for 2 bits of code. We present Tetra, a new codebook on the same lattice. A 24-weight block still takes 48 bits, most of which index a 64-state trellis of the Golay code and one shared 16 KiB table. The kernel decodes a block with six table loads and two small lookups inside the matrix-vector product, and reads 2.148 bits per weight. For full models, we retrain one scale per matrix row, store the matrices that lose the most as 4-bit integers, and pay for them with 4-bit embedding tables. Our Qwen3-4B, 8B and 14B files hold 2.73, 2.70 and 2.73 bits per parameter over the whole model. They score 63.37, 69.58 and 75.66 on the full MMLU test set, 4.76, 4.21 and 2.46 points below 4-bit AWQ at 5.3 to 6.0 bits per parameter. They generate 113.8, 95.0 and 57.2 tokens per second in our engine. On GSM8K, through the served kernel, they lose 9.63, 4.62 and 3.26 points to FP16. At 4B our file scores 23.6 points above llama.cpp's IQ2_XXS (2.48 bits per parameter). Every number we measured for a table or figure comes from one NVIDIA L40S GPU. We preregistered the main experiments.

</details>


### [1483] [Physics-Guided Conditional Diffusion Model for Rare Event Synthesis and Diagnosis for the Water-Gas Shift Reaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35499)
*Md Abrar Rafid Siddique,Bibek Aryal,Qiugang Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出物理引导的条件扩散模型，生成水煤气变换反应中罕见事件轨迹，用于数据增强和故障诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水煤气变换反应制氢中，严重结垢、催化剂劣化和热失控等异常事件罕见，导致异常工况数据难以获取，数据分布不平衡。

Method: 将条件去噪扩散概率模型（CDDPM）与反应控制方程相结合，生成物理一致的罕见事件轨迹；构造条件特征以生成超出训练范围的高质量合成数据；提出危险分数评估工况风险。

Result: 生成轨迹用于增强原始数据集，平衡正常与异常分布；用增强数据训练深度学习模型诊断反应健康状态。仿真显示该物理引导扩散模型在合成数据质量和罕见事件诊断性能上优于纯数据驱动模型。

Conclusion: 物理引导条件扩散模型能有效生成罕见事件数据，提升异常工况下的诊断能力。

Abstract: As the world moves towards sustainable energy sources, hydrogen (H2) can be treated as an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels due to its high energy density and zero carbon emissions. The water-gas shift (WGS) reaction is a widely used industrial process for hydrogen production by converting carbon monoxide and steam into hydrogen and carbon dioxide. However, occurrences like severe fouling, catalyst deterioration, and thermal runaway can hamper the reaction kinetics/process safety and decrease the yield of H2. These incidents are rare, and gathering process data under such abnormal conditions is challenging. In this work, we propose a physics-guided conditional diffusion model to generate realistic rare-event trajectories for the WGS reaction. The proposed model integrates a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (CDDPM) with governing laws of the reaction to generate physically consistent process trajectories. The conditioning features allow the model to produce high-quality synthetic profiles for rare-event domains that are typically beyond the training regimes. The generated rare-event trajectories then augment the raw dataset for a balanced distribution between normal and abnormal conditions. We further propose a hazard score to assess the risk severity of the operating condition based on the operating trajectory. Deep learning models are trained with the augmented dataset to diagnose the health status of the reaction. Simulation results show that the proposed physics-guided diffusion model outperforms data-driven models in terms of the quality of synthetic data and diagnosis performance for rare events.

</details>


### [1484] [Structured Latent Modeling for Supervised Multimodal Information Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35502)
*Wanting Huang,Sanvesh Srivastava,Weiran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个多模态预测框架，通过中间层对比/掩码目标、源级可逆归一化流和监督低秩潜变量模型，将联合分布分解为共享任务相关变化、模态特有预测变化与任务无关依赖，在多个基准上稳健提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态预测依赖多种证据：跨模态重复的信息、单源特有线索、以及仅在联合考虑时才出现的复杂跨模态依赖。现有方法虽促进更丰富的交互，却缺乏原则性手段，在学习到的连续表示中隔离这些相对于目标的贡献。

Method: 在中间层施加对比或掩码目标，并结合源级可逆归一化流与监督低秩潜变量模型；该架构显式将联合分布分解为共享的任务相关变化、模态特有的预测变化和任务无关依赖，并与现有多模态学习假设建立联系，评估模态独立及联合对目标的贡献。

Result: 在多个多模态基准上验证了方法的有效性，预测性能取得稳健提升。

Conclusion: 该框架将中间表示学习与结构化似然引导统一起来，为刻画连续多模态交互提供了实用的潜变量视角。

Abstract: Multimodal prediction relies on diverse forms of evidence: information repeated across modalities, cues specific to a single source, and complex cross-modal dependencies that emerge only when inputs are considered together. While recent methods promote richer interactions, they lack a principled way to isolate these target-relative contributions within learned continuous representations. We introduce a framework that applies contrastive or masked objectives at intermediate layers, coupled with source-wise invertible normalizing flows and a supervised, low-rank latent variable model. This architecture explicitly factorizes the joint distribution into shared task-relevant variation, modality-specific predictive variation, and task-irrelevant dependence. Drawing connections to prior multimodal learning assumptions, our approach evaluates how modalities independently and jointly contribute to the target. Ultimately, this framework unites intermediate representation learning with structured likelihood-based guidance, offering a practical latent-variable lens for characterizing continuous multimodal interactions. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across diverse multimodal benchmarks, showing robust improvements in predictive performance.

</details>


### [1485] [An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35505)
*Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Xiaoyun Wang,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从强化学习视角研究on-policy distillation（OPD），将reverse-KL目标与KL正则化策略优化联系起来，提出Least-Square Policy Distillation（LSPD），结合乐观探索与off-policy数据复用，理论上有$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$遗憾界，实验在六个数学推理基准上平均提升1.59分并提升rollout效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD在语言模型蒸馏中缺乏理论解释，且rollout效率低、策略多样性易丢失。作者希望用RL视角重新理解OPD，并引入价值型RL中的乐观探索与off-policy数据复用来改进蒸馏。

Method: 将OPD的reverse-KL目标与KL正则化策略优化建立联系，提出LSPD框架：借鉴基于价值的RL，加入乐观探索以保持策略多样性，并通过反复学习历史轨迹实现off-policy数据复用；理论分析将其联系到乐观价值学习，并给出理想化下的$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$遗憾界。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准和多种师生设置下，LSPD一致优于现有蒸馏基线，Avg@16平均提升+1.59分；在Pass@k（k达64）评估中随k增大表现更强，说明更好保持策略多样性；完全off-policy变体仅用前25%的rollout批次即可达到与普通OPD相当的性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为OPD提供了RL视角的原则性解释，并给出更有效、rollout更高效的语言模型蒸馏实用路径。

Abstract: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$ regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.

</details>


### [1486] [Improving Generative Model Self-Training with Geometrically Modified Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35512)
*Patrick Batsell,Thomas Walker,Richard Baraniuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出几何修改输出（GMOs），通过重加权生成器雅可比矩阵的奇异值来强化负引导自训练中的负信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量训练数据日益稀缺，自训练（用模型自身输出继续训练）变得重要，但朴素微调会导致模型崩溃和自噬紊乱。负引导自训练能将该退化信号转为有用信号，然而现有方法仅被动使用标准输出中的负信号，未尝试主动强化它。

Method: 引入几何修改输出（GMOs），对生成器输入-输出雅可比矩阵的奇异值进行重加权，增大主导奇异方向的影响。该几何修改放大了标准输出的模式寻求行为与畸变，从而为自训练提供更强、更定向的负信号。

Result: 在多种一步式生成模型上，GMOs 相比使用标准模型输出，一致提升了负引导方法（包括 Neon 和 SIMS）的性能。

Conclusion: 显式强化负信号是提升负引导自训练的有效方向，GMOs 提供了一种通用的几何增强手段。

Abstract: Self-training generative models - the continued improvement of a model using its own outputs - is becoming increasingly important as high-quality training data becomes scarce. However, naively finetuning on model-generated samples leads to degradation through model collapse and the model autophagy disorder. Negative-guidance self-training methods turn this degradation into a useful signal, using a model finetuned on its own outputs to guide the original model toward improved generation. Existing methods, however, take the negative signal in standard model outputs as given. We instead ask whether this signal can be explicitly strengthened. We introduce Geometrically Modified Outputs (GMOs), which reweight the singular values of the generator's input-output Jacobian to increase the influence of its leading singular directions. This geometric modification amplifies the mode-seeking behavior and distortions of standard outputs, providing a stronger and more targeted negative signal for self-training. Across a range of one-step generative models, GMOs consistently improve the performance of negative-guidance methods, including Neon and SIMS, compared with using standard model outputs.

</details>


### [1487] [One Proposal for Every Margin: Zero-Shot Amortized Sequential Importance Sampling for Binary Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35514)
*Ruishuo Chen,Weijia Li,Xun Wang,Yu Chen,Leheng Cai,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出MarginFlow，将二元矩阵在给定行列和下的计数与均匀采样中的SIS提议分布设计转化为学习问题，用GFlowNet实现理想提议，并通过set transformer跨边缘摊销，实现零样本高效采样与计数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生态学、心理测量学及社会/金融网络分析中，常需在固定行列和的条件下分析二元矩阵，核心问题是计数该有限样本空间并从中均匀采样。SIS虽有独立加权样本与无偏计数估计器，但其效率关键取决于提议分布；现有提议为解析设计，准确度随边缘显著变化。

Method: 作者证明理想SIS提议——使每个权重等于计数、方差消失——恰好是奖励为1的GFlowNet策略。据此提出MarginFlow，将提议设计转为学习问题，并利用边缘自相似性（每个部分矩阵本身是缩减边缘的实例）用一个set transformer读取剩余边缘，从而跨边缘摊销；在1904个边缘上训练，零样本评估1190个留出边缘。
